5Fo fɛa efuliana so
nseŋ shin nɛ alubiworapoana mur;
nɛ fo bubɔ bumo be atre mbaanaayɔ.
6Ama doŋana mur cheche.
Fo jija bumo be ndeana kikɛ,
nɛ esa kikɛ maaŋ naŋ nyiŋi
bumo hale mbaanaayɔ.
7Fo Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ e naa ji kuwura
durnya kikɛ so mbaanaayɔ,
nsaa tase fo kuwurputi so a ji demu.
8Feeŋ ji durnya ebi demu
nɛ kumo be ekpa so,
nseŋ ji basa so kuwura
ekpa niŋiso so.
9Fo Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ kutɔ
nɛ basa nɛ baa mɛaŋ
beeŋ tiŋ n shile m ba
nɛ fo kuŋ bumo.
Fo e la ekuŋkpa lempo
awurfoŋ be saŋɛ.
10Bumo nɛ b nyi fo na
beeŋ ta bumo be yirda n deŋi fo so;
Ŋkpal manɛ so, fo Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na
maŋ naŋ pal kama n sa bekama
nɛ baa fin fo kikɛ.
11Men boŋ nshɛ n fur Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ
nɛ e wɔ Zayɔn be kebee so
a ji basa so kuwura na,
n shin nɛ efuliana e nu kusɔ nɛ e wora.
12Mo e maŋ teŋ kegberge
alubiworapo kusoe so,
mo alɛ maa kplaŋ kenu
bumo nɛ b wɔ awurfoŋ to
be kushu so.
13Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ, keni kananɛ
ndoŋana shin nɛ mee ji awurfoŋ.
Wu ma kuwɔr,
m mɔlga ma ashi luwu to,
14nɛ n yili Jerusalɛmebi be anishito
n fur fo ŋ kaŋɛ asɔ nɛ fo wora,
nseŋ ji eyur ŋkpal fo kumɔlga so.
15Efuli pɔtɛana so ebi tɔr amaŋ
nɛ bumo gbagba kur to,
nɛ ajigbelɛ nɛ b sho na
kilgi m pɛ bumo.
16Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ be kebaaji
asheŋ nɛ amo be ekpa so
nɛ baa ta a pin mo.
Ama alubiworapoana gbagba
be alubi e naa kilgi a ji bumo.
17Belubiworapo bee yɔ luwu to nna,
nɛ b ya tu efuli pɔtɛana so ebi
nɛ b kini fo na.
18Ama fo maaŋ teŋ bekama
nɛ asheŋ tir bumo na
bre so mbaanaayɔ;
ŋko n shin nɛ betentaŋasepo
be tama e loge cheche.
19Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ, maŋ kumu so,
sa maŋ shin nɛ dimɛdi
e kini kebaanu a sa fo.
Shin nɛ efuli pɔtɛana kikɛ so ebi
e yili fo anishito nɛ fo ji bumo demu.
20Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ, shin nɛ kufugboŋ
e tɔr efuli pɔtɛana na so,
nɛ b pin fanɛ b la edimɛdi nna
ashi fo anishito.

english_text:
A Prayer for Help
1Why are you far away, Lord?
Why do you hide yourself
when I am in trouble?
2Proud and brutal people
hunt down the poor.
But let them get caught
by their own evil plans!
3The wicked brag about
their deepest desires.
Those greedy people hate
and curse you, Lord.
4The wicked are too proud
to turn to you
or even think about you.
5They are always successful,
though they can't understand
your teachings,
and they keep sneering
at their enemies.
6In their hearts they say,
“Nothing can hurt us!
We'll always be happy
and free from trouble.”
7 They curse and tell lies,
and all they talk about
is how to be cruel
or how to do wrong.
8They hide outside villages,
waiting to strike and murder
some innocent victim.
9They are hungry lions
hiding in the bushes,
hoping to catch
some helpless passerby.
They trap the poor in nets
and drag them away.
10They crouch down and wait
to grab a victim.
11They say, “God can't see!
He's got on a blindfold.”
12Do something, Lord God,
and use your powerful arm
to help those in need.
13The wicked don't respect you.
In their hearts they say,
“God won't punish us!”
14But you see the trouble
and the distress,
and you will do something.
The poor can count on you,
and so can orphans.
15Now break the power
of all merciless people.
Punish them for doing wrong
and make them stop.
16Our Lord, you will always rule,
but every godless nation
will vanish from the earth.
17You listen to the longings
of those who suffer.
You offer them hope,
and you pay attention
to their cries for help.
18You defend orphans
and everyone else in need,
so that no one on earth
can terrify others again.
translation_text:
Kekule Ebɔrɛ n fin kechɛto be asheŋ
1Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ,
Manɛ nna nɛ k du fanɛ
fo ka kplaŋ ma so loŋ?
Manɛ nna nɛ fee ta
fo kumu a ŋana ma so
saŋɛ nɛ n wɔ tɔrɔ to?
2Ŋkpensheŋ e luri
m bɔlɔ basa lubi to
nɛ baa fin bebɔlpo
nɛ b baa tɔrɔ saŋkama.
Shin nɛ b tɔr ajigbelɛ
nɛ bumo gbagba sho na to.
3Belubiworapo bee ji njɔŋ nna
ŋkpal bumo be aparsheŋ lubi so.
Nɛ kejimuniwuraana malɛ kishi fo
nsaa shoduu fo.
4Belubiworapo be shɛŋ
maŋ wɔ Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ to.
Bumo be kamoowu so,
b maa fɛ Ebɔrɛ be asheŋ gba kuraa.
5Ama saŋkikɛ asheŋ
bee nite nɛnɛ nna a sa bumo.
Bumo be shɛŋ maŋ wɔ fo mbra to;
bumo alɛ naa keni bumo
doŋana jiga nna saŋkikɛ.
6Le nɛ baa kaŋɛ bumo be ŋgbene to:
“Shɛŋ shɛŋ maaŋ tiŋ n wora anyi.
Anyi be ŋgbene beeŋ baa fuli saŋkama.
Asheŋ lubi maaŋ tu anyi kikɛ.”
7Bumo be mmalga kikɛ la
shoduu nɛ kafule nɛ kafunti nna,
nɛ bumo be bare kikɛ malɛ yil
asheŋ lubi nɛ alubi be kewora so.
8Baa ŋana ndekarso be ekpa to nna a jo,
a fin esa nɛ e maŋ wora alubi nɛ b mɔ
kenyanyaŋɛso.
Baa dara nna a fin loŋ be esa.
9Baa jo bumo be eŋanakpa nna
fanɛ buluŋ na,
a tɛ basa nɛ b maaŋ tiŋ m mɔlga
bumo be amu
nɛ b tɔr bumo be ajigbelɛ to,
nɛ b pɛ bumo.
10Baa nyaŋ basa nɛ baa pɛ na nna
nɛ bumo be eleŋ kikɛ
nɛ b suge ŋ gben.
11Le nɛ baa kaŋɛ bumo be amu:
“Ebɔrɛ be shɛŋ maŋ wɔtɔ.
E buu mbe anishi so nna.
E maa wu anyi.”
12Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ, wora kusɔ ko.
Maŋ fo enɔ lempo na so
n chɛ bumo nɛ b maaŋ tiŋ n chɛ
bumo be amu to na to.
13Manɛ nna nɛ belubiworapo
bee keni fo jiga
nsaa kaŋɛ bumo be ŋgbene to le:
“Ebɔrɛ maaŋ ji anyi demu
ŋ gberge anyi kusoe”?
14Ama fo Ebɔrɛ na bee wu
tɔrɔ nɛ awurfoŋ ere kikɛ,
nseŋ wora shiriya nɛ fo chɛ to.
Basa nɛ baa wu awurfoŋ na
bɔɔ fo enɔ nna.
Fo e naa chɛ amunibi to na.
15Jija belubiworapo
nɛ basa lubi be eleŋ.
Gberge bumo kusoe
ŋkpal bumo be alubi so,
nseŋ shin nɛ b yige
alubi be kebaawora.
16Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na e naa ji
kuwura kusɔ kama so mbaanaayɔ.
Efuli pɔtɛana na beeŋ mur
ashi mbe kasawule so.
17Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ, fo e naa nu
bumo nɛ baa ji awurfoŋ be kekule.
Feeŋ nu bumo be nfubel
nseŋ leŋ bumo to.
18Fo e naa kuŋ amunibi
nɛ basa nɛ baa mɛaŋ na;
saŋɛ na so, dimɛdi nɛ e la
shishɛr na maaŋ naa tɔrɔ
mo braana n shin nɛ
kufu e baa pɛ bumo ga.

english_text:
(A psalm by David for the music leader.)
Trusting the Lord
1The Lord is my fortress!
Don't say to me,
“Escape like a bird
to the mountains!”
2You tell me, “Watch out!
Those evil people have put
their arrows on their bows,
and they are standing
in the shadows,
aiming at good people.
3What can an honest person do
when everything crumbles?”
4The Lord is sitting
in his sacred temple
on his throne in heaven.
He knows everything we do
because he sees us all.
5The Lord tests honest people,
but despises those
who are cruel
and love violence.
6He will send fiery coals
and flaming sulfur
down on the wicked,
and they will drink nothing
but a scorching wind.
7The Lord always does right
and wants justice done.
Everyone who does right
will see his face.
translation_text:
Keta yirda ŋ deŋi Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ so be asheŋ
1Ŋkpal Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na
ka la ma ekumpo so,
k maŋ la kesheŋ tirso fanɛ
fo kaŋɛ ma fanɛ n firgi fanɛ
kabuibi n yɔ kebeegboŋ so
be kakpa nɛ meeŋ nya kekuŋ.
2Ŋkpal basa lubi ka ŋana
ayoyul to ŋ gberge bumo be ata
nɛ b to n da basa lela
be ŋgbene to so,
3manɛ nɛ basa lela
beeŋ naŋ tiŋ n wora
saŋɛ nɛ kusɔ kikɛ jija?
4Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na wɔ
mbe bɔrɛlambu cheembi na to.
E tase mbe kuwurputi so
ashi ebɔrɛso nna
a keni basa kaplɛkama.
E bee wu kusɔ
nɛ ekama bee wora.
5Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na bee wora
basa lela nna a keni.
Ama e kishi kumu kpakpasowuraana
nɛ baa sha alubi be kebaawora
nsaa maa wu kuwɔr na nna.
6E beeŋ ta ajanwulɛ tushiso
nɛ edɛ wuloŋwuloŋ n lɛ basa lubi so
nseŋ ta kawuliwuli tushiso
ŋ gberge bumo kusoe.
7Ŋkpal manɛ so, Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na
bee wora asheŋ nɛ amo be ekpa so nna
nsaa sha kashenteŋji.
Bumo nɛ baa wora asheŋ niŋiso
e naŋ baa wɔ mo kutɔ.

english_text:
(A psalm by David for the music leader.
)
A Prayer for Help
1Please help me, Lord!
All who were faithful
and all who were loyal
have disappeared.
2Everyone tells lies,
and no one is sincere.
3Won't you chop off
all flattering tongues
that brag so loudly?
4They say to themselves,
“We are great speakers.
No one else has a chance.”
5But you, Lord, tell them,
“I will do something!
The poor are mistreated
and helpless people moan.
I'll rescue all who suffer.”
6Our Lord, you are true
to your promises,
and your word is like silver
heated seven times
in a fiery furnace.
7You will protect us
and always keep us safe
from those people.
8But all who are wicked
will keep on strutting,
while everyone praises
their shameless deeds.
translation_text:
Kefin kechɛto be kabɔrɛkule be asheŋ
1Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ, chɛ ma to.
Basa nɛ baa ŋana Ebɔrɛ
maŋ naa wɔtɔ.
Beshenteŋjipo
loge durnya to.
2Ekama bee fule
mo barkasa nna.
Mmalga belbelso
nɛ b kɔ a fule abar.
3Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ,
shin nɛ kafule be
mmalga belbelso na e ku,
nɛ adonduloŋ nɛ a bee ji
njɔŋ a kaŋɛ fanɛ
4anyi be mmalga bee sa anyi
kusɔ kama nɛ anyee sha nna.
Anyeeŋ kaŋɛ kusɔ kama
nɛ k tir anyi nɛ esa kama
maaŋ tiŋ ŋ kaŋɛ fanɛ an loto.
5Ndoŋ nna nɛ Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ kaŋɛ le:
“Meeŋ koso,
ŋkpal bepɔshipo be kamɛaŋ,
nɛ basa nɛ asheŋ bee tɔrɔ
be kushuto so.
Meeŋ sɔ bumo n yige.”
6Enyɛnpe be nnɔ naseso
la kashenteŋ nna.
A du fanɛ gbiti nɛ b ta
n wɔtɔ edɛ to ale shunu
n lara amo to be eyurpi
kikɛ na nna.
7O, Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ, feeŋ kuŋ anyi,
n shin nɛ an nya kekuŋ ashi
loŋ be basa kutɔ mbaanaayɔ.
8Belubiworapo bee feŋ ŋgbene
a nite kamoowuso nna;
a kpaŋ bumo be asheŋ woraso
nsaa keni asɔ nɛ a daga
kemaŋkura jiga.

english_text:
(A psalm by David for the music leader.)
A Prayer for the Lord's Help
1How much longer, Lord,
will you forget about me?
Will it be forever?
How long will you hide?
2How long must I be confused
and miserable all day?
How long will my enemies
keep beating me down?
3Please listen, Lord God,
and answer my prayers.
Make my eyes sparkle again,
or else I will fall
into the sleep of death.
4My enemies will say,
“Now we've won!”
They will be greatly pleased
when I am defeated.
5I trust your love,
and I feel like celebrating
because you rescued me.
6You have been good to me, Lord,
and I will sing about you.
translation_text:
Kefin kechɛto be kabɔrɛkule be asheŋ
1Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ,
feeŋ teŋ ma so mbaanaayɔ a?
Feeŋ ŋana ma so n chɛr a?
2Nchɛ afanɛ nɛ fee sha fanɛ
ma nfɛra e sa maŋ dese ma?
Nchɛ afanɛ nɛ fee sha fanɛ
kagbenejija e baa wɔ ma to?
Feeŋ shin nɛ n doŋana
e pɔɔ ma so n chɛr a?
3Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ kaŋ kusoe
n nu ma kabɔrɛkule,
nseŋ wora kusɔ nɛ mee
kule fo ere n sa ma.
Shin nɛ ma anishito e saŋɛ to;
nɛ mannɛ aloŋ meeŋ wu,
4nɛ n doŋana e kaŋɛ fanɛ
b kɔ m pɔɔ ma so nna,
nɛ bumo be ŋgbene e fuli bumo
ŋkpal ŋ ka tɔr so.
5Ama ma tama deŋ fo kasha
nɛ k maa loge na so nna.
Ma kagbene beeŋ fuli ma
ŋkpal fo ka beeŋ mɔlga ma so.
6Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ,
meeŋ boŋ kashɛ m maŋkura fo,
ŋkpal fo ka wora ma kelela so.

english_text:
(A psalm by David for the music leader.)
No One Can Ignore the Lord
1 Only a fool would say,
“There is no God!”
People like that are worthless;
they are heartless and cruel
and never do right.
2From heaven the Lord
looks down to see
if anyone is wise enough
to search for him.
3But all of them are corrupt;
no one does right.
4Won't you evil people learn?
You refuse to pray,
and you gobble up
the Lord's people.
5But you will be frightened,
because God is on the side
of every good person.
6You may spoil the plans
of the poor,
but the Lord protects them.
7I long for someone from Zion
to come and save Israel!
Our Lord, when you bless
your people again,
Jacob's family will be glad,
and Israel will celebrate.
translation_text:
Esa kikɛ ka maaŋ tiŋ ŋ kplaŋ Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ so be asheŋ
1Ewulpo e naa kaŋɛ mbe
kagbene to fanɛ Ebɔrɛ maŋ wɔtɔ.
Loŋ be basa maa wora asheŋ
nɛ a bee bɔla ekpa.
Bumo be asheŋ woraso kikɛ
la alubi nna.
Bumo be ekama maa wora
asheŋ lela.
2Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ wɔ ebɔrɛso
a keni a fin fanɛ basa ko wɔtɔ
a nyi asheŋ nsaa fin mo a?
3Ama basa kikɛ wora n foe ekpa.
Bumo kikɛ wora alubi.
Ekama maŋ wɔtɔ a wora alela;
esa koŋwule gba maŋ wɔtɔ.
4Ama alubiworapo maaŋ koya a?
Menyee suge ma basa nna a ji,
nsaa kini kekule Ebɔrɛ.
5Menyi alɛ nɛ kufu nɛ keyeŋiyeŋi nna,
ŋkpal manɛ so, Ebɔrɛ wɔ basa
nɛ baa wora asheŋ niŋiso kutɔ nna.
6Menyi, alubiworapoana
e naa jija betirpo be ŋkre.
Ama Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ
e naa kuŋ bumo.
7Israɛl be kumɔlga beeŋ shi Zayɔn nna.
Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na e naŋ shin nɛ
asheŋ e naa nite nɛnɛ n sa bumo;
nɛ Israɛlebi be ŋgbene e fuli bumo ga.

english_text:
(A psalm by David.)
Who May Worship the Lord?
1Who may stay in God's temple
or live on the holy mountain
of the Lord?
2Only those who obey God
and do as they should.
They speak the truth
3and don't spread gossip;
they treat others fairly
and don't say cruel things.
4They hate worthless people,
but show respect for all
who worship the Lord.
And they keep their promises,
no matter what the cost.
5They lend their money
without charging interest,
and they don't take bribes
to hurt the innocent.
Those who do these things
will always stand firm.
translation_text:
Esa nɛ e beeŋ shuŋ Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ be asheŋ
1Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ, wanɛ e naŋ nya ekpa
a wɔ fo bɔrɛlambu na to?
Wanɛ e naŋ chena
fo kebee cheembi na so?
2Basa nɛ baa wora Ebɔrɛ
kasonu kusɔ kama to na,
nɛ bumo nɛ bumo be asheŋ
woraso niŋi akpa na,
nɛ bumo nɛ baa ji kashenteŋ
ashi bumo be ŋgbene to
3nsaa maa ku efɛ
a deŋi bumo braana,
ŋko a malga asheŋ lubi
a gbiti bumo na;
nɛ bumo nɛ baa sa
basa bunyaŋ na,
4nɛ bumo nɛ bumo nɛ
alubiworapoana maŋ kɔ shɛŋ na.
Bumo e naa sa basa
nɛ baa ŋana Ebɔrɛ bunyaŋ
nsaa wora a bɔlɔ
bumo be nnɔ naseso so,
hale k du kpakpa gba na.
5Bumo nɛ baa ta bumo
be amansherbi a paŋ basa
nsaa maa wɔtɔ nchu na;
ŋko a sɔ brɔbu nsaa ji
a chɛ alubiworapoana to na.
Loŋ be basa bre maaŋ ji
anishinyɔr kikɛ.

english_text:
(A special psalm by David.)
The Best Choice
1Protect me, Lord God!
I run to you for safety,
2and I have said,
“Only you are my Lord!
Every good thing I have
is a gift from you.”
3Your people are wonderful,
and they make me happy,
4but worshipers of other gods
will have much sorrow.
I refuse to offer sacrifices
of blood to those gods
or worship in their name.
5You, Lord, are all I want!
You are my choice,
and you keep me safe.
6You make my life pleasant,
and my future is bright.
7I praise you, Lord,
for being my guide.
Even in the darkest night,
your teachings fill my mind.
8 I will always look to you,
as you stand beside me
and protect me from fear.
9With all my heart,
I will celebrate,
and I can safely rest.
10 I am your chosen one.
You won't leave me in the grave
or let my body decay.
11You have shown me
the path to life,
and you make me glad
by being near to me.
Sitting at your right side,
I will always be joyful.
translation_text:
Kekuŋ be kabɔrɛkule be asheŋ
1Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ,
baa keni ma so;
nsaa kuŋ ma.
2Enyɛnpe,
Fo e la ma Ebɔrɛ
Asɔ lela nɛ ŋ kɔ kikɛ
shi fo kutɔ nna.
3Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ fo basa
la basa cheembi nna.
Ma kagbene beeŋ fuli ma ga
fanɛ n ti bumo so.
4Ama bekama nɛ b shil
a bɛ agbirana so na
bre be etɔrɔ beeŋ wora keshi ga.
M maaŋ tu bumo n lara
bumo be agbir na be esarga.
Ma alɛ maaŋ bunyaŋ amo.
5Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ fo nawule nɛ ŋ kɔ.
Fo alɛ bee sa ma kusɔ kama
nɛ k tir ma.
Fo enɔ to nɛ ma echefoso
be kebaawɔtɔ wɔ.
6Ŋkɛ nɛ fo sa ma na walɛ
nsaa a par ma ga.
7Meeŋ chɔrɔ Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ
nɛ e bee ji ma asoeto na.
E bee bɔla ma kagbene to nna
a malga a sa ma kanyɛso gba.
8Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na be asheŋ
deŋ ma kagbene so nna saŋkama.
Ŋkpal e ka taga ma to so,
shɛŋ shɛŋ maa keta ma kufu.
9Amoso ma kagbene fuli ma nna,
nɛ mee ji eyur
ŋkpal ŋ ka nya kekuŋ so.
10Ŋkpal manɛ so,
fee kuŋ ma ashi luwu to.
Fo maaŋ shin nɛ fo kenya
e luri nchaŋ to;
ŋko n shin nɛ fo esa cheembi
e wu m bɛ.
11Fo shin nɛ m pin
fo ŋkpa be ekpa na.
Fo kebaawɔ ma kutɔ,
e naa shin nɛ ma kagbene
bee fuli ga saŋkama.

english_text:
(A prayer by David.)
The Prayer of an Innocent Person
1I am innocent, Lord!
Won't you listen as I pray
and beg for help?
I am honest!
Please hear my prayer.
2Only you can say
that I am innocent,
because only your eyes
can see the truth.
3You know my heart,
and even during the night
you have tested me
and found me innocent.
I have made up my mind
never to tell a lie.
4I don't do like others.
I obey your teachings
and am not cruel.
5I have followed you,
without ever stumbling.
6I pray to you, God,
because you will help me.
Listen and answer my prayer!
7Show your wonderful love.
Your mighty arm protects those
who run to you for safety
from their enemies.
8Protect me as you would
your very own eyes;
hide me in the shadow
of your wings.
9Don't let my brutal enemies
attack from all sides
and kill me.
10They refuse to show mercy,
and they keep bragging.
11They have caught up with me!
My enemies are everywhere,
eagerly hoping to smear me
in the dirt.
12They are like hungry lions
hunting for food,
or like young lions
hiding in ambush.
13Do something, Lord!
Attack and defeat them.
Take your sword and save me
from those evil people.
14Use your powerful arm
and rescue me
from the hands of mere humans
whose world won't last.
You provide food
for those you love.
Their children have plenty,
and their grandchildren
will have more than enough.
15I am innocent, Lord,
and I will see your face!
When I awake, all I want
is to see you as you are.
translation_text:
Deevid be kabɔrɛkule.
1O Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ,
nu ma kekule ere;
ŋkpal ŋ ka maŋ
wora n da so so,
Nu ma kushu.
Kaŋ kusoe n nu
ma kabɔrɛkule.
Mannɛ efɛ be
kudonduloŋ to nɛ k shi.
2Feeŋ ji n chɛ ma to;
ŋkpal manɛ so,
fo anishi e naa wu
asheŋ niŋiso.
3Fo nyi ma kagbene to.
Fo wora ma ŋ keni kanyɛso
n wu fanɛ maŋ wora n jija.
N yili kumo ma kagbene to
fanɛ m maaŋ ku efɛ kikɛ.
4M maa wora asheŋ
nɛ basa bee wora na.
Mee bɛ fo mbra na so nna.
M maa tu basa nɛ baa tintiŋ
basa a suge asɔ na a wora asheŋ.
5Saŋɛ kikɛ mee nite fo ekpa to nna.
M maa kple kumo kikɛ.
6Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ, mee kule fo nna.
Ŋkpal fo ka beeŋ chɛ ma to so.
Kaŋ kusoe n nu ma kabɔrɛkule.
7Ŋini fo mamachi be kasha na.
Fo enɔ lempo na nɛ fee ta a mɔlga
bumo nɛ baa shile a ba fo kutɔ
ashi bumo doŋana be enɔ to.
8Kuŋ ma fanɛ fo kenishi na.
Ta ma ŋ ŋana fo atɛ to
9ashi basa lubi nɛ baa kɔ ma
nsaa fin ma nɛ b mɔ na,
nɛ ma doŋana nɛ b kulti
ma n wɔtɔ na so.
10B maa wu kuwɔr
nsaa ji njɔŋ.
11B ju ma m pɛ
nseŋ kulti ma n wɔtɔ,
a fin keŋin ma n lɛ nna.
12B du fanɛ ebuluŋ nɛ akoŋ kɔ
nɛ baa fin kusɔ ko nɛ b pɛ n ji nna;
ŋko ebulumbi nɛ b ŋana a dese
a jo kusɔ ko nɛ b pɛ n ji na.
13Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ koso
ŋ kɔ m pɔɔ bumo so.
Ta fo tokobi m mɔlga ma
ashi amu kpakpasowuraana
be enɔ to.
14Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ ta fo enɔ lempo na
m mɔlga ma ashi loŋ be basa be enɔ to.
Basa nɛ durnya ere be kebaawɔtɔ
nawule la bumo be tɔnɔ.
Fo e naa sa basa nɛ fee sha ajibi;
bumo be mbia beeŋ nya
n ji kanaŋkama so,
nɛ bumo nanabiana gba
e nya n ji kanaŋkama so.
15Meeŋ ba fo anishito,
ŋkpal manɛ so,
m maŋ wora kulubi kikɛ.
M baŋ tiŋi nseŋ wu
fanɛ fo wɔ ma kutɔ,
ma kagbene beeŋ fuli nna.

english_text:
(For the music leader. A psalm by David, the Lord's servant. David sang this to the Lord after the Lord had rescued him from his enemies, but especially from Saul.)
David's Song of Thanks
1I love you, Lord God,
and you make me strong.
2You are my mighty rock,
my fortress, my protector,
the rock where I am safe,
my shield, my powerful weapon,
and my place of shelter.
3I praise you, Lord!
I prayed, and you rescued me
from my enemies.
4Death had wrapped
its ropes around me,
and I was almost swallowed
by its flooding waters.
5Ropes from the world
of the dead
had coiled around me,
and death had set a trap
in my path.
6I was in terrible trouble
when I called out to you,
but from your temple
you heard me
and answered my prayer.
7The earth shook and shivered,
and the mountains trembled
down to their roots.
You were angry
8and breathed out smoke.
Scorching heat and fiery flames
spewed from your mouth.
9You opened the heavens
like curtains,
and you came down
with storm clouds
under your feet.
10You rode on the backs
of flying creatures
and swooped down
with the wind as wings.
11Darkness was your robe;
thunderclouds filled the sky,
hiding you from sight.
12Hailstones and fiery coals
lit up the sky
in front of you.
13 Lord Most High, your voice
thundered from the heavens,
as hailstones and fiery coals
poured down like rain.
14You scattered your enemies
with arrows of lightning.
15You roared at the sea,
and its deepest channels
could be seen.
You snorted,
and the earth shook
to its foundations.
16You reached down from heaven,
and you lifted me
from deep in the ocean.
17You rescued me from enemies,
who were hateful
and too powerful for me.
18On the day disaster struck,
they came and attacked,
but you defended me.
19When I was fenced in,
you freed and rescued me
because you love me.
20You are good to me, Lord,
because I do right,
and you reward me
because I am innocent.
21I do what you want
and never turn to do evil.
22I keep your laws in mind
and never look away
from your teachings.
23I obey you completely
and guard against sin.
24You have been good to me
because I do right;
you have rewarded me
for being innocent
by your standards.
25You are always loyal
to your loyal people,
and you are faithful
to the faithful.
26With all who are sincere,
you are sincere,
but you treat the unfaithful
as their deeds deserve.
27You rescue the humble,
but you put down all
who are proud.
28You, the Lord God,
keep my lamp burning
and turn darkness to light.
29You help me defeat armies
and capture cities.
30Your way is perfect, Lord,
and your word is correct.
You are a shield for those
who run to you for help.
31You alone are God!
Only you are a mighty rock.
32You give me strength
and guide me right.
33 You make my feet run as fast
as those of a deer,
and you help me stand
on the mountains.
34You teach my hands to fight
and my arms to use
a bow of bronze.
35You alone are my shield.
Your right hand supports me,
and by coming to help me,
you have made me famous.
36You clear the way for me,
and now I won't stumble.
37I kept chasing my enemies,
until I caught them
and destroyed them.
38I stuck my sword
through my enemies,
and they were crushed
under my feet.
39You helped me win victories,
and you forced my attackers
to fall victim to me.
40You made my enemies run,
and I killed them.
41They cried out for help,
but no one saved them;
they called out to you,
but there was no answer.
42I ground them to dust
blown by the wind,
and I poured them out
like mud in the streets.
43You rescued me
from stubborn people,
and you made me the leader
of foreign nations,
who are now my slaves.
44They obey and come crawling.
45They have lost all courage,
and from their fortresses,
they come trembling.
46You are the living Lord!
I will praise you.
You are a mighty rock.
I will honor you
for keeping me safe.
47You took revenge for me,
and you put nations
in my power.
48You protected me
from violent enemies
and made me much greater
than all of them.
49 I will praise you, Lord,
and I will honor you
among the nations.
50You give glorious victories
to your chosen king.
Your faithful love for David
and for his descendants
will never end.
translation_text:
Kashɛ nɛ Deevid boŋ jemanɛ nɛ Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ mɔlga mo ashi mo doŋana, fɔŋfɔŋ ewura Sɔɔl be enɔ to na.
1Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ mee sha fo;
fo kutɔ nɛ ma eleŋ bee shi.
2Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na
e la ma kefalta gboŋ;
Mo kutɔ nɛ mee nya
kekuŋ nɛ kumɔlga.
Ma Ebɔrɛ na e la
kefaltagboŋ nɛ mee
ŋana mo to.
Mo e du fanɛ benapo
be kusɔ kuŋso a kuŋ ma.
Mo e naa kɔ a mɔlga ma
nsaa sa ma eleŋ.
3Meeŋ di Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na epaŋ;
ŋkpal e ka mɔlga ma ashi
ma doŋana be enɔ to.
4Luwu be ŋgbɛlɛbi chambɔ ma nna;
nɛ kemur be nchu kulti ma n wɔtɔ,
5nɛ luwu sho ma ajigbelɛ,
nɛ kenishipere gboŋgboŋi tɔr ma so.
6Nɛ n ta kebɔltofinfin
n shu n tre Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ.
N shu n tre ma Ebɔrɛ
fanɛ e chɛ ma to;
nɛ ma kushu tɔr mbe asoe to
nɛ e yili mbe bɔrɛlambu to
n nu ma ebɔl.
7Nɛ kasawule gbuŋgbuŋ to m baŋɛ,
nɛ abeegboŋ be kaseto gbuŋgbuŋ.
A gbuŋgbuŋ nna ŋkpal
Ebɔrɛ ka nya agbo so.
8Edishi shi mbe
kamuna to nna a lar;
nɛ edɛ nɛ a bee chɔɔ a mɔ
malɛ shi mbe kɔnɔ to a lar,
fanɛ ajanwulɛ nɛ a bee suse na.
9Nɛ esoso bugi nɛ e lar m ba
nɛ awɔlpa jimajima wɔ
mbe aya ase.
10Nɛ e dii n chena asɔ firgiso
nɛ baa tre chɛrubim na so
n firgi afu to a ba.
11E ta tentembiri nna
ŋ kulti mbe kumu,
nɛ abɔrɛwɔlpa ta mo
ŋ ŋana awɔlpa to.
12Nɛ abɔrɛjembubi
nɛ bɔrɛ be kenyɛkpɛ
be edɛ juŋkpar mo
n fulto ashi awɔlpa
jimajima na to.
13Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ
shi esoso m ponte,
nɛ basa nu mbe ebɔl.
14Nɛ e to atanyembi,
nɛ mo doŋana kikɛ pesaŋ to,
nɛ bɔrɛ nyɛkpɛ nɛ b lara aya fuful.
15Nɛ fo kaponte na shin
nɛ teku be kasawulebi
wɔlto a dese kpantaŋkpalaŋ,
nɛ kasawule be gbaltɔlase
lar n dese kpatokplo.
16Nɛ Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na
shi esoso n to m pɛ ma to,
ŋ gberge ma n chule
ashi nchu chiŋgeliŋ na to.
17E mɔlga ma ashi
bedoŋ lempoana na be enɔ to,
nɛ bumo nɛ b kishi ma
nsaa chɔ ma eleŋ na kutɔ.
18Saŋɛ nɛ kenishipere tu ma na,
nɛ b baa ka kɔ ma,
nɛ Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na kɔ n sɔ ma.
19Mo e lara ma
ashi kenishipere na to,
nseŋ mɔlga ma ŋkpal ma
asheŋ ka bee bɔlɔ mo kenishi so.
20Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ wora loŋ nna
n sa ma ŋkpal ŋ kaa bee wora asheŋ
nɛ a niŋi so.
Ŋ ka maa wora alubi na
be kakɔka nna na.
21Ŋkpal manɛ so,
Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na
be ekpa so nɛ m bɛ.
Ma alɛ maŋ naŋ wora
kulubi nseŋ pal kaman
n sa mo.
22Mee bɛ mbe mbra kikɛ so nna.
Ma alɛ maŋ naŋ kini
kebɛ mbe keŋini so kikɛ.
23M maŋ naŋ wora
n da mo so kikɛ.
Saŋkama mee
gelge alubi nna.
24Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ wora ma
kelela nna ŋkpal ŋ ka bee wora
asheŋ nɛ a niŋi ekpa so.
E wora loŋ nna ŋkpal e ka nyi
ŋ kaa maa wora alubi so.
25Fee ji kashenteŋ nna a sa
bekama nɛ baa ji kashenteŋ na.
Fo alɛ maa pɔlɔ bumo
nɛ b maŋ kɔ mpulɔ na.
26Fee ta kagbenekoŋwule nna
a wora asheŋ a sa
bumo nɛ b kɔ kagbenekoŋwule.
Ama fee gberge alubiworapoana
bre kusoe nna.
27Fee mɔlga bumo nɛ b kɔ
kamubrase nna,
nsaa bar kamoowuwuraana
kaseto.
28Fo Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na
e naa ŋini ma kefulto be ekpa,
nsaa ta tentembiri a ki
kefulto a sa ma.
29Fo e naa sa ma eleŋ
nɛ mee kɔ ma doŋana.
Fo so nɛ mee pɔɔ
bumo so.
30Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ
maa wora shɛŋ a foe.
Mbe kamalga la kashenteŋ nna.
E du fanɛ benapo
be kusɔ kuŋ so gboŋ nna,
a kuŋ ekama nɛ e bee shile
a ba mo kutɔ.
31Enyɛnpe na nawule
e la Ebɔrɛ.
Mo nawule e du fanɛ
kefalta gboŋ a kuŋ.
32Mo e naa sa ma eleŋ,
nsaa shin nɛ mee
wora asheŋ niŋiso.
33Mo e naa sa ma aya shileso
fanɛ chibir na,
a shin nɛ mee tiŋ a dii abee
a maa fiti a tɔr.
34Mo e naa ŋini ma
kananɛ baa kɔ kena;
nsaa chɛ ma to nɛ mee tiŋ a ta
danyaŋ be keta a kɔ kena.
35Mo e naa kuŋ ma nsaa mɔlga ma.
Mbe enɔ lempo na e naa pɛ ma to.
Mbe kechɛto so nɛ e ki esagboŋ.
36Mo e naa lɔŋɛ ekpa a sa ma
nɛ maa nite a fiti.
37N ju m bɛ ndoŋana so nna
n ya pɔɔ bumo so.
M maŋ bɛta kaman kikɛ;
m mur bumo cheche nna.
38Ŋ ŋmɛa bumo n lɛ
nɛ b koso ŋ gben,
nɛ n chichi bumo so n nase
ma aya to.
39Fo e sa ma eleŋ nɛ ŋ kɔ kena,
nseŋ shin nɛ ŋ kɔ m pɔɔ ma doŋana so.
40Fo shin nɛ ndoŋana kilgi
n lara aya fuful n shile,
nɛ ju m bɛ bumo so m mɔ
bekama nɛ b kishi ma na.
41B daa yɛla kenishi to nna
a fin kechɛto;
ama esa kama maŋ mɔlga bumo,
nɛ b shu n tre Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ;
ama e daa maŋ tuge bumo.
42Nɛ n nɔkɔr bumo fanɛ
kepumpuŋ nɛ afu bee ta na,
nseŋ chichi bumo so fanɛ
ekpa to be depɔ na.
43Fo mɔlga ma ashi
kumukpakpaso wuraana
be enɔ to;
nseŋ ta ma ŋ ki efuli pɔtɛana
be ejuŋkparpo.
Basa nɛ n daa maŋ tama fanɛ
baaŋ shuli n sɔ ma
ŋ ki bumo be ewura na.
44Efuli pɔtɛ so ebi bee jɔŋɛ
ma ase nna.
M baŋ yili kesheŋ n sa bumo,
baa bɛ so nna.
45Bumo be aba pɔ bumo,
nɛ baa lar bumo be
ekuŋkpa lempoana to
a chicha kufuso a ba.
46Fo Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na
wɔ ŋkpa to nna.
Meeŋ fur fo, Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ,
ma kefaltagboŋ nɛ fee kuŋ ma.
Meeŋ maŋkura fo,
ma emɔlgapo.
47Fo e bishi kuwule n sa ma
nseŋ shin nɛ efuliana bee nu
a sa ma.
48Fo e mɔlga ma
ashi ndoŋana be enɔ to
nseŋ ta ma n yili eyilikpagboŋ.
Fo sɔ ma n yige ashi basa nɛ baa
ta tintiŋ a suge basa be asɔ na be enɔ to.
49Amoso, Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ,
meeŋ fur fo ashi efuli pɔtɛana kikɛ
be anishito to.
Meeŋ boŋ nshɛ n di fo epaŋ.
50Fo e shin nɛ fo ewura kɔ m pɔɔ so.
Fo ŋini fo esa laraso,
ewura Deevid, fo kasha
nɛ k maŋ kɔ ekar na,
nseŋ wu mo nɛ mbe kaman to ebi
kuwɔr mbaanaayɔ.

english_text:
(A psalm by David for the music leader.)
The Wonders of God and the Goodness of His Law
1The heavens keep telling
the wonders of God,
and the skies declare
what he has done.
2Each day informs
the following day;
each night announces
to the next.
3They don't speak a word,
and there is never
the sound of a voice.
4 Yet their message reaches
all the earth,
and it travels
around the world.
In the heavens a tent
is set up for the sun.
5It rises like a bridegroom
and gets ready like a hero
eager to run a race.
6It travels all the way
across the sky.
Nothing hides from its heat.
7 The Law of the Lord is perfect;
it gives us new life.
His teachings last forever,
and they give wisdom
to ordinary people.
8The Lord's instruction is right;
it makes our hearts glad.
His commands shine brightly,
and they give us light.
9Worshiping the Lord is sacred;
he will always be worshiped.
All his decisions
are correct and fair.
10They are worth more
than the finest gold
and are sweeter than honey
from a honeycomb.
11By your teachings, Lord,
I am warned;
by obeying them,
I am greatly rewarded.
12None of us know our faults.
Forgive me when I sin
without knowing it.
13Don't let me do wrong
on purpose, Lord,
or let sin have control
over my life.
Then I will be innocent,
and not guilty
of some terrible fault.
14Let my words and my thoughts
be pleasing to you, Lord,
because you are my mighty rock
and my protector.
translation_text:
Ebɔrɛ be kemaŋkura ashi mbe asɔ toso to be asheŋ
1Esoso bee di Ebɔrɛ
be kemankura efuli nna,
nɛ awɔlpa malɛ bee ŋini
mbe asɔ toso.
2Karechɛ kikɛ bee shin nɛ
mbe kemaŋkura nɛ kenyi
malɛ bee di efuli nna,
nɛ kanyɛso kikɛ malɛ gba
bee wora loŋ.
3A maa bugi kɔnɔ a malga
ŋko a gbar ŋgbar kikɛ;
4ama durnya to ebi kikɛ bee wu
kusɔ nɛ a bee ŋini saŋkama nna.
Ebɔrɛ wora awɔlpa nna
fanɛ wajɛbu n sa epeŋi.
5Chipurso kikɛ k bee lar nna a ba
fanɛ kejafɔ mo kul ka bee lar ebu to,
ŋko fanɛ ekpampo ka bee lege
kusɔbɔya be kubɔr na.
6K bee fara awɔlpa to
be kaba ko so nna;
n ta loŋ n ya fo kaba ko.
Shɛŋ malɛ maaŋ tiŋ ŋ ŋana
kumo be loŋ so.
Enyɛnpe be mbra na be asheŋ
7Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ be mbra na
bee niŋi ekpa nsaa sa ŋkpa nna.
Asɔ nɛ Enyɛnpe be mbra bee ŋini na
la asɔ nɛ esa beeŋ tiŋ n yirda nna.
Amo alɛ bee sa bebɔlpo,
kanyiasheŋ nna.
8Enyɛnpe be mbra na bee niŋi ekpa,
nsaa sa basa nɛ baa bɛ
amo so na kagbenefuli nna.
Enyɛnpe be mbra na di efuli nna,
a shin nɛ esa bee pin kebaawɔtɔ to nɛnɛ.
9Kabɔrɛŋana walɛ nna,
nsaa beeŋ baa wɔtɔ mbaanaayɔ.
Enyɛnpe be mbra na la kashenteŋ nna.
Amo alɛ maa wora a foe ekpa.
10A walɛ a chɔ shuwa lela kikɛ,
hale shuwa nɛ k maŋ
kɔ eyurpi gba.
Enyɛnpe be mbra wɔ ebel
a chɔ mushoŋchu,
hale mushoŋchu nɛ a maŋ
kɔ eyurpi gba.
11Enyɛnpe be mbra na
bee kpele basa kusoe nna.
Basa nɛ baa bɛ amo so
bee nya tɔnɔ gboŋgboŋi nna.
12Esa kikɛ maaŋ tiŋ m pin
alubi nɛ e wora kikɛ.
Ta ma alubi nɛ m maŋ kute
n wora na m paŋ ma.
13Nseŋ pete ma ashi alubi
be kekute n wora to.
Sa maŋ shin nɛ loŋ be alubi
e pɔɔ ma so.
Saŋɛ na so ma nfɛra maaŋ ji
m bri ma nɛ n ji n lar alubi to.
14Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ nɛ fo la
ma kefaltagboŋ nɛ ma emɔlgapo.
Shin nɛ ma kɔnɔ to be mmalga
nɛ ma kagbene to be nfɛra,
e baa bɔlɔ fo kenishi.

english_text:
(A psalm by David for the music leader.)
A Prayer for Victory
1I pray that the Lord
will listen when you
are in trouble,
and that the God of Jacob
will keep you safe.
2May the Lord send help
from his temple
and come to your rescue
from Mount Zion.
3May he remember your gifts
and be pleased
with what you bring.
4May God do what you want most
and let all go well for you.
5Then you will win victories,
and we will celebrate,
while raising our banners
in the name of our God.
May the Lord answer
all your prayers!
6I am certain, Lord,
that you will help
your chosen king.
You will answer my prayers
from your holy place
in heaven,
and you will save me
with your mighty arm.
7Some people trust the power
of chariots or horses,
but we trust you, Lord God.
8Others will stumble and fall,
but we will be strong
and stand firm.
9Give the king victory, Lord,
and answer our prayers.
translation_text:
Kekɔmpɔɔso be kabɔrɛkule be asheŋ
1Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na,
e nu fo kekule saŋɛ so
nɛ kebaawɔtɔ ki fo so jiga na.
An nananyɛn Jeekɔb be Ebɔrɛ na
e baa kuŋ fo.
2E shin nɛ kechɛto e shi
mbe bɔrɛlambu to m ba fo kutɔ;
nseŋ yili Zayɔn be kebeegboŋ na so
ashi Jerusalɛm to m mɔlga fo.
3E nyiŋi fo esarga nɛ fo lara na kikɛ,
nseŋ sɔ fo esarga chɔɔso.
4E shin nɛ fo nya fo kagbene
be aparsheŋ kikɛ;
nseŋ shin nɛ fo ŋkre kikɛ
bɔlɔ so.
5Nɛ asheŋ nite nɛnɛ n sa fo,
anyeeŋ cha awɔr kagbenefuliso;
nseŋ maŋ anyi be etuta so
ashi anyi be Ebɔrɛ be ketre to.
Enyɛnpetale Ebɔrɛ na e wora
asɔ nɛ fee bishi na n sa fo.
6N nyi geeŋ fanɛ Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na
beeŋ mɔlga mbe ewura lara so.
E beeŋ yili mbe ebɔrɛso
cheembi na n nu ma kekule
nseŋ ta mbe enɔ lempo na
m mɔlga ma.
7Basa ko bee wu bumo be amu nna
ŋkpal bumo be kena to
be egbaŋɛturko so.
Nɛ beko malɛ bee wu bumo be amu
ŋkpal bumo be kena to be egbaŋɛ so.
Ama anyi ere be yirda wɔ fo
Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na to nna.
8Loŋ be basa na beeŋ fiti n tɔr,
ama anyi ere baa yil nna kiŋkiŋ.
Shɛŋ shɛŋ maa gbuŋgbuŋ anyi.
9Enyɛnpetale Ebɔrɛ,
mɔlga anyi be ewura.
Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ,
nu anyi be kekule.

english_text:
(A psalm by David for the music leader.)
Thanking the Lord for Victory
1Our Lord, your mighty power
makes the king glad,
and he celebrates victories
that you have given him.
2You did what he wanted most
and never told him “No.”
3You truly blessed the king,
and you placed on him
a crown of finest gold.
4He asked to live a long time,
and you promised him life
that never ends.
5The king is highly honored.
You have let him win victories
that have made him famous.
6You have given him blessings
that will last forever,
and you have made him glad
by being so near to him.
7 Lord Most High,
the king trusts you,
and your kindness
keeps him from defeat.
8With your mighty arm, Lord,
you will strike down all
of your hateful enemies.
9They will be destroyed by fire
once you are here,
and because of your anger,
flames will swallow them.
10You will wipe their families
from the earth,
and they will disappear.
11All their plans to harm you
will come to nothing.
12You will make them run away
by shooting your arrows
at their faces.
13Show your strength, Lord,
so that we may sing
and praise your power.
translation_text:
Kekɔmpɔɔso be kapandi be asheŋ
1Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ,
ewura be kagbene fuli nna
ŋkpal fo ka sa mo eleŋ so.
Kechɛto nɛ fo sa mo na
e shin nɛ mbe kagbene fuli ga.
2Fo wora mbe kagbene be
aparsheŋ n sa mo.
Fo maŋ kini kewora kusɔ
nɛ e bishi fo na.
3Fo nɛfa mo kashenteŋto,
nseŋ ta shuwa be
kuwurwuro m buu mo.
4E kule fo ŋkpa tenteŋ
nɛ fo sa mo ŋkpa
nɛ k maŋ kɔ ekar.
5E nya bunyaŋ gboŋgboŋi
ŋkpal kechɛto nɛ fo sa mo na so.
Fo shin nɛ e nya ketre nɛ eleŋ.
6Kashenteŋto,
fo sa mo nɛfa mbaanaayɔ;
fo nɛ mo be kebaala na
malɛ bee fuli mo kagbene nna.
7Ewura na yirda Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ nna.
Ŋkpal Ebɔrɛ malɛ be kasha
nɛ k maa loge na so,
shɛŋ shɛŋ maa gbuŋgbuŋ mo.
8Fo ta fo enɔ lempo na
ŋ ŋmɛa fo doŋana n lɛ.
Fo enɔ jisa nɛ feeŋ ta
m pɛ basa nɛ b kishi fo kikɛ.
9Fo kaŋ ba, feeŋ ta edɛ fuful
n chɔɔ bumo m mur,
nɛ fo agbo e shin nɛ b ki fanɛ
edɛ be kepa.
10Feeŋ mur bumo be kaman to ebi
kasawule ere so cheche;
nɛ b maaŋ naŋ nyiŋi bumo
be asheŋ kuraa.
11Kanaŋkama so
nɛ b kre fo ŋkre lubi gba;
b maaŋ tiŋ m pɔɔ fo so kikɛ.
12Fo baŋ to bumo fo atanyembi,
baaŋ pal kaman n shile.
13Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ,
kemaŋkura e baa la fo peya.
Anyeeŋ boŋ nshɛ m maŋkura fo
ŋkpal fo eleŋgboŋ na so.

english_text:
(A psalm by David for the music leader. To the tune “A Deer at Dawn.”)
Suffering and Praise
1 My God, my God, why have you
deserted me?
Why are you so far away?
Won't you listen to my groans
and come to my rescue?
2I cry out day and night,
but you don't answer,
and I can never rest.
3Yet you are the holy God,
ruling from your throne
and praised by Israel.
4 Our ancestors trusted you,
and you rescued them.
5When they cried out for help,
you saved them,
and you did not let them down
when they depended on you.
6But I am merely a worm,
far less than human,
and I am hated and rejected
by people everywhere.
7 Everyone who sees me
makes fun and sneers.
They shake their heads,
8 and say, “Trust the Lord!
If you are his favorite,
let him protect you
and keep you safe.”
9You, Lord, brought me
safely through birth,
and you protected me
when I was a baby
at my mother's breast.
10From the day I was born,
I have been in your care,
and from the time of my birth,
you have been my God.
11Don't stay far off
when I am in trouble
with no one to help me.
12Enemies are all around
like a herd of wild bulls.
Powerful bulls from Bashan
are everywhere.
13My enemies are like lions
roaring and attacking
with jaws open wide.
14I have no more strength
than a few drops of water.
All my bones are out of joint;
my heart is like melted wax.
15My strength has dried up
like a broken clay pot,
and my tongue sticks
to the roof of my mouth.
You, God, have left me
to die in the dirt.
16Brutal enemies attack me
like a pack of dogs,
tearing at my hands
and my feet.
17I can count all my bones,
and my enemies just stare
and sneer at me.
18 They took my clothes
and gambled for them.
19Don't stay far away, Lord!
My strength comes from you,
so hurry and help.
20Rescue me from enemy swords
and save me from those dogs.
21Don't let lions eat me.
You rescued me from the horns
of wild bulls,
22 and when your people meet,
I will praise you, Lord.
23All who worship the Lord,
now praise him!
You belong to Jacob's family
and to the people of Israel,
so fear and honor the Lord!
24The Lord doesn't hate
or despise the helpless
in all of their troubles.
When I cried out, he listened
and did not turn away.
25When your people meet,
you will fill my heart
with your praises, Lord,
and everyone will see me
keep my promises to you.
26The poor will eat and be full,
and all who worship you
will be thankful
and live in hope.
27Everyone on this earth
will remember you, Lord.
People all over the world
will turn and worship you,
28because you are in control,
the ruler of all nations.
29All who are rich
and have more than enough
will bow down to you, Lord.
Even those who are dying
and almost in the grave
will come and bow down.
30In the future, everyone
will worship and learn
about you, our Lord.
31People not yet born
will be told,
“The Lord has saved us!”
translation_text:
Kebɔltofinfin be kabɔrɛkule be asheŋ
1Ma Ebɔrɛ,
manɛ nna nɛ fo kplaŋ ma so?
Manɛ nna nɛ fo wɔ kufɔ loŋ?
Fo maaŋ nu ma
kebɔltofinfin be kushuto,
nseŋ ba mɔlga ma a?
2Ma Ebɔrɛ, mee shu a tre fo
kapa nɛ kanyɛ nna,
fo alɛ maa nu.
Amoso ma kagbene
maŋ dese ma.
3Ama fo la esa cheembi nna
a tase fo kuwurputi so.
Fo nɛ Israɛlebi bee kpaŋ.
4Fo nɛ an nananyɛnana
ta bumo be yirda n deŋi so.
B yirda fo nna,
nɛ fo mɔlga bumo.
5B shu n tre fo,
nɛ fo lara bumo ashi tɔrɔ to.
B yirda fo,
nɛ fo alɛ maŋ shin nɛ
b ji anishinyɔr.
6Ama m maŋ naa du fanɛ dimɛdi.
Ŋ ki fanɛ kushushombi nna
nɛ basa bee keni ma jiga
nsaa wora ma eyurto.
7Ekama nɛ e wu ma
bee wora ma shia nna.
Baa fifi amu nna
nsaa tege ma a kaŋɛ:
8“Fo yɛ fo yirda Ebɔrɛ nna,
nɛ manɛ nna nɛ e maŋ mɔlga fo?
Nɛ fo asheŋ bee bɔlɔ mo kenishi,
manɛ nna nɛ e maŋ chɛ fo to.”
9Ŋkeshin nɛ fo
e shin nɛ b kurge ma.
Fo e keni ma so saŋɛ so nɛ
n la kebi nyiposo gba na.
10B ka kurge ma kikɛ
fo enɔ to nɛ n wɔ;
fo alɛ e la ma Ebɔrɛ
saŋkikɛ.
11Sa maŋ barga ma n yɔ kufɔ;
ŋkpal manɛ so,
ma nɛ tɔrɔ maŋ wɔ kufɔ.
Esa kama malɛ maŋ wɔtɔ
nɛ e chɛ ma to.
12Bedoŋ damta e kulti ma
n wɔtɔ fanɛ apuntona.
B kɔ eleŋ nna nseŋ lubi fanɛ
Bashan be efuli so be egbolu.
13N doŋana na du nna
fanɛ ebuluŋ nɛ b ya bumo be
nnɔ to a ponte to,
nsaa kpɛa kusɔ kama
nɛ b pɛ to na.
14Ma eleŋ kikɛ loge nna
fanɛ nchu ka feeto na,
nɛ ma echɛkpaana du
fanɛ ma awibi ka maŋ naa
chɔ abar so na.
Ma kagbene malɛ ki fanɛ
ŋku bumbuŋ ka ŋalga na nna.
15Ma eleŋ kikɛ loge fanɛ
kusɔ nuunchu ka baŋɛ to na;
nɛ ma kudonduloŋ wɔl
m mata ma anyifar to.
Fo Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na
yige ma nna nɛ n wu
n tɔr shishɛr to a?
16Basa lubi be katuŋ
kulti ma nna n wɔtɔ fanɛ njɔnɔ,
a chɛ a far ma aya nɛ enɔana.
17Meeŋ tiŋ ŋ karga ma awibi kikɛ,
nɛ ma doŋana mɛrge anishi
n yuu ma so a keni
nsaa mushe ma.
18B to beri nna
m barga ma asɔbuuso to
n sa abar.
19Ama Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ,
sa maŋ barga ma ga.
Ma elempo,
ba manaŋ m ba chɛ ma to.
20N doŋana du fanɛ njɔnɔ nna.
Mɔlga ma nɛ b sa maŋ mɔ ma.
21Mɔlga ma ashi
ebuluŋ na kutɔ.
Sɔ ma n yige ashi
apuntona na kutɔ.
22Meeŋ kaŋɛ ma basa
kusɔ nɛ fo wora;
nseŋ yili fo basa
nɛ b shɛr to n fur fo.
23Menyi nɛ menyee ŋana
Ebɔrɛ na e fur mo.
Menyi nɛ men la an nananyɛn
Jeekɔb be kenana kikɛ
e bunyaŋ mo.
Israɛlebi, men shuŋ
Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na bunyaŋ so.
24Ŋkpal manɛ so
e maŋ pal kaman n sa
bumo nɛ b wɔ awurfoŋ to na.
E maŋ kplaŋ bumo so
saŋɛ so nɛ b shu n tre mo na.
E nu bumo be kushu nna.
25Saŋɛ nɛ ma nɛ fo basa shɛr na,
nɛ meeŋ fur fo
ŋkpal kusɔ nɛ fo wora so;
nseŋ tia nnɔ nɛ n nase n sa fo na
ashi bumo be anishito.
26Betirpo beeŋ ji m moɛ,
nɛ bekama nɛ baa
bunyaŋ fo na e chɔrɔ fo.
Shin nɛ asheŋ e baa nyalɛ
a sa bumo saŋkama.
27Efuliana kikɛ so ebi
beeŋ nyiŋi Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na,
nɛ basa e shi durnya be kaplɛkama,
ŋ kilgi m bɛ mo so a bunyaŋ mo.
28Ŋkpal manɛ so
Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ e naa ji
kusɔ kama so eleŋ,
nsaa ji efuliana kikɛ so kuwura.
29Durnya to be amansherbiwuraana
nɛ b kɔ asɔ ga beeŋ bunyaŋ mo,
nɛ bumo nɛ b gbar nchaŋ
be kɔnɔ gba e fur mo.
30Echefosoebi kikɛ beeŋ bunyaŋ mo,
nseŋ ji mbe asheŋ be shɛda
n sa bumo be kaman to ebi.
31Bumo nɛ b kurge kaman to gba
beeŋ ba nu fanɛ Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na
e mɔlga anyi.

english_text:
(A psalm by David.)
The Good Shepherd
1You, Lord, are my shepherd.
I will never be in need.
2 You let me rest in fields
of green grass.
You lead me to streams
of peaceful water,
3and you refresh my life.
You are true to your name,
and you lead me
along the right paths.
4I may walk through valleys
as dark as death,
but I won't be afraid.
You are with me,
and your shepherd's rod
makes me feel safe.
5You treat me to a feast,
while my enemies watch.
You honor me as your guest,
and you fill my cup
until it overflows.
6Your kindness and love
will always be with me
each day of my life,
and I will live forever
in your house, Lord.
translation_text:
1Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na e naa keni ma so,
fanɛ kananɛ mbolpɔkpapo bee keni
mbe mbɔlpo so na.
Amoso mee nya kusɔ kama
nɛ k tir ma nna.
2Kakpa nɛ afitiri bumbuŋ lela wɔ
nɛ e bee yɛr ma nɛ mee ya ka ji
nsaa dese a wushi.
Mo e naa juŋkpar ma a yɔ
eboŋ be kakpa nɛ nchu
maa shile eleŋso.
3Mo e naa sa ma eleŋ popɔr,
nsaa ŋini ma kebaawɔtɔ niŋiso
fanɛ kananɛ e nase kɔnɔ na.
4Hale nɛ n na
tentembiri to mina gba,
kufu maa pɛ ma.
Ŋkpal manɛ so,
fo wɔ ma kutɔ.
Fo kuwurkpabi
nɛ fo kuchuchɔ
e naa kuŋ ma.
5N doŋana be anishito,
nɛ fee wora kejigboŋ a yili ma.
Fo sɔ ma fanɛ fo efɔgboŋ nna,
a keta ma kananɛ k daga so.
6Kashenteŋto,
feeŋ baa wora ma kelela,
nsaa ŋini ma kasha,
jemanɛ nɛ n wɔ ŋkpa to kikɛ.
Meeŋ chena Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ
be laŋ to hale mbaanaayɔ.

english_text:
(A psalm by David.)
Who Can Enter the Lord's Temple?
1 The earth and everything on it,
including its people,
belong to the Lord.
The world and its people
belong to him.
2The Lord placed it all
on the oceans and rivers.
3Who may climb the Lord's hill
or stand in his holy temple?
4 Only those who do right
for the right reasons,
and don't worship idols
or tell lies under oath.
5The Lord God, who saves them,
will bless and reward them,
6because they worship and serve
the God of Jacob.
7Open the ancient gates,
so that the glorious king
may come in.
8Who is this glorious king?
He is our Lord, a strong
and mighty warrior.
9Open the ancient gates,
so that the glorious king
may come in.
10Who is this glorious king?
He is our Lord,
the All-Powerful!
translation_text:
Deevid be kashɛ be asheŋ
1Kasawule ere nɛ kusɔ kikɛ
nɛ k wɔ kumo so,
la Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na peya nna.
Basa nɛ b wɔ durnya ere to kikɛ,
la Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na peya nna.
2Mo e ta kumo n yili,
nseŋ ta teku nɛ nchuana
n wɔtɔ kumo be kaseto.
3Wanɛ e kɔ ekpa nɛ e dii n yɔ
Enyɛnpe be kebee na be esoso?
Wanɛ e naŋ tiŋ n luri n ya
yili mbe bɔrɛlambu cheembi na to?
4Basa nɛ bumo be ashuŋ shuŋso
nɛ nfɛra fɛso niŋi ekpa,
nɛ bumo alɛ maa shuŋ agbir,
ŋko a bɔ ntaŋ a ku efɛ na.
5Loŋ be basa nɛ Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na
bee nɛfa nsaa mɔlga,
a shin nɛ baa ji a lar mbe anishito
fanɛ basa nɛ b maŋ wora n jija na.
6Loŋ be basa e naa fin
Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ be ekpa,
nsaa shuŋ an nananyɛn
Jeekɔb be Ebɔrɛ na.
7Men bugi kadegboŋ na
be mbuna dra na;
nɛ ewura nɛ kemankura
kulti mo na e luri to.
8Wanɛ e la le be kemankura
be ewura ere?
Mo e la an nyɛnpe nɛ e kɔ eleŋ
nsaa kɔ ana a pɔɔ so saŋkama na.
9Men bugi kadegboŋ na
be mbuna dra na
nɛ ewura nɛ kemankura
kulti na e luri.
10Wanɛ e la ewura
nɛ kemankura kulti ere?
Mo e la Enyɛnpetale Ebɔrɛ,
elempo na.

english_text:
(By David.)
A Prayer for Guidance and Help
1I offer you my heart, Lord God,
2and I trust you.
Don't make me ashamed
or let enemies defeat me.
3Don't disappoint any
of your worshipers,
but disappoint all
deceitful liars.
4Show me your paths
and teach me to follow;
5guide me by your truth
and instruct me.
You keep me safe,
and I always trust you.
6Please, Lord, remember,
you have always
been patient and kind.
7Forget each wrong I did
when I was young.
Show how truly kind you are
and remember me.
8You are honest and merciful,
and you teach sinners
how to follow your path.
9You lead humble people
to do what is right
and to stay on your path.
10In everything you do,
you are kind and faithful
to everyone who keeps
our agreement with you.
11Be true to your name, Lord,
by forgiving each one
of my terrible sins.
12You will show the right path
to all who worship you.
13Then they will have plenty,
and their children
will receive the land.
14Our Lord, you are the friend
of your worshipers,
and you make an agreement
with all of us.
15I always look to you,
because you rescue me
from every trap.
16I am lonely and troubled.
Show that you care
and have pity on me.
17My awful worries keep growing.
Rescue me from sadness.
18See my troubles and misery
and forgive my sins.
19Look at all my enemies!
See how much they hate me.
20I come to you for shelter.
Protect me, keep me safe,
and don't disappoint me.
21I obey you with all my heart,
and I trust you, knowing
that you will save me.
22Our God, please save Israel
from all its troubles.
translation_text:
1Fo Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na nɛ mee kule.
2Ma Ebɔrɛ, fo nɛ n yirda.
Sa maŋ shin nɛ n ji anishinyɔr,
ŋko n shin nɛ ma doŋana
e pɔɔ ma so.
3Esa kama nɛ mbe tama deŋ fo so
maaŋ ji anishinyɔr kikɛ.
Ama bekama nɛ b kɔ kebɔrkɔnshi
bre beeŋ ji anishinyɔr.
4Enyɛnpe, ŋini ma fo ekpa na;
nseŋ ŋini ma kananɛ
meeŋ bɛ kumo so.
5Ta fo kashenteŋ na n ŋini ma ekpa.
Ŋkpal manɛ so,
fo e la Ebɔrɛ a mɔlga ma,
nɛ ma tama deŋ fo so saŋkikɛ.
6N nyɛnpe, nyiŋi fo kuwɔrwu
nɛ fo kasha nɛ k maa loge,
nsaa wɔtɔ dra dra na kikɛ na.
7Ta ma kebiato be alubi
nɛ kusoe kpakpaso
be asheŋ woraso m paŋ ma,
nseŋ nyiŋi ma ŋkpal fo kasha
nɛ fo alelasheŋ so.
8Ŋkpal Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ ka walɛ
nɛ mbe asheŋ woraso niŋi ekpa so,
e bee ŋini alubiworapoana
mbe ekpa nna nɛ b bɛ so.
9Nsaa ŋini basa nɛ b kɔ
kamubrase malɛ mbe ekpa
niŋiso nɛ kusɔ nɛ k daga na.
10E bee ji kashenteŋ nna
nsaa kɔ kasha.
E bee juŋkpar bekama
nɛ baa wora asheŋ niŋiso
nsaa wora mbe mbra kasonu nna.
11O Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ,
ta alubi damta
nɛ n wora m paŋ ma,
ŋkpal fo ketre so.
12Fee ŋini basa nɛ baa ŋana
fo bunyaŋ so na ekpa
nɛ fo lara n sa bumo fanɛ
b bɔla so na nna.
13Asheŋ beeŋ baa nite
nɛnɛ a sa bumo,
nɛ bumo be mbia e ji
bumo be kasawule be kapetɛ.
14Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ,
fo nɛ basa nɛ baa ŋana fo
bee ji keteri nna.
Fo e naa shin nɛ baa pin
kɔnɔ naseso be ŋkre nɛ fo
nase dra na n sa fo basa na.
15Ma anishi yuu Enyɛnpe na so nna;
ŋkpal manɛ so,
mo e naa mɔlga ma ashi ajigbelɛ to.
16Kenawule nɛ awurfoŋ kɔ ma nna;
amoso Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ,
ba chɛ ma to.
17Mɔlga ma ashi etɔrɔ
nɛ ma kagbenejija gboŋgboŋi
nɛ k bee ti so ere to.
18Keni ma awurfoŋ
nɛ kebɔltofinfin ere so,
nseŋ ta ma alubi m paŋ ma.
19Keni kananɛ ma doŋana wora keshi,
nɛ kananɛ b kishi ma alegaiso.
20Kuŋ ma nseŋ mɔlga ma.
Sa maŋ shin nɛ n ji anishinyɔr,
ŋkpal manɛ so,
fo kutɔ nɛ mee fin kechɛto.
21Keni ma alelasheŋ
nɛ aworbi nɛ a niŋi ekpa so,
nseŋ kuŋ ma ŋkpa.
Ŋkpal manɛ so,
ma tama deŋ fo so nna.
22O Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ,
jande mɔlga Israɛlebi
ashi bumo be awurfoŋ to.

english_text:
(By David.)
The Prayer of an Innocent Person
1Show that I am right, Lord!
I stay true to myself,
and I have trusted you
without doubting.
2Test my thoughts and find out
what I am like.
3I never forget your kindness,
and I am always faithful
to you.
4I don't spend my time
with worthless liars
5or go with evil crowds.
6I wash my hands, Lord,
to show my innocence,
and I worship at your altar,
7while gratefully singing
about your wonders.
8I love the temple
where you live, and where
your glory shines.
9Don't sweep me away,
as you do sinners.
Don't punish me with death
as you do those people
who are brutal
10or full of meanness
or who bribe others.
11I stay true to myself.
Be kind and rescue me.
12Now I stand on solid ground!
And when your people meet,
I will praise you, Lord.
translation_text:
Deevid be kashɛ be asheŋ
1Enyɛnpe shin nɛ n ji n lar;
ŋkpal manɛ so,
ma kebaawɔtɔ maŋ kɔ mpulɔ kikɛ.
Ma yirda kikɛ deŋ fo so nna,
ma alɛ maa wora shikashika kikɛ.
2Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ, wora ma ŋ keni;
mige ma asheŋ to ŋ keni
ma nfɛra to.
3M maaŋ teŋ fo kasha
nɛ k maa loge na so kikɛ.
Fo kashenteŋji e naa
juŋkpar ma saŋkikɛ.
4Ma nɛ befɛpo maa gama
abar so a wora asheŋ.
Ma nɛ kebirkɔnshiwuraana
malɛ maŋ kɔ shɛŋ.
5Ma nɛ belubiworapo maŋ kɔ shɛŋ.
Ma alɛ maa tu
kumukpakpasowuraana a chena.
6Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ, n fɔr ma enɔ n lar,
nsaa kulti fo bɔrɛsure a bunyaŋ fo,
7nsaa boŋ kapandi be nshɛ,
a malga fo mamachi
be ashuŋ be asheŋ.
8Mee sha fo bɔrɛlambu na,
nɛ kakpa nɛ fo
kemaŋkura wɔ ga na.
9Sa maŋ gama ma nɛ alubiworapo
n ti abar so m mɔ.
Ŋko n ta ma n ti bemɔpo,
10nɛ baa wora asheŋ lubi,
nsaa sa basa brɔbu saŋkikɛ so.
11Ma ere maŋ du fanɛ bumo.
Ŋkpal manɛ so,
ma kebaawɔtɔ niŋi nna.
Amoso wu ma kuwɔr
nseŋ mɔlga ma.
12Ŋkpal fo ka wɔ ŋ kutɔ
nsaa beeŋ chɛ ma to
saŋɛ nɛ k daga so,
meeŋ fur fo
ashi fo basa be nshɛr to.

english_text:
(By David.)
A Prayer of Praise
1You, Lord, are the light
that keeps me safe.
I am not afraid of anyone.
You protect me,
and I have no fears.
2Brutal people may attack
and try to kill me,
but they will stumble.
Fierce enemies may attack,
but they will fall.
3Armies may surround me,
but I won't be afraid;
war may break out,
but I will trust you.
4I ask only one thing, Lord:
Let me live in your house
every day of my life
to see how wonderful you are
and to pray in your temple.
5In times of trouble, Lord,
you will protect me.
You will hide me in your tent
and keep me safe
on top of a mighty rock.
6You will let me defeat
all my enemies.
Then I will celebrate,
as I enter your tent
with animal sacrifices
and songs of praise.
7Please listen when I pray!
Have pity. Answer my prayer.
8My heart tells me to pray.
I am eager to see your face,
9so don't hide from me.
I am your servant, Lord,
and you have helped me.
Don't turn from me in anger.
You alone keep me safe.
Don't reject or desert me.
10Even if my father and mother
should desert me,
you will take care of me.
11Teach me to follow, Lord,
and lead me on the right path
because of my enemies.
12Don't let them do to me
what they want.
People tell lies about me
and make violent threats,
13but I know I will live
to see how kind you are.
14Trust the Lord!
Be brave and strong
and trust the Lord.
translation_text:
Deevid be kashɛ be asheŋ
1Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na
e la ma kefulto,
mo alɛ e naa mɔlga ma;
amoso maaŋ ŋana esa kikɛ.
Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na du fanɛ
ekuŋkpagboŋ nna a kuŋ ma;
amoso maa lɔ kufu.
2Basa lubi baa fin ma nɛ b mɔ,
ŋko nɛ bedoŋ bee kɔ ma gba,
baaŋ fiti n tɔr.
3Hale benapo damta
kulti ma n wɔtɔ gba,
kufu maaŋ pɛ ma.
Hale nɛ baa kɔ ma kena gba,
ŋ kraa beeŋ yirda fo.
4Kusɔ koŋwule nɛ mee fin
Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ kutɔ;
Kumo e la fanɛ,
ŋ ka beeŋ baa wɔ mbe laŋ to
saŋɛ so nɛ n wɔ ŋkpa to ere;
saŋɛ na so mbe alelasheŋ
beeŋ baa bɔlɔ ma kenishi,
nɛ m baa wɔ mo kutɔ
ashi mbe bɔrɛlambu to.
5Saŋɛ na so e beeŋ baa kuŋ ma
tɔrɔ be jemanɛ;
a ta ma a ŋana mbe bɔrɛlambu to.
E beeŋ ta ma n yili kefaltagboŋ so,
nɛ n nya kekuŋ.
6Ndoŋ nna nɛ ŋ kɔ m pɔɔ n doŋana so
nseŋ lara sarga ashi mbe bɔrɛlambu to;
nseŋ cha awɔr kagbenefuliso
m boŋ nshɛ m fur Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na.
7M baŋ shu n tre fo, Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ,
jande nu ma ebɔl,
nseŋ wu ma kuwɔr n nu ma kekule.
8N yili ma kagbene to nna
fanɛ meeŋ fin fo;
amoso nɛ m pere kenishi
nɛ n wu fo na.
9Jande sa maŋ pal kaman n sa ma,
sa maŋ nya agbo n ju fo kenya n lɛ.
Fo e la ma echɛtopo,
amoso, ma Ebɔrɛ nɛ ma emɔlgapo;
sa maŋ kplaŋ ma so ŋko n yige ma.
10Hale nɛ tuto nɛ n nio kini ma gba;
Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na bre beeŋ keni ma so.
11Ŋini ma ekpa lela nɛ fee sha
fanɛ m baa bɔla so,
nɛ ma doŋana maaŋ nya ma.
12Sa maŋ yige ma n sa ma doŋana
nɛ b ta efɛ nɛ kafunti a kɔ ma,
nseŋ nya ma n wora kusɔ nɛ baa sha.
13M baa nyi geeŋ fanɛ meeŋ ji efute,
nseŋ wu fo alelasheŋ durnya ere to.
14Yirda Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na.
Baa kɔ eleŋ nseŋ nya kagbene
a keni mbe anishito.

english_text:
(By David.)
A Prayer for Help
1Only you, Lord,
are a mighty rock!
Don't refuse to help me
when I pray.
If you don't answer me,
I will soon be dead.
2Please listen to my prayer
and my cry for help,
as I lift my hands
toward your holy temple.
3Don't drag me away, Lord,
with those cruel people,
who speak kind words,
while planning trouble.
4 Treat them as they deserve!
Punish them for their sins.
5They don't pay any attention
to your wonderful deeds.
Now you will destroy them
and leave them in ruin.
6I praise you, Lord,
for answering my prayers.
7You are my strong shield,
and I trust you completely.
You have helped me,
and I will celebrate
and thank you in song.
8You give strength
to your people, Lord,
and you save and protect
your chosen ones.
9Come save us and bless us.
Be our shepherd and always
carry us in your arms.
translation_text:
Kechɛto be kefin be kabɔrɛkule be asheŋ
1Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ,
fo e la kefaltagboŋ a kuŋ ma.
Amoso, nu ma kekule
nsaa maŋ kplaŋ ma so.
Fo baŋ kplaŋ ma so,
k maaŋ chɛr nɛ n wu
n yɔ nchaŋ to.
2Jande, nu ma kekule,
saŋɛ so nɛ m maŋ ma enɔana so
n shoŋi fo bɔrɛlambu cheembi na
a bunyaŋ fo nsaa kule fo,
a fin kechɛto ere.
3Sa maŋ ta ma n ti
kumukpakpasowuraana
nɛ basa lubi nɛ baa malga
bumo braana kutɔ kashaso
nsaa kre bumo ŋkre lubi
ashi bumo be ŋgbene to na so
ŋ kaŋɛ fanɛ n ji n tɔr.
4Gberge bumo kusoe
ŋkpal bumo be ashuŋ lubi so;
Shin nɛ b nya bumo
be asheŋ lubi be kakɔka;
n shin nɛ bumo be asheŋ lubi
nɛ b wora na kikɛ e laŋɛ bumo so.
5Bumo be shɛŋ maŋ wɔ
Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ be asheŋ to.
Amoso e beeŋ gberge bumo kusoe
nseŋ mur bumo cheche.
6Meeŋ di Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na epaŋ,
ŋkpal e ka nu ma kushu
nseŋ chɛ ma to so.
7Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na e naa
sa ma eleŋ nsaa kuŋ ma.
N yirda mo kashenteŋto.
E chɛ ma to n shin nɛ
ma kagbene fuli ma.
Amoso meeŋ ji eyur
nseŋ boŋ nshɛ
n di mo epaŋ.
8Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na
e naa sa mbe basa eleŋ.
Mo e naa kuŋ nsaa mɔlga
mbe ewura laraso.
9Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ,
mɔlga fo basa;
nɛfa fo basa laraso.
Baa keni bumo so
fanɛ kananɛ mbolpɔkpapo
bee keni mbe mbɔlpo so
na mbanaayɔ na.

english_text:
(A psalm by David.)
The Voice of the Lord in a Storm
1 All you angels in heaven,
honor the glory and power
of the Lord!
2Honor the wonderful name
of the Lord,
and worship the Lord
most holy and glorious.
3The voice of the Lord
echoes over the oceans.
The glorious Lord God
thunders above the roar
of the raging sea,
4and his voice is mighty
and marvelous.
5The voice of the Lord
destroys the cedar trees;
the Lord shatters cedars
on Mount Lebanon.
6God makes Mount Lebanon
skip like a calf
and Mount Hermon
jump like a wild ox.
7The voice of the Lord
makes lightning flash
8and the desert tremble.
And because of the Lord,
the desert near Kadesh
shivers and shakes.
9The voice of the Lord
makes deer give birth
before their time.
Forests are stripped of leaves,
and the temple is filled
with shouts of praise.
10The Lord rules on his throne,
king of the flood forever.
11Pray that our Lord
will make us strong
and give us peace.
translation_text:
Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ be ebɔl ashi afugboŋ to be asheŋ
1Menyi emalaika nɛ men wɔ
ebɔrɛso e di Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na epaŋ,
ŋkpal mbe kemaŋkura nɛ eleŋ so.
2Men di mbe ketre
nɛ k kɔ kemaŋkura na epaŋ;
nseŋ bunyaŋ mo ŋkpal e ka du
cheembi nsaa kɔ kemaŋkura so.
3Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na
be ebɔl bee gbri teku so nna
fanɛ bɔrɛ ka bee ponte na.
4Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na
be ebɔl kɔ eleŋ nna;
nɛ mbe kamalga kɔ
yuku kumo to.
5Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ be kamalga
bee buri ndibi nɛ baa
tre sida na to nna.
K bee buri sida be ndibi
nɛ a wɔ Lebanɔn be kebeegboŋ
na so burburbi nna.
6Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na
be kamalga e naa shin nɛ
Lebanɔn be kebeegboŋ na
bee tɛto fanɛ kenabi,
nɛ Hɛɛmɔn be kebeegboŋ
malɛ bee tɛto fanɛ gbolu fɔlbi.
7Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ be kamalga
bee nyɛkpɛ nna fanɛ
bɔrɛ ka nyɛkpɛ na.
8Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na be kamalga
bee shin nna nɛ keshishɛrsawule
bee gbuŋgbuŋ to.
Mbe kamalga e shin nɛ Kadɛsh
be keshishɛrsawule gbuŋgbuŋ to.
9Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ be kamalga
e naa shin nɛ ndibigboŋ
bee gbuŋgbuŋ to;
nɛ kupo to be ndibi be afantaŋ
bee chuge a tɔr;
nɛ basa nɛ b wɔ mbe bɔrɛlambu na to
bee ponte a kaŋɛ fanɛ kemaŋkura
e baa la Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ peya.
10Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na e naa ji kuwura
nchuaana nɛ a wɔ nchiŋ gba so.
E bee ji kuwura nna mbaanaayɔ.
11Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na
e naa sa mbe basa eleŋ,
nsaa nɛfa bumo nɛ kagbenewushi.

english_text:
(A psalm by David for the dedication of the temple.)
A Prayer of Thanks
1I will praise you, Lord!
You saved me from the grave
and kept my enemies
from celebrating my death.
2I prayed to you, Lord God,
and you healed me,
3saving me from death
and the grave.
4Your faithful people, Lord,
will praise you with songs
and honor your holy name.
5Your anger lasts a little while,
but your kindness lasts
for a lifetime.
At night we may cry,
but when morning comes
we will celebrate.
6I felt secure and thought,
“I'll never be shaken!”
7You, Lord, were my friend,
and you made me strong
as a mighty mountain.
But when you hid your face,
I was crushed.
8I prayed to you, Lord,
and in my prayer I said,
9“What good will it do you
if I am in the grave?
Once I have turned to dust,
how can I praise you
or tell how loyal you are?
10Have pity, Lord! Help!”
11You have turned my sorrow
into joyful dancing.
No longer am I sad
and wearing sackcloth.
12I thank you from my heart,
and I will never stop
singing your praises,
my Lord and my God.
translation_text:
Kechɔrɔ be kabɔrɛkule be asheŋ
1Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ, meeŋ fur fo;
ŋkpal fo ka mɔlga ma
nsaa maŋ shin nɛ ma doŋana
ji eyur ŋkpal b ka pɔɔ ma so so.
2N shu n tre fo Enyɛnpe ma Ebɔrɛ;
nɛ fo chɛ ma to,
3nsaa maŋ shin nɛ n yɔ nchaŋ to.
N daa gbar nchaŋ be kɔnɔ nna,
nɛ fo mɔlga ma, a maŋ shin nɛ n wu.
4Menyi nɛ menyee ji kashenteŋ na
e boŋ nshɛ n chɔrɔ Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ,
ŋkpal asɔ lela nɛ e wora n sa anyi na so.
5E maa nya agbo a chɛr;
Mbe kelela bre wɔtɔ nna
n sa esa saŋɛ nɛ e wɔ ŋkpa to kikɛ.
Kushu beeŋ tiŋ m ba kanyɛso,
ama kare tea ka chɛ nɛ kagbenefuli ba.
6Ŋ ka daŋ nya asɔ nɛ mee sha na;
n daŋ fɛ nna fanɛ shɛŋ
maaŋ naŋ tir ma kikɛ.
7Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ,
fo daŋ wora ma kelela,
n sa ma eleŋ fanɛ kebeegboŋ na.
Ama fo ka pal kaman n sa ma
nɛ kufu pɛ ma ga.
8Fo Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na
nɛ mee shu a tre,
fanɛ fo wu ma kuwɔr.
9Manɛ be tɔnɔ nɛ ma luwu
kɔ n sa fo?
Manɛ nɛ ma keyɔ nchaŋ to
beeŋ wora fo?
Bubuni beeŋ tiŋ n fur fo a?
Baaŋ tiŋ m malga fo kashenteŋji
nɛ alelasheŋ be asheŋ a?
10Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ,
jande, nu ma kekule,
nseŋ wu ma kuwɔr n chɛ ma to.
11Fo e chɛrga ma kushu
ŋ ki kayurji;
nɛ m maŋ naŋ buu
kagbenejijaso be asɔbuuso.
12Amoso m maaŋ lo ma kɔnɔ.
Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ, meeŋ fur fo,
a di fo ketre epaŋ mbaanaayɔ.

english_text:
(A psalm by David for the music leader.)
A Prayer for Protection
1I come to you, Lord,
for protection.
Don't let me be ashamed.
Do as you have promised
and rescue me.
2Listen to my prayer
and hurry to save me.
Be my mighty rock
and the fortress
where I am safe.
3You, Lord God,
are my mighty rock
and my fortress.
Lead me and guide me,
so that your name
will be honored.
4Protect me from hidden traps
and keep me safe.
5 You are faithful,
and I trust you
because you rescued me.
6I hate the worshipers
of worthless idols,
but I trust you, Lord.
7I celebrate and shout
because you are kind.
You saw all my suffering,
and you cared for me.
8You kept me from the hands
of my enemies,
and you set me free.
9Have pity, Lord!
I am hurting and almost blind.
My whole body aches.
10I have known only sorrow
all my life long, and I suffer
year after year.
I am weak from sin,
and my bones are limp.
11My enemies insult me.
Neighbors are even worse,
and I disgust my friends.
People meet me on the street,
and they turn and run.
12I am completely forgotten
like someone dead.
I am merely a broken dish.
13I hear the crowds whisper,
“Everyone is afraid!”
They are plotting and scheming
to murder me.
14But I trust you, Lord,
and I claim you as my God.
15My life is in your hands.
Save me from enemies
who hunt me down.
16Smile on me, your servant.
Have pity and rescue me.
17I pray only to you.
Don't disappoint me.
Disappoint my cruel enemies
until they lie silent
in their graves.
18Silence those proud liars!
Make them stop bragging
and insulting your people.
19You are wonderful,
and while everyone watches,
you store up blessings for all
who honor and trust you.
20You are their shelter
from harmful plots,
and you are their protection
from vicious gossip.
21I will praise you, Lord,
for showing great kindness
when I was like a city
under attack.
22I was terrified and thought,
“They've chased me
far away from you!”
But you answered my prayer
when I shouted for help.
23 All who belong to the Lord,
show how you love him.
The Lord protects the faithful,
but he severely punishes
everyone who is proud.
24All who trust the Lord,
be cheerful and strong.
translation_text:
Yirda be kabɔrɛkule be asheŋ
1Fo Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na
kutɔ nɛ m ba nɛ fo kuŋ ma.
Sa maŋ shin nɛ n ji anishinyɔr.
Enyɛnpe, jande, sɔ ma n yige;
ŋkpal fo ka la esa niŋiso so.
2Nu ma kekule
nseŋ mɔlga ma manaŋ.
Baa la ma kefaltagboŋ,
nɛ kumɔlga be kakpa lempo
nɛ mee nya kumɔlga fo kutɔ.
3Fo Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na,
e la ma kefaltagboŋ a kuŋ ma.
Amoso baa juŋkpar
a ŋini ma ekpa lela na;
nɛ fo ketre e nya kemaŋkura.
4Kuŋ ma ashi ajigbelɛ
nɛ ma doŋana sho ma to,
n shin nɛ n nya kumɔlga.
5Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ,
fo e naa keni ma so.
Jande mɔlga ma ŋkpal fo
ka la eshenteŋjipo so.
6Ŋ kishi basa nɛ baa shuŋ agbir
nɛ a maŋ la shɛŋ na ga.
Fo Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na nɛ n yirda.
7Ma kagbene beeŋ fuli ma, nɛ n ji eyur
ŋkpal fo kasha nɛ k maa loge na so.
Fo wu ma etɔrɔ nɛ awurfoŋ
nseŋ chɛ ma to.
8Fo maŋ yige ma n wɔtɔ
ma doŋana be enɔ to.
Ama fo sɔ ma n yige,
nɛ n nya ma kumu a ji.
9Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ wu ma kuwɔr
ŋkpal tɔrɔ nɛ n wɔtɔ so.
N shu nɛ ma anishi puŋi m puŋi;
hale ma eyur to kikɛ bee besa ma.
10Kagbenejija shin nɛ n bel katiŋso;
nɛ kebɔltofinfin bee ku ma ŋkpa so.
Awurfoŋ shin nɛ ŋ ki esa pɔso,
nɛ ma awibi to maŋ naa kɔ eleŋ.
11N doŋana nɛ ma bechenashapo
kikɛ bee keni ma jiga nna.
Ŋ ki kusɔ ŋana so n teriana kutɔ,
nɛ baa wu ma nsaa shile.
12B teŋ ma so nna fanɛ esa nɛ e wu,
nɛ ŋ ki fanɛ kapɛlanfu na.
13N nu basa ka bee kuli ma,
nɛ kufu pɛ ma ga.
B yɛ, baa kre ma ŋkre nna,
a fin ma nɛ b mɔ.
14Ama ma yirda deŋ fo so nna.
Enyɛnpe, fo e la ma Ebɔrɛ.
15Ma ŋkpa wɔ fo enɔ to nna.
Mɔlga ma ashi ma doŋana
nɛ b ju a buu ma so
saŋkama na kutɔ.
16Wu fo kenya kuwɔr
nseŋ mɔlga ma,
ŋkpal fo kasha
nɛ k maŋ kɔ ekar na so.
17Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ,
fo nɛ mee shu a tre.
Sa maŋ shin nɛ anishinyɔr
e ji ma.
Ama shin nɛ basa lubi bre
e ji anishinyɔr,
hale n ya wu n yɔ nchaŋ to.
18Shin nɛ befɛpo na
e lo bumo be nnɔ.
Bumo e naa wu bumo be amu
nsaa keni basa niŋiso jiga na.
19Fo kelela shi m baŋ so;
nɛ fee sha kebaawora basa
nɛ baa ŋana fo kelela.
Ekama nyi fo kelela nɛ kananɛ
fee kuŋ basa nɛ b yirda fo.
20Fee kuŋ bumo ashi basa
nɛ baa kre bumo ŋkre lubi
be enɔ to nna,
nsaa ta bumo a gelge katege
nɛ asheŋ nɛ bedoŋ bee ku
a deŋi bumo.
21Kapandi e baa la Enyɛnpe na peya.
Ŋkpal manɛ so e ŋini ma kashagboŋ,
saŋɛ so nɛ bedoŋ kulti ma n wɔtɔ
fanɛ kananɛ benapo bee kulti kadegboŋ
nɛ b pɔr egbal ŋ kulti a wɔtɔ na.
22Kufu daa kɔ ma nna,
nɛ n daa fɛ fanɛ Ebɔrɛ ju ma
ashi mbe anishito nna.
Ama n shu n tre mo
fanɛ e chɛ ma to,
nɛ e nu ma kekule.
23Menyi Ebɔrɛ be basa
e baa sha Enyɛnpe na.
Ŋkpal manɛ so,
e bee kuŋ beshenteŋjipo nna,
nsaa gberge kamoowuwuraana
bre kusoe kananɛ k daga bumo.
24Amoso menyi kikɛ nɛ men be yirda
deŋ Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na so na,
e baa kɔ eleŋ nsaa leŋ men be amu to.

english_text:
(A special psalm by David.)
The Joy of Forgiveness
1 Our Lord, you bless everyone
whose sins you forgive
and wipe away.
2You bless them by saying,
“You told me your sins,
without trying to hide them,
and now I forgive you.”
3Before I confessed my sins,
my bones felt limp,
and I groaned all day long.
4Night and day your hand
weighed heavily on me,
and my strength was gone
as in the summer heat.
5So I confessed my sins
and told them all to you.
I said, “I'll tell the Lord
each one of my sins.”
Then you forgave me
and took away my guilt.
6We worship you, Lord,
and we should always pray
whenever we find out
that we have sinned.
Then we won't be swept away
by a raging flood.
7You are my hiding place!
You protect me from trouble,
and you put songs in my heart
because you have saved me.
8You said to me,
“I will point out the road
that you should follow.
I will be your teacher
and watch over you.
9Don't be stupid
like horses and mules
that must be led with ropes
to make them obey.”
10All kinds of troubles
will strike the wicked,
but your kindness shields those
who trust you, Lord.
11And so your good people
should celebrate and shout.
translation_text:
Ketampaŋ be kabɔrɛkule be asheŋ
1Kagbenefuli la bekama
nɛ Ebɔrɛ ta bumo be alubi
m paŋ bumo na peya nna.
Bumo nɛ e ta bumo
be aworandeso ŋ kɛ bumo na.
2Kagbenefuli la esa nɛ
Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ maŋ naa nyiŋi
mbe alubi na peya nna.
Mo e maŋ ta kulubi kikɛ
ŋ ŋana mbe kagbene to na.
3Ŋ ka daa maŋ tuba
ashi ma alubi to na;
egbɛ ko daa deŋ ma so nna
ŋkpal kare chɛ kikɛ be kushu so.
4Fo kasogberge daa wɔ ma so
kapa nɛ kanyɛ nna;
nɛ ma eleŋ kikɛ loge fanɛ ketarso
be epeŋi ka shin nɛ nchu feeto na.
5Nɛ n tuba nseŋ kaŋɛ fo ma alubi kikɛ.
M maŋ naŋ ta kulubi kikɛ n ŋana;
nɛ fo ta ma alubi kikɛ m paŋ ma.
6Amoso fo kama nɛ fee ŋana Ebɔrɛ,
nsaa wɔ tɔrɔ to, fo kule mo.
Saŋɛ na so, tɔrɔ be awɔrfoŋ nɛ k du
fanɛ nchu ka to chufulgboŋ
a ba eleŋso na maaŋ sulɔ fo n yɔ.
7Fo e la ma eŋanakpa.
Fo alɛ beeŋ mɔlga ma ashi tɔrɔ to;
nɛ m boŋ nshɛ awɔrso
ŋkpal fo ka mɔlga ma so.
8Fo yɛ feeŋ ŋini ma
ekpa nɛ meeŋ bɔla so.
Feeŋ ji ma asoeto
nseŋ keni ma so.
9Amoso n sa maŋ wuli
fanɛ gbaŋɛ ŋko kurma;
nɛ baa wɔtɔ kebarga ŋko efɔl
pɔɛŋ nɛ e bee shuli
a sa mo nyɛnpe na.
10Belubiworapo beeŋ luri
awurfoŋ be yiri yiri to.
Ama Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na
beeŋ ta mbe kasha
nɛ k maa loge na ŋ kuŋ
basa nɛ b yirda mo na bre.
11Amoso, menyi bekama
nɛ menyee wora asheŋ niŋiso na;
e shin nɛ men be ŋgbene
e fuli menyi nɛ men ji eyur;
ŋkpal kusɔ nɛ Enyɛnpe na wora so.
Menyi nɛ menyee wora mo kasonu na
e boŋ nshɛ kagbenefuliso.

english_text:
Sing Praises to the Lord
1You are the Lord's people.
Obey him and celebrate!
He deserves your praise.
2Praise the Lord with harps!
Use harps with ten strings
to make music for him.
3Sing a new song. Shout!
Play beautiful music.
4The Lord is truthful;
he can be trusted.
5He loves justice and fairness,
and he is kind to everyone
everywhere on earth.
6The Lord made the heavens
and everything in them
by his word.
7He scooped up the ocean
and stored the water.
8Everyone in this world
should worship and honor
the Lord!
9As soon as he spoke
the world was created;
at his command,
the earth was formed.
10The Lord destroys the plans
and spoils the schemes
of the nations.
11But what the Lord has planned
will stand forever.
His thoughts never change.
12The Lord blesses each nation
that worships only him.
He blesses his chosen ones.
13The Lord looks at the world
14from his throne in heaven,
and he watches us all.
15The Lord gave us each a mind,
and nothing we do
can be hidden from him.
16 Mighty armies alone
cannot win wars for a king;
great strength by itself
cannot keep a soldier safe.
17In war the strength of a horse
cannot be trusted
to take you to safety.
18But the Lord watches over
all
who honor him
and trust his kindness.
19He protects them from death
and starvation.
20We depend on you, Lord,
to help and protect us.
21You make our hearts glad
because we trust you,
the only God.
22Be kind and bless us!
We depend on you.
translation_text:
Kapandi be kashɛ be asheŋ
1A daga fanɛ menyi bekama
nɛ menyee wora asheŋ niŋiso na;
e boŋ nshɛ kagbenefuliso
ŋkpal kusɔ nɛ Enyɛnpe na wora so.
Menyi nɛ menyee wora mo kasonu na;
e boŋ nshɛ kagbenefuliso n fur mo.
2Men ta alaŋsɔ n fur mo.
Men ta ejaŋjilaŋ n laŋ
m boŋ nshɛ n dele mo.
3Men boŋ nshɛ popɔr n dele mo.
Men laŋ ejaŋjilaŋ kenyiso,
nseŋ cha awɔr kagbenefuliso.
4Ŋkpal manɛ so,
Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na be kamalga
la kashenteŋ nna.
Nɛ mbe asheŋ woraso niŋi,
nɛ esa beeŋ tiŋ n yirda mo.
5Kusɔ nɛ k niŋi ekpa nɛ
kebaaji asheŋ nɛ amo be ekpa so;
nɛ Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na bee sha.
Mbe kasha nɛ k maŋ kɔ ekar na
bɔlɔ durnya kikɛ to nna.
6Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na be kamalga so
nɛ e bɔla n to esoso.
E malga nna nɛ epeŋi nɛ kufɔl
nɛ achɛkpabi lar.
7Mo e gbargbar teku be nchu kikɛ
n wɔtɔ kakpa koŋwule.
Mo koŋwule na e koli nchu na
n wɔtɔ kakpa chiŋgeliŋ to fanɛ ebu na.
8Kasawule so ebi kikɛ
e shuŋ Enyɛnpe na,
nɛ durnya to be basa kikɛ
e bunyaŋ mo.
9Mo e malga nɛ durnya fara.
Mo e kaŋɛ nɛ kusɔ kama ba.
10Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na
e naa jija efuliana be ŋkre.
Mo e naa kuŋ bumo be nfɛra
lubiana ekpa.
11Kusɔ nɛ Enyɛnpe na kre bre
wɔtɔ nna mbaanaayɔ.
Kusɔ nɛ e yili maa chɛrga kikɛ.
12Kagbenefuli la efuli kama so ebi
nɛ bumo be Ebɔrɛ la Enyɛnpe na
peya nna.
Kagbenefuli la bekama nɛ e lara
fanɛ b baa la mbe basa na
peya nna.
13Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na wɔ
ebɔrɛso nna a wu basa kikɛ.
14E wɔ kakpa nɛ e bee ji
kuwura na nna nsaa keni kaseto
a wu basa nɛ b wɔ durnya to kikɛ.
15Mo e sa bumo nfɛra nɛ baa fɛ asheŋ.
Amoso e nyi kusɔ kama nɛ baa fɛ.
16Mannɛ ewura be benapo be eleŋ so,
nɛ e bee tiŋ a kɔ a pɔɔ so.
Mannɛ benapo gba be eleŋ so,
nɛ baa tiŋ a kɔ kena a pɔɔ so.
17Egbaŋɛ nɛ b kɔ a kɔ kena
be eleŋgboŋ na maaŋ tiŋ
m mɔlga esa ŋko ŋ kuŋ mo.
18Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na bee keni
bekama nɛ baa wora mo
kasonu so nna;
nɛ mbe kasha nɛ k maa loge na
malɛ wɔ bekama nɛ b yirda
mo na so.
19E bee mɔlga bumo nna
nɛ b maa wu manaŋ,
nsaa sa bumo ŋkpa
akoŋgboŋ be saŋɛ.
20Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na to
nɛ anyi be tama wɔ.
Mo e la anyi be ekumpo
nɛ echɛtopo.
21Anyi be ŋgbene fuli anyi nna;
ŋkpal an ka yirda mbe ketre so.
22Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ, an ka ta anyi
be yirda n wɔtɔ fo to ere,
shin nɛ fo kasha nɛ k wɔtɔ
mbaanaayɔ na e baa wɔ anyi so.

english_text:
(Written by David when he pretended to be crazy in front of Abimelech, so that Abimelech would send him away, and David could leave.)
Honor the Lord
1 I will always praise the Lord.
2With all my heart,
I will praise the Lord.
Let all who are helpless,
listen and be glad.
3Honor the Lord with me!
Celebrate his great name.
4I asked the Lord for help,
and he saved me
from all my fears.
5Keep your eyes on the Lord!
You will shine like the sun
and never blush with shame.
6I was a nobody, but I prayed,
and the Lord saved me
from all my troubles.
7If you honor the Lord,
his angel will protect you.
8 Discover for yourself
that the Lord is kind.
Come to him for protection,
and you will be glad.
9Honor the Lord!
You are his special people.
No one who honors the Lord
will ever be in need.
10Young lions may go hungry
or even starve,
but if you trust the Lord,
you will never miss out
on anything good.
11Come, my children, listen
as I teach you
to respect the Lord.
12 Do you want to live
and enjoy a long life?
13Then don't say cruel things
and don't tell lies.
14Do good instead of evil
and try to live at peace.
15If you obey the Lord,
he will watch over you
and answer your prayers.
16But God despises evil people,
and he will wipe them all
from the earth,
till they are forgotten.
17When his people pray for help,
he listens and rescues them
from their troubles.
18The Lord is there to rescue
all
who are discouraged
and have given up hope.
19The Lord's people
may suffer a lot,
but he will always
bring them safely through.
20 Not one of their bones
will ever be broken.
21Wicked people are killed
by their own evil deeds,
and if you hate God's people
you will be punished.
22The Lord saves the lives
of his servants.
Run to him for protection,
and you won't be punished.
translation_text:
1Meeŋ baa fur Enyɛnpe na saŋkama.
M maaŋ yige mbe kechɔrɔ kikɛ.
2Meeŋ fur mo ŋkpal kusɔ nɛ e wora so,
nɛ bekama nɛ baa ji awurfoŋ na
e nu kumo be loŋ nɛ bumo be ŋgbene
e fuli bumo.
3Men ba chɛ ma to nɛ an malga
Enyɛnpe na be keshi be asheŋ.
Men shin nɛ an cha abar
n fur mbe ketre.
4Ŋ kule Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na
nɛ e nu ma kekule,
nseŋ sɔ ma n yige ashi asɔ
nɛ a bee da ma kufu na to.
5Bekama nɛ bumo be anishi
yuu mo so be ŋgbene
bee fuli bumo nna.
Bumo alɛ maaŋ ji nyɔmɔ kikɛ.
6Mo nɛ betentaŋasepo bee shu a tre,
nɛ e bee nu bumo be kushu,
nsaa mɔlga bumo ashi bumo
be etɔrɔ to na.
7Enyɛnpe be emalaika bee kulti
bekama nɛ baa bunyaŋ mo nna a wɔtɔ,
nsaa mɔlga bumo ashi kenishipere to.
8Nɛ fo firgi n taga Enyɛnpe na to,
feeŋ wu fanɛ e walɛ.
Nɛfa la bekama nɛ baa nya kekuŋ
ashi Enyɛnpe na to peya nna.
9Bekama nɛ b la Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ
be basa na e bunyaŋ mo.
Ŋkpal manɛ so,
e bee sa bumo nɛ b yirda mo na
asɔ nɛ a tir bumo nna saŋkikɛ.
10Ebuluŋ gba bee kaa di akoŋ
ama bekama nɛ baa wora
Enyɛnpe na kasonu bre,
maa fin kusɔ lela a gben.
11Ma mbia, men kaŋ kusoe n nu;
nɛ n ŋini menyi kananɛ
menyeeŋ baa bunyaŋ Enyɛnpe na.
12Menyeeŋ baa sha kenu
kebaawɔtɔ to be ebel a?
Menyeeŋ baa sha
efute tenteŋ nɛ kagbenefuli a?
13Kumo ere men sa maa
tuge malga lubi,
ŋko n shin nɛ men be nnɔ
e baa ku efɛ.
14Men yige alubi be kebaawora
nsaa wora alela;
meeŋ baa kɔ a fin kagbenewushi
ashi men be ŋgbene to.
15Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na bee keni
basa nɛ baa wora asheŋ niŋiso so
nsaa nu bumo be kekule nna.
16Ama e bee pal kaman nna
a sa alubiworapo bre.
Bumo alɛ baŋ wu e bee
shin nɛ baa teŋ bumo so
kuraa nna.
17Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na bee nu
esa nɛ e bee wora asheŋ niŋiso
be kushu nna,
nsaa mɔlga mo ashi mbe tɔrɔ to.
18Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na taga basa
nɛ bumo be aba pɔ bumo na to nna.
E bee mɔlga bekama
nɛ b maŋ naa kɔ tama na nna.
19Basa lela bee kaa nya etɔrɔ damta nna.
Ama Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na
beeŋ mɔlga bumo ashi etɔrɔ na kikɛ to.
20Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na e naa kuŋ bumo.
Bumo be kuwibi koŋwule gba maaŋ bu.
21Alubiworapoana be asheŋ lubi
bee kilgi nna a ji bumo.
Ebɔrɛ beeŋ gberge bekama
nɛ b kishi mbe basa kusoe.
22Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na
beeŋ mɔlga mbe basa.
E beeŋ kuŋ bekama nɛ baa fin
kekuŋ ashi mo kutɔ na.

english_text:
(A psalm by David.)
A Prayer for Protection from Enemies
1Fight my enemies, Lord!
Attack my attackers!
2Shield me and help me.
3Aim your spear at everyone
who hunts me down,
but promise to save me.
4Let all who want to kill me
be disgraced
and put to shame.
Chase away and confuse
all who plan to harm me.
5Send your angel after them
and let them be like straw
in the wind.
6Make them run in the dark
on a slippery road,
as your angel chases them.
7I did them no harm,
but they hid a net
to trap me,
and they dug a deep pit
to catch and kill me.
8 Surprise them with disaster!
Trap them in their own nets
and let them fall and rot
in the pits they have dug.
9I will celebrate and be joyful
because you, Lord,
have saved me.
10Every bone in my body
will shout:
“No one is like the Lord!”
You protect the helpless
from those in power;
you save the poor and needy
from those who hurt them.
11Liars accuse me of crimes
I know nothing about.
12They repay evil for good,
and I feel all alone.
13When they were sick,
I wore sackcloth
and went without food.
I truly prayed for them,
14as I would for a friend
or a relative.
I was in sorrow and mourned,
as I would for my mother.
15I have stumbled,
and worthless liars
I don't even know
surround me and sneer.
16Worthless people make fun
and never stop laughing.
17But all you do is watch!
When will you do something?
Save me from the attack
of those vicious lions.
18And when your people meet,
I will praise you
and thank you, Lord,
in front of them all.
19 Don't let my brutal enemies
be glad because of me.
They hate me for no reason.
Don't let them wink
behind my back.
20They say hurtful things,
and they lie to people
who want to live in peace.
21They are quick to accuse me.
They say, “You did it!
We saw you ourselves.”
22You see everything, Lord!
Please don't keep silent
or stay so far away.
23Fight to defend me, Lord God,
24and prove that I am right
by your standards.
Don't let them laugh at me
25or say to each other,
“Now we've got what we want!
We'll gobble him up!”
26Disappoint and confuse
all who are glad
to see me in trouble;
disgrace and embarrass
my proud enemies who say to me,
“You are nothing!”
27Let all who want me to win
be happy and joyful.
From now on let them say,
“The Lord is wonderful!
God is glad when all goes well
for his servant.”
28Then I will shout all day,
“Praise the Lord God!
He did what was right.”
translation_text:
Kechɛto be kabɔrɛkule be asheŋ
1Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ,
kɔ bekama nɛ baa kɔ ma na;
nseŋ kuŋ bumo nɛ baa kuŋ ma
ekpa na ekpa.
2Chɛ ma to nseŋ kuŋ ma.
3Maŋ fo kekpa nɛ chutre so
ŋ kuŋ bumo nɛ b ju
a bɛ ma so na ekpa;
n shin nɛ m pin fanɛ
fo e la ma emɔlgapo.
Nase kɔnɔ fanɛ feeŋ
mɔlga ma.
4Shin nɛ bekama nɛ baa
fin ma nɛ b mɔ na
e ji anishinyɔr nseŋ kɔ n tɔr.
Shin nɛ bekama nɛ baa kre ma
ŋkre lubi na kikɛ e wulto
m bɛta kaman.
5Shin nɛ b ki fanɛ afɔfɔ
nɛ afu bee foŋ a lɛ na,
saŋɛ so nɛ Enyɛnpe be malaika
bee ŋin bumo na.
6Shin nɛ bumo be ekpa to
e ki tentembiri nsaa fɛrge,
saŋɛ so nɛ Enyɛnpe be malaika
ju a bɛ bumo so na.
7M maŋ wora bumo shɛŋ
nɛ b fe ma kejigbelɛ;
nseŋ kur kemaŋ chiŋgeliŋ
n nase fanɛ n tɔr to.
8Ama kemur beeŋ purgi bumo.
Bumo gbagba be ajigbelɛ
nɛ b fe na beeŋ kilgi m pɛ bumo.
Baaŋ tur amaŋ nɛ bumo
gbagba kur na to.
9Nɛ ma kagbene e fuli ma
ŋkpal Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na so;
nɛ n ji eyur ŋkpal e ka mɔlga ma so.
10Nseŋ ta ma kagbene kikɛ
ŋ kaŋɛ Enyɛnpe na le:
“Esa kama maŋ du fanɛ fo.
Fo e naa kuŋ bepɔshipo
ashi belempo be enɔ to,
nsaa mɔlga betirpo
ashi basa lempo be kamɛaŋ to.”
11Belubiworapo bee ku efɛ
a ji shɛda a gbiti ma.
Baa ku ma kɔnɔ a kaŋɛ fanɛ
n wora asɔ nɛ m maŋ nyi
amo be asheŋ gba.
12Baa ta alubi nna a ka
ma alela be kukɔ;
nɛ kenawule nɛ kebɔltofinfin
tɔr ma so.
13Ama b ka bee lɔ,
kagbenejijaso be asɔbuuso nɛ m buu;
m mɔn ma kumu ajibi;
m bar ma kumu ase ŋ kule Ebɔrɛ
14fanɛ kananɛ meeŋ wora
n sa n teri ŋko n niopibi na.
N shu kagbenejijaso nna fanɛ
ŋ ka bee shu n nio be keeli na.
15Ama asheŋ ka tu ma ere
bumo be ŋgbene fuli bumo nna
nɛ b shɛr a wora ma eyurto.
Nɛ befɔ kulti ma n wɔtɔ
a bri ma, nɛ b la ma to.
16B wora ma eyurto nna
fanɛ kananɛ basa nɛ b maa ŋana
Ebɔrɛ bee wora ebobi eyurto na;
nsaa keni ma yurkishi so.
17Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ, feeŋ ba tase a keni
nɛ b baa wora ma le a?
Mɔlga ma ashi basa lubi ere be enɔ to.
Mɔlga ma ŋkpa ashi basa nɛ b du fanɛ
ebuluŋ ere be enɔ to.
18Saŋɛ na so meeŋ chɔrɔ fo
ashi fo basa nɛ b shɛr be anishito;
nseŋ yili bumo to n fur fo.
19Sa maŋ shin nɛ ma doŋana,
befɛpo na, be ŋgbene e fuli bumo
ŋkpal b ka pɔɔ ma so so.
Sa maŋ shin nɛ bumo nɛ b kishi ma
kenyanyaŋɛso na e mushe ma
ŋkpal ŋ ka wɔ tɔrɔ to so.
20B maa malga kelɔposo kikɛ.
B wɔtɔ nna a ku efɛ a sa basa
nɛ ma nɛ bumo wɔtɔ
kagbenewushiso na.
21Baa nya manaŋ a ku asheŋ
a deŋi ma nna; nsaa ponte a kaŋɛ le:
“An gbagba be kenishi e wu
kusɔ nɛ fo wora.”
22Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ,
fo gbagba wu kesheŋ ere.
Amoso sa maŋ lo to.
Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ,
sa maŋ yɔ kufɔ ŋ ka ma.
23Niŋi to, ŋ koso m ba kuŋ ma.
Enyɛnpe, ma Ebɔrɛ;
ba kɔ n sɔ ma.
24Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ,
ŋkpal fo ka la esa niŋiso so,
n shin nɛ b pin fanɛ m maŋ wora n foe.
Sa maŋ shin nɛ ma doŋana e mushe ma.
25Sa maŋ shin nɛ b kaŋɛ le:
“Mannɛ mo nde a?
An nya mo n wɔtɔ enɔ to a!”
26Shin nɛ bumo nɛ bumo be ŋgbene
bee fuli ŋkpal ma awurfoŋ so na
be nfɛra e wea to nɛ b kɔ n tɔr cheche.
Shin nɛ bumo nɛ baa kaŋɛ fanɛ
b bɔ ma na e ji nyɔmɔ nseŋ sipa.
27Shin nɛ bumo nɛ baa
fin fanɛ n ji n lar na e cha awɔr
kagbenefuliso ŋ kaŋɛ le:
“Kemaŋkura e baa la Enyɛnpe na peya,
Mbe kagbene e naa fuli
ŋkpal mbe kenya be nɛnɛ so na.”
28Nɛ m malga kananɛ fee wora
asheŋ niŋiso be asheŋ,
nseŋ fur fo kachɛ lelemu.

english_text:
(For the music leader by David, the Lord's servant.)
Human Sin and God's Goodness
1 Sinners don't respect God;
sin is all they think about.
2They like themselves too much
to hate their own sins
or even to see them.
3They tell deceitful lies,
and they don't have the sense
to live right.
4Those people stay awake,
thinking up mischief,
and they follow the wrong road,
refusing to turn from sin.
