5Your love is faithful, Lord,
and even the clouds in the sky
can depend on you.
6Your decisions are always fair.
They are firm like mountains,
deep like the sea,
and all people and animals
are under your care.
7Your love is a treasure,
and everyone finds shelter
in the shadow of your wings.
8You give your guests a feast
in your house,
and you serve a tasty drink
that flows like a river.
9The life-giving fountain
belongs to you,
and your light gives light
to each of us.
10Our Lord, keep showing love
to everyone who knows you,
and use your power to save all
whose thoughts please you.
11Don't let those proud
and merciless people
kick me around
or chase me away.
12Look at those wicked people!
They are knocked down,
never to get up again.
translation_text:
Dimɛdi be alubi nɛ Ebɔrɛ be alelasheŋ be asheŋ
1Belubiworapo maa sa Ebɔrɛ bunyaŋ.
Alubi nawule be asheŋ nɛ baa fɛ
ashi bumo be ŋgbene to.
2Ŋkpal b kaa bee sha bumo gbagba
be amu ga so so;
b maa wu alubi nɛ baa wora,
hale nɛ baa kishi amo gba.
3Kafulesheŋ nɛ efɛ e bɔlɔ
bumo be nnɔ to.
Bumo be nfɛra maa ŋini
bumo kebaawɔtɔ lela;
bumo alɛ maa wora kelela.
4B dese bumo be edesekpa gba
alubi be kewora be ŋkre nɛ baa kre.
B maa wora asheŋ lela kikɛ.
Kulubi kama malɛ maa choŋ bumo so.
5Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ, fo kashenteŋji
nɛ kasha nɛ fo kɔ a sa basa shi ga.
Kumo alɛ maa chɛrga;
k bee fo kaplɛkama,
hale esoso nɛ awɔlpa to kikɛ.
6Fo asheŋ woraso niŋi ekpa nna
nsaa du fanɛ kebeegboŋ
nɛ k maa gbuŋgbuŋ na.
Kananɛ fee mige basa be asheŋ to
a ji asheŋ nɛ amo be ekpa so
du chiŋgeliŋ fanɛ teku nna.
Fo enɔ to nɛ edimɛdi
nɛ asɔbɔya kikɛ wɔ.
7Fo kasha nɛ k maa chɛrga
nsaa maa loge na du fanɛ shuwa nna;
nɛ bebɔlpo nɛ basagboŋ kikɛ
bee nya kekuŋ ashi fo kiyoyul to.
8Fee wora kejigboŋ nna a sa
fo befɔ ashi fo laŋ to.
Fo kasha nɛ fo kɔ a sa anyi na
baŋ anyi be nfɛra so.
9Fo kutɔ nɛ ŋkpa kikɛ shi;
nɛ fo kefulto bee bugi
anyi be anishi nɛ anyee pin fo.
10Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ, baa ŋini bekama
nɛ b nyi fo na kasha saŋkama;
nsaa wora bumo nɛ baa wora
asheŋ niŋiso na kelela.
11Sa maŋ shin nɛ kanyishawuraana
e baa kɔ ma, ŋko n shin nɛ
kumukpakpasowuraana
e ju ma n lɛ.
12Keni kakpa nɛ belubiworapoana,
tɔr a dese.
Bumo alɛ maaŋ naŋ tiŋ n wora
shɛŋ kikɛ.

english_text:
(By David.)
Trust the Lord
1Don't be annoyed by anyone
who does wrong,
and don't envy them.
2They will soon disappear
like grass without rain.
3Trust the Lord and live right!
The land will be yours,
and you will be safe.
4Do what the Lord wants,
and he will give you
your heart's desire.
5Let the Lord lead you
and trust him to help.
6Then it will be as clear
as the noonday sun
that you were right.
7Be patient and trust the Lord.
Don't let it bother you
when all goes well for those
who do sinful things.
8Don't be angry or furious.
Anger can lead to sin.
9All sinners will disappear,
but if you trust the Lord,
the land will be yours.
10Sinners will soon disappear,
never to be found,
11 but the poor will take the land
and enjoy a big harvest.
12Merciless people make plots
against good people
and snarl like animals,
13but the Lord laughs and knows
their time is coming soon.
14The wicked kill with swords
and shoot arrows to murder
the poor and the needy
and all who do right.
15But they will be killed
by their own swords,
and their arrows
will be broken.
16It is better to live right
and be poor
than to be sinful and rich.
17The wicked will lose all
of their power,
but the Lord gives strength
to everyone who is good.
18Those who obey the Lord
are daily in his care,
and what he has given them
will be theirs forever.
19They won't be in trouble
when times are bad,
and they will have plenty
when food is scarce.
20Wicked people are enemies
of the Lord
and will vanish like smoke
from a field on fire.
21An evil person borrows
and never pays back;
a good person is generous
and never stops giving.
22Everyone the Lord blesses
will receive the land;
everyone the Lord curses
will be destroyed.
23If you do what the Lord wants,
he will make certain
each step you take is sure.
24The Lord will hold your hand,
and if you stumble,
you still won't fall.
25As long as I can remember,
good people have never
been left helpless,
and their children have never
gone begging for food.
26They gladly give and lend,
and their children
turn out good.
27If you stop sinning
and start doing right,
you will keep living
and be secure forever.
28The Lord loves justice,
and he won't ever desert
his faithful people.
He always protects them,
but destroys the children
of the wicked.
29God's people will own the land
and live here forever.
30Words of wisdom come
when good people speak
for justice.
31They remember God's teachings,
and they never take
a wrong step.
32The wicked try to trap
and kill good people,
33but the Lord is on their side,
and he will defend them
when they are on trial.
34Trust the Lord and follow him.
He will give you the land,
and you will see
the wicked destroyed.
35I have seen brutal people
abuse others and grow strong
like trees in rich soil.
36Suddenly they disappeared!
I looked, but they were gone
and no longer there.
37Think of the bright future
waiting for all the families
of honest, innocent,
and peace-loving people.
38But not a trace will be left
of the wicked
or their families.
39The Lord protects his people,
and they can come to him
in times of trouble.
40The Lord helps his people
and saves them from the wicked
because they run to him.
translation_text:
Keyirda Ebɔrɛ be asheŋ
1Sa maŋ shin nɛ belubiworapoana
be asheŋ woraso e baa fɔŋ fo,
ŋko n shin nɛ bumo be kanya be asheŋ
e baa besa fo.
2Ŋkpal manɛ so, b du fanɛ
afitiri ŋko afantaŋ bumbuŋ nna,
b maa chɛr nsaa wɔl a wu.
3Yirda Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na,
nsaa wora alelasheŋ.
Saŋɛ na so feeŋ chena
kasawule ere so n nya kekuŋ.
4Shin nɛ fo kagbene e baa fuli fo ga;
ŋkpal fo ka bee wora Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na
be aparsheŋ so.
Mo alɛ beeŋ baa wora kusɔ
nɛ fee sha a sa fo.
5Shin nɛ Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na
e baa juŋkpar fo kusɔ kama to.
Yirda fanɛ e beeŋ chɛ fo to.
6Shin nɛ fo asheŋ woraso niŋiso
e baa kpa edɛ fanɛ karechɛ,
nɛ kananɛ fee ji asheŋ
nɛ amo be ekpa so,
e baa di efuli fanɛ kapiidi be epeŋi.
7Baa kɔ kanyiti a jo Enyɛnpe be saŋɛ.
Sa maŋ shin nɛ k baa tɔrɔ fo
ŋkpal asheŋ ka bee nite nɛnɛ
a sa belubiworapo so.
8Saa maa nya agbo
ŋko a wora asheŋ agbo so.
Agbo bee yɛra esa alubi to nna.
9Alubiworapoana kikɛ beeŋ mur.
Ama bekama nɛ b yirda
Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na bre
beeŋ ji kasawule ere so be tɔnɔ.
10K maaŋ chɛr nɛ alubiworapoana e mur,
nɛ fo keni n fin bumo ŋ gben.
11Ama bebɔlpo bre beeŋ ji
kasawule ere so be tɔnɔ;
nseŋ nya kagbenewushi gboŋgboŋi.
12Belubiworapo bee kre
basa lela asheŋ lubi nna,
nsaa keni bumo yurkishiso.
13Ama Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na
bee mushe belubiworapo nna,
ŋkpal bumo be kasogberge
be saŋɛ ka maaŋ chɛr nseŋ ba so.
14Belubiworapo bee pe nsaŋɛ nna
nsaa gberge bumo be ata to
a fin betirpo nɛ betentaŋasepo
nɛ basa nɛ baa wora asheŋ niŋiso
nɛ b mɔ.
15Ama bumo gbagba be nsaŋɛ na
beeŋ kilgi n da bumo m mɔ,
nɛ bumo be ata na e buri to.
16Kebaa kɔ kebaawɔtɔ niŋiso
nsaa la etirpo
bɔ kebaala damawura
nsaa la alubiworapo.
17Ŋkpal manɛ so,
Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na beeŋ jija
belubiworapo be eleŋ kikɛ;
nseŋ sa bumo nɛ baa bɔla mbe
ekpa niŋiso so na eleŋ.
18Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na e naa keni
bekama nɛ baa wora mo kasonu so.
Kusɔ kama nɛ mo alɛ sa bumo
beeŋ baa la bumo peya mbaanaayɔ.
19B maaŋ ji awurfoŋ jɛrbi be saŋɛ.
Akoŋ be jemanɛ malɛ,
bumo ere beeŋ baa kɔ
ajibi yɛlyɛla so.
20Ama belubiworapo,
nɛ b la Ebɔrɛ mo doŋana na bre,
beeŋ foe fanɛ kananɛ edishi
bee shi edɛ to a lar a foe na.
21Belubiworapo bee paŋ asɔ nna,
nsaa kini keka.
Ama basa nɛ baa wora asheŋ
nɛ a niŋi na bre bee bugi
kagbene nna a kɛ basa asɔ saŋkama.
22Basa nɛ Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ nɛfa na,
e naŋ ji kasawule ere so be tɔnɔ.
Ama bekama nɛ Ebɔrɛ sho kɔnɔ na
bre beeŋ mur.
23Nɛ esa be asheŋ woraso baa fuli
Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na be kagbene;
e bee ŋini mo kananɛ e beeŋ baa
tia mbe aya nna.
24E fiti gba, e maaŋ tɔr;
ŋkpal manɛ so,
Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ gbagba
e naŋ pɛ mo to n yili.
25Yili ma kebiato kikɛ m ba
fo ma mbel to;
m maŋ naŋ wu Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ
ka kplaŋ esa lela so;
ŋko n wu esa lela be mbia
ka ta kawie a na a kule ajibi.
26Ama baa nya a ji nɛnɛ nna,
nsaa bugi kagbene a kɛ
basa asɔ yɛlyɛla so;
nɛ bumo be mbia malɛ
bee nya nɛfa.
27Yige asheŋ lubi be kebaawora;
nseŋ fara a wora alelasheŋ.
Saŋɛ na so fo kaman to ebi
beeŋ nya kasawule ere so
n chena mbaanaayɔ.
28Ŋkpal manɛ so,
Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na bee sha
bekama nɛ baa wora asheŋ
nɛ amo be ekpa so na nna.
Mo alɛ maaŋ kplaŋ bekama
nɛ baa ji kashenteŋ so.
Enyɛnpe na beeŋ baa kuŋ bumo,
ama e beeŋ mur belubiworapo
bre be kaman to ebi.
29Kasawule ere beeŋ baa la basa
nɛ baa wora asheŋ nɛ a niŋi na peya,
nɛ b chena kumo so mbaanaayɔ.
30Kanyiasheŋ be mmalga
e naa lar esa nɛ e bee wora
asheŋ nɛ a niŋi be kɔnɔ to,
nɛ mbe kudonduloŋ bee tuge
asheŋ nɛ a niŋi ekpa.
31E ta Ebɔrɛ be mbra na nna
n wɔtɔ mbe kagbene to;
amoso e bee pere kenishi nna
a bɛ kumo so saŋkikɛ.
32Belubiworapo bre bee
ŋana nna a fin
basa lela nɛ b mɔ.
33Ama Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na
wɔ basa lela kutɔ nna;
nsaa beeŋ malga n sɔ bumo n yige;
saŋɛ nɛ baŋ bar bumo demujikpa na.
34Ta fo yirda n wɔtɔ Enyɛnpe na to,
nsaa bɛ mo so.
E beeŋ shin nɛ fo chena kasawule ere so
n wu kananɛ belubiworapo beeŋ mur.
35N wu amukpakpasowuraana
ka puni basa n nyalɛ;
fanɛ kananɛ ndibi bee daŋ
a walɛ nɛnɛ ashi kasawule lela so na.
36Ama k maaŋ chɛr ko nɛ b foe;
nɛ ŋ keni nɛ b maaŋ naa wɔtɔ.
37Keni, asheŋ lela bee jo
basa nɛ baa ji kashenteŋ
nsaa maa wora a foe;
nsaa fin kayurwushi na
be kaman to ebi nna.
38Ama alubiworapoana
nɛ bumo be kaman to ebi kikɛ
beeŋ mur.
39Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na
e naa kuŋ mbe basa,
nsaa mɔlga bumo tɔrɔ be saŋɛ.
40Enyɛnpe na e naa mɔlga bumo;
ashi alubiworapoana be enɔ to,
ŋkpal b kaa bee fin kekuŋ
ashi mo kutɔ so.

english_text:
(A psalm by David to be used when an offering is made.)
A Prayer in Times of Trouble
1When you are angry, Lord,
please don't punish me
or even correct me.
2You shot me with your arrows,
and you struck me
with your hand.
3My body hurts all over
because of your anger.
Even my bones are in pain,
and my sins 4are so heavy
that I am crushed.
5Because of my foolishness,
I am covered with sores
that stink and spread.
6My body is twisted and bent,
and I groan all day long.
7Fever has my back in flames,
and I hurt everywhere.
8I am worn out and weak,
moaning and in distress.
9You, Lord, know every one
of my deepest desires,
and my noisy groans
are no secret to you.
10My heart is beating fast.
I feel weak all over,
and my eyes are red.
11Because of my sickness,
no friends or neighbors
will come near me.
12All who want me dead
set traps to catch me,
and those who want
to harm and destroy me
plan and plot all day.
13I am not able to hear
or speak a word;
14I am completely deaf
and can't make a sound.
15I trust you, Lord God,
and you will do something.
16I said, “Don't let them laugh
or brag when I slip and fall.”
17I am about to collapse
from constant pain.
18I told you my sins,
and I am sorry for them.
19Many deadly and powerful
enemies hate me,
20and they repay evil for good
because I try to do right.
21You are the Lord God!
Stay nearby
and don't desert me.
22You are the one who saves me.
Please hurry and help.
translation_text:
Tɔrɔ be jemanɛ be kabɔrɛkule be asheŋ
1Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ,
sa maŋ nya agbo n fiɛ ma so,
ŋko ŋ gberge ma kusoe.
2Fo to ma fo atanyembi
nseŋ ta fo enɔ ŋ ŋmɛa ma.
3Ma eyur kikɛ bee besa nna
ŋkpal fo agbo so,
nɛ mee nu ebesa ma awibi to,
4nɛ ma alubi wora ma so egbɛ
hale a buri ma to.
5Ŋkpal ma kawuli so,
ma eyur kikɛ kɔ achuu
nɛ a bɛ a dufɛ nna.
6Ma eyur banto nna nɛ n nyɔŋ to
a tekeŋto saŋkama.
7Ma kaman bel edɛ nna
a besa ma pelpelpel.
Ma eyur kikɛ maŋ kɔ alenfia.
8Ma eyur kikɛ bɛa ma to nna,
nɛ eleŋ fimbi kikɛ maŋ naa wɔ ma to.
9Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ,
fo nyi ma asheŋ tirso
nɛ ma kushuto nɛ mee
shuto kikɛ.
10Ma kagbene bee to nna pep pep pep,
nɛ ma eleŋ kikɛ loge
nɛ ma anishi ki m pere
a maŋ naa wu.
11Ŋkpal ma achuu na so,
n nekpaana nɛ ŋ kurgepoana
bee gelge ma nna;
hale n niopibiana gba
maŋ naa taga ma to.
12Bumo nɛ baa fin ma luwu
bee sho ma ajigbelɛ nna;
nɛ bumo nɛ baa fin ma nɛ b jija
malɛ bee kre ma ŋkre lubi
karechɛ kikɛ.
13Ŋ ki fanɛ kpawu nna,
m maŋ naa nu.
Ŋ ki fanɛ neemu nna,
m maŋ naa tiŋ a malga.
14Ŋ ki kpawu nna nɛ ma kɔnɔ
maaŋ naŋ tiŋ n tuge shɛŋ.
15Fo Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na
nɛ n yirda;
amoso, jande wora kusɔ ko.
16Sa maŋ shin nɛ b wora ma eyurto;
ŋko a wu bumo be amu n wɔtɔ ma
ŋkpal ŋ ka fɛrge n tɔr so.
17Ŋkpal ma eyur to be ebesa damta so,
mee shin nɛ n lar n tɔr nna.
18Ŋ kaŋɛ fo ma alubi kikɛ,
nɛ kananɛ n tuba n lar amo to.
19Bedoŋ lempo damta
e kishi ma kenyanyaŋɛso.
20Baa ta kulubi nna a ka
ma kelela be kukɔ,
nsaa malga a gbiti ma
ŋkpal ŋ kaa bee wora alela so.
21Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ,
sa maŋ kini ma n lɛ!
N nyɛnpe, sa maŋ yɔ kufɔ ŋ ka ma.
22Fo e naa chɛ ma to saŋkama;
Amoso jande wora manaŋ
m mɔlga ma.

english_text:
(A psalm by David for Jeduthun, the music leader.)
A Prayer for Forgiveness
1I told myself, “I'll be careful
not to sin by what I say,
and I'll muzzle my mouth
when evil people are near.”
2I kept completely silent,
but it did no good,
and I hurt even worse.
3I felt a fire burning inside,
and the more I thought,
the more it burned,
until at last I said:
4“Please, Lord,
show me my future.
Will I soon be gone?
5You made my life short,
so brief that the time
means nothing to you.
“Human life is but a breath,
6and it disappears
like a shadow.
Our struggles are senseless;
we store up more and more,
without ever knowing
who will get it all.
7“What am I waiting for?
I depend on you, Lord!
8Save me from my sins.
Don't let fools sneer at me.
9You treated me like this,
and I kept silent,
not saying a word.
10“Won't you stop punishing me?
You have worn me down.
11You punish us severely
because of our sins.
Like a moth, you destroy
what we treasure most.
We are as frail as a breath.
12“Listen, Lord, to my prayer!
My eyes are flooded with tears,
as I pray to you.
I am merely a stranger
visiting in your home
as my ancestors did.
13Stop being angry with me
and let me smile again
before I am dead and gone.”
translation_text:
Alubi be ketampaŋ be kabɔrɛkule be asheŋ
1Ŋ kaŋɛ fanɛ meeŋ baa de so,
nɛ ma kudonduloŋ maaŋ wora alubi.
N yɛ, meeŋ kre ma kɔnɔ so,
saŋɛ nɛ ma nɛ basa lubi wɔtɔ na.
2Ŋ ka loto n yili shruum
a maa malga kelela na,
nɛ ma eyur to be ebesa
nɛ tɔrɔ na wora kishi n ti so.
3Nɛ kewora fanɛ edɛ
ka bee chɔɔ ma eyur to na.
M baa fɛ kumo be asheŋ,
k bee chɔɔ ma to ga nna.
Ndoŋ nna nɛ ŋ kaŋɛ le:
4“Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ, jande ŋini ma
kusɔ nɛ k beeŋ wora ma echefoso.
Meeŋ wu naniere nna a?”
5Fo wora ma ŋkpa shiŋgblembi nna;
nɛ nfɛ nɛ meeŋ ji maŋ la shɛŋ fo kutɔ.
Dimɛdi be ŋkpa du fanɛ
afu ka ber n choŋ nna.
6K bee choŋ manaŋ manaŋ nna
fanɛ kiyoyul na.
Awurfoŋ nɛ anyee ji ere
kikɛ la fuloŋ nna.
Anyee fin asɔ nna
a deŋi abar so a yili
nsaa maŋ nyi esa nɛ e beeŋ ba
ji amo be kapetɛ kachako so.
7Naniere, Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ,
manɛ bre nɛ n naa fin?
Ma tama deŋ fo so nna.
8Mɔlga ma ashi ma alubi to.
Jande, sa maŋ shin nɛ
bewulpo e mushe ma.
9Fo e shin nɛ n ji le be awurfoŋ
n shin nɛ n loto
a maŋ bugi kɔnɔ ŋ kaŋɛ shɛŋ na.
10Fo maaŋ yige kebaa gberge
ma kusoe loŋ a?
Ebɔl lar ma.
11Fee gberge dimɛdi kusoe alegaiso
ŋkpal mbe alubi so nna.
Fee jija anyi be asɔ lela nna
fanɛ kananɛ elala bee jija asɔbuuso na.
Dimɛdi du fanɛ afu ka ber n choŋ nna.
12Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ,
jande, nu ma kekule.
Nu ma kushu nseŋ chɛ ma to.
Anishichubi e bɔlɔ ma anishi kikɛ to.
N du fanɛ efɔ nna ashi fo kutɔ,
fanɛ kananɛ n nananyɛnana
daa la befɔ na.
13Sa maŋ naŋ nya agbo n wɔtɔ ma,
saŋɛ na so meeŋ nya kagbenefuli gbrɛbi
pɔɛŋ nseŋ lar durnya ere to.

english_text:
(A psalm by David for the music leader.)
A Prayer for Help
1I patiently waited, Lord,
for you to hear my prayer.
You listened 2and pulled me
from a lonely pit
full of mud and mire.
You let me stand on a rock
with my feet firm,
3and you gave me a new song,
a song of praise to you.
Many will see this,
and they will honor and trust
you, the Lord God.
4You bless all of those
who trust you, Lord,
and refuse to worship idols
or follow false gods.
5You, Lord God, have done
many wonderful things,
and you have planned
marvelous things for us.
No one is like you!
I would never be able to tell
all you have done.
6 Sacrifices and offerings
are not what please you;
gifts and payment for sin
are not what you demand.
But you made me willing
to listen and obey.
7And so, I said, “I am here
to do what is written
about me in the book,
where it says,
8‘I enjoy pleasing you.
Your Law is in my heart.’ ”
9When your people worshiped,
you know I told them,
“Our Lord always helps!”
10When all your people met,
I did not keep silent.
I said, “Our Lord is kind.
He is faithful and caring,
and he saves us.”
11You, Lord, never fail
to have pity on me;
your love and faithfulness
always keep me secure.
12I have more troubles
than I can count.
My sins are all around me,
and I can't find my way.
My sins outnumber
the hairs on my head,
and I feel weak.
13Please show that you care
and come to my rescue.
Hurry and help me!
14Disgrace and confuse
all who want me dead;
turn away and disgrace
all who want to hurt me.
15Embarrass and shame
everyone who says,
“Just look at you now!”
16Our Lord, let your worshipers
rejoice and be glad.
They love you for saving them,
so let them always say,
“The Lord is wonderful!”
17I am poor and needy,
but, Lord God,
you care about me,
and you come to my rescue.
Please hurry and help.
translation_text:
Kechɛto be kabɔrɛkule be asheŋ
1N ta kanyiti nna n jo
Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na fanɛ
e chɛ ma to,
nɛ e nu ma kekule
nseŋ chɛ ma to.
2K du fanɛ n daŋ tɔr
kemaŋ chiŋgeliŋ nɛ depɔ
bɔlɔ kumo to nna,
nɛ e gberge ma
n lara ashi kumo to.
Nseŋ ta ma n yili kefalta so;
kakpa nɛ m maaŋ naŋ nia.
3E sa ma kashɛ popɔr nna,
nɛ m boŋ n fur mo,
nɛ basa damta e wu kusɔ nɛ
Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na wora,
nsaa ŋana mo;
saŋɛ na so, baaŋ ta bumo
be yirda n deŋi mo so.
4Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na bee nɛfa
bekama nɛ b yirda mo
nɛ bumo nɛ b maa shuŋ agbir
nɛ a la asɔ fuloŋ na nna.
5Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ,
fo wora emamachisheŋ damta.
Ŋkre nɛ fo kɔ n sa anyi
shi m pɔɔ anyi be nfɛra so.
Esa kama maŋ du fanɛ fo.
M maaŋ tiŋ ŋ kute fo asheŋ
woraso kikɛ.
6Mannɛ basa be esarga nɛ ŋkɛ
e naa bɔlɔ fo kenishi.
Mannɛ esarga chɔɔso
nɛ alubi be ketampaŋ be esarga
nɛ amo be ŋkɛ nɛ fee fin.
Ama kusɔ nɛ k tir fo kashenteŋto
e la ŋ kaa beeŋ baa wora fo kasonu.
7Amoso nɛ ŋ kaŋɛ fanɛ ma nde na.
Meeŋ wora asheŋ nɛ b sibɛ n wɔtɔ
fo mbra be kawɔl na to fanɛ m bɛ so na;
Kumo e kaŋɛ le na:
8“Kebaa wora fo aparsheŋ
e naa fuli ma kagbene,
amoso n ta fo mbra n wɔtɔ
ma kagbene to nna.”
9Meeŋ kaŋɛ kananɛ fee
mɔlga anyi saŋkama
ashi fo basa be nshɛrgboŋ to.
Enyɛnpe, fo nyi ŋ ka maaŋ lo
ma kɔnɔ to kikɛ.
10M maŋ ta fo kumɔlga be asheŋ na
n wɔtɔ n nawule be kagbene to nna na.
Ŋ ji fo kumɔlga nɛ fo kashenteŋji
nɛ fo kasha nɛ k maa chɛrga na
be asheŋ be shɛda nna
ashi fo basa be nshɛrgboŋ to.
11Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ, n nyi fo ka
maaŋ yige kebaawu ma kuwɔr.
Fo kasha nɛ k maa chɛrga na
nɛ fo kashenteŋji e naa
kuŋ ma saŋkama.
12Ma etɔrɔsheŋ shi alegaiso
nɛ ma alubi kulti ma
n wɔtɔ kaplɛkama
nɛ m maŋ naa nyi
kusɔ nɛ meeŋ wora.
Ma alubi shi a chɔ emin
nɛ a wɔ ma kumu so gba,
nɛ kumo be loŋ shin nɛ m pɔ aba.
13Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ, jande, mɔlga ma.
Ba chɛ ma to manaŋ.
14Wul basa nɛ baa fin ma
nɛ b mɔ na be nfɛra to
nseŋ shin nɛ b ji anishinyɔr.
Shin nɛ bekama nɛ baa fin ma
luwu na e sipa.
15Shin nɛ anishinyɔr gboŋgboŋi e pɛ
bekama nɛ baa kaŋɛ ma le na:
“Men keni kananɛ e ki a.”
Nɛ kufu e pɛ bumo nɛ b baa chicha.
16Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ,
shin nɛ bumo nɛ baa bunyaŋ fo na
be ŋgbene e fuli bumo nɛ b ji eyur.
Shin nɛ bekama nɛ baa sha fo
kumɔlga na e baa kaŋɛ le saŋkama:
“Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na shibi ga.”
17N la etirpo nɛ etentaŋasepo nna;
m maaŋ tiŋ n wora shɛŋ.
Ama ma asheŋ tir fo,
Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na.
Fo e la ma emɔlgapo,
amoso jande,
nya manaŋ m ba mɔlga ma.

english_text:
(A psalm by David for the music leader.)
A Prayer in Time of Sickness
1You, Lord God, bless everyone
who cares for the poor,
and you rescue those people
in times of trouble.
2You protect them
and keep them alive.
You make them happy here
in this land,
and you don't hand them over
to their enemies.
3You always heal them
and restore their strength
when they are sick.
4I prayed, “Have pity, Lord!
Heal me, though I have sinned
against you.”
5My vicious enemies ask me,
“When will you die
and be forgotten?”
6When visitors come,
all they ever bring
are worthless words,
and when they leave,
they spread gossip.
7My enemies whisper about me.
They think the worst,
8and they say,
“You have some fatal disease!
You'll never get well.”
9 My most trusted friend
has turned against me,
though he ate at my table.
10Have pity, Lord! Heal me,
so I can pay them back.
11Then my enemies
won't defeat me,
and I will know
that you really care.
12You have helped me
because I am innocent,
and you will always
be close to my side.
13 You, the Lord God of Israel,
will be praised forever!
Amen and amen.
translation_text:
Kulɔ be saŋɛ be kabɔrɛkule be asheŋ
1Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ, fee nɛfa bekama
nɛ baa chɛ betirpo to nna,
nsaa mɔlga loŋ be basa
tɔrɔ be saŋɛ so.
2Bumo be ŋkpa wɔ fo enɔ to nna
nɛ fee kuŋ bumo saŋkikɛ.
Fee shin nɛ bumo be ŋgbene bee fuli
kasawule ere so nfe nna.
Fo alɛ maa ta bumo a bɔɔ
bumo doŋana enɔ.
3B baa lɔ fee leŋ bumo to nna
nsaa chɛ bumo be alɔ.
4Enyɛnpe, jande wu ma kuwɔr!
Hale ŋ ka wora alubi
n da fo so ere gba kikɛ,
ta m paŋ ma.
5Bedoŋ bee malga asheŋ lubi
a laŋɛ ma kaplɛa so nna
a kaŋɛ le: “Saŋɛ mo nɛ feeŋ wu
nɛ b teŋ fo ketre so?”
6Bekama nɛ baa ba kaa bɔɔ ma so na,
bee malga mmalga fuloŋ nawule nna.
B baŋ naŋ laŋɛ a yɔ malɛ
ŋkuli nɛ efɛ nɛ b kɔ a salga to a yɔ.
7Bedoŋ baa kuli ma,
nfɛra lubi nawule nɛ b kɔ
a laŋɛ ma kaplɛa so;
8a kaŋɛ fanɛ kulɔ mɔso e kɔ mo,
amoso e maaŋ naŋ koso
ashi kakpa nɛ e dese ere.
9Nteri kpakpasoana nɛ n yirda ga,
nɛ b daa tu ma a ji gba
pal kaman nna n sa ma.
10Ama, Enyɛnpe, jande,
fo ere e wu ma kuwɔr,
n shin nɛ n niŋi to
n wora bumo n tal to.
11Sa maŋ shin nɛ ndoŋana
e pɔɔ ma so, nɛ m pin
fanɛ ma asheŋ bee bɔlɔ
fo kenishi kashenteŋto.
12Ŋkpal ŋ kaa bee wora
asheŋ niŋiso so,
feeŋ chɛ ma to, nseŋ shin nɛ
m baa wɔ fo kutɔ saŋkama.
13Kechɔrɔ e baa la Enyɛnpe
Israɛl be Ebɔrɛ na peya
hale mbaanaayɔ.
Amɛn.

english_text:
BOOK II
(Psalms 42–72)
(A special psalm by the clan of Korah and for the music leader.)
Longing for God
1As a deer gets thirsty
for streams of water,
I truly am thirsty
for you, my God.
2In my heart, I am thirsty
for you, the living God.
When will I see your face?
3Day and night my tears
are my only food,
as everyone keeps asking,
“Where is your God?”
4Sorrow floods my heart,
when I remember
leading the worshipers
to your house.
I can still hear them shout
their joyful praises.
5Why am I discouraged?
Why am I restless?
I should trust you, Lord.
I will praise you again
because you help me,
6and you are my God.
I am deeply discouraged,
and so I think about you
here where the Jordan begins
at Mount Hermon
and at Mount Mizar.
7Your vicious waves
have swept over me
like an angry ocean
or a roaring waterfall.
8Every day, you are kind,
and at night
you give me a song
as my prayer to you,
the God of my life.
9You are my mighty rock.
Why have you forgotten me?
Why must enemies mistreat me
and make me sad?
10Even my bones are in pain,
while all day long
my enemies sneer and ask,
“Where is your God?”
11Why am I discouraged?
Why am I restless?
I trust you, Lord!
And I will praise you again
because you help me,
and you are my God.
translation_text:
KENYƆSOPO
(Nshɛ 42—72)
Esa nɛ b pɛ n yɔ efuli pɔtɛ so be kabɔrɛkule be asheŋ
1Kananɛ achukoŋ bee pɛ chibir
nɛ e bee yɛla kenishi to a fin
eboŋ nɛ k kɔ nchu na,
aloŋ nɛ mee fin fo Ebɔrɛ
kenishipereso ashi ma
kagbene to.
2Kananɛ achukoŋ bee pɛ esa
nɛ e bee fin nchu na,
aloŋ nɛ mee fin fo
Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na
ashi ma kagbene to.
Saŋɛ mo nɛ meeŋ wu fo?
3M ma anishichubi e ki ma
kapa nɛ kanyɛ be ajibi.
Nɛ saŋkama basa
bee bishi ma fanɛ
nnɛ nɛ fo Ebɔrɛ na wɔ.
4M baŋ nyiŋi kananɛ
n daa juŋkpar basa nɛ
baa bɛ abar so a yɔ
fo bɔrɛlambu to
nsaa cha awɔr a boŋ nshɛ
kagbenefuliso a bunyaŋ fo na,
ma kagbene bee jija
alegaiso nna.
5Manɛ nna nɛ ma aba pɔ ma?
Manɛ nna nɛ ma kagbene
maŋ dese ma?
Ŋ kraŋ yirda fo;
ma alɛ kraŋ beeŋ di fo epaŋ
ŋkpal fo ka chɛ ma to so.
6Fo e la ma Ebɔrɛ.
M baŋ fɛ fo asheŋ
ashi kakpa nɛ Jɔɔdan
be lɔr na fara ashi abeegboŋ
nɛ baa tre Hɛɛmɔn
nɛ Miza na ase,
ma aba bee pɔ ma nna.
7Fo agbo ba ma so nna fanɛ
teku be nchu ka baga to
m muni ma so na,
ŋko nchu ka shi kebee
be awɔlto a wurge waa waa na.
8Karechɛ kikɛ fee wora alela nna.
Kanyɛso malɛ kikɛ fee sa ma
kashɛ popɔr nna,
a ŋini ma fo kasha
nɛ k maa chɛrga na,
nɛ k la ma kabɔrɛkule
a yɔ fo kutɔ.
Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ,
fo wɔ ŋkpa to nna.
9Fo e du fanɛ kefalta a kuŋ ma.
Manɛ nna nɛ fo teŋ ma so?
Manɛ nna nɛ bedoŋ bee mɛaŋ ma,
a shin nɛ ma kagbene maa fuli ma?
10Ma eyur to kikɛ bee besa ma nna
nɛ bedoŋ bee wora ma eyurto
a bishi fanɛ ma Ebɔrɛ na wɔ nnɛ?
11Manɛ nna nɛ ma aba pɔ ma?
Manɛ nna nɛ ma kagbene
maŋ dese ma?
Ŋ kraŋ yirda fo;
ma alɛ kraŋ beeŋ di fo epaŋ
ŋkpal fo ka chɛ ma to so.
Fo e la ma Ebɔrɛ.

english_text:
A Prayer in Times of Trouble
1Show that I am right, God!
Defend me against everyone
who doesn't know you;
rescue me from each
of those deceitful liars.
2I run to you for protection.
Why do you turn me away?
Why must enemies mistreat me
and make me sad?
3Send your light and your truth
to guide me.
Let them lead me to your house
on your sacred mountain.
4Then I will worship
at your altar because you
make me joyful.
You are my God,
and I will praise you.
Yes, I will praise you
as I play my harp.
5Why am I discouraged?
Why am I restless?
I trust you, Lord!
And I will praise you again
because you help me,
and you are my God.
translation_text:
1Enyɛnpe, ŋini fanɛ m maŋ
wora n jija!
Malga ŋ kuŋ ma ashi basa
nɛ b maŋ nyi fo na kutɔ.
Mɔlga ma ashi befɛpo nɛ b kɔ
amu kpakpaso na kutɔ.
2Fo e la ma ekumpo lempo;
manɛ nna nɛ fee ju ma a lɛ?
Sa maŋ shin bedoŋ e baa mɛaŋ ma
n shin nɛ ma kagbene e baa jija.
3Shin nɛ fo kefulto nɛ k bee
shin nɛ mee pin fo na,
nɛ fo kashenteŋ na e baa
ŋini ma fo ekpa na.

fo lambu nɛ fo wɔ kumo to
ashi kebee cheembi nɛ baa tre
Zayɔn nɛ k wɔ Jerusalɛm na to.
4Saŋɛ na so meeŋ ya bunyaŋ fo
ashi fo bɔrɛsure na ase,
ŋkpal fo ka sa ma kagbenefuli
gboŋgboŋi so so.
Meeŋ ta ma jaŋjilaŋ
n laŋ m maŋkura fo,

5Manɛ nna nɛ ma aba pɔ ma?
