jemanɛ nɛ ma eleŋ loge.
10Bedoŋ bee malga a gbiti ma nna;
b shɛr nna a kre ma kemɔ be nia.
11B yɛ: “Ebɔrɛ kini mo n lɛ;
men shin nɛ an ju m bɛ so n ya pɛ mo,
ŋkpal manɛ so, esa kikɛ maŋ wɔtɔ
nɛ e kɔ m mɔlga mo.”
12O Ebɔrɛ, sa maŋ barga ma n yɔ kufɔ;
O ma Ebɔrɛ, ba manaŋ m ba chɛ ma to!
13Shin nɛ basa nɛ baa fin ma
nɛ luwu na e kɔ n tɔr nseŋ mur.
Nseŋ shin nɛ basa nɛ baa kɔrfɛ ma
e ŋaba n ji anishinyɔr.
14Ma ere beeŋ ta ma
tama n wɔtɔ fo to;
ma alɛ maaŋ yige
kebaakpaŋ fo kikɛ.
15Karechɛ kikɛ meeŋ baa
malga fo alelasheŋ
nɛ fo kumɔlga be asheŋ;
ŋkpal manɛ so, fo wora
asheŋgboŋ nɛ a baŋ ma
kepinto so.
16O Enyɛnpetale Ebɔrɛ,
fo nawule be asheŋgboŋ
nɛ kebaawɔtɔ niŋiso
be kubomboŋ nɛ meeŋ
baa ber.
17Ma kebiato kikɛ nɛ
fo ŋini ma asheŋ;
hale nɛ mbre,
ŋ kraa malga fo emamachisheŋ
be asheŋ a sa basa.
18Naniere, nɛ m bel n fuli kumu,
sa maŋ pal kaman n sa ma,
O Ebɔrɛ.
Shin nɛ m baa kraa wɔtɔ
a malga fo eleŋgboŋ
be asheŋ a sa kaman to ebi
nɛ baa ba na.
19O Ebɔrɛ, fo kebaawɔtɔ
niŋiso shi ga,
k salga to hale n ya fo awɔlpa to.
Fo e wora asheŋgboŋ ga,
esa kikɛ maŋ du fanɛ fo.
20Fo shin nɛ n ji awurfoŋ damta,
ama fo naŋ wɔtɔ ma eleŋ;
nseŋ kuŋ ma
nɛ m maŋ wu n yɔ nchaŋ to.
21Fo naŋ shin nɛ n nya
kemaŋkura n ti so,
nseŋ naŋ lolo ma nɛ
ma kagbene dese ma.
22Meeŋ ta jaŋjilaŋ m boŋ
nshɛ ŋ kpaŋ fo;
meeŋ kpaŋ fo ma Ebɔrɛ,
ŋkpal fo kashenteŋji so.
Meeŋ laŋ jaŋjilaŋ m boŋ
nshɛ belbelso n sa fo,
Israɛl be Ebɔrɛ cheembi na.
23Meeŋ ta kagbenefuli m boŋ
nshɛ awɔrso ŋ kpaŋ fo,
ŋkpal fo ka mɔlga ma so.
24Meeŋ malga fo kebaawɔtɔ
niŋiso be asheŋ kachɛ lelemu.
Ŋkpal manɛ so,
basa nɛ baa kɔrfɛ ma na
kɔ n tɔr nseŋ ji anishinyɔr.

english_text:
(By Solomon.)
A Prayer for God To Guide and Help the King
1Please help the king
to be honest and fair
just like you, our God.
2Let him be honest and fair
with all your people,
especially the poor.
3Let peace and justice rule
every mountain and hill.
4Let the king defend the poor,
rescue the homeless, and crush
everyone who hurts them.
5Let the king live forever
like the sun and the moon.
6Let him be as helpful as rain
that refreshes the meadows
and the ground.
7Let the king be fair
with everyone,
and let there be peace
until the moon
falls from the sky.
8 Let his kingdom reach
from sea to sea,
from the Euphrates River
across all the earth.
9Force the desert tribes
to accept his rule,
and make his enemies
crawl in the dirt.
10Force the rulers of Tarshish
and of the islands
to pay taxes to him.
Make the kings of Sheba
and of Seba bring gifts.
11Make other rulers bow down
and all nations serve him.
12Do this because the king
rescues the homeless
when they cry out,
and he helps everyone
who is poor and in need.
13The king has pity
on the weak and the helpless
and protects those in need.
14He cares when they hurt,
and he saves them from cruel
and violent deaths.
15Long live the king!
Give him gold from Sheba.
Always pray for the king
and praise him each day.
16Let cities overflow with food
and hills be covered with grain,
just like Mount Lebanon.
Let the people in the cities
prosper like wild flowers.
17May the glory of the king
shine brightly forever
like the sun in the sky.
Let him make nations prosper
and learn to praise him.
18 Lord God of Israel,
we praise you.
Only you can work miracles.
19We will always praise
your glorious name.
Let your glory be seen
everywhere on earth.
Amen and amen.
20This ends the prayers
of David, the son of Jesse.
translation_text:
Kekule Ebɔrɛ a sa ewura be asheŋ
1O Ebɔrɛ, shin nɛ ewura
e baa ji kashenteŋ;
nsaa ji asheŋ nɛ amo be
ekpa so fanɛ fo.
2Saŋɛ na so, e beeŋ baa ji
fo basa demu ekpa niŋiso so,
nsaa keni basa nɛ b wɔ tɔrɔ to
ekpa nɛ k daga so.
3Shin nɛ kayurwushi nɛ keji
asheŋ nɛ amo be ekpa so
e baa wɔ basa nɛ b tase
abeegboŋ nɛ abeebi kikɛ so.
4Shin nɛ ewura na e baa
kɔ a sa betirpo, nsaa
kɔ a suge betentaŋasepo
nseŋ naa kɔ a pɔɔ bekama
nɛ baa kɔrfɛ bumo na so.
5Shin nɛ ewura e baa wɔtɔ
mbaanaayɔ fanɛ kananɛ
epeŋi nɛ kufɔl wɔtɔ na.
6Shin nɛ e baa kɔ kechɛto a sa
basa fanɛ kananɛ bɔrɛchu
bee sa adɔsawule kayul na.
7Shin nɛ ewura na e baa ji asheŋ
nɛ amo be ekpa so a sa ekama,
nseŋ shin nɛ kayurwushi nɛ
kedamaya e sɔ kaplɛkama
hale nɛ kufɔl e ya wu.
8Shin nɛ mbe kuwurji e yili
teku ko ase n salga to n ya fo
teku nyɔsopo ase.
Ŋko n yili Yufreetes be Lɔr na ase
n salga to n ya fo durnya be ekar.
9Saŋɛ na so keshishɛrsawule so
be basa beeŋ ba jɔŋɛ mo ase
m bunyaŋ mo.
Nɛ b tintiŋ mo doŋana nɛ b ba
dese kasawule ashi mbe anishito.
10Speen be efuli so nɛ mplasawule so
be bewuraana beeŋ bar bumo be ŋkɛ
m ba sa mo;
nɛ Areebia nɛ Itiopia be bewuraana gba
e bar bumo be ŋkɛ m ba sa mo.
11Kumo be kaman nɛ bewura kikɛ
e ba jɔŋɛ mo ase.
Nɛ efuliana na be basa kikɛ e shuŋ mo.
12Ŋkpal manɛ so, e beeŋ kɔ n suge
betentaŋasepo nɛ bekama nɛ b wɔ
tɔrɔ to nseŋ shu n tre mo na n yige.
13Ewura na kɔ kushuso n sa
bepɔshipo nɛ betirpo nna,
mo alɛ e naa mɔlga betentaŋasepo
ashi luwu to.
14Mo e naa mɔlga bumo ashi
kamɛaŋ nɛ awurfoŋ to,
ŋkpal manɛ so, bumo be ŋkpa
be asheŋ tir mo nna.
15Shin nɛ ewura na be ŋkpa
e teŋi so!
N shin nɛ e nya Areebia be
kasawule so be shuwa.
Shin nɛ basa e baa kule
Ebɔrɛ a sa mo jemanɛ kikɛ
nsaa nɛfa mo karechɛ kama.
16Shin nɛ ndegboŋ nɛ e wɔ
kasawule na so kikɛ e bɔlɔ ajibi,
nɛ abeeana so kikɛ e bɔlɔ aboyu
nɛ ayu be yiri kikɛ.
Shin nɛ kasawule na so
be ndibi sɔrso e wora ga,
fanɛ Lebanɔn be kebee so
be ndibi sɔrso peya,
nseŋ shin nɛ ndegboŋ na e bɔlɔ
basa fanɛ kupuŋ to be afitiri.
17Shin nɛ basa e baa nyiŋi
ewura na be ketre mbaanaayɔ,
n shin nɛ mbe kemaŋkura
e baa fulto fanɛ epeŋi.
Shin nɛ efuliana na be basa
e bɔla mo so n dii kedama
nseŋ kule Ebɔrɛ be nɛfa n sa mo.
18Anyee kpaŋ fo, Enyɛnpe,
Israɛl be Ebɔrɛ na nna.
Fo nawule e naa tiŋ
a wora emamachisheŋ.
19Anyeeŋ baa kpaŋ fo ketre
nɛ k kɔ kemaŋkura na jemanɛ kikɛ.
Shin nɛ fo kemaŋkuragboŋ na
e dii efuli durnya ere be kaplɛkama.
Amɛn! Amɛn!
20Jɛsi pibinyɛn, Ewura Deevid,
be kabɔrɛkule be ekar nna na.

english_text:
BOOK III
(Psalms 73–89)
(A psalm by Asaph.)
God Is Good
1God is truly good to Israel,
especially to everyone
with a pure heart.
2But I almost stumbled and fell,
3because it made me jealous
to see proud and evil people
and to watch them prosper.
4They never have to suffer,
they stay healthy,
5and they don't have troubles
like everyone else.
6Their pride is like a necklace,
and they commit sin more often
than they dress themselves.
7Their eyes bulge with fat,
and their minds are flooded
with foolish thoughts.
8They sneer and say cruel things,
and because of their pride,
they make violent threats.
9They dare to speak against God
and to order others around.
10God will bring his people back,
and they will drink the water
he so freely gives.
11Only evil people would say,
“God Most High cannot
know everything!”
12Yet all goes well for them,
and they live in peace.
13What good did it do me
to keep my thoughts pure
and refuse to do wrong?
14I am sick all day,
and I am punished
each morning.
15If I had said evil things,
I would not have been loyal
to your people.
16It was hard for me
to understand all this!
17Then I went to your temple,
and there I understood
what will happen
to my enemies.
18You will make them stumble,
never to get up again.
19They will be terrified,
suddenly swept away
and no longer there.
20They will disappear, Lord,
despised like a bad dream
the morning after.
21Once I was bitter
and brokenhearted.
22I was stupid and ignorant,
and I treated you
as a wild animal would.
23But I never really left you,
and you hold my right hand.
24Your advice has been my guide,
and later you will welcome me
in glory.
25In heaven I have only you,
and on this earth
you are all I want.
26My body and mind may fail,
but you are my strength
and my choice forever.
27All-Powerful Lord God,
those who stay far from you
will be lost,
and you will destroy those
who are unfaithful.
28It is good for me
to be near you.
I choose you as my protector,
and I will tell about
your wonderful deeds.
translation_text:
KESASOPO
(Nshɛ 73—89)
Ebɔrɛ ka walɛ be asheŋ
1Kashenteŋto, Ebɔrɛ walɛ n sa Israɛl
nɛ bekama nɛ baa bunyaŋ mo
nɛ ŋgbene fuful na.
2Ama ma ere, a daŋ ka gbrɛ
nɛ n fɛrge n tɔr.
3Ŋkpal manɛ so, ŋ ka daŋ wu
kamoowuwuraana ka dii kedama na,
n daa besa bumo eyur nna.
4B maa ji awurfoŋ ŋko ebesa kikɛ;
b baa kɔ eyur be alenfia nɛ eleŋ nna.
5B maa ji awurfoŋ nɛ beko bee ji na;
bumo alɛ maŋ naa kɔ etɔrɔ
nɛ ekama kɔ na.
6Amoso kamoowu ki fanɛ kubɔtoshembi
ashi bumo be ebɔ to nna,
nɛ kebaanyaŋɛto a wora asheŋ
malɛ ki fanɛ bumo be asɔbuuso.
7Asheŋ lubi nawule e naa shi
bumo be ŋgbene to a lar,
nɛ ŋkre lubi malɛ bɔlɔ bumo
be nfɛra to.
8Baa tege basa nna nsaa malga
mmalga jiga,
nseŋ naa kre beko be kamɛaŋ
kamoowuso.
9Baa malga mmalga lubi
a gbiti Ebɔrɛ nna,
nsaa malga ŋkpensheŋ so
ekama kutɔ durnya to.
10Amoso Ebɔrɛ be basa gba
maŋ naa fɛ bumo be mmalga na
be asheŋ pɔɛŋ nsaa yirda bumo.
11Le nɛ baa kaŋɛ:
“Enyɛnpetale Ebɔrɛ na maaŋ
tiŋ m pin kusɔ kikɛ!”
12Kananɛ kumukpakpasowuraana
du nna na.
B maŋ ta asheŋ lubi fanɛ asheŋ lubi;
bumo alɛ bee dii kedama a ti so nna.
13Manɛ be tɔnɔ nɛ n nya ashi
ma kebaakɔ nfɛra lela,
nɛ kekini kewora asheŋ lubi to bre?
14O Ebɔrɛ, fo shin nɛ n ji
awurfoŋ kachɛ lelemu.
Kachipurso kikɛ fee gberge
ma kusoe nna.
15Nɛ n daŋ malga mmalga lubi nna,
ndafanɛ n daa beeŋ ki
edebɔrpo fo basa to.
16Kedaa du kpakpa n sa ma
nɛ n tiŋ m pin asheŋ ere kikɛ to.
17Ebɔrɛ be bɔrɛlambu to nɛ n yɔ
pɔɛŋ nseŋ ya pin kusɔ nɛ k beeŋ tu
kumukpakpasowuraana.
18Abaanaaworasheŋ feeŋ
shin nɛ b fɛrge n tɔr
nsaa maŋ naŋ tiŋ ŋ koso kikɛ.
19Baaŋ mur epul to nɛ kufu e pɛ
bumo nɛ b baa chicha.
Bumo be lalaloge beeŋ lubi pasaa!
20Baaŋ baa du fanɛ edare
nɛ kare beeŋ chɛ nɛ k choŋ na nna.
O Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ, fo baŋ kpa n niŋi to,
baaŋ foe fanɛ afu.
21Ma kagbene to ka daa ji edɛ
ŋkpal kusɔ nɛ k daa wora so na,
22kawulisheŋ nɛ kebaamaŋ nyi
asheŋ e daa kɔ ma,
nɛ n daa wora asheŋ fo anishito
fanɛ kusɔbɔya na.
23Ama amo nɛ amo kikɛ ŋ kraa
wɔ fo kutɔ jemanɛ kikɛ.
Fo daa kɔ ma to fo enɔ jisa to nna.
24Fo kasotoji e daa ŋini ma
kananɛ meeŋ baa wora asheŋ,
kumo be lalaloge nɛ fo ba ta ma
n yɔ kemaŋkura to.
25M maŋ naa kɔ esa kikɛ ebɔrɛso
n naŋ ti fo so.
Ŋ ka baa kɔ fo ere, m maŋ naa
sha shɛŋ durnya ere to.
26Ma eyur nɛ nfɛra beeŋ tiŋ
n wora asheŋ ŋ gben,
ama Ebɔrɛ e la ma eleŋ
ashi ma kagbene to.
Mo alɛ be asheŋ a tir ma
jemanɛ kikɛ.
27O Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ,
bekama nɛ b kplaŋ fo so
beeŋ mur cheche.
Fo alɛ beeŋ mur bekama
nɛ b maŋ ji kashenteŋ n sa fo.
28Ama k walɛ ga ŋkpal ma ere
ka taga fo, Ebɔrɛ na, to so.
N ta fo, Enyɛnpetale Ebɔrɛ na,
fanɛ ma ekumpo nna.
Ma alɛ beeŋ baa bɔ fo
emamachisheŋ na be kubɔya.

english_text:
(A special psalm by Asaph.)
A Prayer for the Nation in Times of Trouble
1Our God, why have you
completely rejected us?
Why are you so angry
with the ones you care for?
2Remember the people
you rescued long ago,
the tribe you chose
for your very own.
Think of Mount Zion,
your home;
3walk over to the temple
left in ruins forever
by those who hate us.
4Your enemies roared like lions
in your holy temple,
and they have placed
their banners there.
5It looks like a forest
chopped to pieces.
6They used axes and hatchets
to smash the carvings.
7They burned down your temple
and badly disgraced it.
8They said to themselves,
“We'll crush them!”
Then they burned every one
of your meeting places
all over the country.
9There are no more miracles
and no more prophets.
Who knows how long
it will be like this?
10Our God, how much longer
will our enemies sneer?
Won't they ever stop
insulting you?
11Why don't you punish them?
Why are you holding back?
12Our God and King,
you have ruled
since ancient times;
you have won victories
everywhere on this earth.
13 By your power you made a path
through the sea,
and you smashed the heads
of sea monsters.
14 You crushed the heads
of the monster Leviathan,
then fed him to wild creatures
in the desert.
15You opened the ground
for streams and springs
and dried up mighty rivers.
16You rule the day and the night,
and you put the moon
and the sun in place.
17You made summer and winter
and gave them to the earth.
18Remember your enemies, Lord!
They foolishly sneer
and won't respect you.
19You treat us like pet doves,
but they mistreat us.
Don't keep forgetting us
and letting us be fed
to those wild animals.
20Remember the agreement
you made with us.
Violent enemies are hiding
in every dark corner
of the earth.
21Don't disappoint those in need
or make them turn from you,
but help the poor and homeless
to shout your praises.
22Do something, God!
Defend yourself.
Remember how those fools
sneer at you all day long.
23Don't forget the loud shouts
of your enemies.
translation_text:
Kekule Ebɔrɛ n sa efuli na be asheŋ
1O Ebɔrɛ, manɛ nna nɛ fo
kplaŋ anyi so loŋ?
Feeŋ baŋ nya agbo n wɔtɔ fo
basa mbaanaayɔ a?
2Baa nyiŋi fo basa nɛ fo lara n sa
fo kumu dra dra kikɛ na.
Basa nɛ fo lara kenyaya to na;
yiri nɛ fo lara fanɛ
fo gbagba be basa na.
Baa nyiŋi Zayɔn be kebee
nɛ b daa wɔ kumo so na gba.
3Naŋ bɛta m ba bɔla fo bɔrɛlambu
nɛ k bure a dese na ase;
kakpa nɛ an doŋana jija
kusɔ kama nyam na.
4Fo doŋana daŋ yili bɔrɛlambu na
to n ji njɔŋ nseŋ yuu bumo be etuta
a ŋini fanɛ b kɔ m pɔɔ so nna.
5B daa wora asheŋ fanɛ basa ka keta
akpanfu a ku kupo to be ndibi a lɛ nna.
6B daŋ ta bumo be akpanfugboŋ
nɛ awurbi m buri m buri asɔ nɛ b shɛl
n ta n ji bɔrɛlambu na kebita na nna.
7B daŋ chɔɔ fo bɔrɛlambu na
m mur cheche nna,
nseŋ shin nɛ kakpa nɛ basa daa
bunyaŋ fo na wora eyurpi
daŋkare be ekpa so.
8Le nɛ an doŋana na daŋ kaŋɛ
ashi bumo be ŋgbene to:
“Anyeeŋ mur bumo cheche!”
B daŋ chɔɔ kaplɛkama nɛ basa
bee bunyaŋ Ebɔrɛ na ashi
kasawule na kikɛ so nna
m mur cheche.
9Emamachisheŋ maŋ naa wɔtɔ,
anebiana na gba maŋ naa wɔtɔ.
Ekama malɛ maŋ nyi saŋɛ nɛ asheŋ na
beeŋ fo amo be ekar.
10O Ebɔrɛ, saŋɛ mo nɛ an doŋana
beeŋ yige kebaa tege anyi
nɛ kebaawora fo eyur to?
11Manɛ nna nɛ fo kini
kechɛ anyi to?
Manɛ nna nɛ fo maaŋ
gberge bumo kusoe?
12O Ebɔrɛ, sososo na kikɛ,
fo e la anyi be ewura;
fo alɛ e bar kumɔlga durnya kikɛ
be basa to.
13Fo eleŋgboŋ nɛ fo ta n nase
ekpa teku peper na to,
nseŋ bure nchu to be asɔ
keniso lubi gboŋgboŋi na
be amu to.
14Fo e daŋ bure teku to be
kusɔbɔya lubi gboŋgboŋi
nɛ baa tre Liviatan na
be kumu to.
Nseŋ shin nɛ k ki keji n sa
keshishɛrsawule so be asɔbɔya.
15Fo e daŋ shin nɛ kasawule
pante n lar nchu ŋ ki fanɛ
kebuye nɛ mbombi.
Nseŋ shin nɛ elɔr nɛ a daa
shile bre wɔlto na.
16Fo e to kapa nɛ kanyɛ kikɛ,
nseŋ taŋɛ epeŋi nɛ kufɔl;
nɛ kekama kɔ kumo be eyilikpa.
17Fo e yili durnya be egbaŋ kikɛ,
nseŋ to kechali nɛ ketar.
18Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ,
baa nyiŋi kananɛ fo doŋana
wora fo eyurto a mushe fo na,
nɛ kananɛ bewulpo
keni fo ketre jiga na.
19Sa maŋ yige fo basa nɛ b du
fanɛ alepɔ na n sa bedoŋ nɛ b du
fanɛ kupuŋ to be asɔbɔya lubi na.
Fo alɛ e sa maŋ teŋ basa nɛ baa ji
awurfoŋ na so.
20Baa nyiŋi kɔnɔkoŋwule be ŋkre
nɛ anyi nɛ fo wora na.
Ŋkpal manɛ so, kebagato e sɔ durnya
be kukɔlɔbi kikɛ to, n shin nɛ
tentembiri sɔ kaplɛkama.
21Sa maŋ shin nɛ anishinyɔr a ji
basa nɛ baa ji awurfoŋ.
Ama fo shin nɛ betirpo nɛ
betentaŋasepo e kpaŋ fo ketre na.
22O Ebɔrɛ, koso ŋ kɔ n sa fo kumu!
Baa nyiŋi kananɛ bewulpo na
wora fo eyurto kachɛ lelemu kikɛ na.
23Sa maŋ teŋ awɔr nɛ fo
doŋana wora na so,
awɔr nɛ b baa wora jemanɛ
kikɛ na so.

english_text:
(A psalm and a song by Asaph for the music leader. To the tune “Don't Destroy.”
)
Praise God for All He Has Done
1Our God, we thank you
for being so near to us!
Everyone celebrates
your wonderful deeds.
2You have set a time
to judge with fairness.
3The earth trembles,
and its people shake;
you alone keep
its foundations firm.
4You tell every bragger,
“Stop bragging!”
And to the wicked you say,
“Don't boast of your power!
5Stop bragging! Quit telling me
how great you are.”
6Our Lord and our God,
victory doesn't come
from the east or the west
or from the desert.
7You are the one who judges.
You can take away power
and give it to others.
8You hold in your hand
a cup filled with wine,
strong and foaming.
You will pour out some
for every sinful person
on this earth,
and they will have to drink
until it is gone.
9But I will always tell about
you, the God of Jacob,
and I will sing your praise.
10Our Lord, you will destroy
the power of evil people,
but you will give strength
to those who are good.
translation_text:
Ebɔrɛ ka la demujipo be asheŋ
1O Ebɔrɛ, anyee di fo epaŋ,
ŋkpal fo ka taga anyi to so!
Ekama bee ji eyur nna a malga
fo mamachisheŋ be asheŋ.
2Fo yɛ:
“N lara demuji
be jemanɛ nna n yili;
ma alɛ beeŋ ji demu nɛ
kumo be ekpa so.
3Nɛ kasawule gbuŋgbuŋ
nɛ basa bee chicha gba,
ma e kraa kɔ kumo be gbaltɔlase
to a yil dindiŋ.
4Ma e naa kaŋɛ
kumukpakpasowura fanɛ
e sa maa kpeŋ a wu mbe kumu.
5Ma e naa kaŋɛ bumo fanɛ
b yige kebaapuchi a malga
bumo be keshi be asheŋ.”
6Esa kikɛ maŋ wɔ epeŋilarkpa
ŋko epeŋitɔrkpa ŋko durnya be
kaplɛkama nɛ e tiŋ n ta esa
n yili eyilikpagboŋ.
7Ebɔrɛ e naa ji kusɔ kama demu.
Mo e naa bar eko kaseto
nsaa maŋ eko so!
8K du fanɛ Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na
ka kɔ kawiebi mbe enɔ to nna,
nɛ mbe agbo du fanɛ yabra kpakpaso
a wɔ kawiebi na to.
E bee duga mbe agbo na nna
a sa durnya to be amukpakpasowuraana,
nɛ baa chise amo kikɛ nyam a nuu.
9Ama ma ere beeŋ baa malga fo,
Jeekɔb be Ebɔrɛ na, be asheŋ,
nsaa boŋ nshɛ a kpaŋ fo mbaanaayɔ.
10O Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ,
feeŋ mur basa lubi be eleŋ,
nseŋ shin nɛ basa niŋiso bre
be eleŋ e ti so.

english_text:
(A song and a psalm by Asaph for the music leader. Use stringed instruments.)
God Always Wins
1You, our God,
are famous in Judah
and honored in Israel.
2Your home is on Mount Zion,
the city of peace.
3There you destroyed
fiery arrows, shields, swords,
and all the other weapons.
4You are more glorious than
the eternal mountains.
5Brave warriors were robbed
of what they had taken,
and now they lie dead,
unable to lift an arm.
6God of Jacob, when you roar,
enemy chariots and horses
drop dead in their tracks.
7Our God, you are fearsome,
and no one can oppose you
when you are angry.
8From heaven you announced
your decisions as judge!
And all who live on this earth
were terrified and silent
9when you took over as judge,
ready to rescue
everyone in need.
10Even the most angry people
will praise you
when you are furious.
11Everyone, make your promises
to the Lord your God
and do what you promise.
The Lord is fearsome,
and all his servants
should bring him gifts.
12God destroys the courage
of rulers and kings
and makes cowards of them.
translation_text:
Ebɔrɛ ka bee kɔ a pɔɔ so jemanɛ kikɛ be asheŋ
1Ekama nyi Ebɔrɛ be asheŋ
ashi Juda be efuli so,
nɛ mbe ketre malɛ bee nya
kemaŋkura Israɛl to.
2Zayɔn be kebee nɛ k wɔ
Jerusalɛm to na
e la kakpa nɛ e wɔ.
3Ndoŋ nɛ e buri m buri edompo na
be atanyembi nɛ etokobi nɛ
abɛlso be asɔkuŋso to.
4Fo kemaŋkura bee nyɛkpɛ nna
fanɛ edɛ;
kumo alɛ kɔ eleŋ a walɛ ga
a chɔ abee nɛ kupuŋ to
be asɔbɔya bee nite so na.
5Bedoŋ tiŋ n suge benapo lempo
nɛ b kɔ dama na gba be asɔ;
ama naniere bumo alɛ gba wu
n dese a di nchaŋ to nɛ bumo
be eleŋ nɛ kenyi kikɛ to jiga.
6Jeekɔb be Ebɔrɛ, fo ka ponte to,
egbaŋɛ nɛ bumo be bediipo
kikɛ tɔr nna n wu a dese shruum.
7Fo Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na e daga fanɛ
ekama e baa ŋana fo.
Fo baŋ nya agbo,
esa kikɛ maaŋ tiŋ
n yili fo anishito.
8Ebɔrɛso nɛ fo wɔ nseŋ bɔ
fo demuji be kubɔya;
nɛ kufu tɔr durnya so,
nɛ kakpa kikɛ wora shruum.
9Jemanɛ nɛ fo kpa n niŋi to
nɛ fo fara demuji m mɔlga basa
nɛ baa ji awurfoŋ durnya to nna na.
10Kashenteŋto nɛ fo baŋ nya agbo,
basa nɛ b nya agbo n wɔtɔ fo gba
bee kpaŋ fo nna.
11Men nase nnɔ n sa Enyɛnpe,
menyi be Ebɔrɛ na.
Menyi alɛ e wora m bɔlɔ
men be nnɔ naseso na so.
Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na e daga keŋana,
mo e daga fanɛ efuli pɔtɛana
nɛ a kulti anyi na kikɛ be basa
ka bar ŋkɛ m ba sa mo.
12Mo e naa bar bewura kama
nɛ baa boo kenyɛn na kaseto;
a shin nɛ baa ki befupo.

english_text:
(A psalm by Asaph for Jeduthun, the music leader.)
In Times of Trouble God Is with His People
1I pray to you, Lord God,
and I beg you to listen.
2In days filled with trouble,
I search for you.
And at night I tirelessly
lift my hands in prayer,
refusing comfort.
3When I think of you,
I feel restless and weak.
4Because of you, Lord God,
I can't sleep.
I am restless
and can't even talk.
5I think of times gone by,
of those years long ago.
6Each night my mind
is flooded with questions:
7“Have you rejected me forever?
Won't you be kind again?
8Is this the end of your love
and your promises?
9Have you forgotten
how to have pity?
Do you refuse to show mercy
because of your anger?”
10Then I said, “God Most High,
what hurts me most
is that you no longer help us
with your mighty arm.”
11Our Lord, I will remember
the things you have done,
your miracles of long ago.
12I will think about each one
of your mighty deeds.
13Everything you do is right,
and no other god
compares with you.
14You alone work miracles,
and you have let nations
see your mighty power.
15With your own arm you rescued
your people, the descendants
of Jacob and Joseph.
16The ocean looked at you, God,
and it trembled deep down
with fear.
17Water flowed from the clouds.
Thunder was heard above
as your arrows of lightning
flashed about.
18Your thunder roared
like chariot wheels.
The world was made bright
by lightning,
and all the earth trembled.
19You walked through the water
of the mighty sea,
but your footprints
were never seen.
20You guided your people
like a flock of sheep,
and you chose Moses and Aaron
to be their leaders.
translation_text:
Ebɔrɛ ka wɔ mbe basa to tɔrɔ be jemanɛ be asheŋ
1N shu n tre Ebɔrɛ nna
a fin kechɛto.
Ŋ ka shu n tre mo,
nɛ e nu ma kushu na.
2Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na nɛ mee
kule tɔrɔ be jemanɛ;
mee maŋ ma enɔana so
kanyɛ na kikɛ nna
ashi kabɔrɛkule to,
ama n daa maŋ nya
kagbenewushi.
3N daŋ nyiŋi fo Ebɔrɛ na nna,
nseŋ tekeŋto;
n fɛ nfɛra ga, nɛ aba pɔ ma.
4Ŋkpal fo, Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na so,
m maŋ tiŋ nɛ n di.
Ewushi kikɛ maŋ wɔ ma to,
m maŋ tiŋ nɛ m malga gba.
5Mee fɛ nchɛ nɛ a choŋ na
nɛ nfɛ dra na be asheŋ nna.
6Mee nyiŋi kanyɛso kikɛ be
nshɛ nɛ n daa boŋ,
nsaa fɛ nfɛra ga na nna,
a bishi ma kumu le:
7“Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na kini anyi nna
n lɛ le mbaanaayɔ a?
E maaŋ naŋ wu anyi kuwɔr a?
8Mbe kasha nɛ k maŋ kɔ ekar na
loge anyi so nna ere a?
Mbe nnɔ naseso na malɛ gba
ba ekar nna ere a?
9Ama Ebɔrɛ teŋ so kananɛ
baa wu kuwɔr nna a?
E kpal agbo so m pɛ mbe
kuwɔrwu be kasha nna ere a?”
10Ade be kaman nɛ n fɛ le:
“Enyɛnpetale Ebɔrɛ,
kusɔ nɛ k baa tɔrɔ ma ga
e la fo ka maŋ naa ta fo
eleŋgboŋ na a chɛ anyi to na.
11Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ,
meeŋ baa nyiŋi fo asheŋgboŋ
nɛ emamachisheŋ nɛ fo wora
dra dra na be asheŋ.
12Meeŋ baa fɛ asheŋ tumase
nɛ fo wora na kikɛ be asheŋ.
13O Ebɔrɛ, kusɔ kama nɛ fee wora
du cheembi nna.
Kegbir kikɛ maŋ shi nsaa kɔ
eleŋ fanɛ fo.
14Fo nawule e la Ebɔrɛ
nɛ e bee wora emamachisheŋ;
nsaa ŋini fo eleŋgboŋ
ashi efuliana na be basa to.
15Fo eleŋgboŋ na nɛ fo ta
m mɔlga fo basa nɛ b la
Jeekɔb nɛ Josɛf be
kaman to ebi na.
16O Ebɔrɛ, kewora fanɛ
teku be nchu na ka wu fo,
kufu pɛ amo nna nɛ kumo
be kechimbi to baga to
m pulgi to kufuso.
17Abɔrɛwɔlpa daŋ chulgi
bɔrɛchu nna n wurge to;
nɛ bɔrɛ nyɛkpɛ awɔlpa to
nseŋ ponte to.
18Bɔrɛ na ka nyɛkpɛ m ponte to
nɛ kusɔ kikɛ nu kumo.
K ka nyɛkpɛ na
nɛ durnya kikɛ fulto.
K ka ponte to na
nɛ kasawule gbuŋgbuŋ to
fanɛ k kaa bee chicha na.
19Fo daŋ nase ekpa teku be
nchugboŋ na to nna,
nɛ k wora fanɛ fo ka bɔla
kumo to n choŋ;
ama esa maŋ wu
fo aya ka dese.
20Fo daŋ bɔla Mosis
nɛ Ɛɛrɔn so nna n juŋkpar
fo basa fanɛ mbolpɔkpapo na.”

english_text:
(A special psalm by Asaph.)
What God Has Done for His People
1My friends, I beg you
to listen as I teach.
2 I will give instruction
and explain the mystery
of what happened long ago.
3These are things we learned
from our ancestors,
4and we will tell them
to the next generation.
We won't keep secret
the glorious deeds
and the mighty miracles
of the Lord.
5God gave his Law
to Jacob's descendants,
the people of Israel.
And he told our ancestors
to teach their children,
6so that each new generation
would know his Law
and tell it to the next.
7Then they would trust God
and obey his teachings,
without forgetting anything
God had done.
8They would be different
from their ancestors,
who were stubborn, rebellious,
and unfaithful to God.
9The warriors from Ephraim
were armed with arrows,
but they ran away
when the battle began.
10They broke their agreement
with God,
and they turned their backs
on his teaching.
11They forgot all he had done,
even the mighty miracles
12 he did for their ancestors
near Zoan in Egypt.
13 God made a path in the sea
and piled up the water
as he led them across.
14 He guided them during the day
with a cloud,
and each night he led them
with a flaming fire.
15 God made water flow
from rocks he split open
in the desert,
and his people drank freely,
as though from a lake.
16He made streams gush out
like rivers from rocks.
17But in the desert,
the people of God Most High
kept sinning and rebelling.
18 They stubbornly tested God
and demanded from him
what they wanted to eat.
19They challenged God by saying,
“Can God provide food
out here in the desert?
20It's true God struck the rock
and water gushed out
like a river,
but can he give his people
bread and meat?”
21When the Lord heard this,
he was angry and furious
with Jacob's descendants,
the people of Israel.
22They had refused to trust him,
and they had doubted
his saving power.
23But God gave a command
to the clouds,
and he opened the doors
in the skies.
24 From heaven he sent grain
that they called manna.
25He gave them more than enough,
and each one of them ate
this special food.
26God's mighty power
sent a strong wind
from the southeast,
27and it brought birds
that covered the ground,
like sand on the beach.
28Then God made the birds fall
in the camp of his people
near their tents.
29God gave his people
all they wanted,
and each of them ate
until they were full.
30But before they had swallowed
the last bite,
31God became angry and killed
the strongest and best
from the families of Israel.
32But the rest kept on sinning
and would not trust
God's miracles.
33So he cut their lives short
and made them terrified.
34After he killed some of them,
the others turned to him
with all their hearts.
35They remembered God Most High,
the mighty rock
that kept them safe.
36But they tried to flatter God,
and they told him lies;
37 they were unfaithful
and broke their promises.
38Yet God was kind.
He kept forgiving their sins
and didn't destroy them.
He often became angry,
but never lost his temper.
39God remembered that they
were made of flesh
and were like a wind
that blows once
and then dies down.
40While they were in the desert,
they often rebelled
and made God sad.
41They kept testing him
and caused terrible pain
for the Holy One of Israel.
42They forgot about his power
and how he had rescued them
from their enemies.
43God showed them all kinds
of wonderful miracles
near Zoan in Egypt.
44 He turned the rivers of Egypt
into blood,
and no one could drink
from the streams.
45 He sent swarms of flies
to pester the Egyptians,
and he sent frogs
to cause them trouble.
46 God let worms and grasshoppers
eat their crops.
47 He destroyed their grapevines
and their fig trees
with hail and floods.
48Then he killed their cattle
with hail
and their other animals
with lightning.
49God was so angry and furious
that he went into a rage
and caused them great trouble
by sending swarms
of destroying angels.
50God released his anger
and slaughtered them
in a terrible way.
51 He killed the first-born son
of each Egyptian family.
52 Then God led his people
out of Egypt
and guided them in the desert
like a flock of sheep.
53 He led them safely along,
and they were not afraid,
but their enemies drowned
in the sea.
54 God brought his people
to the sacred mountain
that he had taken
by his own power.
55 He made nations run
from the tribes of Israel,
and he let the tribes
take over their land.
56 But the people tested
God Most High,
and they refused
to obey his laws.
57They were as unfaithful
as their ancestors,
and they were as crooked
as a twisted arrow.
58God demanded all their love,
but they made him angry
by worshiping idols.
59So God became furious
and completely rejected
the people of Israel.
60 Then he deserted his home
at Shiloh, where he lived
here on earth.
61 He let enemies capture
the sacred chest
and let them dishonor him.
62God took out his anger
on his chosen ones
and let them be killed
by enemy swords.
63Fire destroyed the young men,
and the young women were left
with no one to marry.
64Priests died violent deaths,
but their widows
were not allowed to mourn.
65Finally the Lord woke up,
like a soldier
startled from a drunken sleep.
66God scattered his enemies
and made them ashamed
forever.
67Then the Lord decided
not to make his home
with Joseph's descendants
in Ephraim.
68Instead he chose the tribe
of Judah,
and he chose Mount Zion,
the place he loves.
69There he built his temple
as lofty as the mountains
and as solid as the earth
he made to last forever.
70 The Lord God chose David
to be his servant and took him
from tending sheep
71and from caring for lambs.
Then God made him the leader
of Israel, his own nation.
72David treated the people fairly
and guided them with wisdom.
translation_text:
Kusɔ nɛ Ebɔrɛ wora n sa mbe basa be asheŋ
1Ma basa, men nu ma keŋini ere,
nseŋ nu kusɔ nɛ mee kaŋɛ ere nɛnɛ.
2Meeŋ ta kanyiasheŋ be
mmalga m bugi wulo to be
mmalga nɛ a choŋ na to.
3A la asheŋ nɛ an nu nsaa nyi nna,
nsaa la asheŋ nɛ an nanaana
kaŋɛ anyi na nna.
4Anyi maaŋ ta amo ŋ ŋana
anyi be mbia so.
Anyeeŋ malga Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na
be eleŋgboŋ nɛ mbe asheŋgboŋ
nɛ emamachisheŋ nɛ e wora na
be asheŋ n sa anyi be mbia
nɛ baaŋ ba anyi be kaman na.
5Mo e ta mbe mbraana n sa
Israɛl be basa nɛ b la Jeekɔb
be kaman to ebi na.
Mo e kaŋɛ an nanaana fanɛ
b baa ŋini bumo be mbia
mbe mbraana na;
6saŋɛ na so mbia nɛ baaŋ ba
kaman to na beeŋ koya amo
nseŋ ŋini bumo alɛ be mbia amo.
7Aloŋ e naŋ shin nɛ mbia na gba
e ta bumo be yirda n wɔtɔ Ebɔrɛ to
nsaa maŋ teŋ asɔ nɛ e wora so.
Saŋɛ na so, jemanɛ kikɛ baaŋ baa
wora mbe mbraana na kasonu.
8Bumo ere maaŋ baa du fanɛ
bumo nanaana nɛ b daŋ lar
Ebɔrɛ kaman nseŋ kini kewora
mo kasonu, nɛ bumo be yirda
ashi Ebɔrɛ to daa maa yil to kpakpa,
nɛ b maŋ ji kashenteŋ n sa mo na.
9Kena be kachɛ ka fo,
Efrayimebi nɛ b daa kɔ
ata nɛ atanyembi to na
daŋ lara keya nna n shile.
10B daa maŋ wora m bɔlɔ
bumo nɛ Ebɔrɛ be kɔnɔkoŋwule
be ŋkre na so.
B daŋ kini kewora mbe mbraana
kasonu nna.
11B daŋ teŋ kusɔ e wora so nna,
emamachisheŋ nɛ b daŋ wu
e ka wora na kikɛ nɛ b daŋ teŋ so.
12Bumo nanaana be anishito
nɛ e daŋ wora emamachisheŋ na.
Ijipt be efuli so be kebonfu
nɛ baa tre Zowan na so
nɛ e daŋ wora amo.
13E daŋ shin nɛ teku na ku to nna,
nseŋ shin nɛ nchu na ki
fanɛ egbal a yil,
nɛ e juŋkpar bumo m bɔla
kumo to n choŋ.
14E daa bɔla kuwɔlpa so nna
a ŋini bumo ekpa kapaso,
nseŋ daa bɔla edɛ be kabulpi so
a ŋini bumo ekpa kanyɛso malɛ.
15E daŋ shin nɛ afalta pante a lar
nchu a shile fanɛ mbombi nna
ashi keshishɛrsawule so nɛ b nya
nchu n nuu bumo be kepar.
16Mo e daŋ shin nɛ nchu
shi kefalta to n lar
a shile fanɛ lɔr na.
17Ama b kraŋ wora alubi
n da Enyɛnpetale Ebɔrɛ so;
nseŋ lar mbe kaman ashi
keshishɛrsawule na so.
18B daŋ kute nna n wora
Ebɔrɛ ŋ keni;
jemanɛ nɛ b daa yil mo so
fanɛ e sa bumo ajibi
nɛ b daa sha ga na.
19B daŋ malga nna ŋ gbiti Ebɔrɛ
ŋ kaŋɛ le: “Ebɔrɛ beeŋ tiŋ n sa anyi
ajibi kiyi ere to nfe nna ere a?
20E ka daŋ shin nɛ kefalta na pante na,
nchu daŋ lar a shile fanɛ mbombi na.
Ama e kraa beeŋ tiŋ n sa
anyi ajibi nna ere a?
E beeŋ tiŋ n sa mbe basa
eblaŋ nna ere a?”
21Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na ka nu
kusɔ nɛ b kaŋɛ na,
nɛ e nya agbo ga
nseŋ shin nɛ mbe edɛ suse so
ashi mbe basa nɛ b la Jeekɔb
be kaman to ebi to,
22ŋkpal b ka daa maŋ yirda mo
nseŋ daŋ ji mbe kumɔlga
be eleŋ emɔrɔ so.
23Ama e daŋ naŋ malga
n sa awɔlpa nseŋ daŋ
bugi esoso be mbuna
24nɛ ajibi nɛ baa tre manna na
tɔr to nɛ basa na nya n ji.
Ebɔrɛso be ajibi nɛ
e daŋ sa bumo.
25Amoso emalaika be ajibi
nɛ b daŋ nya n ji;
Ebɔrɛ daŋ sa bumo ajibi
kama nɛ baaŋ tiŋ n ji nna.
26Kumo be kaman nɛ Ebɔrɛ
be eleŋgboŋ shin nɛ afu shi
epeŋilarkpa, a laŋɛ kelargato
be kaseto be kaba so na
ber m ba.
27Afu na daŋ sulɔ mbuibi ko nna
m ba sɔ kasawule na kikɛ so
fanɛ teku ase be eshishɛr na.
28Basa na be keeyi to gbagba
nɛ Ebɔrɛ shin nɛ mbuibi na tɔr
ŋ kulti bumo be ewajɛbu n wɔtɔ.
29Ndoŋ nna nɛ b pɛ bumo m mɔ
n we m moɛ.
Ŋkpal manɛ so, Ebɔrɛ e daŋ sa
bumo asɔ nɛ b daa sha ga
nseŋ daa kɔ a fin amo na.
30Ama b daa maŋ naŋ nya amo
n we bumo be keparso gba,
a kraa wɔ bumo be nnɔ to nna
31nɛ Ebɔrɛ be agbo koso bumo so,
nɛ e shin nɛ bumo to be belempo wu.
Israɛl be efuli so be mbifɔlbi
e daŋ wu na.
32Ama amo nɛ amo kikɛ,
b kraa wora alubi nna.
Emamachisheŋ nɛ Ebɔrɛ
wora na kikɛ be kaman,
b kraa maŋ yirda mo.
33Amoso e daŋ shin nɛ bumo
be ŋkpa ku so nna,
nseŋ daŋ shin nɛ kufugboŋ ko
tɔr bumo so.
34Jemanɛ kikɛ nɛ Ebɔrɛ baŋ
shin nɛ bumo be beko wu,
bumo nɛ b ka na bee tuba nna
nsaa kule mo kenishipere so.
35B daŋ nyiŋi fanɛ Ebɔrɛ la
bumo be ekumpo nna,
nseŋ daŋ naŋ nyiŋi fanɛ
Enyɛnpetale Ebɔrɛ e la
bumo be emɔlgapo.
36Ama bumo be nnɔ to
be mmalga kikɛ la efɛ nna.
Asheŋ kama nɛ baa malga
maa shi bumo be ŋgbene to.
37B daa maa ji kashenteŋ a sa mo;
bumo alɛ daa maa bɛ mo nɛ bumo
be kɔnɔkoŋwule be ŋkre so.
38Ama Ebɔrɛ kraa wu
mbe basa kuwɔr.
E daŋ ta bumo be alubi
m paŋ bumo nna,
nsaa maŋ mur bumo.
Ale damta nɛ e pɛ mbe kagbene,
a maŋ shin nɛ mbe agbo
koso bumo so alegaiso.
39E daŋ nyiŋi fanɛ b la
eyur nɛ ŋklaŋ nna.
B du fanɛ afu nɛ k bee ber
a yɔ a maŋ naa laŋɛ nna.
40Jemanɛ nɛ b daa wɔ
keshishɛrsawule na so na,
ale damta nɛ b daŋ lar
Ebɔrɛ kaman n jija mbe kagbene!
41B daŋ baa wɔtɔ nna
a wora mo a keni,
nsaa wɔtɔ Israɛl be Ebɔrɛ
cheembi na ebesa to.
42B daa maa nyiŋi mbe
eleŋ nɛ e kɔ,
bumo alɛ daa maa nyiŋi
kachɛ nɛ e mɔlga bumo
ashi bumo doŋana be
enɔ to na gba.
43B daŋ teŋ emamachisheŋ
nɛ e wora ashi Zowan be
kebonfu so ashi Ijipt be
efuli so na nna.
44Ebɔrɛ e daŋ shin nɛ Ijipt be
elɔrana be nchu kilgi ŋ ki ŋklaŋ
nɛ b daa maŋ nya nchu nuuso na.
45E daŋ shin nɛ ashushombi
ba sɔ kaplɛkama a tɔrɔ bumo nna;
nɛ ebɔl lar bumo.
E daŋ shin nɛ epulo ba ta
kenishi m pere bumo ashi
kasawule na so nna ga.
46E daŋ shin nɛ elotɔr nɛ alonte
lar nna m ba mur bumo be
adɔjibi kikɛ kasawule na so.
47E daŋ shin nɛ abɔrɛjembubi ba mur
bumo be ndibi sɔrsoana nna,
nseŋ shin nɛ kunyɔlɔ malɛ mur
bumo be figi be ndibi kikɛ.
48Mo e shin nɛ abɔrɛjembubi bri
bumo be ana m mɔ,
nseŋ shin nɛ bɔrɛ nyɛkpɛ m mɔ
bumo be asɔbɔya nɛ a ka na.
49Ebɔrɛ daŋ nya agbo nna
nɛ mbe kagbene koso bumo so ga,
fanɛ luwu be mbɔ damta
ka mel abar so na.
50E daa maŋ pɛ mbe kagbene
ashi mbe agbo na to,
ŋko n yige m paŋ bumo
nɛ b ji efute kikɛ.
E daŋ mɔ bumo nna
n shin nɛ kenishi pere bumo.
51E daŋ shin nɛ Ijipt be efuli so
be ewurkoŋnyɛn kikɛ wu nna.
52Kumo be kaman nɛ
Ebɔrɛ juŋkpar mbe basa
fanɛ mbolpɔkpapo n lar
Ijipt be efuli so m bɔla
keshishɛrsawule so n choŋ.
53E ka daa juŋkpar bumo so,
kufu daa maa kɔ bumo;
ama Teku Peper na daŋ mur
bumo doŋana bre nna.
54Ebɔrɛ daŋ juŋkpar mbe basa nna
n yɔ kepreŋsawule nɛ e bɔla mbe
eleŋgboŋ so n suge n sa bumo na so.
55E daŋ ju efuli pɔtɛana na
be basa nna n lar nseŋ barga
kasawule na nɛ bumo be
nwuana to n sa Israɛl be
eyiri yiri nɛ b la mbe basa na.
56Ama b daŋ lar Ebɔrɛ kaman
nseŋ wora Enyɛnpetale Ebɔrɛ na
ŋ keni nna.
B daa maŋ bɛ mbe mbraana so.
57B daa du fanɛ bumo nanaana
nɛ b daa maa ji kashenteŋ
nseŋ paŋ yirda na nna.
Bumo alɛ daa du fanɛ
ketanyembi kɔnto nɛ esa maaŋ
tiŋ n fute n yige kumo so nna.
58B daŋ pɔr agbirana nna
n yili agurɔŋgu so a shuŋ;
n shin nɛ Ebɔrɛ be kukɔrkɔ
koso nɛ e nya agbo ga.
59Ŋkpal kusɔ nɛ b wora na so,
Ebɔrɛ daŋ nya agbo nna
nseŋ kini Israɛl be basa na n lɛ.
60E daŋ kini mbe wajɛbu nɛ e
daa wɔ kumo to ashi mbe basa to
ashi Shilo be kade to nna n lɛ.
61Kumo be kaman nɛ e shin nɛ
an doŋana kɔ n suge kɔnɔkoŋwule
be ŋkre be deka nɛ k yili n sa
mbe kemaŋkura nɛ eleŋgboŋ na.
62E daŋ nya agbo nna n wɔtɔ mo
gbagba be basa nseŋ shin nɛ
bumo doŋana mɔ bumo.
63Edɛ e daŋ mur bumo be
mbrantiɛbia, nɛ bumo be
besuŋgurbi maŋ nya
benyɛn nɛ b kil.
64Bɔrɛmatapoana na daŋ wu
luwu nyaŋgraŋ nna,
bumo be bekulpoche maŋ nya
n shu bumo be nli gba.
65Kumo be kaman nɛ
Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na kpa niŋi to
fanɛ esa ka tiŋi edi to,
ŋko enapo ka diewu ŋ koso na.
66E daŋ bri mo doŋana nna n ju,
n shin nɛ b ji nyɔmɔ mbaanaayɔ.
67Ama e daŋ kini kebaawɔ
an nananyɛn Josɛf be kaman to ebi to
nseŋ daŋ kini kelara Efrayim be yiri to
ebi n yili n sa mbe kumu nna.
68Juda be yiri to ebi nɛ Zayɔn be kebee
nɛ e daa sha ga ashi Jerusalɛm to na
nɛ e daŋ lara n yili n sa mbe kumu.
69Kumo be awɔlto,
nɛ e daŋ pɔr mbe bɔrɛlambu
nɛ kumo be gbaltɔlase daa kɔ
eleŋ fanɛ kasawule nɛ e to
n yili mbaanaayɔ na.
70Ewura Deevid nɛ e daa
kpa mbolpɔ na nɛ e daŋ
lara fanɛ mbe kayɛrbi.
71Mbolpɔ na be kekpa to nɛ e daa wɔ
nɛ Ebɔrɛ lara mo nseŋ buu mo
Israɛl be kuwura nɛ e baa juŋkpar
mbe basa nɛ b la Jeekɔb
be kaman to ebi na.
72Ewura Deevid malɛ daŋ ta
kagbene koŋwule n juŋkpar bumo
nseŋ wora asheŋ kanyiasheŋ so
ashi bumo to nna.

english_text:
(A psalm by Asaph.)
Have Pity on Jerusalem
1 Our God, foreign nations
have taken your land,
disgraced your temple,
and left Jerusalem in ruins.
2They have fed the bodies
of your servants
to flesh-eating birds;
your loyal people are food
for savage animals.
3All Jerusalem is covered
with their blood,
and there is no one left
to bury them.
4Every nation around us
sneers and makes fun.
5Our Lord, will you keep on
being angry?
Will your angry feelings
keep flaming up like fire?
6Get angry with those nations
that don't know you
and won't worship you!
7They have gobbled up
Jacob's descendants
and left the land in ruins.
8 Don't make us pay for the sins
of our ancestors.
Have pity and come quickly!
We are completely helpless.
9Our God, you keep us safe.
Now help us! Rescue us.
Forgive our sins
and bring honor to yourself.
10Why should nations ask us,
“Where is your God?”
Let us and the other nations
see you take revenge
for your servants who died
a violent death.
11Listen to the prisoners groan!
Let your mighty power save all
who are sentenced to die.
12Each of those nations sneered
at you, our Lord.
Now let others sneer at them,
seven times as much.
13Then we, your people,
will always thank you.
We are like sheep
with you as our shepherd,
and all generations
will hear us praise you.
translation_text:
Efuli na be kesɔnyige be kabɔrɛkule be asheŋ
1O Ebɔrɛ, efuli pɔtɛana so ebi
ba kɔ n suge fo kasawule.
B shin nɛ fo bɔrɛlambu cheembi
na wora eyurpi daŋkare be ekpa so,
nseŋ shin nɛ Jerusalɛm ki
kade bureso a dese fuloŋ.
2B ta fo basa nɛ b wu na
n sa ejita nɛ kupuŋ to
be asɔbɔya nɛ e bee ji.
3B chulgi ŋklaŋ n wurge
nɛ e bee shile fanɛ nchu
ashi Jerusalɛm to.
Esa kikɛ maŋ wɔtɔ
nɛ e puli bubuni na.
4Efuliana nɛ a kulti anyi na
be basa bee mushe nsaa
wora anyi eyurto nna.
5O Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ,
fo nya agbo n wɔtɔ
anyi nna mbaanaayɔ a?
Fo agbo kraa beeŋ baa
suse fanɛ edɛ nna a?
6Laŋɛ fo agbo na n deŋi
efuli pɔtɛana nɛ b maa bunyaŋ fo
ŋko a shu a tre fo ketre na so,
7ŋkpal b ka mɔ Jeekɔb
be kaman to ebi
nseŋ mur fo efuli na so.
8Sa maŋ gberge anyi kusoe
ŋkpal an nanaana be alubi so.
Wu anyi kuwɔr naniere.
Ŋkpal manɛ so,
anyi maŋ naa kɔ tama kikɛ.
9O Ebɔrɛ nɛ fo la anyi be emɔlgapo,
chɛ anyi to!
Ŋkpal fo ketre be kemaŋkura so,
mɔlga anyi nseŋ ta anyi be
alubi m paŋ anyi.
10Manɛ nna nɛ efuli pɔtɛana na
bee bishi anyi fanɛ,
nnɛ nɛ menyi be Ebɔrɛ na wɔ?
Shin nɛ an wu kasogberge
nɛ k bee ba efuliana na so,
ŋkpal b ka chulgi basa
nɛ b shuŋ fo be ŋklaŋ
n wurge so.
11Kaŋ kusoe n nu basa
nɛ b wɔ kabuti to be kushu.
Ta fo eleŋgboŋ na n sɔ basa
nɛ baa shin nɛ b mɔ na n yige.
12O Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ,
fo e naaŋ ka efuli pɔtɛana
nɛ a kulti anyi ere kukɔ
ale shunu so;
ŋkpal b ka tege fo na so.
13Saŋɛ na so anyi nɛ an la fo basa,
a du fanɛ fo mbolpɔ ere,
beeŋ baa di fo epaŋ
nsaa kpaŋ fo mbaanaayɔ.

english_text:
(A psalm by Asaph for the music leader. To the tune “Lilies of the Agreement.”)
Help Our Nation
1 Shepherd of Israel, you lead
the descendants of Joseph,
and you sit on your throne
above the winged creatures.
Listen to our prayer
and let your light shine
2for the tribes of Ephraim,
Benjamin, and Manasseh.
Save us by your power.
3Our God, make us strong again!
Smile on us and save us.
4 Lord God All-Powerful,
how much longer
will the prayers of your people
make you angry?
5You gave us tears for food,
and you made us drink them
by the bowlful.
6Because of you,
our enemies who live nearby
laugh and joke about us.
7Our God, make us strong again!
Smile on us and save us.
8We were like a grapevine
you brought out of Egypt.
You chased other nations away
and planted us here.
9Then you cleared the ground,
and we put our roots deep,
spreading over the land.
10Shade from this vine covered
the mountains.
Its branches climbed
the mighty cedars
11and stretched to the sea;
its new growth reached
to the river.
12Our Lord, why have you
torn down the wall
from around the vineyard?
You let everyone who walks by
pick the grapes.
13Now the vine is gobbled up
by pigs from the forest
and other wild animals.
14God All-Powerful,
please do something!
Look down from heaven
and see what's happening
to this vine.
15With your own hands
you planted its roots,
and you raised it
as your very own.
16Enemies chopped the vine down
and set it on fire.
Now show your anger
and destroy them.
17But help the one who sits
at your right side,
the one you raised
to be your very own.
18Then we will never turn away.
Put new life into us,
and we will worship you.
19 Lord God All-Powerful,
make us strong again!
Smile on us and save us.
translation_text:
Kechɛ anyi be efuli to be kabɔrɛkule be asheŋ
1O Israɛl be ekenipo,
nu anyi be kekule!
Fo nɛ fee juŋkpar Josɛf be
kaman to ebi fanɛ mbolpɔ
nseŋ chena fo kuwurputi so
ashi asɔ pɔrso nɛ baa tre
chɛrubim na be nferinto na,
2lara fo kumu ŋ ŋini Efrayim
nɛ Bɛnjamin nɛ Manase
be eyiri to ebi.
Ŋini fo eleŋ nseŋ ba mɔlga anyi!
3O Ebɔrɛ, naŋ shin nɛ an nya eleŋ!
Mushe n wɔtɔ anyi nseŋ mɔlga anyi.
4O Enyɛnpetale Ewurbɔrɛ,
jemanɛ mo nɛ fo basa be
kabɔrɛkule maaŋ naa nu fo agbo?
5Fo shin nɛ anishichubi ki
bumo be ajibi jiso
nɛ nchu nuuso.
6Fo shin nɛ efuli pɔtɛana
nɛ a kulti anyi na bee kɔ abar
kena ŋkpal anyi be kasawule so,
nseŋ shin nɛ an doŋana bee tege
anyi nsaa mushe anyi.
7O Enyɛnpetale Ebɔrɛ,
naŋ mushe n wɔtɔ anyi,
nɛ an naŋ nya kumɔlga.
8An du fanɛ asɔrso nɛ baa
tre greeps na be kefeelebi nna,
nɛ fo keta anyi n lar Ijipt be efuli so
nseŋ ba ju efuli pɔtɛana so be basa
n lɛ nseŋ ta anyi n fɛa bumo
be kasawule so.
9Fo e lɔŋɛ kasawule na so,
nɛ kefeelebi na e tiŋ n daŋ;
nɛ kumo be nliŋi e nya
n luri kasawule to nɛnɛ.
Saŋɛ na so k beeŋ purge
m buu kasawule na kikɛ so.
10Nɛ kumo be kayul e daŋ m buu
abeeana na so nɛ kumo be ayabi
malɛ e daŋ m buu sida
be ndibigboŋ so.
11Nseŋ daŋ n ya fo Mɛditerenia
be teku na ase, n ta n ya fo
Yufreetes be lɔr na ase gba.
12Manɛ nna nɛ fo buri kunji
nɛ k bee kuŋ kumo na to,
nɛ ekama nɛ e bɔla ndoŋ
a choŋ bee nya kumo be
asɔrso a chuge?
13Kupuŋ to be asɔbɔya alubi gba
bee nya amo be asɔrso a ji.
14O Enyɛnpetale Ebɔrɛ,
naŋ bɛta m ba anyi kutɔ!
Shi ebɔrɛso n to kenishi
ŋ keni anyi nseŋ ba mɔlga
fo basa!
15Ba mɔlga kefeelebi popɔrbi
nɛ fo gbagba fɛa nseŋ shin nɛ
k daŋ n nya eleŋ ga na.
16Bedoŋ ba ku kefeelebi na n lɛ
nseŋ nya edɛ n wɔtɔ kumo to.
Naniere shin nɛ fo agbo e ba
mur bedoŋ na.
17Chɛ esa nɛ e chena fo
enɔ jisa so na to.
Mo e la nyiŋgbasa pibinyɛn
nɛ fo bela mo n sa fo kumu na.
18Anyi maaŋ naŋ lar fo
kaman kikɛ.
Sa anyi ŋkpa popɔr nɛ an baa
bunyaŋ fo.
19O Enyɛnpetale Ewurbɔrɛ,
naŋ bɛta anyi m ba fo kutɔ!
Mushe n wɔtɔ anyi n shin nɛ
an nya kumɔlga.

english_text:
(By Asaph for the music leader.
)
God Makes Us Strong
1Be happy and shout to God
who makes us strong!
Shout praises to the God
of Jacob.
2Sing as you play tambourines
and the lovely sounding
stringed instruments.
3 Sound the trumpets and start
the New Moon Festival.
We must also celebrate
when the moon is full.
4This is the law in Israel,
and it was given to us
by the God of Jacob.
5The descendants of Joseph
were told to obey it,
when God led them out
from the land of Egypt.
In a voice unknown to me,
I heard someone say:
6“I lifted the burden
from your shoulder
and took the heavy basket
from your hands.
7 When you were in trouble,
I rescued you,
and from the thunderclouds,
I answered your prayers.
Later I tested you
at Meribah Spring.
8“Listen, my people,
while I, the Lord,
correct you!
Israel, if you would only
pay attention to me!
9 Don't worship foreign gods
or bow down to gods
you know nothing about.
10I am the Lord your God.
I rescued you from Egypt.
Just ask, and I will give you
whatever you need.
11“But, my people, Israel,
you refused to listen,
and you would have nothing
to do with me!
12So I let you be stubborn
and keep on following
your own advice.
13“My people, Israel,
if only you would listen
and do as I say!
14I, the Lord, would quickly
defeat your enemies
with my mighty power.
15Everyone who hates me
would come crawling,
and that would be the end
of them.
16But I would feed you
with the finest bread
and with the best honey
until you were full.”
translation_text:
Ebɔrɛ ka bee sa anyi eleŋ be asheŋ
1Men boŋ nshɛ kagbenefuliso
n sa Ebɔrɛ nɛ e bee sa anyi
eleŋ na!
Men boŋ nshɛ ŋ kpaŋ
an nananyɛn Jeekɔb be Ebɔrɛ na!
2Men fara a boŋ nshɛ nsaa
laŋ echakachaka a wɔtɔ;
men baa laŋ ejaŋjilaŋ nɛ egoji
a boŋ nshɛ belbelso.
3Men foŋ mbel n fara kufɔl popɔr
be kejigboŋ be kasheŋwora na
kufɔl kikɛ be kachɛ sososo nɛ
kumo be kachɛ baŋɛto na.
4Mbra nɛ k dese Israɛl
be efuli so nna na;
an nananyɛn Jeekɔb be
Ebɔrɛ na e yili kumo.
5Mo e ta kumo n sa Israɛl be basa,
nɛ b la Josɛf be kaman to ebi na,
jemanɛ nɛ Ebɔrɛ daŋ juŋkpar bumo
n lar Ijipt be efuli so na.
N daŋ nu esa ko ka kaŋɛ ma
ashi ŋgbar nɛ m maŋ nyi to le:
6“Ma e daŋ bɛge esulɔ
gbɛgbɛso na ashi menyi so,
nseŋ sɔ nlantaŋɛ gbɛgbɛso na
menyi be enɔana to.
7Men ka daa wɔ etɔrɔ to,
ma nɛ men shu n tre,
nɛ m mɔlga menyi.
Abɔrɛwɔlpa to nɛ n daa wɔ
nseŋ nu menyi be kushu.
Kumo be kaman nɛ n wora
menyi ŋ keni ashi Mɛriba
be kebuye na ase.
8O ma basa, men nu ma
kasokpele ere.
Israɛlebi, n daa beeŋ baa sha
fanɛ men nu n sa ma!
9Men sa maŋ kaŋ shuŋ efuli pɔtɛ
kikɛ be kegbir, ŋko kegbir kikɛ
nɛ menyi maŋ nyi shɛŋ a laŋɛ
kumo kaplɛa so!
10Ma e la Enyɛnpe menyi be Ebɔrɛ
nɛ e lara menyi ashi Ijipt
be efuli so m ba na.
Menyi ere e bugi kɔnɔ ŋ kaŋɛ ma
kusɔ nɛ menyee sha de,
nɛ n wora kumo n sa menyi.
11Ama ma basa maa nu a sa ma;
Israɛl be basa na maa wora ma
kasonu.
12Ŋkpal loŋ so nɛ n yige bumo
n sa bumo be ŋkpensheŋ
be kebaawɔtɔ nɛ b wɔtɔ a wora
asheŋ nɛ baa sha.
13Ma basa, Israɛlebi,
daa beeŋ nu n sa ma
nseŋ bɛ ma ekpaana so nna,
14ndafanɛ ma, Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na
daa beeŋ nya manaŋ n ta ma
eleŋgboŋ na m pɔɔ bumo doŋana
kikɛ so n sa bumo.
15Bekama nɛ b kishi ma,
Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na,
beeŋ ta kufu m ba jɔŋɛ ma ase;
bumo alɛ be kasogberge beeŋ
baa wɔtɔ mbaanaayɔ.
16Ama menyi ere, ayu lela
nɛ abee to be mushoŋchu
nɛ meeŋ ta m bela menyi
nɛ men ji m moɛ.”

english_text:
(A psalm by Asaph.)
Please Do Something, God!
1When all the other gods
have come together,
the Lord God judges them
and says:
2“How long will you
keep judging unfairly
and favoring evil people?
3Be fair to the poor
and to orphans.
Defend the helpless
and everyone in need.
4Rescue the weak and homeless
from the powerful hands
of heartless people.
5“None of you know
or understand a thing.
You live in darkness,
while the foundations
of the earth tremble.
6 “I, the Most High God, say
that all of you are gods
and also my own children.
7But you will die,
just like everyone else,
including powerful rulers.”
8Do something, God!
Judge the nations of the earth;
they belong to you.
translation_text:
Ebɔrɛ Ewurgboŋ na be asheŋ
1Ebɔrɛ e naa juŋkpar ebɔrɛso
be nshɛrgboŋ na;
mo e naa ji agbirana na demu
a kaŋɛ amo le:
2“A maŋ daga men baa ji demu
a kpɛa beko to;
men sa maa ji a chɛ
kumukpakpaso wuraana to!
3Men baa ji asheŋ nɛ amo
be ekpa so a sa bepɔshipo
nɛ amunibi nɛ betentaŋasepo
nɛ basa nɛ b maŋ kɔ
echɛtopo kikɛ na.
4Men baa kɔ a suge bepɔshipo
nɛ betentaŋasepo ashi
kumukpakpasowuraana be enɔ to.
5Menyi be ekama maŋ nyi shɛŋ
ŋko a pin asheŋ to!
Tentembiri to nɛ men wɔ
a nite a kulti;
saŋɛ so nɛ durnya kikɛ be
gbaltɔlase bee gbuŋgbuŋ.
6Ma, Enyɛnpetale Ebɔrɛ na
e kaŋɛ fanɛ men kikɛ la
agbirana nna nsaa la
ŋ gbagba be asɔ toso.
7Ama menyeeŋ baa wu
fanɛ edimɛdi;
menyi alɛ be ŋkpa beeŋ baa
loge fanɛ ewurjipo kama peya.”
8O Ebɔrɛ, koso n ji durnya demu,
ŋkpal manɛ so,
efuliana na kikɛ la fo peya nna.

english_text:
(A song and a psalm by Asaph.)
God Rules All the Earth
1Our God, don't just sit there,
silently doing nothing!
2Your hateful enemies
are turning against you
and rebelling.
3They are sly, and they plot
against those you treasure.
4They say, “Let's wipe out
the nation of Israel
and make sure that no one
remembers its name!”
5All of them fully agree
in their plans against you,
and among them are
6Edom and the Ishmaelites;
Moab and the Hagrites;
7Gebal, Ammon, and Amalek;
Philistia and Phoenicia.
8Even Assyria has joined forces
with Moab and Ammon.
9 Our Lord, punish all of them
as you punished Midian.
Destroy them, as you destroyed
Sisera and Jabin
at Kishon Creek 10near Endor,
and let their bodies rot.
11 Treat their leaders as you did
Oreb and Zeeb,
Zebah and Zalmunna.
12All of them said, “We'll take
God's valuable land!”
13Our God, scatter them around
like dust in a whirlwind.
14Just as flames destroy forests
on the mountains,
15pursue and terrify them
with storms of your own.
16Make them blush with shame,
until they turn and worship
you, our Lord.
17Let them be forever ashamed
and confused.
Let them die in disgrace.
18Make them realize that you
are the Lord Most High,
the only ruler of earth!
translation_text:
Ebɔrɛ ka bee ji kuwura durnya kikɛ so be asheŋ
1O Ebɔrɛ, sa maŋ wora shruum,
n lo to a maa wora shɛŋ!
2Keni, fo doŋana e lar fo kaman
nseŋ koso a kɔ fo na.
3Baa kre fo basa ŋkre lubi
ashiri to nna;
Basa nɛ fee sha ga na be
ŋkre lubi nɛ baa kre.
4B yɛ: “Men ba nɛ an ya mur
bumo be efuli na,
nɛ esa maaŋ naa nyiŋi
Israɛl be asheŋ hale mbaanaayɔ.”
5B wora kɔnɔkoŋwule nna ŋ kre
fanɛ baaŋ chɛ abar ŋ kɔ fo.
6Basa nɛ b kre loŋ be ŋkre na
e la Edɔmebi nɛ Ishmaɛlebi,
nɛ Mowabebi nɛ Hegaebi,
7nɛ basa nɛ b shi Gebal nɛ Ammɔn
nɛ Amalɛk be efuliana so,
nɛ Filisti nɛ Tayɛ be ndegboŋana to.
8Asiriya be efuli so ebi gba shuli so
fanɛ baaŋ ya ti Ammɔnebi nɛ
Mowabebi, nɛ b la Lɔt be kaman to
ebi na so, nɛ b nya eleŋ n ti so.
9Wora bumo kusɔ nɛ fo wora
Midianebi nɛ basa nɛ baa tre
Sisɛra nɛ Jabin, ashi Kishɔn be
lɔr na ase na.
10Kakpa nɛ baa tre Ɛndɔ na
nɛ fo daŋ mur bumo;
bumo be kebuni daŋ dese
kasawule so nna m bɛ.
11Wora bumo be bejuŋkparpo
kusɔ nɛ fo daŋ wora Ɔrɛb nɛ Ziib na.
Pɔɔ bumo be bewuraana so
fanɛ kananɛ fo daŋ pɔɔ
Zeba nɛ Zalmuna gba so na.
12Kusɔ nɛ b daŋ kaŋɛ nde:
“Men shin nɛ an sɔ Ebɔrɛ be
kasawule na ŋ ki anyi peya.”
13O anyi be Ebɔrɛ, shin nɛ b ki
fanɛ eshishɛr ŋko amimi nɛ afu
foŋ n ya lɛ na.
14Kananɛ edɛ baa ji kupo na,
ŋko a suse abee so na,
15aloŋ a daga fanɛ fo ta bɔrɛfugboŋ
n ju bumo n lɛ, nseŋ shin nɛ afugboŋ
a funti bumo nɛ b baa chicha.
16O Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ,
shin nɛ b ji anishinyɔr,
saŋɛ na so basa beeŋ
yɛla kenishi to n fin fo.
17Shin nɛ b kɔ n tɔr nɛ kufu
e pɛ bumo mbaanaayɔ,
nseŋ shin nɛ b wu ŋaba be luwu.
18Shin nɛ b pin fanɛ fo e la
Enyɛnpetale Ebɔrɛ.
Fo alɛ nawule e naa ji kuwura
durnya kikɛ so.

english_text:
(For the music leader.
A psalm by the clan of Korah.)
The Joy of Worship
1 Lord God All-Powerful,
your temple is so lovely!
2Deep in my heart I long
for your temple,
and with all that I am
I sing joyful songs to you.
3 Lord God All-Powerful,
my King and my God,
sparrows find a home
near your altars;
swallows build nests there
to raise their young.
4You bless everyone
who lives in your house,
and they sing your praises.
5You bless all who depend
on you for their strength
and all who deeply desire
to visit your temple.
6When they reach Dry Valley,
springs start flowing,
and the autumn rain fills it
with pools of water.
7Your people grow stronger,
and you, the God of gods,
will be seen in Zion.
8 Lord God All-Powerful,
the God of Jacob,
please answer my prayer!
9You are the shield
that protects your people,
and I am your chosen one.
Won't you smile on me?
10One day in your temple
is better than a thousand
anywhere else.
I would rather serve
in your house,
than live in the homes
of the wicked.
11Our Lord and our God,
you are like the sun
and also like a shield.
You treat us with kindness
and with honor,
never denying any good thing
to those who live right.
12 Lord God All-Powerful,
you bless everyone
who trusts you.
translation_text:
Kabɔrɛshuŋ to be kagbenefuli be asheŋ
1O Enyɛnpetale Ebɔrɛ,
fo bɔrɛlambu na walɛ pasaa!
2Kumo to be keyɔ bee yɛlga ma ga!
Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na be bɔrɛlambu to
be keyɔ wɔ ma kagbene to ga.
N ta ma kagbene nɛ ma eyur kikɛ nna
a boŋ nshɛ kagbenefuliso a sa Ebɔrɛ
nɛ e wɔ ŋkpa to na.
3Enyɛnpetale Ebɔrɛ nɛ fo la ma
Ewura nɛ ma Ebɔrɛ.
Etitibi nɛ abɔrɛpɔpɔbi kikɛ tɔ
bumo be asha nna m mata
fo bɔrɛsure nsaa to a bure ndoŋ.
4Kagbenefuli la bekama nɛ b wɔ
fo bɔrɛlambu to a boŋ nshɛ
jemanɛ kikɛ e kpaŋ fo na peya nna.
5Kagbenefuli la bekama nɛ
baa nya eleŋ fo kutɔ nsaa pere
kenishi a yɔ Zayɔn be kebee so
n ya kaa shuŋ fo na peya nna.
6Jemanɛ kikɛ nɛ b baŋ ya kaa
bɔla ketaŋɛ wɔlso nɛ baa
tre Baka na to, k bee ki kebuye
nna a shile.
Kpanchali so be bɔrɛ gba bee
shin nɛ k bee bɔlɔ nchu nna a shile.
7Fo basa bee nya eleŋ nna a ti so,
n ya fo fanɛ ekama ka beeŋ baa
tiŋ a ba Ebɔrɛ na be anishito
ashi Zayɔn be kebee na so.
8O Enyɛnpetale Ebɔrɛ,
nu ma kabɔrɛkule;
O Jeekɔb be Ebɔrɛ,
kaŋ kusoe n nu ŋ kutɔ!
9O Ebɔrɛ, nɛfa anyi be ewura,
nɛ fo gbagba lara n sa fo kumu na.
10Keji kachɛ koŋwule ashi
fo bɔrɛlambu to bɔ keji nchɛ
kagboŋ ashi kakpa pɔtɛ.
Ŋ ka yili ma Ebɔrɛ be lambu
be kabuna to bɔ ŋ ka wɔ
kumukpakpasowura pe.
11Ŋkpal manɛ so,
Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na du fanɛ epeŋi
nɛ kebɛlso be kusɔ kuŋso nna.
Mo e naa wu kuwɔr nsaa ta
bunyaŋ a buu esa so,
mo alɛ maa ta kusɔ lela
a ŋana basa niŋiso so.
12O Enyɛnpetale Ebɔrɛ,
kagbenefuli la esa kama nɛ
e yirda fo na peya nna!

english_text:
(A psalm by the clan of Korah for the music leader.)
A Prayer for Peace
1Our Lord, you have blessed
your land
and made all go well
for Jacob's descendants.
2You have forgiven the sin
and taken away the guilt
of your people.
3Your fierce anger is no longer
aimed at us.
4Our Lord and our God,
you save us!
Please bring us back home
and don't be angry.
5Will you always be angry
with us and our families?
6Won't you give us fresh life
and let your people be glad
because of you?
7Show us your love
and save us!
8I will listen to you, Lord God,
because you promise peace
to those who are faithful
and no longer foolish.
9You are ready to rescue
everyone who worships you,
so that you will live with us
in all your glory.
10Love and loyalty
will come together;
goodness and peace
will unite.
11Loyalty will sprout
from the ground;
justice will look down
from the sky above.
12Our Lord, you will bless us;
our land will produce
wonderful crops.
13Justice will march in front,
making a path
for you to follow.
translation_text:
Efuli na be nɛnɛ be kabɔrɛkule be asheŋ
1O Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ,
fo e nɛfa fo kasawule
nseŋ shin nɛ kusɔ kama
nite nɛnɛ n sa Israɛlebi nɛ
b la Jeekɔb be kaman to ebi na.
2Fo e ta fo basa be alubi
m paŋ bumo nɛ kejimbri
maŋ naa wɔ bumo so.
3Fo daŋ kaa kagbene nna,
n nya agbo n wɔtɔ bumo.
4O Ebɔrɛ nɛ fo la anyi be emɔlgapo,
naŋ bɛta anyi m ba fo kutɔ,
nsaa maŋ nya agbo n wɔtɔ anyi!
5Feeŋ nya agbo n wɔtɔ anyi nɛ
anyi be nnaŋ to ebi mbaanaayɔ a?
6Naŋ sa anyi eleŋ nɛ anyi,
nɛ an la fo basa na be ŋgbene
e baa fuli fo so nɛ an baa kpaŋ fo.
7O Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ,
ŋini anyi fo kasha nɛ
k maŋ kɔ ekar na,
nseŋ kumɔlga anyi.
8Mee kaŋ kusoe a nu kusɔ nɛ
Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na bee kaŋɛ nna.
E nase kayurwushi be kɔnɔ n sa
anyi, mbe basa; nɛ anyi maŋ naŋ
bɛta n yɔ anyi be kawulisheŋ to nna.
9Kashenteŋto e wora shiriya
nɛ e mɔlga bekama nɛ baa
ŋana mo na nna;
saŋɛ na so mo gbagba be
kemaŋkura beeŋ baa wɔ
anyi be kasawule so.
10Kasha nɛ kashenteŋji
beeŋ ba abar so,
nɛ alelasheŋ nɛ kayurwushi
malɛ e ki kukoŋwule.
11Edimɛdi be kashenteŋji
beeŋ shi kasawule so nna;
nɛ Ebɔrɛ be kebaawɔtɔ
niŋiso bee shi ebɔrɛso.
12Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na beeŋ
nɛfa anyi nɛ anyi be kasawule
e wora adɔjibi nɛnɛ.
13Kebaawɔtɔ niŋiso beeŋ juŋkpar
a lɔŋɛ akpa a sa Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na
nɛ e baa bɛ so.

english_text:
(A prayer by David.)
A Prayer for Help
1Please listen, Lord,
and answer my prayer!
I am poor and helpless.
2Protect me and save me
because you are my God.
I am your faithful servant,
and I trust you.
3Be kind to me!
I pray to you all day.
4Make my heart glad!
I serve you,
and my prayer is sincere.
5You willingly forgive,
and your love is always there
for those who pray to you.
6Please listen, Lord!
Answer my prayer for help.
7When I am in trouble, I pray,
knowing you will listen.
8No other gods are like you;
only you work miracles.
9 You created each nation,
and they will all bow down
to worship and honor you.
10You perform great wonders
because you alone are God.
11Teach me to follow you,
and I will obey your truth.
Always keep me faithful.
12With all my heart I thank you.
I praise you, Lord God.
13Your love for me is so great
that you protected me
from death and the grave.
14Proud and violent enemies,
who don't care about you,
have ganged up to attack
and kill me.
15But you, the Lord God,
are kind and merciful.
You don't easily get angry,
and your love
can always be trusted.
16I serve you, Lord,
and I am the child
of one of your servants.
Look on me with kindness.
Make me strong and save me.
17Show that you approve of me!
Then my hateful enemies
will feel like fools,
because you have helped
and comforted me.
translation_text:
Kekule Ebɔrɛ n fin kechɛto be asheŋ
1O Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ,
kaŋ kusoe n nu ma kekule,
ŋkpal manɛ so, etirpo nɛ
etentaŋasepo e la ma.
2Ŋkpal ŋ kaa bee nu a sa fo so,
mɔlga ma ashi luwu to.
Ŋkpal ŋ ka la fo kayɛrbi
nseŋ yirda fo so, baa kuŋ ma.
3O Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ, wu ma kuwɔr!
Kachɛ lelemu nɛ mee shu a tre fo.
4Shin nɛ fo kayɛrbi be kagbene
e fuli mo;
ŋkpal ŋ ka shi ma kagbene
to a kule fo so.
5O Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ, fo la esa lela
nɛ fee ta alubi a paŋ nna.
Fo alɛ kɔ kasha damta n sa
bumo nɛ baa shu a tre fo na nna.
6O Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ,
kaŋ kusoe n nu ma kabɔrɛkule,
nseŋ wu ma kuwɔr n chɛ ma to.
7M baa wɔ tɔrɔ to,
fo nɛ mee shu a tre;
ma alɛ nyi fanɛ fee
nu ma kabɔrɛkule.
8O Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ,
agbirana kikɛ maŋ du fanɛ fo,
Ebɔrɛ kikɛ maŋ naa wɔtɔ
a du fanɛ fo.
Esa malɛ kikɛ maŋ naŋ wora
asheŋ nɛ fee wora ere be kekama.
9Efuliana nɛ fo to ere be basa
beeŋ ba jɔŋɛ fo ase m bunyaŋ fo
n shin nɛ fo ketre e nya kemaŋkura.
10Fo ka la Ebɔrɛ so,
fo nawule e naa wora
emamachisheŋ nɛ e
bee mɔ kɔnɔ.
11O Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ,
ŋini ma kusɔ nɛ fee sha fanɛ n wora.
Meeŋ baa nu a sa fo kashenteŋ na.
Ŋini ma kananɛ meeŋ ta ma kagbene
kikɛ a shuŋ fo nsaa bunyaŋ fo ketre na.
12O Enyɛnpe ma Ebɔrɛ,
meeŋ bugi ma kagbene to ŋ kpaŋ fo,
nseŋ maŋkura fo ketre mbaanaayɔ.
13Ŋkpal manɛ so,
kasha nɛ fo kɔ n sa ma na
shi alegaiso!
Fo mɔlga ma ashi luwu
gbagba to.
14O Ebɔrɛ, kamoowuwuraana
koso ma so nna;
nɛ basa lubi cha abar a fin ma
nɛ b mɔ.
Bumo alɛ kikɛ maŋ ta fo n tre shɛŋ.
15Ama fo, Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na,
la ewɔrwupo nɛ kasha be Ebɔrɛ nna.
Fo la esa nna nsaa kɔ kanyiti,
a wu kuwɔr jemanɛ kikɛ.
16Keni ma nseŋ wu ma kuwɔr!
Sa fo kayɛrbi fo gbagba be eleŋ na
nseŋ mɔlga fo kenyache pibinyɛn.
17Shin nɛ ekama e pin alelasheŋ
nɛ fee wora a sa ma.
Saŋɛ na so ma doŋana beeŋ wu
kumo be loŋ nɛ nyɔmɔ e pɛ bumo.
Ŋkpal manɛ so, fo Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na,
e chɛ ma to nseŋ lolo ma
nɛ ma kagbene wushi ma.

english_text:
(A psalm and a song by the clan of Korah.)
The Glory of Mount Zion
1Zion was built by the Lord
on the holy mountain,
2and he loves that city
more than any other place
in all of Israel.
3Zion, you are the city of God,
and wonderful things
are told about you.
4Egypt, Babylonia, Philistia,
Phoenicia, and Ethiopia
are some of those nations
that know you,
and their people all say,
“I was born in Zion.”
5God Most High will strengthen
the city of Zion.
Then everyone will say,
“We were born here too.”
6The Lord will make a list
of his people,
and all who were born here
will be included.
7All who sing or dance will say,
“I too am from Zion.”
translation_text:
Jerusalɛm be kekpaŋ be asheŋ
1Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na pɔr mbe
kadegboŋ n yili kebee
cheembi na so nna.
2Mo alɛ bee sha kadegboŋ na
a chɔ kade kikɛ ashi Israɛl
be efuli na kikɛ so.
3Jerusalɛm la Ebɔrɛ be kadegboŋ nna,
nɛ baa malga asheŋ lela damta ga
a laŋɛ kumo be kaplɛa so.
4Nɛ m baa ti efuliana nɛ a bee nu
a sa ma be atre, meeŋ ti Ijipt nɛ
Babilɔn be efuliana n ti so.
Nɛ m baa naa karga Jerusalɛm
to be basa, meeŋ karga Filisti nɛ
Itiopia be efuliana nɛ Tayɛ
be kadegboŋ to be basa gba n ti so.
5Kashenteŋto, kusɔ nɛ baaŋ baa kaŋɛ
a laŋɛ Jerusalɛm be kaplɛa so nde:
“Jerusalɛm to nɛ b kurge kuti nɛ kuti.
Enyɛnpetale Ebɔrɛ na malɛ e naa
sa kumo eleŋ.”
6Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na beeŋ shin nɛ
b sibɛ mbe basa be atre n nase
nseŋ ta bekama nɛ b kurge ndoŋ
gba be atre n ti so fanɛ b ka la
Jerusalɛm to be ndetobia na;
7nɛ bumo be bekama nɛ baaŋ
baa boŋ nshɛ a cha na e baa kaŋɛ le:
“Anyi alɛ gba la Jerusalɛm to be
ndetobia gbagba nna.”

english_text:
(A song and a psalm by the clan of Korah for the music leader. To the tune “Mahalath Leannoth.”
A special psalm by Heman the Ezrahite.)
A Prayer When You Can't Find the Way
1You keep me safe, Lord God.
So when I pray at night,
2please listen carefully
to each of my concerns.
3I am deeply troubled
and close to death;
4I am as good as dead
and completely helpless.
5I am no better off
than those in the grave,
those you have forgotten
and no longer help.
6You have put me in the deepest
and darkest grave;
7your anger rolls over me
like ocean waves.
8You have made my friends turn
in horror from me.
I am a prisoner
who cannot escape,
9and I am almost blind
because of my sorrow.
Each day I lift my hands
in prayer to you, Lord.
10Do you work miracles
for the dead?
Do they stand up
and praise you?
11Are your love and loyalty
announced in the world
of the dead?
12Do they know of your miracles
or your saving power
in the dark world below
where all is forgotten?
13Each morning I pray
to you, Lord.
14Why do you reject me?
Why do you turn from me?
15Ever since I was a child,
I have been sick
and close to death.
You have terrified me
and made me helpless.
16Your anger is like a flood!
And I am shattered
by your furious attacks
17that strike each day
and from every side.
18My friends and neighbors
have turned against me
because of you,
and now darkness
is my only companion.
translation_text:
Kekule Ebɔrɛ be kechɛto be asheŋ
1O Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ
nɛ fo la ma emɔlgapo,
kapa nɛ kanyɛ,
fo nɛ mee shu a tre.
2Jande nu ma kabɔrɛkule
nseŋ kaŋ kusoe n nu ma kushu.
3Etɔrɔ damta e ba ma so,
hale nɛ n taga to luwu.
4Baa karga ma nna a ti
basa nɛ b wu so;
ŋ ki fanɛ esa nɛ e maŋ
naa kɔ eleŋ nna.
5Ŋ ki fanɛ ebuni nɛ b kplaŋ
mbe asheŋ so ŋko esa nɛ
b mɔ m puli nchaŋ to nna.
Ŋko esa nɛ fo maŋ naa
nyiŋi mbe asheŋ,
fo alɛ be kechɛto maŋ naa
tu mo na nna.
6Fo ta ma n lɛ nchaŋ chiŋgeliŋ
nɛ k biri to mina to nna.
7Fo kanya agbo muni ma so nna
fanɛ nchu ka muni esa so na.
8Fo shin nɛ nteriana kini ma n lɛ,
nɛ ma asheŋ bee nu bumo agbo.
M baŋ nyaŋto nna a wɔtɔ,
a maaŋ naŋ tiŋ n suge ma kumu.
9Ma alɛ shu nna m puŋi anishi,
ŋkpal awurfoŋ nɛ kagbenejijaso.
O Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ, fo nɛ mee maŋ
ma enɔana so a shu a tre
karechɛ kikɛ.
10Fo maa wora emamachisheŋ
a sa bubuni.
Bumo alɛ maa koso a kpaŋ fo.
11B maa malga fo kasha
nɛ k maŋ kɔ ekar na
ŋko fo kashenteŋji be asheŋ
ashi bubuni to.
12B maa wu fo emamachisheŋ
ashi kakpa nɛ k biri to mina;
ŋko a nyi fo alelasheŋ be asheŋ
ashi kakpa nɛ b maŋ naa nyiŋi
shɛŋ be asheŋ.
13Ama fo Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na
nɛ mee shu a tre kachipurso
kikɛ fanɛ fo chɛ ma to.
14O Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ,
manɛ nna nɛ fee kini ma a lɛ,
nsaa ta fo kumu a ŋana ma so?
15Ma kebia to kikɛ nɛ n ji awurfoŋ,
hale a taga to luwu gba kuraa.
Fo kasogberge shin nɛ kufugboŋ
tɔr ma so, hale ma aba pɔ ma ga.
16Fo agbo ki fanɛ nchu nna
m muni ma so;
nɛ fo etɔrɔ malɛ mur ma cheche.
17Karechɛ kikɛ a kulti ma
n wɔtɔ kaba kama so nna.
18Fo shin nɛ nteri kpakpasoana
nɛ ma beshapo kikɛ kini ma n lɛ
nseŋ kplaŋ ma so, nɛ k wora fanɛ
tentembiri e ki nteri kpakpaso.

english_text:
(A special psalm by Ethan the Ezrahite.)
The Lord's Agreement with David
1 Our Lord, I will sing
of your love forever.
Everyone yet to be born
will hear me praise
your faithfulness.
2I will tell them, “God's love
can always be trusted,
and his faithfulness lasts
as long as the heavens.”
3You said, “David, my servant,
is my chosen one,
and this is the agreement
I made with him:
4 David, one of your descendants
will always be king.”
5Our Lord, let the heavens
now praise your miracles,
and let all your angels
praise your faithfulness.
6None who live in the heavens
can compare with you.
7You are the most fearsome
of all who live in heaven;
all the others fear
and greatly honor you.
8You are Lord God All-Powerful!
No one is as loving
and faithful as you are.
9You rule the roaring sea
and calm its waves.
10You crushed the monster Rahab,
and with your powerful arm
you scattered your enemies.
11The heavens and the earth
belong to you.
And so does the world
with all its people
because you created them
12and everything else.
Mount Tabor and Mount Hermon
gladly praise you.
13You are strong and mighty!
14Your kingdom is ruled
by justice and fairness
with love and faithfulness
leading the way.
15Our Lord, you bless those
who join in the festival
and walk in the brightness
of your presence.
16We are happy all day
because of you,
and your saving power
brings honor to us.
17Your own glorious power
makes us strong,
and because of your kindness,
our strength increases.
18Our Lord and our King,
the Holy One of Israel,
you are truly our shield.
19In a vision, you once said
to your faithful followers:
“I have helped a mighty hero.
I chose him from my people
and made him famous.
20 David, my servant, is the one
I chose to be king,
21and I will always be there
to help and strengthen him.
22“No enemy will outsmart David,
and he won't be defeated
by any hateful people.
23I will strike down and crush
his troublesome enemies.
24He will always be able
to depend on my love,
and I will make him strong
with my own power.
25I will let him rule the lands
across the rivers and seas.
26He will say to me,
‘You are my Father
and my God,
as well as the mighty rock
where I am safe.’
27 “I have chosen David
as my first-born son,
and he will be the ruler
of all kings on earth.
28My love for him will last,
and my agreement with him
will never be broken.
29“One of David's descendants
will always be king,
and his family will rule
until the sky disappears.
30Suppose some of his children
should reject my Law
and refuse my instructions.
31Or suppose they should disobey
all of my teachings.
32Then I will correct
and punish them
because of their sins.
33But I will always love David
and faithfully keep all
of my promises to him.
34“I won't break my agreement
or go back on my word.
35I have sworn once and for all
by my own holy name,
and I won't lie to David.
36His family will always rule.
I will let his kingdom last
as long as the sun 37and moon
appear in the sky.”
38You are now angry, Lord,
and you have turned your back
on your chosen king.
39You broke off your agreement
with your servant, the king,
and you completely destroyed
his kingdom.
40The walls of his city
have been broken through,
and every fortress
now lies in ruins.
41All who pass by
take what they want,
and nations everywhere
joke about the king.
42You made his enemies powerful
and let them celebrate.
43But you forced him to retreat
because you did not fight
on his side.
44You took his crown
and threw his throne
in the dirt.
45You made an old man of him
and put him to shame.
46How much longer, Lord?
Will you hide forever?
How long will your anger
keep burning like fire?
47Remember, life is short!
Why did you empty our lives
of all meaning?
48No one can escape the power
of death and the grave.
49Our Lord, where is the love
you have always shown
and that you promised
so faithfully to David?
50Remember your servant, Lord!
People make jokes about me,
and I suffer many insults.
51I am your chosen one,
but your enemies chase
and make fun of me.
52Our Lord, we praise you
forever. Amen and amen.
translation_text:
Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ nɛ Deevid ka wora kɔnɔkoŋwule be ŋkre be asheŋ
1O Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ,
meeŋ baa boŋ nshɛ a laŋɛ
fo kasha nɛ k maŋ kɔ ekar na
be kaplɛa so jemanɛ kikɛ.
Ma alɛ beeŋ naa ber fo
kashenteŋji na be kebomboŋ
mbaanaayɔ.
2Meeŋ kaŋɛ ekama fanɛ fo kasha
wɔtɔ nna mbaanaayɔ,
nɛ fo kashenteŋji malɛ wɔ
ebɔrɛso jemanɛ kikɛ.
3Fo yɛ: “Ma nɛ esa nɛ n lara na
wora kɔnɔkoŋwule be ŋkre nna.
Ma alɛ nase kɔnɔ nna n sa ma
kayɛrbi Deevid fanɛ
4mbe kaman to ebi e naaŋ baa
ki bewura jemanɛ kikɛ.
Ma alɛ beeŋ shin nɛ mbe kabuna
ebi e baa wɔtɔ mbaanaayɔ.”
5O Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ,
shin nɛ asɔ nɛ a wɔ ebɔrɛso
e baa kpaŋ fo emamachisheŋ,
nseŋ shin nɛ fo emalaika e baa
kpaŋ fo kashenteŋji.
6Ekama maŋ du fanɛ fo,
Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na ashi ebɔrɛso;
Ekama malɛ maaŋ tiŋ n ta mbe
kumu m ber fo ashi ndoŋ.
7Fo nɛ ekama bee ŋana ga
ashi ebɔrɛso ndoŋ.
Fo asheŋ malɛ bee keta
kufu nsaa kɔ bunyaŋ ga
a chɔ bekama nɛ b wɔ
ebɔrɛso.
8Fo e la Enyɛnpetale Ebɔrɛ na.
Ekama maŋ naa kɔ kasha
nsaa ji kashenteŋ fanɛ fo.
9Fo e naa ji kuwura ashi teku
nɛ k bee baga to na so,
a shin nɛ atili nɛ a bee koso
kumo so na bee wora shruum.
10Fo e daŋ to m pɛ teku to
be kusɔbɔya lubi gboŋgboŋi
nɛ baa tre Reehab na to kpakpa
nseŋ mɔ kumo na.
Fo gbagba be eleŋgboŋ nɛ fo ta
m pɔɔ fo doŋana so, nseŋ shin nɛ
b pesaŋ to n sɔ kaplɛkama.
11Ebɔrɛso nɛ kasawule so
kikɛ la feya nna;
fo e to durnya nɛ kusɔ
kama nɛ k wɔ kumo to.
12Fo e to kelargato be esoso
nɛ kaseto kikɛ.
K du fanɛ abee nɛ baa tre
Tabɔɔ nɛ Hɛɛmɔn na bee boŋ
nshɛ kagbenefuliso nna
a kpaŋ fo ketre.
13Fo shibi nsaa kɔ eleŋ pasaa!
14Fee ji kuwura ekpa niŋiso so,
nsaa ji asheŋ nɛ amo be ekpa so nna.
Kasha nɛ kashenteŋji bee dii efuli
kusɔ kama nɛ fee wora to nna.
15O Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ,
kagbenefuli la bekama nɛ baa
bugi ŋgbene to a bunyaŋ fo
nsaa wɔ fo kefultogboŋ na to
na peya nna.
16Baa ji eyur nna ashi fo ketre to
karechɛ lelemu kikɛ,
nsaa kpaŋ fo ŋkpal fo alelasheŋ so.
17Ŋkpal manɛ so,
bumo be kemaŋkura nɛ eleŋ
shi fo kutɔ nna, nɛ fo
kuwɔrwu malɛ bee shin nɛ
anyee nya eleŋ a ti so.
18Kashenteŋto, anyi be kekuŋ
bee shi Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na kutɔ nna.
Israɛl be Ebɔrɛ cheembi na
e la anyi be ewura.
19Le nɛ fo daŋ bɔla bɔrɛdare to
ŋ kaŋɛ fo bebɛsopo nɛ baa
ji kashenteŋ a sa fo na:
“Ma e naa sa enapo eleŋ.
Ma alɛ e ta kuwurputi na
n sa esa nɛ ŋ gbagba lara
ashi ma basa to.
20Ma e lara ma kayɛrbi Deevid
nseŋ duga ma ŋku cheembi
n do mbe kumu so n ta
mo ŋ ki ewura.
21Jemanɛ kikɛ ma eleŋ
beeŋ baa wɔ mo so,
nɛ ma eleŋgboŋ na
e baa sa mo eleŋ.
22Mo doŋana maaŋ tiŋ
m pɔɔ mo so kikɛ,
kumukpakpasowuraana gba
beeŋ kɔ mo ŋ gben.
23Meeŋ tɔrɔ mo doŋana ga
nseŋ mɔ ekama nɛ e kishi mo.
24Ma kashenteŋji be kasha na
beeŋ baa wɔ mo so;
ma alɛ beeŋ shin nɛ e baa
kɔ a pɔɔ so jemanɛ kikɛ.
25Meeŋ shin nɛ mbe kuwurji e yili
Teku nɛ baa tre Mɛditerenia na
n salga to n ya fo lɔr nɛ baa
tre Yufreetes na.
26Ndoŋ nna nɛ e kaŋɛ ma le:
‘Fo e la n tuto nɛ ma Ebɔrɛ;
Fo e la ma ekumpo nɛ
ma emɔlgapo.’
27Meeŋ shin nɛ e ki ma wurkoŋnyɛn,
nseŋ ki esagboŋ a chɔ durnya to
be bewura kikɛ.
28Jemanɛ kikɛ meeŋ baa wora
a bɔlɔ ma nnɔ nɛ n nase a sa mo;
nɛ ma nɛ mo be kɔnɔkoŋwule
be ŋkre na e baa wɔtɔ mbaanaayɔ.
29Meeŋ shin nɛ mbe kabuna ebi
e baa ji kuwura mbaanaayɔ;
mbe kanaŋ to be esa e naaŋ
baa ji kuwura jemanɛ kikɛ.
30Ama nɛ fanɛ mbe kaman to ebi
kini kewora ma mbraana kasonu,
nseŋ kini kewora m bɔlɔ ma
atande so,
31ŋko nɛ b kplaŋ ma keŋini so
nsaa maŋ bɛ ma mbraana so,
32kumo ere meeŋ gberge bumo
kusoe ŋkpal bumo be alubi so.
Meeŋ shin nɛ b ji awurfoŋ
ŋkpal bumo be kewora n jija so.
33Ama m maaŋ yige kebaasha Deevid,
ŋko ŋ kini kebɛ nnɔ nɛ n nase
n sa mo na so.
34Ma alɛ maaŋ ku ma nɛ mo
be kɔnɔkoŋwule be ŋkre na to,
ŋko n lar nnɔ nɛ n nase n sa mo
na be kekama kaman.
35Kelekoŋwule pati nɛ n ta ma
Ketre cheembi na m bɔ ntaŋ fanɛ,
m maaŋ ku efɛ n sa Deevid kikɛ.
36Mbe kanaŋ to ebi e naaŋ baa
ji kuwura jemanɛ kikɛ.
Kananɛ epeŋi nɛ kufɔl baa
lar awɔlpa so ere,
aloŋ nɛ mbe kuwurji gba beeŋ baa
wɔtɔ mbaanaayɔ.
37Mbe kuwurji na beeŋ baa wɔtɔ
mbaanaayɔ nna fanɛ kananɛ
kufɔl baa wɔ esoso mbaanaayɔ na.”
38Ama naniere fo, Ebɔrɛ na
nya agbo nna n wɔtɔ ewura
nɛ fo lara na nseŋ kini mo n lɛ,
nseŋ pal kaman n sa mo.
39Fo lar fo nɛ fo kayɛrbi be
kɔnɔkoŋwule be ŋkre na
kaman kuraa nseŋ shin nɛ
mbe kuwura terge m paŋ
kumo be kemaŋkura kikɛ.
40Fo shin nɛ egbal nɛ a kulti
kadegboŋ na kikɛ bure
nɛ kumo be mboŋ lempoana na
kikɛ ki alambure a dese.
41Bekama nɛ b bɔla kumo ase
a choŋ nya ewura na be asɔ ko n ta,
nɛ mbe bechenashapoana bee
mushe mo nsaa wora mo eyurto.
42Fo shin nɛ mo doŋana
sɔ kelempo mo so,
nɛ bumo kikɛ be ŋgbene
fuli bumo.
43Fo shin nɛ mbe akɔsɔ kikɛ
ki asɔ jiga,
nseŋ shin nɛ e kɔ kena n tɔr.
44Fo suge mbe kuwurwuro
n shin nɛ mbe kuwura paŋ
kumo be kemaŋkura.
45Fo shin nɛ e bel katinso
nɛ e kraa la kebifɔlbi,
nseŋ ta anishinyɔr be piŋi
m buu mo nɛ nyɔmɔ pɛ mo.
46O Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ,
feeŋ ta fo kumu ŋ ŋana
mbaanaayɔ a?
Jemanɛ mo nɛ fo agbo
nɛ k bee suse fanɛ edɛ na
beeŋ wushi?
47Baa nyiŋi fanɛ ma ŋkpa
maŋ wɔ nteŋ.
Fo to anyi nna nɛ an baa wɔ ŋkpa
to gbrɛbi nseŋ wu!
48Dimɛdi kikɛ maaŋ tiŋ n suge
mbe kumu ashi luwu nɛ nchaŋ
be eleŋana to.
49O Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ,
nnɛ nɛ kashagboŋ nɛ fo
daa kɔ na wɔ?
Nnɔ nɛ fo nase kashenteŋ
be ekpa so n sa Deevid
na wɔ nnɛ?
50Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ baa nyiŋi
kananɛ basa tege ma
nseŋ wora fo kayɛrbi eyurto,
nɛ n ta amo kikɛ n wɔtɔ
kagbene to na be asheŋ.
51O Enyɛnpetale Ebɔrɛ,
fo doŋana bee tege ewura
nɛ fo lara n sa fo kumu nna na.
Kaplɛkama nɛ e yɔ, baa tege mo
nsaa wora mo eyurto nna.
52Men baa kpaŋ
Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na
mbaanaayɔ!
Amɛn! Amɛn!

english_text:
BOOK IV
(Psalms 90–106)
(A prayer by Moses, the man of God.)
God Is Eternal
1Our Lord, in all generations
you have been our home.
2You have always been God—
long before the birth
of the mountains,
even before you created
the earth and the world.
3At your command we die
and turn back to dust,
4 but a thousand years
mean nothing to you!
They are merely a day gone by
or a few hours in the night.
5You bring our lives to an end
just like a dream.
We are merely tender grass
6that sprouts and grows
in the morning,
but dries up by evening.
7Your furious anger frightens
and destroys us,
8and you know all our sins,
even those we do in secret.
9Your anger is a burden
each day we live,
then life ends like a sigh.
10 We can expect seventy years,
or maybe eighty,
if we are healthy,
but even our best years
bring trouble and sorrow.
Suddenly our time is up,
and we disappear.
11No one knows the full power
of your furious anger,
but it is as great as the fear
that we owe to you.
12Teach us to use wisely
all the time we have.
13Help us, Lord! Don't wait!
Pity your servants.
14When morning comes,
let your love satisfy
all our needs.
Then we can celebrate
and be glad for what time
we have left.
15Make us happy for as long
as you caused us trouble
and sorrow.
16Do wonderful things for us,
your servants,
and show your mighty power
to our children.
17Our Lord and our God,
treat us with kindness
and let all go well for us.
Please let all go well!
translation_text:
KENASOPO
(Nshɛ 90—106)
Mosis be kabɔrɛkule be asheŋ
1O Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ,
fo kutɔ e la anyi pe,
jemanɛ kikɛ.
2Pɔɛŋ nɛ fo to abeeana nɛ
kasawule nɛ durnya kikɛ na,
nɛ fo la Ebɔrɛ nna nsaa
wɔtɔ mbaanaayɔ.
3Fo e yili kumo fanɛ an baa wu
nsaa bɛta a yɔ eshishɛr to.
4Nfɛ kagboŋ du fanɛ kachɛ
koŋwule fo kutɔ nna,
ŋko kanyɛso be jemanɛ
gbrɛbi ko ka choŋ nna.
5Fo e naa shin nɛ anyi be ŋkpa
bee ba ekar fanɛ edare na.
An du fanɛ kachipurso be afitiri
nɛ a purge a walɛ nna.
6Kachipurso, afitiri bee daŋ nna
a purge a walɛ;
ama ta a ba kaaseso nɛ a bolo
nseŋ wu n wɔl.
7Fo kanya agbo bee ta kufu nna
a da anyi nsaa mur anyi kuraa.
8Fo alɛ nyi anyi be alubi
kikɛ be asheŋ;
hale amo nɛ an ŋana n wora
ashiri to gba.
9Anyi be nchɛ bee ku so nna
ŋkpal fo agbo so,
nfubel damta malɛ e bɔlɔ nfɛ
nɛ anyee ji kikɛ to.
10Nfɛ nɛ anyee ji kikɛ la nfɛ
adushunu nna,
nɛ an baa kɔ eleŋ malɛ nɛ
an ji nfɛ aduburwa;
Ama etɔrɔ wurbi nɛ kagbenejija
damta e wɔ amo to,
ŋkpal manɛ so, a maa chɛr
nsaa choŋ fanɛ afu.
11Esa kikɛ maŋ nyi kananɛ
fo agbo be eleŋ sa.
Ŋkpal manɛ so, k shi alegaiso,
nseŋ daga fanɛ an baa ŋana fo
ŋkpal kumo so.
12Ŋini anyi kananɛ anyi be nchɛ sa,
saŋɛ na so, anyeeŋ baa wora
asheŋ kanyiasheŋ so.
13Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ, chɛ anyi to!
Sa maŋ naŋ jo gbrɛbi kama!
Wu fo nyɛrbi kuwɔr,
n shu anyi so!
14Kachipurso kikɛ, shin nɛ fo kasha
nɛ k maŋ kɔ ekar na e kukwe anyi,
saŋɛ na so, anyeeŋ baa ta kagbenefuli
a boŋ nshɛ anyi be kebaawɔtɔ kikɛ to.
15Shin nɛ an nya kagbenefuli n tal
nchɛ nɛ anyi be ŋgbene jija anyi na to.
16Wora emamachisheŋ n sa anyi,
fo nyɛrbi, nseŋ shin nɛ anyi
be mbia e wu fo eleŋgboŋ na.
17Enyɛnpe anyi be Ebɔrɛ,
shin nɛ fo nɛfa e baa wɔ anyi so,
nseŋ shin nɛ asheŋ e baa nite
nsaa loge to nɛnɛ a sa anyi!

english_text:
The Lord Is My Fortress
1Live under the protection
of God Most High
and stay in the shadow
of God All-Powerful.
2Then you will say to the Lord,
“You are my fortress,
my place of safety;
you are my God,
and I trust you.”
3The Lord will keep you safe
from secret traps
and deadly diseases.
4He will spread his wings
over you
and keep you secure.
His faithfulness is like
a shield or a city wall.
5You won't need to worry
about dangers at night
or arrows during the day.
6And you won't fear diseases
that strike in the dark
or sudden disaster at noon.
7You will not be harmed,
though thousands fall
all around you.
8And with your own eyes
you will see the punishment
of the wicked.
9The Lord Most High
is your fortress.
Run to him for safety,
10and no terrible disasters
will strike you
or your home.
11 God will command his angels
to protect you
wherever you go.
12 They will carry you
in their arms,
and you won't hurt your feet
on the stones.
13 You will overpower
the strongest lions
and the most deadly snakes.
14The Lord says, “If you love me
and truly know who I am,
I will rescue you
and keep you safe.
15When you are in trouble,
call out to me.
I will answer and be there
to protect and honor you.
16You will live a long life
and see my saving power.”
translation_text:
Ebɔrɛ ka la anyi be ekumpo be asheŋ
1Esa kama nɛ e shile n ya
mata Enyɛnpetale Ebɔrɛ na
e naŋ nya mbe kekuŋ.
2Kumo be kaman nɛ e kaŋɛ
Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na le:
“Fo nɛ mee shile n ya kaa
mata nɛ fee kuŋ ma,
fo e la ma Ebɔrɛ nɛ n yirda fo.”
3Kashenteŋto, Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na
beeŋ kuŋ fo ashi ajigbelɛ
nɛ alɔ mɔso kikɛ to.
4E beeŋ parga mbe atɛ m buu
fo so a kuŋ fo nɛ fo nya fo kumu,
Mbe kashenteŋji du fanɛ
kebɛlso be kusɔ kuŋkumuso
ŋko egbal nɛ k bee kuŋ kade nna.
5Fo maaŋ naa ŋana kanyɛso
be asɔ nɛ a bee keta kufu
ŋko kapaso be kelantokɔ kikɛ,
6ŋko tentembiri to be alɔ mɔso
ŋko kapiidi be kayurnyaŋ lubi kikɛ.
7Basa kagboŋ beeŋ tiŋ n wu
n dese fo kekel ko so,
nɛ ŋgboŋ kudu e wu
n dese fo jisoso,
ama shɛŋ maaŋ wora fo ere.
8Fo anishi nɛ feeŋ
ta n wu kasogberge nɛ
kumukpakpasowuraana beeŋ nya.
9Nɛ fo ta Enyɛnpetale Ebɔrɛ na
fanɛ esa nɛ fee shile n ya kaa mata
nɛ e baa kuŋ fo,
10kumo ere alɔ lubi maaŋ ba fo so,
ŋko ŋ bɔla fo kowu ase n choŋ gba.
11Ŋkpal manɛ so, Ebɔrɛ beeŋ
shin nɛ mbe emalaika e baa kuŋ
fo ashi kusɔ kama nɛ fee wora to.
12Baaŋ ta bumo be enɔana
n suse fo to,
nɛ fo maaŋ doro fo anashibi
kejembu so.
13Feeŋ pɔɔ ebuluŋ lempo so
nseŋ chichi awɔ lubi gba so,
nɛ e maaŋ tiŋ n wora fo shɛŋ.
14Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ yɛ:
“Nɛ fee sha ma nsaa nyi esa
nɛ e la ma kashenteŋto,
meeŋ mɔlga fo nsaa kuŋ fo.
15Nɛ fo luri asheŋ to nseŋ
shu n tre ma,
meeŋ nu fo kekule m ba mɔlga fo
nseŋ ta kemaŋkura m buu fo so.
16Meeŋ sa fo ŋkpa tenteŋ
nseŋ ŋini fo ma kumɔlga.”

english_text:
(A psalm and a song for the Sabbath.)
Sing Praises to the Lord
1It is wonderful to be grateful
and to sing your praises,
Lord Most High!
2It is wonderful each morning
to tell about your love
and at night to announce
how faithful you are.
3I enjoy praising your name
to the music of harps,
4because everything you do
makes me happy,
and I sing joyful songs.
5You do great things, Lord.
