Your thoughts are too deep
6 for an ignorant fool
to know or understand.
7Though the wicked sprout
and spread like grass,
they will be pulled up
by their roots.
8But you will rule
over all of us forever,
9and your hateful enemies
will be scattered
and then destroyed.
10You have given me
the strength of a wild ox,
and you have chosen me
to be your very own.
11My eyes have seen,
and my ears have heard
the doom and destruction
of my evil enemies.
12Good people will prosper
like palm trees,
and they will grow strong
like the cedars of Lebanon.
13They will take root
in your house, Lord God,
and they will do well.
14They will be like trees
that stay healthy and fruitful,
even when they are old.
15And they will say about you,
“The Lord always does right!
God is our mighty rock.”
translation_text:
Keboŋ nshɛ n fur Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na be asheŋ
1Kekpaŋ Enyɛnpetale Ebɔrɛ na
nɛ keboŋ nshɛ n dele mo walɛ ga.
2Keber mbe kasha be asheŋ
be kebomboŋ kachipurso,
nɛ mbe kashenteŋji be asheŋ
kanyɛso gba walɛ ga.
3Keta alaŋsɔ be yiri kikɛ
a boŋ nshɛ a kpaŋ fo ketre
bee wora ma ebel
nsaa par ma ga.
4Ŋkpal manɛ so,
fo asheŋ woraso bee wushi
ma kagbene nna, a shin nɛ
mee tiŋ a boŋ nshɛ
kagbenefuliso,
O Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ.
5O Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ,
fee wora asheŋgboŋ pasaa,
fo nfɛra fɛso malɛ du
chiŋgeliŋ alegaiso!
6Esa nɛ e maŋ nyi asheŋ
maa pin fo asheŋ to;
ewulpo malɛ maaŋ tiŋ
m pin amo to fanɛ,
7kumukpakpasowura beeŋ tiŋ
m purge fanɛ afitiri,
nɛ belubiworapoana e nya asɔ
nseŋ dii dama.
E maŋ nyi fanɛ bumo kikɛ beeŋ
mur cheche mbaanaayɔ.
8Fo, Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na e naŋ baa
ji kuwura kusɔ kama so mbaanaayɔ.
9An nyi fanɛ fo doŋana beeŋ mur
kashenteŋto,
nɛ alubiworapoana kikɛ
e pesaŋ to.
10Fo shin nɛ n nya eleŋ
fanɛ kupuntona nna,
nɛ fo lara ma n yili n sa
fo gbagba be kumu.
11Ŋ gbagba be anishi wu,
nɛ ma asoe nu kumulubi
nɛ kemur nɛ a ba bedoŋ so.
12Basa lela beeŋ dii dama
fanɛ ŋkubadibi ka purge na;
baaŋ daŋ n yili fanɛ Lebanɔn
be ndibi nɛ baa tre sida na.
13Baaŋ mur achin ashi fo,
Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na be laŋ to,
nseŋ nyalɛ ashi anyi be
Ebɔrɛ na be bɔrɛlambu to.
14Baaŋ baa du fanɛ ndibi nɛ e bel
nseŋ kraa kɔ eleŋ a sɔr asɔrso.
15Saŋɛ na so nɛ b baa kaŋɛ le:
“Kusɔ kama nɛ Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na
wora niŋi nna!
Ebɔrɛ e la anyi be kefaltagboŋ
a kuŋ anyi,
kulubi kikɛ maŋ wɔ mo to.”

english_text:
The Lord Is King
1Our Lord, you are King!
Majesty and power
are your royal robes.
You put the world in place,
and it will never be moved.
2You have always ruled,
and you are eternal.
3The ocean is roaring, Lord!
The sea is pounding hard.
4Its mighty waves are majestic,
but you are even more majestic,
and you rule over all.
5Your decisions are firm,
and your temple will always
be beautiful and holy.
translation_text:
Ebɔrɛ ka la ewura be asheŋ
1Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na e la ewura.
Kemaŋkuragboŋ nɛ eleŋ
buu mo nna fanɛ kuwurpiŋi.
Mo e tɔl durnya n yili kpakpa,
nɛ shɛŋ shɛŋ maaŋ tiŋ n fifir kumo.
2Dra na kikɛ nɛ fee ji kuwura,
fo alɛ wɔtɔ nna mbaanaayɔ.
3Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ,
etekuana bee baga to nna
a wora awɔr fanɛ e ka
bugi ebɔl a boŋ nshɛ na!
Atiligboŋ bee koso
etekuana so nna pasaa!
4Teku so be atili bee wora
awɔr nna nsaa kɔ eleŋ ga,
ama Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na
be eleŋ shi a chɔ amo
be eleŋana.
5O Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ,
fo mbraana wɔtɔ nna mbaanaayɔ,
jemanɛ kikɛ fo bɔrɛlambu na du
cheembi nna nsaa walɛ kebita.

english_text:
The Lord Punishes the Guilty
1 Lord God, you punish
the guilty.
Show what you are like
and punish them now.
2You judge the earth.
Come and help us!
Pay back those proud people
for what they have done.
3How long will the wicked
celebrate and be glad?
4All of those cruel people
strut and boast,
5and they crush and wound
your chosen nation, Lord.
6They murder widows,
foreigners, and orphans.
7Then they say,
“The Lord God of Jacob
doesn't see or know.”
8Can't you fools see?
Won't you ever learn?
9God gave us ears and eyes!
Can't he hear and see?
10God instructs the nations
and gives knowledge to us all.
Won't he also correct us?
11 The Lord knows how useless
our plans really are.
12Our Lord, you bless everyone
that you instruct and teach
by using your Law.
13You give them rest
from their troubles,
until a pit can be dug
for the wicked.
14You won't turn your back
on your chosen nation.
15Justice and fairness
will go hand in hand,
and all who do right
will follow along.
16Who will stand up for me
against those cruel people?
17If you had not helped me, Lord,
I would soon have gone
to the land of silence.
18When I felt my feet slipping,
you came with your love
and kept me steady.
19And when I was burdened
with worries,
you comforted me
and made me feel secure.
20But you are opposed
to dishonest lawmakers
21who gang up to murder
innocent victims.
22You, Lord God, are my fortress,
that mighty rock
where I am safe.
23You will pay back my enemies,
and you will wipe them out
for the evil they did.
translation_text:
Ebɔrɛ ka la ekama be demujipo be asheŋ
1O Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ nɛ fee gberge
basa nɛ b wora n jija kusoe;
ŋini bumo esa nɛ e la fo
nseŋ gberge bumo kusoe!
2Fo e naa ji durnya kikɛ demu.
Ba chɛ anyi to!
Ka kamoowuwuraana kukɔ,
ŋkpal kusɔ nɛ b wora so.
3O Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ, saŋɛ mo nɛ
kumukpakpasowuraana
be kagbenefuliso be kamooji ere
beeŋ fo ekar?
4Basa lubi ere bee nite nna
a puchi bumo be asheŋ lubi so.
5O Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ,
baa mɛaŋ basa nna a pira bumo;
fo gbagba be basa laraso
nɛ baa mɛaŋ.
6Baa mɔ bekulpoche nɛ amunibi
nɛ befɔ nɛ b wɔ kasawule na so nna.
7Kumo be kaman nɛ b kaŋɛ le:
“Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na maa wu anyi.
Jeekɔb be Ebɔrɛ na be shɛŋ
maŋ wɔ anyi to.”
8Ma basa, manɛ nna nɛ men
paŋ nfɛra loŋ?
Saŋɛ mo nɛ menyi beeŋ naŋ
nya kanyiasheŋ?
9Ebɔrɛ nɛ e to anyi be
asoe nɛ anishi na,
maŋ kɔ asoe a nu nɛ
anishi a wu nna a?
10Mo ere Ebɔrɛ nɛ e bee
fɛa efuliana na so na;
nɛ b wora n da mo so,
e maaŋ gberge bumo kusoe a?
Mo ere nɛ e bee ŋini bumo
asheŋ na bre maŋ nyi asheŋ a?
11Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na nyi
dimɛdi kikɛ be nfɛra ka la
nfɛra fuloŋ a maŋ kɔ tɔnɔ.
12Kagbenefuli la ekama nɛ fo
Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na bee bela
nsaa ŋini mo fo mbra na peya nna!
13Fo e naa wushi mo kagbene
ashi mbe tɔrɔ to,
n ya fo jemanɛ nɛ baaŋ kur
kemaŋ n nase nɛ
kumukpakpasowura e tɔr to.
14Ama fo Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ
maaŋ kini fo basa n lɛ;
fo alɛ maaŋ kplaŋ efuli nɛ fo
gbagba lara na so.
15Demujipoana beeŋ baa ji
asheŋ nɛ amo be ekpa so,
nɛ basa niŋiso malɛ e yili
bumo be kaman.
16Wanɛ e naŋ yili ma kaman
n tu ma ŋ kɔ basa lubi ere?
17Nɛ Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na
daa maŋ chɛ ma to,
ndafanɛ n wu n yɔ bubuni to.
18Ŋ ka daŋ fɛrge a shin nɛ tɔr
nseŋ boŋ to na,
fo Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na e bɔla fo
kasha nɛ k maŋ kɔ ekar na so
n suse ma to nɛ n yili dindiŋ.
19Jemanɛ kikɛ nɛ kafɔŋ
damta baŋ tɔr ma so,
fo e naa lolo ma a
wushi ma kagbene.
20Ama fo maa sa basa nɛ b maa
ta mbra a shuŋ na kashuli kikɛ.
21Loŋ be basa e naa kre
basa lela ŋkre lubi nsaa kaŋɛ
fanɛ basa nɛ b maŋ wora n jija
e daga luwu na.
22Ama fo Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na
e ki kakpa lempo
nɛ kefaltagboŋ a kuŋ ma.
23Ebɔrɛ beeŋ gberge
kumukpakpasowuraana kusoe
nseŋ mur bumo ŋkpal bumo be
asheŋ lubi so.
Enyɛnpe anyi be Ebɔrɛ na
e naŋ mur bumo.

english_text:
Worship and Obey the Lord
1Sing joyful songs to the Lord!
Praise the mighty rock
where we are safe.
2Come to worship him
with thankful hearts
and songs of praise.
3The Lord is the greatest God,
king over all other gods.
4He holds the deepest part
of the earth in his hands,
and the mountain peaks
also belong to him.
5The ocean is the Lord's
because he made it,
and with his own hands
he formed the dry land.
6Bow down and worship
the Lord our Creator!
7 The Lord is our God,
and we are his people,
the sheep he takes care of
in his own pasture.
Listen to God's voice today!
8 Don't be stubborn and rebel
as your ancestors did
at Meribah and Massah
out in the desert.
9For forty years
they tested God and saw
the things he did.
10Then God got tired of them
and said,
“You never show good sense,
and you don't understand
what I want you to do.”
11 In his anger, God told them,
“You people will never enter
my place of rest.”
translation_text:
Kapandi be kashɛ be asheŋ
1Men ba nɛ an boŋ kagbenefuli
be nshɛ n sa Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ
nɛ e bee kuŋ anyi na.
2Men shin nɛ an ta kapandi
m ba boŋ nshɛ ŋ kpaŋ mo.
3Ŋkpal manɛ so,
Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na e la Ewurgboŋ;
agbirana maŋ la shɛŋ mbe anishito.
4Asɔ nɛ a wɔ kasawule be
kechimbi to nɛ abee be awɔlto
kikɛ be eleŋ bɔɔ mbe enɔ nna.
5Teku la mo peya nna,
ŋkpal manɛ so, mo e to kumo.
Mo gbagba be enɔana
nɛ e ta n tɔl kasawule.
6Men ba nɛ an jɔŋɛ m bunyaŋ
Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ nɛ e to anyi na!
7Mo e la anyi be Ebɔrɛ,
nɛ anyi alɛ la mbe basa.
An du fanɛ mbe mbolpɔ
nɛ e bee keni so nna.
Men baŋ nu mbe ebɔl kabre,
8men sa maŋ wora menyi
be ŋgbene kpakpa, fanɛ kananɛ
men nanaana daŋ wora ashi mboŋ
nɛ baa tre Mɛriba nɛ Maasa ashi
keshishɛrsawule so na.
9Asheŋ nɛ b daŋ wu Ebɔrɛ
ka wora na kikɛ be kaman,
b daŋ chɔ mo nseŋ wora mo
ŋ keni ndoŋana nna.
10Nfɛ adena nɛ bumo be asheŋ
daa nu Ebɔrɛ agbo, nɛ e kaŋɛ le:
“Saŋkikɛ basa ere bee wora
a foe ekpa nna;
bumo alɛ maa pin ma
asheŋ woraso to.”
11Ebɔrɛ daŋ nya agbo nna
nseŋ bɔ ntaŋ ŋ kaŋɛ le:
“B maaŋ luri ma
kewushi na to kikɛ!”

english_text:
Sing a New Song to the Lord
1Sing a new song to the Lord!
Everyone on this earth,
sing praises to the Lord,
2sing and praise his name.
Day after day announce,
“The Lord has saved us!”
3Tell every nation on earth,
“The Lord is wonderful
and does marvelous things!
4The Lord is great and deserves
our greatest praise!
He is the only God
worthy of our worship.
5Other nations worship idols,
but the Lord created
the heavens.
6Give honor and praise
to the Lord,
whose power and beauty
fill his holy temple.”
7 Tell everyone of every nation,
“Praise the glorious power
of the Lord.
8He is wonderful! Praise him
and bring an offering
into his temple.
9Everyone on earth, now tremble
and worship the Lord,
majestic and holy.”
10Announce to the nations,
“The Lord is King!
The world stands firm,
never to be shaken,
and he will judge its people
with fairness.”
11Tell the heavens and the earth
to be glad and celebrate!
Command the ocean to roar
with all its creatures
12and the fields to rejoice
with all their crops.
Then every tree in the forest
will sing joyful songs
13to the Lord.
He is coming to judge
all people on earth
with fairness and truth.
translation_text:
Men boŋ kashɛ popɔr n sa Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na
1Ekama nɛ e wɔ durnya to,
e boŋ kashɛ popɔr
n sa Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na!
2Men boŋ kashɛ n sa
Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na,
nseŋ kpaŋ mbe ketre na.
Karechɛ kama men baa ber
mbe kumɔlga na be asheŋ
be kubomboŋ.
3Men baa malga mbe kemaŋkura
nɛ asheŋgboŋ be asheŋ a sa basa
nɛ b wɔ efuliana kikɛ so.
4Ŋkpal manɛ so, Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ shi ga,
nseŋ daga fanɛ ekama e baa kpaŋ mo
nsaa ŋana mo a chɔ agbirana kikɛ.
5Efuli pɔtɛana so ebi bee
shuŋ agbirana nna;
ama Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na
e to ebɔrɛso.
6E kɔ kemaŋkura nɛ bunyaŋgboŋ,
nɛ eleŋgboŋ nɛ kela bɔlɔ
mbe bɔrɛlambu to.
7Durnya to be basa kikɛ e kpaŋ
Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na, nseŋ shuli so
fanɛ kemaŋkura nɛ eleŋ la mo
peya nna.
8Men kpaŋ Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na
be ketre nɛ k kɔ kemaŋkura na;
nseŋ ta esarga m ba
mbe bɔrɛlambu to.
9Men baa yili Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na
be kela nɛ kecheembiya so a bunyaŋ.
Durnya to ebi kikɛ e ta kechicha chicha
m ba mbe anishito.
10Men kaŋɛ efuliana na so ebi le:
“Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na e la Ewura!
Mo e tɔl durnya na n yili dindiŋ
nɛ k maa fifir;
mo alɛ e naaŋ ji basa kikɛ demu
nɛ e maŋ puni eko.”
11Kaŋɛ esoso nɛ kasawule so ebi
fanɛ b shin nɛ bumo be ŋgbene
e wushi bumo nɛ b baa ji eyur!
Shin nɛ teku nɛ kumo to be asɔ
keniso kikɛ e baa wora awɔr,
12nseŋ shin nɛ adɔsawule nɛ adɔjibi
nɛ a wɔ amo so na gba e ji eyur.
Kumo be kaman nɛ kupo to
be ndibi kikɛ e boŋ nshɛ
kagbenefuliso
13n sa Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na.
E bee ba nɛ e ba bɔla
ekpa niŋiso nɛ kashenteŋ so nna
n ji basa nɛ b wɔ durnya to demu.

english_text:
The Lord Brings Justice
1The Lord is King!
Tell the earth to celebrate
and all islands to shout.
2Dark clouds surround him,
and his throne is supported
by justice and fairness.
3Fire leaps from his throne,
destroying his enemies,
4and his lightning is so bright
that the earth sees it
and trembles.
5Mountains melt away like wax
in the presence of the Lord
of all the earth.
6The heavens announce,
“The Lord brings justice!”
Everyone sees God's glory.
7Those who brag about
the useless idols they worship
are terribly ashamed,
and all the false gods
bow down to the Lord.
8When the people of Zion
and of the towns of Judah
hear that God brings justice,
they will celebrate.
9The Lord rules the whole earth,
and he is more glorious
than all the false gods.
10Love the Lord
and hate evil!
God protects his loyal people
and rescues them
from violence.
11If you obey and do right,
a light will show you the way
and fill you with happiness.
12You are the Lord's people!
So celebrate and praise
the only God.
translation_text:
Ebɔrɛ ka bee ji asheŋ nɛ amo be ekpa so be asheŋ
1Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na e la Ewura!
Shin nɛ durnya kikɛ e ji eyur
nɛ mplasawule kikɛ e wora awɔr.
2Bɔrɛwɔlpa nɛ tentembiri mina
e kulti mo n wɔtɔ kaplɛkama.
Mo alɛ bee ji mbe kuwura ekpa niŋiso
nɛ keji asheŋ nɛ amo be ekpa so nna.
3Edɛ e naa juŋkpar mo a chɔɔ
mo doŋana kaba kama so a mur.
4Mo e naa shin nɛ bɔrɛ bee
nyɛkpɛ nɛ durnya bee fulto,
nɛ kasawule so ebi bee
wu kumo a chicha.
5Abee bee ŋalga fanɛ kemar ashi
Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ nɛ e la durnya kikɛ
be Enyɛnpe na be anishito nna.
6Ebɔrɛso bee ber mbe kebaawɔtɔ
niŋiso be kebomboŋ nna,
nɛ efuliana na kikɛ be basa
bee wu mbe kemaŋkura.
7Bekama nɛ baa shuŋ agbirana ŋko
a puchi amo so na bee ŋaba nna;
ŋkpal manɛ so, agbirana kikɛ
maŋ la shɛŋ Ebɔrɛ be anishito.
8O Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ, Jerusalɛm to
nɛ Juda be efuli so be ndeana to
be basa be ŋgbene fuli nna,
nɛ baa ji eyur ŋkpal fo demuji so.
9Ŋkpal manɛ so, fo, Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na
e naa ji kuwura durnya kikɛ ebi so.
Fo alɛ shi ga a chɔ agbirana kikɛ.
10Bekama nɛ baa sha
Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na kishi kulubi nna.
Ŋkpal manɛ so, mo e naa kuŋ mbe basa
nɛ baa ji kashenteŋ a sa mo na be ŋkpa
nsaa kɔ a suge bumo ashi
kumukpakpasowuraana be enɔ to.
11Kefulto bee nyaŋɛ a yuu
basa niŋiso so nna,
nɛ ŋgbenefufulwuraana malɛ
bee nya kagbenefuli.
12Menyi nɛ men wɔ kebaawɔtɔ
niŋiso to e shin nɛ menyi be
ŋgbene e fuli menyi ŋkpal kusɔ
nɛ Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na wora so.
Men baa nyiŋi kusɔ nɛ Ebɔrɛ
cheembi na bee wora
nsaa di mo epaŋ.

english_text:
The Lord Works Miracles
1Sing a new song to the Lord!
He has worked miracles,
and with his own powerful arm,
he has won the victory.
2The Lord has shown the nations
that he has the power to save
and to bring justice.
3God has been faithful
in his love for Israel,
and his saving power is seen
everywhere on earth.
4Tell everyone on this earth
to sing happy songs
in praise of the Lord.
5Make music for him on harps.
Play beautiful melodies!
6Sound the trumpets and horns
and celebrate with joyful songs
for our Lord and King!
7Command the ocean to roar
with all its creatures,
and the earth to shout
with all its people.
8Order the rivers
to clap their hands,
and all the hills
to sing together.
9Let them worship the Lord!
He is coming to judge
everyone on the earth,
and he will be honest
and fair.
translation_text:
Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ ka bee wora emamachisheŋ be asheŋ
1Men boŋ kashɛ popɔr n sa
Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na!
Mo e ta mbe enɔ lempo
cheembi na n wora
emamachisheŋ ŋ kɔ m pɔɔ so na.
2Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na lara mbe
kumɔlga nɛ kebaawɔtɔ niŋiso
ŋ ŋini efuli pɔtɛana so be basa.
3E nyiŋi mbe kasha nɛ kashenteŋji
nɛ e kɔ n sa Israɛlebi na be asheŋ.
Bekama nɛ b wɔ kasawule so
be kaplɛkama wu anyi be
Ebɔrɛ na be kumɔlga.
4Durnya to be basa kikɛ e boŋ
nshɛ kagbenefuliso ŋ kpaŋ
Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na.
5Men laŋ ejaŋjilaŋ m boŋ nshɛ
belbelso n sa Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na.
6Men foŋ mbel m boŋ nshɛ
n ji eyur kagbenefuliso;
ŋkpal manɛ so,
Enyɛnpe anyi be Ebɔrɛ na
e la ewura!
7Shin nɛ teku nɛ kumo to
be asɔ keniso kikɛ,
nɛ kasawule nɛ kumo so
be basa kikɛ
e baa wora awɔr a kpaŋ
Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na.
8Shin nɛ elɔrana e baa gbri fanɛ
a ka bee kpla enɔ na,
nɛ abeebi so e baa gbri fanɛ
a ka bee cha abar a boŋ nshɛ
kagbenefuliso ashi
Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ be anishito.
9Ŋkpal manɛ so, mo e naa ba nɛ
e ba ji kuwura kasawule so.
E beeŋ ba bɔla ekpa niŋiso so
n ji esa kama nɛ e wɔ kasawule
so demu nɛ e maŋ kpɛa ekama to.

english_text:
Our Lord Is King
1 Our Lord, you are King!
You rule from your throne
above the winged creatures,
as people tremble
and the earth shakes.
2You are praised in Zion,
and you control all nations.
3Only you are God!
And your power alone,
so great and fearsome,
is worthy of praise.
4You are our mighty King,
a lover of fairness,
who sees that justice is done
everywhere in Israel.
5Our Lord and our God,
we praise you
and kneel down to worship you,
the God of holiness!
6Moses and Aaron were two
of your priests.
Samuel was also one of those
who prayed in your name,
and you, our Lord,
answered their prayers.
7 You spoke to them
from a thick cloud,
and they obeyed your laws.
8Our Lord and our God,
you answered their prayers
and forgave their sins,
but when they did wrong,
you punished them.
9We praise you, Lord God,
and we worship you
at your sacred mountain.
Only you are God!
translation_text:
Ebɔrɛ ka la bewura to be ewura be asheŋ
1Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na e la ewura!
Efuliana kikɛ so be basa e baa chicha.
E chena mbe kuwurputi nɛ
emalaika nɛ b kɔ aba wɔ kumo
be kaseto na so nna;
nɛ kasawule bee gbuŋgbuŋ.
2Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na la esagboŋ nna
ashi Jerusalɛm to;
mo e kɔ eleŋ efuliana na kikɛ so.
3Ekama beeŋ kpaŋ mbe ketregboŋ
nɛ k kɔ eleŋ ga na.
Ŋkpal manɛ so, e du cheembi nna.
4Ewura na la esagboŋ nna,
nsaa sha kebaaji asheŋ nɛ
amo be ekpa so.
Mo e yili keji asheŋ nɛ amo
be ekpa so ashi Israɛl be
efuli so be kaplɛkama.
5Men baa maŋ Enyɛnpe
anyi be Ebɔrɛ na so,
nsaa bunyaŋ mo ashi mbe
kuwurputi ase.
Ŋkpal manɛ so,
e du cheembi nna.
6Mosis nɛ Ɛɛrɔn daa la
mbe bɔrɛmatapoana nna,
nɛ anebi Samuɛl malɛ daa la
esa nɛ e daa bɔla Ebɔrɛ
be ketre to a kule mo.
Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na nɛ bumo
kikɛ daa shu a tre,
nɛ e daa nu a sa bumo.
7E daŋ bɔla kuwɔlpa to nna
m malga n sa Mosis nɛ Ɛɛrɔn;
nɛ bumo alɛ daŋ wora mbe
mbraana nɛ atande nɛ e ta
n sa bumo na kasonu.
8O Enyɛnpe anyi be Ebɔrɛ,
fo e daŋ nu bumo be kekule,
nseŋ ta bumo be alubi m paŋ bumo.
Ama b ka naŋ wora kusɔ
nɛ k maŋ daga na,
fo gberge bumo kusoe nna.
9Anyee kpaŋ fo,
Enyɛnpe anyi be Ebɔrɛ na,
nsaa bunyaŋ fo ashi fo
kebee cheembi na ase.
Ŋkpal manɛ so,
Enyɛnpe anyi be Ebɔrɛ na
du cheembi nna.

english_text:
(A psalm of praise.)
The Lord Is God
1Shout praises to the Lord,
everyone on this earth.
2Be joyful and sing
as you come in
to worship the Lord!
3You know the Lord is God!
He created us,
and we belong to him;
we are his people,
the sheep in his pasture.
4Be thankful and praise the Lord
as you enter his temple.
5 The Lord is good!
His love and faithfulness
will last forever.
translation_text:
Kapandi be kashɛ be asheŋ
1Durnya to be basa kikɛ,
e baa kpaŋ Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na!
2Men baa bunyaŋ mo
kagbenefuliso,
nsaa boŋ kagbenefuli be
nshɛ a sa mo.
3Men baa nyi fanɛ Enyɛnpe na
e la Ebɔrɛ!
Mo e to anyi nɛ an la mbe basa;
an du fanɛ mbe mbolpɔ nna
nɛ e bee keni so.
4Men bɔla mbe bɔrɛlambu na
be mbunagboŋ to n luri mbe
kelɔnɛ so m ba di mo epaŋ,
nseŋ kpaŋ mo.
5Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na walɛ ga!
Mbe kasha nɛ k maa loge na,
nɛ mbe kashenteŋji malɛ wɔtɔ
nna mbaanaayɔ.

english_text:
(A psalm by David.)
A King and His Promises
1I will sing to you, Lord!
I will celebrate your kindness
and your justice.
2Please help me learn
to do the right thing,
and I will be honest and fair
in my own kingdom.
3I refuse to be corrupt
or to take part
in anything crooked,
4and I won't be dishonest
or deceitful.
5Anyone who spreads gossip
will be silenced;
no one who is conceited
will be my friend.
6I will find trustworthy people
to serve as my advisors;
only an honest person
will serve as an official.
7No one who cheats or lies
will have a position
in my royal court.
8Each morning I will silence
any lawbreakers I find
in the countryside
or in the city of the Lord.
translation_text:
Ewura be kɔnɔ naseso be asheŋ
1O Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ,
meeŋ boŋ kashɛ a laŋɛ
fo kasha nɛ keji asheŋ nɛ
amo be ekpa so be kaplɛa so.
2Jande, chɛ ma to nɛ ŋ koya
kebaawora asheŋ niŋiso;
saŋɛ na so meeŋ baa ji
kashenteŋ nsaa maa kɔ
ŋkpɛato ashi ma kuwurji to.
3Ma alɛ beeŋ kishi kusɔ
nɛ basa nɛ b pal kaman
n sa Ebɔrɛ bee wora na kikɛ.
4Ma shɛŋ maaŋ baa wɔ basa
nɛ b maa ji kashenteŋ nsaa
wɔtɔ a wora asheŋ lubi to.
5M maaŋ sa ekama nɛ e bee
nite a ji basa be asheŋ
ekpa nɛ e baa wora loŋ.
Ma alɛ maaŋ sa kamoowuwura
ŋko keŋkenshiwura
kashuli kikɛ nɛ b baa du loŋ.
6Basa nɛ b kɔ kashenteŋji
nɛ meeŋ shin nɛ b baa
wɔ ŋ kutɔ a ji ma asoe to.
Basa nɛ b maŋ kɔ amoso
malɛ e naŋ ki ma ekrachi
a shuŋ a sa ma.
7Esa kama nɛ e bee puni
ŋko a fule kikɛ maaŋ nya
ma lambu to n chena.
8Karechɛ kikɛ, m maaŋ sa
kumukpakpasowuraana kashuli
ashi anyi be kasawule so.
Meeŋ ju basa lubi kikɛ ashi
Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ be kadegboŋ na to.

english_text:
(A prayer for someone who hurts and needs to ask the Lord for help.)
A Prayer in Time of Trouble
1I pray to you, Lord!
Please listen.
2Don't hide from me
in my time of trouble.
Pay attention to my prayer
and quickly give an answer.
3My days disappear like smoke,
and my bones are burning
as though in a furnace.
4I am wasting away like grass,
and my appetite is gone.
5My groaning never stops,
and my bones can be seen
through my skin.
6I am like a lonely owl
in the desert
7or a restless sparrow
alone on a roof.
8My enemies insult me all day,
and they use my name
for a curse word.
9Instead of food,
I have ashes to eat
and tears to drink,
10because you are furious
and have thrown me aside.
11My life fades like a shadow
at the end of day
and withers like grass.
12Our Lord, you are King forever
and will always be famous.
13You will show pity to Zion
because the time has come.
14We, your servants,
love each stone in the city,
and we are sad to see them
lying in the dirt.
15Our Lord, the nations
will honor you,
and all kings on earth
will praise your glory.
16You will rebuild
the city of Zion.
Your glory will be seen,
17and the prayers of the homeless
will be answered.
18Future generations must also
praise the Lord,
so write this for them:
19“From his holy temple,
the Lord looked down
at the earth.
20He listened to the groans
of prisoners,
and he rescued everyone
who was doomed to die.”
21All Jerusalem should praise
you, our Lord,
22when people from every nation
meet to worship you.
23I should still be strong,
but you, Lord, have made
an old person of me.
24You will live forever!
Years mean nothing to you.
Don't cut my life in half!
25 In the beginning, Lord,
you laid the earth's foundation
and created the heavens.
26They will all disappear
and wear out like clothes.
You change them,
as you would a coat,
but you last forever.
27You are always the same.
You are God for all time.
28Every generation of those
who serve you
will live in your presence.
translation_text:
Esa nɛ e wɔ tɔrɔ to be kabɔrɛkule be asheŋ
1Mee kule fo nna,
Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ!
Jande, nu ma kekule.
2Sa maŋ ŋana ma so
jemanɛ nɛ n wɔ tɔrɔ to.
Kaŋ kusoe n nu ma kekule,
nseŋ tuge ma manaŋ manaŋ.
3Ma nchɛ bee choŋ nna
fanɛ edishi nɛ ma awibi to
bee chɔɔ ma to fanɛ edɛ.
4M baa wɔl fanɛ afitiri nna,
ajibi kikɛ malɛ maa yɛlga ma.
5M baa shu to awɔrso a tekeŋ nna,
nseŋ nyɔr ŋ ki fanɛ awibi nawule.
6M baŋ ki fanɛ gbuŋgbula koŋko
ashi keshishɛrsawule so nna.
7Mee dese a keni nna a klade;
n du fanɛ kabuibi koŋko
nɛ e jɔŋ ebu so nna.
8N doŋana bee tege ma
karechɛ kikɛ nna;
nɛ bumo nɛ baa wora ma
eyurto malɛ bee ti ma
ketre fanɛ shoduu be kusɔ na.
9-10Ŋkpal fo ka nya agbo ga
nseŋ ta ma n lɛ so,
nsunɔ e ki ma ajibi jiso,
nɛ anishichubi malɛ ki ma
nchu nuuso.
11Ma kebaawɔtɔ bee choŋ nna
fanɛ kaaseso be kiyoyul;
nɛ ŋ gbagba malɛ bee wɔl
fanɛ afitiri na.
12Ama fo, Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na
la ewura nna mbaanaayɔ;
nɛ yili kenana ko m ba tu
kenana ko to ebi bee nyiŋi
fo asheŋ.
13Fo e naaŋ shu Jerusalɛmebi so,
ŋkpal manɛ so, jemanɛ fo nɛ feeŋ
wu bumo kuwɔr.
14Anyi fo anya bee sha kejembu kama
nɛ k wɔ kadegboŋ na to nna;
amoso kumo be kebure a dese loŋ na
shin nɛ kagbenejija tɔr anyi so ga.
15Efuli pɔtɛana so be basa beeŋ ŋana
fo, Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na, be ketre na.
Nɛ durnya to be bewuraana kikɛ
e ta bunyaŋ gboŋ gboŋi n sa fo.
16Ŋkpal manɛ so, Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na
beeŋ lɔŋɛ Jerusalɛm be kadegboŋ na
m pɔr nseŋ shin nɛ mbe kemaŋkura
e dii efuli.
17E beeŋ wu betentaŋasepo kuwɔr
nseŋ nu bumo be kabɔrɛkule.
18Men sibɛ kusɔ nɛ Ebɔrɛ wora
n nase n sa kaman to ebi nɛ baaŋ
ba echefoso na;
saŋɛ na so, bumo alɛ gba beeŋ
ba kpaŋ Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na ŋ kaŋɛ le:
19“Ebɔrɛso nɛ Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na wɔ
nsaa to kenishi a keni kasawule so.
20E daŋ nu basa nɛ b wɔ kabuti to
ka bee shu to nna,
nseŋ sɔ bumo nɛ b daŋ daga
luwu na n yige.
21Amoso Jerusalɛmebi kikɛ
e ber mbe asheŋ be kubomboŋ,
nseŋ kpaŋ Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ
be ketre na,
22jemanɛ nɛ efuli pɔtɛana nɛ
kuwurjiana kikɛ be basa
beeŋ shɛr abar so m bunyaŋ
mo na.
23Kebifɔlbi e kraa la ma,
ama Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na
shin nɛ ŋ ki esa pɔso nɛ
ma nchɛ duga so.
24Ndoŋ nna nɛ ŋ kaŋɛ le:
O ma Ebɔrɛ, sa maŋ ta ma,
nɛ ma nchɛ maŋ naŋ fo.
Fo ere wɔtɔ nna mbaanaayɔ.
25Sososo na kikɛ nɛ fo to durnya
n yili kumo be gbaltɔlase so.
Fo gbagba be enɔ nɛ fo ta
n to ebɔrɛso gba.
26Amo kikɛ beeŋ choŋ
fanɛ asɔbuuso ka wu na.
Fee chɛrga amo nna
fanɛ esa ka bee chɛrga mbe
asɔbuuso dra nsaa kini amo na.
27Ama fo ere maa chɛrga kikɛ;
fo alɛ maa bel kikɛ.
28Basa nɛ baa shuŋ fo be mbia
beeŋ baa wɔ fo kutɔ,
nɛ fo baa kuŋ bumo nɛ bumo
be kaman to ebi kikɛ.”

english_text:
(By David.)
The Lord's Wonderful Love
1With all my heart
I praise the Lord,
and with all that I am
I praise his holy name!
2With all my heart
I praise the Lord!
I will never forget
how kind he has been.
3The Lord forgives our sins,
heals us when we are sick,
4and protects us from death.
His kindness and love
are a crown on our heads.
5Each day that we live,
he provides for our needs
and gives us the strength
of a young eagle.
6For all who are mistreated,
the Lord brings justice.
7He taught his Law to Moses
and showed all Israel
what he could do.
8 The Lord is merciful!
He is kind and patient,
and his love never fails.
9The Lord won't always be angry
and point out our sins;
10he doesn't punish us
as our sins deserve.
11How great is God's love for all
who worship him?
Greater than the distance
between heaven and earth!
12How far has the Lord taken
our sins from us?
Farther than the distance
from east to west!
13Just as parents are kind
to their children,
the Lord is kind
to all who worship him,
14because he knows
we are made of dust.
15We humans are like grass
or wild flowers
that quickly bloom.
16But a scorching wind blows,
and they quickly wither
to be forever forgotten.
17The Lord is always kind
to those who worship him,
and he keeps his promises
to their descendants
18who faithfully obey him.
19God has set up his kingdom
in heaven, and he rules
the whole creation.
20All of you mighty angels,
who obey God's commands,
come and praise your Lord!
21All of you thousands
who serve and obey God,
come and praise your Lord!
22All of God's creation
and all that he rules,
come and praise your Lord!
With all my heart
I praise the Lord!
translation_text:
Ebɔrɛ be kasha be asheŋ
1Meeŋ ta ma kagbene kikɛ
n fur Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na,
nseŋ ta ma kebaawɔtɔ kikɛ
ŋ kpaŋ mbe ketre cheembi na!
2Meeŋ ta ma kagbene kikɛ
ŋ kpaŋ Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na!
Ma alɛ maaŋ teŋ asheŋ lela
nɛ e wora ma na kikɛ so.
3Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na e naa
ta anyi be alubi a paŋ anyi.
Mo alɛ e naa chɛ
anyi be alɔana kikɛ,
4nsaa kuŋ anyi ashi luwu to.
Mbe kuwɔrwu nɛ kasha
malɛ shi anyi so ga.
5Karechɛ kikɛ e bee sa anyi
asɔ nɛ a tir anyi nna,
nsaa shin nɛ anyee nya eleŋ
a ti so fanɛ kusore fɔlbi na.
6Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na bee ji asheŋ
nɛ amo be ekpa so nna a sa
bumo nɛ beko bee mɛaŋ na.
7Mo e daŋ juŋkpar an nananyɛn Mosis
dra dra na n wora asheŋ,
nseŋ shin nɛ Israɛl be basa wu
mbe asheŋgboŋ nɛ e wora na.
8Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na la ewɔrwupo nna,
nsaa kɔ kanyiti;
mbe kasha malɛ maa chɛrga kikɛ.
9E maa wu basa kulubi jemanɛ kikɛ;
mo alɛ maa nya agbo mbaanaayɔ.
10E maa gberge anyi kusoe
kananɛ a daga fanɛ e gberge
anyi kumo na;
ŋko a laŋɛ anyi be alubi
a ka anyi kukɔ.
11Kasha nɛ e kɔ n sa basa
nɛ baa bunyaŋ mo na shi ga;
k shi a chɔ yili kasawule so
n ya fo awɔlpa so.
12Kananɛ epeŋilarkpa nɛ epeŋitɔrkpa
barga abar a wɔ kufɔ na,
aloŋ nɛ Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na
lara anyi be alubi ashi anyi so.
13Kananɛ bekurgepo bee sha
bumo be mbia ga na,
aloŋ nɛ Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ gba bee sha
bekama nɛ baa bunyaŋ mo na ga.
14Ŋkpal manɛ so, e nyi fanɛ
eshishɛr nɛ e ta m pɔr anyi.
15Anyi edimɛdi be nchɛ du fanɛ afitiri
ŋko kupuŋ to be atoto nɛ a bee
purge manaŋ manaŋ nna;
16ama afu baŋ chela amo so nɛ a bolo,
n wu n tɔr nseŋ bɛ n luri kasawule to;
nɛ esa maaŋ naŋ wu amo gba kuraa.
17Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na bee lara mbe kasha
nɛ k maa chɛrga na a ŋini bekama
nɛ baa bunyaŋ mo mbaanaayɔ nna;
mo alɛ nsaa wora a bɔlɔ mbe nnɔ
naseso so a sa bumo be kaman to ebi
18nɛ basa nɛ baa bɛ mbe
kɔnɔkoŋwule be ŋkre so
nsaa wora mbe mbraana
kasonu kashenteŋto na.
19Ebɔrɛ taŋɛ mbe kuwurji
ebɔrɛso nna,
mo alɛ nsaa ji kuwura asɔ
toso kikɛ so.
20Menyi emalaika lempoana,
nɛ menyee nu Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ
be kɔnɔ nsaa wora mo kasonu na
kikɛ e kpaŋ mo!
21Menyi ebɔrɛso be apɔrso
nɛ menyee shuŋ a sa Ebɔrɛ
nsaa wora mo kasonu na
kikɛ e baa kpaŋ Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ!
22Menyi, Ebɔrɛ be asɔ toso kikɛ,
nɛ e bee ji kuwura menyi so na,
e baa kpaŋ men Nyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na!
Ma ere be kagbene kikɛ nɛ ŋ kɔ
a kpaŋ Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na!

english_text:
The Lord Takes Care of His Creation
1I praise you, Lord God,
with all my heart.
You are glorious and majestic,
dressed in royal robes
2and surrounded by light.
You spread out the sky
like a tent,
3and you built your home
over the mighty ocean.
The clouds are your chariot
with the wind as its wings.
4 The winds are your messengers,
and flames of fire
are your servants.
5You built foundations
for the earth, and it
will never be shaken.
6You covered the earth
with the ocean that rose
above the mountains.
7Then your voice thundered!
And the water flowed
8down the mountains
and through the valleys
to the place you prepared.
9Now you have set boundaries,
so that the water will never
flood the earth again.
10You provide streams of water
in the hills and valleys,
11so that the donkeys
and other wild animals
can satisfy their thirst.
12Birds build their nests nearby
and sing in the trees.
13From your home above
you send rain on the hills
and water the earth.
14You let the earth produce
grass for cattle,
plants for our food,
15wine to cheer us up,
olive oil for our skin,
and grain for our health.
16Our Lord, your trees
always have water,
and so do the cedars
you planted in Lebanon.
17Birds nest in those trees,
and storks make their home
in the fir trees.
18Wild goats find a home
in the tall mountains,
and small animals can hide
between the rocks.
19You created the moon
to tell us the seasons.
The sun knows when to set,
20and you made the darkness,
so the animals in the forest
could come out at night.
21Lions roar as they hunt
for the food you provide.
22But when morning comes,
they return to their dens,
23then we go out to work
until the end of day.
24Our Lord, by your wisdom
you made so many things;
the whole earth is covered
with your living creatures.
25But what about the ocean
so big and wide?
It is alive with creatures,
large and small.
26 And there are the ships,
as well as Leviathan,
the monster you created
to splash in the sea.
27All of these depend on you
to provide them with food,
28and you feed each one
with your own hand,
until they are full.
29But when you turn away,
they are terrified;
when you end their life,
they die and rot.
30You created all of them
by your Spirit,
and you give new life
to the earth.
31Our Lord, we pray
that your glory
will last forever
and that you will be pleased
with what you have done.
32You look at the earth,
and it trembles.
You touch the mountains,
and smoke goes up.
33As long as I live,
I will sing and praise you,
the Lord God.
34I hope my thoughts
will please you,
because you are the one
who makes me glad.
35Destroy all wicked sinners
from the earth
once and for all.
With all my heart
I praise you, Lord!
I praise you!
translation_text:
Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na ka bee keni mbe asɔ toso so be asheŋ
1Ma kagbene kikɛ nɛ n ta a kpaŋ fo,
Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na, ŋkpal manɛ so,
kemaŋkuragboŋ nɛ kela kikɛ
buu fo fanɛ kuwurpiŋi nna,
2nɛ kefulto kulti fo n wɔtɔ
kaplɛkama.
Fo e parga kuwɔlpa to n sɔ
kaplɛkama
fanɛ wajɛbu, a wɔ kumo to.
3Fo alɛ e pɔr fo kowu n shin nɛ
tekugboŋ wɔ kumo be kaseto.
Bɔrɛwɔlpa nɛ k bee bɔla afu so
a nite na du fanɛ gbaŋɛturko
nna n sa fo.
4Fo e ta afuana fanɛ fo mbɔ
nsaa ta bɔrɛ be kenyɛkpɛ malɛ
fanɛ fo nyɛrbi.
5Fo e to durnya n yili
kumo be gbaltɔlase so,
nɛ k maaŋ tiŋ ŋ gbuŋgbuŋ na.
6Fo alɛ e to eteku chiŋgeliŋana
nɛ e bee bɔlɔ a dii abee so,
nsaa buu durnya so fanɛ piŋi na.
7Ama nɛ fo baŋ ponte,
nchuana kikɛ bee shile nna
8a gbelge abee so a bɔla ataŋɛ to
a yɔ kakpa nɛ fo bela ase
n yili amo na.
9Fo e yili amo be egbaŋ n sa amo
nɛ a sa maŋ bɔlɔ n dii kepla
m buu kasawule na kikɛ so.
10Fo e shin nɛ abuye bee
pete ataŋɛ to a ki elɔr
a shile abee to a choŋ,
11saŋɛ na so ekurma nɛ
kupuŋ to be asɔbɔya beeŋ baa
nya nchu a nuu a tuge achukoŋ.
12Mbuibi malɛ beeŋ tɔ bumo be asha
ndibi nɛ a yil m mata eboŋana na
be ayabi to nsaa jɔŋɛ amo so a shu.
13Fo e naa shin nɛ bɔrɛchu bee shi
awɔlpa so a ba abee so nɛ kasawule
bee nya kayul nɛnɛ.
14Fo alɛ e naa shin nɛ afitiri bee kɔr
nɛ kowu be asɔbɔya bee nya a ji,
nɛ dimɛdi malɛ bee duu asɔ
kasawule so a nya ajibi a ji,
15nsaa nya yabra a nuu
nɛ mbe kagbene bee fuli mo,
mo alɛ naa nya ŋku a gbiti
mbe anishito nɛ k bee nyɛkpɛ
nsaa nya ajibi be yiri kikɛ
a ji a nya eleŋ nɛ alenfia.
16An Nyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ,
fo ndibi bee nya nchu nna
jemanɛ kikɛ,
aloŋ nɛ ndibigboŋ nɛ
baa tre sida nɛ fo duu
Lebanɔn be efuli so na
gba bee nya nchu.
17Ndibi na so nɛ mbuibi bee
tɔ bumo be asha;
nɛ etɔkɔrkɔ malɛ gba bee
tɔ bumo be asha ashi ndibi
tenteŋ nɛ baa tre fir na so.
18Kupuŋ to be mboe wɔ
abee jeŋgreŋ so nna,
nɛ asɔbɔya wurbi
fanɛ eshiboe malɛ
wɔ abee na be afalta to.
19Fo e to kufɔl nɛ k bee ŋini anyi
kananɛ jemanɛ bee ba a yɔ;
nɛ epeŋi malɛ nyi saŋɛ
nɛ k bee tɔr.
20Fo e to tentembiri
nɛ kanyɛ bee biri,
nɛ kupuŋ to be asɔbɔya
bee nya lar a nite a kulti
a fin kusɔ jiso a ji.
21Ebuluŋ bee munto a shu nna
a fin keji, nɛ Ebɔrɛ beeŋ sa bumo.
22Epeŋi baŋ pete, nɛ b naŋ
bɛta n yɔ bumo be edesekpaana.
23Kumo be kaman nɛ edimɛdi
e koso n yɔ ashuŋ to n ya shuŋ
n tɔr epeŋi.
24Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ, kanyiasheŋ so
nɛ fo bɔla n to asɔ damta.
Fo asɔ to so nɛ e kɔ ŋkpa
sɔ kasawule so kikɛ nna.
25Asɔ keniso be yiri yiri damta
e wɔ teku nɛ k shi a dese palɛlɛ na to;
Asɔgboŋ nɛ asɔwurbi kikɛ e wɔ kumo to.
26Teku so nɛ ekuloŋgboŋ
bee nite a yɔ a ba;
Kubɔya lubi gboŋgboŋi
nɛ baa tre Liviatan na gba
wɔ teku to nna.
27Le be asɔ keniso ere kikɛ
bee keni fo anishito nna
nɛ fo sa amo kusɔ jiso
jemanɛ nɛ k daga.
28Fo alɛ bee bugi enɔ to nna
a sa amo kusɔ jiso
nɛ a bee nya a ji a moɛ.
29Ama nɛ fo baŋ pal kaman
n sa amo, kufugboŋ bee tɔr
amo so nna nɛ a chicha.
Fo alɛ baŋ naŋ lara amo be efute,
a bee wu nna a bɛta a yɔ eshishɛr to.
30Fo Kiyoyu so nɛ fo bɔla
n to amo be ekama
nsaa shin nɛ ŋkpa popɔr
bee ba kasawule so.
31An Nyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ,
anyee kule nna fanɛ fo
kemaŋkura e baa wɔtɔ
mbaanaayɔ;
saŋɛ na so, fo kagbene
beeŋ baa fuli kusɔ kama
nɛ fo wora so.
32Fo baŋ to kenishi ŋ keni
kasawule, k bee gbuŋgbuŋ nna.
Fo alɛ baŋ beta abee,
e bee kaa edishi nna.
33Meeŋ boŋ nshɛ ŋ kpaŋ fo
Enyɛnpe ma Ebɔrɛ na,
ashi ma kebaawɔtɔ kikɛ to.
34Mee tama fanɛ ma nfɛra fɛso
beeŋ baa par fo,
ŋkpal manɛ so,
ma kagbene fuli fo so.
35Shin nɛ alubiworapoana kikɛ
e mur ashi kasawule ere so,
n shin nɛ kumukpakpasowuraana
e sa maŋ naa wɔtɔ kuraa.
Meeŋ kpaŋ fo Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na
ashi ma kagbene to kikɛ.

english_text:
The Lord Can Be Trusted
1 Praise the Lord
and pray in his name!
Tell everyone
what he has done.
2Sing praises to the Lord!
Tell about his miracles.
3Celebrate and worship
his holy name
with all your heart.
4Trust the Lord
and his mighty power.
5Remember his miracles
and all his wonders
and his fair decisions.
6You belong to the family
of Abraham, his servant;
you are his chosen ones,
the descendants of Jacob.
7The Lord is our God,
bringing justice
everywhere on earth.
8He will never forget
his agreement or his promises,
not in thousands of years.
* 9 God made an eternal promise
10 to Abraham, Isaac, and Jacob,
11when he said, “I'll give you
the land of Canaan.”
12At the time there were
only a few of us,
and we were homeless.
13We wandered from nation
to nation, from one country
to another.
14 God did not let anyone
mistreat our people.
Instead he protected us
by punishing rulers
15and telling them,
“Don't touch my chosen leaders
or harm my prophets!”
16 God kept crops from growing
until food was scarce
everywhere in the land.
17 But he had already sent Joseph,
sold as a slave into Egypt,
18 with chains of iron
around his legs and neck.
19Joseph remained a slave
until his own words
had come true,
and the Lord had finished
testing him.
20 Then the king of Egypt
set Joseph free
21 and put him in charge
of everything he owned.
22Joseph was in command
of the officials,
and he taught the leaders
how to use wisdom.
23 Jacob and his family
came and settled in Egypt
as foreigners.
24 They were the Lord's people,
so he let them grow stronger
than their enemies.
25They served the Lord,
and he made the Egyptians plan
hateful things against them.
26 God sent his servant Moses.
He also chose and sent Aaron
27to his people in Egypt,
and they worked miracles
and wonders there.
28 Moses and Aaron obeyed God,
and he sent darkness
to cover Egypt.
29 God turned their rivers
into streams of blood,
and the fish all died.
30 Frogs were everywhere,
even in the royal palace.
31 When God gave the command,
flies and gnats
swarmed all around.
32 In place of rain,
God sent hailstones
and flashes of lightning.
33He destroyed their grapevines
and their fig trees,
and he made splinters
of all the other trees.
34 God gave the command,
and more grasshoppers came
than could be counted.
35They ate every green plant
and all the crops that grew
in the land of Egypt.
36 Then God took the life
of every first-born son.
37 When God led Israel from Egypt,
they took silver and gold,
and no one was left behind.
38The Egyptians were afraid
and gladly let them go.
39 God hid them under a cloud
and guided them by fire
during the night.
40 When they asked for food,
he sent more birds
than they could eat.
41 God even split open a rock,
and streams of water
gushed into the desert.
42God never forgot
his sacred promise
to his servant Abraham.
43When the Lord rescued
his chosen people from Egypt,
they celebrated with songs.
44 The Lord gave them the land
and everything else
the nations had worked for.
45He did this so that his people
would obey all his laws.
Shout praises to the Lord!
translation_text:
Ebɔrɛ nɛ mbe basa be asheŋ
1Men baa di Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na epaŋ
nsaa kule Ebɔrɛ ashi mbe ketre to!
Men baa kaŋɛ efuli kikɛ so ebi
kusɔ nɛ e wora be asheŋ.
2Men baa boŋ nshɛ a kpaŋ
Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na;
nsaa malga emamachisheŋ
nɛ e wora be asheŋ.
3Men baa ji eyur nsaa bunyaŋ
mbe ketre cheembi na
ashi men be ŋgbene to kikɛ.
4Men ta men be yirda n deŋi
Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na nɛ mbe
eleŋgboŋ so nsaa bunyaŋ mo
jemanɛ kikɛ.
5-6Menyi nɛ men la Eebraham
nɛ e shuŋ Ebɔrɛ na,
nɛ Jeekɔb nɛ Ebɔrɛ lara
dra dra na mo nanabiana na,
e baa nyiŋi Ebɔrɛ be mamachi
be asheŋ woraso
nɛ kananɛ e bee ji asheŋ nɛ amo
be ekpa so be asheŋ.
7Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na e la
anyi be Ebɔrɛ.
E bee ji asheŋ nɛ amo be
ekpa so nna kasawule so kikɛ.
8E bee nyiŋi a bɛ mbe
kɔnɔkoŋwule be ŋkre
nɛ mbe nnɔ naseso nɛ e
nase n sa menyi na so
hale n ya fo yili kenana ko
m ba tu kenana ko be
ntuŋ kagboŋ so nna.
9Le be kɔnɔkoŋwule be ŋkre nɛ mo
nɛ men nananyɛn Eebraham kre,
nɛ e bɔ ntaŋ n nase kɔnɔ n sa
men nananyɛn Aizek malɛ dra dra na.
10Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na
nɛ an nananyɛn Jeekɔb gba
daŋ wora kɔnɔkoŋwule be ŋkre
nɛ k beeŋ baa wɔtɔ mbaanaayɔ nna.
11E yɛ: “Meeŋ ta Keenan be kasawule
n sa fo nɛ k baa la feya mbaanaayɔ.”
12Loŋ be jemanɛ na nɛ Ebɔrɛ
be basa na daa maŋ shi,
bumo alɛ daa la befɔ ashi
Keenan be kasawule so nna.
13B daa nite nna a kilgi to
ashi efuli pɔtɛana so
nɛ bewuraana be nsawule so.
14Ama Ebɔrɛ daa maŋ shin nɛ
ekama mɛaŋ bumo.
E daŋ fɛa bewurjipo so nna
ŋkpal e ka daa kuŋ mo basa so.
15E yɛ: “Men sa maŋ kaa tɔrɔ
bejuŋkparpo nɛ n lara na,
ŋko ma anebiana!”
16Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na daŋ shin nɛ
ewule ba efuli na so nna nɛ
bumo be adɔjibi kikɛ mur.
17Ndoŋ nna nɛ e shin nɛ
bumo kurgepo Josɛf,
nɛ b daŋ fa fanɛ kenya na,
juŋkpar n yɔ Ijipt be efuli so.
18B daŋ wɔtɔ Josɛf be aya
nɛ mbe kubɔ to ŋgbɛlɛbi nna,
nɛ e pɛge so;
19nɛ kusɔ nɛ Ebɔrɛ kaŋɛ na bɔlɔ so.
Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na be kamalga e shin nɛ
kusɔ nɛ Josɛf kaŋɛ na ki kashenteŋ.
20Kumo be kaman nɛ Ijipt be efuli so
be ewura shin nɛ b lara Josɛf
ashi kabuti to.
21Ewura na daŋ shin nna nɛ e
bee keni mbe laŋ nɛ asɔ kikɛ so.
22Josɛf e daa keni ekrachiana na so
nsaa ŋini benimuana na kasheŋwora.
23Kumo be kaman nɛ Jeekɔb
nɛ mbe kanaŋ ya ki befɔ n chena
Ijipt be efuli so.
24B ka la Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ be basa so,
e daŋ shin nna nɛ b salga to
nseŋ nya eleŋ a chɔ bumo doŋana.
25E daŋ shin nna nɛ Ijiptebi na
kishi mbe basa nsaa kre
bumo asheŋ lubi be nia.
26Kumo be kaman nɛ e shuŋi
mbe kayɛrbi Mosis nɛ Ɛɛrɔn
nɛ mo gbagba daŋ lara na mbe basa kutɔ.
27B daŋ wora emamachisheŋ
nɛ asheŋ tumase gboŋ
ashi Ijipt be efuli so nna.
28Ebɔrɛ daŋ shin nɛ tentembiri
ba buu efuli na kikɛ so nna,
ama Ijiptebi na daa maŋ
nu n sa Ebɔrɛ.
29E daa naŋ shin nɛ bumo be
elɔrana be nchuana kilgi ŋklaŋ
nɛ ekɔrɔtɔ kikɛ wu nna.
30Epulo daŋ ba sɔ efuli na
kikɛ be kaplɛkama nna;
hale bumo be edesekpaana
nɛ ewurkpa gba daŋ bɔlɔ
epulo na nna.
31Ebɔrɛ daŋ malga nna
nɛ ashushombi firgiso
nɛ asɔ duŋso fanɛ epini
ba mel efuli na kikɛ so.
32Ade be kaman nɛ e shin nɛ
bumo be bɔrɛchu ki abɔrɛjembu
nɛ bɔrɛ bee nyɛkpɛ
kasawule na kikɛ so;
33e daŋ mur bumo be greep
be afeelebi nɛ ndibi nɛ baa
tre figi na nɛ ndibi nɛ a ka
na kikɛ gba nna.
34E daŋ malga gba nna
nɛ elotɔr ŋgboŋto ŋgboŋto
ba sɔ efuli na kikɛ so.
35Elotɔr ere daŋ ji
afitiri bumbuŋ kikɛ
nɛ asɔ nɛ b duu ndɔana
kikɛ to nna m mur.
36Ade kikɛ nyam be kaman
nɛ Ebɔrɛ shin nɛ Ijiptebi be
ewurkoŋnyɛn kikɛ nyam wu.
37Kumo be kaman nɛ e juŋkpar
Israɛlebi na n lar Ijipt be efuli so.
Bumo be eyiriana na to
be esa koŋwule gba
daa maŋ ka kaman.
B daŋ sulɔ shuwa
nɛ gbiti nna n lar.
38Jemanɛ nɛ b lar a yɔ na,
Ijiptebi na be ŋgbene
daŋ fuli bumo nna,
ŋkpal manɛ so,
kufu daŋ pɛ bumo nna.
39Ebɔrɛ daa bɔla kuwɔlpa so
kapaso nɛ edɛ be kabulpi so
kanyɛso nna a ŋini bumo ekpa
ashi bumo be enite na to.
40B ka daŋ kule mo ajibi,
mbuibi nɛ baa tre kweels na
nɛ ebɔrɛso be ajibi nɛ baa
tre manna na nɛ e sa bumo,
nɛ b daa nya a ji a moɛ.
41E daŋ shin nɛ kefalta pante
nɛ nchu lar kumo to eleŋso,
a shile keshishɛrsawule na so
fanɛ lɔr na nna.
42E daa nyiŋi mbe nnɔ
naseso cheembi nɛ e nase
n sa mbe kayɛrbi
Eebraham na nna.
43Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na ka kɔ n suge
mbe basa laraso ashi Ijipt
be efuli so na, b daŋ boŋ nshɛ
n ji eyur kagbenefuliso nna.
44E daŋ suge efuli pɔtɛana ko
be nsawule nɛ asɔ kama nɛ
b gben n nya nna n sa
Israɛlebi na.
45E wora loŋ nna nɛ mbe basa
e baa wora mbe mbraana kasonu.
Men kpaŋ Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na!

english_text:
A Nation Asks for Forgiveness
1 We will celebrate
and praise you, Lord!
You are good to us,
and your love never fails.
2No one can praise you enough
for all the mighty things
you have done.
3You bless those people
who are honest and fair
in everything they do.
4Remember me, Lord,
when you show kindness
by saving your people.
5Let me prosper with the rest
of your chosen ones,
as they celebrate with pride
because they belong to you.
6We and our ancestors
have sinned terribly.
7 When they were in Egypt,
they paid no attention
to your marvelous deeds
or your wonderful love.
And they turned against you
at the Red Sea.
8But you were true to your name,
and you rescued them to prove
how mighty you are.
9 You said to the Red Sea,
“Dry up!”
Then you led your people across
on land as dry as a desert.
10You saved all of them
11and drowned every one
of their enemies.
12 Then your people trusted you
and sang your praises.
13But they soon forgot
what you had done
and rejected your advice.
14 They became greedy for food
and tested you there
in the desert.
15So you gave them
what they wanted,
but later you destroyed them
with a horrible disease.
16 Everyone in camp was jealous
of Moses and of Aaron,
your chosen priest.
17Dathan and Abiram rebelled,
and the earth opened up
and swallowed them.
18Then fire broke out
and destroyed all
of their followers.
19 At Horeb your people
made and worshiped the statue
20of a bull, instead of you,
their glorious God.
21You worked powerful miracles
to save them from Egypt,
but they forgot about you
22and the fearsome things
you did at the Red Sea.
23You were angry and started
to destroy them,
but Moses, your chosen leader,
begged you not to do it.
24 They would not trust
you, Lord,
and they did not like
the promised land.
25They would not obey you,
and they grumbled
in their tents.
26So you threatened them
by saying, “I'll kill you
out here in the desert!
27 I'll scatter your children
everywhere in the world.”
28 Your people became followers
of a god named Baal Peor,
and they ate sacrifices
offered to the dead.
29They did such terrible things
that you punished them
with a deadly disease.
30But Phinehas helped them,
and the sickness stopped.
31Now he will always
be highly honored.
32 At Meribah Spring
they turned against you
and made you furious.
33Then Moses got into trouble
for speaking in anger.
34 Our Lord, they disobeyed you
by refusing to destroy
the nations.
35Instead they were friendly
with those foreigners
and followed their customs.
36Then they fell into the trap
of worshiping idols.
37 They sacrificed their sons
and their daughters to demons
38 and to the gods of Canaan.
Then they poured out the blood
of these innocent children
and made the land filthy.
39By doing such gruesome things,
they also became filthy.
40 Finally, Lord, you were angry
and terribly disgusted
with your people.
41So you put them in the power
of nations that hated them.
42They were mistreated and abused
by their enemies,
43but you saved them
time after time.
They were determined to rebel,
and their sins caused
their downfall.
44You answered their prayers
when they were in trouble.
45You kept your agreement
and were so merciful
46that their enemies
had pity on them.
47 Save us, Lord God!
Bring us back
from among the nations.
Let us celebrate and shout
in praise of your holy name.
48 Lord God of Israel,
you deserve to be praised
forever and ever.
Let everyone say, “Amen!
Shout praises to the Lord!”
translation_text:
Kelela nɛ Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na wora mbe basa be asheŋ
1Men kpaŋ Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na!
Men ta kechɔrɔ n sa Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ,
ŋkpal manɛ so, e walɛ nna
nɛ mbe kasha malɛ maa chɛrga
hale mbaanaayɔ.
2Esa kikɛ maaŋ tiŋ m malga
mbe asheŋgboŋ be asheŋ
n ya loge kikɛ.
Esa kikɛ malɛ maaŋ tiŋ ŋ kpaŋ
mo gba n ya loge.
3Kagbenefuli la bekama nɛ
baa ji asheŋ nɛ amo be ekpa so
nsaa wora asheŋ niŋiso
jemanɛ kikɛ na peya nna.
4Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ, baa nyiŋi ma,
jemanɛ nɛ fee chɛ fo basa to
nsaa mɔlga bumo na.
5Shin nɛ n ti fo basa laraso so n nyalɛ,
saŋɛ na so ma alɛ gba beeŋ ji eyur
fanɛ kananɛ baa ji eyur kagbenefuliso
ŋkpal b ka la fo basa so na.
6Anyi nɛ an nanaana kikɛ
wora asheŋ lubi ga.
7An nanaana ka daa wɔ
Ijipt be efuli so na,
bumo be lakal daa maa wɔ Ebɔrɛ
be mamachi be asheŋ woraso so;
ŋko kasha so.
Jemanɛ nɛ b daa dii teku peper na,
b daŋ pal kaman nna n sa mo.
8Ama e daŋ mɔlga bumo,
fanɛ kananɛ e nase kɔnɔ na;
nseŋ ŋini bumo mbe eleŋgboŋ.
9E daŋ kaŋɛ teku peper na nna
fanɛ k ku to, nɛ k ku to.
Ndoŋ nna nɛ e juŋkpar bumo
kasawule wɔlso so
m bɔla kumo to n choŋ.
10E daŋ mɔlga bumo kikɛ ashi basa
nɛ b kishi bumo be enɔ to nna,
11nseŋ shin nɛ nchu na ji bumo doŋana
nɛ b daa ju a buu bumo so na bre.
Hale ekoŋwule gba daa maŋ ji efute.
12Ndoŋ nna nɛ mbe basa na
nyiŋi mbe nnɔ naseso
nseŋ naŋ yirda mo
a boŋ nshɛ a kpaŋ mo.
13Ama k maŋ chɛr ko nɛ b naŋ teŋ
kusɔ nɛ e wora so
nsaa maŋ naa sɔ mbe kasotoji.
14Ajibi be kayɛlgagboŋ daŋ pɛ bumo
ashi keshishɛrsawule na so nna
nɛ b wora Ebɔrɛ ŋ keni.
15Amoso e daŋ sa bumo kusɔ
nɛ b daa sha na nna,
ama e daŋ ta kulɔ lubi nna
ŋ gberge bumo kusoe.
16Bumo be ekama ashi bumo
be keeyi to daa besa Mosis nɛ Ɛɛrɔn,
nɛ b la Ebɔrɛ be nyɛrbi nɛ e lara
n sa mbe kumu na eyur nna.
17Epul na to nɛ kasawule baŋɛ
n ta Datan nɛ Abiram nɛ
bumo be nnaŋ m min.
Ŋkpal manɛ so, b daŋ kini kenu
n sa Mosis nɛ Ɛɛrɔn nna.
18Kumo be kaman nɛ edɛ
suse n chɔɔ kumukpakpasowuraana
nɛ b daa bɛ bumo so na kikɛ m mur.
19B ka ya fo kebee nɛ baa tre Sainai
na ase, b daŋ ta shuwa nna n lɔŋɛ
gbolu fɔlbi nna a bunyaŋ kumo.
20B daŋ ta Ebɔrɛ be kemaŋkura nna
n sa gbolu fɔlbi nɛ k la kusɔbɔya
nɛ k bee ji afitiri na, be kapɔrduli.
21B daŋ teŋ Ebɔrɛ nɛ e daŋ wora
asheŋgboŋ ashi Ijipt be efuli so
m mɔlga bumo na so nna.
22Bumo alɛ daŋ naŋ teŋ
alemaŋkarsheŋ nɛ e wora
ashi teku peper na ase na
be asheŋ so nna.
23Ebɔrɛ daŋ nya agbo nna
ŋ kaŋɛ fanɛ e beeŋ mur
mbe basa na; ama Mosis
nɛ e lara nɛ e baa la mbe
kayɛrbi na, e mata mo
nɛ e maŋ naŋ mur bumo.
24B daa maŋ yirda kɔnɔ nɛ Ebɔrɛ
nase n sa bumo, fanɛ e beeŋ sa bumo
bumo gbagba be kasawule na;
amoso kasawule lela na be asheŋ
daa maa tir bumo.
25B daŋ kini kewora Ebɔrɛ kasonu nna,
nseŋ daa munto a bile asheŋ
ashi bumo be ewajɛbu to.
26Amoso e daŋ kpele bumo kusoe
kenishipereso nna fanɛ e beeŋ
shin nɛ b wu n tɔr
keshishɛrsawule na so.
27E yɛ e beeŋ pesaŋ bumo kaman to ebi
nɛ baaŋ ka na n yɔ nnyamase to,
saŋɛ na so baaŋ ya wu n tɔr
efuli pɔtɛana so.
28Ebɔrɛ be basa na be beko
daŋ ya kaa bɛ kegbir nɛ baa
tre Baal Piyɔɔ na so nna,
nseŋ daa ji agbir be nlɔŋɛjibi.
29B daŋ wora asheŋ lubi ga nna
nɛ Ebɔrɛ be kagbene kaa,
nɛ e shin nɛ kulɔ lubi ko ba bumo so.
30Ama kanyɛn nɛ baa tre Finihas na
e koso ŋ gberge alubiworapoana na
kusoe, nɛ kulɔ lubi na kuu.
31Ŋkpal loŋ so, baa nyiŋi mo nna
jemanɛ kikɛ nsaa sa mo bunyaŋ ga.
32Basa na daŋ wɔtɔ Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na
agbo to nna ashi kubuye nɛ baa tre
Mɛriba na ase,
nɛ Mosis daŋ ŋkpal bumo so
n wora n da Ebɔrɛ so.
33B daŋ shin nɛ kabɔlar pɛ Mosis nna
nɛ e nya agbo a malga.
34B ka ya fo kɔnɔ naseso
be kasawule na so,
Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ daŋ kaŋɛ bumo nna
fanɛ b mur nnyamase na kikɛ
nɛ b kini.
35Ama b daŋ ji bumo keteri nna
hale a wora asheŋ nnyamase na
be edaŋkare be ekpa so.
36Ebɔrɛ be basa na daŋ shuŋ
agbirana nna, nɛ kumo be loŋ
shin nɛ kemur ba bumo so.
37B daŋ ta bumo be mbia n lara
esarga nna n sa ayoyu lubi.
38Bumo be mbia nɛ b maŋ nyi
kulubi nɛ kelela na be ŋklaŋ
nɛ b daŋ ta n lara esarga n sa
Keenan be efuli so be agbirana
n jija kasawule na.
39Kusɔ nɛ b daŋ wora na
shin nɛ b wora eyurpi
daŋkare be ekpa so nna.
B daa maŋ ji
kashenteŋ n sa Ebɔrɛ.
40Amoso Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na
daŋ nya agbo n wora mbe basa nna
nseŋ daŋ kishi bumo be asheŋ.
41E daŋ kplaŋ bumo so nna
nseŋ yige bumo n sa efuli
pɔtɛana so be basa; nɛ bumo
doŋana daa ji kuwura bumo so.
42Bumo doŋana daŋ kɔrfɛ bumo
nseŋ ji eleŋ bumo so ga.
43Ale damta nɛ Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na
daŋ mɔlga mbe basa;
ama b daŋ kute n lar mo kaman
a wora asheŋ gela m bɔla amo so
n tɔr alubi damta to.
44Ama b ka shu n tre Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ
kagbenejijaso, e daŋ nu bumo
be kushu na nna.
45E daŋ nyiŋi mbe kɔnɔkoŋwule
be ŋkre na nna, nseŋ kpal kashagboŋ
nɛ e kɔ n sa bumo na so n chɛrga
mbe nfɛra a maŋ gberge bumo kusoe.
46E daŋ shin nɛ bumo doŋana
shu bumo so nna.
47O Enyɛnpe anyi be Ebɔrɛ, mɔlga anyi,
nseŋ lara anyi efuli pɔtɛana so
m bɛta m ba epe.
Saŋɛ na so anyeeŋ di fo epaŋ
nseŋ kpaŋ fo ketre cheembi na.
48Enyɛnpe, Israɛl be Ebɔrɛ,
fo e daga esa ka kpaŋ fo mbaanaayɔ.
Shin nɛ ekama e kaŋɛ, “Amɛn!”
Men kpaŋ Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na!

english_text:
BOOK V
(Psalms 107–150)
The Lord Is Good to His People
1 Shout praises to the Lord!
He is good to us,
and his love never fails.
2Everyone the Lord has rescued
from trouble
should praise him,
3everyone he has brought
from the east and the west,
the north and the south.
4Some of you were lost
in the scorching desert,
far from a town.
5You were hungry and thirsty
and about to give up.
6You were in serious trouble,
but you prayed to the Lord,
and he rescued you.
7At once he brought you
to a town.
8You should praise the Lord
for his love
and for the wonderful things
he does for all of us.
9To everyone who is thirsty,
he gives something to drink;
to everyone who is hungry,
he gives good things to eat.
10Some of you were prisoners
suffering in deepest darkness
and bound by chains,
11because you had rebelled
against God Most High
and refused his advice.
12You were worn out
from working like slaves,
and no one came to help.
13You were in serious trouble,
but you prayed to the Lord,
and he rescued you.
14He brought you out
of the deepest darkness
and broke your chains.
15You should praise the Lord
for his love
and for the wonderful things
he does for all of us.
16He breaks down bronze gates
and shatters iron locks.
17Some of you had foolishly
committed a lot of sins
and were in terrible pain.
18The very thought of food
was disgusting to you,
and you were almost dead.
19You were in serious trouble,
but you prayed to the Lord,
and he rescued you.
20By the power of his own word,
he healed you and saved you
from destruction.
21You should praise the Lord
for his love
and for the wonderful things
he does for all of us.
22You should celebrate
by offering sacrifices
and singing joyful songs
to tell what he has done.
23Some of you made a living
by sailing the mighty sea,
24and you saw the miracles
the Lord performed there.
25At his command a storm arose,
and waves covered the sea.
26You were tossed to the sky
and to the ocean depths,
until things looked so bad
that you lost your courage.
27You staggered like drunkards
and gave up all hope.
28You were in serious trouble,
but you prayed to the Lord,
and he rescued you.
29He made the storm stop
and the sea be quiet.
30You were happy because of this,
and he brought you to the port
where you wanted to go.
31You should praise the Lord
for his love
and for the wonderful things
he does for all of us.
32Honor the Lord
when you and your leaders
meet to worship.
33If you start doing wrong,
the Lord will turn rivers
into deserts,
34 flowing streams
into scorched land,
and fruitful fields
into beds of salt.
35But the Lord can also turn
deserts into lakes
and scorched land
into flowing streams.
36If you are hungry,
you can settle there
and build a town.
37You can plant fields
and vineyards that produce
a good harvest.
38The Lord will bless you
with many children
and with herds of cattle.
39Sometimes you may be crushed
by troubles and sorrows,
until only a few of you
are left to survive.
40But the Lord will take revenge
on those who conquer you,
and he will make them wander
across desert sands.
41When you are suffering
and in need,
he will come to your rescue,
and your families will grow
as fast as a herd of sheep.
42You will see this because
you obey the Lord,
but everyone who is wicked
will be silenced.
43Be wise! Remember this
and think about the kindness
of the Lord.
