1Most beautiful of women,
tell us where he has gone.
Let us help you find him.
She Speaks:
2My darling has gone down
to his garden of spices,
where he will feed his sheep
and gather lilies.
3I am his, and he is mine,
as he feeds his sheep
among the lilies.
He Speaks:
4My dearest, the cities of Tirzah
and Jerusalem
are not as lovely as you.
Your charms are more powerful
than all of the stars
in the heavens.
5Turn away your eyes—
they make me melt.
Your hair tosses about
as gracefully as goats
coming down from Gilead.
6Your teeth are whiter
than sheep freshly washed;
they match perfectly,
not one is missing.
7Behind your veil are hidden
beautiful rosy cheeks.
8What if I could have
sixty queens, eighty wives,
and thousands of others!
9You would be my only choice,
my flawless dove,
the favorite child
of your mother.
The young women, the queens,
and all the others
tell how excited you are
as they sing your praises:
10“You are as majestic
as the morning sky—
glorious as the moon—
blinding as the sun!
Your charms are more powerful
than all the stars above.”
She Speaks:
11I went down to see if blossoms
were on the walnut trees,
grapevines, and fruit trees.
12But in my imagination
I was suddenly riding
on a glorious chariot.
Their Friends Speak:
13Dance! Dance!
Beautiful woman from Shulam,
let us see you dance!
She Speaks:
Why do you want to see
this woman from Shulam
dancing with the others?

Kaba mo so nɛ fo jipo na bɔla, nɛ an chɛ fo to n fin mo?
Eche na be kashɛ
2N jipo yɔ mbe kudɔbi
nɛ kumo to be ndibi
be afantaŋ kɔ efɛa belbelso na to nna.
E ya kaa sa mbe mbolpɔ ajibi nna,
nsaa chala mbe atoto nɛ baa tre lili na.
3N la n jipo peya nna nɛ n jipo malɛ gba la meya.
E bee sa mbe mbolpɔ ajibi ashi atoto
nɛ baa tre lili na be kudɔbi na to nna.
Kashɛ Nusopo
Enyɛn na be kashɛ
4N jipo, fo walɛ kebita nna fanɛ ndegboŋ nɛ baa tre Tiiza,
nɛ Jerusalɛm na.
Fo alɛ bee tia aya nna fanɛ esoji ka keta etuuta
m bɛ abar so a nite na nna.
5Kpele fo anishi ashi ma so,
ŋkpal manɛ so, a bee shin nna nɛ mee chena a gben.
Fo emin bee gbuŋgbuŋ to nna
fanɛ mboe ka shi Giliad be kebee so
a gbelge to a ba kaseto na.
6Fo anyii fuli nna parr
fanɛ mbolpɔ nɛ b bɛr nɛnɛ.
Fo anyii bɛ abar so nna yɛɛr.
K kama maŋ gbaŋ n tɔr.
7Fo ŋgbuŋ du kulkulbi nna,
a walɛ nsaa nyɛkpɛ fo shata to.
8Hale nɛ n nya bewurche adeshe nɛ bejipo aduburwa
nɛ besuŋgurbi nɛ esa maaŋ tiŋ ŋ karga gba,
9fo nawule nɛ meeŋ lara.
Fo e walɛ fanɛ lepɔ,
nsaa la fo nio pibiche koŋwule.
Fo nɛ bechefɔlbi nɛ bewurche
nɛ bekama bee kpaŋ,
a boŋ nshɛ a fur fo.
10Wanɛ e ya kaa ba fanɛ karechɛso loŋ;
a walɛ kebita nsaa nyɛkpɛ so fanɛ epeŋi
ŋko kufɔl ka fara a lar?
Wanɛ e naa tia aya fanɛ achɛkpabi damta
ka lar awɔlto m bɛ abar so loŋ?
11N daŋ n yɔ ndibisɔrso be kudɔbi to nna
nɛ n ya keni fanɛ afeelebi
nɛ a bee sɔr asɔrso
nɛ baa tre greeps na,
nɛ amo nɛ baa tre pomegranates na,
teŋ fara a wora atoto a?
Eche na be kashɛ
12Ama n tia kaa pin
nɛ ma nfɛra yɛr ma n jipo be kasha so
fanɛ gbaŋɛturko be ediipo
ka bee yɔ kena to na.
Eche na be kashɛ
13Bɛta m ba, bɛta m ba!
Shulaim be kanaŋ to be kebichebi,
bɛta m ba cha ŋ ŋini anyi.
Eche na be kashɛ
Manɛ nna nɛ menyee sha fanɛ men wu ma kacha
basa damta ere to?

english_text:
Their Friends Speak:
1Most beautiful of women,
tell us where he has gone.
Let us help you find him.
She Speaks:
2My darling has gone down
to his garden of spices,
where he will feed his sheep
and gather lilies.
3I am his, and he is mine,
as he feeds his sheep
among the lilies.
He Speaks:
4My dearest, the cities of Tirzah
and Jerusalem
are not as lovely as you.
Your charms are more powerful
than all of the stars
in the heavens.
5Turn away your eyes—
they make me melt.
Your hair tosses about
as gracefully as goats
coming down from Gilead.
6Your teeth are whiter
than sheep freshly washed;
they match perfectly,
not one is missing.
7Behind your veil are hidden
beautiful rosy cheeks.
8What if I could have
sixty queens, eighty wives,
and thousands of others!
9You would be my only choice,
my flawless dove,
the favorite child
of your mother.
The young women, the queens,
and all the others
tell how excited you are
as they sing your praises:
10“You are as majestic
as the morning sky—
glorious as the moon—
blinding as the sun!
Your charms are more powerful
than all the stars above.”
She Speaks:
11I went down to see if blossoms
were on the walnut trees,
grapevines, and fruit trees.
12But in my imagination
I was suddenly riding
on a glorious chariot.
Their Friends Speak:
13Dance! Dance!
Beautiful woman from Shulam,
let us see you dance!
She Speaks:
Why do you want to see
this woman from Shulam
dancing with the others?

english_text:
The Wedding Dance
He Speaks:
1You are a princess,
and your feet are graceful
in their sandals.
Your thighs are works of art,
each one a jewel;
2your navel is a wine glass
filled to overflowing.
Your body is full and slender
like a bundle of wheat
bound together by lilies.
3Your breasts are like twins
of a deer.
4Your neck is like ivory,
and your eyes sparkle
like the pools of Heshbon
by the gate of Bath-Rabbim.
Your nose is beautiful
like Mount Lebanon
above the city of Damascus.
5Your head is held high
like Mount Carmel;
your hair is so lovely
it holds a king prisoner.
6You are very beautiful,
so desirable!
7You are tall and slender
like a palm tree,
and your breasts are full.
8I will climb that tree
and cling to its branches.
I will discover that your breasts
are clusters of grapes,
and that your breath
is the aroma of apples.
9Kissing you is more delicious
than drinking the finest wine.
How wonderful and tasty!
She Speaks:
10My darling, I am yours,
and you desire me.
11Let's stroll through the fields
and sleep in the villages.
12At dawn let's slip out and see
if grapevines and fruit trees
are covered with blossoms.
When we are there,
I will give you my love.
13Perfume from the magic flower
fills the air, my darling.
Right at our doorstep
I have stored up for you
all kinds of tasty fruits.
translation_text:
Enyɛn na be kashɛ
1Fo la ewurbi pibi nna,
nɛ asɛbta bee nyalɛ fo aya to ga.
Fo abembi walɛ nna
nseŋ ku nchule fanɛ kubɔtoshembi na.
2Fo kejapulo du kulkulbi nna
fanɛ kawulunchu nɛ nsa maa paŋ kumo to kikɛ na.
Nɛ fo eyur walɛ nsaa du shirembi
fanɛ ketɛmbɔ nɛ b lɔŋɛ so ŋ kreto n yili
nɛ atoto nɛ baa tre lili na kulti kumo.
3Fo anyipo yil nna jɔŋjurɔmbi
fanɛ echibir anyɔ ka lar kepla so a ji na.
4Fo kubɔ du shirembi nna
fanɛ jebote be kenyii be
ketempreŋ jeŋgreŋ na.
Fo anishi bee kpa edɛ nna
fanɛ Heshbɔn be kade to be nchu
nɛ a dese m mata Baf Rabbin be kabunagboŋ na.
Nɛ fo kamuna lar jurɔmbi fanɛ Lebanɔn be kebeegboŋ
nɛ k shoŋi Damaskɔs be kaba so na.
5Fo kumu wɔ esoso nna
fanɛ kebeegboŋ nɛ baa tre kamɛl na.
Nɛ fo emin walɛ nsaa nyɛkpɛ so
nɛ bewura gba maa keni amo a moɛ.
6Fo lar kebita ga;
fo kebita maŋ kɔ emɔrɔ.
7Fo wɔ nteŋ nna
a du sherembi fanɛ kebii be kedibi na;
nɛ fo anyipo cha abar fanɛ asɔrso ka cha abar na.
8Meeŋ dii kebii be kedibi na
n chuge kumo be asɔrso.
Fo anyipo du nna fanɛ asɔrso nɛ baa tre greeps na n sa ma.
Nɛ fo efute du viim n sa ma fanɛ asɔrso nɛ baa tre apɔl na.
9Kepipe fo kɔnɔ bee wora ma ebel
a chɔ nsa belbelso nɛ baa tre wain na.
Eche na be kashɛ
Amo be kenuu e wɔ ebel ga na.
10N la ma eshapo peya nna,
nɛ e bee sha ma ga.
11N jipo, ba nɛ an yɔ edekarso,
n ya di ndoŋ ŋklade.
12Shin nɛ an wule ŋ koso
n ya keni, afeelebi nɛ a bee sɔr greeps na fara a futi a?
Ŋko asɔrso nɛ baa tre pomegranates na
bee wora atoto a?
An kaŋ yɔ ndoŋ na
nɛ meeŋ ŋini fo ma kasha.
13Atoto be efɛa sɔ ndoŋ be kaplɛkama nna.
N jipo lela, asɔrso lela dra nɛ a popɔr kikɛ
nɛ n fin n yili fo.

english_text:
If Only You and I …
She Speaks:
1If you were my brother,
I could kiss you
whenever we happen to meet,
and no one would say
I did wrong.
2I could take you to the home
of my mother,
who taught me all I know.
I would give you delicious wine
and fruit juice as well.
3Put your left hand under my head
and embrace me
with your right arm.
4Young women of Jerusalem,
promise me never to awaken love
before it is ready.
Their Friends Speak:
5Who is this young woman
coming in from the desert
and leaning on the shoulder
of the one she loves?
She Speaks:
I stirred up your passions
under the apple tree
where you were born.
6Always keep me in your heart
and wear this bracelet
to remember me by.
The passion of love
bursting into flame
is more powerful than death,
stronger than the grave.
7Love cannot be drowned
by oceans or floods.
It cannot be bought—
any offer would be scorned
no matter how great.
Their Friends Speak:
8We have a little sister
whose breasts
are not yet formed.
If someone asks to marry her,
what should we do?
9She isn't a wall
that we can defend
behind a silver shield.
Neither is she a room
that we can protect
behind a wooden door.
She Speaks:
10I am a wall around a city,
my breasts are towers,
and just looking at me
brings him great pleasure.
11Solomon has a vineyard
at Baal-Hamon,
which he rents to others
for a thousand pieces
of silver each.
12My vineyard is mine alone!
Solomon can keep his silver
and the others can keep
their share of the profits.
He Speaks:
13You are in the garden
with friends all around.
Let me hear your voice!
She Speaks:
14Hurry to me, my darling!
Run faster than a deer
to mountains of spices.

1Fo daa la n siponyɛn
nɛ ma nɛ fo nyipo kenyipo koŋwule nna;
n daa beeŋ tiŋ m pipe fo kɔnɔ kasha so kaplɛkama;
nɛ esa kikɛ maaŋ tiŋ m bugi kɔnɔ.
2Meeŋ keta fo m ba n nio nɛ e bela ma na be laŋ to;
m ba sa fo ŋ gbagba be nsa belbelso
nɛ a shi asɔrso nɛ baa tre pomegranates na to.
3Fo enɔ bena suse ma kumu to nna

4Jerusalɛm be beche
men nase kɔnɔ n sa ma
fanɛ men maaŋ chuchɔl kasha
nɛ kumo be saŋɛ maŋ naŋ fo.

5Wanɛ nɛ mo jipo
e pɛ abar be enɔ to
n shi keshishɛrsawule so

Ndibi nɛ baa tre apɔl na be kifi to

ndoŋ nɛ fo nio di fo kedampo

6Sa maŋ naŋ sha esa kikɛ n ti ma so.

Kasha kɔ eleŋ nna fanɛ luwu.

8An kɔ an sipochebi ko nɛ e maŋ naŋ daŋ.

9Nɛ e daa la egbal nna

11Ewura Sɔlɔmɔn kɔ asɔrso nɛ baa tre greep na
be kudɔbi nna ashi Baal Hamɔn,
E daa kɔ kudɔ na nna a haya a sa basa

12Ewura Sɔlɔmɔn beeŋ tiŋ a kɔ mbe gbiti be ndarbi,
nɛ basa na malɛ e baa kɔ bumo be tɔnɔ.
Ama ma ere be asɔrso
nɛ baa tre greep be kudɔbi na
la n nawule peya nna Eshaponyɛnso na
13Fo nɛ fo teriana wɔ kudɔbi to nna a ber bare,
shin nɛ ma alɛ gba e nu fo ebɔl.
Eche na be kashɛ
14N jipo lela
shile manaŋ fanɛ chibir
ka shi kebeegboŋ
nɛ ndibi nɛ amo be efɛa wɔ ebel yil so na,
m ba ma kutɔ.

english_text:
1 I am Isaiah, the son of Amoz.
And this is the message that I was given about Judah and Jerusalem when Uzziah, Jotham, Ahaz, and Hezekiah were the kings of Judah:
A Guilty Nation
2The Lord has said,
“Listen, heaven and earth!
The children I raised
have turned against me.
3Oxen and donkeys know
who owns and feeds them,
but my people won't ever learn.”
4Israel, you are a sinful nation
loaded down with guilt.
You are wicked and corrupt
and have turned from the Lord,
the holy God of Israel.
5Why be punished more?
Why not give up your sin?
Your head is badly bruised,
and you are weak all over.
6From your head to your toes
there isn't a healthy spot.
Bruises, cuts, and open sores
go without care
or oil to ease the pain.
A Country in Ruins
7Your country lies in ruins;
your towns are in ashes.
Foreigners and strangers
take and destroy your land
while you watch.
8Enemies surround Jerusalem,
alone like a hut
in a vineyard
or in a cucumber field.
9 Zion would have disappeared
like Sodom and Gomorrah,
if the Lord All-Powerful
had not let a few
of its people survive.
Justice, Not Sacrifices
10You are no better
than the leaders and people
of Sodom and Gomorrah!
So listen to the Lord God:
11 “Your sacrifices
mean nothing to me.
I am sick of your offerings
of rams and choice cattle;
I don't like the blood
of bulls or lambs or goats.
12“Who asked you to bring all this
when you come to worship me?
Stay out of my temple!
13Your sacrifices are worthless,
and your incense disgusting.
I can't stand the evil you do
on your New Moon Festivals
or on your Sabbaths
and other times of worship.
14I hate your New Moon Festivals
and all others as well.
They are a heavy burden
I am tired of carrying.
15“No matter how much you pray,
I won't listen.
You are too violent.
16Wash yourselves clean!
I hate your filthy deeds.
Stop doing wrong
17and learn to live right.
See that justice is done.
Defend widows and orphans
and help the oppressed.”
An Invitation from the Lord
18I, the Lord, invite you
to come and talk it over.
Your sins are scarlet red,
but they will be whiter
than snow or wool.
19If you willingly obey me,
the best crops in the land
will be yours.
20But if you turn against me,
your enemies will kill you.
I, the Lord, have spoken.
The Lord Condemns Jerusalem
21Jerusalem, you are like
an unfaithful wife.
Once your judges were honest
and your people lived right;
now you are a city
full of murderers.
22Your silver is fake,
and your wine
is watered down.
23Your leaders have rejected me
to become friends of crooks;
your rulers are looking
for gifts and bribes.
Widows and orphans
never get a fair trial.
24I am the Lord All-Powerful,
the mighty ruler of Israel,
and I make you a promise:
You are now my enemy,
and I will show my anger
by taking revenge on you.
25I will punish you terribly
and burn away everything
that makes you unfit
to worship me.
26Jerusalem, I will choose
judges and advisors
like those you had before.
Your new name will be
“Justice and Faithfulness.”
The Lord Will Save Jerusalem
27Jerusalem, you will be saved
by showing justice;
Zion's people who turn to me
will be saved
by doing right.
28But those rebellious sinners
who turn against me, the Lord,
will all disappear.
29You will be made ashamed
of those groves of trees
where you worshiped idols.
30You will be like a grove of trees
dying in a drought.
31Your strongest leaders
will be like dry wood
set on fire by their idols.
No one will be able to help,
as they all go up in flames.
translation_text:
1Kubɔya nɛ Ebɔrɛ lara ŋ ŋini Aizaaya, nɛ e la Amɔz pibinyɛn, a laŋɛ Juda be efuli nɛ kadegboŋ nɛ baa tre Jerusalɛm na be kaplɛa so jemanɛ nɛ Uziya nɛ Jotam nɛ Ahaz nɛ Hɛzekaya daa ji kuwura Juda be efuli so na, e wɔ kawɔl ere to na.
Ebɔrɛ ka fɛa mbe basa so be asheŋ
2Ndoŋ nna nɛ Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ naŋ kaŋɛ: “Basa nɛ b wɔ ebɔrɛso nɛ kasawule so kikɛ e kaŋ asoe n nu kusɔ nɛ mee kaŋɛ ere! Mbia nɛ m bela e kilgi a kɔ ma na. 3Ana nɛ ekurma nyi basa nɛ b wɔ bumo nsaa bela bumo. Ama ma basa, Israɛlebi, bre maŋ nyi ma. B maa pin asheŋ to gba kuraa.”
4Asheŋ maaŋ nyalɛ n sa fo efuli lubi nɛ fo basa wora alubi damta nsaa nyi fanɛ b wora n da so ere. Men kini Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ nɛ e la Israɛl be Ebɔrɛ cheembi na nseŋ pal kaman n sa mo. 5Manɛ nna nɛ menyi kraa maa sa mo kashuli? Menyee sha kasogberge nna n ti so a? Israɛl be basa, k du fanɛ menyi be amu so kikɛ du fanɛ a ka wora achuu nna nɛ kulɔ malɛ wɔ menyi be ŋgbene kikɛ to nɛ nfɛra kikɛ to. 6K du fanɛ yili menyi be amu so m ba fo aya so, menyi be eyurana be kaplɛkama kɔ alɔ nna. Men pɛge so nna n wora achuu ama menyi alɛ maa sha esa kikɛ malɛ ka fɔr amo nseŋ wɔtɔ amo kudur ŋko ŋ kre amo so.
7Menyi be efuli na kikɛ mur nɛ esa kikɛ maŋ naa wɔ kumo so nɛ kumo be ndegboŋana na chɔɔ a dese fuloŋ. Men yil a keni nna nɛ befɔ ta menyi be kasawule nseŋ mur kusɔ kama cheche. 8Jerusalɛm nawule e ka fanɛ kudɔ to be kubuu na, nɛ bedoŋ malɛ kre kena m ba kulti kumo n wɔtɔ. 9Nɛ Enyɛnpetale Ebɔrɛ na daŋ maŋ shin nɛ basa na be beko ji efute, ndafanɛ Jerusalɛm gba mur cheche fanɛ kananɛ nde nɛ baa tre Sodɔm nɛ Gomɔra mur na.
10Jerusalɛmebi, menyi be bewuraana nɛ basa kikɛ du fanɛ Sodɔm nɛ Gomɔra be basa nna. Men kaŋ asoe n nu kusɔ nɛ Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na bee kaŋɛ nseŋ wɔtɔ lakal kusɔ nɛ Ebɔrɛ bee ŋini menyi to. 11Ebɔrɛ yɛ: “Men tama fanɛ mee sha esarga nɛ menyee lara a sa ma ere kikɛ nna a? Mbolpɔ nɛ asɔbɔya pɔtɛ be eblaŋ be alela akpa nɛ menyee chɔɔ a lara esarga a sa ma na fi ma. Ma alɛ maŋ naa sha egbolu nɛ mbolpɔ nɛ mboe be ŋklaŋ gba. 12Wanɛ e kaŋɛ menyi fanɛ men baa bar le be asɔ m ba kaa sa ma jemanɛ nɛ menyee shuŋ ma, Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na? Wanɛ e kaŋɛ menyi fanɛ men baa nite a kulti nɛ men be aya e baa gbri ma bɔrɛlambu to? 13Esarga nɛ menyee bar na kikɛ maŋ kɔ tɔnɔ. Ŋ kishi eduwu nɛ menyee chɔɔ na be efɛa nna ga. Ma alɛ maa sha Kufɔl Popɔr nɛ Kewushiachɛ be nchɛgboŋana nɛ menyi be kabɔrɛshuŋ be nshɛrana be asheŋ. Men wora alubi nna n jija amo. 14Ŋ kishi menyi be Kufɔl Popɔr be Nchɛgboŋ nɛ nchɛ cheembiana kikɛ nna. A du fanɛ esulɔ gbɛgbɛso nɛ amo be kesulɔ shin nɛ ŋ gben nna.
15Nɛ menyee maŋ menyi be enɔana so ashi kabɔrɛkule to, m maaŋ gbɛ ŋ keni menyi gba. Kanaŋkama nɛ men kule ma gba, m maaŋ nu n sa menyi, ŋkpal manɛ so, men la bemɔpo nna nɛ ŋklaŋ gbiti menyi be enɔana. 16Men fɔr menyi be eyurana so n nyalɛ so nseŋ yige asheŋ lubi nɛ mee wu menyi kaa bee wora na. Kashenteŋto, men yige alubi be kewora 17nseŋ koya kebaawora kusɔ nɛ k daga. Men shin nɛ keji asheŋ nɛ amo be ekpa so e baa wɔ menyi to. Kumo e la fanɛ, men baa chɛ bumo nɛ baa mɛaŋ to nsaa sa bemunibi asɔ nɛ a daga bumo nsaa ji bekulpoche be asheŋ ashi demujikpa nɛnɛ a sa bumo.”
18Ade be kaman nɛ Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na naŋ kaŋɛ le: “Naniere, men shin nɛ an ji kesheŋ na. Kulubi shin nɛ men pere kpeŋ fanɛ ŋklaŋ, ama meeŋ fɔr menyi so nɛ men fuli parr a chɔ ateebi. 19Nɛ menyeeŋ baa wora ma kasonu bre, menyeeŋ baa nya asɔ lela kasawule ere so a ji. 20Ama nɛ men kplaŋ ma so bre, kumo ere menyeeŋ wu kena to. Ma, Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na, e kaŋɛ na.”
Kadegboŋ lubi na be asheŋ
21Menyi Jerusalɛmebi nɛ men daa ji kashenteŋ na, chɛrga nna a wora asheŋ fanɛ sakaleche. Basa nɛ b niŋi e daŋ bɔlɔ menyi be kadegboŋ to jemanɛ ko, ama naniere basa nɛ baa mɔ basa nawule e ka kumo to. 22Men daa du fanɛ gbiti nɛ k kɔ tɔnɔ ga nna, ama naniere menyi maŋ naa kɔ tɔnɔ kikɛ kuraa. Men daa du fanɛ yabra lela ga nna, ama naniere men ki fanɛ nchu nawule nna. 23Menyi be bejuŋkparpoana kini fanɛ m maaŋ naa wɔ bumo nseŋ ya ji beyu keteri. B wɔtɔ nna a sɔ ŋkɛ nɛ asɔ basa kutɔ pɔɛŋ nsaa wora asheŋ a sa bumo. B maa kɔ a sa bemunibi ashi demujikpa, ŋko a nya asoe a nu asheŋ ashi bekulpoche kutɔ.
24Amoso, naniere men nu kusɔ nɛ Enyɛnpetale Israɛl be Ebɔrɛ lempo na bee kaŋɛ. E yɛ: “Meeŋ wora n tal menyi nɛ men la n doŋana ere to, nɛ menyi maaŋ naa wora asheŋ a tɔrɔ ma. 25Meeŋ gberge menyi kusoe kenishipereso nɛ ebɔl e lar menyi. Meeŋ lara eyurpi menyi so fanɛ kananɛ baa ta edɛ a lara eyurpi ashi abɛlso to na. 26Ma alɛ beeŋ sa menyi bewura nɛ besoetojipo nɛ b du fanɛ bumo nɛ men daa kɔ dra na. Ŋ kaŋ wora loŋ, baaŋ naa tre Jerusalɛm Kadegboŋ Niŋiso nɛ Kashenteŋji be Kakpa.”
27Ŋkpal Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na ka niŋi so, e beeŋ mɔlga Jerusalɛm nɛ esa kama nɛ e beeŋ tuba n lar alubi to ashi ndoŋ. 28Ama e beeŋ mur esa kama nɛ e bee wora alubi nseŋ kini fanɛ Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ e baa wɔ mo na. Mo alɛ beeŋ shin nɛ esa kama nɛ e kplaŋ mo so e wu.
29Saŋɛ na so nɛ nyɔmɔ e pɛ menyi nɛ men be ŋgbene e jija menyi ŋkpal men ka daŋ shuŋ ndibi nseŋ lɔŋɛ mboŋ ko a shuŋ agbir ndoŋ so. 30Menyi alɛ beeŋ ki fanɛ kedibigboŋ nɛ kumo be afantaŋ bee gbaŋgbaŋ a tɔr ŋkpal ewule so ŋko kudɔbi to be asɔduu so ka bolo ŋkpal a ka maŋ nya nchu so na. 31Kananɛ edɛbi beeŋ tiŋ n shin nɛ afitiri wɔlso e chɔɔ m mur na nɛ menyi to be bejuŋkparpo lempoana gbagba be asheŋ lubi beeŋ mur bumo nɛ esa kikɛ maaŋ tiŋ n chɛ bumo to.

english_text:
Peace That Lasts Forever
1This is the message I was given about Judah and Jerusalem:
2In the future, the mountain
with the Lord's temple
will be the highest of all.
It will reach above the hills;
every nation will rush to it.
3Many people will come and say,
“Let's go to the mountain
of the Lord God of Jacob
and worship in his temple.”
The Lord will teach us his Law
from Jerusalem,
and we will obey him.
4 He will settle arguments
between nations.
They will pound their swords
and their spears
into rakes and shovels;
they will never make war
or attack one another.
5People of Israel, let's live
by the light of the Lord.
Following Sinful Customs
6Our Lord, you have deserted
your people, Israel,
because they follow customs
of nations from the east.
They worship Philistine gods
and are close friends
of foreigners.
7They have endless treasures
of silver and gold;
they have countless horses
and war chariots.
8Everywhere in the country
they worship the idols
they have made.
9And so, all of them
will be ashamed and disgraced.
Don't forgive them!
A Day of Judgment
10 Every one of you,
go hide among the rocks
and in the ground,
because the Lord is fearsome,
marvelous, and glorious.
11When the Lord comes,
everyone who is proud
will be made humble,
and the Lord alone
will be honored.
12The Lord All-Powerful
has chosen a day
when those who are proud
and conceited
will be put down.
13The tall and towering
cedars of Lebanon
will be destroyed.
So will the oak trees of Bashan,
14all high mountains and hills,
15every strong fortress,
16all the seagoing ships,
and every beautiful boat.
17When that day comes,
everyone who is proud
will be put down.
Only the Lord will be honored.
18Idols will be gone for good.
19You had better hide
in caves and holes—
the Lord will be fearsome,
marvelous, and glorious
when he comes to terrify
people on earth.
20On that day everyone will throw
to the moles and bats
their idols of silver and gold
they made to worship.
21The Lord will be fearsome,
marvelous, and glorious
when he comes to terrify
people on earth—
they will hide in caves
and in the hills.
22Stop trusting the power
of humans.
They are all going to die,
so how can they help?
translation_text:
Kayurwushi nɛ k wɔtɔ mbaanaayɔ be asheŋ
(Maika 4:1-3)
1Kubɔya nɛ Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na ta n sa Aizaaya nɛ e la Amɔz pibinyɛn a laŋɛ Juda be efuli nɛ kadegboŋ nɛ baa tre Jerusalɛm na be kaplɛa so nde:
2Lalaloge be nchɛ na to
kebee nɛ Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na be bɔrɛlambu na yil so na
beeŋ ba ki abee kikɛ to be kejeŋgreŋ,
nɛ efuli damtaana be basa e shile m ba kumo ase
3m ba kaŋɛ le:
“Men shin nɛ an dii n yɔ Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na be kebee so,
n ya luri Israɛl be Ebɔrɛ na be bɔrɛlambu na to.
E beeŋ ŋini anyi kusɔ nɛ e bee sha fanɛ an wora;
saŋɛ na so nɛ an baa wora mbe aparsheŋ saŋkama.
Ŋkpal manɛ so, Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na be keŋini bee shi Jerusalɛm nna;
nɛ e bee shi Zayɔn a malga a sa mbe basa.”
4Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na beeŋ naŋ lɔŋɛ efuligboŋana
nɛ kelantokɔ wɔ amo be basa to na nɛ b naaŋ nyalɛ abar so.
Kumo be kaman nɛ b ta bumo be etokobi m bɛl ntekpa
nseŋ ta bumo be akpa malɛ m bɛl eloji.
Efuliana na maaŋ naa ŋini bumo be basa kena be kekɔ kikɛ,
ŋko n naaŋ kɔ abar kena gba kuraa.
5Naniere, Israɛlebi, men shin nɛ an baa wora asheŋ
ashi Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na be kefulto
nɛ kebaanyi mbe kebaawɔtɔ to!
Ŋkpensheŋ ka maaŋ naa wɔtɔ be asheŋ
6O Ebɔrɛ, fo kplaŋ Israɛlebi nɛ b la fo basa so,
ŋkpal b ka yɔ efuli pɔtɛana nɛ a wɔ epeŋilarkpa be kaba so
be bekpalpo kutɔ so.
B daa luri Filisti be efuli so be belejipo so nna
nseŋ daŋ naa tu nnyamase a ji keteri.
7Bumo be kasawule so kɔ shuwa nɛ gbiti ga,
nɛ bumo alɛ daa kɔ asɔ lela ga bumo be ekpanjawu to.
Egbaŋɛ daa shi kasawule na so ga nɛ esa maŋ tiŋ ŋ karga amo.
Bumo be egbaŋɛturko malɛ gba daa maa kɔ kɔnɔ.
8B daa shuŋ agbirana
nɛ bumo gbagba lɔŋɛ ashi efuli na be kaplɛkama nna.
9Amoso, bumo kikɛ
beeŋ ŋaba nseŋ ji anishinyɔr.
Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ, sa maŋ ta m paŋ bumo!
10Bumo kikɛ beeŋ shile n ya ŋana abeelaŋ to
ŋko n ya kur kasawule n luri to
a fin keshile ŋ ŋana Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na be agbo
nɛ mbe eleŋgboŋ nɛ kemaŋkura so.
11Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na kaŋ ba,
baaŋ bar esa kama nɛ e bee fɛ fanɛ e shi ga,
ŋko ekama nɛ e bee maŋ mbe kumu so, kaseto.
Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na nawule
e naaŋ nya kemaŋkura loŋ be kachɛ na.
12Enyɛnpetale Ebɔrɛ na
lara kachako nna n yili
nɛ e bar bekama nɛ baa maŋ bumo be amu so
nsaa wu bumo be amu na kaseto.
13Lebanɔn be efuli so be ndibi tenteŋ ga
nɛ baa tre Sida na beeŋ mur.
Aloŋ nɛ ndibi gboŋgboŋi nɛ a wɔ Bashan
be efuli so gba beeŋ mur.
14Abeegboŋ nɛ abeebi kikɛ beeŋ bure to n tɔr
n lala so ŋ ki fanɛ kasawule,
15nɛ ebu jeŋgreŋana nɛ
egbal lempoana kikɛ e bure n tɔr.
16Teku so be ekuloŋgboŋ lela kikɛ beeŋ mur nchu to.
17Kachɛ na kaŋ fo, baaŋ bar
esa kama nɛ e bee maŋ mbe kumu so
nɛ ekama nɛ e bee fɛ fanɛ e shi ga kaseto.
Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na nawule e naaŋ nya kemaŋkura.
18Agbirana maaŋ naa wɔtɔ kuraa.
19Jemanɛ nɛ Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na
beeŋ shin nɛ durnya e gbuŋgbuŋ na,
basa beeŋ shile n ya ŋana abeelaŋ to,
ŋko n ya kur kasawule n luri to ŋ ŋana,
a fin keshile ŋ ŋana Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na be agbo
nɛ mbe eleŋgboŋ nɛ kemaŋkura so.
20Kamɔnchɛ na kaŋ fo,
ekama beeŋ ta mbe shuwa nɛ gbiti be agbirana
nɛ e lɔŋɛ a shuŋ na n lɛ eshiboe nɛ ekɔŋkɔŋ.
21Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na kaŋ ba nɛ e ba gbuŋgbuŋ kasawule na,
basa beeŋ shile n ya ŋana amaŋ nɛ abeelaŋ to
a fin keŋana Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na be agbo
nɛ eleŋgboŋ nɛ kemaŋkura so.
22Men yige kebaata yirda a wɔtɔ dimɛdi be eleŋ to.
Dimɛdi kikɛ beeŋ wu. Amoso dimɛdi maaŋ tiŋ n chɛ menyi to?

english_text:
Judgment on Jerusalem and Judah
1The mighty Lord All-Powerful
is going to take away
from Jerusalem and Judah
everything you need—
your bread and water,
* 2soldiers and heroes,
judges and prophets,
leaders and army officers,
3officials and advisors,
fortunetellers and others
who tell the future.
4He will let children and babies
become your rulers.
5You will each be cruel
to friends and neighbors.
Young people will insult
their elders;
no one will show respect
to those who deserve it.
6Some of you will grab hold
of a relative and say,
“You still have a coat.
Be our leader and rule
this pile of ruins.”
7But the answer will be,
“I can't do you any good.
Don't make me your leader.
There's no food or clothing
left in my house.”
8Jerusalem and Judah,
you rebelled against
your glorious Lord—
your words and your actions,
made you stumble and fall.
9The look on your faces shows
that you are sinful as Sodom,
and you don't try to hide it.
You are in for trouble,
and you have brought it all
on yourselves.
The Wrong Kind of Leaders
10Tell those who obey God,
“You're very fortunate—
you will be rewarded
for what you have done.”
11Tell those who disobey,
“You're in big trouble—
what you did to others
will come back to you.”
12Though you are God's people,
you are ruled and abused
by women and children.
You are confused by leaders
who guide you
down the wrong path.
13The Lord is ready to accuse
and judge all nations.
14He will even judge
you rulers and leaders
of his own nation.
You destroyed his vineyard
and filled your houses
by robbing the poor.
15The Lord All-Powerful says,
“You have crushed my people
and rubbed in the dirt
the faces of the poor.”
The Women of Jerusalem
16The Lord says:
The women of Jerusalem
are proud and strut around,
winking shamelessly.
They wear anklets that jingle
and call attention
to the way they walk.
17But I, the Lord, will cover
their heads with sores,
and I will uncover
their private parts.
18-23When that day comes, I will take away from those women all the fine jewelry they wear on their ankles, heads, necks, ears, arms, noses, fingers, and on their clothes. I will remove their veils, their belts, their perfume, their magic charms, their royal robes, and all their fancy dresses, hats, and purses.
24In place of perfume,
there will be a stink;
in place of belts,
there will be ropes;
in place of fancy hairdos,
they will have bald heads.
Instead of expensive clothes,
they will wear sackcloth;
instead of beauty,
they will have ugly scars.
25The fighting men of Jerusalem
will be killed in battle.
26The city will mourn
and sit in the dirt,
emptied of its people.
translation_text:
Demuji nɛ k ba Jerusalɛm nɛ Juda be efuli so be asheŋ
1To, Enyɛnpetale Ebɔrɛ na bee shin nɛ e lara kusɔ kama nɛ esa kama nɛ basa ta bumo be anishi n yuu so ashi Jerusalɛm to nɛ Juda be efuli so nna. E bee shin nɛ e lara bumo be ajibi jiso nɛ nchu nuuso, 2nɛ bumo be basa nɛ b wora asheŋgboŋ nɛ baa puchi bumo so nɛ esoji nɛ demujipoana nɛ anebiana nɛ bekpalpo nɛ ekrachigboŋ, 3nɛ bumo be esoji be benimuana nɛ ekrachi be bejuŋkparpoana nɛ gomena be benimu nɛ bekama nɛ baa bɔla ŋkilgi so a wora asheŋ ashi kade na to nɛ efuli na kikɛ so nna. 4Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na beeŋ shin nɛ mbinyɛnsobi nɛ b maŋ naŋ daŋ n yili na e ji basa na so kuwura. 5Basa beeŋ baa kɔrfɛ abar. Mbifɔlbi maaŋ baa sa bumo be benimuana bunyaŋ. Basa jiga maaŋ naa bunyaŋ basa nɛ b daga bunyaŋ.
6Jemanɛ ko bee ba nɛ kanaŋ to be kabuna ko be basa e lara bumo gbagba to be esa nseŋ kaŋɛ mo le: “Fo e kɔ asɔbuuso, amoso ki anyi be ejuŋkparpo ashi tɔrɔ be jemanɛ ere to.”
7Ama amodoŋwura beeŋ kaŋɛ bumo le: “Mannɛ ma ere! M maŋ tiŋ n chɛ menyi to. Ma alɛ gba maŋ kɔ ajibi ŋko asɔbuuso. Men sa maŋ ta ma ŋ ki menyi be ejuŋkparpo!”
8Kashenteŋto, asheŋ maaŋ nyalɛ n sa Jerusalɛmebi! Juda be efuli so malɛ baa mur nna na! Kusɔ kama nɛ baa kaŋɛ ŋko a wora bee gbiti Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na nna. Baa tege Ebɔrɛ ekama be anishito nna. 9Kananɛ bumo be anishiakpaana du na e naa ji shɛda a gbiti bumo. Baa wora alubi nna a maŋ naa ta amo a ŋana fanɛ kananɛ kade nɛ baa tre Sodɔm na be basa daa wora na nna. Asheŋ maaŋ nyalɛ n sa bumo. Bumo alɛ gbagba e bar kumu lubi gboŋgboŋi bumo be amu so.
10Kaŋɛ basa nɛ b niŋi na fanɛ asheŋ beeŋ nite nɛnɛ n sa bumo ere. Baaŋ nya bumo be kegben be tɔnɔ. 11Ama asheŋ maaŋ nyalɛ n sa basa lubi na bre. Kusɔ nɛ b ta n wora basa ko na e naaŋ wora bumo alɛ gba naniere.
12Mbifɔlbi nɛ beche e naa ji kuwura ma basa so nsaa kɔrfɛ bumo ga.
Ma basa, menyi be bejuŋkparpoana maa juŋkpar menyi nɛnɛ, amoso menyi maŋ nyi ekpa nɛ menyeeŋ bɔla so n wora asheŋ.
Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na ka ji mbe basa demu be asheŋ
13Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na bela ase nɛ e kaŋɛ kusɔ nɛ k wɔtɔ nseŋ wora shiriya nɛ e ji mbe basa demu. 14E bee shin nɛ e ji mbe basa be benimuana nɛ bejuŋkparpoana demu nseŋ kaŋɛ le a laŋɛ bumo be kaplɛa so: “Men chɔɔ ma adɔjibi m mur nseŋ nyaŋ betirpo n suge asɔ m bɔlɔ menyi be elaŋana. 15Menyi alɛ maŋ kɔ ekpa nɛ men nyaŋ ma basa n wɔtɔ nsaa ta betirpo fanɛ b maŋ la shɛŋ ŋkpal bumo be ketir so. Ma, Enyɛnpetale Ebɔrɛ na e kaŋɛ na.”
Jerusalɛm to be beche be asheŋ
16Kede be kaman, nɛ Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na naŋ kaŋɛ le: “Keni kananɛ Jerusalɛm to be beche bee wu bumo be amu loŋ! Baa nite boeŋ boeŋ nna a keni a fin fanɛ benyɛn e baa wu bumo nsaa yɛlga bumo jemanɛ kikɛ. Baa nite nna nɛ bumo be anampase bee gbri. 17Amoso ma, Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na beeŋ gberge bumo kusoe nseŋ she bumo be amu kɔlikɔli.”
18-23Kachako bee ba nɛ Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na e suge Jerusalɛm to be beche be abitasɔ nɛ baa wɔtɔ bumo be aya so nɛ amu so nɛ abɔ to nɛ asoe to nɛ mbre so nɛ mmuna to nɛ ashilbi to na, nɛ bumo be asɔbuuso so kikɛ. E beeŋ suge bumo be eshata nɛ ekreso nɛ etulale nɛ a bee shin nɛ bumo be kebita bee gberge benyɛn a sa bumo na. Mo alɛ beeŋ naaŋ suge bumo be nle nɛ baa buu fanɛ bewurche na nɛ bumo be asɔbuuso lela nɛ nwuro nɛ enɔ to be ebagiwurbiana kikɛ.
24Beche na beeŋ baa ka dufɛ nyaŋnyaŋ ŋkpal b ka maaŋ naa gbiti etulale eyurana so so. B maaŋ naa nya a mɛa to a kre so. Baaŋ baa yige bumo be epiŋi nna nɛ a baa sha bumo so kanaŋkama loŋ. Bumo alɛ beeŋ she kɔlikɔli nseŋ buu asɔ farbi, nɛ bumo be kebita e terge nɛ anishinyɔr e pɛ bumo.
25Ade kikɛ be kaman, Jerusalɛm to be benyɛn lempo nɛ baa tiŋ a kɔ kena na kikɛ beeŋ wu kena to; 26nɛ kadegboŋ na e ka a dese fanɛ eche ka chena kasawule n teŋi aya a shu keeli na. Ŋkpal manɛ so kumo to be basa kikɛ maaŋ naa wɔtɔ.

english_text:
1When this happens, seven women will grab the same man, and each of them will say, “I'll buy my own food and clothes! Just marry me and take away my disgrace.”
The Lord Will Bless His People Who Survive
2The time is coming when the Lord will make his land fruitful and glorious again, and the people of Israel who survive will take great pride in what the land produces. 3Everyone who is left alive in Jerusalem will be called special, 4after the Lord sends a fiery judgment to clean the city and its people of their violent deeds.
5 Then the Lord will cover the whole city and its meeting places with a thick cloud each day and with a flaming fire each night. God's own glory will be like a huge tent that covers everything. 6It will provide shade from the heat of the sun and a place of shelter and protection from storms and rain.
translation_text:
1Jemanɛ na kaŋ fo malɛ, beche ashunu beeŋ baa shil a buu enyɛn koŋwule so a kaŋɛ le: “Anyeeŋ tiŋ a bela nsaa buu anyi be amu, jande, fo ere e baŋ shuli nɛ an baa tre fo anyi kul, saŋɛ na so anyi maaŋ ji nyɔmɔ ŋkpal anyi ka maa kil so.”
Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ ka beeŋ nɛfa mbe basa nɛ baaŋ ka be asheŋ
2To, jemanɛ ko bee ba nɛ Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na e shin nɛ adɔjibi nɛ ndibi kikɛ e daŋ n nyalɛ a walɛ. Saŋɛ na so nɛ Israɛl be basa kama nɛ baaŋ ji efute na be ŋgbene e fuli kasawule na be adɔjibi so nɛ b baa puchi amo so. 3Baaŋ baa tre Jerusalɛm to be esa kama nɛ Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na shin nɛ e ji efute na esa cheembi. 4Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na beeŋ bɔla mbe eleŋgboŋ so n ji efuli na demu nseŋ fɔr Jerusalɛm be kewora n jija nɛ basa nɛ b mɔ na be ŋklaŋ n lɛ nɛ efuli na e naaŋ nyalɛ so ashi asheŋ lubi be kaplɛa so. 5Kumo be kaman nɛ Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na e shin nɛ kuwɔlpa e baa buu kebee nɛ baa tre Zayɔn na nɛ bekama nɛ b gama ndoŋ na so kapaso nseŋ shin nɛ edishi nɛ edɛ wuloŋwuloŋ nɛ kefulto e baa buu kumo so kanyɛso. Ebɔrɛ be kemaŋkura beeŋ baa buu kadegboŋ na kikɛ so a kuŋ kumo. 6Mbe kemaŋkura beeŋ baa wora kiyoyul a buu kadegboŋ na so a kuŋ kumo ashi epeŋi be ebeldɛ so nseŋ shin nɛ k baa la kesɔnyige be kakpa a kuŋ basa ashi bɔrɛ nɛ afugboŋ to.

english_text:
A Song about a Vineyard
The Lord said:
1 I will sing a song
about my friend's vineyard
that was on the side
of a fertile hill.
2My friend dug the ground,
removed the stones,
and planted the best vines.
He built a watchtower
and dug a pit in rocky ground
for pressing the grapes.
He hoped they would be sweet,
but bitter grapes
were all it produced.
3Listen, people of Jerusalem
and of Judah!
You be the judge of me
and my vineyard.
4What more could I have done
for my vineyard?
I hoped for sweet grapes,
but bitter grapes
were all that grew.
5Now I will let you know
what I am going to do.
I will cut down the hedge
and tear down the wall.
My vineyard will be trampled
and left in ruins.
6It will turn into a desert,
neither pruned nor hoed;
it will be covered
with thorns and briars.
I will command the clouds
not to send rain.
7I am the Lord All-Powerful!
Israel is the vineyard,
and Judah is the garden
I tended with care.
I had hoped for honesty
and for justice,
but dishonesty
and cries for mercy
were all I found.
Isaiah Condemns Social Injustice
8You are in for trouble! You take over house after house and field after field, until there is no room left for anyone else in all the land. 9But the Lord All-Powerful has made this promise to me:
Those large and beautiful homes will be left empty, with no one to take care of them. 10Four hectares of grapevines will produce only 27 liters of juice, and 180 liters of seed will produce merely 18 liters of grain.
11 You are in for trouble! You get up early to start drinking, and you keep it up late into the night. 12At your drinking parties you have the music of stringed instruments, tambourines, and flutes. But you never even think about all the Lord has done, 13and so his people know nothing about him. That's why many of you will be dragged off to foreign lands. Your leaders will starve to death, and everyone else will suffer from thirst.
14The world of the dead has opened its mouth wide and is eagerly waiting for the leaders of Jerusalem and for its noisy crowds, especially for those who take pride in that city. 15Its citizens have been put down, and its proud people have been brought to shame. 16But the holy Lord God All-Powerful is praised, because he has shown who he is by bringing justice. 17His people will be like sheep grazing in their own pasture, and they will take off what was left by others.
18You are in for trouble! The lies you tell are like ropes by which you drag along sin and evil. 19And you say, “Let the holy God of Israel hurry up and do what he has promised, so we can see it for ourselves.” 20You are headed for trouble! You say wrong is right, darkness is light, and bitter is sweet.
21You think you are clever and smart. 22And you are great at drinking and mixing drinks. But you are in for trouble. 23You accept bribes to let the guilty go free, and you cheat the innocent out of a fair trial.
24You will go up in flames like straw and hay! You have rejected the teaching of the holy Lord God All-Powerful of Israel. Now your roots will rot, and your blossoms will turn to dust.
25You are the Lord's people, but you made him terribly angry, and he struck you with his mighty arm. Mountains shook, and dead bodies covered the streets like garbage. The Lord is still angry, and he is ready to strike you again.
Foreign Nations Will Attack
26The Lord has signaled for the foreign nations to come and attack you. He has already whistled, and they are coming as fast as they can. 27None of them are tired. They don't sleep or get drowsy, and they run without stumbling. Their belts don't come loose; their sandal straps don't break. 28Their arrows are sharp, and their bows are ready. The hoofs of their horses are hard as flint; the wheels of their war chariots turn as fast as a whirlwind.
29They roar and growl like fierce young lions as they grab their victims and drag them off where no one can rescue them. 30On the day they attack, they will roar like the ocean. And across the land you will see nothing but darkness and trouble, because the light of day will be covered by thick clouds.
translation_text:
Waindibi be kudɔ be kashɛ be asheŋ
1Men kaŋ asoe n nu kashɛ nɛ mee shin nɛ m boŋ n sa menyi ere.
K la n teri ko nɛ mbe ndibi sɔrso be kudɔ be asheŋ be kashɛ nna.
N teri na daa kɔ ndibi sɔrso be kudɔ
nɛ k daa wɔ kepreŋsawule nɛ k bee wora asɔ nɛnɛ so nna.
2N teri na daŋ pulgi kasawule na to nna,
n tise kumo so be ajembu kikɛ pɔɛŋ;
nseŋ duu afeelebi lela kumo so.
Kumo be kaman nɛ e pɔr egbal a kuŋ amo,
nseŋ pɔr ebu jeŋgreŋ ko nɛ baaŋ baa yili so a keni kudɔ na
nseŋ kur kemaŋ nɛ baaŋ baa nyaŋ asɔrso na a wɔtɔ.
E daa tama fanɛ asɔrso na beeŋ wora nɛnɛ nseŋ pere a wɔ ebel nna,
ama amo kikɛ daa du nyaŋnyaŋ nna.
3Ŋkpal loŋ so nɛ n teri na kaŋɛ le: “Menyi basa nɛ men wɔ Jerusalɛm be kade to nɛ Judiya be efuli so, men ji ma nɛ ma ndibi sɔrso be kudɔ be asheŋ ere n sa ma. 4Kusɔ ko daga fanɛ n wora kudɔ na to nɛ m maŋ wora kumo a? Nɛ manɛ e ba nɛ ndibi na bee sɔr asɔrso nyaŋnyaŋso? Mannɛ asɔrso lela nɛ mee sha a?
5Kusɔ nɛ meeŋ wora ma ndibi sɔrso be kudɔ na e la fanɛ, meeŋ lara kunji nɛ k kulti kumo na nseŋ bure egbal nɛ k bee kuŋ kumo na nna, nɛ kupuŋ to be asɔbɔya e ba ji ndibi sɔrso na nseŋ chichi amo so m mata kasawule. 6Ma alɛ beeŋ yige amo nɛ amo to e wora afitiri ŋ ki kupuŋ. M maŋ naŋ lɔŋɛ ndibi na be ayabi so ŋko n ta kɔtɔkrɔ m buse amo to kikɛ. Meeŋ shin nɛ egɔnnyaŋɛ nɛ ewi e sɔ amo to. Ma alɛ beeŋ naŋ pɛ bɔrɛ nɛ k sa maŋ naŋ ba kudɔ na to kikɛ.”
7Israɛl e la Enyɛnpetale Ebɔrɛ na be ndibi sɔrso be kudɔ na;
Juda be efuli so be basa malɛ e la afeelebi nɛ e daŋ duu na.
E daa sha fanɛ b wora kusɔ nɛ k walɛ nna,
ama b daŋ mɔ basa nna.
Mo alɛ daa sha fanɛ b baa wora kusɔ nɛ k daga nna,
ama bumo be basa daa shu a fin esa nɛ e beeŋ wu bumo kuwɔr nna.
Asheŋ lubi nɛ basa bee wora na be asheŋ
8Asheŋ maaŋ nyalɛ n sa menyi! Menyi bee tɔ nwu nɛ nsawule damta a ti amo nɛ men chɛr a kɔ so nna. K maaŋ chɛr nɛ kakpa maaŋ naa wɔtɔ nɛ esa kikɛ e naaŋ ba chena so. Menyi nawule e naaŋ ka kasawule na so. 9N daŋ nu Enyɛnpetale Ebɔrɛ na ka kaŋɛ le: “Nwu gboŋgboŋi lela ere kikɛ beeŋ ki alambure nɛ esa kikɛ maaŋ naa wɔ amo to. 10Yabra belbelso fanɛ egalɔn ashe nawule nɛ esa beeŋ nya ashi ndibi sɔrso be kudɔ nɛ k fo fanɛ nto adunyɔ be kasawule so, nseŋ nya ayu beeŋ wora ekurwa kuduaburwa nawule ashi ayuduu ekurwa kalfa nɛ aduburwa nɛ e ta n duu to.”
11Asheŋ kraa maaŋ nyalɛ n sa menyi nɛ menyeeŋ koso n fara kasanuu kachipurdidi hale nɛ kaaseso e ya fo nɛ menyi kraa boo ere. 12Ejaŋjilaŋ nɛ echakachaka nɛ nlopi nɛ yabra nɛ menyee ta a ji menyi be amu ashi menyi be kasanuu be kejigboŋana to, ama menyi maa kaa fɛ asɔ nɛ Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na wora be asheŋ. 13Ŋkpal loŋ so menyi maŋ nyi shɛŋ a laŋɛ mbe kaplɛa so. Amoso men doŋana beeŋ ba pɛ menyi be galeŋga ŋ ki anya katiŋ so n yɔ efuli pɔtɛ so. Akoŋ beeŋ mɔ menyi be bejuŋkparpoana nɛ achukoŋ e mɔ basa damta malɛ. 14Bubuni wora shiriya nna m bela ase a jo Jerusalɛm to be bejuŋkparpoana na nɛ jimaŋ damta nɛ baa cha awɔr na, fɔŋfɔŋ bumo nɛ baa puchi kadegboŋ na so na.
15Nyɔmɔ beeŋ pɛ ekama. Bekama nɛ baa maŋ bumo be amu so na beeŋ ba kaseto. 16Enyɛnpetale Ebɔrɛ na bre bee wora kusɔ nɛ k daga nna a ŋini mbe keshi, nsaa ji mbe basa demu a lara mbe kecheembiya efuli. 17Ndegboŋana na be alambure to nɛ mbolpɔ fɔlbi nɛ mboe fɔlbi beeŋ ta ŋ ki amo be ejikpa a ji afitiri.
18Asheŋ maaŋ nyalɛ n sa menyi! Menyi maaŋ tiŋ n suge menyi be amu ashi menyi be alubi to. 19Le nɛ menyee kaŋɛ: “Shin nɛ Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na e nya manaŋ n wora kusɔ nɛ e yɛ e beeŋ wora na ai, saŋɛ na so anyeeŋ wu kumo. Shin nɛ Israɛl be Ebɔrɛ cheembi na e wora asheŋ nɛ e kre na ai; n shin nɛ an wu kusɔ nɛ k wɔ mbe nfɛra to.”
20Asheŋ maaŋ nyalɛ n sa menyi! Menyee ta kulubi nna a tre kelela nsaa ta kelela a tre kulubi. Menyee ta tentembiri nna a ki kefulto nsaa ta kefulto a ki tentembiri. Menyi alɛ naa ta kusɔ kekra nna a ki kusɔ belbelso, nsaa ta kusɔ belbelso a ki kusɔ kekra.
21Asheŋ maaŋ nyalɛ n sa menyi! Menyee fɛ fanɛ menyi be anishi bugi nna nɛ men nyi asheŋ ga.
22Asheŋ maaŋ nyalɛ n sa menyi! Nsa be keta n wea abar to n nuu bre be kaplɛa so, men la egoni nna nɛ esa kikɛ maŋ fo menyi so! 23Ŋkpal menyi be kebaasɔ brɔbu basa kutɔ so, basa nɛ b daga fanɛ b ji n tɔr na bee nya bumo be amu nna a ji. Menyi alɛ bee ji demu nna a puni basa nɛ b maŋ wora alubi na. 24Kananɛ atuweklaŋ nɛ afitiri bee wɔl nsaa ji edɛ na nɛ menyi alɛ gba beeŋ ji edɛ nɛ menyi be nliŋi e bɛ nɛ menyi be atoto malɛ e wɔl nɛ afu e gbaŋgbaŋ amo n lɛ! Ŋkpal manɛ so, men kini kesɔ Enyɛnpetale Israɛl be Ebɔrɛ cheembi na be keŋini na. 25Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na nya agbo ga nna n wɔtɔ mbe basa nsaa shin nɛ e gberge bumo kusoe kenishipereso. Abee beeŋ gbuŋgbuŋ nɛ basa e wu n dese agbembiana so fanɛ epi na. Ama amo nɛ amo kikɛ Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na be agbo kraa maaŋ wushi. E kraa beeŋ baa sha kegberge menyi kusoe n ti so.
26Kasogberge na be kaman, Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ ere beeŋ pal enɔ n tre efuli pɔtɛana nɛ a wɔ kufɔ kufɔ be basa nɛ b ba kɔ menyi kena. E beeŋ foŋ kafoli nna n tre bumo nɛ b nya manaŋ n shi durnya be lalaloge kikɛ m ba fanɛ afu na! 27Bumo be ekama maa gben kikɛ; ekama malɛ maa fiti gba. Edi maa la bumo gba a bishi nɛ baa di. Bumo alɛ be ekreso maa yɔɔ nɛ bumo be asɛbta be efɔlana maa tuge kikɛ. 28Kumo be kaman, bumo be akpaana du pɛlpɛlbi nna nɛ bumo alɛ wora shiriya a jo nɛ b to bumo be ata. Bumo be egbaŋɛ be alotobi du kpakpa fanɛ awarabi nna, nɛ bumo be kena to be egbaŋɛturko malɛ be aya bee kilgi to manaŋ manaŋ fanɛ kawuliwuli na. 29Bumo be benapoana bee munto nna fanɛ ebuluŋ ka pɛ kusɔbɔya nsaa gbeye kumo a yɔ kakpa nɛ shɛŋ maaŋ tiŋ n suge kumo bumo kutɔ na.
30Kachɛ nɛ baaŋ kre kena m ba na, baaŋ munto fanɛ teku ka bee kaa ketili a gbri na. Tentembiri nɛ kebagato beeŋ sɔ efuli na kikɛ so, ŋkpal manɛ so kuwɔlpa nɛ k biri to beeŋ buu kefulto nɛ k wɔtɔ kabre ere kikɛ so.

english_text:
A Vision of the Lord in the Temple
1 In the year that King Uzziah died, I had a vision of the Lord. He was on his throne high above, and his robe filled the temple. 2Flaming creatures with six wings each were flying over him. They covered their faces with two of their wings and their bodies with two more. They used the other two wings for flying, 3 as they shouted,
“Holy, holy, holy,
Lord All-Powerful!
The earth is filled
with your glory.”
4 As they shouted, the doorposts of the temple shook, and the temple was filled with smoke. 5Then I cried out, “I'm doomed! Everything I say is sinful, and so are the words of everyone around me. Yet I have seen the King, the Lord All-Powerful.”
6One of the flaming creatures flew over to me with a burning coal that it had taken from the altar with a pair of metal tongs. 7It touched my lips with the hot coal and said, “This has touched your lips. Your sins are forgiven, and you are no longer guilty.”
8After this, I heard the Lord ask, “Is there anyone I can send? Will someone speak for us?”
“I'll go,” I answered. “Send me!”
9 Then the Lord told me to go and speak this message to the people:
“You will listen and listen,
but never understand.
You will look and look,
but never see.”
The Lord also said,
10“Make these people stubborn!
Make them stop up
their ears,
cover their eyes,
and fail to understand.
Don't let them turn to me
and be healed.”
11Then I asked the Lord, “How long will this last?”
The Lord answered:
Until their towns are destroyed and their houses are deserted, until their fields are empty, 12and I have sent them far away, leaving their land in ruins. 13If only a tenth of the people are left, even they will be destroyed. But just as stumps remain after trees have been cut down, some of my chosen ones will be left.
translation_text:
Ebɔrɛ ka tre Aizaaya nɛ e baa kaa la anebi be asheŋ
1Kafɛ nɛ ewura Uzzaya wu na nɛ ŋ ku bɔrɛdare n wu Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na nɛ e tase mbe kuwurputi so kemaŋkura nɛ bunyanso. Mbe kuwurpiŋi daŋ sɔ bɔrɛlambu na be kaplɛkama nna. 2Nɛ asɔbɔya keniso nɛ baa suse so fanɛ edɛ be adondulombi na yili ŋ kulti mo. Bumo be ekama daa kɔ mbuibi be aba ashe nna. Asɔbɔya na be ekama daŋ ta mbe mbuibi be aba anyɔ nna m buu mbe anishiakpa so nseŋ ta anyɔ m buu mbe eyur so nseŋ ta anyɔ nɛ a ka na a firgi. 3Bumo alɛ daa ponte awɔrso nna a shoŋi abar a kaŋɛ le:
“Enyɛnpetale Ebɔrɛ na nawule e du cheembi!
Mbe kemaŋkura e bɔlɔ durnya kikɛ nyam to.”
4Asɔbɔya keniso na be ebɔl be awɔr na daŋ shin nɛ bɔrɛlambu na be gbaltɔlase daa gbuŋgbuŋ nna, nɛ edishi malɛ sɔ kumo kikɛ to.
5Ndoŋ nna nɛ ŋ kaŋɛ le: “Tama maaŋ naa wɔtɔ n sa ma nna na! Asheŋ maaŋ nyalɛ n sa ma, ŋkpal manɛ so, kamalga kikɛ nɛ k beeŋ lar ma kɔnɔ to la kulubi nna. Ma alɛ nɛ basa nɛ bumo be mmalga kikɛ la alubi e wɔtɔ, ama ma alɛ wu Enyɛnpetale Ebɔrɛ na kenishiso.”
6Kumo be kaman nɛ asɔbɔya na be eko ta beterɛ n lara kejanwulɛbi ashi ebɔrɛso be bɔrɛsure na so n firgi ŋ gbelge to m ba 7beta ma kɔnɔpurbi nseŋ kaŋɛ le: “Kede beta fo kɔnɔpurbi nna na. Fo nya alubi be ketampaŋ nsaa maŋ naa la esa nɛ e wora n jija nna na.”
8Kede be kaman nɛ n nu Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na ka kaŋɛ le: “Wanɛ nɛ meeŋ shuŋi? Wanɛ e naaŋ baa la anyi be kabɔ?”
Nɛ n shuli ŋ kaŋɛ: “Meeŋ yɔ! Shuŋi ma!”
9Ndoŋ nna nɛ e kaŋɛ ma fanɛ n ta kubɔya ere n ya sa mbe basa. E yɛ “Kanaŋkama nɛ men nu asheŋ gba, menyi maaŋ pin amo to. Kanaŋkama malɛ nɛ men keni asheŋ, menyi maaŋ pin kusɔ nɛ k bee wora na to.” 10Kumo be kaman nɛ e naŋ kaŋɛ ma le: “Shin nɛ basa ere be nfɛra e mel to nɛ bumo be asoe e ti nɛ bumo be anishi e tan, saŋɛ na so b maaŋ baa wu ŋko a nu ŋko a pin asheŋ to. Nɛ mannɛ aloŋ, baaŋ baa wu ŋko a nu ŋko a pin asheŋ to nseŋ bɛta m ba ma kutɔ m ba nya kechɛ.”
11Ndoŋ nna nɛ m bishi Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na le: “Jemanɛ mo nɛ kede beeŋ fo ekar?”
Nɛ e kaŋɛ ma le: “Jemanɛ nɛ ndegboŋana na beeŋ mur nɛ amo to be nwuana e ka a yil fuloŋ nɛ amo to be adɔsawule e dese jiga na nɛ k beeŋ fo ekar. 12Meeŋ yɛr basa na kakpa wɔfɔ nseŋ shin nɛ kasawule na kikɛ e ki jiga a dese fuloŋ. 13Basa kudu to be esa koŋwule gba ka kasawule na so, mo alɛ gba beeŋ mur. E beeŋ ki fanɛ kedibi gboŋgboŋi nɛ b ku n lɛ be keyimu.”
(Keyimu na yili n sa Ebɔrɛ be basa ka beeŋ naŋ fara kepopɔr to nna.)

english_text:
Isaiah Offers Hope to King Ahaz
1 Ahaz, the son of Jotham and the grandson of Uzziah, was king of Judah when King Rezin of Syria and King Pekah son of Remaliah of Israel went to attack Jerusalem. But they were not able to do what they had planned. 2When news reached the royal palace that Syria had joined forces with Israel, King Ahaz and everyone in Judah were so terrified that they shook like trees in a windstorm.
3Then the Lord said to me:
Take your son Shearjashub and go see King Ahaz. You will find him on the road near the cloth makers' shops at the end of the canal that brings water from the upper pool. 4Tell Ahaz to stop worrying. There's no need for him to be afraid of King Rezin and King Pekah. They are very angry, but they are nothing more than a dying fire. Ahaz doesn't need to fear 5their evil threats 6to invade and defeat Judah and Jerusalem and to let the son of Tabeel be king in his place.
7I, the Lord, promise that this will never happen. 8-9Damascus is just the capital of Syria, and King Rezin rules only in Damascus. Samaria is just the capital of Israel, and King Pekah rules only in Samaria. But in less than 65 years, Israel will be destroyed. And if Ahaz and his officials don't trust me, they will be defeated.
A Son Named Immanuel
10Once again the Lord God spoke to King Ahaz. This time he said, 11“Ask me for proof that my promise will come true. Ask for something to happen deep in the world of the dead or high in the heavens above.”
12“No, Lord,” Ahaz answered. “I won't test you!”
13Then I said:
Listen, every one of you in the royal family of David. You have already tried my patience. Now you are trying God's patience by refusing to ask for proof. 14 But the Lord will still give you proof. A virgin is pregnant; she will have a son and will name him Immanuel. 15-16Even before the boy is old enough to know how to choose between right and wrong, he will eat yogurt and honey, and the countries of the two kings you fear will be destroyed. 17But the Lord will make more trouble for your people and your kingdom than any of you have known since Israel broke away from Judah. He will even bring the king of Assyria to attack you.
The Threat of an Invasion
18When that time comes, the Lord will whistle, and armies will come from Egypt like flies and from Assyria like bees. 19They will settle everywhere—in the deep valleys and between the rocks, on every thornbush and all over the pastureland.
20The Lord will pay the king of Assyria to bring a razor from across the Euphrates River and shave your head and every hair on your body, including your beard.
21Anyone who is able to save only one young cow and two sheep, 22will have enough milk to make yogurt. In fact, everyone left in the land will eat yogurt and honey.
23Vineyards that had 1,000 vines and were worth 1,000 pieces of silver will turn into thorn patches. 24You will go there to hunt with your bow and arrows, because the whole country will be covered with thornbushes. 25The hills where you once planted crops will be overgrown with thorns and thistles. You will be afraid to go there, and your cattle, sheep, and goats will be turned loose on those hills.
translation_text:
Kubɔya nɛ k yɔ ewura Ahaz kutɔ be asheŋ
1Ewura Ahaz, mo tuto e daa la Jotam nɛ mo nananyɛn malɛ daa la Uzaya. Jemanɛ nɛ ewura Ahaz daa ji kuwura Juda be efuli so na nɛ Siriya be efuli so be ewura, Rezin nɛ Israɛl be efuli so be ewura nɛ baa tre Pɛka, nɛ e la Remaliya pibinyɛn na, daŋ cha abar m ba kɔ Jerusalɛmebi kena nna, ama b daŋ maŋ tiŋ ŋ kɔ n sɔ kadegboŋ na.
2Juda be ewura ka daŋ nu fanɛ Siriya be efuli so be benapo ba ti Israɛl be benapo so, nɛ kufu pɛ ewura Ahaz nɛ mbe basa kikɛ ga nɛ baa chicha fanɛ afu ka bee ber ndibi so na.
3Ndoŋ nna nɛ Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na kaŋɛ anebi Aizaaya le: “Keta fo pibinyɛn nɛ baa tre Shiya Jashub nɛ kumo be kifito la Basa gbrɛbi e naaŋ bɛta m ba na, nɛ men yɔ ewura Ahaz kutɔ. Menyeeŋ ya wu mo ashi ekpa nɛ k dese m mata kɔrɛwuraana na be eshuŋkpa nɛ k wɔ nchu be kubɔr nɛ k shi esoso a ba kadegboŋ na be lalaloge to na ase. 4Men kaŋ wu mo nɛ fo kaŋɛ mo fanɛ e shin nɛ mbe kagbene e dese mo. E saa maa ŋana ewura Rezin nɛ ewura Pɛka. B nya agbo ga bre, ama bumo alɛ baa du fanɛ ndibi anyɔ ka kɔ edɛ nsaa dese a duŋ gbrɛgbrɛbi nna. 5Siriya be efuli so be basa nɛ Israɛl nɛ ewura Pɛka e kre kebaamur menyi a kaŋɛ le: 6‘Men shin nɛ an ya kɔ Juda be efuli so ebi kena m pɔɔ bumo so nseŋ barga kasawule na to n sa abar, nseŋ ta kanyɛn nɛ baa tre Tabil na pibinyɛn ŋ ki ewura n chena ndoŋ.’
7Ama ma, Enyɛnpetale Ebɔrɛ na e kaŋɛ fanɛ loŋ maaŋ wora kikɛ. 8Ŋkpal manɛ so, Siriya be efuli na maŋ kɔ eleŋ a chɔ kumo be kadegboŋ nɛ baa tre Damaskɔs na, nɛ Damaskɔs malɛ maŋ kɔ eleŋ a chɔ ewura Rezin. Ta a ba nfɛ adeshe nɛ anu be jemanɛ so Israɛl be efuli na bre beeŋ mur a maaŋ naa wɔtɔ gba. 9Israɛl be efuli na maŋ kɔ eleŋ a chɔ kumo be kadegboŋ nɛ baa tre Samɛria na, nɛ Samɛria malɛ maŋ kɔ eleŋ a chɔ ewura Pɛka.
Nɛ Juda be ewura, Ahaz, nɛ mbe benimuana maŋ yirda ma bre, baaŋ kɔ n tɔr.”
Immanuɛl be tɔɔnɛ be asheŋ
10Kede be kaman nɛ Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na naŋ ta kubɔya ere n ya sa ewura Ahaz. 11E yɛ: “Kule Enyɛnpe fo Ebɔrɛ na nɛ e sa fo tɔɔnɛ ko a ŋini fanɛ kusɔ nɛ e kaŋɛ na beeŋ wora m bɔlɔ so. K beeŋ tiŋ n shi kasawule be kechimbi to ŋko ebɔrɛso.”
12Ndoŋ nna nɛ Ewura Ahaz kaŋɛ: “M maaŋ kule n fin tɔɔnɛ kikɛ. Ŋkpal manɛ so, m maa sha kewora Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na ŋ keni.”
13Nɛ Aizaaya malɛ kaŋɛ le: “Ewura Deevid be kamanebi, men kaŋ asoe n nu nfe. Menyee kaa wora edimɛdi a keni. Menyee sha kewora Ebɔrɛ gba nna ŋ keni a? 14To, kumo ere Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na gbagba e naaŋ sa anyi tɔɔnɛ. Kasuŋgurbia nɛ e maŋ nyi enyɛn ŋ ku so beeŋ di kedampo ŋ kurge ebinyɛn nseŋ nase mo ketre Immanuɛl. Kumo be kifito e la fanɛ Ebɔrɛ wɔ anyi kutɔ. 15Kebia na baŋ daŋ m pin asheŋ, nsaa nyi kelela nɛ kulubi, e beeŋ baa nuu kenyipochu nsaa ji mushoŋ. 16Ama pɔɛŋ nɛ loŋ be jemanɛ malɛ e fo, bewura anyɔ nɛ fee ŋana na be nsawule beeŋ mur a dese fuloŋ.
17Ama Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na beeŋ shin nɛ etɔrɔ damta nɛ a chɔ etɔrɔ kama nɛ a daŋ ba menyi so, yili jemanɛ nɛ Israɛl nɛ Juda be kuwurji barga to m ba fo kabre na, e ba fo nɛ fo basa nɛ fo tuto be laŋ to ebi kikɛ so. E beeŋ shin nɛ efuli nɛ baa tre Asiriya na be ewura gba e ba kɔ menyi kena.
18Loŋ be jemanɛ na kaŋ fo, Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na beeŋ foŋ kafoli nɛ k baa la tɔɔnɛ n sa Ijipt be efuli so be basa, nɛ b shi lɔrgboŋ nɛ baa tre Nail na ase m ba menyi so fanɛ ashushombi na. Kumo be kaman nɛ Asiriya be basa malɛ e shi bumo be kasawule so m ba menyi so fanɛ emushoŋ na. 19Baaŋ mel abar so n sɔ ataŋɛ chiŋgeliŋ to nɛ abeelaŋ to nɛ kupuŋ to kikɛ nɛ asɔbɔya be ejikpa kikɛ so n chena.
20Jemanɛ na kaŋ fo, Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na beeŋ ber wonjomu paa ashi lɔrgboŋ nɛ baa tre Yufreetes na be kaba ndoŋ m ba she menyi be ntɔl nɛ menyi be amu nɛ eyur so be afuibi. Mo e naaŋ baa la Asiriya be efuli so be ewurgboŋ na.
21Ade be kaman, nɛ edɔpo ko kaŋ tiŋ n wora ania n nya mbe kena fɔlbi koŋwule ŋko mboe anyɔ ko n yige, 22kumo ere asɔbɔya na beeŋ baa sa mo kenyipochu damta ga nɛ e bɔla amo so n nya kusɔ kama nɛ e bee sha. Kashenteŋto, basa gbrɛbi nɛ baaŋ ji efute nseŋ ka a wɔ kasawule na so na beeŋ nya kenyipochu nɛ mushoŋ a ji.
23Jemanɛ na kaŋ fo, ewi nɛ egɔnnyaŋɛ beeŋ sɔ ndibi sɔrso be adɔ lelaana nɛ amo to be kekama kɔ ewaindibi nɛ a fo kagboŋ nɛ amo be amansherbi beeŋ fo fanɛ gbiti be ndarbi kagboŋ na kikɛ to. 24Saŋɛ na so basa beeŋ baa ta ata nɛ atanyembi a luri amo to a mɔ asɔbɔya. Kashenteŋto, ewi nɛ egɔnnyaŋɛ beeŋ sɔ efuli na kikɛ so. 25Ewidibi be yiri yiri beeŋ kɔr n sɔ apreŋsawule kama nɛ men daa dɔ so nɛ esa kikɛ maaŋ naŋ yɔ amo so. A beeŋ ki mboŋ nɛ ana nɛ mbolpɔ beeŋ baa ji.”

english_text:
A Warning and a Hope
1The Lord said, “Isaiah, get something to write on. Then write in big clear letters the name, MAHER-SHALAL-HASH-BAZ. 2I will tell Uriah the priest and Zechariah son of Jeberechiah to serve as witnesses to this.”
3Sometime later, my wife and I had a son, and the Lord said, “Name him Maher-Shalal-Hash-Baz. 4Because before he can say ‘Mommy’ or ‘Daddy,’ the king of Assyria will attack and take everything of value from Damascus and Samaria.”
5The Lord spoke to me again and said:
6These people have refused the gentle waters of Shiloah and have gladly gone over to the side of King Rezin and King Pekah. 7Now I will send the king of Assyria against them with his powerful army, which will attack like the mighty Euphrates River overflowing its banks. 8Enemy soldiers will cover Judah like a flood reaching up to your neck.
But God is with us.
He will spread his wings
and protect our land.
9All of you foreign nations,
go ahead and prepare for war,
but you will be crushed.
10Get together and make plans,
but you will fail
because God is with us.
11The Lord took hold of me with his powerful hand and said:
I'm warning you! Don't act like these people. 12 Don't call something a rebellious plot, just because they do, and don't be afraid of something, just because they are. 13I am the one you should fear and respect. I am the holy God, the Lord All-Powerful! 14-15 Run to me for protection. I am a rock that will make both Judah and Israel stumble and break their bones. I am a trap that will catch the people of Jerusalem—they will be captured and dragged away.
Isaiah and His Followers
16My message and my teachings are to be sealed and given to my followers. 17 Meanwhile, I patiently trust the Lord, even though he is no longer pleased with Israel. 18 My children and I are warning signs to Israel from the Lord All-Powerful, who lives on Mount Zion.
19Someone may say to you, “Go to the fortunetellers who make soft chirping sounds or ask the spirits of the dead. After all, a nation ought to be able to ask its own gods 20what it should do.”
None of those who talk like that will live to see the light of day! 21They will go around in great pain and will become so hungry that they will angrily curse their king and their gods. And when they try to find help in heaven 22and on earth, they will find only trouble and darkness, terrible trouble and deepest darkness.
translation_text:
Anebi Aizaaya pibinyɛn ka la tɔɔnɛ n sa basa na be asheŋ
1Ndoŋ nna nɛ Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na kaŋɛ ma le: “Ta kusɔ sibɛso peŋgelembi n sibɛ le ŋ deŋi kumo so: ‘NYA MANAŊ N FUU ASƆ; NƐ NYA MANAŊ Ŋ KƆ N SUGE ASƆ.’ Sibɛ amo kananɛ esa kikɛ beeŋ tiŋ n wu ŋ kraŋ n deŋi kumo so. 2Meeŋ kaŋɛ Yuriya nɛ e la bɔrɛmatapo na nɛ Zakareya nɛ e la Jeberekiya pibinyɛn na nɛ b baa la eshɛdajipo nɛ esa beeŋ tiŋ n yirda bumo a laŋɛ kumo be kaplɛa so.”
3Kedaŋ maŋ chɛr ko nɛ ma eche di kedampo. E ka kurge an pibinyɛn nɛ Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na kaŋɛ le: “Nase mbe ketre ‘NYA MANAŊ N FUU ASƆ, NYA MANAŊ Ŋ KƆ N SUGE ASƆ.’ Ŋkpal manɛ so, 4pɔɛŋ nɛ kebia na e daŋ m pin ketre, m ma ŋko n tuto na, Asiriya be efuli so be ewura beeŋ ba kɔ n suge kusɔ lela nɛ k kɔ tɔnɔ kikɛ ashi Damaskɔs nɛ Samɛria n yɔ Siriya be efuli so.”
Asiriya be efuli so be ewurgboŋ ka bee ba be asheŋ
5Kede be kaman nɛ Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na naŋ kaŋɛ ma le: 6“Basa ere kini kechubɔr nɛ baa tre Shilowa na be nchu nɛ a bee shile yɛlyɛlbi na, nseŋ yɔ ewura Rezin nɛ ewura Pɛka be kaba so nɛ kagbenefuli. 7Ma, Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na, beeŋ shin nɛ Asiriya be ewurgboŋ nɛ mbe benapo kikɛ e ba kɔ Juda be basa. Asiriyaebi na beeŋ ba buu bumo so fanɛ Lɔrgboŋ nɛ baa tre Yufreetes na ka bɔlɔ n dii kumo be kepla kikɛ so na. 8Bedoŋ be benapo beeŋ ba sɔ Juda be efuli kikɛ so fanɛ lɔr to be nchu ka bɔlɔ n dii m muni kusɔ kama so na.”
Ebɔrɛ wɔ anyi kutɔ! E parga mbe aba to fanɛ kabuibi nna, a kuŋ kasawule na.
9Efuli pɔtɛana so ebi, men gama abar so kufuso! Menyi bumo nɛ men wɔ durnya be mboŋ wɔfɔ wɔfɔ e kaŋ asoe n nu nfe. Men bela ase nɛ kekɔ kena, ama men baa ŋana kufu! Kashenteŋto, men bela ase, ama men baa ŋana kufu! 10Men wora menyi be ŋkre! Ama amo alɛ maaŋ tiŋ n wora m bɔlɔ so. Menyeeŋ tiŋ m malga kusɔ nɛ menyee sha! Ama amo kikɛ la fuloŋ nna, ŋkpal manɛ so Ebɔrɛ wɔ anyi kutɔ.
Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na kaa fiɛ anebi na so be asheŋ
11Kumo be kaman nɛ Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na bɔla mbe eleŋgboŋ so n fiɛ ma so fanɛ n sa maa wora asheŋ fanɛ kananɛ basa na bee wora na. 12E yɛ: “Sa maŋ kaŋ tre kusɔ kama nɛ basa ere bee tre ŋkre lubi fanɛ k la ŋkre lubi. Fo alɛ e sa maa ŋana kusɔ ko ŋkpal b ka bee ŋana kumo so. 13Baa nyiŋi fanɛ ma, Enyɛnpetale Ebɔrɛ na du cheembi nna. N nawule e daga fanɛ fo baa ŋana ga nsaa sa ma bunyaŋ. 14Ŋkpal ma kecheembiya ka bee keta kufu so n du fanɛ kejembu gboŋ nɛ k pul nɛ basa bee fiti kumo a tɔr na nna. Ma alɛ naa du fanɛ kejigbelɛ nɛ k beeŋ pɛ Juda nɛ Israɛl be efuliana so nɛ Jerusalɛm to be basa nna. 15Basa damta beeŋ fiti kumo n tɔr m buri to nɛ bedamta e tɔr kejigbelɛ na to nɛ b pɛ bumo ŋ gberge bumo n yɔ.”
Anebi Aizaaya nɛ mbe bebɛsopo be asheŋ
16Menyi nɛ men la ma bebɛsopo ere daga fanɛ men baa kuŋ nsaa keta abɔya nɛ Ebɔrɛ ta n sa ma ere nɛnɛ. 17Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na ta mbe kumu nna ŋ ŋana mbe basa so, ama amo nɛ amo kikɛ ma ere kraŋ yirda mo nseŋ ta ma tama n wɔtɔ mo to nna.
18Ma nɛ mbia nɛ Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na sa ma na nde. Enyɛnpetale Ebɔrɛ nɛ mbe kuwurputi wɔ kebee nɛ baa tre Zayɔn na so na e shuŋi anyi fanɛ kasokpele be tɔɔnɛ n sa Israɛl be basa.
19Ama basa beeŋ kaŋɛ menyi fanɛ men yɔ bekpalpo nɛ belejipo nɛ baa gbar a jugeto na kutɔ n ya bishi so n nu abɔya nɛ a wɔtɔ. Baaŋ kaŋɛ le: “Basa bee yili bumo nɛ b wɔ ŋkpa to be katelamu to nna a bishi abɔya ashi ayoyu nɛ bubuni kutɔ.”
20Ndoŋ nna nɛ men kaŋɛ bumo le: “Men baa nu kusɔ nɛ Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na bee ŋini menyi nsaa maa nu a sa bekpalpo nɛ belejipo, ŋkpal manɛ so kusɔ nɛ baaŋ kaŋɛ menyi na maaŋ tiŋ n lara menyi ashi etɔrɔ to.
Kare maaŋ chɛ bekama nɛ baa malga le ere be ekama! 21Baaŋ ta ebesa damta a nite a kulti nɛ akoŋ e pɛ bumo ga hale nɛ b shoduu bumo be ewura nɛ agbirana agbo so. 22Baaŋ maŋ amu so ŋ keni esoso ŋko n to anishi ŋ keni kasawule, bumo alɛ maaŋ wu shɛŋ she etɔrɔ nɛ tentembiri. Tentembiri mina nɛ k bee da kufu ga na to nɛ baa yɔ.”

english_text:
1 But those who have suffered will no longer be in pain. The territories of Zebulun and Naphtali in Galilee were once hated. But this land of the Gentiles across the Jordan River and along the Mediterranean Sea will be greatly respected.
War Is Over
2 Those who walked in the dark
have seen a bright light.
And it shines upon everyone
who lives in the land
of darkest shadows.
3Our Lord, you have made
your nation stronger.
Because of you, its people
are glad and celebrate
like workers at harvest time
or like soldiers dividing up
what they have taken.
4You have broken the power
of those who abused
and enslaved your people.
You have rescued them
just as you saved your people
from Midian.
5The boots of marching warriors
and the blood-stained uniforms
have been fed to flames
and eaten by fire.
A Child Has Been Born
6A child has been born for us.
We have been given a son
who will be our ruler.
His names will be
Wonderful Advisor
and Mighty God,
Eternal Father
and Prince of Peace.
7 His power will never end;
peace will last forever.
He will rule David's kingdom
and make it grow strong.
He will always rule
with honesty and justice.
The Lord All-Powerful
will make certain
that all of this is done.
God Will Punish Israel
8The Lord had warned the people of Israel, 9and all of them knew it, including everyone in the capital city of Samaria. But they were proud and stubborn and said,
10“Houses of brick and sycamore
have fallen to the ground,
but we will build houses
with stones and cedar.”
11The Lord made their enemies attack them. 12He sent the Arameans from the east and the Philistines from the west, and they swallowed up Israel. But even this did not stop him from being angry, so he kept on punishing them. 13The people of Israel still did not turn back to the Lord All-Powerful and worship him.
14In one day he cut off their head and tail, their leaves and branches. 15Their rulers and leaders were the head, and the lying prophets were the tail. 16They had led the nation down the wrong path, and the people were confused. 17The Lord was angry with his people and kept punishing them, because they had turned against him. They were evil and spoke foolishly. That's why he did not have pity on their young people or on their widows and orphans.
18Evil had spread like a raging forest fire sending thornbushes up in smoke. 19The Lord All-Powerful was angry and used the people as fuel for a fire that scorched the land. They turned against each other 20like wild animals attacking and eating everyone around them, even their own relatives. But still they were not satisfied. 21The tribes of Ephraim and Manasseh turned against each other, then joined forces to attack Judah. But the Lord was still angry and ready to punish the nation even more.
translation_text:
B ka kurge ebi ko n sa anyi be asheŋ
1Ama basa nɛ b daŋ ji awurfoŋ na maaŋ naa wɔ ebesa to. Zɛbyulɔn nɛ Naftali be eyiriana be nsawule daŋ ji nyɔmɔ nna, ama echefoso kemaŋkura beeŋ ba kebonfu nɛ k yili Teku nɛ baa tre Mɛditerenia na be epeŋilarkpa be kaba so n dese n ya fo lɔr nɛ baa tre Jɔɔdan na, hale n ta n ya fo Galili be kasawule nɛ nnyamase tase so na so ebi so.
2Basa nɛ baa nite tentembiri to na
wu kefultogboŋ ko.
Kumo e la kebaanyi Ebɔrɛ na.
Kefultogboŋ na lar nna n fulto n yuu ekama
nɛ e wɔ kasawule nɛ k la
luwu be tentembiri mina na so so.
3Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ, fo shin nɛ
fo basa wora keshi n ti so;
fo alɛ nseŋ shin nɛ
bumo be ŋgbene fuli bumo.
Baa ji eyur kagbenefuliso
ashi kusɔ nɛ fo wora to nna,
fanɛ kananɛ basa
nɛ b teŋi ayu
be ŋgbene bee fuli bumo na,
ŋko fanɛ basa nɛ b kɔ
n suge asɔ kena to
nsaa barga amo to na.
4Ŋkpal manɛ so, fo e pɔɔ basa
nɛ b ta fo basa ŋ ki anya
a kɔrfɛ bumo
ŋkpal eleŋ nɛ b kɔ so na so.
Fo e kɔ n sɔ bumo
fanɛ kananɛ dra na fo mɔlga fo basa
ashi Midian be efuli so
be benapo be enɔ to na.
5Benapo nɛ b bɛ abar so a nite be asɛbtagboŋ
nɛ bumo be asɔbuuso
nɛ ŋklaŋ gbiti na kikɛ
beeŋ chɔɔ edɛ to m mur.
6Ebɔrɛ sa anyi ebi ko!
E sa anyi ebinyɛn!
Mo e naŋ baa la anyi
be ewura.
Baaŋ tre mo Mamachi be asoetojipo,
nɛ Ebɔrɛ Lempo nɛ Etuto nɛ e wɔtɔ Mbaanaayɔ nɛ
Kayurwushi be Ewurbi.
7Mbe kuwurji be eleŋgboŋ beeŋ baa wora keshi a ti so;
mbe kuwurji beeŋ baa kɔ kayurwushi jemanɛ kikɛ.
E beeŋ ji kuwura fanɛ
ewura Deevid be kanaŋ to be esa,
nseŋ shin nɛ mbe eleŋgboŋ
e baa yil kashenteŋ
nɛ kusɔ nɛ k daga so.
K beeŋ fara naniere
hale mbaanaayɔ.
Enyɛnpetale Ebɔrɛ na gbagba
e naŋ shin nɛ ade kikɛ e wora.
Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na ka beeŋ gberge Israɛl kusoe be asheŋ
8Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na tiŋ n fiɛ Israɛl be basa nɛ b la Jeekɔb be kaman to ebi na so. 9Bumo kikɛ, nɛ ekama nɛ e wɔ bumo be kadegboŋ nɛ baa tre Samɛria na nyi kumo be asheŋ. Ama b daŋ kpeŋ nna nsaa wu bumo be amu nseŋ daŋ kaŋɛ le: 10“Nwu nɛ an ta ebirkesi m pɔr na tɔr, ama anyeeŋ ta ajembu m pɔr n tal amo to. Elarbeŋ nɛ an ku ndibi nɛ baa tre sikamɔɔ n wora na buri to, ama anyeeŋ ku ndibi nɛ baa tre sida na be alela n wora elarbeŋ n tal amo to.”
11Ndoŋ nna nɛ Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na shin nɛ bumo doŋana kre m ba nɛ b ba kɔ bumo kena. 12Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na daŋ shin nna nɛ Siriya be benapo shi epeŋilarkpa nɛ Filisti be benapo malɛ shi epeŋitɔrkpa m bela ase m ba kɔ Israɛl be basa kena m mur bumo. Ama amo nɛ amo kikɛ Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na be agbo kra maŋ wushi. E kraa shin nɛ e gberge bumo kusoe nna n ti so.
13Enyɛnpetale Ebɔrɛ be kasogberge nɛ e sa Israɛl be basa na be kaman, b kra maŋ tuba m bɛta m ba mo kutɔ. 14Amoso kachɛ koŋwule nɛ Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na beeŋ ta ŋ gberge Israɛlebi na nɛ bumo be bejuŋkparpoana kusoe nseŋ mur bumo kikɛ kuraa. 15E beeŋ mur bumo be bewurjipoana nɛ bejuŋkparpoana nɛ anebiana nɛ b maa ji kashenteŋ na kikɛ. 16Basa nɛ baa juŋkpar basa ere shin nɛ b foe ekpa nna nseŋ mel to kikɛ. 17Amoso Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na maaŋ shin nɛ mbrantiɛfɔlbi na be ekama e nya n shile. Mo alɛ maaŋ wu bekulpoche nɛ amunibiana na be ekama kuwɔr. Ŋkpal manɛ so basa na kikɛ la amu kpakpaso wuraana nɛ b kini Ebɔrɛ nna. Bumo be malga kikɛ gba daa la asheŋ lubi be mmalga nna. Ama amo nɛ amo kikɛ, Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na be agbo kra maaŋ wushi. E kraa shin nɛ e gberge bumo kusoe n ti so nna.
18Basa na be kumu kpakpaso bee salga to fanɛ edɛ nɛ k bee chɔɔ kiyi a ji afitiri wɔlso a mur na nna. K du fanɛ edɛ ka ji kupo n loge nɛ edishi bee kaa na nna. 19Enyɛnpetale Ebɔrɛ na ka nya agbo so, mbe kasogberge bee chɔɔ nna fanɛ edɛ a mur basa na ashi kasawule na kikɛ so, nɛ k ki fanɛ ekama nɛ mbe kumu so be asheŋ nna na. 20Basa bee fuu ajibi kama nɛ b wu kenishiso nna a ji ashi efuli na be kaplɛkama, ama akoŋ kraa mɔ bumo. B daa daŋɛ bumo be mbia gba nna a we! 21Manase be yiri to be basa nɛ Efrayim be yiri to be basa daa kɔ abar nna nseŋ naa chɛ abar to a kɔ Juda be yiri to be basa kena. Ama amo nɛ amo kikɛ, Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na be agbo kra maaŋ wushi. E kraa shin nɛ e gberge bumo kusoe nna n ti so.

english_text:
1You people are in for trouble! You have made cruel and unfair laws 2that let you cheat the poor and needy and rob widows and orphans. 3But what will you do when you are fiercely attacked and punished by foreigners? Where will you run for help? Where will you hide your valuables? 4How will you escape being captured or killed? The Lord is still angry, and he isn't through with you yet!
The Lord's Purpose and the King of Assyria
5 The Lord says:
I am furious! And I will use the king of Assyria as a club 6to beat down you godless people. I am angry with you, and I will send him to attack you. He will take what he wants and walk on you like mud in the streets. 7He has even bigger plans in mind, because he wants to destroy many nations.
8The king of Assyria says:
My army commanders are kings! 9They have already captured the cities of Calno, Carchemish, Hamath, Arpad, Samaria, and Damascus. 10-11 The gods of Jerusalem and Samaria are weaker than the gods of those powerful nations. And I will destroy Jerusalem, together with its gods and idols, just as I did Samaria.
12The Lord will do what he has planned against Jerusalem and Mount Zion. Then he will punish the proud and boastful king of Assyria, 13who says:
I did these things by my own power because I am smart and clever. I attacked kings like a wild bull, and I took the land and the treasures of their nations. 14I have conquered the whole world! And it was easier than taking eggs from an unguarded nest. No one even flapped a wing or made a peep.
15King of Assyria, can an ax or a saw overpower the one who uses it? Can a wooden pole lift whoever holds it? 16The mighty Lord All-Powerful will send a terrible disease to strike down your army, and you will burn with fever under your royal robes. 17The holy God, who is the light of Israel, will turn into a fire, and in one day you will go up in flames, just like a thornbush. 18The Lord will make your beautiful forests and fertile fields slowly rot. 19There will be so few trees that even a young child can count them.
Only a Few Will Come Back
20A time is coming when the survivors from Israel and Judah will completely depend on the holy Lord of Israel, instead of the nation that defeated them. 21-22 There were as many people as there are grains of sand along the seashore, but only a few will survive to come back to Israel's mighty God. This is because he has threatened to destroy their nation, just as they deserve. 23The Lord All-Powerful has promised that everyone on this earth will be punished.
24Now the Lord God All-Powerful says to his people in Jerusalem:
The Assyrians will beat you with sticks and abuse you, just as the Egyptians did. But don't be afraid of them. 25Soon I will stop being angry with you, and I will punish them for their crimes. 26I will beat the Assyrians with a whip, as I did the people of Midian near the rock at Oreb. And I will show the same mighty power that I used when I made a path through the sea in Egypt. 27Then they will no longer rule your nation. All will go well for you, and your burden will be lifted.
28Enemy troops have reached the town of Aiath. They have gone through Migron, and they stored their supplies at Michmash, 29before crossing the valley and spending the night at Geba. The people of Ramah are terrified; everyone in Gibeah, the hometown of Saul, has run away. 30Loud crying can be heard in the towns of Gallim, Laishah, and sorrowful Anathoth. 31No one is left in Madmenah or Gebim. 32Today the enemy will camp at Nob and shake a threatening fist at Mount Zion in Jerusalem.
33But the Lord All-Powerful
will use his fearsome might
to bring down the tallest trees
and chop off every branch.
34With an ax, the glorious Lord
will destroy every tree
in the forests of Lebanon.
translation_text:
1Asheŋ maaŋ nyalɛ n sa menyi! Menyee wora mbra nɛ a kɔ ŋkpɛato nna nsaa bɔla amoso a nyaŋ ma basa a wɔtɔ a tɔrɔ bumo. 2Kananɛ menyee wora a maa ji kashenteŋ a sa betirpo nɛ basa nɛ asheŋ tir bumo ashi menyi be demujikpaana nseŋ naa suge bekulpoche nɛ amunibi be asɔ nna na. 3To, nɛ Ebɔrɛ bee gberge menyi kusoe, manɛ nɛ menyeeŋ wora? Nɛ e kaŋ shin nɛ efuli pɔtɛ ko so ebi shi kufɔ m ba nɛ b ba kɔ menyi kena m mur menyi, manɛ nɛ menyeeŋ wora? Nnɛ nɛ menyeeŋ shile n ya fin kechɛto ŋko nnɛ nɛ menyeeŋ ta menyi be mpetɛsɔ n ya ŋana? 4Baaŋ mɔ menyi kena to ŋko ŋ gberge menyi n yɔ kenyaya to. Ama amo nɛ amo kikɛ, Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na be agbo maaŋ wushi. E kraa beeŋ baa sha kegberge menyi kusoe n ti so.
Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na ka bɔla Asiriya be ewurgboŋ na so n wora asheŋ
5Ndoŋ nna nɛ Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na kaŋɛ: “N ta Asiriya fanɛ kaprɛ nna nɛ ŋ gberge basa nɛ n nya agbo n wɔtɔ na kusoe. 6N shuŋi Asiriyaebi nna fanɛ b ya kɔ efuli nɛ b kini ma n shin nɛ n nya agbo na kena. Ma e shuŋi bumo fanɛ b ya suge, nseŋ fuu bumo be asɔ eleŋso nsaa chichi bumo be basa so fanɛ agbembi so be depɔ na.”
7Ama Asiriya be ewurgboŋ na malɛ daa kɔ mo gbagba be nfɛragboŋ mbe kumu to nna. E daa sha kemur efuli damtaana nna. 8E daa puchi nna a kaŋɛ le: “Ma benapo be bejuŋkparpoana na be ekama la ewura nna! 9Ma e kɔ m pɔɔ ndegboŋ nɛ baa tre Kalno nɛ Kaakɛmish nɛ Hamaf nɛ Apad so. Ma koŋwule na e kɔ m pɔɔ Samɛria nɛ Damaskɔs so. 10-11Agbirana nɛ a wɔ Jerusalɛm nɛ Samɛria be ndegboŋ to na maŋ shi n fo amo nɛ a wɔ efuli lempoana na to so. Ma alɛ beeŋ mur Jerusalɛm nɛ agbirana kama nɛ a wɔ kumo to na fanɛ kananɛ n wora Samɛria na.”
12Kumo be kaman nɛ Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na kaŋɛ: “Ŋ kaŋ loge kusɔ nɛ mee wora kebee nɛ baa tre Zayɔn na so nɛ Jerusalɛm to, meeŋ gberge Asiriya be efuli so be ewurgboŋ kusoe ŋkpal mbe mpuchi nɛ kamoowu kikɛ so.”
13Asiriya be ewurgboŋ bee puchi nna a kaŋɛ le: “Ŋ gbagba be eleŋ so nɛ n wora ade kikɛ. Ma alɛ kɔ eleŋ nsaa nyi asheŋ nsaa kɔ kenyi ga. N du fanɛ gbolu kpenso nɛ e bee tɛ a yuu basa so nna a suge efuliana na be nsawule nɛ mpetɛsɔ na eleŋ so. 14Ma e kɔ m pɔɔ durnya kikɛ so na! Keshoŋi kabuibi be kesha to n lara afule gba du kpakpa a chɔ kekɔ kena m pɔɔ so. Efuliana na be kekama daa maŋ tiŋ ŋ kuŋ ma ekpa!”
15Ama le nɛ Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na kaŋɛ Asiriya be ewura na: “Kekpanfu ŋko kasaŋɛgboŋ beeŋ tiŋ ŋ kaŋɛ fanɛ kumo e chɔ esa nɛ e bee keta kumo a shuŋ na a? Dimɛdi e naa keta kaprɛ ŋko kaprɛ e naa keta dimɛdi?”
16Enyɛnpetale Ebɔrɛ na beeŋ shin nɛ kulɔ lubi e tɔr fo nɛ fo benapo so nseŋ shin nɛ fo eyur e bel edɛ fanɛ k ka bee suse ashi fo kuwurpiŋi to na. 17Ebɔrɛ cheembi nɛ e la Israɛl be kefulto na beeŋ kilgi fanɛ edɛ n shin nɛ fo suse so kachɛ koŋwule fanɛ kupuŋ wɔlso na. 18Kumo be kaman nɛ menyi be apo nɛ adɔsawule lelaana kikɛ e mur cheche fanɛ kananɛ kulɔ mɔso bee mur esa na. 19Ndibi nɛ a beeŋ ka na maaŋ naa shi. Kebibi gba beeŋ tiŋ ŋ karga amo.
Basa nɛ baaŋ bɛta m ba na be asheŋ
20Jemanɛ ko bee ba nɛ Israɛl nɛ Juda be basa nɛ baaŋ ji efute na maaŋ naŋ ta bumo be amu n deŋi efuli nɛ k daŋ ka gbrɛ nɛ k mur na so. Baaŋ ta bumo be amu n deŋi Enyɛnpe, Israɛl be Ebɔrɛ cheembi na so nna. 21-22Israɛlebi na daa shi nna ga fanɛ teku ase be eshishɛr, ama bumo to be gbrɛbi e naaŋ ji efute nseŋ bɛta m ba Israɛl be Ebɔrɛ lempo na kutɔ. Ŋkpal manɛ so, e daŋ yili kumo nna fanɛ e beeŋ mur bumo be efuli na, kumo be loŋ malɛ daga bumo nna. 23Kashenteŋto, Enyɛnpetale Ebɔrɛ na bɔ ntaŋ fanɛ e beeŋ gberge esa kama nɛ e wɔ efuli na so kusoe.
Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na ka beeŋ gberge Asiriya kusoe be asheŋ
24Ade kikɛ be kaman nɛ Enyɛnpetale Ebɔrɛ na kaŋɛ mbe basa nɛ b wɔ Jerusalɛm to na le: “Asiriya be basa na beeŋ kɔrfɛ menyi fanɛ kananɛ Ijiptebi daŋ wora na. Ama men sa maa ŋana bumo. 25K maaŋ chɛr nɛ ma agbo e wushi nɛ ŋ gberge Asiriyaebi kusoe m mur bumo cheche ŋkpal bumo be asheŋ lubi so. 26Ma, Enyɛnpetale Ebɔrɛ na gbagba e naaŋ ta ma kuchuchɔ ŋ kuya bumo so, fanɛ kananɛ n daŋ wora Midian be efuli so ebi ashi kefalta nɛ k wɔ kakpa nɛ baa tre Ɔrɛb na. Ma alɛ beeŋ ŋini ma eleŋgboŋ nɛ n daŋ ŋini nseŋ shin nɛ ekpa dese Teku Peper na to ashi Ijipt be efuli so na. 27Jemanɛ na kaŋ fo meeŋ shin nɛ men suge menyi be amu ashi Asiriya be eleŋgboŋ to nɛ b maaŋ naa ji menyi so kuwura a tɔrɔ menyi. Asheŋ beeŋ naŋ nyalɛ n sa menyi.”
28Bedoŋ be benapo na daŋ ba kɔ n suge kade nɛ baa tre Ai na. B daŋ bɔla Migrɔn nna, nseŋ daŋ yige bumo be asɔ nɛ ajibi ashi kakpa nɛ baa tre Mikmash na, 29pɔɛŋ nseŋ dii ketaŋɛ na n ya dese Gɛba ŋklade! Kufugboŋ ko daŋ tɔr basa nɛ b wɔ kade nɛ baa tre Rama na so nna, nɛ basa nɛ b wɔ Gibiya, nɛ k la Ewura Sɔɔl be kade to na, shile ŋ ka kade na. 30Esa beeŋ tiŋ n nu basa ka bee shu awɔrso ashi nde nɛ baa tre Gallim nɛ Laisha nɛ Anatɔf nɛ kagbenejija tɔr so na to. 31Basa nɛ b wɔ nde nɛ baa tre Madmɛna nɛ Gɛbiim na bee shile a mɔlga bumo be amu. 32Kabre bedoŋ na wɔ kade nɛ baa tre Nɔb na to nna m bɔɔ enɔ a fiɛ to a teŋi a ŋini Zayɔn be kebee nɛ k wɔ Jerusalɛm na.
33Ama Enyɛnpetale Ebɔrɛ na beeŋ shin nɛ b ber ase fanɛ b ka ku kedibi be keyabi nɛ k tɔr to na. Bumo to be bumo nɛ baa puchi ga nsaa maŋ bumo be amu so na nɛ e beeŋ da n lɛ nɛ b ji nyɔmɔ. 34Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na e naaŋ ku bumo n lɛ fanɛ kananɛ baa ta kekpanfu a ku ndibi ashi Lebanɔn be kupo to a lɛ na!

english_text:
Peace at Last
1 Like a branch that sprouts
from a stump,
someone from David's family
will someday be king.
2The Spirit of the Lord
will be with him
to give him understanding,
wisdom, and insight.
He will be powerful,
and he will know
and honor the Lord.
3His greatest joy will be
to obey the Lord.
This king won't judge
by appearances
or listen to rumors.
4The poor and the needy
will be treated with fairness
and with justice.
His word will be law
everywhere in the land,
and criminals
will be put to death.
5 Honesty and fairness
will be his royal robes.
6 Leopards will lie down
with young goats,
and wolves will rest
with lambs.
Calves and lions
will eat together
and be cared for
by little children.
7Cows and bears will share
the same pasture;
their young will rest
side by side.
Lions and oxen
will both eat straw.
8Little children will play
near snake holes.
They will stick their hands
into dens of poisonous snakes
and never be hurt.
9 Nothing harmful will take place
on the Lord's holy mountain.
Just as water fills the sea,
the land will be filled
with people who know
and honor the Lord.
God's People Will Come Back Home
10 The time is coming when one of David's descendants will be the signal for the people of all nations to come together. They will follow his advice, and his own nation will become famous.
11When that day comes, the Lord will again reach out his mighty arm and bring home his people who have survived in Assyria, Egypt, Pathros, Ethiopia, Elam, Shinar, Hamath, and the land along the coast. 12He will give a signal to the nations, and he will bring together the refugees from Judah and Israel, who have been scattered all over the earth. 13Israel will stop being jealous of Judah, and Judah will no longer be the enemy of Israel. 14Instead, they will get together and attack the Philistines in the west. Then they will defeat the Edomites, the Moabites, and the Ammonites in the east. They will rule those people and take from them whatever they want.
15 The Lord will dry up the arm of the Red Sea near Egypt, and he will send a scorching wind to divide the Euphrates River into seven streams that anyone can step across. 16Then for his people who survive, there will be a good road from Assyria, just as there was a good road for their ancestors when they left Egypt.
translation_text:
Kuwurgboŋ nɛ k kɔ kayurwushi na be asheŋ
1Kananɛ keyimu bee purge afantaŋ popɔr nɛ a bee daŋ a ki kedibi na, aloŋ nɛ esa ko beeŋ shi ewura Deevid be kanaŋ to m ba ki ewura kachako so.
2Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na be kiyoyu
e naŋ sa mo kanyiasheŋ
nɛ kashennyi nɛ kasheŋwora
be kenyi nɛ e ta n ji kuwura
mbe basa so nɛnɛ.
E beeŋ baa nyi
Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na
be aparsheŋ nsaa bunyaŋ mo.
3Kusɔ nɛ k beeŋ baa fuli mo kagbene ga
e naaŋ baa la kewora Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na kasonu.
Ewura ere maaŋ baa keni kananɛ esa du so,
ŋko a yili b yɛ b yɛ so a ji demu.
4Kashenteŋ be ekpa so
nɛ e beeŋ baa ji betirpo demu
nsaa kɔ a kuŋ bumo
nɛ b maaŋ tiŋ n wora shɛŋ
n sa bumo be amu na.
Kusɔ nɛ e beeŋ kaŋɛ kenishipereso na
beeŋ ki mbra ashi efuli na kikɛ so;
nɛ basa lubi malɛ e nya
luwu be kasogberge.
5Kashenteŋji nɛ keji asheŋ
nɛ amo be ekpa so
nɛ e beeŋ ta n ji kuwura
mbe basa so.
