6Ekuntuŋ nɛ mbolpɔ
beeŋ baa wɔ abar so
kayurwushi so,
nɛ ekarmɛ nɛ mboe fɔlbi
e baa tu abar a dese.
Anabi nɛ ebuluŋ be bibi
beeŋ baa gama abar so a ji,
nɛ mbiwurbi e baa keni
bumo so nsaa kpa bumo
a yɔ a ba.
7Eshishiri beeŋ baa tu abar a ji,
nɛ bumo be bibi e baa tu abar
a dese kayurwushiso.
Saŋɛ na so nɛ ebuluŋ
e baa ji afitiri fanɛ ana.
8Mbiwurbi beeŋ baa pɛl
ashi awɔ be amaŋ ase
nɛ a maaŋ duŋ bumo.
Baaŋ ta bumo be enɔana
n wɔtɔ awɔ lubi be amaŋ to
nɛ awɔ na maaŋ wora bumo shɛŋ.
9Kusɔ lubi kikɛ maaŋ naa wɔ
Ebɔrɛ be kebee cheembi
nɛ baa tre Zayɔn na so.
Kananɛ nchu bɔlɔ teku to na,
aloŋ nɛ basa nɛ b nyi
nsaa bunyaŋ Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na gba
beeŋ baa kaa shi kasawule na so.
Ebɔrɛ be basa ka beeŋ bɛta m ba epe be asheŋ
10Jemanɛ ko bee ba nɛ ewura popɔr nɛ e beeŋ shi ewura Deevid be kuwurji be kabuna na e baa la tɔɔnɛ n sa efuliana na. Baaŋ baa gama abar so mbe kuwurade to nsaa sa mo bunyaŋ. 11Loŋ be kachɛ na kaŋ fo, Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na beeŋ naŋ bɔla mbe eleŋgboŋ so m bɛta mbe basa nɛ b ka a wɔ efuliana nɛ baa tre Asiriya nɛ Ijipt nɛ Patrɔs nɛ Itiopia nɛ Ilam nɛ Babilɔn nɛ Hamaf nɛ teku ase be nsawule nɛ kepla so na m ba. 12Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na beeŋ maŋ tɔɔnɛ be tuta so ŋ ŋini efuliana na fanɛ e naa bɛta Israɛl nɛ Juda be basa nɛ b daŋ pesaŋ to a wɔ durnya be kaplɛkama na nna a ba. 13Israɛl be kuwurji maaŋ naa kɔ Juda be kuwurji kukɔrkɔ. Juda malɛ maaŋ naa la Israɛl mo doŋ. 14Baaŋ chɛ abar to ŋ kɔ Filistiebi nɛ b wɔ epeŋitɔrkpa na nseŋ suge basa nɛ b wɔ epeŋilarkpa na be asɔ eleŋso. Bumo alɛ beeŋ kɔ m pɔɔ Edɔm nɛ Mowab be basa so, nseŋ shin nɛ Ammɔn be basa e wora bumo kasonu. 15Kumo be kaman nɛ Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na e shin nɛ Teku Peper na be keyabi nɛ k mata Ijipt na e wɔlto nseŋ shin nɛ afu tushiso e ba shin nɛ lɔrgboŋ nɛ baa tre Yufreetes na gba e wɔlto ŋ ka mbombi wurbi ashunu nawule. Saŋɛ na so ekama beeŋ tiŋ n nite m bɔla kumo to n choŋ. 16Ekpagboŋ lela beeŋ dese n shi Asiriya be efuli so n sa mbe basa Israɛlebi nɛ b ji efute nseŋ ka a wɔ ndoŋ na nɛ b bɔla so, fanɛ kananɛ ekpa lela daa dese n sa bumo nanaana jemanɛ nɛ b daŋ lar Ijipt be efuli so na.

english_text:
A Song of Praise
1At that time you will say,
“I thank you, Lord!
You were angry with me,
but you stopped being angry
and gave me comfort.
2 I trust you to save me,
Lord God,
and I won't be afraid.
My power and my strength
come from you,
and you have saved me.”
3With great joy, you people
will get water
from the well of victory.
4At that time you will say,
“Our Lord, we are thankful,
and we worship only you.
We will tell the nations
how glorious you are
and what you have done.
5Because of your wonderful deeds
we will sing your praises
everywhere on earth.”
6Sing, people of Zion!
Celebrate the greatness
of the holy Lord of Israel.
God is here to help you.
translation_text:
Kapandi be kashɛ be asheŋ
1Kachako bee ba nɛ basa e boŋ kashɛ ŋ kaŋɛ le:
“Mee kpaŋ fo nna, Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ!
Fo daŋ nya agbo nna n wɔtɔ ma,
ama fo yige fo kanya agbo na
nsaa lɔlɔ ma.
2Ebɔrɛ e la ma emɔlgapo.
Meeŋ ta ma yirda n wɔtɔ mo to nsaa maa ŋana kufu.
Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na e naa sa ma eleŋ;
mo e mɔlga ma.
3Kananɛ esa nɛ achukoŋ kɔ be kagbene bee fuli nchu wushiso so na,
aloŋ nɛ Ebɔrɛ be basa be ŋgbene bee fuli bumo
jemanɛ nɛ e bee mɔlga bumo na.”
4Kachako bee ba nɛ basa e boŋ kashɛ ŋ kaŋɛ le:
“Ta kechɔrɔ n sa Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na!
Tre mo fanɛ e chɛ fo to!
Kaŋɛ efuliana na kusɔ nɛ e wora!
Kaŋɛ bumo kananɛ e shi be asheŋ!
5Boŋ kashɛ ŋ kpaŋ Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na
ŋkpal asheŋgboŋ nɛ e wora so.
Shin nɛ durnya kikɛ e nu baru na.
6Esa kama nɛ e wɔ Zayɔn to e boŋ kashɛ awɔrso;
ŋkpal manɛ so, Israɛl be Ebɔrɛ cheembi na shi ga,
nsaa wɔ mbe basa to a chɛ bumo to.”

english_text:
Babylon Will Be Punished
1 This is the message that I was given about Babylon:
2From high on a barren hill
give a signal, shout the orders,
and point the way
to enter the gates
of Babylon's proud rulers.
3The Lord has commanded
his very best warriors
and his proud heroes
to show how angry he is.
4Listen to the noisy crowds
on the mountains!
Kingdoms and nations
are joining forces.
The Lord All-Powerful
is bringing together
an army for battle.
5From a distant land
the Lord is coming
fierce and furious—
he brings his weapons
to destroy the whole earth.
6 Cry and weep!
The day is coming
when the mighty Lord
will bring destruction.
* 7All people will be terrified.
Hands will grow limp;
courage will melt away.
8Everyone will tremble with pain
like a woman giving birth;
they will stare at each other
with horror on their faces.
There Will Be No Mercy
9I, the Lord,
will show no mercy or pity
when that time comes.
In my anger I will destroy
the earth and every sinner
who lives on it.
10 Light will disappear
from the stars in the sky;
the dawning sun will turn dark,
and the moon
will lose its brightness.
11I will punish this evil world
and its people
because of their sins.
I will crush the horrible pride
of those who are cruel.
12Survivors will be harder to find
than the purest gold.
13I, the Lord All-Powerful,
am terribly angry—
I will make the sky tremble
and the earth shake loose.
14Everyone will run
to their homelands,
just as hunted deer run,
and sheep scatter
when they have no shepherd.
15Those men who are captured
will be killed by a sword.
16They will see their children
beaten against rocks,
their homes robbed,
and their wives abused.
17The Medes can't be bought off
with silver or gold,
and I'm sending them
to attack Babylonia.
18Their arrows will slaughter
the young men;
no pity will be shown
to babies and children.
The Lord Will Destroy Babylon
19 The city of Babylon
is glorious and powerful,
the pride of the nation.
But it will be like the cities
of Sodom and Gomorrah
after I, the Lord,
destroyed them.
20No one will live in Babylon.
Even nomads won't camp nearby,
and shepherds won't let
their sheep rest there.
21 Only desert creatures,
hoot owls, and ostriches
will live in its ruins,
and goats will leap about.
22Hyenas and wolves will howl
from Babylon's fortresses
and beautiful palaces.
Its time is almost up!
translation_text:
Ebɔrɛ ka beeŋ gberge Babilɔn kusoe be asheŋ
1Kubɔya nɛ Aizaaya nɛ e la Amɔz pibinyɛn na nya ashi Ebɔrɛ kutɔ a laŋɛ Babilɔn be kadegboŋ be kaplɛa so na nde.
2E yɛ, Aizaaya, yili kepreŋ nɛ shɛŋ maŋ wɔ kumo so na be awɔlto m maŋ kena be tuta so! Ponte ŋ kaŋɛ esoji na fanɛ b kre kena. Pla bumo enɔ fanɛ b kɔ n nya n luri mbunagboŋ lempo na to n ya kɔ Babilɔn be kadegboŋ na. 3N tre ma benapo lempoana nɛ b yirda bumo be amu n lar nɛ b ya kɔ kena ŋ gberge basa nɛ n nya agbo n wɔtɔ na kusoe.
4Men kaŋ asoe n nu, awɔr ka bee gbri abee so fanɛ jimaŋ damta na! K du fanɛ efuliana nɛ kuwurgboŋana e naa gama abar so! Enyɛnpetale Ebɔrɛ na e naa gama benapo abar so nɛ b kɔ kena. 5B shi efuli wɔfɔ wɔfɔ nɛ a wɔ durnya be lalaloge to nna a ba. Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na malɛ e kaa kagbene n ta mbe akɔsɔ a ba nɛ e ba mur Babilɔn be efuli kikɛ.
6Men baa boŋ to a shu awɔrso! Ŋkpal manɛ so, Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na be demuji be kachɛ na taga to. K la kachɛ nɛ Enyɛnpetale Ebɔrɛ na beeŋ shin nɛ basa e mur nna. 7-8Kufugboŋ beeŋ tɔr basa kikɛ so nɛ bumo be mbre e yulge bumo nɛ bumo be kenyɛn kikɛ e foe. Nɛ ebesagboŋ e tɔr ekama so fanɛ kakurge be ebesa ka tɔr eche nɛ e bee kurge so na. Anishinyɔr beeŋ pɛ bumo nɛ b kurgi amu n yuu to a maaŋ naŋ tiŋ ŋ keni abar be anishito. 9Loŋ be kachɛ na kaŋ fo, Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na maaŋ shu esa kikɛ so ŋko n wu esa kuwɔr. E beeŋ nya agbo ga nseŋ mur alubiworapoana n shin nɛ efuli na kikɛ e ki kiyitokpaŋ. 10Kefulto maaŋ naa wɔtɔ, ŋkpal manɛ so achɛkpabi nɛ a wɔ esoso na kikɛ beeŋ fulto ŋ gben nɛ epeŋi e pete nseŋ biri to nɛ kufɔl malɛ gba e fuli to ŋ gben.
11Ade be kaman nɛ Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ naŋ kaŋɛ le: “Meeŋ gberge efuli lubi ere nɛ kumo to be basa kusoe ŋkpal bumo be alubi so. Ma alɛ beeŋ bar ekama nɛ e bee maŋ mbe kumu so kaseto nseŋ gberge ekama nɛ e bee fɛ fanɛ e shi ga nsaa ŋini to, a kute a wɔtɔ basa ebesa to na kusoe. 12Loŋ be jemanɛ na basa gbrɛbi fimbi e naŋ ji efute. Kewu esa kenishiso beeŋ ba kaa du kpakpa a chɔ kewu shuwa. 13Kachɛ nɛ ma, Enyɛnpetale Ebɔrɛ na beeŋ ŋini kananɛ ma agbo du na, meeŋ shin nɛ esoso e baga to nɛ kasawule e gbuŋgbuŋ m pulgi ashi kumo be epul to.
14Kumo be kaman nɛ befɔ nɛ b wɔ Babilɔn be kadegboŋ to na e shile n yɔ bumo peana be nsawule so, n ya pesaŋ to n sɔ kaplɛkama fanɛ echibir ka wu ekpampo nsaa shile na ŋko fanɛ mbolpɔ nɛ a maŋ kɔ ekpapo na. 15Bekama malɛ nɛ baaŋ pɛ na, baaŋ da bumo etokobi m mɔ. 16Basa beeŋ baa yil a keni nɛ bedoŋ a pɛ bumo be mbia n ta bumo ŋ ŋmɛa afalta so m mɔ nseŋ luri bumo be elaŋana to n ta bumo be asɔ eleŋ so nseŋ pur bumo be beche gba n ti so.”
17Ade be kaman nɛ Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na naŋ kaŋɛ le: “Meeŋ we n wɔtɔ efuli nɛ baa tre Mɛdi na be basa nɛ b koso m ba kɔ Babilɔn be efuli so be basa kena. Bumo ere be shɛŋ maŋ wɔ shuwa nɛ gbiti to. 18Bumo be ata nɛ atanyembi nɛ baaŋ ta m mɔ mbrantiɛfɔlbi. B maaŋ wu mbi popɔrbi kuwɔr ŋko n shu mbiwurbi so. 19Babilɔn be kadegboŋ na e walɛ nsaa kɔ eleŋ a chɔ kadegboŋ kama. Kumo be basa bee puchi kumo so nna, ama ma, Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na beeŋ mur kumo fanɛ kananɛ m mur ndegboŋ nɛ b daa tre Sodɔm nɛ Gomɔra na! 20Esa kama maaŋ naa wɔ Babilɔn be kadegboŋ na to. Asɔbɔya belapo nɛ b maŋ kɔ epul na gba maaŋ naŋ yuu bumo be ewajɛbu ndoŋ. Mbolpɔkpapo gba maaŋ naŋ kpa bumo be mbolpɔ n yɔ ndoŋ nɛ b ya dese n wushi. 21Kadegboŋ na beeŋ ki kakpa nɛ kiyi to be asɔbɔya beeŋ baa wɔ, nɛ egbuŋgbula nɛ mbuibi be yiri yiri e tɔ asha ndoŋ. Kupuŋ to be asɔbɔya be yiri yiri beeŋ baa wɔ ndoŋ nɛ echibir e baa tɛ to a pɛl kumo to. 22Ekuntuŋ nɛ ejiŋkaamu beeŋ baa nite kadegboŋ na be ebu jeŋgreŋana nɛ a kɔ eleŋ ga na nɛ bewura be elambu nɛ a walɛ ga na to a shu. Ŋkpal manɛ so, Babilɔn be kemur be jemanɛ na fo.”

english_text:
The Lord's People Will Come Home
1The Lord will have mercy on Israel and will let them be his chosen people once again. He will bring them back to their own land, and foreigners will join them as part of Israel. 2Other nations will lead them home, and Israel will make slaves of them in the land that belongs to the Lord. Israel will rule over those who once governed and mistreated them.
Death to the King of Babylonia!
3The Lord will set you free from your sorrow, suffering, and slavery. 4Then you will make fun of the King of Babylonia by singing this song:
That cruel monster is done for!
He won't attack us again.
5The Lord has crushed the power
of those evil kings,
6who were furious
and never stopped abusing
the people of other nations.
7Now all the world is at peace;
its people are celebrating
with joyful songs.
8King of Babylonia,
even the cypress trees
and the cedars of Lebanon
celebrate and say,
“Since you were put down,
no one comes along
to chop us down.”
9The world of the dead
eagerly waits for you.
With great excitement,
the spirits of ancient rulers
hear about your coming.
10Each one of them will say,
“Now you are just as weak
as any of us!
11Your pride and your music
have ended here
in the world of the dead.
Worms are your blanket,
maggots are your bed.”
12 You, the bright morning star,
have fallen from the sky!
You brought down other nations;
now you are brought down.
13 You said to yourself,
“I'll climb to heaven
and place my throne
above the highest stars.
I'll sit there with the gods
far away in the north.
14I'll be above the clouds,
just like God Most High.”
15But now you are deep
in the world of the dead.
16Those who see you will stare
and wonder, “Is this the man
who made the world tremble
and shook up kingdoms?
17Did he capture every city
and make earth a desert?
Is he the one who refused
to let prisoners go home?”
18When kings die, they are buried
in glorious tombs.
19But you will be left unburied,
just another dead body
lying underfoot
like a broken branch.
You will be one of many
killed in battle and gone down
to the deep rocky pit.
20You won't be buried with kings;
you ruined your country
and murdered your people.
You evil monster!
We hope that your family
will be forgotten forever.
21We will slaughter your sons
to make them pay for the crimes
of their ancestors.
They won't take over the world
or build cities
anywhere on this earth.
22The Lord All-Powerful has promised to attack Babylonia and destroy everyone there, so that none of them will ever be remembered again. 23The Lord will sweep out the people, and the land will become a swamp for wild animals.
Assyria Will Be Punished
24 The Lord All-Powerful
has made this promise:
Everything I have planned
will happen just as I said.
25I will wipe out every Assyrian
in my country,
and I will crush those
on my mountains.
I will free my people
from slavery
to the Assyrians.
26I have planned this
for the whole world,
and my mighty arm
controls every nation.
27I, the Lord All-Powerful,
have made these plans.
No one can stop me now!
The Philistines Will Be Punished
28 This message came from the Lord in the year King Ahaz died:
29 Philistines, don't be happy
just because the rod
that punished you
is broken.
That rod will become
a poisonous snake, and then
a flying fiery dragon.
30The poor and needy will find
pastures for their sheep
and will live in safety.
But I will starve some of you,
and others will be killed.
31Cry and weep in the gates
of your towns,
you Philistines!
Smoke blows in from the north,
and every soldier is ready.
32If a messenger comes
from a distant nation,
you must say:
“The Lord built Zion.
Even the poorest of his people
will find safety there.”
translation_text:
Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na be basa ka beeŋ bɛta m ba epe be asheŋ
1Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na beeŋ naaŋ wu mbe basa Israɛlebi nɛ e lara n sa mbe kumu na kuwɔr. E beeŋ shin nɛ b bɛta bumo m ba bumo gbagba be kasawule so, nɛ befɔ e tu bumo n chena ndoŋ fanɛ bumo alɛ gba ka la Israɛlebi na. 2Efuli pɔtɛana so be basa beeŋ chɛ Israɛl be basa to nɛ b bɛta n yɔ kasawule nɛ Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na sa bumo na so. Efuli pɔtɛ ebi na beeŋ ya kaa shuŋ Israɛlebi na fanɛ anya, nɛ Israɛlebi na e naa ji kuwura basa nɛ b daa kɔrfɛ bumo na so.
Babilɔn be ewura ka beeŋ wu be asheŋ
3Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na beeŋ sɔ Israɛl be basa na n yige ashi ebesa nɛ awurfoŋ nɛ kenyaya to. 4E kaŋ wora loŋ n loge nɛ bumo alɛ e wora Babilɔn be efuli so be ewura eyur to nseŋ kaŋɛ le:
“Ewura nyaŋnyaŋso na e tɔr na!
E maaŋ naŋ tiŋ ŋ kɔrfɛ esa kikɛ!”
5-6Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na shin nɛ bewura lubiana nɛ baa nya agbo ga a kɔrfɛ basa nsaa tɔrɔ efuliana nɛ b kɔ m pɔɔ so na be eleŋgboŋana fo ekar.
7Naniere durnya na kikɛ nya ewushi nɛ kayurwushi,
nɛ ekama bee boŋ nshɛ kagbene fuli so.
8Ndibi kpakpaso fanɛ seprɛs nɛ Lebanɔn be efuli so be ndibi nɛ baa tre sida na,
e ji eyur ŋkpal Babilɔn be ewura ka tɔr
nɛ esa kama maŋ naa wɔtɔ
nɛ e naa ku amo a lɛ na so.
9Bumo nɛ b wɔ bubuni to wora shiriya nna a jo nɛ b keta Babilɔn be efuli so be ewura kefɔ. Bewura dra nɛ b ji eleŋ ga durnya to na ka nu mbe keba bumo kutɔ ashi bubuni to na be asheŋ, bumo be ŋgbene fuli nna. 10E kaŋ ba bumo kutɔ baaŋ kaŋɛ mo le: “Naniere fo alɛ gba pɔ fanɛ anyi! Fo ki anyi to be eko nna na! 11Ejaŋjilaŋ nɛ b daa ta a boŋ nshɛ a maŋkura fo, ama naniere fo e ba bubuni to na. Ashushombi e ki fanɛ fo kusɔ dese so nɛ echɔnchɔŋ malɛ ki fanɛ keta m buu fo so na.”
12Fo Babilɔn be efuli so be ewura nɛ fo du fanɛ kachipurso be kechɛkpabi na, shi ebɔrɛso n tɔr to kasawule so! Jemanɛ nɛ k choŋ na fo daŋ kɔ m pɔɔ efuliana so nna, ama naniere fo alɛ gba nɛ b kɔ m pɔɔ so na. 13Fo daŋ kre fo kagbene to nna fanɛ feeŋ dii n yɔ ebɔrɛso n ya baŋ achɛkpabi nɛ a wɔ awɔlto so na n ya chena ndoŋ a ji kuwura. Fo daa fɛ fanɛ feeŋ chena fanɛ ewura nna ashi kebee nɛ k wɔ kelargato be esoso be kakpa nɛ baa shɛr na. 14Fo yɛ feeŋ dii n yɔ awɔlpa be awɔlto n ya ki fanɛ Enyɛnpetale Ebɔrɛ na. 15Ama b gbelge fo n yɔ durnya be kaseto ashi bubuni to.
16Bubuni nɛ baaŋ wu fo na beeŋ pɛ nnɔ ŋ keta a keni fo, nseŋ bishi le: “Kanyɛn nɛ e gbuŋgbuŋ durnya nseŋ shin nɛ bewurgboŋana bee chicha kufuso na nde a? 17Kanyɛn nɛ e mur ndegboŋ nseŋ shin nɛ durnya ki fanɛ kiyitokpaŋ na nde a? Mo e daŋ kini keshin nɛ basa nɛ b pɛ kena to na e nya ekpa n yɔ bumo peana na a?”
18Durnya to be bewura kikɛ baaŋ wu baa pɔr bubuni be ebu ko nna a ta bumo a wɔtɔ to, 19ama fo ere maŋ kɔ loŋ be ebu ere. B ta fo kebuni nna n lɛ nɛ k dese m bɛ. Esoji e wu kena to n deŋi fo kebuni so nɛ b ta fo nɛ bumo kikɛ n wɔtɔ kefalta be kemaŋ to nseŋ gbare eshishɛr n deŋi so n chichi so. 20Fo ka shin nɛ efuli pɔtɛana ba mɔ fo basa nseŋ mur fo efuli so, b maaŋ puli fo fanɛ kananɛ baa puli bewuraana na. Fo kanaŋ lubi ere to be esa kama maaŋ ji efute a wɔ ŋkpa to. 21Anyeeŋ teŋ fo mbinyɛnsobi so ŋkpal bumo nananyɛnana be alubi so. Bumo be ekama maaŋ ji kuwura ŋko m pɔr ndegboŋ durnya be kaplɛkama.
Ebɔrɛ ka beeŋ mur Babilɔn be asheŋ
22Ade kikɛ be kaman, nɛ Enyɛnpetale Ebɔrɛ na naŋ kaŋɛ le: “Meeŋ kɔ Babilɔn be efuli so be basa nseŋ mur esa kama nɛ e wɔ ndoŋ, nɛ basa maaŋ naŋ nyiŋi bumo be asheŋ kikɛ. 23Meeŋ shin nɛ Babilɔn be efuli e ki ketaŋɛsawule a pete nchu nɛ egbuŋgbula e baa wɔ ndoŋ. Meeŋ lara kumo be basa ashi kumo so fanɛ b ka ta pese n fuge bumo na. Ma, Enyɛnpetale Ebɔrɛ na e kaŋɛ na.”
Ebɔrɛ ka beeŋ mur Asiriya be basa be asheŋ
24Kumo be kaman nɛ Enyɛnpetale Ebɔrɛ na bɔ ntaŋ ŋ kaŋɛ le: “Kusɔ nɛ n yili ma kagbene to fanɛ meeŋ wora na gbagba nɛ meeŋ wora. 25Meeŋ mur Asiriya be efuli so be basa ashi ma kasawule nɛ k la Israɛl be fuli na so nseŋ chichi bumo so ashi ma abee so. Ma alɛ beeŋ mɔlga ma basa ashi bumo be etɔrɔ kikɛ nɛ bumo be kebaala Asiriyaebi be anya to. 26Ŋkre nɛ ŋ kɔ n sa durnya to ebi nna na. Ma alɛ kraa shin nɛ ŋ gberge efuliana na kusoe nna.” 27Enyɛnpetale Ebɔrɛ na e yili kumo mbe kagbene to fanɛ e beeŋ wora ade kikɛ. Esa kikɛ malɛ maaŋ tiŋ ŋ kuŋ mo ekpa fanɛ e sa maŋ wora amo.
Ebɔrɛ ka beeŋ mur Filisti be basa be asheŋ
28Kafɛ nɛ Ewura Ahaz wu na nɛ kubɔya ere shi Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na kutɔ m ba: 29Filistiebi, men sa maŋ shin nɛ menyi be ŋgbene e fuli menyi ŋkpal kekpabi nɛ k bee gberge menyi kusoe na ka bu to so. Kekpabi butoso na beeŋ ki fanɛ kuwɔ lubi. Kumo be kaman nɛ k ki kusɔ gbeyeso nɛ k du fanɛ laŋchaŋ nɛ k kɔ mbuibi be aba a firgi na. 30Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na beeŋ baa keni betirpo nɛ b wɔ mbe basa Israɛlebi to so fanɛ kananɛ mbolpɔkpapo bee keni mbe mbolpɔ so na. E beeŋ shin nɛ b baa wɔtɔ nɛ shɛŋ maaŋ naa tɔrɔ bumo. Ama mo alɛ beeŋ shin nɛ akoŋgboŋ e tɔr menyi Filistiebi so nɛ menyi be ekama maaŋ pete.
31Menyi nɛ men wɔ Filisti be ndegboŋ to na e boŋ to n shu n fin kechɛto! Men kikɛ e baa chicha kufuso! Ŋkpal manɛ so, kalabɛr gboŋgboŋi nɛ k du fanɛ kuwɔlpa shi kelargato be esoso a ba. K yili n sa benapo nɛ efupo kikɛ maŋ wɔ bumo to nna.
32Nɛ fanɛ kabɔ ko shi Filisti be efuli so m ba menyi kutɔ, a daga fanɛ men kaŋɛ mo le: “Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na e pɔr Zayɔn, nɛ mbe basa to be etirpo gba e nya a wɔ ndoŋ nɛ shɛŋ maaŋ tɔrɔ mo.”

english_text:
Moab Will Be Punished
1 This is a message about Moab:
The towns of Ar and Kir
were destroyed in a night.
Moab is left in ruins!
2Everyone in Dibon has gone up
to the temple and the shrines
to cry and weep.
All of Moab is crying.
Heads and beards are shaved
because of what happened
at Nebo and Medeba.
3In the towns and at home,
everyone wears sackcloth
and cries loud and long.
4From Heshbon and Elealeh,
weeping is heard in Jahaz;
Moab's warriors scream
while trembling with fear.
Pity Moab
5I pity Moab!
Its people are running to Zoar
and to Eglath-Shelishiyah.
They cry on their way up
to the town of Luhith;
on the road to Horonaim
they tell of disasters.
6The streams of Nimrim
and the grasslands
have dried up.
Every plant is parched.
7The people of Moab are leaving,
crossing over Willow Creek,
taking everything they own
and have worked for.
8In the towns of Eglaim
and of Beerelim
and everywhere else in Moab
mournful cries are heard.
9The streams near Dimon
are flowing with blood.
But the Lord will bring
even worse trouble to Dimon,
because all in Moab who escape
will be attacked by lions.
translation_text:
Ebɔrɛ ka beeŋ mur Mowab be asheŋ
1Kubɔya nɛ k wɔtɔ a laŋɛ efuli nɛ baa tre Mowab na be kaplɛa so nde.
Kanyɛ koŋwule nɛ ndegboŋ nɛ baa tre Ar nɛ Kir na mur nɛ kakpa wora shruum ashi Mowab be kasawule so, ŋkpal shɛŋ ka maŋ naa wɔ kumo so so. 2Ndoŋ nna nɛ basa nɛ b wɔ kade nɛ baa tre Dibɔn na dii n yɔ kegbir ase ashi kebee so n ya shu ndoŋ. Mowab be basa daŋ shu kagbenejijaso nna ŋkpal ndegboŋ nɛ baa tre Nɛbo nɛ Mɛdiba na so. B daŋ she bumo be amu nɛ ntɔl kagbenejijaso gba nna. 3Basa nɛ b daa nite agbembi so na daŋ buu nli be asɔbuuso a ŋini bumo be ŋgbenejija nna, nɛ beko malɛ daa wɔ achoŋi nɛ alɔnɛ so a shu. 4Basa nɛ b wɔ nde nɛ baa tre Hɛshbɔn nɛ Ɛliale na daa shu awɔrso nna, nɛ esa wɔ kakpa wɔfɔ fanɛ Jahaz gba e daa nu bumo be kushu na. Bumo be esoji gba be kenyɛn kikɛ daŋ lar bumo to nna nɛ baa chicha kufuso. 5Mee shu ma kagbene to nna a sa Mowabebi na ŋkpal b kaa shile a yɔ nde nɛ baa tre Zowa nɛ Ɛglaf Shelishiya na so. Bumo be beko dii m bɔla ekpa nɛ k bee yɔ kade nɛ baa tre Luhif na nna a shu a yɔ, nɛ beko malɛ ŋana n ta kagbenejija a shu awɔrso a shile a yɔ kade nɛ baa tre Hɔronaim na. 6Mbombi nɛ a wɔ kakpa nɛ baa tre Nimrim na wɔlto nna nɛ ndoŋ be afitiri kikɛ wɔl. Kefitiri bumbuŋ kikɛ maŋ naa wɔ eboŋkarana na. 7Basa na daa wora ania nɛ b tiŋ n ta bumo be asɔ ŋ ŋana n dii ketaŋɛ na nna. 8Kagbenejija so be kushu baaŋ sɔ Mowab be kasawule kikɛ so nna nɛ esa beeŋ tiŋ n nu bumo be kushu ashi nde nɛ baa tre Eglaim nɛ Beerilim na to. 9Lɔr nɛ k wɔ kade nɛ baa tre Dibɔn na be nchu kikɛ kilgi ŋ ki ŋklaŋ nna. Ebɔrɛ malɛ kraa kɔ kusɔ nɛ k chɔ loŋ nɛ e wora basa nɛ b wɔ ndoŋ nna. Kashenteŋto, luwu kraa wɔtɔ a jo basa kama nɛ b ka a wɔ Mowab be efuli so na.

english_text:
More Troubles for Moab
1Send lambs as gifts
to the ruler of the land.
Send them across the desert
from Sela to Mount Zion.
2The women of Moab
crossing the Arnon River
are like a flock of birds
scattered from their nests.
3Moab's messengers say
to the people of Judah,
“Be kind and help us!
Shade us from the heat
of the noonday sun.
Hide our refugees!
Don't turn them away.
4Let our people live
in your country
and find safety here.”
Moab, your cruel enemies
will disappear;
they will no longer attack
and destroy your land.
5Then a kingdom of love
will be set up,
and someone from David's family
will rule with fairness.
He will do what is right
and quickly bring justice.
Moab's Pride Is Destroyed
6We have heard of Moab's pride.
Its people strut and boast,
but without reason.
7Tell everyone in Moab
to mourn for their nation.
Tell them to cry and weep
for those fancy raisins
of Kir-Hareseth.
8Vineyards near Heshbon
and Sibmah
have turned brown.
The rulers of nations
used to get drunk
on wine from those vineyards
that spread to Jazer,
then across the desert
and beyond the sea.
9Now I mourn like Jazer
for the vineyards
of Sibmah.
I shed tears for Heshbon
and for Elealeh.
There will be no more
harvest celebrations
10or joyful and happy times,
while bringing in the crops.
Singing and shouting are gone
from the vineyards.
There are no joyful shouts
where grapes were pressed.
God has silenced them all.
11Deep in my heart I hurt
for Moab and Kir-Heres.
12It's useless for Moab's people
to wear themselves out
by going to their altars
to worship and pray.
13The Lord has already said all of this about Moab. 14Now he says, “The contract of a hired worker is good for three years, but Moab's glory and greatness won't last any longer than that. Only a few of its people will survive, and they will be left helpless.”
translation_text:
Etɔrɔ damta ka beeŋ naŋ ba Mowab so be asheŋ
1Mowab be basa nɛ b wɔ kiyi to be kadegboŋ nɛ baa tre Sela na ta mbolpɔ fɔlbi n shuŋi n ya sa Jerusalɛm be ewura nna. 2Mowab be beche nɛ baa dii lɔr nɛ baa tre Aanɔn na du fanɛ mbuibi nɛ b jija bumo be asha to nna.
3Le nɛ Mowab be mbɔ na daŋ kaŋɛ Juda be basa na: “Men baa ŋini anyi kusɔ nɛ anyeeŋ baa wora. Men baa kuŋ anyi fanɛ kedibi be kiyoyul kapiidi, nseŋ shin nɛ an chena menyi be kayul to n wushi. An la basa nɛ b shile kena nna a mɔlga anyi be amu. Men ta anyi ŋ ŋana kakpa nɛ esa kikɛ maaŋ wu anyi. 4Men shin nɛ an chena menyi be kasawule so nɛ men baa kuŋ anyi ashi basa nɛ baa sha kemur anyi na kutɔ.”
Mowabebi, men doŋana nɛ b maa wu kuwɔr nsaa kɔrfɛ menyi na maaŋ naa wɔtɔ. B maaŋ naaŋ kɔ menyi m mur menyi be efuli. 5Kumo be kaman, Deevid be kaman to ebi to be eko beeŋ ba ki ewura nseŋ ta kashenteŋji nɛ kasha a keni basa so. E beeŋ nya manaŋ n wora kusɔ nɛ k daga nseŋ keni so n ji asheŋ nɛ amo be ekpa so. 6Ndoŋ nna nɛ Juda be basa na kaŋɛ: “An nu fanɛ Mowab be basa bee wu bumo be amu nna. An nyi fanɛ b la basa nɛ b kpeŋ nsaa keni basa jiga nna, ama mpuchi fuloŋ nɛ b kɔ.”
7Mowab be basa ere beeŋ shu anishichubi ŋkpal bumo be etɔrɔ nɛ a beeŋ tu bumo so. B kaŋ nyiŋi ajibi nɛ b daa ji ashi kadegboŋ nɛ baa tre Kir Hɛrɛs na, baaŋ shu anishichubi nɛ k wora bumo fanɛ tama kikɛ loge a laŋɛ bumo be kaplɛa so. 8Bumo be adɔ nɛ a mata Hɛshbɔn na nɛ ewaindibi be adɔana nɛ a wɔ Sibma na mur. Loŋ be adɔana na to be afeelebi be asɔrso nɛ b daa ta a wora yabra a sa efuli na so be bewura nɛ baa nu. Jemanɛ ko afeelebi na daŋ salga to loŋ hale n ya fo kadegboŋ nɛ baa tre Jaza, nɛ keshishɛrsawule so ashi epeŋilarkpa be kaba so, nɛ Teku Wuso na be kaba ndoŋ ashi epeŋitɔrkpa be kaba so nna. 9Naniere kananɛ mee shu anishichubi a sa Sibma be afeelebi na nɛ mee shu a sa Jaza gba peya. Ma anishichubi wurge nna ŋkpal shɛŋ ka maŋ naa wɔtɔ nɛ Hɛshbɔn nɛ Eliale be ndeana to ebi e teŋi nɛ bumo be ŋgbene fuli bumo so. 10Esa kama b kagbene maŋ fuli ŋkpal nsawule na ka maŋ naa wora adɔjibi ga na so. Esa kikɛ maa boŋ nshɛ ashi waindibi be adɔana to. Ekama maŋ naa nya afeelebi be asɔrso nɛ baa tre greeps na a wora nsa. Esa kama maŋ naa nu kagbenefuliso be awɔr gba kuraa. 11Ebesa bee ji ma nna ashi ma kagbene to nɛ mee shu a sa Mowab nɛ Kir Hɛrɛs. 12Mowab be basa bee gben jiga nna a yɔ bumo be agbir to ashi abee so nɛ agbirlambuana to n ya ka shuŋ amo. Tɔnɔ kikɛ maaŋ lar kumo to.
13Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na teŋ bɔ le be kubɔya ere a laŋɛ Mowab be kaplɛa so. 14Ama naniere le nɛ Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ naaŋ laŋɛ a kaŋɛ: “Ta a ba nfɛ asa be jemanɛ to gbagba Mowab be kedama damta nɛ kumo be basa na kikɛ beeŋ mur. Basa gbrɛbi ko e naŋ ji efute ashi kumo be basa damta na kikɛ to, bumo alɛ maaŋ baa kɔ eleŋ nɛ b tiŋ n chɛ bumo be amu to.”

english_text:
Damascus Will Be Punished
1 This is a message about Damascus:
Damascus is doomed!
It will end up in ruins.
2The villages around Aroer
will be deserted,
with only sheep living there
and no one to bother them.
3Israel will lose its fortresses.
The kingdom of Damascus
will be destroyed;
its survivors will suffer
the same fate as Israel.
The Lord All-Powerful
has promised this.
Sin and Suffering
4When that time comes,
the glorious nation of Israel
will be brought down;
its prosperous people
will be skin and bones.
5Israel will be like wheat fields
in Rephaim Valley
picked clean of grain.
6It will be like an olive tree
beaten with a stick,
leaving two or three olives
or maybe four or five
on the highest
or most fruitful branches.
The Lord God of Israel
has promised this.
7At that time the people will turn and trust their Creator, the holy God of Israel. 8They have built altars and places for burning incense to their goddess Asherah, and they have set up sacred poles for her. But they will stop worshiping at these places.
9Israel captured powerful cities and chased out the people who lived there. But these cities will lie in ruins, covered over with weeds and underbrush.
10Israel, you have forgotten
the God who saves you,
the one who is the mighty rock
where you find protection.
You plant the finest flowers
to honor a foreign god.
11The plants may sprout
and blossom
that very same morning,
but it will do you no good,
because you will suffer
endless agony.
God Defends His People
12The nations are a noisy,
thunderous sea.
13But even if they roar
like a fearsome flood,
God will give the command
to turn them back.
They will be like dust,
or like a tumbleweed
blowing across the hills
in a windstorm.
14In the evening
their attack is fierce,
but by morning
they are destroyed.
This is what happens to those
who raid and rob us.
translation_text:
Ebɔrɛ ka beeŋ gberge Siriya nɛ Israɛl kusoe be asheŋ
1Kusɔ nɛ Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na kaŋɛ a laŋɛ kadegboŋ nɛ baa tre Damaskɔs na be kaplɛa so nde. E yɛ: “Damaskɔs beeŋ ki kadegboŋ nɛ k bure a dese fanɛ b ka koli asɔ bureso n deŋi abar so na. 2Siriya be efuli so be ndegboŋ beeŋ ki nde nɛ ekama shile ka amo nɛ a dese fuloŋ. A beeŋ ki mbolpɔ nɛ ana be ejikpa nɛ esa kikɛ maaŋ baa ju amo a lar ndoŋ. 3Israɛl beeŋ paŋ kumo be ndegboŋana nɛ b pɔr egbal lempoana a kuŋ amo na nɛ Damaskɔs be kuwurgboŋ na malɛ e mur. Siriya be basa kama nɛ baaŋ ji efute na beeŋ ji anishinyɔr fanɛ Israɛl be basa. Ma, Enyɛnpetale Ebɔrɛ na e kaŋɛ.”
4Kumo be kaman nɛ Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na naŋ kaŋɛ le: “Kachako bee ba nɛ Israɛl be kemaŋkura nɛ keshi e ba ekar nɛ kumo be damawuraana e ki betirpo nseŋ nyɔr ŋ ki awibi nawule. 5Israɛl beeŋ ki fanɛ kudɔsawule nɛ b dɔ ayu n teŋi kumo so ashi ketaŋɛ nɛ baa tre Refaebi na to na. 6Basa gbrɛbi ko e naŋ ji efute nɛ Israɛl e ki fanɛ ɔlif be kedibi nɛ b chuge kumo so be asɔrso kikɛ nseŋ ka anyɔ ŋko asa ko ashi kumo be awɔlto ŋko asɔrso gbrɛbi ko ashi kumo be kaseto be ayabi so na. Ma, Enyɛnpe, Israɛl be Ebɔrɛ na e kaŋɛ na.”
7Loŋ be kachɛ na kaŋ fo, basa beeŋ bɛta n yɔ bumo be etopo nɛ e la Israɛl be Ebɔrɛ cheembi na kutɔ n ya fin kechɛto. 8B maaŋ naŋ ta bumo be yirda n deŋi agbirsure nɛ bumo gbagba pɔr na ŋko ndibi tenteŋ nɛ b yuu kakpa nɛ baa shuŋ kegbir cheso nɛ baa tre Ashira na, nsaa chɔɔ eduwu agbirsure so ndoŋ na so.
9Loŋ be kachɛ na kaŋ fo, baaŋ shile ŋ ka ndegboŋ nɛ b daa kuŋ nɛnɛ na nɛ a ki alambure a dese fanɛ ndegboŋ nɛ Hivi nɛ Amɔ be basa daŋ shile ŋ ka jemanɛ nɛ Israɛl be basa daa kɔ bumo kena nɛ baa shile a mɔlga bumo be amu na.
10Menyi Israɛlebi teŋ Ebɔrɛ nɛ e bee mɔlga menyi nsaa kuŋ menyi fanɛ kefalta gboŋ na so nna. Men dɔ atoto be adɔbi nna a shuŋ agbirana amo to. 11Ama nɛ aduuso na kɔr n daŋ nseŋ purge kachɛ nɛ men duu amo na kikɛ gba, men kraa maaŋ teŋi shɛŋ amo so, ama etɔrɔ nɛ ebesa nɛ a maaŋ ku nɛ menyeeŋ nya.
Ebɔrɛ ka beeŋ kɔ n sa mbe basa be asheŋ
12Efuliana nɛ a kɔ eleŋ ga na du fanɛ atiligboŋ nɛ a bee koso teku so a wora awɔrgboŋ na nna. 13Ama nɛ efuli lempoana bee ba eleŋso fanɛ atiligboŋ gba, Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na beeŋ ponte bumo so nɛ b bɛta fanɛ kalabɛr ka koso kebee ase ŋko kewabi nɛ kawuliwuli ta a yɔ na. 14Baa kɔ kenishipereso nna a ta kufu a pɛ basa kaaseso, ama ta a ba kachipurso nɛ b mur nsaa maŋ naa wɔtɔ. Kusɔ nɛ k bee tu bekama nɛ baa ta eleŋsheŋ a kɔ a suge anyi be asɔ nna na.

english_text:
Ethiopia Will Be Punished
1 Downstream from Ethiopia
lies the country of Egypt,
swarming with insects.
2Egypt sends messengers
up the Nile River
on ships made of reeds.
Send them fast to Ethiopia,
whose people are tall
and have smooth skin.
Their land is divided by rivers;
they are strong and brutal,
feared all over the world.
3Everyone on this earth,
listen with care!
A signal will be given
on the mountains,
and you will hear a trumpet.
4The Lord said to me,
“I will calmly look down
from my home above—
as calmly as the sun at noon
or clouds in the heat
of harvest season.”
5Before the blossoms
can turn into grapes,
God will cut off the sprouts
and hack off the branches.
6Ethiopians will be food
for mountain vultures
during the summer
and for wild animals
during the winter.
7Those Ethiopians are tall and their skin is smooth. They are feared all over the world, because they are strong and brutal. But at that time they will come from their land divided by rivers, and they will bring gifts to the Lord All-Powerful, who is worshiped on Mount Zion.
translation_text:
Ebɔrɛ ka beeŋ gberge Itiopia kusoe be asheŋ
1Efuli ko dese Itiopia be elɔrana be kaba ndoŋ nɛ baa tre kumo Ijipt, nɛ asɔ firgisobi shi ga ndoŋ nɛ esa beeŋ tiŋ n nu amo be kefergi be egbri. 2Ijipt bee shuŋi mbɔ nna nɛ baa ta nchu so be ekuloŋ nɛ b ta agasa n lɔŋɛ a nite lɔrgboŋ nɛ baa tre Nail na so, fanɛ b nya manaŋ n yɔ Itiopia nɛ kumo be basa wɔ nteŋ nɛ bumo be kayurwule du mɔlmɔlbi na. Elɔr shibi nna ashi Itiopia ebi ere be kasawule so nɛ b kɔ eleŋ nseŋ lubi ga nɛ ekama bee ŋana bumo ashi durnya kikɛ to.
3Esa kama nɛ e wɔ durnya ere to, e nu nfe! Tɔɔnɛ be tuta ko beeŋ baa wɔ abee be awɔlto nɛ men wu kumo nseŋ nu kabel be kushu! 4Kumo be kaman nɛ Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na kaŋɛ ma le: “Meeŋ baa wɔ ma pe ashi ebɔrɛso nsaa keni kaseto boeŋ fanɛ kapiidi be epeŋi ŋko awɔlpa nɛ a bee lar kasɔteŋi be jemanɛ ketarso na. 5Pɔɛŋ nɛ atoto beeŋ wora ŋ ki asɔrso na, Ebɔrɛ beeŋ shin nɛ a chuge n tɔr saŋɛ nɛ a bel na nseŋ shin nɛ ndibi sɔrso na be ayabiana na malɛ e buri n tɔr to. 6Itiopia be esoji na beeŋ ki keji n sa kebee so be ejita kechali so nsaa ki keji n sa kupuŋ to be asɔbɔya malɛ ketarso.”
7Itiopia be basa ere la basa tenteŋ nɛ bumo be kayurwule du mɔlmɔlbi nna. Ekama bee ŋana bumo durnya ere to nna, ŋkpal b ka kɔ eleŋ ga nseŋ lubi so. Ama loŋ be jemanɛ kaŋ fo, baaŋ shi bumo be kasawule nɛ elɔr shibi kumo so na so n ta esarga m ba sa Enyɛnpetale Ebɔrɛ nɛ baa shuŋ mo ashi Zayɔn be kebee so na.

english_text:
Egypt Will Be Punished
1 This is a message about Egypt:
The Lord comes to Egypt,
riding swiftly on a cloud.
The people are weak from fear.
Their idols tremble
as he approaches and says,
2“I will punish Egypt
with civil war—
neighbors, cities, and kingdoms
will fight each other.
3“Egypt will be discouraged
when I confuse their plans.
They will try to get advice
from their idols,
from the spirits of the dead,
and from fortunetellers.
4I will put the Egyptians
under the power of a cruel,
heartless king.
I, the Lord All-Powerful,
have promised this.”
Trouble along the Nile
5The Nile River will dry up
and become parched land.
6Its streams will stink,
Egypt will have no water,
and the reeds and tall grass
will dry up.
7Fields along the Nile
will be completely barren;
every plant will disappear.
8Those who fish in the Nile
will be discouraged
and mourn.
9None of the cloth makers
will know what to do,
and they will turn pale.
10Weavers will be confused;
paid workers will cry and mourn.
Egypt's Helpless Leaders
11The king's officials in Zoan
are foolish themselves
and give stupid advice.
How can they say to him,
“We are very wise,
and our families go back
to kings of long ago?”
12Where are those wise men now?
If they can, let them say
what the Lord All-Powerful
intends for Egypt.
13The royal officials in Zoan
and in Memphis
are foolish and deceived.
The leaders in every state
have given bad advice
to the nation.
14The Lord has confused Egypt;
its leaders have made it stagger
and vomit like a drunkard.
15No one in Egypt can do a thing,
no matter who they are.
16When the Lord All-Powerful punishes Egypt with his mighty arm, the Egyptians will become terribly weak and will tremble with fear. 17They will be so terrified of Judah that they will be frightened by the very mention of its name. This will happen because of what the Lord All-Powerful is planning against Egypt.
The Lord Will Bless Egypt, Assyria, and Israel
18The time is coming when Hebrew will be spoken in five Egyptian cities, and their people will become followers of the Lord. One of these cities will be called City of the Sun.
19In the heart of Egypt an altar will be set up for the Lord; at its border a shrine will be built to honor him. 20These will remind the Egyptians that the Lord All-Powerful is with them. And when they are in trouble and ask for help, he will send someone to rescue them from their enemies. 21The Lord will show the Egyptians who he is, and they will know and worship the Lord. They will bring him sacrifices and offerings, and they will keep their promises to him. 22After the Lord has punished Egypt, the people will turn to him. Then he will answer their prayers, and the Egyptians will be healed.
23At that time a good road will run from Egypt to Assyria. The Egyptians and the Assyrians will travel back and forth from Egypt to Assyria, and they will worship together. 24Israel will join with these two countries. They will be a blessing to everyone on earth, 25then the Lord All-Powerful will bless them by saying,
“The Egyptians are my people.
I created the Assyrians
and chose the Israelites.”
translation_text:
Ebɔrɛ ka beeŋ gberge Ijipt kusoe be asheŋ
1Kubɔya nɛ k wɔtɔ a laŋɛ Ijipt be efuli be kaplɛa so nde.
Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na bɔla kuwɔlpa so nna a ba Ijipt be efuli so manaŋ manaŋ. Kufu pɛ Ijipt be agbirana nna nɛ a bee chicha mbe anishito, nɛ kumo be basa malɛ be ŋgbene jija bumo ga nɛ b paŋ kenyɛn. 2Ndoŋ nna nɛ Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na kaŋɛ le: “Meeŋ shin nɛ kelantokɔ e ku Ijipt be efuli so nɛ bekurgepo e kilgi a kɔ abar nɛ bechenashapo malɛ gba e baa kɔ abar. Kadegboŋ ko beeŋ kɔ kuko kena nɛ kuwurgboŋ ko e kɔ kuwurgboŋ nyɔsopo kena. 3Ma alɛ beeŋ shin nɛ Ijiptebi be ŋkre e mel to nɛ bumo be ŋgbene e jija bumo nɛ b paŋ kenyɛn. Baaŋ ya fin kechɛto bumo be agbirana kutɔ nseŋ naaŋ yɔ belejipo kutɔ n ya bishi so a fin kenu kusɔ ko ashi bubuni kutɔ. 4Ma alɛ kraa beeŋ shin nɛ ewura nɛ e maa wu kuwɔr nsaa kute a wɔtɔ basa ebesa to na e ji kuwura bumo so. Ma, Enyɛnpetale Ebɔrɛ na e kaŋɛ na.”
5Lɔrgboŋ nɛ k wɔ Ijipt be efuli so nɛ baa tre kumo Nail na beeŋ wɔlto m baŋɛ to. 6Mbombi nɛ a bee shile a luri lɔrgboŋ na to na be nchu beeŋ bɛ a dufɛ nɛ Ijipt be efuli so maaŋ naa kɔ nchu nuuso. Agasa nɛ afitiri tenteŋ nɛ a yil lɔrkar na kikɛ beeŋ bolo n wɔl. 7Ndoŋ nna nɛ adɔsawule nɛ a dese m mata Nail be lɔrgboŋ na be asɔduuso kikɛ e wu nɛ afu e ber amo n ya lɛ nɛ kusɔduuso kikɛ maaŋ naa wɔ adɔsawule na so. 8Bekama nɛ baa pɛ ekɔrɔtɔ Nail be lɔrgboŋ na to a nya kusɔ jiso na beeŋ shu kagbenejijaso, ŋkpal manɛ so, bumo be edariwa nɛ ashewu maaŋ naa kɔ tɔnɔ n sa bumo. 9Bekama malɛ nɛ baa lue ewajɛ lela na beeŋ ki chaam a wɔtɔ, a maaŋ naa nyi kusɔ nɛ baaŋ wora, 10nɛ kagbenejija e tɔr basa nɛ baa lue kɔrɛ nɛ basa nɛ baa shuŋ a sɔ kakɔka so.
11Ijipt be ewura be benimuana nɛ b wɔ kadegboŋ nɛ baa tre Zowan na la bewulpo nna nsaa sa mo kawuliso be kasotoji. Amoso nuso nɛ baaŋ naŋ tiŋ n wora ŋ kaŋɛ ewura na le: “An nyi asheŋ ga. An shi dra dra na be bewura to be kanaŋ to nna!” 12Ijipt be ewura, nnɛ nɛ fo asoetojipo nyiashempoana na wɔ? Ashere baaŋ tiŋ ŋ kaŋɛ fo nfɛra nɛ Enyɛnpetale Ebɔrɛ na kɔ a laŋɛ Ijipt be kaplɛa so. 13Benimuana nɛ b wɔ Zowan nɛ Mɛmfis na la bewulpo nna. Bumo e daŋ daga fanɛ b juŋkpar efuli na, ama b sa basa kasotoji lubi nɛ k shin nɛ efuli na be basa foe ekpa. 14Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na e shin nɛ b sa kasotoji nɛ k wul Ijiptebi na to nɛ baa wora kusɔ kama a foe ekpa nsaa nite a jante fanɛ esa kaa nuu nsa m boo na. 15Esa kikɛ ashi Ijipt be efuli so maaŋ tiŋ n wora shɛŋ n chɛ to, k maŋ tir ŋko esa na la damawura nna ŋko etirpo.
Ijiptebi ka beeŋ shuŋ Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na be asheŋ
16Jemanɛ ko bee ba nɛ Ijipt be basa e paŋ kenyɛn fanɛ beche na. B baŋ wu fanɛ Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na bee sha kegberge bumo kusoe nɛ kufugboŋ e tɔr bumo so nɛ b baa chicha. 17Baaŋ fara a ŋana Judaebi ga. Hale nɛ b baŋ nu ketre Juda na gba, kufu bee pɛ bumo nna nɛ b baa chicha ŋkpal kusɔ nɛ Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na bee kre a laŋɛ Ijipt be kaplɛa so so.
18Loŋ be jemanɛ na kaŋ fo basa beeŋ baa gbar Hibruw be ŋgbar ashi Ijipt be efuli so be ndegboŋ anu to. Basa na beeŋ baa bɔ ntaŋ ashi Enyɛnpetale Ebɔrɛ na be ketre to. Ndegboŋ na be kuko be ketre e naŋ baa la Epeŋi be Kadegboŋ.
19Kumo be kaman nɛ basa na e pɔr bɔrɛsure n sa Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na ashi Ijipt be kasawule so nseŋ naŋ yuu kanyiŋi be ajembu ashi Ijipt nɛ efuli pɔtɛana be egbaŋ to n sa mo. 20Ade kikɛ beeŋ baa nyiŋi Ijiptebi na fanɛ Enyɛnpetale Ebɔrɛ na wɔ bumo kutɔ. Nɛ b kaŋ luri asheŋ to nseŋ kule Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na a fin kechɛto, e beeŋ shin nɛ esa ko e ba kɔ m mɔlga bumo ashi bumo doŋana be enɔ to. 21Kede be kaman nɛ Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na e lara mbe kumu ŋ ŋini Ijiptebi na, nɛ bumo alɛ e pin mo nsaa shuŋ mo. Baaŋ baa lara bumo be esarga nɛ ŋkɛ be yiri kikɛ a sa mo nsaa wora a bɔlɔ nnɔ nɛ b nase n sa mo so. 22Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na kaŋ gberge Ijiptebi na kusoe n loge, baaŋ bɛta m ba mo kutɔ. Kumo be kaman nɛ e nu bumo be kabɔrɛkule nseŋ shin nɛ Ijiptebi na e nya kechɛ.
23Nɛ loŋ be jemanɛ na kaŋ fo, kegbembi lela gboŋgboŋi beeŋ dese n shi Ijipt n ya fo Asiriya. Saŋɛ na so efuli anyɔ ere be basa beeŋ baa yɔ abar be efuliana na so a ba nsaa tu abar a shuŋ Ebɔrɛ. 24Israɛl beeŋ ti efuli anyɔ ere so, nɛ bumo nɛ Ijipt nɛ Asiriya e baa la nɛfa n sa durnya kikɛ. 25Ade kikɛ be kaman nɛ Enyɛnpetale Ebɔrɛ na e nɛfa bumo nseŋ kaŋɛ le: “Ijiptebi la ma basa nna. Ma e to Asiriyaebi nseŋ lara Israɛlebi fanɛ ŋ gbagba be basa.”

english_text:
Isaiah Acts Out the Defeat of Egypt and Ethiopia
1King Sargon of Assyria gave orders for his army commander to capture the city of Ashdod. 2About this same time the Lord had told me, “Isaiah, take off everything, including your sandals!” I did this and went around naked and barefoot 3for three years.
Then the Lord said:
What Isaiah has done is a warning to Egypt and Ethiopia. 4Everyone in these two countries will be led away naked and barefoot by the king of Assyria. Young or old, they will be taken prisoner, and Egypt will be disgraced. 5They will be confused and frustrated, because they depended on Ethiopia and bragged about Egypt. 6When this happens, the people who live along the coast will say, “Look what happened to them! We ran to them for safety, hoping they would protect us from the king of Assyria. But now, there is no escape for us.”
translation_text:
Ijipt nɛ Itiopia be kekɔ n tɔr be asheŋ
1Asiriya be efuli so be ewurgboŋ nɛ baa tre Saagɔn na e daŋ kaŋɛ mbe benapo be ejuŋkparpo fanɛ e ya kɔ n sɔ Filistiebi be kadegboŋ nɛ baa tre Ashdɔd na. 2Nfɛ asa pɔɛŋ nɛ loŋ wora na, Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na daŋ kaŋɛ Aizaaya nɛ e la Amɔz pibinyɛn na nna fanɛ e gbaŋ mbe asɛbta nɛ keeli be kusɔbuuso nɛ e daŋ buu na n nase. Ndoŋ nna nɛ e wora kasonu nseŋ gbaŋ amo kikɛ n nase nseŋ delge so a nite aya fuloŋ. 3B ka kɔ n sɔ Ashdɔd be kadegboŋ n loge na nɛ Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na kaŋɛ le: “Nfɛ nsa nna na nɛ ma keyɛrbi Aizaaya delge so a nite aya fuloŋ. Kusɔ nɛ k beeŋ wora Ijipt nɛ Itiopia nna na. 4Asiriya be ewurgboŋ na beeŋ delge basa nɛ e beeŋ pɛ kena to ashi efuli anyɔ na so n shin nɛ b nite aya fuloŋ n yɔ kenyaya to. Mbifɔlbi nɛ benimu kikɛ nɛ e beeŋ delge so n shin nɛ bumo be aperbi e baa dese, nɛ Ijiptebi e ŋaba. 5Ndoŋ nna nɛ bekama nɛ b ta bumo be yirda n deŋi Itiopia so nseŋ daa puchi Ijipt so na be nfɛra mel to nɛ b pɔ aba. 6Loŋ be jemanɛ na kaŋ fo, basa nɛ b wɔ Filisti be efuli so be teku be ekarso na beeŋ kaŋɛ le: ‘Keni kusɔ nɛ k wora basa nɛ an ta anyi be amu to so fanɛ b baa kuŋ anyi ashi Asiriya be ewurgboŋ be enɔ to na! Nuso nɛ anyi alɛ beeŋ wora n nya anyi be amu?’ ”

english_text:
The Fall of Babylonia
1This is a message about a desert beside the sea:
Enemies from a hostile nation
attack like a whirlwind
from the Southern Desert.
2What a horrible vision
was shown to me—
a vision of betrayal
and destruction.
Tell Elam and Media
to surround and attack
the Babylonians.
The Lord has sworn to end
the suffering they caused.
3I'm in terrible pain
like a woman giving birth.
I'm shocked and hurt so much
that I can't hear or see.
4My head spins; I'm horrified!
Early evening, my favorite time,
has become a nightmare.
5In Babylon the high officials
were having a feast.
They were eating and drinking,
when someone shouted,
“Officers, take your places!
Grab your shields.”
6The Lord said to me,
“Send guards
to find out
what's going on.
7When they see cavalry troops
and columns of soldiers
on donkeys and camels,
tell them to be ready!”
8Then a guard said,
“I have stood day and night
on this watchtower, Lord.
9 Now I see column after column
of cavalry troops.”
At once someone shouted,
“Babylon has fallen!
Every idol in the city
lies broken on the ground.”
10Then I said, “My people,
you have suffered terribly,
but I have a message for you
from the Lord All-Powerful,
the God of Israel.”
How Much Longer?
11This is a message about Dumah:
From the country of Seir,
someone shouts to me,
“Guard, how much longer
before daylight?”
12From my guard post, I answered,
“Morning will soon be here,
but night will return.
If you want to know more,
come back later.”
13This is a message for Arabs who live in the barren desert in the region of Dedan:
You must order your caravans
14to bring water for those
who are thirsty.
You people of Tema
must bring food
for the hungry refugees.
15They are worn out and weary
from being chased by enemies
with swords and arrows.
16The Lord said to me:
A year from now the glory of the people of Kedar will all come to an end, just as a worker's contract ends after a year. 17Only a few of their warriors will be left with bows and arrows. This is a promise that I, the Lord God of Israel, have made.
translation_text:
Babilɔn be ketɔr be asheŋ
1Kubɔya nɛ k wɔtɔ a laŋɛ Babilɔn be efuli so be kaplɛa so na nde.
Kananɛ kawuliwuli bee koso kiyi to a choŋ na nɛ kumulubi gboŋgboŋi nɛ k bee bar kemur na beeŋ shi efuli nɛ kumo be asheŋ kɔ kufugboŋ na so m ba. 2Ŋ ku bɔrɛdare n wu asheŋ ko nɛ a bee bar awurfoŋ basa so. Amo e la kedebɔr abar nɛ kemur abar be asheŋ.
Kaŋɛ Elam be efuli nɛ Mediya be efuli so be benapo fanɛ b kre kena m ba kulti Babilɔn be efuli so be ndegboŋana n wɔtɔ ŋ kɔ bumo kena! Ŋkpal manɛ so, Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na bɔ ntaŋ fanɛ e beeŋ shin nɛ awurfoŋ nɛ Babilɔnebi bee shin nɛ efuli pɔtɛana so be basa bee ji na e ba ekar.
3Kusɔ nɛ n daŋ wu nseŋ nu bɔrɛdare na to na shin nna nɛ kufugboŋ ko nɛ ebesa fanɛ kakurge be ebesa luri ma to. 4Ndoŋ nna nɛ ma nfɛra wul ma to nɛ kufu pɛ ma ga nɛ mee chicha. N daa yɛlga fanɛ kaaseso e fo manaŋ nna nɛ ma eyur e wushi ma, ama kaaseso ka fo nɛ kusɔ nɛ k chɔ loŋ naŋ tu ma.
5N daŋ wu bɔrɛdare na to nna fanɛ benapo be benimuana na ka wora kejigboŋ a ji ashi Babilɔn be kadegboŋ na to. Jemanɛ nɛ baa ji nsaa nu na, nɛ esa ko ponte epul to ŋ kaŋɛ le: “Benimu, men koso! Ekama e ta mbe kebɛlso be kusɔ kuŋkumuso.”
6Ndoŋ nna nɛ Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na kaŋɛ ma le: “Shin nɛ esa ko e ya yili menyi be kadegboŋ na be egbal so a keni ekpa to nsaa kute kusɔ kama nɛ e wu k kaa bee ba. 7E kaŋ wu basa ka dii egbaŋɛ m bɛ abar so kenyɔ nyɔ, nɛ beko dii ekurma nɛ enyɔma m bɛ so a ba, e dara bumo ŋ keni nɛnɛ nseŋ kaŋɛ kadeebi nɛ b bela ase.”
8Ndoŋ nna nɛ esa nɛ e yil egbal na so a keni na kaŋɛ le: “Kapa nɛ kanyɛ kikɛ nɛ n yili nfe a dara a keni, ama m maŋ wu shɛŋ ka bee ba.” 9K maŋ chɛr ko nɛ esoji nɛ b dii egbaŋɛ m bɛ abar so kenyɔ nyɔ fara a ba.
Epul na to nɛ ekenipo na ponte awɔrso n sa baru nɛ egbaŋɛ diipo na bar ŋ kaŋɛ le: “Babilɔn be basa kɔ n tɔr! Agbirana nɛ b daa shuŋ na bure kuraa m pesaŋ to a dese kasawule.”
10Ndoŋ nna nɛ ma, Aizaaya kaŋɛ le: “Ma basa, Israɛlebi, men ji awurfoŋ fanɛ kananɛ baa bri adurbi kegoro so na, ama n teŋ kaŋɛ menyi baru lela nɛ n nu ashi Enyɛnpetale, Israɛl be Ebɔrɛ na kutɔ.” Edɔm be kaplɛa so be kubɔya be asheŋ
11Kubɔya nɛ k wɔtɔ a laŋɛ efuli nɛ baa tre Edɔm na be kaplɛa so nde.
Esa ko yili Edɔm be efuli so nna n tre ma m bishi le: “Ekenipo, saŋɛ mo nɛ kare beeŋ chɛ nɛ kaboŋ e fuli to?”
12Ndoŋ nna nɛ ŋ kaŋɛ mo: “K maaŋ chɛr nɛ kare e chɛ, ama kanyɛ kraa beeŋ naŋ biri. Nɛ fo kraa sha kenaŋ pin to n ti so, kumo ere fo naŋ bɛta m ba bishi to.”
Areebia be kaplɛa so be kubɔya be asheŋ
13Kubɔya nɛ k bee yɔ efuli nɛ baa tre Areebia na be basa kutɔ nde.
Menyi basa nɛ men wɔ kebonfu nɛ baa tre Dedan nɛ menyi be eyawujipoana bee dii enyɔma a ji yawu nsaa yuu bumo be ewajɛbu ashi Areebia be efuli so be kiyi to na, 14daga fanɛ men sa basa nɛ achukoŋ kɔ nɛ b ba menyi kutɔ na nchu nɛ b nuu. Menyi alɛ nɛ men wɔ kasawule nɛ baa tre Tɛma na, e sa basa nɛ b shile kena m ba menyi be efuli so, nɛ akoŋ kɔ bumo na ajibi. 15B la basa nɛ baa shile a mɔlga bumo be amu nna ashi bumo doŋana nɛ b ta etokobi nɛ atanyembi a ju a buu bumo so a fin kemɔ bumo na kutɔ nna.
16Kumo be kaman nɛ Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na kaŋɛ ma le: “Ta a ba fanɛ kafɛ be jemanɛ to gbagba, eyiri yiri nɛ b shi Areebia be kebonfu nɛ baa tre Kɛda na be kemaŋkura kikɛ beeŋ ba ekar, fanɛ kananɛ paawura be kushuŋ bee loge a ba ekar na. 17Bumo to be benapo nɛ baa ta ata a kɔ kena na e la basa nɛ b kɔ kenyɛn, ama bumo to be gbrɛbi e naaŋ ka a wɔ Kɛda be kebonfu to ndoŋ. Ma, Enyɛnpe Israɛl be Ebɔrɛ na e kaŋɛ na.”

english_text:
Trouble in Vision Valley
1This is a message about Vision Valley:
Why are you celebrating
on the flat roofs
of your houses?
2Your city is filled
with noisy shouts.
Those who lie drunk
in your streets
were not killed in battle.
3Your leaders ran away,
but they were captured
without a fight.
No matter how far they ran,
they were found and caught.
4Then I said, “Leave me alone!
Let me cry bitter tears.
My people have been destroyed,
so don't try to comfort me.”
5The Lord All-Powerful
had chosen a time
for noisy shouts and confusion
to fill Vision Valley,
and for everyone to beg
the mountains for help.
6The people of Elam and Kir
attacked with chariots
and carried shields.
7Your most beautiful valleys
were covered with chariots;
your cities were surrounded
by cavalry troops.
8Judah was left defenseless.
At that time you trusted in the weapons you had stored in Forest Palace. 9You saw the holes in the outer wall of Jerusalem, and you brought water from the lower pool. 10You counted the houses in Jerusalem and tore down some of them, so you could get stones to repair the city wall. 11Then you built a large tank between the walls to store the water. But you refused to trust the God who planned this long ago and made it happen.
A Time To Weep
12When all of this happened,
the Lord All-Powerful told you
to weep and mourn,
to shave your heads,
and wear sackcloth.
13 But instead, you celebrated
by feasting on beef and lamb
and by drinking wine,
because you said,
“Let's eat and drink today!
Tomorrow we may die.”
14The Lord All-Powerful
has spoken to me
this solemn promise:
“I won't forgive them for this,
not as long as they live.”
Selfish Officials Are Doomed
15The Lord All-Powerful is sending me with this message for Shebna, the prime minister:
16Shebna, what gives you the right to have a tomb carved out of rock in this burial place of royalty? None of your relatives are buried here. 17You may be powerful, but the Lord is about to snatch you up and throw you away. 18He will roll you into a ball and throw you into a wide open country, where you will die and your chariots will be destroyed. You're a disgrace to those you serve.
19The Lord is going to take away your job! 20-21He will give your official robes and your authority to his servant Eliakim son of Hilkiah.
Eliakim will be like a father to the people of Jerusalem and to the royal family of Judah. 22 The Lord will put him in charge of the key that belongs to King David's family. No one will be able to unlock what he locks, and no one will be able to lock what he unlocks. 23The Lord will make him as firm in his position as a tent peg hammered in the ground, and Eliakim will bring honor to his family.
24His children and relatives will be supported by him, like pans hanging from a peg on the wall. 25That peg is fastened firmly now, but someday it will be shaken loose and fall down. Then everything that was hanging on it will be destroyed. This is what the Lord All-Powerful has promised.
translation_text:
Jerusalɛm be kaplɛa so be kubɔya be asheŋ
1Kubɔya nɛ k wɔtɔ a laŋɛ ketaŋɛ nɛ baa tre Ebɔrɛdare be Ketaŋɛ na be kaplɛa so nde.
Manɛ e naa wora? Manɛ nna nɛ basa nɛ b wɔ kadegboŋ na to bee ji eyur ashi bumo be achoŋi so? 2Awɔr e sɔ kadegboŋ na kikɛ to nɛ basa bee ji a nuu nsaa boŋ nshɛ a cha kaplɛkama.
Menyi be basa nɛ b wu kena ere to ere be ekama maa kɔ kena nna nseŋ wu. 3Menyi be bejuŋkparpoana kikɛ daŋ cha abar nna a shile nɛ b ya pɛ bumo kaplɛkama nɛ b shile n yɔ na, nɛ bumo alɛ maŋ tiŋ ŋ kɔ gbrɛbi kama gba nɛ b suge bumo be amu. 4Men yige ma nɛ n shu ga ŋkpal ma basa nɛ b wu na so. Men sa maŋ wora ania fanɛ menyeeŋ lɔlɔ ma. 5Le be jemanɛ ere la keyeŋiyeŋi nɛ kekɔ n tɔr nɛ kebagato be saŋɛ nna ashi Ebɔrɛdare be Ketaŋɛ na to. Enyɛnpetale Ebɔrɛ na malɛ e bar kumo anyi so. Anyi be kadegboŋ na be egbalana nɛ b da n lɛ nɛ ekama bee shu a fin kechɛto ashi abee so.
6Benapo shi Elam be kasawule so ŋ keta bumo be ata nɛ atanyembi nseŋ dii egbaŋɛ nɛ beko malɛ shi Kir be kasawule so ŋ keta bumo be abɛlso be asɔ kuŋamuso m ba. 7Ndoŋ nna nɛ egbaŋɛturko ba sɔ Juda be ataŋɛ to be adɔsawule lela kikɛ so nɛ esoji nɛ b tase egbaŋɛ so ba yili Jerusalɛm be mbunagboŋ be anishito kikɛ. 8Ndoŋ nna nɛ Juda be mboŋ lempo nɛ a bee kuŋ kumo na bure n tɔr.
Loŋ ka wora na, nɛ men ta menyi be yirda n deŋi akɔsɔ nɛ men ta n yili ewurkpa nɛ men pɔr n yili kupo to na so nseŋ ya bar amo. 9-10Menyi alɛ daŋ wu fanɛ Jerusalɛm be egbalana na be mboŋ ko daŋ daga kelɔnɛ m pɔr nna. Men daŋ keni ŋ keni nwu nɛ a wɔ Jerusalɛm to na to na kikɛ nseŋ bure amo be ako saŋɛ na so menyeeŋ nya ajembu n lɔŋɛ kadegboŋ na be egbalana na m pɔr. Men ka daa sha nchu so, 11men daŋ pɔr nchu be eyilikpa nna ashi kadegboŋ na to n sɔ nchu nɛ a shi kepa dra na to a ba na n yili. Ama men daŋ maŋ laŋɛ menyi be lakal Ebɔrɛ nɛ e kre ade kikɛ dra dra na kikɛ pɔɛŋ nɛ a bee wora ere bre so.
12Enyɛnpetale Ebɔrɛ na daŋ kaŋɛ menyi loŋ be kachɛ na fanɛ men baa shu anishichubi nsaa boŋ to awɔrso, nseŋ she menyi be amu m buu keeli be asɔbuuso. 13Ama men daa maŋ nu n sa Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na nsaa ji eyur. Men daŋ mɔ mbolpɔ nɛ ana nna a ji nsaa nuu yabra. Ade kikɛ be kaman nɛ men kaŋɛ le: “Men shin nɛ an ji nseŋ nuu kabre! Ŋkpal manɛ so echefo nɛ an wu n choŋ.”
14Ndoŋ nna nɛ Enyɛnpetale Ebɔrɛ na gbagba bɔ ntaŋ ŋ kaŋɛ ma le: “B maaŋ nya kulubi nɛ b wora ere be ketampaŋ ashi bumo be ŋkpa kikɛ to. Ma, Enyɛnpetale Ewurbɔrɛ na e kaŋɛ na.”
Shebna be kasokpele be asheŋ
15Ade kikɛ be kaman nɛ Enyɛnpetale Ebɔrɛ na kaŋɛ ma fanɛ n yɔ kanyɛn nɛ baa tre Shebna nɛ e la ewurkpa be nyɛrbi na kikɛ be enimu na kutɔ n ya kaŋɛ mo le: 16“Wanɛ nɛ fee fɛ fanɛ fo la? Manɛ e ba nɛ fo kur fo nchaŋ n nase kakpa nɛ baa puli bewura? 17Feeŋ tiŋ a la esagboŋ a kɔ eleŋ ga, ama Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na beeŋ fuu fo ŋ kpa n lɛ. 18E beeŋ bɔɔlɔ fo fanɛ bɔɔl ŋ kpa fo n lɛ efuli nɛ k shi ga so, kakpa nɛ feeŋ ya wu n dese m mata fo egbaŋɛturko nɛ fee puchi so na. Fo la ŋaba nna n sa fo nyɛnpe be laŋ to ebi. 19Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ beeŋ lara fo ashi fo eshuŋkpa be eyilikpa nɛ fo wɔtɔ to ere to m bar fo kaseto.”
20Ade be kaman nɛ Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na kaŋɛ Shebna le: “Nɛ loŋ kaŋ wora malɛ, meeŋ shin nɛ ma kayɛrbi Eliakim nɛ e la Hilkiya pibinyɛn e ba, 21nɛ n ta fo eshuŋkpa be piŋi nɛ kumo be kreso m mɛa mo to a ŋini basa fanɛ mo e sɔ fo so. Kumo be kaman nɛ e ki fanɛ etuto n sa Jerusalɛmebi kikɛ nɛ bekama nɛ b wɔ ewurkpa na. 22Ma, Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na beeŋ sa Eliakim eleŋ nɛ k bɛ ewura nɛ e shi Deevid be kanaŋ to peya so, saŋɛ na so kusɔ kama nɛ e yili, esa maaŋ tiŋ ŋ kini kumo; kusɔ kama malɛ nɛ e maŋ sa akpa, esa kikɛ maaŋ tiŋ n wora kumo. 23Meeŋ shin nɛ e baa yil to kpakpa fanɛ b ka gbir keyir kasawule to na. E beeŋ baa la esa nɛ mbe kanaŋ to ebi kikɛ beeŋ bɔla so n nya kemaŋkura.
24Ama mo kurgepoana nɛ mbe eyali kikɛ be kebaawɔtɔ beeŋ ba deŋ mo so nna fanɛ kananɛ baa ta mpuliya nɛ echeenshi a buu kelantaŋɛ to na! 25Naniere bre keyir na gbir kasawule to kpakpa nna na, ama kachako bee ba nɛ k gbuŋgbuŋ n tia n tɔr. Saŋɛ na so asɔ kama nɛ amo be egbɛ daa deŋ kumo so na gba beeŋ mur.” Kusɔ nɛ Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na kaŋɛ nna na.

english_text:
The City of Tyre Will Be Punished
1 This is a message from distant islands about the city of Tyre:
Cry, you seagoing ships!
Tyre and its houses
lie in ruins.
2Mourn in silence,
you shop owners of Sidon,
you people on the coast.
Your sailors crossed oceans,
making your city rich.
3Your merchants sailed the seas,
making you wealthy by trading
with nation after nation.
They brought back grain
that grew along the Nile.
4Sidon, you are a mighty fortress
built along the sea.
But you will be disgraced
like a married woman
who never had children.
5When Egypt hears about Tyre,
it will tremble.
6All of you along the coast
had better cry and sail
far across the ocean.
7Can this be the happy city
that has stood for centuries?
Its people have spread
to distant lands;
8its merchants were kings
honored all over the world.
Who planned to destroy Tyre?
9The Lord All-Powerful planned it
to bring shame and disgrace
to those who are honored
by everyone on earth.
10People of Tyre,
your harbor is destroyed!
You will have to become farmers
just like the Egyptians.
Tyre Will Be Forgotten
11The Lord's hand has reached
across the sea,
upsetting the nations.
He has given a command
to destroy fortresses
in the land of Canaan.
12The Lord has said
to the people of Sidon,
“Your celebrating is over—
you are crushed.
Even if you escape to Cyprus,
you won't find peace.”
13Look what the Assyrians have done to Babylonia! They have attacked, destroying every palace in the land. Now wild animals live among the ruins. 14Not a fortress will be left standing, so tell all the seagoing ships to mourn.
15The city of Tyre will be forgotten for 70 years, which is the lifetime of a king. Then Tyre will be like that evil woman in the song:
16You're gone and forgotten,
you evil woman!
So strut through the town,
singing and playing
your favorite tune
to be remembered again.
17At the end of those 70 years, the Lord will let Tyre get back into business. The city will be like a woman who sells her body to everyone of every nation on earth, 18but none of what is earned will be kept in the city. That money will belong to the Lord, and it will be used to buy more than enough food and good clothes for those who worship the Lord.
translation_text:
Tayɛ be kaplɛa so be kubɔya be asheŋ
1Kubɔya nɛ k wɔtɔ a laŋɛ kadegboŋ nɛ baa tre Tayɛ na be kaplɛa so nde.
Menyi nɛ menyee ta ekuloŋgboŋ a shuŋ nchu so e boŋ to awɔrso n shu ga! Ŋkpal manɛ so, kade nɛ menyee kaa ta menyi be ekuloŋ a gbuŋ kumo to nɛ baa tre Tayɛ na mur. Kumo to be nwu nɛ ekulonyilikpa kikɛ mur kuraa. Jemanɛ nɛ menyi be ekuloŋgboŋ shi kepla nɛ baa tre Saipres a ba na nɛ men nu ebaru na be asheŋ. 2Menyi eyawujipo nɛ men shi teku be ekarso be kade nɛ baa tre Sidɔn na e baa shu a wɔtɔ epunto ga. Men shuŋi mbɔ teku be kaba ndoŋ n ji yawu nɛ menyi be basa nɛ b wɔ kadegboŋ to na e dii kedama. 3Men shuŋi basa Ijipt be efuli so nɛ b ya tɔ ayu n laŋɛ n fa, nseŋ tu efuliana nɛ a ka na n ji yawu be yiri kikɛ.
4Sidɔn be kadegboŋ na du fanɛ kakpa lempo nɛ b pɔr n yili teku be ekarso nna. Ama fo alɛ beeŋ ji anishinyɔr fanɛ eche kilpo nɛ e maŋ kurge ŋ ku so na nna.
5Ijiptebi gba kaŋ nu fanɛ Tayɛ mur, k beeŋ chinchiŋ bumo nɛ kufu e pɛ bumo.
6Menyi nɛ men wɔ efuli nɛ baa tre Fenisha na e boŋ to awɔrso n shu ga nseŋ wora ania n shile n yɔ efuli nɛ baa tre Speen na! 7Kadegboŋ ere beeŋ tiŋ a la Tayɛ be kadegboŋ nɛ kagbenefuli daŋ bɔlɔ kumo to nɛ k jɔŋɛ dra dra na kikɛ a? Kadegboŋ nɛ k daa shuŋi kumo to be basa nɛ baa dii teku a yɔ efuli pɔtɛana so n ya ka ji kuwura bumo so na nde a? 8Wanɛ e kre le n deŋi Tayɛ so? Kumo be basa daŋ ji eleŋ ga nɛ kumo be eyawujipo malɛ daa la bewurbi nɛ basa daa maŋkura bumo ashi durnya to kikɛ. 9Enyɛnpetale Ebɔrɛ na e daŋ kre kumo fanɛ e beeŋ shin nɛ bumo be mpuchi nɛ baa puchi ŋkpal kusɔ nɛ b tiŋ n wora so na e ba ekar nɛ e ŋaba bumo be bunyaŋwuraana.
10Tayɛebi, men ya kaa dɔ menyi be kasawule na so fanɛ kananɛ Ijiptebi bee dɔ Nail be lɔrgboŋ na be ekarso na, ŋkpal manɛ so, menyi maŋ naa kɔ kakpa nɛ men baa yili menyi be ekuloŋgboŋana. 11Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na teŋi mbe enɔ to m baŋ teku so n ya shin nɛ kufugboŋ tɔr efuliana na so. Mo alɛ yili kumo nna fanɛ Fenisha be efuli so be ndegboŋ nɛ b pɔr egbal lempoana ŋ kulti na kikɛ beeŋ mur. 12Ade be kaman nɛ Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na kaŋɛ Sidɔn be basa na le: “Menyi be kayurji na fo ekar. Menyi alɛ mur nna na. Hale nɛ men ŋana n shile n yɔ Saipres be kepla so gba, men kraa maaŋ nya kayurwushi ndoŋ.”
13Keni kusɔ nɛ Asiriyaebi wora Babilɔn be efuli so be basa! B kre kena m ba gbare shishɛr n deŋi abar so nseŋ dii amo so n luri kadegboŋ na to ŋ kɔ kumo nseŋ mur kasawule na so be ewurkpa kikɛ. Naniere kupuŋ to be asɔbɔya lubi e wɔ kumo be alambure na to. 14Kakpa lempo nɛ k bee kuŋ efuli na kikɛ maŋ naŋ ka a yil, amoso kaŋɛ basa nɛ b wɔ ekuloŋgboŋ nɛ e wɔ teku so na kikɛ fanɛ b baa shu awɔrso kagbenejijaso. Ŋkpal manɛ so, kadegboŋ nɛ baa fute a yige so na kikɛ mur.
15Jemanɛ ko bee ba nɛ b teŋ Tayɛ be kadegboŋ so n ya fo nfɛ adushunu. Nfɛ nɛ ewura bee ji durnya to nna. Nfɛ adushunu ere be kaman, Tayɛ beeŋ ki fanɛ sakaleche nɛ kashɛ ere bee ji mbe asheŋ ere:
16Ta jaŋjilaŋ n nite ŋ kulti kade na kikɛ to,
fo sakaleche nɛ b teŋ fo so ere!
Baa laŋ kumo nsaa boŋ fo nshɛ nɛ fee sha ga na
nɛ fo basa e naŋ nyiŋi fo asheŋ nseŋ bɛta m ba.
17Nfɛ adushunu na be kaman, Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na beeŋ naŋ shin nɛ Tayɛ e bɛta n yɔ mbe kayawuji dra na to. Kadegboŋ na beeŋ baa du fanɛ eche nɛ e bee fa mbe kumu a sa enyɛn kikɛ ashi durnya to be efuli kama so nna, 18ama asɔ kama nɛ e beeŋ nya na be kekama maaŋ nya n yili kadegboŋ na to. Amansherbi na beeŋ baa la Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na peya nɛ bekama nɛ baa shuŋ mo na e ta amo n tɔ ajibi damta nɛ asɔbuuso lela nɛ baa sha.

english_text:
The Earth Will Be Punished
1The Lord is going to twist the earth out of shape and turn it into a desert. Everyone will be scattered, 2including ordinary people and priests, slaves and slave owners, buyers and sellers, lenders and borrowers, the rich and the poor. 3The earth will be stripped bare and left that way. This is what the Lord has promised.
4The earth wilts away;
its mighty leaders melt
to nothing.
5The earth is polluted
because its people
disobeyed the laws of God,
breaking their agreement
that was to last forever.
6The earth is under a curse;
its people are dying out
because of their sins.
7Grapevines have dried up:
wine is almost gone—
mournful sounds are heard
instead of joyful shouts.
8No one plays tambourines
or stringed instruments;
all noisy celebrating
has come to an end.
9They no longer sing
as they drink their wine,
and it tastes sour.
10Towns are crushed and in chaos;
houses are locked tight.
11Happy times have disappeared
from the earth,
and people shout in the streets,
“We're out of wine!”
12Cities are destroyed;
their gates are torn down.
13Nations will be stripped bare,
like olive trees or vineyards
after the harvest season.
Praise the God of Justice
14People in the west shout;
they joyfully praise
the majesty of the Lord.
15And so, everyone in the east
and those on the islands
should praise the Lord,
the God of Israel.
16From all over the world
songs of praise are heard
for the God of justice.
But I feel awful,
terribly miserable.
Can anyone be trusted?
So many are treacherous!
There's No Escape
17Terror, traps, and pits
are waiting for everyone.
18If you are terrified and run,
you will fall into a pit;
if you crawl out of the pit,
you will get caught in a trap.
The sky has split apart
like a window thrown open.
The foundations of the earth
have been shaken;
19the earth is shattered,
ripped to pieces.
20It staggers and shakes
like a drunkard
or a hut in a windstorm.
It is burdened down with sin;
the earth will fall,
never again to get up.
21On that day the Lord
will punish the powers
in the heavens
and the kings of the earth.
22He will put them in a pit
and keep them prisoner.
Then later on,
he will punish them.
23Both the moon and sun will
be embarrassed and ashamed.
The Lord All-Powerful will rule
on Mount Zion in Jerusalem,
where he will show its rulers
his wonderful glory.
translation_text:
Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ ka beeŋ gberge durnya kusoe be asheŋ
1Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na bee sha kejija durnya kikɛ nna nɛ k dese fuloŋ fanɛ kiyitokpaŋ na. E beeŋ melgi durnya na m buu nseŋ pesaŋ kumo be basa to. 2Kesheŋ koŋwule na e naaŋ tu bɔrɛmatapoana nɛ bumo be basa, nɛ anya nɛ bumo nyɛnpeana, nɛ basa nɛ baa tɔ nɛ bumo nɛ baa fa asɔ, nɛ basa nɛ baa paŋ asɔ nɛ bumo nɛ baa ta asɔ a paŋ basa, nɛ damawuraana nɛ betirpo kikɛ. 3Durnya na beeŋ jija nseŋ mur kuraa. Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na e kaŋɛ; kumo alɛ beeŋ wora loŋ. 4Kasawule wɔl a baŋɛ to, nɛ durnya kikɛ ki kakpa nɛ basa nɛ b kɔ eyilikpa nɛ bumo nɛ b maŋ kɔ eyilikpa kikɛ wu m bɛ. 5Edimɛdi jija durnya nna ŋkpal b ka kini kewora Ebɔrɛ be mbraana kasonu so. Bumo alɛ maŋ naa sa bumo nɛ Ebɔrɛ be kɔnɔkoŋwule be ŋkre nɛ k daga fanɛ k baa wɔtɔ mbaanaayɔ na bunyaŋ. 6Amoso Ebɔrɛ sho durnya na kɔnɔ nna nɛ kumo to be basa bee wu ŋkpal bumo be alubi so. 7Ewaindibi bee wu nna nɛ yabra be asheŋ bee ki kpakpa. Esa kama nɛ mbe kagbene daa fuli mo wɔ kagbenejija to naniere nna. 8Kagbenefuliso be nshɛ nɛ b daa laŋ ejaŋjilaŋ nɛ ŋkure a boŋ na kikɛ kuu. 9Basa maŋ naa nuu yabra nsaa boŋ nshɛ kagbenefuliso. Yabra gba maŋ naa wora basa ebel 10Kebagato e sɔ ndeana na kikɛ to nɛ basa ber bumo be amu so n wɔtɔ ebuana to ŋkpal kufu so. 11Kagbenefuli foe durnya to nɛ basa bee ponte to agbembi so a kaŋɛ le: “Anyi maŋ naa kɔ yabra! Anyi maŋ naa kɔ yabra!” 12Ndegboŋana na kikɛ mur nɛ amo be mbunagboŋana buri to n tɔr. 13Kusɔ nɛ k beeŋ wora efuliana nɛ a wɔ durnya kikɛ to nna na. K beeŋ baa du fanɛ kasɔteŋi be jemanɛ nɛ b ŋeri ndibi kikɛ be asɔrso n lɛ nseŋ chuge waindibi be asɔrso koko na malɛ kikɛ na nna.
14Basa nɛ baaŋ ji efute bre beeŋ boŋ nshɛ kagbenefuliso nɛ bumo nɛ b wɔ epeŋitɔrkpa na e malga kananɛ Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na be keshi nɛ kemaŋkura du, 15nɛ bumo nɛ b wɔ epeŋilarkpa na malɛ e kpaŋ mo. Basa nɛ b wɔ teku be ekarso na malɛ gba beeŋ fur Enyɛnpe, Israɛl be Ebɔrɛ na. 16Anyeeŋ nu b kaa bee boŋ nshɛ a kpaŋ Israɛl nɛ k la efuli niŋiso na ashi durnya be mboŋ wɔfɔ wɔfɔ kikɛ.
Ama tama maŋ wɔtɔ n sa ma ere! Ma ere be asheŋ jija n loge nna na! Bedebɔrpo kraa wɔtɔ nna a debɔr basa, nɛ bumo be kedebɔre na malɛ bee daŋɛ so. 17Ekama e nu nfe! Kufugboŋ nɛ amaŋ chiŋgeliŋ nɛ ajigbelɛ dese a jo menyi. 18Ekama nɛ e wora ania n shile kufugboŋ na beeŋ ya tɔr kemaŋ chiŋgeliŋ to, nɛ emo nɛ e gelge kemaŋ chiŋgeliŋ malɛ e ya tɔr kejigbelɛ to. Bɔrɛchu damta beeŋ shi awɔlpa so m ba kasawule so nɛ durnya be gbaltɔlase e gbuŋgbuŋ to. 19Kasawule beeŋ pante m baŋɛ to kaplɛkama. 20Kumo be kaman nɛ durnya na e baa lente fanɛ esa nɛ e boo nsa na, ŋko afugboŋ kaa bee ber kubuu so na. Durnya be alubi pɔɔ kumo so. Amoso k beeŋ mur nsaa maaŋ naaŋ tiŋ ŋ koso kikɛ.
21Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na beeŋ gberge esoso be eleŋana nɛ durnya to be bewuraana kusoe. 22Ebɔrɛ beeŋ gbargbar bewuraana n wɔtɔ kemaŋ gboŋ koŋwule to fanɛ basa nɛ b wɔ kabuti to na. E beeŋ ti bumo so loŋ hale nɛ bumo be kasogberge be saŋɛ e ya fo ekar. 23Kufɔl beeŋ biri to nɛ epeŋi e nyaŋɛ ŋ gben, ŋkpal manɛ so, Enyɛnpetale Ebɔrɛ na e la ewura. Zayɔn be kebee na so nɛ e beeŋ baa wɔ nsaa ji Jerusalɛm so kuwura nɛ basa na be benimuana e wu mbe kemaŋkura.

english_text:
A Prayer of Thanks to God
1You, Lord, are my God!
I will praise you
for doing the wonderful things
you had planned and promised
since ancient times.
2You have destroyed the fortress
of our enemies,
leaving their city in ruins.
Nothing in that foreign city
will ever be rebuilt.
3Now strong and cruel nations
will fear and honor you.
4You have been a place of safety
for the poor and needy
in times of trouble.
Brutal enemies pounded us
like a heavy rain
or the heat of the sun at noon,
but you were our shelter.
5Those wild foreigners struck
like scorching desert heat.
But you were like a cloud,
protecting us from the sun.
You kept our enemies from singing
songs of victory.
The Lord Has Saved Us
6On this mountain
the Lord All-Powerful
will prepare for all nations
a feast of the finest foods.
Choice wines and the best meats
will be served.
7Here the Lord will strip away
the burial clothes
that cover the nations.
8 The Lord All-Powerful
will destroy the power of death
and wipe away all tears.
No longer will his people
be insulted everywhere.
The Lord has spoken!
9At that time, people will say,
“The Lord has saved us!
Let's celebrate.
We waited and hoped—
now our God is here.”
10 The powerful arm of the Lord
will protect this mountain.
The Moabites will be put down
and trampled on like straw
in a pit of manure.
11They will struggle to get out,
but God will humiliate them
no matter how hard they try.
12The walls of their fortresses
will be knocked down
and scattered in the dirt.
translation_text:
Kekpaŋ Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na be asheŋ
1Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ,
fo e la ma Ebɔrɛ;
Meeŋ maŋkura fo
nseŋ kpaŋ fo ketre.
Fo e wora emamachisheŋ
nɛ a bee mɔ kɔnɔ;
fo alɛ e ta kashenteŋji
n shin nɛ fo ŋkre nɛ fo wora
dra na kikɛ bɔlɔ so.
2Fo e shin nɛ ndegboŋana bure ŋ ki alambure
nɛ amo be ekuŋkpa lempoana mur.
Ewurkpaana nɛ an doŋana pɔr na
mur hale mbaanaayɔ.
3Basa nɛ b wɔ efuli lempoana so beeŋ kpaŋ fo;
nɛ bumo nɛ b wɔ ndegboŋana nɛ a wɔ efuliana
nɛ b maa wu kuwɔr na to
e ŋana fo.
4Betirpo nɛ basa nɛ b maaŋ tiŋ
n chɛ bumo be amu to
shile m ba buu fo
etɔrɔ be jemanɛ
nseŋ nya bumo be amu.
Fo e kuŋ bumo ashi bɔrɛfugboŋ to
nseŋ sa bumo kayul epeŋi
nyaŋnyaŋso so.
Bedoŋ nɛ b maa wu kuwɔr
kre m ba fanɛ gbaŋgbaŋ to
be afugboŋ,
5ŋko ewule ashi kasawule wɔlso so nna.
Ama fo Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na
shin nɛ an doŋana
lo bumo be nnɔ;
nseŋ shin nɛ basa
nɛ b maa wu kuwɔr
be awɔr kuu,
fanɛ kananɛ awɔlpa to be epeŋi
be ebeldɛ bee dugaso na.
Ebɔrɛ ka bela kejigboŋ ase be asheŋ
6Enyɛnpetale Ebɔrɛ na beeŋ bela ajibi lela nɛ asɔ nuuso belbelso be kejigboŋ ase n sa durnya to be efuliana kikɛ so ebi ashi kebee nɛ baa tre Zayɔn na so ashi Jerusalɛm. 7Kebee ere so nɛ Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na beeŋ lara kagbenejija nɛ k du fanɛ awɔlpa a buu efuliana na kikɛ so na. 8Enyɛnpetale Ebɔrɛ na beeŋ mur luwu mbaanaayɔ! E beeŋ kpra anishichubi ashi ekama be anishito nseŋ lara ŋaba nɛ mbe basa ji ashi durnya kikɛ to na ashi bumo so. Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na gbagba e kaŋɛ.
9Jemanɛ na kaŋ fo, ekama beeŋ kaŋɛ le: “Mo e la anyi be Ebɔrɛ! An ta anyi be yirda n deŋi mo so, nɛ e mɔlga anyi. Mo e la Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na! An ta anyi be yirda n deŋi mo so, nɛ anyi be ŋgbene fuli nɛ an nya kagbenewushi ŋkpal e ka mɔlga anyi so.”
Ebɔrɛ ka beeŋ gberge Mowab kusoe be asheŋ
10Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na e naŋ kuŋ Zayɔn be kebee ere, ama e beeŋ chichi efuli nɛ baa tre Mowab na be basa so fanɛ ana ka chichi atuweklaŋ so n wɔtɔ depɔ to na. 11Baaŋ wora ania fanɛ baaŋ lar depɔ na to, ama Ebɔrɛ beeŋ wora bumo eyurto n shin nɛ b lar ŋ gben. 12E beeŋ shin nɛ Mowabebi na be kumɔlga be kakpa lempoana be egbal jeŋgreŋana e bure n tɔr ŋ ki fanɛ eshishɛr.

english_text:
A Song of Victory
1The time is coming when the people of Judah will sing this song:
“Our city is protected.
The Lord is our fortress,
and he gives us victory.
2Open the city gates
for a law-abiding nation
that is faithful to God.
3The Lord gives perfect peace
to those whose faith is firm.
4So always trust the Lord
because he is forever
our mighty rock.
5God has put down our enemies
in their mountain city
and rubbed it in the dirt.
6Now the poor and abused
trample all over that city.”
The Lord Can Be Trusted
7Our Lord, you always do right,
and you make the path smooth
for those who obey you.
8You are the one we trust
to bring about justice;
above all else we want
your name to be honored.
9Throughout the night,
my heart searches for you,
because your decisions
show everyone on this earth
how to live right.
10Even when the wicked
are treated with mercy
in this land of justice,
they do wrong and are blind
to your glory, our Lord.
11 Your hand is raised and ready
to punish them,
but they don't see it.
Put them to shame!
Show how much you care for us
and throw them into the fire
intended for your enemies.
12You will give us peace, Lord,
because everything we have done
was by your power.
13Others have ruled over us
besides you, our Lord God,
but we obey only you.
14Those enemies are now dead
and can never live again.
You have punished them—
they are destroyed,
completely forgotten.
15Our nation has grown
because of you, our Lord.
We have more land than before,
and you are honored.
The Lord Gives Life to the Dead
16When you punished our people,
they turned and prayed
to you, our Lord.
17Because of what you did to us,
we suffered like a woman
about to give birth.
18But instead of having a child,
our terrible pain
produced only wind.
We have won no victories,
and we have no descendants
to take over the earth.
19Your people will rise to life!
Tell them to leave their graves
and celebrate with shouts.
You refresh the earth
like morning dew;
you give life to the dead.
20Go inside and lock the doors,
my people.
Hide there for a little while,
until the Lord
is no longer angry.
The Earth and the Sea Will Be Punished
21The Lord will come out
to punish everyone on earth
for their sins.
And when he does,
those who did violent crimes
will be known and punished.
translation_text:
Ebɔrɛ ka beeŋ shin nɛ mbe basa e kɔ m pɔɔ so be asheŋ
1Kachako bee ba nɛ basa e boŋ kashɛ ere ashi Juda be kasawule so:
Anyi be kadegboŋ na kɔ eleŋ!
Ebɔrɛ gbagba e naa kɔ
a kuŋ kumo be egbalana!
2Men bugi kadegboŋ na
be mbunagboŋana na
n shin nɛ efuli nɛ k bee ji kashenteŋ
nɛ kumo be basa bee wora kusɔ nɛ k niŋi na e luri to.
3Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na e naa sa basa
nɛ bumo be yirda yil to kpakpa na
kayurwushi gbagba.
4Amoso an baa yirda Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na saŋkama,
nɛ e baa la fanɛ kefalta
a kuŋ anyi saŋkikɛ.
5Ebɔrɛ bar an doŋana
nɛ baa maŋ bumo be amu so na kaseto;
nseŋ mur kadegboŋ lempo
nɛ b daa wɔtɔ na,
nseŋ shin nɛ kumo
be egbalana bure
n tɔr kasawule.
6Naniere betirpo nɛ basa
nɛ bedoŋ na daa kɔrfɛ na
e naa chichi a chichi
kakpa nɛ kadegboŋ na
daa wɔ na so.
7Kusɔ nɛ k daga nɛ fo Enyɛnpe
Ebɔrɛ bee wora jemanɛ kikɛ,
nsaa shin nɛ ekpabi
bee ki fanɛ kegbembi
a sa basa nɛ baa wora
fo kasonu.
8Anyee bɛ fo aparsheŋ so nna
nsaa ta anyi be tama
a to fo so.
Fo nawule be ketre
nɛ anyee sha fanɛ
k baa nya kemaŋkura
ashi anyi be ŋgbene to.
9Kanyɛso kikɛ ma kagbene
bee kɔ a fin fo nna.
Fo baŋ ji durnya
nɛ kumo be basa demu,
bumo kikɛ beeŋ koya
kebaawɔtɔ ŋini so.
10Kuwɔr nɛ fo wu
kumu kpakpasowuraana ere
kikɛ be kaman,
b kraa maŋ naŋ koya
kewora kusɔ nɛ k daga.
Basa nɛ b niŋi gba
be kasawule so nfe
b kraa wora asheŋ lubi nna
nseŋ kini kewu fo,
Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na be kemaŋkura.
11Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ, fo doŋana
maŋ nyi fanɛ feeŋ gberge
bumo kusoe.
Shin nɛ b wu fanɛ
fee sha kebaachɛ fo basa to saŋkama nna,
nɛ anishinyɔr e pɛ bumo.
Shin nɛ edɛ nɛ fo bela ase a jo fo doŋana na
e chɔɔ bumo m mur.
12Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ,
fo e naaŋ sa anyi
kedamaya nɛ kayurwushi,
ŋkpal manɛ so,
kusɔ kama nɛ anyee wora,
fo eleŋ to nɛ anyee tiŋ
a wora kumo.
13Beko gba daŋ ji kuwura anyi so
n ti fo, Enyɛnpe
anyi be Ebɔrɛ na so,
ama fo nawule
nɛ anyee wora kasonu.
14Bumo kikɛ wu naniere
nsaa maaŋ naa wɔ ŋkpa to.
Bumo be abuniyoyu
maaŋ naŋ koso kikɛ,
ŋkpal fo ka gberge bumo kusoe nseŋ mur bumo so.
Esa maaŋ naŋ nyiŋi bumo kikɛ.
15Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ, fo e shin
nɛ anyi be basa wora keshi,
fo e kpalga anyi be efuli
be egbaŋ kaba kama so;
nɛ kumo be loŋ bar fo kemaŋkura.
16Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ, fo gberge
fo basa kusoe,
nɛ b ta kagbenejija nɛ kushu ŋ kule fo.
17Ŋkpal kusɔ nɛ fo wora
anyi na so,
an daŋ ji awurfoŋ fanɛ eche
nɛ kakurge ta mo nna.
18An daa wɔ ebesa damta to
nna fanɛ eche nɛ kakurge ta na,
ama anyi alɛ daa maŋ kurge.
An daa maŋ tiŋ ŋ kɔ m pɔɔ so kikɛ
ashi anyi be kasawule so;
anyi alɛ maŋ tiŋ n wora
ŋko n nya shɛŋ
n sa basa durnya to.
19Anyi be basa nɛ b wu na
beeŋ naŋ ba ŋkpa to!
Bumo be eyurana
beeŋ naŋ bɛta m ba ŋkpa to.
Bekama nɛ baa di
bumo be nchaŋana to na
beeŋ naŋ koso m boŋ nshɛ kagbenefuliso
Kananɛ kachipurso be bunyaŋ
bee shin nɛ nsawule
bee wushi na,
loŋ nɛ Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na
beeŋ naŋ tiŋi basa
nɛ b wu dra dra na.
20Ma basa, men luri
menyi be ebuana to
nseŋ ti menyi be amu so n wɔtɔ.
Men ŋana ndoŋ gbrɛbi,
n ya fo fanɛ Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na
be agbo ka beeŋ wushi.
21Keni, Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na
beeŋ shi ebɔrɛso
m ba gberge durnya to
be basa kusoe
ŋkpal bumo alubi so.
Basa kama nɛ b mɔ
ashiri to na
be asheŋ beeŋ lar efuli
nɛ b nya kumo be kasogberge.

english_text:
1 On that day, Leviathan,
the sea monster,
will squirm and try to escape,
but the Lord will kill him
with a cruel, sharp sword.
Protection and Forgiveness
The Lord said:
2At that time you must sing
about a fruitful vineyard.
3I, the Lord, will protect it
and always keep it watered.
I will guard it day and night
to keep it from harm.
4I am no longer angry.
But if it produces thorns,
I will go to war against it
and burn it to the ground.
5Yet if the vineyard depends
on me for protection,
it will become my friend
and be at peace with me.
6Someday Israel will take root
like a vine.
It will blossom and bear fruit
that covers the earth.
7I, the Lord, didn't punish and kill
the people of Israel
as fiercely as I punished
and killed their enemies.
8I carefully measured out
Israel's punishment
and sent the scorching heat
to chase them far away.
9There's only one way
that Israel's sin and guilt
can be completely forgiven:
They must crush the stones
of every pagan altar
and place of worship.
The Lord Will Bring His People Together
10Fortress cities are left
like a desert
where no one lives.
Cattle walk through the ruins,
stripping the trees bare.
11When broken branches
fall to the ground,
women pick them up
to feed the fire.
But these people are so stupid
that the God who created them
will show them no mercy.
12The time is coming when the Lord will shake the land between the Euphrates River and the border of Egypt, and one by one he will bring all of his people together. 13A loud trumpet will be heard. Then the people of Israel who were dragged away to Assyria and Egypt will return to worship the Lord on his holy mountain in Jerusalem.
translation_text:
Israɛl be kumɔlga be asheŋ
1Kamɔnchɛ kaŋ fo, Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na beeŋ ta mbe tokobi nɛ k kɔ eleŋ ga na ŋ gberge kusɔbɔya gbeyeso gboŋgboŋi nɛ k wɔ teku to nɛ baa tre kumo Liviatan na kusoe m mɔ kumo. 2Kachɛ na kaŋ fo, le nɛ Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na beeŋ kaŋɛ a laŋɛ mbe ndibi sɔrso be kudɔ lela na be kaplɛa so: 3“Mee keni kudɔ na so nna nsaa wurge kumo so nchu jemanɛ kikɛ. Ma alɛ naa kuŋ kumo kapa nɛ kanyɛ nna nɛ esa kikɛ e sa maŋ tiŋ n tɔrɔ kumo. 4Kumo be kaman, m maŋ naŋ nya agbo n wɔtɔ ndibi sɔrso be kudɔ na. Nɛ fanɛ ewi be yiri yiri kɔr kumo to gba, meeŋ tia amo kikɛ n chɔɔ m mur cheche. 5Ama nɛ ma basa bumo doŋana bee sha fanɛ m baa kuŋ bumo bre, b shin nɛ ma nɛ bumo e nya kayurwushi anyi be kefɛato.”
6Kachako bee ba nɛ Israɛl be basa nɛ b la Jeekɔb be kaman to ebi na e mur achin fanɛ kedibi nɛ k purge nseŋ wora atoto na. Saŋɛ na so bumo be asɔrso beeŋ chase durnya be kaplɛkama.
7Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na maŋ naŋ gberge Israɛl be basa kusoe kenishipereso nseŋ mɔ bumo be basa fanɛ kananɛ e gberge bumo doŋana kusoe nseŋ mɔ bumo be basa na. 8Kasogberge nɛ Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na sa mbe basa e la fanɛ e shin nna nɛ bumo doŋana kɔ m pɔɔ bumo so nseŋ pɛ bumo n yɔ efuli pɔtɛ so n ya ki anya. Bumo bedoŋana na daa du fanɛ epeŋilarkpa be afu tushiso nna m ba ber bumo n yɔ kufɔ kufɔ. 9Ekpa koŋwule so nɛ Israɛlebi beeŋ tiŋ m bɔla so n nya bumo be alubi nɛ kewora n jija be ketampaŋ. A daga fanɛ b bure nnyamase be agbirsure nɛ b pɔr a chɔɔ eduwu amo so na nseŋ tia kegbirche nɛ baa tre Ashira na be ndibi tenteŋ nɛ b yuu na kikɛ n lɛ.
10Kadegboŋ nɛ k kɔ egbal kuŋso lempoana na e ki alambure fanɛ keshishɛrsawule nɛ ekama maŋ wɔ kumo to, a dese na. K ki ana be ejikpa nɛ kakpa nɛ baa dese a wushi nna. 11Kumo to be ndibi be ayabi bee wɔl nna a buri a tɔr nɛ beche bee kil amo a puga edɛ. Ŋkpal basa na ka maŋ pin asheŋ to na so, Ebɔrɛ nɛ e to bumo na maaŋ wu bumo kuwɔr ŋko n shu bumo so.
12Jemanɛ ko bee ba nɛ Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na e yili Lɔrgboŋ nɛ baa tre Yufreetes na n ya fo Ijipt be egbaŋ to na ŋ gama mbe basa abar so fanɛ kananɛ baa beri ayu a chela to a deŋi abar so na. 13Kachɛ na kaŋ fo, kabel beeŋ shu awɔrso n tre Israɛlebi nɛ b pɛ n yɔ kenyaya to ashi Asiriya nɛ Ijipt be efuliana so na. Baaŋ bɛta m ba kaa shuŋ Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na mbe kebee cheembi na so ashi Jerusalɛm to.

english_text:
Samaria Will Be Punished
1The city of Samaria
above a fertile valley
is in for trouble!
Its leaders are drunkards,
who stuff themselves
with food and wine.
But they will be like flowers
that dry up and wilt.
2Only the Lord is strong
and powerful!
His mighty hand
will strike them down
with the force of a hailstorm
or a mighty whirlwind
or an overwhelming flood.
3Every drunkard in Ephraim
takes pride in Samaria,
but it will be crushed.
4Samaria above a fertile valley
will quickly lose its glory.
It will be gobbled up
like the first ripe fig
at harvest season.
5When this time comes,
the Lord All-Powerful
will be a glorious crown
for his people who survive.
6He will see that justice rules
and that his people are able
to defend their cities.
Corrupt Leaders Will Be Punished
7Priests and prophets stumble
because they are drunk.
