my own name is cursed.
6My people, you will learn
who I am and who is speaking
because I am here.
A Message of Hope for Jerusalem
7 What a beautiful sight!
On the mountains a messenger
announces to Jerusalem,
“Good news! You're saved.
There will be peace.
Your God is now King.”
8Everyone on guard duty,
sing and celebrate!
Look! You can see the Lord
returning to Zion.
9Jerusalem, rise from the ruins!
Join in the singing.
The Lord has given comfort
to his people;
he comes to your rescue.
10The Lord has shown all nations
his mighty strength;
now everyone will see
the saving power of our God.
A Command To Leave Babylon
11 Leave the city of Babylon!
Don't touch anything filthy.
Wash yourselves. Be ready
to carry back everything sacred
that belongs to the Lord.
12You won't need to run.
No one is chasing you.
The Lord God of Israel
will lead and protect you
from enemy attacks.
The Suffering Servant
13The Lord says:
My servant will succeed!
He will be given great praise
and the highest honors.
14Many were horrified
at what happened to him.
But everyone who saw him
was even more horrified
because he suffered until
he no longer looked human.
15 My servant will make
nations worthy to worship me;
kings will be silent
as they bow in wonder.
They will see and think about
things they have never seen
or thought about before.
translation_text:
Ebɔrɛ ka beeŋ kɔ m mɔlga Jerusalɛm be basa be asheŋ
1Jerusalɛm to ebi, men tiŋi edi to!
Men koso n yili ŋ kpeŋ menyi be eyur to!
Ebɔrɛ be kade cheembi to ebi,
men ta menyi be asɔbuuso lela m buu!
Nnyamase nɛ b shi efuli pɔtɛana so na
maaŋ naŋ luri menyi be kadegboŋ to n tɔrɔ menyi kikɛ.
2Jerusalɛm to ebi, men lar menyi be asheŋ lubi to!
Men lar men be asheŋ lubi nɛ a du
fanɛ efɔl ŋkre menyi be ebɔ to na to.
3Kede be kaman nɛ Enyɛnpetale Ebɔrɛ kaŋɛ mbe basa le: “Men ka daa la anya na, esa kikɛ daa maaŋ ka shɛŋ n tɔ menyi. Amoso, esa maaŋ ka shɛŋ nɛ men nya menyi be amu a ji. 4Dra dra na menyi gbagba be keparso nɛ men daŋ yɔ Ijipt be efuli so n ya ka wɔ ndoŋ fanɛ befɔ. Kumo be kaman nɛ Asiriya be efuli so ebi ba kɔ nseŋ pɛ menyi eleŋso n yɔ bumo be efuli so nɛ b maŋ ka shɛŋ. 5Naniere aloŋ e naaŋ wora ashi Babilɔn be efuli so gba. Men la anya nna, ama b maŋ ka shɛŋ n tɔ menyi. Bekama nɛ baa ji kuwura menyi so na bee puchi nna nsaa wu bumo be amu a wɔtɔ ma a keni ma jiga. 6Jemanɛ ko bee ba nɛ men pin fanɛ ma e la Ebɔrɛ nɛ ŋ kaŋɛ menyi asheŋ ere kikɛ pɔɛŋ nɛ a wora.”
7K la mamachi be kesheŋ nna fanɛ esa ka beeŋ wu
kabɔ ka ta kagbenewushi be baru
n shi abee so a gbelge to a ba nɛ e ba sa basa.
Kekɔmpɔɔso be kebomboŋ nɛ e bee ber
a sa Jerusalɛm to ebi a kaŋɛ le:
“Menyi be Ebɔrɛ e la Ewura!”
8Bekama nɛ baa keni kadegboŋ na so a kuŋ kumo na,
ber abar so nna a wora awɔr kagbenefuliso
B wu fanɛ Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na bɛta a ba Jerusalɛm to nna.
9Menyi Jerusalɛmebi nɛ menyi be kade daŋ bure a dese na,
e baa wora awɔr kagbenefuliso!
Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na beeŋ kɔ m mɔlga mbe kadegboŋ
nseŋ lolo mbe basa.
10Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na beeŋ ta mbe eleŋgboŋ
m mɔlga mbe basa ashi bumo doŋana be enɔ to,
saŋɛ na so durnya to ebi kikɛ beeŋ wu kumo.
11Menyi kikɛ nɛ menyee sulɔ bɔrɛlambu na to be asɔ na,
e lar kadegboŋ nɛ baa tre Babilɔn na to.
Men sa maŋ kaŋ beta keyurpisɔ kikɛ n wora
eyurpi daŋkare be ekpa so.
Menyi alɛ e bɛr nchu a du farfarbi pɔɛŋ nseŋ lar ndoŋ.
12Ama men sa maŋ kuse n lar ndoŋ. Ŋkpal manɛ so,
esa kama maa ju a buu menyi so.
Enyɛnpe menyi be Ebɔrɛ na e naaŋ baa juŋkpar menyi,
nsaa kuŋ menyi kaba kama so ashi men doŋana be enɔ to.
Kayɛrbi nɛ e bee ji awurfoŋ na be asheŋ
13Ade kikɛ be kaman, nɛ Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ kaŋɛ le:
“Asheŋ beeŋ nite nɛnɛ n sa ma kenya
ashi kusɔ kama nɛ e bee wora to.
Mo alɛ beeŋ nya kemaŋkuragboŋ nɛ basa e kpaŋ mo ga.
14Basa damta nɛ b wu mo be nnɔ daŋ mɔ bumo nna.
Mbe kayurwule daŋ chɛrga nna ŋkpal awurfoŋ nɛ e ji so;
e daŋ maŋ naŋ duli dimɛdi gba kuraa.
15Ma kenya na beeŋ sa efuliana na be basa ekpa nɛ b ki
basa nɛ baaŋ tiŋ n shuŋ ma Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na.
Bewura beeŋ wu mo nɛ k wora bumo mamachi
nseŋ mɔ bumo be nnɔ.
Efuli pɔtɛana be basa beeŋ wu asɔ
nɛ b maŋ naŋ wu ŋ ku so,
nseŋ fɛ asɔ nɛ b maŋ naŋ fɛ amo be asheŋ
ŋ ku so be nfɛra.”

english_text:
What God's Servant Did for Us
1 Has anyone believed us
or seen the mighty power
of the Lord in action?
2Like a young plant or a root
that sprouts in dry ground,
the servant grew up
obeying the Lord.
He wasn't some handsome king.
Nothing about the way he looked
made him attractive to us.
3He was hated and rejected;
his life was filled with sorrow
and terrible suffering.
No one wanted to look at him.
We despised him and said,
“He is a nobody!”
4He suffered and endured
great pain for us,
but we thought his suffering
was punishment from God.
5 He was wounded and crushed
because of our sins;
by taking our punishment,
he made us completely well.
6 All of us were like sheep
that had wandered off.
We had each gone our own way,
but the Lord gave him
the punishment we deserved.
7 He was painfully abused,
but he did not complain.
He was silent like a lamb
being led to the butcher,
as quiet as a sheep
having its wool cut off.
8He was condemned to death
without a fair trial.
Who could have imagined
what would happen to him?
His life was taken away
because of the sinful things
my people had done.
9 He wasn't dishonest or violent,
but he was buried in a tomb
among cruel, rich people.
10The Lord decided his servant
would suffer as a sacrifice
to take away the sin
and guilt of others.
Now the servant will live
to see his own descendants.
He did everything
the Lord had planned.
11By suffering, the servant
will learn the true meaning
of obeying the Lord.
Although he is innocent,
he will take the punishment
for the sins of others,
so that many of them
will no longer be guilty.
12 The Lord will reward him
with honor and power
for sacrificing his life.
Others thought he was a sinner,
but he suffered for our sins
and asked God to forgive us.
translation_text:
Kusɔ nɛ Ebɔrɛ be kenya wora n sa anyi be asheŋ
1Ndoŋ nna nɛ basa na malɛ bishi le:
“Wanɛ e naaŋ yirda kubɔya nɛ anyee nu ere?
Wanɛ e daŋ wu Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ be eleŋgboŋ ka shuŋ le?
2Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na gbagba be keparso nɛ mbe kenya
daŋ ki fanɛ kusɔduuso nɛ k mur achin
kasawule wɔlso so.
E daa maŋ walɛ keyɛrbi ŋko a la esagboŋ ko
nɛ basa nyi mbe asheŋ ŋko a keni mo a bɔlɔ kenishi.
Mbe kapɔr be shɛŋ daa maa par basa,
nɛ k shin nɛ basa e baa firgi a taga mo to.
3Ekama daŋ keni mo jiga nna nseŋ kini mo n lɛ.
Kagbenejija nɛ ebesa damta e daŋ bɔlɔ mo to,
nɛ mo alɛ ji kanyiti nseŋ sɔ amo kikɛ n deŋi mbe kumu so.
Ekama daa maa sha kewu mo kenishiso gba.
B daŋ wu mo nna fanɛ esa jiga.
4Ama e sɔ anyi be awurfoŋ nɛ ebesa kikɛ
n deŋi mbe kumu so.
Ade kikɛ to, an daa fɛ nna fanɛ
Ebɔrɛ e naa gberge mo kusoe.
5Anyi ere be asheŋ lubi so nɛ b beri mo nɛ e doro.
Kasogberge nɛ e nya na so nɛ an nya kayurwushi
nɛ mbe edoro na malɛ shin nɛ an nya kechɛ.
6Anyi kikɛ daa du fanɛ mbolpɔ
nɛ b yeŋ n foe n luri to nna.
Ekama daŋ sɔ mbe ekpa nna a yɔ.
Ama Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na daŋ shin nna
nɛ anyi be kasogberge ba mbe kenya so.
7Awurfoŋ nɛ ebesa damta daŋ ba mo so,
ama e daŋ lo to boeŋ nna, a maŋ fubel.
E daŋ lo to fanɛ kpakpafɔlbi
nɛ b gberge a yɔ nɛ b ya mɔ nna.
Mo alɛ nseŋ daa du fanɛ kubolpɔ nɛ baa kuya kumo be afuibi
nɛ k dese boeŋ nna, e maŋ wora shɛŋ.
8B daŋ pɛ mo nseŋ ji mo demu nɛ k maŋ niŋi.
Kumo be kaman nɛ b kaŋɛ fanɛ e daga b mɔ mo;
mbe asheŋ malɛ daa maŋ tir esa kikɛ.
B daŋ mɔ mo nna ŋkpal anyi be basa be asheŋ lubi so.
9E daŋ maŋ wora kulubi kikɛ ŋko ŋ ku efɛ ŋ ku so,
ama b daŋ mɔ mo nna m puli mo kakpa nɛ baa puli
alubiworapoana nɛ damawuraana.”
10Kumo be kaman nɛ Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na kaŋɛ le:
“Ma keparso nɛ ma kenya bee ji awurfoŋ.
Mbe luwu na la sarga nɛ k beeŋ bar alubi be ketampaŋ
m ba sa basa pɔtɛ nna.
Amoso e beeŋ naŋ wu mbe kaman to ebi kenishiso
nsaa wɔ ŋkpa to n chɛr.
Mo so nɛ kusɔ nɛ ŋ kre kikɛ beeŋ wora m bɔlɔ so nɛnɛ.
11Awurfoŋ nɛ e beeŋ ji na be kaman, e beeŋ naŋ nya
kagbenewushi nseŋ pin fanɛ e maŋ gben jiga.
Ma kenya nɛ e bee shuŋ ma kagbene koŋwuleso
nɛ ma kagbene bee fuli mo so na
e naaŋ sɔ basa galeŋga be kasogberge n deŋi mbe kumu so,
nɛ ŋ kpal mo so n ta bumo be alubi m paŋ bumo.
12Amoso meeŋ sa mo kemaŋkuragboŋ nɛ eleŋgboŋ.
E shuli so n ta mbe kumu n lara sarga,
nseŋ yili alubiworapoana damta be aya to
ŋ kule alubi be ketampaŋ n sa bumo.”

english_text:
A Promise of the Lord's Protection
1 Sing and shout,
even though you have never
had children!
The Lord has promised that you
will have more children
than someone married
for a long time.
2Make your tents larger!
Spread out the tent pegs;
fasten them firmly.
3You and your descendants
will take over the land
of other nations.
You will settle in towns
that are now in ruins.
4Don't be afraid or ashamed
and don't be discouraged.
You won't be disappointed.
Forget how sinful you were
when you were young;
stop feeling ashamed
for being left a widow.
5The Lord All-Powerful,
the Holy God of Israel,
rules all the earth.
He is your Creator and husband,
and he will rescue you.
6You were like a young wife,
brokenhearted and crying
because her husband
had divorced her.
But the Lord your God says,
“I am taking you back!
7I rejected you for a while,
but with love and tenderness
I will embrace you again.
8For a while, I turned away
in furious anger.
Now I will have mercy
and love you forever!
I, your protector and Lord,
make this promise.”
The Lord Promises Lasting Peace
9 I once promised Noah that I
would never again destroy
the earth by a flood.
Now I have promised that I
will never again get angry
and punish you.
10 Every mountain and hill
may disappear.
But I will always be kind
and merciful to you;
I won't break my agreement
to give your nation peace.
The New Jerusalem
11 Jerusalem, you are sad
and discouraged,
tossed around in a storm.
But I, the Lord,
will rebuild your city
with precious stones;
for your foundation
I will use blue sapphires.
12Your fortresses
will be built of rubies,
your gates of jewels,
and your walls of gems.
13 I will teach your children
and make them successful.
14You will be built on fairness
with no fears of injustice;
every one of your worries
will be taken far from you.
15I will never send anyone
to attack your city,
and you will make prisoners
of those who do attack.
16Don't forget that I created
metalworkers who make weapons
over burning coals.
I also created armies
that can bring destruction.
17Weapons made to attack you
won't be successful;
words spoken against you
won't hurt at all.
My servants, Jerusalem is yours!
I, the Lord, promise
to bless you with victory.
translation_text:
Kasha nɛ Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na kɔ n sa Israɛl be asheŋ
1Jerusalɛm, fo daa du fanɛ egbentepo nna,
ama naniere feeŋ tiŋ m boŋ nshɛ kagbenefuliso
Naniere bre feeŋ nya mbia damta
a chɔ eche kurgepo nɛ e kɔ ekul gba.
2Kpalga wajɛbu nɛ fo wɔtɔ to na,
nseŋ teŋi amo be efɔlana so
nseŋ naŋ lɔŋɛ kumo be ayir ŋ gbir nɛnɛ!
3Fo nɛ fo kaman to ebi beeŋ sɔ efuli pɔtɛana
be nsawule ŋ ki menyeya;
nseŋ pɔr n chena bumo be nde
nɛ e bure a dese naniere na to.
4Men sa maa ŋana kufu ŋko anishinyɔr.
Menyi alɛ e sa maŋ pɔ aba kikɛ.
Men teŋ menyi be kebifɔlbi to be asheŋ lubi na so.
Men sa maŋ shin nɛ menyi be kebaawɔtɔ nɛ k du fanɛ
ekulpoche be kebaawɔtɔ na e baa keta menyi nyɔmɔ.
5Ŋkpal manɛ so menyi be etopo na
beeŋ baa la fanɛ ekul n sa menyi.
Mo e la Enyɛnpetale, Israɛl be Ebɔrɛ cheembi na.
E beeŋ mɔlga menyi.
Mo e naa ji kuwura durnya kikɛ so na.
6Menyi, Israɛlebi, du fanɛ eche fɔlbi
nɛ mo kul kini mo nɛ e bee shu kagbenejijaso nna.
Ama Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na naŋ tre menyi m ba,
nsaa kaŋɛ menyi le:
7“N daŋ kplaŋ menyi so jemanɛ gbrɛbi ko nna,
ama ŋkpal ma kashagboŋ nɛ kushuso so,
meeŋ naŋ bɛta n sɔ menyi.
8N daŋ nya agbo nna m pal kaman n sa menyi
jemanɛ gbrɛbi ko,
ama meeŋ naaŋ wu menyi kuwɔr nseŋ sha menyi mbaanaayɔ.
Kusɔ nɛ ma, Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ, nɛ n la menyi be emɔlgapo na
bee kaŋɛ menyi nna na.”
9“Nowa be jemanɛ na, ma Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na
daŋ nase kɔnɔ fanɛ m maaŋ naŋ ta nchu m mur durnya.
Mee nase kɔnɔ naniere nna fanɛ
m maaŋ naŋ nya agbo ŋ gberge menyi kusoe.
10Abeegboŋ nɛ abeebi beeŋ tiŋ m bure n tɔr,
ama kasha nɛ ŋ kɔ n sa menyi maaŋ loge kikɛ.
Meeŋ bɛ kɔnɔ nɛ n naseso ŋ kaŋɛ fanɛ
meeŋ sa menyi kayurwushi na so mbaanaayɔ.
Kusɔ nɛ Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ, nɛ mee sha menyi na kaŋɛ nna na.”
Jerusalɛm popɔr na be asheŋ
11Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na yɛ:
“O Jerusalɛm be kadegboŋ
nɛ fee ji awurfoŋ nsaa maa kɔ echɛtopo,
nɛ esa nɛ e bee lolo fo;
meeŋ ta yawu kpakpaso be ajembu lela
n tɔl fo gbaltɔlase.
12Yawu kpakpaso be ajembu peper nɛ baa tre rubi na
nɛ meeŋ ta m pɔr fo kakpa lempoana na,
nseŋ ta ajembu nɛ a bee kpa edɛ na n lɔŋɛ fo mbunagboŋ,
nseŋ naŋ ta yawu kpakpaso be ajembu
nɛ baa ta a lɔŋɛ abitasɔ na m pɔr egbal ŋ kulti fo.
13Ma, Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na gbagba e naŋ ŋini fo basa asheŋ,
nseŋ sa bumo kedama nɛ kayurwushi damta.
14Fo basa be kewora kusɔ nɛ k daga
nɛ bumo be kewora asheŋ nɛ amo be ekpa so
beeŋ shin nɛ fo baa kɔ eleŋ.
Ma alɛ beeŋ lara bumo be kafɔŋ kikɛ ashi fo to,
nɛ a maa naŋ taga fo to gba kuraa.
15M maaŋ naŋ shin nɛ esa kikɛ
e kɔ kena ashi fo kadegboŋ na to.
Bekama nɛ baaŋ kɔ menyi kena
maaŋ tiŋ m pɔɔ menyi so kikɛ.
16Ma e to bɔyɛpo nɛ e bee puga edɛ
a ŋalga abɛlso a lɔŋɛ akɔsɔ.
Ma alɛ e to enapo nɛ e bee ta
akɔsɔ na a kɔ kena a mɔ basa.
17Ama kekɔsɔ kama maaŋ tiŋ n wora fo shɛŋ.
Fo alɛ beeŋ nya kusɔ ko ŋ kaŋɛ
bekama nɛ baaŋ ku fo kɔnɔ.
Meeŋ kɔ n sa ma anya
nseŋ shin nɛ b kɔ m pɔɔ so.”
Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ e kaŋɛ na.

english_text:
The Lord's Invitation
1 If you are thirsty,
come and drink water!
If you don't have any money,
come, eat what you want!
Drink wine and milk
without paying a cent.
2 Why waste your money
on what really isn't food?
Why work hard for something
that doesn't satisfy?
Listen carefully to me,
and you will enjoy
the very best foods.
3 Pay close attention!
Come to me and live.
I will promise you
the eternal love and loyalty
that I promised David.
4I made him the leader and ruler
of the nations;
he was my witness to them.
5You will call out to nations
you have never known.
And they have never known you,
but they will come running
because I am the Lord,
the holy God of Israel,
and I have honored you.
God's Words Are Powerful
6Turn to the Lord!
He can still be found.
Call out to God! He is near.
7Give up your evil ways
and your evil thoughts.
Return to the Lord our God.
He will be merciful
and forgive your sins.
8The Lord says:
“My thoughts and my ways
are not like yours.
9Just as the heavens
are higher than the earth,
my thoughts and my ways
are higher than yours.
10 “Rain and snow fall from the sky.
But they don't return
without watering the earth
that produces seeds to plant
and grain to eat.
11That's how it is with my words.
They don't return to me
without doing everything
I send them to do.”
God's People Will Celebrate
12When you are set free,
you will celebrate
and travel home in peace.
Mountains and hills will sing
as you pass by,
and trees will clap.
13Cypress and myrtle trees
will grow in fields
once covered by thorns.
And then those trees will stand
as a lasting witness
to the glory of the Lord.
translation_text:
Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ be kuwɔrwu be asheŋ
1Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ yɛ:
“Ekama nɛ achukoŋ kɔ mo
e ba nuu nchu!
Ekama nɛ e maŋ kɔ amansherbi gba
e ba tɔ ajibi n ji!
Men ba tɔ yabra nɛ kenyipochu n nuu
nsaa maŋ ka shɛŋ!
2Manɛ nna nɛ menyee jija amansherbi
asɔ nɛ a maŋ la ajibi so?
Manɛ nna nɛ menyee shuŋ ga a fin
asɔ nɛ a maaŋ chɛ menyi to?
Men nu asɔ nɛ mee kaŋɛ menyi ere nseŋ wora amo
nseŋ nya ajibi kikɛ to be alela n ji.
3Ma basa, men nu n sa ma nseŋ ba ma kutɔ.
Men ba ma kutɔ nseŋ nya ŋkpa!
Ma nɛ menyi beeŋ kre kɔnɔkoŋwule be ŋkre
nɛ k wɔtɔ mbaanaayɔ, saŋɛ na so meeŋ sa menyi enɛfa
nɛ n nase amo be kɔnɔ n sa Ewura Deevid na.
4Ma e daŋ shin nɛ e ki efuliana na be ejuŋkparpo nɛ ewura,
nseŋ bɔla mo so ŋ ŋini bumo ma eleŋgboŋ.
5To, menyeeŋ kela a tre efuli pɔtɛana
nɛ menyi maŋ nyi bumo be basa gba
fanɛ b ba ti menyi so, nɛ b shile m ba buu menyi!
Ma, Enyɛnpe, Israɛl be Ebɔrɛ cheembi na
e naaŋ shin nɛ ade kikɛ e wora m bɔlɔ so.
Meeŋ shin nɛ men nya kemaŋkura nɛ bunyaŋ
ashi basa kikɛ to.”
6Men fin Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na nseŋ kule mo
saŋɛ nɛ e taga menyi to ere.
7Kumu kpakpasowuraana, men lar menyi be asheŋ lubi to
nseŋ chɛrga menyi be nfɛra lubi nɛ menyee fɛ na.
Men bɛta m ba Enyɛnpe anyi be Ebɔrɛ na kutɔ,
mo e la ewɔrwupo nsaa nya manaŋ a ta alubi a paŋ na.
8Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na yɛ:
“Ma nfɛra fɛso maŋ du fanɛ menyi be nfɛra fɛso.
Ma alɛ be ekpa nɛ mee bɔla so a wora asheŋ kɔr menyeya to.
9Kananɛ ebɔrɛso wɔ esoso a chɔ kasawule so na,
aloŋ nɛ ma kasheŋwora nɛ nfɛra fɛso chɔ menyi peya.
10Ma mmalga du fanɛ bunyaŋ nɛ bɔrɛchu
nɛ a bee shi awɔlpa to a ba,
a shin nɛ kasawule so bee nya kayul nna.
Kananɛ bunyaŋ nɛ bɔrɛchu bee shin nɛ basa
bee nya a ji nsaa nya asɔduuso a du na,
11aloŋ nɛ ma kɔnɔ to be mmalga gba du.
Kusɔ kama nɛ ŋ kaŋɛ, aloŋ gbagba e naa wora.
12Kagbenefuli nɛ menyeeŋ ta n lar Babilɔn be efuli so,
nseŋ lar kadegboŋ na to nɛ kayurwushi.
Abeegboŋ nɛ abeebi beeŋ baa boŋ nshɛ a sa menyi,
nɛ ndibi malɛ e baa kpla enɔ a wɔtɔ.
13Ndibi sɔrso beeŋ kɔr n yili mboŋ nɛ ewidibi daa yil,
saŋɛ na so k beeŋ baa la tɔɔnɛ a dese mbaanaayɔ.
Kumo alɛ beeŋ naa la kanyiŋi a laŋɛ kusɔ
nɛ ma, Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na wora be kaplɛa so.”

english_text:
All Nations Will Be Part of God's People
1The Lord said:
Be honest and fair!
Soon I will come to save you;
my saving power will be seen
everywhere on earth.
2I will bless everyone
who respects the Sabbath
and refuses to do wrong.
3Foreigners who worship me
must not say,
“The Lord won't let us
be part of his people.”
Men who are unable
to become fathers
must no longer say,
“We are dried-up trees.”
4 To them, I, the Lord, say:
Respect the Sabbath,
obey me completely,
and keep our agreement.
5Then you will be like monuments
in my temple with your names
written on them.
This will be much better
than having children,
because these monuments
will stand there forever.
6Foreigners will follow me.
They will love me and worship
in my name;
they will respect the Sabbath
and keep our agreement.
7 I will bring them
to my holy mountain,
where they will celebrate
in my house of worship.
Their sacrifices and offerings
will always be welcome
on my altar.
Then my house will be known
as a house of worship
for all nations.
8I, the Lord, promise
to bring together my people
who were taken away,
and let them join the others.
God Promises To Punish Israel's Leaders
9Come from the forest,
you wild animals!
Attack and gobble up
your victims.
10You leaders of Israel
should be watchdogs,
protecting my people.
But you can't see a thing,
and you never warn them.
Dozing and daydreaming
are all you ever do.
11You stupid leaders are a pack
of hungry and greedy dogs
that never get enough.
You are shepherds
who mistreat your own sheep
for selfish gain.
12You say to each other,
“Let's drink till we're drunk!
Tomorrow we'll do it again.
We'll really enjoy ourselves.”
translation_text:
Efuli pɔtɛana so ebi ka beeŋ ki Ebɔrɛ be basa be asheŋ
1Nɛ Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na kaŋɛ mbe basa le: “Men baa wora kusɔ nɛ k daga nseŋ bɔla ekpa, ŋkpal manɛ so, k maaŋ chɛr nɛ m ba mɔlga menyi. 2Meeŋ nɛfa bekama nɛ baa keni kewushiachɛ na a bɔlɔ kenishi nsaa bɛ kumo so na. Ma alɛ beeŋ nɛfa bekama nɛ b maa wora asheŋ lubi.”
3Efɔ kama nɛ e ba tu Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na be basa a wɔtɔ e sa maŋ kaŋ kaŋɛ fanɛ: “Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na maaŋ shuli nɛ n tu mbe basa a shuŋ mo.”
Enyɛn kama nɛ b lara mbe awulbi be bibi e sa maŋ kaa fɛ fanɛ e ka maaŋ tiŋ ŋ kurge bibi so, mo ere maaŋ tiŋ n ti Ebɔrɛ be basa so. 4Le nɛ Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na bee kaŋɛ amodoŋwura: “Fo baa keni ma kewushiachɛ na a bɔlɔ kenishi nsaa wora kusɔ nɛ k bee par ma nsaa bɛ ma kɔnɔkoŋwule be ŋkre na so kashenteŋto, 5kumo ere baaŋ baa nyiŋi fo ketre ma bɔrɛlambu to nɛ ma basa to n chɛr a chɔ fo ka beeŋ baa kɔ mbia gba. Basa maaŋ teŋ fo so kikɛ.”
6Kumo be kaman nɛ Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na kaŋɛ befɔ nɛ b ti mbe basa so a sha mo nsaa bɛ kewushiachɛ na so nseŋ naa bɛ mbe kɔnɔkoŋwule be ŋkre na so kashenteŋto na le: 7“Meeŋ bar menyi ma kebee cheembi nɛ baa tre Zayɔn nɛ k wɔ Jerusalɛm na so m ba sa menyi kagbenewushi ashi ma bɔrɛlambu to. Ma alɛ beeŋ sɔ menyi be esarga nɛ menyeeŋ lara ashi ma bɔrɛsure so. Ma bɔrɛlambu beeŋ baa la kabɔrɛkule be kakpa n sa efuli kama so be basa.”
8Enyɛnpetale Ebɔrɛ nɛ e keta mbe basa Israɛlebi n shi kenyaya to ashi efuli pɔtɛ wɔfɔ so m ba na e nase kɔnɔ fanɛ e beeŋ bar basa pɔtɛ m ba ti bumo so.
Ebɔrɛ ka beeŋ gberge Israɛl be bejuŋkparpo kusoe be asheŋ
9Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na e kaŋɛ efuli pɔtɛana so ebi fanɛ b ba fanɛ kupuŋ to be asɔbɔya lubi m ba mur mbe basa. 10E yɛ: “Bejuŋkparpo nɛ b daga kekpele ma basa kusoe na kikɛ tan nna! B maŋ nyi shɛŋ. B du fanɛ njɔnɔ nɛ b maa gbu nna. Bumo peya e la kebaadese a di a ku edare. Baa sha edi nna ga! 11Bejuŋkparpo na du fanɛ njɔnɔ nɛ baa sha ajibi ga nna. B maa ji a moɛ kikɛ. Bumo alɛ maa pin asheŋ to nsaa wɔtɔ a wora asheŋ nɛ a bee par bumo nawule. 12Kusɔ nɛ basa nɛ baa boo nsa bee kaŋɛ e la fanɛ men shin nɛ an ya nuu nsa m boo kananɛ anyee sha. Echefo peya e baa chɔ kabre peya!”

english_text:
God's Faithful People Suffer
1God's faithful people
are dragged off and killed,
and no one even cares.
Evil sweeps them away,
2but in death they find peace
for obeying God.
The Lord Condemns Idolatry
3You people are unfaithful!
You go to fortunetellers,
and you worship idols.
Now pay close attention!
4Who are you making fun of?
Who are you sneering at?
Look how your sins
have made fools of you.
5All you think about is sex
under those green trees
where idols are worshiped.
You sacrifice your children
on altars built in valleys
under rocky slopes.
6You have chosen to worship
idols made of stone;
you have given them offerings
of wine and grain.
Should I be pleased?
7You have spread out your beds
on the tops of high mountains,
where you sacrifice to idols.
8Even in your homes
you have placed pagan symbols
all around your huge beds.
Yes, you have rejected me,
sold yourselves to your lovers,
and gone to bed with them.
9You smear on olive oil
and all kinds of perfume
to worship the god Molech.
You even seek advice
from spirits of the dead.
10Though you tired yourself out
by running after idols,
you refused to stop.
Your desires were so strong
that they kept you going.
11Did you forget about me
and become unfaithful
because you were more afraid
of someone else?
Have I been silent so long
that you no longer fear me?
12You think you're so good,
but I'll point out the truth.
13Ask your idols to save you
when you are in trouble.
Be careful though—
it takes only a faint breath
to blow them over.
But if you come to me
for protection,
this land and my holy mountain
will always belong to you.
The Lord Helps the Helpless
14The Lord says,
“Clear the road!
Get it ready for my people.”
15 Our holy God lives forever
in the highest heavens,
and this is what he says:
Though I live high above
in the holy place,
I am here to help those
who are humble
and depend only on me.
16My people, I won't stay angry
and keep on accusing you.
After all, I am your Creator.
I don't want you to give up
in complete despair.
17Your greed made me furious.
That's why I punished you
and refused to be found,
while you kept returning
to your old sinful ways.
18I know what you are like!
But I will heal you, lead you,
and give you comfort,
until those who are mourning
19 start singing my praises.
No matter where you are,
I, the Lord, will heal you
and give you peace.
20The wicked are a restless sea
tossing up mud.
21 But I, the Lord, have promised
that none who are evil
will live in peace.
translation_text:
Ebɔrɛ be basa nɛ b maa ji kashenteŋ be awurfoŋ be asheŋ
1Basa niŋiso bee wu nɛ ekama malɛ be shɛŋ maŋ wɔtɔ bumo to. Ama nɛ b baŋ wu malɛ b maŋ naa luri alubi to. 2Bekama nɛ b wɔ kebaawɔtɔ lela to bee nya kayurwushi nɛ ewushi ashi luwu to nna ŋkpal b ka daa wora Ebɔrɛ kasonu so.
3Belubiworapoana ere, men ba nfe nɛ b ji menyi demu! Menyi nɛ bekpalpo nɛ kubojuajiwuraana nɛ esakale kikɛ la kukoŋwule nna. 4Wanɛ nɛ menyee wora eyurto? Wanɛ nɛ menyee mɛr kɔnɔ? Men keni, menyi be alubi shin nɛ men ki bewulpo nna. 5Menyi ka bee shuŋ agbirana nɛ menyee fɛ fanɛ e bee sa kakurge so, men wɔtɔ nna a di abar keche nɛ kenyɛn ashi ndibigboŋ nɛ menyee shuŋ agbir na amo be afito. Menyi alɛ naa ta menyi be mbia a lara esarga ashi abeelaŋ nɛ ataŋɛ chiŋgeliŋ nɛ a wɔ abeemase na nna. 6Kumo be kaman menyee ta elɔr be epun to be ajembu mɔlmɔlbi nna a ki agbir, nsaa ta nsa nɛ ajibi a lara esarga a sa amo. Menyee tama fanɛ kumo be loŋ bee par ma nna a? 7Menyee yɔ abee jeŋgreŋ so nna n ya kaa lara esarga nsaa di abar keche nɛ kenyɛn ndoŋ. 8Menyi alɛ naa ta agbirana nɛ amo be asheŋ bee nu ma agbo na nna a yili menyi be mbuna be akɔlɔbi to nɛ egedo be afito. Men kplaŋ ma so nna nseŋ ta menyi be amu n fa n sa basa nɛ menyee sha nɛ baa tu menyi a dese menyi be egedo so a wora menyi be kayɛlga fuloŋ be asheŋ woraso. 9Menyee gbiti ŋku nsaa wora etulale n ya kaa shuŋ kegbir nɛ baa tre Mɔlɛk na nna. Menyi alɛ bee shuŋi mbɔ mboŋ wɔfɔ, hale a yɔ bubuni to nna n ya kaa fin agbirana nɛ menyeeŋ baa shuŋ. 10Menyee gben ga a fin agbir popɔr, ama menyi alɛ maa gben a yige to. Menyee fɛ nna fanɛ menyi be agbirana nɛ amo be asheŋ bee nu ma agbo na e naa sa menyi eleŋ, amoso nɛ menyee sha amo na.
11Ade be kaman nɛ Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na bishi le: “Nuso be agbir e shin nɛ kufu pɛ menyi, nɛ men kpal amo so a ku efɛ nseŋ teŋ ma so kuraa loŋ? Ŋkpal ŋ ka wora shruum n chɛr so nɛ men yige kebaabunyaŋ ma ere a? 12Menyee fɛ fanɛ kusɔ nɛ menyee wora na daga nna, ama meeŋ shin nɛ menyi be asheŋ woraso e lar efuli nɛ menyi be agbirana e chɛ menyi to ŋ gben. 13Men kaa shu a fin kechɛto, men shin nɛ menyi be agbirana e mɔlga menyi! Ama afu fimbi e naŋ ber amo n lɛ. Bekama nɛ b yirda ma e naaŋ chena kasawule na so nseŋ shuŋ ma ashi ma bɔrɛlambu to ashi ma kebee cheembi na so.”
Ebɔrɛ ka nase kechɛto nɛ kechɛ be kɔnɔ be asheŋ
14Ade be kaman nɛ Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ naŋ kaŋɛ le: “Men lɔŋɛ ekpa nseŋ lara ajembu nɛ keyimu kikɛ kumo so n sa ma basa nɛ b bɔla kumo so m bɛta m ba ma kutɔ!
15Ma e la Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ nɛ e wɔ ebɔrɛso nsaa wɔtɔ mbaanaayɔ na. N wɔ kakpa cheembi nɛ k wɔ esoso nna, ama ma alɛ nɛ basa nɛ b bar bumo be amu kaseto nseŋ ta bumo be amu n deŋi ma so na gba e wɔtɔ nɛ m baa chɛ bumo to. 16M maaŋ naaŋ nya agbo n wɔtɔ ma basa a wu bumo kulubi mbaanaayɔ. Ŋkpal manɛ so, ma e to bumo nsaa maa sha fanɛ bumo be aba e pɔ bumo. 17N daŋ nya agbo ga nna n wora bumo ŋkpal bumo be alubi nɛ kejimuni be kebaawɔtɔ so, amoso nɛ n daŋ gberge bumo kusoe nseŋ daŋ kplaŋ bumo so na. Ama b kraŋ wora kusoe kpakpaso ŋ kini a wɔ bumo be asheŋ lubi na to.
18N wu asheŋ nɛ b wora na kikɛ, ama ŋ kraa beeŋ chɛ bumo be alɔ. Ma alɛ beeŋ juŋkpar bumo nseŋ chɛ bumo to nseŋ naŋ lolo bekama nɛ baa shu nli na, 19nɛ b fara a boŋ nshɛ a kpaŋ ma. Meeŋ shin nɛ bekama nɛ b taga to nɛ bumo nɛ b wɔ kufɔ kufɔ kikɛ e nya kayurwushi. Ma e naaŋ chɛ ma basa be alɔ kikɛ! 20Basa lubi bre du fanɛ teku nɛ k bee baga to a kaa ketili a lara eyurpi a deŋi kedeŋi so jemanɛ kikɛ na nna. 21Ama ma, Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na nase kɔnɔ fanɛ belubiworapoana maaŋ nya kayurwushi kikɛ.”

english_text:
True Religion
1Shout the message!
Don't hold back.
Say to my people Israel:
You've sinned! You've turned
against the Lord.
2Day after day, you worship him
and seem eager to learn
his teachings.
You act like a nation
that wants to do right
by obeying his laws.
You ask him about justice,
and say you enjoy
worshiping the Lord.
3You wonder why the Lord
pays no attention
when you go without eating
and act humble.
But on those same days
that you give up eating,
you think only of yourselves
and abuse your workers.
4You even get angry
and ready to fight.
No wonder God won't listen
to your prayers!
5Do you think the Lord
wants you to give up eating
and to act as humble
as a bent-over bush?
Or to dress in sackcloth
and sit in ashes?
Is this really what he wants
on a day of worship?
6I'll tell you
what it really means
to worship the Lord.
Remove the chains of prisoners
who are bound unjustly.
Free those who are abused!
7 Share your food with everyone
who is hungry;
share your home
with the poor and homeless.
Give clothes to those in need;
don't turn away your relatives.
8Then your light will shine
like the dawning sun, and you
will quickly be healed.
Your honesty will protect you
as you advance,
and the glory of the Lord
will defend you from behind.
9When you beg the Lord for help,
he will answer, “Here I am!”
Don't mistreat others
or falsely accuse them
or say something cruel.
10Give your food to the hungry
and care for the homeless.
Then your light will shine
in the dark;
your darkest hour will be
like the noonday sun.
11The Lord will always guide you
and provide good things to eat
when you are in the desert.
He will make you healthy.
You will be like a garden
that has plenty of water
or like a stream
that never runs dry.
12You will rebuild those houses
left in ruins for years;
you will be known
as a builder and repairer
of city walls and streets.
13But first, you must start
respecting the Sabbath
as a joyful day of worship.
You must stop doing and saying
whatever you please
on this special day.
14Then you will truly enjoy
knowing the Lord.
He will let you rule
from the highest mountains
and bless you with the land
of your ancestor Jacob.
The Lord has spoken!
translation_text:
Kashenteŋto be ekishi be asheŋ
1Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ yɛ: “Boŋ to awɔrso ga ŋ kaŋɛ ma basa Israɛlebi na bumo be alubi be asheŋ! 2Baa shuŋ ma karechɛ kikɛ nna a ŋini fanɛ b pere kenishi a sha kepin ma ekpa nseŋ wora ma mbraana kasonu fanɛ efuli nɛ k bee wora kusɔ nɛ k daga. B yɛ n sa bumo mbraana nɛ a maa kpɛa basa to nseŋ naa leŋ bumo to a kaŋɛ fanɛ bumo kebaashuŋ ma na bee wora bumo ebel nna.”
3Kumo be kaman nɛ basa na bishi le: “Manɛ nna nɛ anyee kishi nɛ Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na maa wu fanɛ anyee kishi? Nɛ manɛ nna nɛ anyee bar anyi be amu kaseto nɛ mbe lakal maŋ wɔ anyi so?”
Ade be kaman nɛ Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na malɛ kaŋɛ bumo le: “Kashenteŋ na e la fanɛ, jemanɛ kikɛ nɛ menyee kishi menyi gbagba be aparsheŋ nɛ menyee wora nsaa mɛaŋ menyi be beshumpoana. 4Menyi be ekishi bee shin nɛ menyee ki nyaŋnyaŋ nna nɛ menyee bile a tege abar nsaa bri abar. Men tama fanɛ le be ekishi beeŋ tiŋ n shin nɛ n nu menyi be kabɔrɛkule a? 5Men baŋ kishi kikɛ, menyee ta menyi be amu nna a wɔtɔ awurfoŋ to. Menyi alɛ naa wora asheŋ nna fanɛ bebɔlpo, a kurgi amu a yuu to fanɛ ayu ka bel n chulgi na nseŋ naa buu nli to be asɔbuuso a dese nsunɔ to a ŋini men ka bar menyi be amu kaseto. Le nɛ menyee tre ekishi nɛ k bee par ma nna a?
6Ekishi nɛ k bee par ma a ŋini menyee ka bee shuŋ ma kashenteŋto e la men ka beeŋ lara kanyaŋ nɛ kebaakɔrfɛ basa nɛ b maŋ wora shɛŋ nsaa wɔ kabuti to na nseŋ shin nɛ ekama e nya a wora asheŋ yila yila so. 7Men baa chige menyi be ajibi to a sa basa nɛ b maŋ kɔ nɛ b ji nsaa sa bumo nɛ b maŋ kɔ edesekpa kakpa nɛ b dese ashi menyi peana. Menyi alɛ e naa chɛ basa nɛ b maŋ kɔ asɔbuuso to, a sa bumo asɔbuuso nsaa maa kini kebaachɛ men kurgepoana to.
8Aloŋ nɛ ma kuwɔrwu beeŋ nyaŋɛ n yuu menyi so fanɛ kachipurso be epeŋi, nɛ menyi alɛ e naaŋ nya menyi be alɔ be kechɛ manaŋ manaŋ. Ma nɛ menyi beeŋ baa wɔtɔ nɛ m baa mɔlga menyi nsaa kuŋ menyi ekpa kama so. 9Nɛ men baŋ kule ma kusɔ kama, meeŋ nu menyi be kekule. Nɛ men tre ma malɛ meeŋ shuli menyi be ketre na!
Nɛ men yige kanyaŋ nɛ nfɛlso be kebaawɔtɔ nɛ mmalga lubi be kebaamalga 10nsaa sa basa nɛ akoŋ kɔ ajibi nseŋ naa chɛ bumo nɛ asheŋ tir bumo to, kumo ere kanyɛso beeŋ ki fanɛ kapiidi n sa menyi. 11Ma, Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na malɛ beeŋ baa juŋkpar menyi nsaa sa menyi asɔ lela nɛ a beeŋ baa kukwe menyi jemanɛ kikɛ. Ma alɛ beeŋ baa sa menyi eleŋ nɛ alenfia a ti so. Menyi alɛ beeŋ baa du fanɛ kambɔl nɛ k bee nya nchu nɛnɛ ŋko kabombi nɛ k maa wɔlto kikɛ na nna. 12Menyi be basa beeŋ lɔŋɛ m pɔr mboŋ nɛ e bure a dese n chɛr na n yili amo be egbaltɔlase dra na so. Saŋɛ na so ekama beeŋ pin fanɛ men la basa nɛ baa lɔŋɛ egbalana nɛ alambure a pɔr nna.”
Kebaakeni kewushiachɛ na a bɔlɔ kenishi be tɔnɔ be asheŋ
13Ade kikɛ be kaman nɛ Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na naaŋ kaŋɛ le: “Nɛ men ta kewushiachɛ na fanɛ kachɛ cheembi a maa wora menyi gbagba be aparsheŋ fanɛ kebaayɔ nde ŋko a shuŋ kushuŋ be yiri kikɛ ŋko a malga mmalga jiga loŋ be kachɛ na, 14menyeeŋ nya kagbenefuli nɛ k shi kebaashuŋ ma, Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na to. Meeŋ shin nɛ men nya bunyaŋ ashi durnya be kaplɛkama nɛ menyi alɛ e naŋ ji kasawule nɛ n sa menyi nananyɛn Jeekɔb na be ebel. Ma Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ e kaŋɛ na!”

english_text:
Social Injustice Is Condemned
1The Lord hasn't lost
his powerful strength;
he can still hear
and answer prayers.
2Your sins are the roadblock
between you and your God.
That's why he doesn't answer
your prayers
or let you see his face.
3Your talk is filled with lies
and plans for violence;
every finger on your hands
is covered with blood.
4You falsely accuse others
and tell lies in court;
sin and trouble are the names
of your children.
5You eat the deadly eggs
of poisonous snakes,
and more snakes crawl out
from the eggs left to hatch.
You weave spider webs,
6but you can't make clothes
with those webs
or hide behind them.
You're sinful and brutal.
7 You hurry off to do wrong
or murder innocent victims.
All you think about is sin;
you leave ruin and destruction
wherever you go.
8You don't know how
to live in peace
or to be fair with others.
The roads you make are crooked;
your followers cannot find peace.
The People Confess Their Sins
9No one has come to defend us
or to bring about justice.
We hoped for a day of sunshine,
but all we found
was a dark, gloomy night.
10We feel our way along,
as if we were blind;
we stumble at noon,
as if it were night.
We can see no better
than someone dead.
11We growl like bears
and mourn like doves.
We hope for justice and victory,
but they escape us.
12How often have we sinned
and turned against you,
the Lord God?
Our sins condemn us!
We have done wrong.
13We have rebelled and refused
to follow you.
Our hearts were deceitful,
and so we lied;
we planned to abuse others
and turn our backs on you.
14Injustice is everywhere;
justice seems far away.
Truth is chased out of court;
honesty is shoved aside.
15Everyone tells lies;
those who turn from crime
end up ruined.
The Lord Will Rescue His People
When the Lord noticed
that justice had disappeared,
he became very displeased.
16 It disgusted him even more
to learn that no one
would do a thing about it.
So with his own powerful arm,
he won victories for truth.
17 Justice was the Lord's armor;
saving power was his helmet;
anger and revenge
were his clothes.
18Now the Lord will get furious
and do to his enemies,
both near and far,
what they did to his people.
19He will attack like a flood
in a mighty windstorm.
Nations in the west and the east
will then honor and praise
his wonderful name.
20 The Lord has promised to rescue
the city of Zion
and Jacob's descendants
who turn from sin.
21The Lord says: “My people,
I promise to give you my Spirit
and my message.
These will be my gifts to you
and your families forever.
I, the Lord, have spoken.”
translation_text:
Anebi na ka malga ŋ gbiti basa na be asheŋ lubi be asheŋ
1Men sa maa fɛ fanɛ Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na pɔ nna ga so nɛ e maaŋ tiŋ m mɔlga menyi ŋko mbe asoe ti nna so nɛ e maaŋ tiŋ n nu kushu nɛ menyee shu a fin kechɛto na! 2Menyi be alubi e barga menyi nɛ men be Ebɔrɛ be kefɛato. Amoso nɛ e maa nu menyi be kabɔrɛkule na. 3Ŋkpal manɛ so, menyi be mmalga kikɛ la efɛsheŋ nna nɛ menyi be ŋkre kikɛ la kebagato nɛ kelantokɔ be asheŋ. Basa be kamɔ damta so, ŋklaŋ gbiti menyi be enɔana nna.
4Men baŋ yɛra asheŋ demujikpa gba, men maa nya kashenteŋ ashi menyi be edemu be keji to. Efɛ nɛ menyee ku a ji lar edemuji na to. Basa be keji awurfoŋ be ŋkre e wɔ menyi to nɛ menyee wora a bɔlɔ so. 5-6Ŋkre lubi nɛ menyee kre na la kɔrtɔ nna fanɛ awɔ lubi be afule. Efule na be kekama bee bure kuwɔ nna! Ama menyi be ŋkre na maaŋ lɔŋɛ shɛŋ n sa menyi. A du fanɛ esa ka maaŋ tiŋ n ta enansatata n lue wajɛ nna! 7Jemanɛ kikɛ asheŋ lubi nɛ menyee kre nsaa nya manaŋ a wora amo. Basa nɛ b maŋ wora shɛŋ be kemɔ maŋ du menyi so kpakpa. Basa nɛ asɔ be kejija n lɛ nɛ kemur nɛ menyee yige kaman ashi kaplɛkama nɛ men yɔ. 8Menyi maŋ nyi kananɛ menyi nɛ beko beeŋ tiŋ n chena abar so nɛ kayurwushi, ŋko kananɛ baa ji kashenteŋ a sa basa pɔtɛ. Ekpaana nɛ menyee bɔla so a wora asheŋ kikɛ maŋ niŋi nɛ menyi be bebɛsopo malɛ maaŋ tiŋ n nya kayurwushi kebaawɔtɔ to kikɛ.
Basa ka bugi to ŋ kaŋɛ bumo be alubi be asheŋ
9Kede be kaman nɛ basa na kaŋɛ le: “Naniere nɛ an pin kusɔ nɛ k ba nɛ Ebɔrɛ maa mɔlga anyi ashi basa nɛ baa kɔrfɛ anyi na be enɔ to. An daa tama fanɛ anyeeŋ baa na kefulto to nna, ama tentembiri e kulti anyi n wɔtɔ 10nɛ anyee la a fin ekpa fanɛ etanpo. Kapiidi gba anyi maa wu ekpa to nsaa fiti fanɛ kanyɛso ŋko fanɛ an ka wɔ nchaŋ to na. 11Anyee munto nna fanɛ eshishiri nsaa shu fanɛ ali na. Anyi alɛ daa tama fanɛ Ebɔrɛ beeŋ mɔlga anyi ashi kanyaŋ nɛ alubi to, ama loŋ maŋ wora.
12An wora alubi damta ŋ gbiti fo, Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na. Anyi be alubi bee ji a bri anyi nna, nɛ anyi alɛ nyi amo kikɛ nyam be asheŋ. 13An lar fo kaman nseŋ kini fo a maa shuŋ fo. Anyi alɛ kɔrfɛ beko ga nseŋ shile fo. Anyi be nfɛra fɛso gba la kafulesheŋ nna nɛ anyi be mmalga malɛ maŋ la kashenteŋ. 14Keji asheŋ nɛ amo be ekpa so maŋ naa wɔtɔ, nɛ kewora kusɔ nɛ k daga gba maŋ wɔ anyi be kebaawɔtɔ to. Keji kashenteŋ kelɔnɛ so gba maŋ naa wɔtɔ ashi anyi to kuraa. 15Kashenteŋji ka maŋ naa wɔtɔ so, bekama nɛ b yige asheŋ lubi be kewora na bee luri asheŋ to nna.”
Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ ka beeŋ mɔlga mbe basa be asheŋ
Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na b kagbene daa maŋ fuli mo ŋkpal keji asheŋ nɛ amo be ekpa so ka maŋ naa wɔtɔ so. 16E ka wu fanɛ esa kikɛ maŋ wɔtɔ nɛ e wora kusɔ ko a laŋɛ kumo be kaplɛa so nɛ k jija mbe kagbene ga n ti so. Amoso e beeŋ bɔla mo gbagba be eleŋ so ŋ kɔ n suge basa nɛ baa kɔrfɛ na n yige nseŋ shin nɛ b kɔ m pɔɔ so. 17E beeŋ ta keji asheŋ nɛ amo be ekpa so m buu fanɛ enapo be kebɛlso be kekpaŋkale nɛ kumɔlga malɛ gba m buu fanɛ enapo be kebɛlso be kekpaŋwuro. Mo alɛ beeŋ naŋ ta kewora asheŋ ekpa nɛ k daga so kenishipereso fanɛ kusɔbuuso m buu nseŋ sɔ basa nɛ baa ji awurfoŋ be kɔnɔ so ŋ ka kulubi kukɔ. 18Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na beeŋ gberge mo doŋana nɛ b wɔ kufɔ nɛ bumo nɛ b taga to kikɛ kusoe agbo so, ŋkpal kusɔ nɛ b wora mbe basa so. 19Yili epeŋilarkpa m ba choŋ epeŋitɔrkpa, ekama beeŋ baa ŋana Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na nɛ mbe eleŋgboŋ nseŋ bunyaŋ mo. E beeŋ ba fanɛ lɔr to be nchu nɛ a bee shile eleŋso ŋko afugboŋ nɛ a bee ber eleŋso na.
20Ade kikɛ be kaman nɛ Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ naŋ kaŋɛ mbe basa le: “Meeŋ ba Jerusalɛm to m ba kɔ n sɔ menyi, Jeekɔb be kaman to ebi nɛ men lar menyi be alubi kikɛ to. 21Ma alɛ bee nase kɔnɔ nna fanɛ meeŋ sa menyi ma Kiyoyu nɛ keŋini nɛ a baa wɔ menyi to mbaanaayɔ. Yili kabre a yɔ, menyeeŋ baa wora ma kasonu nsaa ŋini menyi be mbia nɛ kaman to ebi nɛ bumo alɛ gba e baa wora ma kasonu mbaanaayɔ.”

english_text:
A New Day for Jerusalem
1Jerusalem, stand up! Shine!
Your new day is dawning.
The glory of the Lord
shines brightly on you.
2The earth and its people
are covered with darkness,
but the glory of the Lord
is shining upon you.
3Nations and kings
will come to the light
of your dawning day.
Crowds Are Coming to Jerusalem
The Lord said:
4 Open your eyes! Look around!
Crowds are coming.
Your sons are on their way
from distant lands;
your daughters are being carried
like little children.
5When you see this,
your faces will glow;
your hearts will pound
and swell with pride.
Treasures from across the sea
and the wealth of nations
will be brought to you.
6Your country will be covered
with caravans of young camels
from Midian and Ephah.
The people of Sheba
will bring gold and spices
in praise of me, the Lord.
7Every sheep of Kedar
will come to you;
rams from Nebaioth
will be yours as well.
I will accept them as offerings
and bring honor to my temple.
8What is that sailing by
like clouds
or like doves flying home?
9On those distant islands
your people are waiting
for me, the Lord.
Seagoing ships lead the way
to bring them home
with their silver and gold.
I, the holy Lord God of Israel,
do this to honor your people,
so they will honor me.
Jerusalem Will Be Rebuilt
The Lord said:
10Jerusalem, your city walls
will be rebuilt by foreigners;
their rulers will become
your slaves.
I punished you in my anger;
now I will be kind
and treat you with mercy.
11 Your gates will be open
day and night
to let the rulers of nations
lead their people to you
with all their treasures.
12Any nation or kingdom
that refuses to serve you
will be wiped out.
13Wood from Lebanon's best trees
will be brought to you—
the pines, the firs,
and the cypress trees.
It will be used in my temple
to make beautiful the place
where I rest my feet.
14 The descendants of enemies
who hated and mistreated you
will kneel at your feet.
They will say, “You are Zion,
the city of the Lord,
the holy One of Israel.”
15You were hated and deserted,
rejected by everyone.
But I will make you beautiful,
a city to be proud of
for all time to come.
16You will drain the wealth
of kings and foreign nations.
You will know that I,
the mighty Lord God of Israel,
have saved and rescued you.
17I will bring bronze and iron
in place of wood and stone;
in place of bronze and iron,
I will bring gold and silver.
I will appoint peace and justice
as your rulers and leaders.
18Violence, destruction, and ruin
will never again be heard of
within your borders.
“Victory” will be the name
you give to your walls;
“Praise” will be the name
you give to your gates.
19 You won't need the light
of the sun or the moon.
I, the Lord your God,
will be your eternal light
and bring you honor.
20Your sun will never set
or your moon go down.
I, the Lord, will be
your everlasting light,
and your days of sorrow
will come to an end.
21Your people will live right
and always own the land;
they are the trees I planted
to bring praise to me.
22Even the smallest family
will be a powerful nation.
I am the Lord,
and when the time comes,
I will quickly do all this.
translation_text:
Jerusalɛm be echefoso be kemaŋkura be asheŋ
1Jerusalɛmebi, men koso n nyɛkpɛ n fulto fanɛ epeŋi.
Karechɛ popɔr bee chɛ menyi so nna na.
Ŋkpal manɛ so, Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ
be kemaŋkura nyaŋɛ n yuu menyi so nna!
2Tentembiri beeŋ buu durnya nɛ kumo be basa kikɛ so.
Ama Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na be kemaŋkura be kefulto beeŋ nyaŋɛ
n yuu menyi ere so a ŋini fanɛ e wɔ menyi kutɔ.
3Efuli pɔtɛana be basa nɛ bewura kikɛ
beeŋ ba menyi be karechɛ popɔr na be kefulto to.
4Men keni ŋ kulti kusɔ nɛ k bee wora ere.
Menyi be basa bee gama abar so nna nɛ b bɛta m ba epe!
Menyi be mbinyɛnsobi beeŋ shi kufɔ, kufɔ m ba,
nɛ b keta menyi be mbichesobi enɔ to
fanɛ mbibi m ba sa menyi.
5Menyi alɛ beeŋ wu loŋ nɛ men be ŋgbene e fuli menyi ga.
Kagbenefuli be ga beeŋ shin nɛ men baa chicha.
Baaŋ sulɔ efuli pɔtɛana nɛ awɔ teku be kaba ndoŋ na
be asɔ lela nɛ kanya m ba sa menyi.
6Enyɔma be ntuŋ damta beeŋ shi efuliana nɛ baa tre
Midian nɛ Efa na so n sulɔ asɔ lela
m ba sɔ menyi be efuli na kikɛ so.
Beko beeŋ shi Shiba be kasawule so n sulɔ shuwa nɛ eduwu
m ba kaa lara esarga a sa Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na
nsaa malga kusɔ nɛ e wora be asheŋ!
7Baaŋ gama abonfu nɛ baa tre Kɛda nɛ Neboyot na
be mbolpɔ kikɛ abar so m ba sa menyi fanɛ esarga.
Ma, Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na malɛ beeŋ sɔ amo
fanɛ ma bɔrɛsure so be esarga,
nseŋ shin nɛ ma bɔrɛlambu e nya kemaŋkura n ti so.
8Manɛ e naa choŋ zii fanɛ awɔlpa,
ŋko fanɛ elepɔ ka mel abar so a firgi a yɔ asha to loŋ?
9Teku so be ekuloŋgboŋ nɛ e shi
aplasawule wɔfɔ wɔfɔ so nna.
Ebɔrɛ be basa nɛ e sulɔ a ba epe.
Bumo alɛ keta bumo be shuwa nɛ gbiti nna a ba.
Enyɛnpe Israɛl be Ebɔrɛ cheembi na
e shin nɛ loŋ wora nɛ mbe basa e nya kemaŋkura.
Saŋɛ na so baaŋ baa shuŋ mo nsaa bunyaŋ mo.
10Kumo be kaman nɛ Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ kaŋɛ Jerusalɛmebi le:
“Befɔ e naaŋ lɔŋɛ menyi be kadegboŋ be egbalana m pɔr,
nɛ bumo be bewura e shuŋ menyi be basa.
N daŋ nya agbo nna ŋ gberge menyi be basa kusoe,
ama naniere meeŋ shu menyi so nseŋ wu menyi kuwɔr.
11Kapa nɛ kanyɛ menyi be kadegboŋ na
be mbunagboŋ beeŋ baa bugi a yili.
Saŋɛ na so efuli pɔtɛana be bewura beeŋ juŋkpar
bumo be basa n sulɔ bumo be asɔ lela kikɛ
m ba sa menyi be basa.
12Ama efuli ŋko kuwurji kama be basa nɛ b maaŋ shuŋ
menyi be basa kikɛ beeŋ mur cheche kuraa.
13Baaŋ ku Lebanɔn be efuli so be ndibi lela
m ba lɔŋɛ menyi be kadegboŋ, Jerusalɛm be ebuana m pɔr
nseŋ shin nɛ ma bɔrɛlambu e nyalɛ kebita.
Saŋɛ na so ma kadegboŋ na gba beeŋ nya kemaŋkura.
14Kumo be kaman, men doŋana be kaman to ebi
beeŋ baa jɔŋɛ menyi ase a sa menyi bunyaŋ.
Bekama nɛ b daa keni menyi jiga beeŋ fara a bunyaŋ menyi,
nsaa tre menyi be kadegboŋ na Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na be Kadegboŋ;
ŋko Zayɔn, Israɛl be Ebɔrɛ cheembi na be Kadegboŋ.
15Menyi be kadegboŋ na maaŋ naa la kade nɛ ekama beeŋ kini n lɛ
nseŋ kishi kumo be asheŋ a maa sha kumo to be keba gba na.
Ama meeŋ shin nɛ k nyalɛ kebita nɛ kumo be ketre e dii.
K beeŋ ki kagbenewushi be kakpa n sa bekama
nɛ baaŋ chena kumo to nɛ bekama nɛ baaŋ
shir kaman m ba na kikɛ.
16Efuli pɔtɛana be bewura nɛ bumo be basa
beeŋ ta bumo be asɔ lela ŋ keni menyi be kadegboŋ na so,
fanɛ kananɛ ebinio bee bela mbe mbia na.
Saŋɛ na so nɛ men pin fanɛ ma, Enyɛnpetale
Israɛl be Ebɔrɛ na e mɔlga menyi nseŋ sɔ menyi n yige.
17Meeŋ sa menyi shuwa, mannɛ danyaŋ peper,
ŋko gbiti, mannɛ kebɛlso be yiri kama,
ŋko danyaŋ peper, mannɛ ndibi,
ŋko abɛlso be yiri yiri, mannɛ ajembu.
Menyi be bewura maaŋ naa kɔrfɛ menyi be basa.
Ma alɛ beeŋ shin nɛ b baa ji kuwura
ashi kashenteŋji nɛ kayurwushi be ekpa so.
18Esa maaŋ naŋ nu nlu kikɛ be asheŋ efuli na so.
Menyi be efuli na malɛ maaŋ naŋ mur kikɛ.
Meeŋ baa kuŋ menyi ekpa kama so fanɛ egbal na.
Saŋɛ na so menyi be basa beeŋ baa kpaŋ ma
ŋkpal ŋ ka mɔlga bumo so.
19Epeŋi nɛ kufɔl be kefulto be asheŋ maaŋ naa tir menyi.
Ŋkpal manɛ so, ma Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na be kemaŋkura
be kefulto e naaŋ baa nyaŋɛ a yuu menyi so mbaanaayɔ.
20Epeŋi nɛ kufɔl kikɛ maaŋ naŋ tɔr ashi Jerusalɛm to.
Ma, Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na e naaŋ baa la kumo be kefulto mbaanaayɔ;
saŋɛ na so menyi be kebɔltofinfin na kikɛ beeŋ fo ekar.
21Kumo be kaman nɛ menyi be basa kikɛ e chena
kasawule na so nsaa wora kusɔ nɛ k niŋi mbaanaayɔ.
B du fanɛ kedibi nɛ ŋ gbagba du ndoŋ
nɛ n lara ma keshi ŋ ŋini ekama nna.
22Bumo to be kanaŋ fimbi kama
beeŋ ki fanɛ efuli nɛ k kɔ eleŋ ga.
Ma e la Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ, nɛ jemanɛ na kaŋ fo
meeŋ shin nɛ kusɔ nɛ ŋ kaŋɛ na kikɛ e wora manaŋ.”

english_text:
The Good News of Victory
1 The Spirit of the Lord God
has taken control of me!
The Lord has chosen and sent me
to tell the oppressed
the good news,
to heal the brokenhearted,
and to announce freedom
for prisoners and captives.
2 This is the year
when the Lord God
will show kindness to us
and punish our enemies.
The Lord has sent me
to comfort those who mourn,
3especially in Jerusalem.
He sent me to give them flowers
in place of their sorrow,
olive oil in place of tears,
and joyous praise
in place of broken hearts.
They will be called
“Trees of Justice,”
planted by the Lord
to honor his name.
4Then they will rebuild cities
that have been in ruins
for many generations.
5They will hire foreigners
to take care of their sheep
and their vineyards.
6But they themselves will be
priests and servants
of the Lord our God.
The treasures of the nations
will belong to them,
and they will be famous.
7They were terribly insulted
and horribly mistreated;
now they will be greatly blessed
and joyful forever.
The Lord Loves Justice
8I, the Lord, love justice!
But I hate robbery
and injustice.
My people, I solemnly promise
to reward you
with an eternal agreement.
9Your descendants will be known
in every nation.
All who see them will realize
that they have been blessed,
by me, the Lord.
Celebrate and Shout
10 I celebrate and shout
because of my Lord God.
His saving power and justice
are the very clothes I wear.
They are more beautiful
than the jewelry worn
by a bride or groom.
11The Lord will bring about
justice and praise
in every nation on earth,
like flowers blooming
in a garden.
translation_text:
Kumɔlga be baru lela be asheŋ
1Enyɛnpetale Ebɔrɛ na be Kiyoyu wɔ ma so.
E lara ma nna n nɛfa ma nɛ m bɔ baru lela na
n sa betirpo, nseŋ chɛ bumo nɛ kagbenejija tɔr so na.
Mo e shuŋi ma nɛ n ya bɔ kesɔnyige be baru
n sa bumo nɛ b ki beko be anya,
nseŋ sɔ bumo nɛ b wɔ kabuti to n yige.
2E shuŋi ma nna nɛ m ba kaŋɛ basa fanɛ,
Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ be kumɔlga mbe basa
nseŋ kɔ m pɔɔ bumo doŋana so be jemanɛ fo.
Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na shuŋi ma nna nɛ m ba lolo
bumo nɛ baa shu nli,
3fɔŋfɔŋ bumo nɛ baa shu nli Jerusalɛm to na.
E yɛ, n sa basa kagbenefuli nɛ kagbenewushi;
mannɛ kagbenejija damta.
E yɛ, n sa bumo kapandi be nshɛ, mannɛ kebɔltofinfin.
Baaŋ baa du fanɛ ndibi nɛ Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ gbagba duu nna.
Bumo kikɛ beeŋ baa wora kusɔ nɛ k daga,
nseŋ kpaŋ Ebɔrɛ ŋkpal kusɔ nɛ e wora so.
4Kumo be kaman nɛ b lɔŋɛ m pɔr
ndegboŋ nɛ a bure n dese dra dra na kikɛ na.
5Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na be basa beeŋ ber befɔ paa,
nɛ befɔ na e baa keni bumo be mbolpɔ so,
nseŋ naa dɔ bumo be adɔjibi nɛ ndibi sɔrso be adɔ to.
6Ama Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na be basa bre beeŋ baa la
Ebɔrɛ be bɔrɛmatapoana nɛ mbe nyɛrbi nna.
Efuli pɔtɛana na be kanya nɛ kedama beeŋ ki mbe basa peya
nɛ bumo be ketre e dii nɛ b baa puchi amo so.
7Bumo be anishinyɔr nɛ ŋaba beeŋ fo ekar.
Baaŋ chena bumo gbagba be kasawule so
nɛ bumo be kanya nɛ kedama e daŋɛ so ntuŋ anyɔ so.
Bumo be kagbenewushi beeŋ baa wɔtɔ mbaanaayɔ.
8Ŋkpal manɛ so, Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na
bee sha kebaawora asheŋ nɛ amo be ekpa so nna.
Ama kasuge nɛ kapuni bre, e kishi amo.
Mo e nase mbe basa kɔnɔ kashenteŋto
fanɛ e beeŋ nɛfa bumo mbaanaayɔ na.
9Bumo be ketre beeŋ dii a chɔ efuli pɔtɛana peya.
Ekama nɛ e wu bumo beeŋ pin fanɛ
b la basa nɛ Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ nɛfa nna.
10Jerusalɛm bre bee ji eyur kagbenefuliso nna
ŋkpal kusɔ nɛ Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na wora so.
K du fanɛ kejafɔche ka ta mbe kejafɔ to be asɔbuuso
m buu mbe kejafɔachɛ na nna.
Ebɔrɛ ta kumɔlga nɛ kekɔmpɔɔso m buu
Jerusalɛm nna fanɛ piŋi.
11Kananɛ esa bee duu kusɔ nɛ k kɔr n daŋ nɛnɛ na,
nɛ Enyɛnpetale Ebɔrɛ na gba beeŋ mɔlga mbe basa
nseŋ shin nɛ b baa wɔ kebaawɔtɔ niŋiso to;
saŋɛ na so efuliana na be basa kikɛ beeŋ baa kpaŋ mo.

english_text:
Jerusalem Will Be Saved
1Jerusalem, I will speak up
for your good.
I will never be silent
till you are safe and secure,
sparkling like a flame.
2Your great victory will be seen
by every nation and king;
the Lord will even give you
a new name.
3You will be a glorious crown,
a royal headband
for the Lord your God.
4Your name will no longer be
“Deserted and Childless,”
but “Happily Married.”
You will please the Lord;
your country
will be his bride.
5Your people will take the land,
just as a young man
takes a bride.
The Lord will be pleased
because of you,
just as a husband is pleased
with his bride.
6Jerusalem, on your walls
I have stationed guards,
whose duty it is
to speak out day and night,
without resting.
They must remind the Lord
7and not let him rest
till he makes Jerusalem strong
and famous everywhere.
8The Lord has given his word
and made this promise:
“Never again will I give
to your enemies
the grain and grapes
for which you struggled.
9As surely as you harvest
your grain and grapes,
you will eat your bread
with thankful hearts,
and you will drink your wine
in my temple.”
10People of Jerusalem,
open your gates!
Repair the road to the city
and clear it of stones;
raise a banner to help
the nations find their way.
11 Here is what the Lord has said
for all the earth to hear:
“Soon I will come to save
the city of Zion
and to reward you.
12Then you will be called,
‘The Lord's Own People,
The Ones He Rescued!’
Your city will be known
as a good place to live
and a city full of people.”
translation_text:
Jerusalɛm ka beeŋ nya kumɔlga be asheŋ
1Meeŋ malga n leŋ Jerusalɛmebi to.
M maaŋ lo ma kɔnɔ kikɛ, ama b nya kumɔlga nna
nɛ bumo be kekɔmpɔɔso e dii efuli
fanɛ kabulpi nɛ k chɔɔ so kanyɛso
nɛ ekama wu kumo na nna.
2Efuli pɔtɛana na beeŋ wu kananɛ fo,
Jerusalɛm kɔ m pɔɔ so!
Bumo be bewura kikɛ beeŋ wu fo kemaŋkura.
Feeŋ nya ketre popɔr nɛ Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ gbagba beeŋ sa na.
3Feeŋ baa du fanɛ kuwurwuro lela kebita n sa Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na.
4Fo ketre maaŋ naa la Kini n lɛ.
Efuli na gba be ketre maaŋ naa la Eche nɛ b kini n lɛ.
Ama fo ketre popɔr e naaŋ baa la Ebɔrɛ be Kagbene fuli mo so.
Efuli na malɛ peya e naaŋ baa la Kagbenefuli be kakil.
Ŋkpal manɛ so, Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na be kagbene beeŋ fuli fo so;
mo alɛ beeŋ baa la fanɛ ekul n sa fo efuli na.
5Kananɛ kabrantiɛbia bee wora kasuŋgurbia
nɛ e maŋ nyi enyɛn kejafɔ a ta mo a ki mbe eche na
nɛ Ebɔrɛ nɛ e to fo na gba beeŋ kre fo kejafɔ nɛ fo ki mbe eche.
Kananɛ kejafɔ mo kul be kagbene bee fuli mbe kejafɔ so na,
nɛ Ebɔrɛ gba be kagbene beeŋ baa fuli fo so.
6Jerusalɛm, n shin nɛ basa yil fo egbalana so e keni ekpa to.
Kapa nɛ kanyɛ kikɛ, a maŋ daga b lo bumo be nnɔ kikɛ.
A daga fanɛ b baa shin nɛ Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ e baa nyiŋi
mbe nnɔ naseso na be asheŋ, nɛ e sa maŋ teŋ amo so kikɛ.
7B sa maŋ sa Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na ewushi kikɛ,
ama e bɛta Jerusalɛm nna n yili kumo be eyilikpa,
nseŋ shin nɛ k ki kadegboŋ nɛ durnya to
be basa kikɛ bee kpaŋ kumo na nna.
8Le nɛ Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na bɔ ntaŋ n nase kɔnɔ ŋ kaŋɛ:
“M maaŋ naŋ ta fo ayu n sa fo doŋana
fanɛ bumo be kusɔ jiso kikɛ;
befɔ malɛ maaŋ naŋ nya yabra nɛ fo gben
n wora na n nuu kikɛ.
9Ama fo nɛ fo dɔ ayu na n teŋi na e naaŋ ji amo
nseŋ di Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ epaŋ ŋkpal amo so.
Fo nɛ fo keni ndibi sɔrso na so nseŋ chuge amo be asɔrso na,
e naaŋ nu amo be yabra ashi ma bɔrɛlambu be kelɔnɛ so.”
10Jerusalɛmebi, men lar kadegboŋ na to
n ya lɔŋɛ ekpa n sa menyi be basa nɛ baa bɛta a ba na!
Men lɔŋɛ ekpagboŋ nɛ ajembu e sa maa wɔ kumo so.
Kumo be kaman nɛ men yili tuta nɛ k baa la tɔɔnɛ
n sa efuli pɔtɛana na nɛ b tiŋ n wu ekpa m bɔla so.
11Kusɔ nɛ Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na bee kaŋɛ
nsaa sha fanɛ durnya to be basa kikɛ e nu nde:
“Kaŋɛ basa nɛ b wɔ Jerusalɛm to fanɛ
Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na bee ba nɛ e ba mɔlga bumo.
Men keni, basa nɛ e sɔ n yige na nɛ e kɔ a ba.”
12Kumo be kaman nɛ b baa tre menyi, “Ebɔrɛ be Basa Cheembi.”
Ŋko Basa nɛ Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na mɔlga.
Baaŋ baa tre Jerusalɛm “Kadegboŋ nɛ Ebɔrɛ mɔlga.”
Ŋko “Kadegboŋ nɛ basa bɔlɔ kumo to.”

english_text:
The Lord's Victory over the Nations
1 Who is this coming
from Bozrah in Edom
with clothes stained red?
Who is this hero marching
in his glorious uniform?
“It's me, the Lord!
I have won the battle,
and I can save you!”
2What are those red spots?
Your clothes look stained
from trampling on grapes.
3 “I alone trampled the grapes!
None of the nations helped.
I trampled nations in my anger
and stained my clothes
with their blood.
4I did this because I wanted
to take revenge—
the time had come
to rescue my people.
5 No one was there to help me
or to give support;
my mighty arm won the battle,
strengthened by my anger.
6In my fury I trampled on nations
and made them drunk;
their blood poured out
everywhere on earth.”
The Lord's Goodness to His People
7I will tell about the kind deeds
the Lord has done.
They deserve praise!
The Lord has shown mercy
to the people of Israel;
he has been kind and good.
8The Lord rescued his people,
and said, “They are mine.
They won't betray me.”
9It troubled the Lord
to see them in trouble,
and his angel saved them.
The Lord was truly merciful,
so he rescued his people.
He took them in his arms
and carried them all those years.
10Then the Lord's people
turned against him and made
his Holy Spirit sad.
So he became their enemy
and attacked them.
11But his people remembered
what had happened
during the time of Moses.
Didn't the Lord bring them
and their leaders
safely through the sea?
Didn't he give them
his Holy Spirit?
12 The glorious power of the Lord
marched beside Moses.
The Lord will be praised forever
for dividing the sea.
13He led his people across
like horses running wild
without stumbling.
14His Spirit gave them rest,
just as cattle find rest
when led into a valley.
The name of the Lord was praised
for doing these things.
A Prayer for Mercy and Help
15Please, Lord, look down
from your holy and glorious
home in the heavens
and see what's going on.
Have you lost interest?
Where is your power?
Show that you care about us
and have mercy!
16 Our ancestors Abraham and Jacob
have both rejected us.
But you are still our Father;
you have been our protector
since ancient times.
17Why did you make us turn away
from you, our Lord?
Why did you make us want
to disobey you?
Please change your mind!
We are your servants,
your very own people.
18For a little while,
your temple belonged to us;
and now our enemies
have torn it down.
19We act as though you
had never ruled us
or called us your people.
translation_text:
Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ ka kɔ m pɔɔ efuli pɔtɛana so be asheŋ
1Wanɛ e shi Edɔm be efuli so be kadegboŋ nɛ baa tre Bozra na ŋ kre to nɛnɛ m buu epiŋi peper a tia aya eleŋ so a ba ere?
Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ nɛ e kɔ eleŋ ga nɛ e tiŋ m mɔlga basa na e naa ba nɛ e ba bɔ mbe kekɔmpɔɔso be kubɔya.
2“Manɛ e ba nɛ mbe asɔbuuso pere fanɛ esa nɛ e nyaŋ asɔrso nɛ baa tre greeps na n wora yabra loŋ?”
3Nɛ Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na kaŋɛ le: “Ma e nyaŋ efuliana na fanɛ asɔrso nɛ baa tre greeps na nɛ esa kikɛ maŋ chɛ ma to. N nya agbo nna n nyaŋ bumo fanɛ asɔrso, nɛ bumo be ŋklaŋ gbiti ma asɔbuuso. 4N wora loŋ nna nɛ m bishi kuwule n sa ma basa ashi bumo doŋana so a ŋini fanɛ jemanɛ fo nɛ m mɔlga bumo. 5K daŋ chinchiŋ ma nna fanɛ esa kikɛ ka daa maŋ wɔtɔ nɛ e chɛ ma to ŋko n wɔtɔ ma enɔ. Amoso ma agbo e wɔtɔ ma eleŋ n shin nɛ ŋ gbagba kɔ m pɔɔ so. 6Agbo so nɛ n daŋ chichi efuli pɔtɛana na so m mata kasawule nseŋ farnyaŋ bumo to n lɛ nɛ bumo be ŋklaŋ lar n wurge kasawule.”
Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ ka wora Israɛl kelela be asheŋ
7Meeŋ malga Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na be alelasheŋ be asheŋ
nseŋ kpaŋ mo ŋkpal asɔ nɛ e bee wora a sa anyi so.
E nɛfa Israɛl be basa ga nna
ŋkpal mbe kuwɔrwu nɛ kasha nɛ k wɔtɔ jemanɛ kikɛ na so.
8Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na daŋ mɔlga mbe basa nna nseŋ kaŋɛ le: “Kashenteŋto b la ma basa nna. B maaŋ ku efɛ n sa ma kikɛ.” 9Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na ka wu mbe basa ka wɔ etɔrɔ to nɛ k tɔrɔ mo ga nɛ e shuŋi mbe malaika nɛ e ba mɔlga bumo ashi awurfoŋ na to. Kashenteŋto Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na bee wu kuwɔr pasaa, amoso nɛ e kɔ n suge mbe basa na. Mbe enɔ to nɛ e keta bumo nfɛ damta nɛ a choŋ ere kikɛ na. 10Ade be kaman nɛ Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ be basa na lar mo kaman ŋ kilgi a kɔ mo nɛ mbe Kiyoyu Cheeŋ na be kagbene jija mo ga. Amoso Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ ki bumo doŋ nna nseŋ kɔ bumo.
11Ama Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na be basa naŋ nyiŋi asheŋ nɛ e wora bumo nananyɛn Mosis be jemanɛ nseŋ bishi le: “Nnɛ nɛ Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ nɛ e daŋ mɔlga mbe basa be bejuŋkparpoana ashi teku peper na to dra dra na wɔ? Nnɛ nɛ Ebɔrɛ nɛ e ta mbe Kiyoyu n sa Mosis na wɔ? 12Nnɛ nɛ Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ nɛ e bɔla Mosis so n ta mbe eleŋ n wora asheŋgboŋ n shin nɛ teku peper barga to anyɔ nɛ ekpa dese kumo to nɛ mbe ketre dii mbaanaayɔ na wɔ?” 13Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na ka daa juŋkpar bumo so, b daa kɔ eleŋ nna fanɛ egbaŋɛ ka yeŋ a shile nsaa maa fiti na nna. 14Kananɛ baa kpa ana a yɔ keplasawule so nɛ a bee nya a wushi na aloŋ nɛ Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na be Kiyoyu sa bumo ewushi. E daŋ juŋkpar mbe basa nna nɛ mbe ketre bɔla bumo so n nya kemaŋkura.
Kekule Ebɔrɛ n fin mbe kuwɔrwu nɛ kechɛto be asheŋ
15Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ, jande chena fo kuwurputigboŋ na so ashi fo kakpa cheembi nɛ k kɔ kemaŋkura na ŋ keni kusɔ nɛ k bee wora anyi. Fo shɛŋ maŋ naa wɔ anyi to nna a? Nnɛ nɛ fo eleŋgboŋ na wɔ? Ŋini anyi fanɛ anyi be asheŋ tir fo nseŋ wu anyi kuwɔr! 16Fo e la an tuto. K wora fanɛ Eebraham nɛ Jeekɔb nɛ b la an nananyɛnana na maŋ naa nyiŋi anyi be asheŋ. Ama fo, Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ nɛ fo la an tuto na e naa kuŋ anyi dra kikɛ hale m ba fo kabre. 17Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ, manɛ nna nɛ fo shin nɛ an foe n lar fo ekpa so n ta ŋkpensheŋ n shile fo? Jande bɛta m ba anyi kutɔ! An la fo nyɛrbi nɛ fo gbagba be basa nna.
18Jemanɛ nɛ k choŋ na fo bɔrɛlambu na daa la fo basa peya nna, ama naniere an doŋana ba bure kumo kikɛ n lɛ nseŋ chichi kumo so. 19Naniere fee wora anyi nna fanɛ fo ka maŋ naŋ ji kuwura anyi so ŋ ku so ŋko an ka daa maŋ la fo basa ŋ ku so na.

english_text:
1Rip the heavens apart!
Come down, Lord;
make the mountains tremble.
2Be a spark that starts a fire
causing water to boil.
Then your enemies will know
who you are;
all nations will tremble
because you are nearby.
3Your fearsome deeds
have completely amazed us;
even the mountains shake
when you come down.
4 You are the only God
ever seen or heard of
who works miracles
for his followers.
5You help all who gladly obey
and do what you want,
but sin makes you angry.
Only by your help
can we ever be saved.
6We are unfit to worship you;
each of our good deeds
is merely a filthy rag.
We dry up like leaves;
our sins are storm winds
sweeping us away.
7No one worships in your name
or remains faithful.
You have turned your back on us
and let our sins melt us away.
8You, Lord, are our Father.
We are nothing but clay,
but you are the potter
who molded us.
9Don't be so furious
or keep our sins
in your thoughts forever!
Remember that all of us
are your people.
10Every one of your towns
has turned into a desert,
especially Jerusalem.
11Zion's glorious and holy temple
where our ancestors praised you
has been destroyed by fire.
Our beautiful buildings
are now a pile of ruins.
12When you see these things,
how can you just sit there
and make us suffer more?
translation_text:
1Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ, bugi awɔlpa to nseŋ gbelge m ba nɛ kufu e pɛ abee nɛ a baa chicha. 2A beeŋ baa chicha fanɛ nchu ka bɛ edɛ so a falte na. Lara fo eleŋgboŋ ŋ ŋini fo doŋana n shin nɛ kufu e pɛ efuli pɔtɛana na nɛ bumo alɛ gba e baa chicha fo anishito! 3Jemanɛ ko daŋ fo nɛ fo wora asheŋgboŋ nɛ a bee mɔ kɔnɔ nɛ anyi daa maa fɛ fanɛ feeŋ wora amo. Abee ka wu fo nɛ kufu pɛ amo nɛ e bee chicha. 4Dra na kikɛ hale m ba fo kabre esa kikɛ maŋ naŋ wu ŋko n nu Ebɔrɛ ko nɛ e du fanɛ fo a tiŋ a wora emamachisheŋ a sa mbe bebɛsopo nɛ b ta bumo be tama n deŋi mo so. 5Bekama nɛ baa ta kagbenefuli a wora fo kasonu nsaa wora asɔ nɛ fee sha na, fo alɛ bee chɛ bumo to nna. Ama kulubi bre bee shin nɛ fo kagbene bee kaa nna. Fo nawule e naaŋ tiŋ n chɛ anyi to n shin nɛ an nya kumɔlga. 6Anyi kikɛ wora alubi ŋ ku so. Hale anyi be asheŋ lela gba du fanɛ achɛbi krenso ashi fo kutɔ nna. Anyi be alubi so, an du fanɛ afantaŋ wɔlso nɛ afu ber amo n ya lɛ nna. 7Esa kikɛ maŋ naa tre fo kabɔrɛkule to ŋko a fin fo kechɛto gba. Anyi be alubi so, fo ta fo kumu nna ŋ ŋana nseŋ kplaŋ anyi so.
8Ama fo, Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na e la an tuto. Anyi ere du fanɛ ebɔ nna nɛ fo alɛ du fanɛ mba nɛ mpuliya be epɔrpo. Fo e to anyi, 9amoso sa maŋ nya agbo ga n wɔtɔ anyi ŋko a nyiŋi anyi be alubi mbaanaayɔ. Baa nyiŋi fanɛ fo basa e la anyi kikɛ, amoso wu anyi kuwɔr. 10Fo ndegboŋ cheembiana na be kekama ki fanɛ keshishɛrsawule nna. Jerusalɛm ki kelambure nna nɛ ekama maŋ naa wɔ kumo to. 11Edɛ chɔɔ anyi be bɔrɛlambu nɛ k daa walɛ ga nsaa du cheembi nɛ an nanaana daa luri kumo to a bunyaŋ fo na m mur. Anyi be nwu lela nɛ an daa sha ga na kikɛ ki alambure m biti abar so a dese. 12O Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ, ade kikɛ maa gbuŋgbuŋ fo a? Ama feeŋ wora shruum ŋ kplaŋ anyi nɛ an baa wɔ kasogberge nɛ k shi m pɔɔ anyi so ere to a?

english_text:
The Lord Will Punish the Guilty
1 I, the Lord, was ready
to answer even those
who were not asking
and to be found by those
who were not searching.
To a nation that refused
to worship me,
I said, “Here I am!”
2 All day long I have reached out
to stubborn and sinful people
going their own way.
3They keep making me angry
by sneering at me,
while offering sacrifices
to idols in gardens
and burning incense
to them on bricks.
4They spend their nights
hiding in burial caves;
they eat the meat of pigs,
cooked in sauces
made of stuff unfit to eat.
5And then they say to others,
“Don't come near us!
We're dedicated to God.”
Such people are like smoke,
irritating my nose all day.
6I have written this down;
I won't keep silent.
I'll pay them back
just as their sins deserve.
7I, the Lord, will make them pay
for their sins and for those
of their ancestors—
they have disgraced me
by burning incense
on mountains.
8Here is what the Lord says:
A cluster of grapes
that produces wine
is worth keeping!
So, because of my servants,
I won't destroy everyone.
9I have chosen the people
of Israel and Judah,
and I will bless them
with many descendants.
They will settle here
in this land of mountains,
and it will be theirs.
10 My people will worship me.
Then the coastlands of Sharon
and the land as far
as Achor Valley
will turn into pastureland
where cattle and sheep
will feed and rest.
11What will I, the Lord, do
if any of you reject me
and my holy mountain?
What will happen to you
for offering food and wine
to the gods you call
“Good Luck” and “Fate”?
12Your luck will end!
I will see to it that you
are slaughtered with swords.
You refused to answer
when I called out;
you paid no attention
to my instructions.
Instead, you did what I hated,
knowing it was wrong.
13I, the Lord God, will give
food and drink to my servants,
and they will celebrate.
But all of you sinners
will go hungry and thirsty,
overcome with disgrace.
14My servants will laugh and sing,
but you will be sad
and cry out in pain.
15I, the Lord God, promise
to see that you are killed
and that my chosen servants use
your names as curse words.
But I will give new names
to my servants.
16I am God! I can be trusted.
Your past troubles are gone;
I no longer think of them.
When you pray for someone
to receive a blessing,
or when you make a promise,
you must do it in my name.
I alone am the God
who can be trusted.
The Lord's New Creation
17 I am creating new heavens
and a new earth;
everything of the past
will be forgotten.
18Celebrate and be glad forever!
I am creating a Jerusalem,
full of happy people.
19 I will celebrate with Jerusalem
and all its people;
there will be no more crying
or sorrow in that city.
20No child will die in infancy;
everyone will live
a very long life.
Anyone a hundred years old
will be considered young,
and to die younger than that
will be considered a curse.
21My people will live
in the houses they build;
they will enjoy grapes
from their own vineyards.
22No one will take away
their homes or vineyards.
My chosen people will live
to be as old as trees,
and they will enjoy
what they have earned.
23Their work won't be wasted,
and their children won't die
of dreadful diseases.
I will bless their children
and their grandchildren.
24I will answer their prayers
before they finish praying.
25 Wolves and lambs
will graze together;
lions and oxen
will feed on straw.
Snakes will eat only dirt!
They won't bite or harm anyone
on my holy mountain.
I, the Lord, have spoken!
translation_text:
Ebɔrɛ ka beeŋ gberge basa nɛ b lar mo kaman kusoe be asheŋ
1Ade kikɛ be kaman nɛ Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na kaŋɛ le: “N daŋ wora shiriya nɛ n nu ma basa be kabɔrɛkule nna, ama b maŋ kule ma. Ma alɛ daŋ naŋ wora shiriya nɛ n lara ma kumu ŋ ŋini bumo, ama b maŋ wora ania nɛ b fin ma gba kuraa. Ŋ ka wora shiriya nɛ n shuli so ŋ kaŋɛ fanɛ ‘ma nde, meeŋ chɛ menyi to na gba’, efuli na be basa na maŋ kule n fin ma kechɛto. 2Jemanɛ kikɛ ma ere wora shiriya nɛ n sɔ ma basa kpeŋso nɛ b sɔ bumo gbagba be ekpa a wɔtɔ a wora asheŋ lubi na nna. 3B paŋ nyɔmɔ nna a wɔtɔ a shin nɛ ma kagbene bee kaa. Ŋkpal manɛ so, b wɔtɔ nna a lara esarga a sa agbir ashi adɔbi to nsaa chɔɔ eduwu agbirsure nɛ b ta ebirkesi m pɔr so a sa amo. 4Kanyɛso malɛ baa yɔ nchaŋ ase nna n ya kaa bishi so a fin abuniyoyu be kechɛto. Bumo alɛ naa we epreku be eblaŋ nna nsaa fe asɔbɔya nɛ b ta n lara esarga n sa agbir be epochu.” 5Ade be kaman nɛ b kaŋɛ basa pɔtɛ le: “Men sa maa mata anyi, an du cheembi ga nɛ men baa bɛta anyi!” Le be basa du fanɛ edishi nna a luri ma kamuna to a kpar ma. Ma agbo a laŋɛ bumo be kaplɛa so, du fanɛ edɛ nɛ k maa duŋ kikɛ na nna.
6N tiŋ ŋ kre bumo be kasogberge nseŋ sibɛ kusɔ nɛ k beeŋ wora bumo n nase. M maaŋ kplaŋ kusɔ nɛ b wora na so, ama meeŋ ka bumo kukɔ 7ŋkpal bumo gbagba nɛ bumo nanaana be alubi so. B shuŋ agbir nseŋ chɔɔ eduwu n sa amo ashi abee so a malga a jija ma ketre. Amoso meeŋ keni bumo be asheŋ dra so ŋ gberge bumo kusoe kananɛ k daga bumo.
8Ade kikɛ be kaman nɛ Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na naŋ kaŋɛ le: “Esa kikɛ maaŋ shuli n ta asɔrso nɛ baa tre greep na be alela n lɛ, ama e beeŋ ta amo n wora yabra nna. To, ma alɛ gba maaŋ shuli m mur ma basa kikɛ, ama meeŋ mɔlga bumo nɛ baa shuŋ ma na. 9Meeŋ nɛfa Israɛl nɛ Juda be basa nseŋ shin nɛ ma kasawule nɛ k kɔ abee na e ki bumo be kaman to ebi peya. Saŋɛ na so ma basa laraso nɛ baa shuŋ ma na beeŋ chena kumo so. 10Kumo be kaman nɛ b baa shuŋ ma, Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na ashi ndoŋ nsaa kpa bumo be mbolpɔ nɛ ana a yɔ Sharɔn be keplasawule nɛ k wɔ kasawule na be epeŋitɔrkpa be kaba so nɛ b ya ji afitiri lela nɛ Akɔ be Ketaŋɛ nɛ kumo alɛ wɔ epeŋilarkpa be kaba so na so.
11Ama asheŋ maaŋ baa du loŋ n sa menyi nɛ men kini ma nɛ ma kebee cheembi nɛ baa tre Zayɔn na nsaa shuŋ agbir nɛ baa tre Gad nɛ Meni na. Amo be afito la Kumulela nɛ Kela m ba. 12Menyi be kumulela beeŋ fo ekar nɛ m bugi ekpa n shin nɛ b ta etokobi m mɔ menyi. Ŋkpal manɛ so, ŋ ka tre menyi men kini keshuli nna; menyi alɛ maŋ naŋ wɔtɔ lakal kusɔ nɛ ŋ ŋini menyi na to. Ama asɔ nɛ ŋ kishi nɛ menyi alɛ nyi k ka la kulubi na nɛ men wora.” 13Kumo be kaman nɛ Enyɛnpetale Ebɔrɛ na naŋ kaŋɛ le: “Basa kama nɛ baa shuŋ ma nsaa wora ma kasonu na beeŋ nya n ji nseŋ nuu yilayilaso, ama akoŋ nɛ achukoŋ e naaŋ mɔ menyi alubiworapoana bre. Bumo be ŋgbene beeŋ fuli bumo ama menyi ere beeŋ ji anishinyɔr. 14Ma nyɛrbi beeŋ baa mushe nsaa boŋ nshɛ kagbenefuliso, ama menyi ere be ŋgbene beeŋ jija menyi nɛ men baa shu. 15Ma, Enyɛnpetale Ebɔrɛ na beeŋ shin nɛ men wu nɛ ma basa laraso e ta menyi be atre a sho basa nnɔ. Ama meeŋ sa basa nɛ baa nu a sa ma na bre atre popɔr. 16Esa kama nɛ e bee sha nɛfa ashi kasawule na so beeŋ kule Ebɔrɛ nɛ e bee ji kashenteŋ na nɛ e nɛfa mo. Ekama malɛ nɛ e bee sha kenase kɔnɔ e beeŋ nase kɔnɔ na kashenteŋji be Ebɔrɛ na be ketre to nna. Ŋkpal manɛ so, etɔrɔ dra na kikɛ choŋ nɛ n teŋ amo so.”
Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na be apɔrso popɔr be asheŋ
17Ade kikɛ be kaman nɛ Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na naŋ kaŋɛ le: “Mee to durnya nɛ ebɔrɛso popɔr nna. Asheŋ dra na kikɛ choŋ nɛ n teŋ amo so kuraa. 18Meeŋ shin nɛ menyi be ŋgbene e fuli menyi nɛ men baa ji eyur hale mbaanaayɔ ŋkpal asɔ nɛ meeŋ to so. Kagbenefuli beeŋ bɔlɔ Jerusalɛm popɔr nɛ meeŋ to na to nɛ kumo to be basa be ŋgbene e fuli bumo. 19Ŋ gbagba be kagbene beeŋ fuli ma ŋkpal Jerusalɛm nɛ kumo be basa so. Kushu nɛ kebɔltofinfin maaŋ naa wɔ ndoŋ. 20Mbi popɔrbi be luwu maaŋ naa wɔtɔ. Basa kikɛ beeŋ chena n fo bumo be nchɛ be ekar pɔɛŋ nseŋ wu. Basa nɛ b ji nfɛ kalfa gba beeŋ baa du fanɛ mbifɔlbi. Basa nɛ b maaŋ fo nfɛ kalfa pɔɛŋ nseŋ wu na, baaŋ wu bumo be luwu na fanɛ kɔnɔsho be luwu. 21-22Basa beeŋ pɔr nwu n chena amo to bumo gbagba, mannɛ esa pɔtɛ e naaŋ chena amo to. Bumo alɛ beeŋ dɔ ndibi sɔrso be adɔ nseŋ nya amo be asɔrso be yabra n nu nɛ mannɛ basa pɔtɛ e naaŋ nu amo. Ma basa beeŋ chena n chɛr fanɛ ndibi. Baaŋ ji bumo be kegben be tɔnɔ nɛnɛ ga. 23Bumo be ashuŋ beeŋ nyalɛ n sa bumo nɛ bumo be mbia malɛ maaŋ naaŋ lɔ alɔ lubi n wu. Meeŋ nɛfa bumo nɛ bumo be kaman to ebi kikɛ. 24Pɔɛŋ nɛ baaŋ kule ma kusɔ kama gba nɛ n tiŋ n nu bumo be kekule. 25Ekuŋtuŋ nɛ mbolpɔ fɔlbi beeŋ tu abar a ji nɛ ebuluŋ e ji afitiri fanɛ ana. Awɔ beeŋ baa ji eshishɛr, amo alɛ maaŋ naa duŋ basa a mɔ. Kusɔ lubi kikɛ maaŋ naa wɔ ma kebee cheembi nɛ baa tre Zayɔn na so. Ma, Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ e kaŋɛ na.”

english_text:
True Worship
1 The Lord said:
Heaven is my throne;
the earth is my footstool.
What kind of house
could you build for me?
In what place will I rest?
2I have made everything;
that's how it all came to be.
I, the Lord, have spoken.
The people I treasure most
are the humble—
they depend only on me
and tremble when I speak.
3You sacrifice oxen to me,
and you commit murder;
you sacrifice lambs to me
and dogs to other gods;
you offer grain to me
and pigs' blood to idols;
you burn incense to me
and praise your idols.
You have made your own choice
to do these disgusting things
that you enjoy so much.
4You refused to answer
when I called out;
you paid no attention
to my instructions.
Instead, you did what I hated,
knowing it was wrong.
Now I will punish you
in a way you dread the most.
The Lord Will Help Jerusalem
5If you tremble
when the Lord speaks,
listen to what he says:
“Some of your own people hate
and reject you because of me.
They make fun and say,
‘Let the Lord show his power!
Let us see him
make you truly happy.’
But those who say these things
will be terribly ashamed.”
6Do you hear that noise
in the city and those shouts
coming from the temple?
It is the Lord shouting
as he punishes his enemies.
7 Have you ever heard of a woman
who gave birth to a child
before having labor pains?
8Who ever heard of such a thing
or imagined it could happen?
Can a nation be born in a day
or come to life in a second?
Jerusalem is like a mother
who gave birth to her children
as soon as she was in labor.
9The Lord is the one
who makes birth possible.
And he will see that Zion
has many more children.
The Lord has spoken.
10If you love Jerusalem,
celebrate and shout!
If you were in sorrow
because of the city,
you can now be glad.
11She will nurse and comfort you,
just like your own mother,
until you are satisfied.
You will fully enjoy
her wonderful glory.
12The Lord has promised:
“I will flood Jerusalem
with the wealth of nations
and make the city prosper.
Zion will nurse you at her breast,
carry you in her arms,
and hold you in her lap.
13I will comfort you there
like a mother
comforting her child.”
14When you see this happen,
you will celebrate;
your strength will return
faster than grass can sprout.
Then everyone will know
that the Lord provides help
for his servants,
but he is angry
with his enemies.
15The Lord will come down
like a whirlwind
with his flaming chariots.
He will be furiously angry
and punish his enemies
with fire.
16The Lord's fiery sword
will bring justice
everywhere on this earth
and execute many people.
A Threat and a Promise
17Some of you get yourselves ready and go to a garden to worship a foreign goddess. You eat the meat of pigs, lizards, and mice. But I, the Lord, will destroy you for this.
18I know everything you do and think! The time has now come to bring together the people of every language and nation and to show them my glory 19by proving what I can do. I will send the survivors to Tarshish, Pul, Lud, Meshech, Tubal, Javan, and to the distant islands. I will send them to announce my wonderful glory to nations that have never heard about me.
20They will bring your relatives from the nations as an offering to me, the Lord. They will come to Jerusalem, my holy mountain, on horses, chariots, wagons, mules, and camels. It will be like the people of Israel bringing the right offering to my temple. 21I promise that some of them will be priests and others will be helpers in my temple. I, the Lord, have spoken.
22 I also promise that you will always have descendants and will never be forgotten, just as the new heavens and the new earth that I create will last forever. 23On the first day of each month and on each Sabbath, everyone will worship me. I, the Lord, have spoken.
24 My people will go out and look at the dead bodies of those who turned against me. The worms there never die, the fire never stops burning, and the sight of those bodies will be disgusting to everyone.
translation_text:
Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na ka ji efuliana na demu be asheŋ
1Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ yɛ: “Ebɔrɛso e la ma kuwurjiakpa nɛ kasawule so malɛ la ma aya be kusɔ yiliso so. Nɛ nuso be ebu nɛ menyeeŋ naŋ pɔr n sa ma nɛ n naŋ chena to ŋko nnɛ nɛ meeŋ naŋ chena n wushi? 2Ma e to durnya kikɛ nseŋ shin nɛ kusɔ kikɛ wɔtɔ. Basa nɛ bumo be asheŋ bee par ma nɛ mee keni bumo a bɔlɔ kenishi, e la basa nɛ baa bar bumo be amu kaseto nsaa tuba ashi bumo be alubi to ŋko bumo nɛ baa ŋana ma nsaa wora ma kasonu na.
3Basa kikɛ bee wora bumo be aparsheŋ nna nsaa wɔtɔ a wora mbushusheŋ kananɛ baa sha. Ŋkpal loŋ so, esa kama nɛ e ta gbolu n lara sarga n sa ma nɛ esa nɛ e mɔ esa kikɛ la kukoŋwule nna; nɛ emo nɛ e ta kpakpafɔlbi n lara sarga malɛ nɛ esa nɛ e kii jɔnɔ be kubɔ to m mɔ gba la kukoŋwule nna. Bekama malɛ nɛ baa ta ayu a lara esarga a sa ma nɛ basa nɛ baa ta epreku be ŋklaŋ a lara esarga kikɛ la kukoŋwule nna ashi ma anishito. Esa nɛ e bee chɔɔ duwu a lara sarga a sa ma nɛ emo nɛ e bee shuŋ agbir kikɛ la kukoŋwule nna. 4Amoso meeŋ gberge bumo kusoe n shin nɛ kusɔ nɛ baa ŋana e ba bumo so, ŋkpal manɛ so, ŋ ka tre bumo, ekama maŋ shuli ŋko n nu kusɔ nɛ ŋ kaŋɛ na. B kini kewora ma kasonu nna nsaa wɔtɔ a wora asɔ nɛ ŋ kishi.”
5Menyi nɛ menyee ŋana Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ nsaa wora mo kasonu na e nu kusɔ nɛ e kaŋɛ. E yɛ: “Ŋkpal men ka bee ji kashenteŋ a sa ma so, menyi gbagba be basa ko kishi menyi nna a maa sha ketu menyi n wora shɛŋ. Baa wora menyi eyurto nna a kaŋɛ le: ‘Men shin nɛ Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na e ŋini mbe eleŋgboŋ nseŋ mɔlga menyi, saŋɛ na so anyeeŋ wu fanɛ menyi be ŋgbene fuli menyi.’ Ama bumo gbagba beeŋ ji anishinyɔr!” 6Men nu awɔr nɛ k shi kadegboŋ na nɛ bɔrɛlambu na to a ba! Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na be bedoŋana be kasogberge be awɔr nɛ menyee nu na.
7Men daŋ nu fanɛ eche bee kurge nna pɔɛŋ nsaa nu kakurge be ebesa a? 8Wanɛ e daŋ nu ŋko n wu loŋ ŋ ku so? Kachɛ koŋwule nɛ efuli bee ta a ki efuli nɛ basa wɔ kumo to ŋko epul to nɛ loŋ bee wora? Ama Jerusalɛm bre du fanɛ eche nɛ kakurge ta mo nɛ e kurge kebia epul na to nna. 9Kumo be kaman nɛ Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na naŋ kaŋɛ: “Men sa maa fɛ fanɛ meeŋ shin nɛ ma basa be kakurgeachɛ e fo nɛ m maaŋ shin nɛ b tiŋ ŋ kurge bumo.”
10Menyi kikɛ nɛ menyee sha Jerusalɛm be kadegboŋ be asheŋ,
men tu kumo n ji eyur!
Menyi nɛ menyi be ŋgbene jija ŋkpal kumo so na
e tu kumo n ji eyur naniere!
11Ŋkpal manɛ so, kumo be kemaŋkura nɛ kedamaya kikɛ
beeŋ suse menyi alɛ gba
fanɛ kananɛ kebibi bee nya a nyipo mo nio be anyipo na.
12Kusɔ nɛ Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ naŋ kaŋɛ nde: “Meeŋ shin nɛ efuli pɔtɛana so be asɔ lela e ba bɔlɔ Jerusalɛm to nɛ k dii dama fanɛ kananɛ lɔr bee bɔlɔ nchu a dii kepla so na. Menyeeŋ baa du fanɛ kebia nɛ mo nio bee nyipo mo nsaa ŋini mo kasha na nna. 13Kananɛ ebinio bee lolo mbe kebia na nɛ ma alɛ gba beeŋ baa lolo menyi ashi Jerusalɛm to. 14Men kaŋ wu le ka bee wora, menyi be ŋgbene beeŋ fuli menyi nɛ men nya eleŋ nɛ alenfia. Aloŋ nɛ menyeeŋ pin fanɛ ma, Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na bee chɛ basa nɛ baa wora ma kasonu na to nna; ma alɛ nsaa shin nɛ ma agbo bee ba n doŋana so.”
15Keni, Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na kɔ edɛ nna a ba. E beeŋ ta mbe gbaŋɛturko nɛ k bee kpa edɛ na m bɔla kawuliwuli so m ba. E nya agbo nna ga a ba nɛ e ba ta edɛ ŋ gberge mo doŋana kusoe. 16Edɛ nɛ tokobi nɛ Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na kɔ ba nɛ e ba ji durnya to be basa kikɛ demu nɛ basa damta nɛ baaŋ ji n tɔr na e wu.
17Menyi to be beko bee bela ase nna a yɔ adɔbi to n ya kaa shuŋ efuli pɔtɛana so be agbir cheso. Menyi alɛ bee ji epreku nɛ eshiboe nɛ asɔ damta nɛ a la ekishi n sa menyi na nna. Ma, Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na beeŋ mur menyi ŋkpal loŋ so. 18N nyi asɔ nɛ menyee fɛ nsaa wora kikɛ! Naniere jemanɛ fo nɛ ŋ gama efuli pɔtɛana na be basa nɛ bumo nɛ baa gbar ŋgbar pɔtɛ na abar so nɛ b ba wu ma kemaŋkura, 19nseŋ pin fanɛ ma e naa gberge bumo kusoe.
Ama meeŋ yige bumo be beko nseŋ yɛr bumo efuli pɔtɛana fanɛ Speen nɛ Libiya nɛ Tubal nɛ Griis nɛ nsawule nɛ a wɔ kufɔ kufɔ nɛ b maŋ naŋ nu ma asheŋ ŋko n wu ma keshi nɛ eleŋgboŋ na so. Baaŋ ya bɔ ma kemaŋkura nɛ keshi be kubɔya n sa ndoŋebi. 20Bumo alɛ beeŋ bɛta men kurgepoana ashi efuliana na so fanɛ kakɛ m ba sa Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na. Egbaŋɛ nɛ egbaŋɛturko nɛ ekurma nɛ enyɔma nɛ baaŋ dii m ba ma kebee cheembi so ashi Jerusalɛm to fanɛ kananɛ Israɛlebi bee ta bumo be ayu be esarga ekpa nɛ k daga so ashi ma bɔrɛlambu to na. 21Ma, Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na beeŋ lara bumo be beko nɛ b baa la bɔrɛmatapoana nɛ beko malɛ e baa la bechɛtopo ashi ma bɔrɛlambu to.
22Ade be kaman nɛ Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na naaŋ kaŋɛ le: “Kananɛ ebɔrɛso popɔr nɛ kasawule popɔr nɛ meeŋ to na beeŋ bɔla ma eleŋgboŋ so a wɔtɔ mbaanaayɔ na, nɛ menyi alɛ gba be ketre nɛ kaman to ebi beeŋ baa wɔtɔ mbaanaayɔ. 23Kufɔl popɔr be kejigboŋ kikɛ be jemanɛ nɛ kewushiachɛ kikɛ nɛ men gama a shuŋ ma, efuli pɔtɛana so be basa gba beeŋ ba shuŋ ma ashi Jerusalɛm to. 24Kumo be kaman nɛ ma basa e lar kowu n ya wu basa nɛ b lar ma kaman ŋ kilgi a kɔ ma na be kebuniana. Ashushombi nɛ a beeŋ ji bumo na maaŋ wu kikɛ. Edɛ nɛ a beeŋ chɔɔ bumo m mur na malɛ gba maaŋ duŋ kikɛ. Bumo be asheŋ beeŋ keta ekama nɛ e beeŋ wu bumo kenishiso kejija.”
