20But you did something even worse than that—you sacrificed your own children to those idols! 21You slaughtered my children, so you could offer them as sacrifices. 22You were so busy sinning and being a prostitute that you refused to think about the days when you were young and were rolling around naked in your own blood.
23Now I, the Lord God, say you are doomed! Not only did you do these evil things, 24but you also built places on every street corner 25where you disgraced yourself by having sex with anyone who walked by. And you did that more and more every day! 26To make me angry, you even offered yourself to Egyptians, who were always ready to sleep with you.
27So I punished you by letting those greedy Philistine enemies take over some of your territory. But even they were offended by your repulsive behavior.
28You couldn't get enough sex, so you chased after Assyrians and slept with them. You still weren't satisfied, 29so you went after Babylonians. But those merchants could not satisfy you either.
30I, the Lord God, say that you were so disgusting that you would have done anything to get what you wanted. 31You had sex on every street corner, and when you finished, you refused to accept money. That's worse than being a prostitute! 32You are nothing but an unfaithful wife who would rather have sex with strangers than with your own husband. 33Prostitutes accept money for having sex, but you bribe men from everywhere to have sex with you. 34You're not like other prostitutes. Men don't ask you for sex—you offer to pay them!
Jerusalem Must Be Punished
The Lord said:
35Jerusalem, you prostitute, listen to me. 36You chased after lovers, then took off your clothes and had sex. You even worshiped disgusting idols and sacrificed your own children as offerings to them. 37So I, the Lord God, will gather every one of your lovers, those you liked and those you hated. They will stand around you, and I will rip off your clothes and let all of those lovers stare at your nakedness. 38I will find you guilty of being an unfaithful wife and a murderer, and in my fierce anger I will sentence you to a violent death! 39Then I will hand you over to your lovers, who will tear down the places where you had sex. They will take your clothes and jewelry, leaving you naked and empty-handed.
40Your lovers and an angry mob will stone you to death; they will cut your dead body into pieces 41and burn down your houses. Other women will watch these terrible things happen to you. I promise to stop you from being a prostitute and paying your lovers for sex.
42Only then will I calm down and stop being angry and jealous. 43You made me furious by doing all these disgusting things and by forgetting how I took care of you when you were young. Then you made things worse by acting like a prostitute. You must be punished! I, the Lord God, have spoken.
Jerusalem's Two Sisters
The Lord said:
44People will use this saying about you, Jerusalem: “If the mother is bad, so is her daughter.” 45You are just like your mother, who hated her husband and her own children. You are also like your sisters, who hated their husbands and children. Your father was an Amorite, and your mother was a Hittite. 46Your older sister was Samaria, that city to your north with her nearby villages. Your younger sister was Sodom, that city to your south with her nearby villages. 47You followed their way of life and their wicked customs, and soon you were more repulsive than they were.
48As surely as I am the living Lord God, the people of Sodom and its nearby villages were never as sinful as you. 49They were arrogant and spoiled; they had everything they needed and still refused to help the poor and needy. 50They thought they were better than everyone else, and they did things I hate. And so I destroyed them.
51You people of Jerusalem have sinned twice as much as the people of Samaria. In fact, your evil ways have made both Sodom and Samaria look innocent. 52So their punishment will seem light compared to yours. You will be disgraced and put to shame because of your disgusting sins.
Jerusalem Will Be Ashamed
The Lord said to Jerusalem:
53Someday I will bless Sodom and Samaria and their nearby villages. I will also bless you, Jerusalem. 54Then you will be ashamed of how you've acted, and Sodom and Samaria will be relieved that they weren't as sinful as you. 55When that day comes, you and Sodom and Samaria will once again be well-off, and all nearby villages will be restored.
56Jerusalem, you were so arrogant that you sneered at Sodom. 57But now everyone has learned how wicked you really are. The countries of Syria and Philistia, as well as your other neighbors, hate you and make insulting remarks. 58You must pay for all the vulgar and disgusting things you have done. I, the Lord, have spoken.
The Lord Makes a Promise to Jerusalem
The Lord said:
59Jerusalem, you deserve to be punished, because you broke your promises and ignored our agreement. 60But I remember the agreement I made with you when you were young, and so I will make you a promise that will last forever. 61When you think about how you acted, you will be ashamed, especially when I return your sisters to you as daughters, even though this was not part of our agreement. 62I will keep this solemn promise, and you will know that I am the Lord. 63I will forgive you, but you will think about your sins and be too ashamed to say a word. I, the Lord God, have spoken.
translation_text:
Jerusalɛm ka maŋ ji kashenteŋ n sa Ebɔrɛ be asheŋ
1Nɛ Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na kaŋɛ ma le: 2“Dimɛdi pibi, Ezikɛl, shin nɛ Jerusalɛm be basa e pin ekishisheŋ nɛ baa wora na be asheŋ, 3nseŋ kaŋɛ bumo kusɔ nɛ ma, Enyɛnpetale Ebɔrɛ na bee kaŋɛ a laŋɛ Jerusalɛm be kaplɛa so na fanɛ Keenan be kasawule so nɛ b kurge fo nɛ fo tuto la Amɔri be esa nɛ fo nio malɛ la Hiti be esa. 4Kachɛ nɛ b kurge fo, esa kikɛ maŋ ku fo enyaŋ, ŋko m bɛr fo nchu ŋko n wora nfɔl ŋ gbiti fo eyur so ŋko n ta wajɛ m buu fo so. 5Esa kikɛ daa maŋ wu fo kuwɔr gba a bishi nɛ e bee wora fo asheŋ ere be kekama. Kachɛ nɛ b kurge fo gbagba na esa kikɛ maŋ nya kasha n sa fo. B ta fo nna n lɛ kupuŋ to.
6Ndoŋ nna nɛ m bɔla ndoŋ a choŋ nseŋ wu fo nɛ fo dese fo gbagba be ŋklaŋ to a to aya to nɛ ŋ kaŋɛ fanɛ m maaŋ shin nɛ fo wu. 7Kumo be kaman nɛ n ta fo n ya bela fo fanɛ kusɔ duuso popɔrbi na. Ndoŋ nna nɛ fo daŋ nɛnɛ ŋ ki suŋguru n nyalɛ kebita. Nɛ fo anyipo koso n yili fo kagbene to nɛ fo emin daŋ m ba buu fo abatimu so, ama nɛ fo kraa maa dela shɛŋ.
8Ŋ ka naŋ ba wu fo nɛ m pin fanɛ naniere fo ki eche nna n loge na, nɛ n ta ŋ gbagba be kusɔbuuso m buu fo kayurkpaŋ so. Kumo be kaman nɛ n nase kɔnɔ n sa fo nseŋ bɔ ntaŋ fanɛ feeŋ baa la meya nɛ ma, Enyɛnpetale Ebɔrɛ na e baa keni fo so.
9Kumo be kaman nɛ m bɛr fo nchu n fɔr fo ŋklaŋ na kikɛ nseŋ gbiti fo ɔlif be ŋku. 10Kumo be kaman nɛ n ta kale nɛ b jɔɔ m buu fo nseŋ wɔtɔ fo asɔbɔya be kawɔl lela be asɛbta. Nseŋ naŋ sa fo chimu nɛ k bee nyɛkpɛso pɛlpɛl nɛ fo chɛ nɛ yawu kpakpaso be epiŋi. 11Ade kikɛ be kaman nɛ n sa fo enɔ to be mpinibi nɛ kubɔtoshembi 12nɛ kamuna to be kepinibi nɛ akonde nɛ kuwurwuro lela ga nɛ fo ta m buu fo kumu so. 13Shuwa nɛ gbiti be abitasɔ nɛ fo daa wɔtɔ nsaa buu epiŋi nɛ b jɔɔ nɛ yawu kpakpaso be asɔbuuso. Nyifu lela nɛ fo daa ta a wora bodobodo nseŋ daa ji mushoŋ nɛ ɔlif be ŋku. Ŋkpal loŋ so, nɛ fo kebita lar nɛnɛ nɛ fo ki ewurche. 14Ndoŋ nna nɛ fo asheŋ sɔ kaplɛkama nɛ ekama bee ji fo kebita be asheŋ ashi efuliana na kikɛ so, ŋkpal kananɛ ma, Enyɛnpetale Ebɔrɛ na shin nɛ fo kela lar nɛ ekama bee wu kumo so.
15Ama fo shin nɛ fo kela na luri fo kumu to nɛ fo ki sakaleche nsaa ta fo kumu a sa enyɛn kama nɛ e kra fo a choŋ. 16Fo alɛ lɔŋɛ agbirshuŋkpa nseŋ ta fo asɔbuuso na be ako n lɔŋɛ ndoŋ nsaa keta fo benyɛn a yɔ ndoŋ n ya kaa ji kesakalea. Le be asheŋ daa maŋ daga fanɛ a wora kikɛ. 17Fo ta shuwa nɛ gbiti be abitasɔ nɛ n sa fo na n lɔŋɛ agbir nyɛnsoana nsaa yɔ amo ase n ya kaa ji kesakalea. 18Fo alɛ ta epiŋi nɛ b jɔɔ nɛ n sa fo na a buu agbirana na nsaa ta ɔlif be ŋku nɛ duwu nɛ n sa fo na a lara sarga a sa amo. 19Fo ta nyifu lela nɛ ɔlif be ŋku nɛ mushoŋ nɛ n sa fo fanɛ fo baa ji na n lara sarga n sa agbirana na a fin fanɛ fo asheŋ e par amo. Ma, Enyɛnpetale Ebɔrɛ na gbagba e wu k ka bee wora.
20Ade kikɛ be kaman, nɛ fo ta fo mbia nɛ fo kurge n sa ma na n lara sarga n sa agbirana na. Fo kubojua na nawule maŋ kukwe a? 21Fo mɔ ma mbia n lara sarga n sa agbirana. 22Fo ka pere kenishi a wora ekishisheŋ ere nsaa ji fo kubojua ere kikɛ na, fo teŋ fo kebia to so; jemanɛ nɛ fo daŋ delge so a dese ŋklaŋ to a to aya to na.
23To, ma Enyɛnpetale Ebɔrɛ na e kaŋɛ fanɛ kumu lubi gboŋgboŋi bee ba fo so! Asheŋ maaŋ nyalɛ n sa fo kikɛ. Fo ekar fo nna na! Asheŋ lubi nɛ fee wora ere kikɛ be kaman, 24fo kraa pɔr agbirshuŋkpaana a yili alɔnɛ so nna. 25Kubɔrbi kikɛ ase fo pɔr kegbirshuŋkpa n yili ndoŋ n ya kaa jija fo kela nsaa tu enyɛn kikɛ nɛ e bɔla ndoŋ a choŋ a ŋaba fo kumu. 26Fo tu Ijipt be efuli so be basa nɛ b pere kenishi a fin kananɛ baaŋ nya n di fo na n ji kubojua nɛ ma kagbene kaa ŋkpal loŋ so. 27Amoso nɛ ŋ gberge fo kusoe nseŋ shin nɛ ma nɛfa lar fo so nɛ Filisti be basa nɛ b la fo doŋana nɛ fo asheŋ bee nu bumo agbo na ba ku fo kasawule so. 28Ŋkpal benyɛn nɛ fo kɔ na ka maa kukwe fo so fo kra naŋ ya tu Asiriya be basa malɛ gba nna n ji kesakalea. Bumo alɛ gba maŋ kukwe fo. 29Kumo be kaman nɛ fo naŋ yɔ Babilɔn, nɛ k la eyawujipo be efuli na, malɛ gba nɛ fo kubojuaji na wora keshi n ti so. Ama amo kikɛ be kaman, fo kraa maŋ nya fo kepar.
30Amoso nɛ ma nɛ Enyɛnpetale Ebɔrɛ kaŋɛ fanɛ fo to fo kumu pasaa! Fo wora asheŋ ere kikɛ fanɛ sakaleche nɛ e paŋ anishinyɔr pasaa! 31Fo daŋ pɔr mboŋ nɛ feeŋ baa shuŋ agbirana nsaa ji kubojua n yili kubɔrbi kikɛ ase nna. Ama mannɛ amansherbi so nɛ fo daa wora loŋ, ŋkpal manɛ so fo daa maa sɔ amansherbi. 32Fo du fanɛ eche nɛ e bee sha kebaatu befɔ nna a ji kubojua a chɔ kebaa sha mo kul nawule. 33Sakaleche kikɛ bee sɔ amansherbi nna, ama fo ere e naa sa fo jipoana asɔ, a lɔlɔ bumo nɛ b baa shi kaplɛkama a ba m ba kaa di fo. 34Fo ere be kubojuaji na baa kɔr bekama peya to nna. Benyɛn maa kɔ a fin fo, ama fo ere e naa fin bumo nsaa ka bumo kukɔ gba kuraa.”
Ebɔrɛ ka ji Jerusalɛm demu be asheŋ
35Amoso Jerusalɛm, nu kusɔ Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na bee kaŋɛ fo, sakaleche ere! 36Fo ka delge fo kumu so fanɛ sakaleche nseŋ ta fo kumu n sa fo jipoana nseŋ mɔ fo mbia n lara esarga n sa agbirana nɛ ŋ kishi amo be asheŋ ga na so, 37meeŋ gama fo jipoana nɛ fee sha nɛ bumo nɛ fo kishi kikɛ abar so. Nseŋ shin nɛ b yili ŋ kulti fo nɛ n delge fo so bumo kikɛ be anishito nɛ b wu fo kayurkpaŋ. 38Kejimbri be kasogberge beeŋ ba fo so ŋkpal kubojuaji nɛ basa be kemɔ so. Meeŋ nya agbo ga nseŋ ta luwu ŋ gberge fo kusoe. 39Kumo be kaman, meeŋ shin nɛ fo jipoana e bure m bure mboŋ nɛ fee ji kesakalea na nsaa shuŋ agbirana na kikɛ. Baaŋ suge fo asɔbuuso nɛ abitasɔ na kikɛ ŋ ka fo kayurkpaŋ nɛ enɔfuloŋ.
40“Bumo alɛ beeŋ naŋ we n wɔtɔ jimaŋ nɛ b kpa fo ajembu m mɔ. Kumo be kaman nɛ b ta etokobi ŋ ŋele fo to fanɛ mblaŋkul nseŋ chɔɔ fo nwu. 41Meeŋ wora loŋ ashi beche damta be anishito nɛ fo kubojuaji e fo ekar nɛ fo jipoana maaŋ naaŋ nya ŋkɛ ashi fo kutɔ. 42Aloŋ nɛ ma agbo beeŋ wushi nɛ ma kagbene e dese ma nɛ m maaŋ naŋ nya agbo ŋko ŋ kɔ kukɔrkɔ. 43Fo teŋ so kananɛ ŋ keta fo jemanɛ nɛ fo daa la kebia fɔlbi na nna nseŋ wora ekishisheŋ nɛ agbo pɛ ma ga. Fo daŋ wora amo nɛ a chɔ loŋ gba nseŋ ki sakaleche gba kuraa. Fo daga kasogberge!” Ma, Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ e kaŋɛ na.
Ebiche ka du fanɛ kananɛ mo nio du be asheŋ
44Ade kikɛ be kaman, nɛ Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na naŋ kaŋɛ: “Basa beeŋ baa bɔ keŋasa ere a laŋɛ fo, Jerusalɛm be kaplɛa fanɛ kananɛ enio be da baa du, aloŋ nɛ mo pibiche gba be da du. 45Fo baa du fanɛ fo nio gbagba nna. Mo e kishi mo kul nɛ mbe mbia na. Fo alɛ baa naa du fanɛ fo kurgepo chesoana nna. Bumo alɛ gba kishi bumo kulana nɛ mbia na. Fo nio daa la Hiti be esa nna nɛ fo tuto malɛ daa la Amɔri be esa. 46Fo dacheso e la kadegboŋ nɛ baa tre Samɛria na, nɛ kumo nɛ kumo be ndekarso wɔ a laŋɛ fo kelargato be esoso na. Nɛ fo sipocheso malɛ la kadegboŋ nɛ baa tre Sodɔm na, nɛ kumo alɛ nɛ kumo be ndekarso wɔ a laŋɛ fo kelargato be kaseto na. 47Fo baa maŋ kute bumo be kebaawɔtɔ to nna n wora ekishisheŋ nɛ b wora na nawule, ama fo wora amo nɛ a chɔ bumo peya na gba kuraa.”
48Kede be kaman nɛ Enyɛnpetale Ebɔrɛ na naŋ kaŋɛ: “Kashenteŋ nɛ mee kaŋɛ fo, Jerusalɛm na, fanɛ fo sipocheso Sodɔm nɛ kumo be nde kreso to be basa kikɛ maŋ wora asheŋ lubi n fo amo nɛ fo nɛ fo ndekarso to be basa wora so. 49Sodɔm nɛ kumo be ndekarso to be basa daa wu bumo be amu nna ŋkpal b kaa kɔ ajibi damta a ji nseŋ naa wɔ kayurwushi to so. B daa maa keni betirpo nɛ basa nɛ asheŋ maa nyalɛ a sa na so. 50B daŋ kpeŋ nna nsaa wu bumo be amu nseŋ daŋ naa wora ma ekishisheŋ. Amoso nɛ n daŋ mur bumo fanɛ kananɛ fo nyi geeŋ na.
51Samɛria to be basa bre daŋ maŋ wora asheŋ lubi nɛ fo basa wora ere be barga to gba. Fo basa wora asheŋ keshiso a chɔ bumo be basa, n shin nɛ k wora fanɛ fo kurgepoana na be basa la basa lela a chɔ fo basa. 52To, naniere e daga fanɛ fo nya fo ŋaba. Ŋkpal fo basa be asheŋ lubi ka shi a chɔ fo kurgepoana be basa peya so, kewora fanɛ b la basa lela a chɔ fo basa.”
53Kumo be kaman nɛ Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ naŋ kaŋɛ Jerusalɛm to be basa le: “Meeŋ naŋ nɛfa Sodɔm nɛ Samɛria nɛ amo be nde kresoana kikɛ to be basa. Ma alɛ beeŋ nɛfa fo alɛ gba be basa ashi Jerusalɛm to, 54saŋɛ na so nyɔmɔ beeŋ pɛ fo basa ŋkpal bumo be asheŋ wora so ka shin nɛ Sodɔm nɛ Samɛria kikɛ to be basa duli basa lela a chɔ bumo so. 55Kachɛ na kaŋ fo, asheŋ beeŋ naŋ nyalɛ n sa fo basa nɛ Sodɔm nɛ Samɛria kikɛ be basa nɛ ndekarsoana na kikɛ to be basa nɛ ekama e bɛta n yɔ kakpa nɛ e daa wɔ dra na. 56Fo, Jerusalɛm, daa wora Sodɔm eyur to nna jemanɛ nɛ fo daa wu fo kumu na, 57kumo be pɔɛŋ nɛ ekama wu fo da lubi na. Naniere fo ki kemɔmɔshia be kusɔ nna n sa Edɔmebi nɛ Filistiebi nɛ efuliana nɛ a kulti fo na kikɛ nɛ baa keni fo jiga. 58Ma, Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ e kaŋɛ na, fanɛ, feeŋ ji awurfoŋ ŋkpal asheŋ jiga nɛ asheŋ lubi nɛ fo wora na kikɛ so.”
59Nɛ Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ naŋ kaŋɛ: “Meeŋ gberge fo, Jerusalɛm, kusoe ŋkpal fo ka kplaŋ ntaŋ nɛ fo bɔ na so nseŋ jija ma nɛ fo kɔnɔkoŋwule be ŋkre na so. 60Ama ma ere beeŋ wora m bɔlɔ kɔnɔkoŋwule be ŋkre nɛ ma nɛ fo kre fo kebia to kikɛ na so nseŋ naŋ shin nɛ ma nɛ fo e wora kɔnɔkoŋwule be ŋkre nɛ k beeŋ baa wɔtɔ mbaanaayɔ. 61Aloŋ nɛ feeŋ nyiŋi asheŋ lubi nɛ fo wora na nɛ nyɔmɔ e pɛ fo jemanɛ nɛ meeŋ shin nɛ fo kurgepoana, Sodɔm nɛ Samɛria, e naŋ bɛta m ba ki fo mbia na, ama mannɛ a loŋ e daa la ma nɛ fo be kɔnɔkoŋwule be ŋkre na. 62To, ma nɛ fo beeŋ naŋ wora kɔnɔkoŋwule be ŋkre nɛ fo pin fanɛ ma e la Enyɛnpe na. 63Meeŋ ta fo alubi m paŋ fo, ama feeŋ baa nyiŋi amo nɛ nyɔmɔ e pɛ fo nɛ fo maaŋ naŋ tiŋ m bugi kɔnɔ. Ma, Enyɛnpetale Ebɔrɛ e kaŋɛ na.”

english_text:
A Story about Two Eagles and a Vine
1The Lord said:
2Ezekiel, son of man, tell the people of Israel the following story, 3so they will understand what I am saying to them:
A large eagle with strong wings and beautiful feathers once flew to Lebanon. It broke the top branch off a cedar tree, 4then carried it to a nation of merchants and left it in one of their cities. 5The eagle also took a seed from Israel and planted it in a fertile field with plenty of water, like a willow tree beside a stream. 6The seed sprouted and grew into a grapevine that spread over the ground. It had lots of leaves and strong, deep roots, and its branches grew upward toward the eagle.
7There was another eagle with strong wings and thick feathers. The roots and branches of the grapevine soon turned toward this eagle, hoping it would bring water for the soil. 8But the vine was already growing in fertile soil, where there was plenty of water to produce healthy leaves and large grapes.
9Now tell me, Ezekiel, do you think this grapevine will live? Or will the first eagle pull it up by its roots and pluck off the grapes and let its new leaves die? The eagle could easily kill it without the help of a large and powerful army. 10The grapevine is strong and healthy, but as soon as the scorching desert wind blows, it will quickly wither.
The Lord Explains the Story
11The Lord said:
12 Ezekiel, ask the rebellious people of Israel if they know what this story means.
Tell them that the king of Babylonia came to Jerusalem, then he captured the king of Judah and his officials, and took them back to Babylon as prisoners. 13He chose someone from the family of Judah's king and signed a treaty with him, then made him swear to be loyal. He also led away other important citizens, 14so that the rest of the people of Judah would obey only him and never gain control of their own country again.
15But this new king of Judah later rebelled against Babylonia and sent officials to Egypt to get horses and troops. Will this king be successful in breaking the treaty with Babylonia? Or will he be punished for what he's done?
16As surely as I am the living Lord God, I swear that the king of Judah will die in Babylon, because he broke the treaty with the king of Babylonia, who appointed him king. 17Even the king of Egypt and his powerful army will be useless to Judah when the Babylonians attack and build towers and dirt ramps to destroy the cities of Judah and its people. 18The king of Judah broke his own promises and ignored the treaty with Babylonia. And so he will be punished!
19He made a promise in my name and swore to honor the treaty. And now that he has broken that promise, my name is disgraced. He must pay for what he's done. 20I will spread out a net to trap him. Then I will drag him to Babylon and see that he is punished for his unfaithfulness to me. 21His best troops will be killed in battle, and the survivors will be scattered in every direction. I, the Lord, have spoken.
22Someday, I, the Lord,
will cut a tender twig
from the top of a cedar tree,
then plant it on the peak
of Israel's tallest mountain,
23where it will grow
strong branches
and produce large fruit.
All kinds of birds will find
shelter under the tree,
and they will rest in the shade
of its branches.
24Every tree in the forest
will know that I, the Lord,
can bring down tall trees
and help short ones grow.
I dry up green trees
and make dry ones green.
I, the Lord, have spoken,
and I will keep my word.
translation_text:
Ŋjɔnɔkoso anyɔ be keŋasa be asheŋ
1Nɛ Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na kaŋɛ ma le: 2“Dimɛdi pibi, Ezikɛl, bɔ Israɛl be basa na keŋasa 3n shin nɛ b pin fanɛ kusɔ nɛ ma, Enyɛnpetale Ebɔrɛ, bee kaŋɛ bumo e la fanɛ kajɔnɔkoso gboŋ ko nɛ e daa kɔ aba lempo nɛ atɛ lela ga e daŋ firgi n yɔ Lebanɔn be abee so n ya bu kedibi nɛ baa tre sida na be awɔlto be keyabi. 4Nseŋ ta keyabi na n yɔ eyawujipo be kasawule so n ya fɛa bumo kadegboŋ to.
5Kumo be kaman nɛ kajɔnɔkoso na ta Israɛl be efuli so be keduuso n ya duu kasawule lela nɛ k mata kabombi so, kakpa nɛ k beeŋ baa nya nchu jemanɛ kikɛ nseŋ tiŋ n daŋ nɛnɛ na. 6Ndoŋ nna nɛ keduuso na kɔr n daŋ ŋ ki kefeelebi a sɔr asɔrso nɛ baa tre greep na. Nɛ kumo be ayabi daŋ esoso a shoŋi kajɔnɔkoso na, nɛ kumo be nliŋi yɔ nchiŋ kasawule to. Nɛ kefeelebi na wora ayabi damta nseŋ purge afantaŋ.
7Kajɔnɔkoso nyɔsopo ko malɛ gba daa wɔtɔ a kɔ aba lempo nɛ atɛ damta. Nɛ kefeelebi na be ayabi nɛ nliŋi salga to a yɔ kajɔnɔkoso nyɔsopo na kutɔ, a tama fanɛ k beeŋ nya nchu kumo kutɔ a chɔ kudɔbi nɛ k daa wɔ kumo to na. 8Ama kasawule lela nɛ k kɔ nchu nɛnɛ so nɛ b daŋ duu kumo nɛ k tiŋ n daŋ nɛnɛ ŋ ki kefeelebi lela nseŋ tiŋ n sɔr nɛnɛ.
9Naniere, Ezikɛl, kaŋɛ ma, fo tama fanɛ kefeelebi ere beeŋ pete a? Kajɔnɔkoso juŋkparso na maaŋ nya agbo n tia kumo nseŋ kuya kumo be ayabi to n lɛ nɛ a wɔl a? Kajɔnɔkoso na beeŋ tiŋ n tia kefeelebi na nɛ k maŋ fin benapo lempo damta be kechɛto gba. 10Kefeelebi na kɔ eleŋ nɛ alenfia nɛnɛ, ama nɛ fanɛ epeŋilarkpa be afu ber kumo so, k maaŋ chɛr nɛ k bolo.”
Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na ka bugi keŋasa na to be asheŋ
11Kumo be kaman, nɛ Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ kaŋɛ ma le: 12“Bishi Israɛl be basa nɛ b pal kaman n sa ma ere fanɛ b pin keŋasa ere be kefito a? Kaŋɛ bumo fanɛ Babilɔn be efuli so be ewurgboŋ e ba Jerusalɛm to m ba pɛ Juda be ewura nɛ mbe benimuana m bɛta n yɔ Babilɔn be efuli so. 13Babilɔn be ewurgboŋ na daŋ ta Juda be ewura be kanaŋ to be esa ko nna n shin nɛ e bɔ ntaŋ fanɛ e beeŋ baa nu a sa mo, nseŋ shin nɛ mo nɛ mo wora kɔnɔkoŋwule be ŋkre. Kumo be kaman nɛ e pɛ kade na be basa gboŋ n ti so n yɔ, 14saŋɛ na so Juda be efuli so be basa nɛ b ka na beeŋ baa wɔ mbe kaseto a nu a sa mo nawule nsaa maaŋ naŋ tiŋ n nya eleŋ bumo gbagba be efuli na so kikɛ. 15Ama ewura popɔr nɛ Babilɔn be ewurgboŋ lara na pal kaman n sa mo nseŋ shuŋi mbɔ Ijipt be efuli so a fin egbaŋɛ nɛ benapo damta. Fo tama fanɛ ewura ere beeŋ ji n lar kusɔ nɛ e bee wora ere to a? E maaŋ tiŋ n lar kɔnɔkoŋwule be ŋkre na kaman nsaa maŋ nya kumo be kasogberge!”
16Kumo be kaman nɛ Enyɛnpetale Ebɔrɛ kaŋɛ le: “Ŋ ka baa la Enyɛnpetale Ebɔrɛ nɛ e bee sa ŋkpa ere bre, Juda be ewura ere beeŋ wu ashi Babilɔn be efuli so, ŋkpal e ka lar kɔnɔkoŋwule be ŋkre nɛ mo nɛ Babilɔn be ewurgboŋ kre na kaman so nseŋ wora n da mo gbagba be ntaŋ nɛ e bɔ na so so. 17Fɛɛro nɛ e la Ijipt be ewurgboŋ na nɛ mbe benapo lempo kikɛ maaŋ tiŋ n chɛ Juda be basa to ŋ kɔ jemanɛ nɛ Babilɔn be basa beeŋ ba gbare eshishɛr n deŋi abar so m mata Jerusalɛm be egbal na a fin keluri kade na to ŋ kɔ m mɔ basa na. 18Juda be ewura gbagba e wora n da mbe ntaŋ so nseŋ lar kɔnɔkoŋwule be ŋkre nɛ mo nɛ Babilɔn be ewurgboŋ kre na kaman, ŋkpal loŋ so, e beeŋ nya kasogberge.
19Amoso kusɔ nɛ ma Enyɛnpetale Ebɔrɛ nɛ mee sa ŋkpa na kaŋɛ e la fanɛ meeŋ gberge Juda be ewura kusoe ŋkpal e ka wora n da mo gbagba be ntaŋ nɛ e bɔ so nseŋ lar kɔnɔkoŋwule be ŋkre na kaman so so. 20Kewora fanɛ kashewu nɛ n ta m pɛ mo nseŋ yɛr mo Babilɔn be efuli so n ya ji mo demu ndoŋ ŋkpal e ka maŋ ji kashenteŋ n sa ma so. 21Mbe benapo kpakpaso kama nɛ baaŋ shile na beeŋ wu kena to nɛ bumo nɛ baaŋ ji efute na malɛ e pesaŋ to n sɔ kaplɛkama. Ndoŋ nɛ menyeeŋ pin fanɛ ma, Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na e kaŋɛ na.”
Ebɔrɛ ka nase tama be kɔnɔ n sa Israɛl be asheŋ
22Kusɔ nɛ Enyɛnpetale Ebɔrɛ na kaŋɛ nde:
“Ŋ gbagba beeŋ ku kedibi nɛ baa tre sida na
be keyabi n fɛa;
keyabi popɔrbi nɛ meeŋ ku ashi kumo be awɔlto
n ya fɛa kebee jeŋgreŋ so.
23Israɛl be kebee nɛ k du jeŋgreŋ ga na be awɔlto nɛ meeŋ fɛa kumo.
Nɛ k daŋ n wora ayabi nseŋ sɔr asɔrso
nseŋ ki sida be kedibi lela.
Nɛ mbuibi be yiri kikɛ e ba tɔ asha kumo so;
nseŋ nya edikpa kumo be ayabi so.
24Ndoŋ nɛ ndibi nɛ a wɔ kasawule na so beeŋ pin
fanɛ ma, Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na
e naa ku ndibi tenteŋ a lɛ
nsaa shin nɛ ndibi shiimbi bee daŋ nteŋ.
Mee naa shin nɛ ndibi bumbuŋ bee wɔl
nsaa shin nɛ ndibi wɔlso bee purge.
Ma, Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ e malga na; ma alɛ beeŋ wora kusɔ nɛ ŋ kaŋɛ na kikɛ.”

english_text:
Those Who Sin Will Die
1The Lord said:
2 Ezekiel, I hear the people of Israel using the old saying,
“Sour grapes eaten by parents
leave a sour taste in the mouths
of their children.”
3Now tell them that I am the Lord God, and as surely as I live, that saying will no longer be used in Israel. 4The lives of all people belong to me—parents as well as children. However, only those who sin will be put to death.
5Suppose there is a truly good man who always does what is fair and right. 6He refuses to eat meat sacrificed to foreign gods at local shrines or to worship Israel's idols. He doesn't have sex with someone else's wife or with a woman having her monthly period. 7He never cheats or robs anyone and always returns anything taken as security for a loan; he gives food and clothes to the poor 8and doesn't charge interest when lending money. He refuses to do anything evil; he is fair to everyone 9 and faithfully obeys my laws and teachings. This man is good, and I promise he will live.
10But suppose this good man has an evil son who is violent and commits sins 11his father never did. He eats meat at local shrines, has sex with someone else's wife, 12cheats the poor, and robs people. He keeps what is given to him as security for a loan. He worships idols, does disgusting things, 13and charges high interest when lending money. An evil man like that will certainly not live. He is the one who has done these horrible sins, so it's his own fault that he will be put to death.
14But suppose this evil man has a son who sees his father do these things and refuses to act like him. 15He doesn't eat meat at local shrines or worship Israel's idols, and he doesn't have sex with someone else's wife. 16He never cheats or robs anyone and doesn't even demand security for a loan. He gives food and clothes to the poor 17and refuses to do anything evil or to charge interest. And he obeys all my laws and teachings. Such a man will live. His own father sinned, but this good man will not be put to death for the sins of his father. 18It is his father who will die for cheating and robbing and doing evil.
19You may wonder why a son isn't punished for the sins of his father. It is because the son does what is right and obeys my laws. 20 Only those who sin will be put to death. Children won't suffer for the sins of their parents, and parents won't suffer for the sins of their children. Good people will be rewarded for what they do, and evil people will be punished for what they do.
21Suppose wicked people stop sinning and start obeying my laws and doing right. They won't be put to death. 22All their sins will be forgiven, and they will live because they did right. 23I, the Lord God, don't like to see wicked people die. I had much rather see them turn back from their sins and live.
24But when good people start sinning and doing disgusting things, will they live? No! All their good deeds will be forgotten, and they will be put to death because of their sins.
25You people of Israel accuse me of being unfair! But listen—I'm not unfair; you are! 26If good people start doing evil, they must be put to death, because they have sinned. 27And if wicked people start doing right, they will save themselves from punishment. 28They will think about what they've done and stop sinning, and so they won't be put to death. 29But you still say that I am unfair. You are the ones who have done wrong and are unfair!
30I will judge each of you for what you've done. So stop sinning, or else you will certainly be punished. 31Give up your evil ways and start thinking pure thoughts. And be faithful to me! Do you really want to be put to death for your sins? 32 I, the Lord God, don't want to see that happen to anyone. So stop sinning and live!
translation_text:
Esa nɛ e wora kulubi e naaŋ wu
1Nɛ Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na kaŋɛ ma: 2“Ezikɛl, mee kaa nu Israɛl be basa ka bee bɔ keŋasa ere e kaŋɛ fanɛ;
bekurgepo e ji anyinyembi
nɛ a bee nyiri bumo be mbia be anyi.
3Naniere kaŋɛ bumo fanɛ ma, Enyɛnpetale Ebɔrɛ nɛ e bee sa ŋkpa na e kaŋɛ na fanɛ b maaŋ naa bɔ loŋ be keŋasa na Israɛl be efuli so. 4Dimɛdi kikɛ be ŋkpa bɔɔ ma enɔ nna, bekurgepo nɛ bumo be mbia kikɛ. Amoso, esa nɛ e wora kulubi e naaŋ wu kumo be luwu.
5Nɛ fanɛ esa lela koso a ji kashenteŋ nsaa wora kusɔ nɛ k daga jemanɛ kikɛ. 6E maa ji agbirjibi ŋko a shuŋ Israɛl be basa be agbirana na. Mo alɛ maa sha mo barkasa be eche ŋko a di eche jemanɛ nɛ e bee lar ntamaŋ. 7Amodoŋwura malɛ maa puni ŋko a suge esa, mo alɛ maa sɔ tarma pɔɛŋ nseŋ sa esa mpaŋ. Ade be kaman mo alɛ naa chɛ betirpo to a sa bumo ajibi nɛ asɔbuuso. 8Loŋ be esa na maa wɔtɔ amansherbi nɛ e ta m paŋ esa nchu, mo alɛ maa wora kulubi nseŋ naa ji asheŋ nɛ amo be ekpa so a sa ekama. 9Ade kikɛ be kaman, mo alɛ de so nna nɛ e maaŋ wora n da ma mbra nɛ ma keŋini so. Le be esa la esa lela nna nsaa beeŋ ji efute n chɛr.” Ma, Enyɛnpetale Ebɔrɛ e kaŋɛ na.
10Ama nɛ fanɛ esa lela ere kurge ebi nɛ e bee suge nsaa mɔ basa, nsaa wora 11asheŋ nɛ mo tuto bre maaŋ wora na. Ebi na bee ji agbirjibi nsaa di mo braana be beche. 12E bee puni betirpo nsaa suge basa. Nɛ esa ta kusɔ ko m ba yili tarma gba e maaŋ naŋ laŋɛ kumo n sa kumo wura. Mo alɛ bee shuŋ agbirana nsaa wora ekishisheŋ. 13Ade kikɛ be kaman, e bee wɔtɔ mpaŋ kama nɛ e sa esa nchu ga nna. Esa kikɛ nɛ e la esa lubi fanɛ mo maa ba nɛ e ji efute n chɛr. Mo gbagba e wora le be ekishisheŋ ere, amoso mo e daga amo be luwu. Mo luwu na be turju beeŋ baa bɛ mo gbagba nna.
14Ama nɛ fanɛ esa lubi ere pibi wu asheŋ nɛ mo tuto bee wora na nseŋ kini kewora asheŋ fanɛ mo tuto, 15nsaa maa ji agbirjibi ŋko a shuŋ Israɛl be agbirana, mo alɛ maaŋ di mo barkasa be eche. 16E maaŋ suge ŋko m puni esa kikɛ, mo alɛ maaŋ sɔ tarma pɔɛŋ nseŋ sa esa mpaŋ. Mo alɛ bee sa betirpo ajibi nɛ asɔbuuso nna 17nsaa kini asheŋ lubi be kewora. Kusɔ nɛ e bee wora e la fanɛ e bee nu nna nsaa bɛ ma mbraana nɛ ma keŋini so. Le be esa beeŋ ji efute n chɛr. Mo tuto e wora alubi, nɛ le be esa lela ere maaŋ wu ŋkpal mo tuto be asheŋ lubi so. 18Mo tuto gbagba e naŋ wu ŋkpal mbe kapuni nɛ kasuge nɛ asheŋ lubi so.
19Ashere menyeeŋ bishi fanɛ nɛ mannɛ e baa nɛ ebi maaŋ nya mo tuto be asheŋ lubi be kakɔka? Kusɔ nɛ k ba e la fanɛ ebi na wora kusɔ nɛ k daga nseŋ wora ma mbraana kasonu nna. 20Basa nɛ b wora alubi e naa wu alubi be luwu. Mbia maaŋ ji awurfoŋ ŋkpal bumo tutoana be alubi so nɛ bekurgepo gba maaŋ ji awurfoŋ ŋkpal bumo be mbia be alubi so. Basa lela beeŋ nya bumo be alelasheŋ be kakɔka nɛ basa lubi malɛ e nya kasogberge ŋkpal bumo be alubi so.
21Nɛ fanɛ basa lubi yige asheŋ lubi be kewora nseŋ fara a wora ma mbraana kasonu nseŋ naa wora asheŋ nɛ a daga, b maaŋ wu manaŋ. 22Baaŋ nya bumo be alubi kikɛ be ketampaŋ, ŋkpal b ka wora asheŋ nɛ a daga so. 23Basa lubi be luwu maa par ma Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na kikɛ. Kusɔ nɛ mee sha e la fanɛ b ka beeŋ tuba n lar bumo be alubi to nseŋ ji efute n chɛr.
24Ama nɛ fanɛ basa lela yige alela be kewora nseŋ fara a wora ekishisheŋ nɛ basa lubi bee wora na, a daga fanɛ b ji efute n chɛr a? Ayai! B maaŋ nyiŋi bumo alelasheŋ dra na. Baaŋ wu ŋkpal bumo be asheŋ lubi na so.
25Menyi Israɛl be basa bee kaa kaŋɛ fanɛ, kusɔ nɛ Enyɛnpe bee wora na maŋ walɛ. Ama men nu nfe, mannɛ ma e naa wora asɔ nɛ a maŋ walɛ. Menyi e naa wora asɔ nɛ a maŋ walɛ! 26Nɛ fanɛ basa lela fara asheŋ lubi be kewora, a daga fanɛ b wu ŋkpal bumo be alubi so. 27Nɛ fanɛ basa lubi malɛ yige asheŋ lubi be kewora nsaa wora asheŋ lela, baaŋ mɔlga bumo be amu ashi kasogberge to. 28Ŋkpal b ka fɛ bumo be asheŋ wora so na be asheŋ nseŋ yige asheŋ lubi na be kewora so nɛ baaŋ ji efute. 29Ama men kraa kaŋɛ fanɛ asɔ nɛ mee wora na maŋ walɛ. Menyi e wora n jija nsaa wora asɔ nɛ a maŋ walɛ.
30“Ma, Enyɛnpetale Ebɔrɛ na e naa kaŋɛ menyi Israɛl be basa fanɛ meeŋ ji menyi be ekama demu ŋkpal kusɔ nɛ e wora so. Amoso, men tuba ashi menyi be asheŋ woraso lubi to. Nɛ mannɛ aloŋ, a beeŋ yɛr menyi kemur to. 31Men lar men be asheŋ lubi na to nseŋ fara a fɛ asheŋ lela be kewora be asheŋ menyi be ŋgbene to. Menyi alɛ e baa ji kashenteŋ a sa ma. Men sa maŋ shin nɛ menyi be alubi e mɔ menyi. 32Ma, Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na maa sha fanɛ men be ekama e wu. Amoso men tuba nseŋ ji efute n chɛr!”

english_text:
A Funeral Song for Israel's Leaders
The Lord said:
1Ezekiel, sing a funeral song for two of Israel's leaders:
2Your mother was a brave lioness
who raised her cubs
among lions.
3She taught one of them to hunt,
and he learned to eat people.
4When the nations heard of him,
they trapped him in a pit,
then they used hooks
to drag him to Egypt.
5His mother waited
for him to return.
But soon she lost all hope
and raised another cub,
who also became fierce.
6He hunted with other lions
and learned to eat people.
7He destroyed fortresses
and ruined towns;
his mighty roar
terrified everyone.
8Nations plotted to kill him,
and people came from all over
to spread out a net
and catch him in a trap.
9They put him in a cage
and took him to Babylonia.
The lion was locked away,
so that his mighty roar
would never again be heard
on Israel's hills.
10Your mother was a vine like you,
growing near a stream.
There was plenty of water,
so she was filled with branches
and with lots of fruit.
11Her strong branches
became symbols of authority,
and she was taller
than all other trees—
everyone could see how strong
and healthy she was.
12But in anger, I pulled her up
by the roots
and threw her to the ground,
where the scorching desert wind
dried out her fruit.
Her strong branches wilted
and burned up.
13Then she was planted
in a hot, dry desert,
14where her stem caught fire,
and flames burned
her branches and fruit.
Not one strong branch is left;
she is stripped bare.
This funeral song must be sung with sorrow.
translation_text:
Kagbenejija be kashɛ
1Ndoŋ nna nɛ Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ kaŋɛ ma fanɛ m boŋ kagbenejija be kashɛ n sa Israɛl be benimu anyɔ ko ŋ kaŋɛ le:
2“Men nio daa la fanɛ buluŋ cheso nɛ e daa kɔ kenyɛn nna
nseŋ bela mbe bibi ashi ebuluŋ nyɛnso lempo to!
3E bela mbe ebi ko nseŋ ŋini kumo kepɛ n ji,
nɛ k koya edimɛdi be kepɛ n ji.
4Efuliana na ka nu mbe asheŋ,
nɛ b fe mo kekpaala m pɛ mo,
nseŋ ta edariwa
ŋ gberge mo n yɔ Ijipt be efuli so.
5Kumo nio ka jo nseŋ wu fanɛ tama loge na,
nɛ k naŋ ta kumo be bibi na be eko
m bela kumo nɛ k ki buluŋ lempo.
6K ka daŋ n yili
nɛ k tu kumo braana ebuluŋ e ji kekpaŋ.
Nseŋ koya edimɛdi be kepɛ n ji.
7K daa bure basa be ebu lempoana nna,
nsaa jija bumo be ndeana.
K baaŋ ponte jemanɛ kikɛ, kufugboŋ bee tɔr
ekama so efuli na so nna nɛ b baa chicha.
8Ndoŋ nna nɛ efuliana na kre kumo be kemɔ be nia,
nɛ basa shi kaplɛkama m ba.
Nɛ b sho kashewu
m pɛ kumo
9Kumo be kaman nɛ b ta kumo n wɔtɔ katurgegboŋ to
nseŋ ta kumo n yɔ Babilɔn be ewura kutɔ.
N ya ta mo n ti ebu
nɛ ekama maŋ naŋ nu mbe kaponte
ashi Israɛl be abee so kikɛ.
10Fo nio daa du fanɛ kedibi sɔrso nna
nɛ k yil m mata kabombi;
K daa sɔr nɛnɛ nna nsaa kɔ ayabi damta
ŋkpal k ka daa nya nchu nɛnɛ so.
11Kumo be ayabi daa kɔ eleŋ nna,
nseŋ daa walɛ keku n wora kuwurkpabi.
K daŋ daŋ n yɔ awɔlto
a chɔ ndibi nɛ a ka na kikɛ nna.
Ekama daŋ wu kumo be nteŋ nɛ ayabi damta.
12Ama agbo so nɛ n tia kumo
n lɛ kasawule.
Afu nɛ a shi epeŋilarkpa daŋ shin nɛ k bolo
nɛ kumo be asɔrso gbaŋgbaŋ n tɔr;
nɛ kumo be ayabi lempo na wɔl
nɛ edɛ ji amo.
13Naniere keshishɛrsawule so nɛ n duu kumo,
kasawule wɔlso nɛ nchu maŋ wɔ kumo so.
14Ndoŋ nna nɛ kumo be keyabi gboŋgboŋi ko pɛ edɛ;
nɛ edɛ na bɛ kumo so n chɔɔ kumo be ayabi nɛ asɔrso kikɛ.
Keyabi lempo kikɛ daŋ maŋ naŋ ka kumo so
nɛ b ku n wora kuwurkpabi.
Kashɛ ere la kagbenejija be kashɛ nna n daga kebaaboŋ kagbenejijaso.”

english_text:
Israel Keeps On Rebelling
1Seven years after King Jehoiachin and the rest of us had been led away as prisoners to Babylonia, some of Israel's leaders came to me on the tenth day of the fifth month. They sat down and asked for a message from the Lord. 2Just then, the Lord God said:
3Ezekiel, son of man, these leaders have come to find out what I want them to do. As surely as I live, I will not give them an answer of any kind.
4Are you willing to warn them, Ezekiel? Then remind them of the disgusting sins of their ancestors.
5 Tell them that long ago I, the Lord God, chose Israel to be my own. I appeared to their ancestors in Egypt and made a solemn promise that I would be their God and the God of their descendants. 6I swore that I would rescue them from Egypt and lead them to a land I had already chosen. This land was rich with milk and honey and was the most splendid land of all. 7I told them to get rid of their disgusting idols and not to sin by worshiping the gods of Egypt. I reminded them that I was the Lord their God, 8but they still rebelled against me. They refused to listen and kept on worshiping their idols and foreign gods.
In my anger, I decided to punish the Israelites in Egypt. 9But that would have made me look like a liar, because I had already promised in front of everyone that I would lead them out of Egypt. 10So I brought them out and led them into the desert. 11 I gave them my laws and teachings, so they would know how to live right. 12 And I commanded them to respect the Sabbath as a way of showing that they were holy and belonged to me. 13But the Israelites rebelled against me in the desert. They refused to obey my laws and teachings, and they treated the Sabbath like any other day.
Then in my anger, I decided to destroy the Israelites in the desert once and for all. 14But that would have disgraced me, because many other nations had seen me bring the Israelites out of Egypt. 15 Instead, I told them in the desert that I would not lead them into the beautiful, fertile land I had promised. 16I said this because they had not only ignored my laws and teachings, but had disgraced my Sabbath and worshiped idols.
17Yet, I felt sorry for them and could not let them die in the desert. 18So I warned the children not to act like their parents or follow their evil ways or worship their idols. 19I reminded them that I was the Lord their God and that they should obey my laws and teachings. 20I told them to respect my Sabbath to show that they were my people and that I was the Lord their God. 21But the children also rebelled against me. They refused to obey my laws and teachings, and they treated the Sabbath as any other day.
I became angry and decided to punish them in the desert. 22But I did not. That would have disgraced me in front of the nations that had seen me bring the Israelites out of Egypt. 23 So I solemnly swore that I would scatter the people of Israel across the nations, 24because they had disobeyed my laws and ignored my teachings; they had disgraced my Sabbath and worshiped the idols their ancestors had made. 25I gave them laws that bring punishment instead of life, 26and I let them offer me unacceptable sacrifices, including their first-born sons. I did this to horrify them and to let them know that I, the Lord, was punishing them.
27Ezekiel, tell the people of Israel that their ancestors also rejected and insulted me 28by offering sacrifices, incense, and wine to gods on every hill and under every large tree. I was very angry, because they did these things in the land I had given them! 29I asked them where they went to worship those gods, and they answered, “At the local shrines.” And those places of worship are still called shrines.
30Then ask the Israelites why they are following the example of their wicked ancestors 31by worshiping idols and by sacrificing their own children as offerings. They commit these sins and still think they can ask me for a message. As surely as I am the living Lord God, I will give them no answer. 32They may think they can be like other nations and get away with worshiping idols made of wood and stone. But that will never happen!
The Lord Promises To Restore Israel
The Lord said to the people of Israel:
33As surely as I am the living Lord God, I will rule over you with my powerful arm. You will feel my fierce anger 34and my power, when I gather you from the places where you are scattered 35and lead you into a desert surrounded by nations. I will meet you there face to face. Then I will pass judgment on you 36and punish you, just as I punished your ancestors in the desert near Egypt. 37I will force each of you to obey the regulations of our solemn agreement. 38I will separate the sinful rebels from the rest of you, and even though I will bring them from the nations where they live in exile, they won't be allowed to return to Israel. Then you will know that I am the Lord.
39Go ahead and worship your idols for now, you Israelites, because soon I will no longer let you dishonor me by offering gifts to them. You will have no choice but to obey me! 40When that day comes, everyone in Israel will worship me on Mount Zion, my holy mountain in Jerusalem. I will once again call you my own, and I will accept your sacred offerings and sacrifices. 41When I bring you home from the places where you are now scattered, I will be pleased with you, just as I am pleased with the smell of the smoke from your sacrifices. Every nation on earth will see that I am holy, 42and you will know that I, the Lord, am the one who brought you back to Israel, the land I promised your ancestors. 43Then you will remember your wicked sins, and you will hate yourselves for doing such horrible things. They have made you unacceptable to me, 44so you deserve to be punished. But I will treat you in a way that will bring honor to my name, and you will know that I am the Lord God.
Fire from the South
45The Lord said, 46“Ezekiel, son of man, turn toward the south and warn the forests 47that I, the Lord God, will start a fire that will burn up every tree, whether green or dry. Nothing will be able to put out the blaze of that fire as it spreads to the north and burns everything in its path. 48Everyone will know that I started it, and that it cannot be stopped.”
49But I complained, “Lord God, I don't want to do that! People already say I confuse them with my messages.”
translation_text:
Israɛl ka wora kagbene kpakpaso be asheŋ
1B ka pɛ ewura Jehowachin nɛ anyi be beko n yɔ Babilɔn be efuli so na be kafɛ shunusopo to be kufɔl nusopo to be kachɛ kudusopo na nɛ Israɛl be benimuana ko ba chena ma anishi to a fin kenu kusɔ nɛ Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na kɔ nɛ e kaŋɛ bumo.
2Ndoŋ nna nɛ Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na kaŋɛ ma 3fanɛ ŋ kaŋɛ Israɛl be benimuana na fanɛ kusɔ nɛ Enyɛnpetale Ebɔrɛ na kaŋɛ nde: “Men ba nna nɛ men ba pin kusɔ nɛ mee sha fanɛ men wora a? Ŋ ka baa la Enyɛnpetale Ebɔrɛ nɛ e bee sa ŋkpa ere, m maaŋ shin nɛ men pin kusɔ nɛ mee sha fanɛ men wora.
4Dimɛdi pibi, fo wora shiriya nɛ fo kpele bumo kusoe a? Kumo ere nyiŋi bumo ekishisheŋ nɛ bumo tutoana daŋ wora na be asheŋ, 5nseŋ naŋ kaŋɛ bumo fanɛ kusɔ nɛ Enyɛnpetale Ebɔrɛ na bee kaŋɛ e la fanɛ kachɛ nɛ e lara menyi nɛ men baa la mbe basa na, e daŋ bɔ ntaŋ nna n nase kɔnɔ n sa Jeekɔb nɛ men tutoana nseŋ lara mbe kumu ŋ ŋini bumo ashi Ijipt be efuli so ŋ kaŋɛ fanɛ e beeŋ baa la menyi nɛ men be kaman to ebi be Ebɔrɛ. 6Loŋ be kachɛ na nɛ e nase kɔnɔ fanɛ e beeŋ lara bumo Ijipt be efuli so n yɔ kasawule nɛ k kɔ kanya alegaiso nsaa wora adɔjibi ga nseŋ naa la kasawule nɛ k walɛ a chɔ nsawule kikɛ nɛ mo gbagba fin n yili bumo na so. 7Kumo be kaman, nɛ e naŋ kaŋɛ bumo fanɛ bumo be ekama e yige agbirana nɛ men ta menyi be anishi n yuu so, nɛ amo be asheŋ bee nu ma agbo nɛ ŋ kishi amo ga na be kebaashuŋ; saŋɛ na so, menyi maaŋ ta Ijipt be efuli so be agbirana n jija menyi be kebaawɔtɔ. Ŋkpal manɛ so, ma e la Enyɛnpe menyi be Ebɔrɛ na.”
8Ama b pal kaman n sa ma nseŋ kini kenu n sa ma. B daŋ maŋ lara asɔ nɛ b ta ŋ ki agbirana ashuŋ nseŋ ta bumo be anishi n yuu amo so na ashi bumo to. Bumo alɛ daa maŋ naŋ kini Ijipt be efuli so be agbirana na gba. Amoso nɛ n daŋ kaŋɛ fanɛ meeŋ shin nɛ ma agbo a ba bumo so nɛ ŋ gberge bumo kusoe ashi Ijipt ndoŋ na. 9Ama n daa maŋ wora loŋ, ŋkpal ŋ ka daa maa sha fanɛ ma ketre e jija efuliana nɛ baaŋ wu kananɛ meeŋ lara ma kumu ŋ ŋini Israɛl be basa nseŋ juŋkpar bumo n lar Ijipt be efuli so na be anishito so. 10Amoso nɛ n daŋ juŋkpar bumo n lar Ijipt be efuli so n yɔ keshishɛrsawule so na. 11Ndoŋ nɛ n sa bumo ma mbraana nɛ ma keŋini, nɛ b wora amo kasonu nseŋ pin kananɛ baŋ baa keta bumo be amu. 12Kumo be kaman, nɛ n yili ma Kewushiachɛ n sa bumo nɛ k baa la ashi tɔɔnɛ ma nɛ bumo be kefɛato, saŋɛ na so baaŋ pin fanɛ ma, Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na e shin nɛ b ki basa cheembi.
13Ama Israɛl be basa na lar ma kaman keshishɛrsawule na so ndoŋ, nseŋ kini kebɛ ma mbraana nɛ keŋini nɛ a bee shin nɛ esa bee bii kebaawɔtɔ lela na so. Bumo alɛ nseŋ keni ma Kewushiachɛ na jiga. Amoso nɛ n daŋ kaŋɛ fanɛ meeŋ shin nɛ ma agbo e ba bumo so nɛ m mur bumo ashi keshishɛrsawule na so na. 14Ama n daa maŋ wora loŋ, ŋkpal ŋ ka daa maa sha fanɛ ma ketre e jija ashi efuliana nɛ b wu kananɛ n lara bumo ashi Ijipt be efuli so na be anishito so. 15Amoso nɛ ma alɛ daŋ bɔ ntaŋ ŋ kaŋɛ bumo keshishɛrsawule na so fanɛ m maaŋ naŋ yɛr bumo kasawule lela nɛ k bee wora adɔjibi ga nɛ n daŋ sa bumo na so. 16Ŋkpal manɛ so, b kini kebɛ ma mbraana nɛ ma keŋini so nseŋ keni ma Kewushiachɛ na jiga, nɛ bumo be ŋgbene kikɛ malɛ daa wɔ bumo be agbirana na so a chɔ ma. 17Ade kikɛ be kaman, n daŋ wu bumo kuwɔr nna a maŋ mur bumo ŋko n shin nɛ b shir keshishɛrsawule na so ndoŋ. 18Kusɔ nɛ n daŋ wora e la fanɛ, n daŋ fɛa bumo be mbifɔlbi nɛ b daa wɔ bumo to na so nna, fanɛ b sa maŋ kaŋ kute bumo tutoana to m bɔla agbirana so n jija bumo be amu. 19Ma e la Enyɛnpe, menyi be Ebɔrɛ na; men be ma mbraana nɛ ma keŋini so. 20Men ta ma Kewushiachɛ naŋ ki kachɛ cheembi, saŋɛ na so k beeŋ baa la tɔɔnɛ a ŋini fanɛ men la ma basa nna nɛ ma alɛ la Enyɛnpe menyi be Ebɔrɛ na.
21Ama ashi keshishɛrsawule na so ndoŋ, mbia na gba lar ma kaman nseŋ kini kebɛ ma mbraana nɛ ma keŋini so. Bumo alɛ gba naŋ keni ma Kewushiachɛ na jiga nna. Amoso nɛn daŋ kaŋɛ fanɛ meeŋ shin nɛ ma agbo e ba bumo so ashi kiyi na to ndoŋ. 22Ama n daa maŋ wora loŋ, ŋkpal ŋ ka daa maa sha fanɛ ma ketre e jija ashi efuliana nɛ b wu kananɛ n juŋkpar bumo n lar Ijipt be efuli so na be anishito so. 23Amoso nɛ n daŋ naŋ bɔ ntaŋ ŋ kaŋɛ bumo kiyi na to fanɛ meeŋ shin nɛ b pesaŋ to n sɔ efuliana pɔtɛana so na. 24Ŋkpal manɛ so, b daŋ kini kebɛ ma mbraana nɛ atande so nsaa maŋ ta ma Kewushiachɛ na n tre sheŋ nna. Bumo tutoana be agbirana e daŋ bɔlɔ bumo kenishi ga nɛ b daa shuŋ amo. 25Nɛ n daŋ kpal loŋ so n sa bumo mbraana nɛ ŋ gbagba nyi fanɛ b daa maaŋ tiŋ m bɛ amo so n nya ŋkpa. 26B daŋ naŋ bɔla bumo gbagba be esarga so n jija bumo be kebaawɔtɔ nna. B daa ta bumo be ewurkoŋ nna a lara esarga. N daŋ shin nɛ loŋ wora nna nɛ kufu e pɛ bumo nɛ b pin fanɛ ma e la Enyɛnpe na.
27Amoso, dimɛdi pibi, Ezikɛl, kaŋɛ Israɛlebi na fanɛ, kusɔ nɛ Enyɛnpetale Ebɔrɛ na kaŋɛ e la fanɛ kananɛ bumo tutoana daŋ kini ma nseŋ tege ma nna na. 28Jemanɛ nɛ m bar men tutoana kasawule nɛ n nase kɔnɔ fanɛ meeŋ sa bumo na so n loge na, nɛ b baa wu agoŋgulombi nɛ ndibigboŋ nɛ a kɔ afantaŋ nseŋ ta amo ŋ ki bumo be agbirshuŋkpaana nsaa wɔtɔ a lara esarga amo ase a sa bumo be agbirana. B daa chɔɔ eduwu nna nsaa duga nsa a wurge agbirana na nɛ kumo be loŋ daa nu ma agbo nsaa kaa ma kagbene. 29Ndoŋ nna nɛ m bishi bumo fanɛ nuso be mboŋ nɛ menyee kaa yɔ na? Nɛ b kaŋɛ, ‘Agbir ase’ nɛ anyee yɔ. Hale nɛ mbre agbirshuŋkpa nɛ baa tre agbir ase.
30Amoso kaŋɛ Israɛl be basa na fanɛ kusɔ nɛ Enyɛnpetale Ebɔrɛ bee bishi e la fanɛ, manɛ e baa nɛ menyeeŋ jija menyi be amu nɛ kebaawɔtɔ fanɛ kananɛ men tutoana daŋ wora na nsaa shuŋ bumo be agbirana nɛ amo be asheŋ bee nu agbo na? 31Jemanɛ nɛ menyee ta menyi be mbia a lara esarga a sa agbirana na hale nɛ mbre na, menyee jija menyi be amu nɛ menyi be kebaawɔtɔ nna na. O Israɛlebi, a daga ŋ ka naŋ sa menyi ekpa nɛ men bishi ma kusɔ ko a? Ma, Enyɛnpetale Ebɔrɛ e naa kaŋɛ menyi kashenteŋto na fanɛ m maaŋ sa menyi ekpa nɛ men bishi ma shɛŋ.
32Menyee kaa kaŋɛ le nna: “Anyee sha fanɛ an baa du fanɛ efuliana nɛ amo be basa bee shuŋ ndibi nɛ ajembu na nna.” Ama kusɔ nɛ menyee fɛ na maaŋ tiŋ n wora kikɛ. 33Ma Enyɛnpetale Ebɔrɛ na e naa kaŋɛ menyi kashenteŋto na fanɛ meeŋ ta eleŋ n ji kuwura menyi so nɛ men pin kananɛ ma agbogboŋ du. 34Eleŋ nɛ tintiŋ nɛ agbogboŋ nɛ meeŋ ta n lara menyi ashi efuliana nɛ men pesaŋ to n yɔ na, m ba gama abar so. 35Nseŋ bar menyi keshishɛrsawule nɛ efuliana na kulti kumo na so, nɛ ma nɛ menyi e tu abar ndoŋ nɛ n ji menyi demu nɛ men ji n tɔr. 36Kananɛ n ji men tutoana demu Ijipt be efuli so be kiyi to nɛ b ji n tɔr nɛ ŋ gberge bumo kusoe na nɛ meeŋ ji menyi alɛ gba demu. Ma, Enyɛnpetale Ebɔrɛ e kaŋɛ na. 37“Meeŋ ta tintiŋ n shin nɛ men be ekama e wora kusɔ nɛ kɔnɔkoŋwule be ŋkre na bee ŋini. 38Meeŋ lara ŋgbene kpakpaso wuraana nɛ baa lar ma kaman na ashi menyi to. Hale nɛ n lara bumo ashi efuliana nɛ b pesaŋ to n yɔ na gba m ba, b maaŋ nya m bɛta n yɔ Israɛl be kasawule so. Ndoŋ nɛ menyeeŋ pin fanɛ ma e la Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na.
39Kusɔ nɛ Enyɛnpetale Ebɔrɛ bee kaŋɛ menyi nde: Menyi Israɛlebi, be ekama nɛ e bee sha e ya kaa shuŋ mbe agbirana, ŋkpal manɛ so, ade kikɛ be kaman menyeeŋ ba nu n sa ma nseŋ yige kebaa lara esarga a sa menyi be agbirana a jija ma ketre. 40Ŋkpal manɛ so, kachɛ na kaŋ fo ekama ashi Israɛl be efuli so beeŋ shuŋ ma ashi kebee cheembi nɛ baa tre Zayɔn ashi Jerusalɛm to na so, nɛ ma alɛ e sɔ bumo esarga nɛ baaŋ lara n sa ma ndoŋ na. Menyi be asheŋ beeŋ baa par ma nɛ ma alɛ e baa keni menyi be esarga lela nɛ ŋkɛ cheembi na akpa. 41Jemanɛ nɛ meeŋ naŋ lara menyi efuliana nɛ men pesaŋ to n yɔ to m bɛta m ba gama abar so na, ma kagbene beeŋ naŋ fuli menyi so nɛ n sɔ menyi be esarga fanɛ duwu nɛ a bee dufɛ viim na. Ndoŋ nɛ efuliana na kikɛ beeŋ wu fanɛ n du cheembi nna. 42Jemanɛ nɛ meeŋ bɛta menyi m ba Israɛl be efuli so, kasawule nɛ n nase kɔnɔ fanɛ meeŋ ta n sa men tutoana na, nɛ menyeeŋ pin fanɛ ma e la Enyɛnpe na. 43Ndoŋ nɛ menyeeŋ nyiŋi menyi be asheŋ wora so nɛ a shin nɛ men jija menyi be kebaawɔtɔ na, nɛ a shin nɛ menyi be asheŋ e baa nu menyi gbagba agbo ŋkpal asheŋ lubi nɛ men wora so. 44Jemanɛ nɛ meeŋ wora menyi, Israɛlebi, asheŋ nɛ a beeŋ bar ma ketre kemaŋkura nɛ mannɛ men be asheŋ lubi nɛ aworbi jiga so na nɛ menyeeŋ pin fanɛ ma e la Enyɛnpetale Ebɔrɛ na.”
45Kede be kaman nɛ Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na be kubɔya naŋ ba ma kutɔ. 46E yɛ: “Dimɛdi pibi, kilgi a keni kelargato be kaseto nseŋ malga ŋ gbiti kupo nɛ k wɔ ndoŋ na. 47Kaŋɛ kupo na fanɛ k kaŋ kusoe n nu Enyɛnpe na be kubɔya. E yɛ: ‘Mee sha kenya edɛ n wɔtɔ fo to nɛ a chɔɔ fo ndibi bumbuŋ nɛ awɔlso kikɛ m mur nna na. Sheŋ maaŋ tiŋ n duŋ edɛ na saŋɛ nɛ a beeŋ yili kelargato be kaseto n chɔɔ a yɔ kelargato be esoso na. Kusɔkama malɛ nɛ edɛ na beeŋ tu amo be kebɔr so beeŋ ji edɛ m mur. 48Ekama beeŋ pin fanɛ ma Enyɛnpe na e nya edɛ na n wɔtɔ kupo na to nɛ ekama malɛ maaŋ tiŋ n duŋ amo.’ ”
49Ndoŋ nna nɛ n fubel ŋ kaŋɛ: “Enyɛnpetale Ebɔrɛ, sa maŋ shin nɛ n wora loŋ! Ekama bee malga a kaŋɛ fanɛ aŋasa nɛ mee bɔ nɛ a bee wul bumo to.”

english_text:
The Lord Will Punish Jerusalem
1The Lord said:
2Ezekiel, son of man, condemn the places in Jerusalem where people worship. Warn everyone in Israel 3that I am about to punish them. I will pull out my sword and have it ready to kill everyone, whether good or evil. 4From south to north, people will die, 5knowing that my sword will never be put away.
6Ezekiel, groan in sorrow and despair so that everyone can hear you. 7When they ask why you are groaning, tell them you have terrifying news that will make them faint and tremble in fear and lose all courage. These things will happen soon. I, the Lord God, make this promise!
A Sword Is Ready To Attack Israel
8The Lord said:
9-10Ezekiel, son of man, tell the people of Jerusalem:
I have sharpened my sword
to slaughter you;
it is shiny and will flash
like lightning!
Don't celebrate—
punishment is coming,
because everyone has ignored
my warnings.
11My sword has been polished;
it's sharp and ready to kill.
12Groan in sorrow, Ezekiel;
the sword is drawn against
my people and their leaders.
They will die!
So give up all hope.
13I am testing my people,
and they can do nothing
to stop me.
I, the Lord, have spoken.
14Ezekiel, warn my people,
then celebrate my victory
by clapping your hands.
My vicious sword will attack
again and again,
killing my people
with every stroke.
15They will lose all courage
and stumble with fear.
My slaughtering sword
is waiting at every gate,
flashing and ready to kill.
16It will slash right and left,
wherever the blade is pointed.
17Then I will stop being angry,
and I will clap my hands
in victory.
I, the Lord, have spoken.
The King of Babylonia and His Sword
18The Lord said:
19Ezekiel, son of man, mark two roads for the king of Babylonia to follow when he comes with his sword. The roads will begin at the same place, but be sure to put up a signpost where the two roads separate and go in different directions. 20Clearly mark where the two roads lead. One goes to Rabbah, the capital of Ammon, and the other goes to Jerusalem, the fortified capital of Judah. 21When the Babylonian king stands at that signpost, he will decide which way to go by shaking his arrows, by asking his idols, and by carefully looking at the liver of a sacrificed animal. 22His right hand will pull out the arrow marked “Jerusalem.” Then he will immediately give the signal to shout the battle cry, to build dirt ramps up to the top of the city walls, to break down its walls and gates with large wooden poles, and to kill the people. 23Everyone in Jerusalem had promised to be loyal to Babylonia, and so none of them will believe that this could happen to them. But Babylonia's king will remind them of their sinful ways and warn them of their coming captivity.
24Ezekiel, tell the people of Jerusalem and their ruler that I, the Lord God, am saying:
Everything you do is wicked and shows how sinful you are. You are guilty and will be taken away as prisoners.
25And now, you evil and wicked ruler of Israel, your day of final punishment is almost here. 26I, the Lord God, command you to take off your royal turban and your crown, because everything will be different. Those who had no power will be put in charge, and those who now rule will become nobodies. 27I will leave Jerusalem in complete ruins like no one has ever seen until my chosen one comes to punish this city.
Judgment against Ammon
28 The Lord God said:
Ezekiel, son of man, the Ammonites have insulted Israel, so condemn them and tell them I am saying:
A sword is drawn,
ready to slaughter;
it is polished and prepared
to kill as fast as lightning.
29You wicked Ammonites see false visions and believe untrue messages. But your day of punishment is coming soon, and my sword will slaughter you!
30Your days to punish others are over, so put your swords away. You will be punished in the land of your birth. 31My furious anger will scorch you like fire, and I will hand you over to cruel men who are experts in killing. 32You will be burned and will die in your own land. Then you will be forgotten forever. I, the Lord, have spoken.
translation_text:
Babilɔn ka la Ebɔrɛ be tokobi be asheŋ
1Ndoŋ nna nɛ Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na kaŋɛ ma le: 2“Dimɛdi pibi, Ezikɛl, kilgi fo anishi n shoŋi Jerusalɛm m malga ŋ gbiti kakpa nɛ basa na bee shuŋ be Ebɔrɛ na. Kpele Israɛl be basa kikɛ kusoe 3nseŋ kaŋɛ bumo fanɛ ma, Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na bee kaŋɛ fanɛ b ki ndoŋana nna. Amoso meeŋ pee ma tokobi kumo be efar to m mɔ bumo to be basa lela nɛ belubi kikɛ. 4Ma tokobi na beeŋ yili kelargato be kaseto be kaba so m ba choŋ kelargato be esoso na kikɛ m mɔ basa kama nɛ b wɔ ndoŋ 5Nɛ ekama e pin fanɛ ma, Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na maaŋ naŋ bɛta ma tokobi nɛ n pee na n wɔtɔ kumo be efar to kikɛ.
6Amoso, dimɛdi pibi, shin nɛ fo kagbene e jija fo nɛ fo baa shu ashi kakpa nɛ ekama beeŋ wu fo. 7B kaŋ bishi fo kusɔ nɛ k ba nɛ fee shu fo kaŋɛ bumo le: ‘Baru nɛ k bee ba na so nɛ mee shu.’ Kumo jemanɛ kaŋ fo ekama be kagbene beeŋ jija mo nɛ kufu e tɔr ekama so nɛ bumo be aba e pɔ bumo nɛ b baa chicha a maaŋ naŋ tiŋ n wora shɛŋ. Kachɛ na bee ba! K maaŋ naŋ chɛr nseŋ ba. Ma, Enyɛnpetale Ebɔrɛ na e kaŋɛ na.”
8Kumo be kaman nɛ Enyɛnpe na naŋ kaŋɛ ma le: 9“Dimɛdi pibi, kaŋɛ Jerusalɛm be basa na fanɛ;
N wora ma tokobi shiriya n loge,
n yee kumo nɛ k bee kpa edɛ.
10N yee kumo nɛ n mɔ;
n fifɛa kumo so nɛ k bee kpa edɛ fanɛ bɔrɛ ka nyɛkpɛ na!
Kayurji maŋ naa wɔtɔ,
ŋkpal manɛ so, ma basa
kplaŋ ma kasokpele nɛ kasogberge kikɛ so nna.
11Mee yee ma tokobi nna,
a wora kumo shiriya a jo,
esa nɛ e beeŋ ta kumo m mɔ na.
12Dimɛdi pibi, boŋ to awɔrso,
ŋkpal manɛ so tokobi na bee ba ma basa
nɛ Israɛl be benimuana so nna.
Bumo kikɛ beeŋ wu,
bumo nɛ basa nɛ b ka na kikɛ.
Amoso, ta enɔ n deŋi kumu a shu!”
13Kede be kaman nɛ Enyɛnpetale Ebɔrɛ na naŋ kaŋɛ le: “Mee wora ma basa a keni nna na,
nɛ b kaŋ kini ketuba,
kumo ere asheŋ ere kikɛ beeŋ ba bumo so.”
14“Amoso, dimɛdi pibi,
kpele bumo kusoe,
nseŋ ber enɔbelaŋ ŋkpal ŋ ka kɔ m pɔɔ so so.
Tokobi na beeŋ baa mɔ bena nɛ jiso kikɛ,
nseŋ ta kufu m pɛ basa na.
Kamɔ be tokobi e la kumo
k la kamɔ damta be tokobi nna,
bena nɛ jiso nɛ k bee mɔ.
15Saŋɛ na so kufu beeŋ pɛ basa;
nɛ galeŋga e chicha n fiti n tɔr.
N wora ma tokobi shiriya nɛ k mɔ
ashi bumo be mbunaana kikɛ ase.
N tiŋ n yee kumo nna nɛ k bee kpa edɛ fanɛ bɔrɛ ka bee nyɛkpɛ na,
nseŋ pɛ kumo to nɛ m mɔ.
16K beeŋ baa ŋe bena nɛ jiso;
kaplɛkama nɛ kumo be jisoso
kilgi n shoŋi nɛ k beeŋ ŋe.
17Ma alɛ gba beeŋ ber enɔbelaŋ,
nɛ ma agbo e yɔɔso.
Ma, Enyɛnpe e kaŋɛ na.”
18Kumo be kaman nɛ Enyɛnpe na be kubɔya ba ma kutɔ: 19E yɛ: “Dimɛdi pibi, ŋini ekpa anyɔ nɛ Babilɔn be efuli so be ewura beeŋ ta mbe tokobi na m bɔla so m ba. Ekpa anyɔ na daga fanɛ a fara efuli koŋwule so nna. Dulgi kakpa nɛ ekpa na barga to anyɔ na, 20a ŋini ekpa nɛ k bee yɔ Ammɔnebi be kadegboŋ nɛ baa tre Raba na, nɛ kumo nɛ kumo alɛ bee yɔ Juda be kadegboŋ nɛ baa tre Jerusalɛm nɛ b pɔr egbal ŋ kulti kumo na; nɛ Babilɔn be ewura na e bɔla so n yɛr mbe tokobi na. 21Babilɔn be ewura kaŋ baa fo ekpa anyɔ na be ŋkpancheri na, e beeŋ bɔla mbe atanyembi so nɛ mbe agbirana so nɛ kusɔbɔya nɛ b mɔ n lara sarga be kegbirche so m bishi so m pin kusɔ nɛ e beeŋ wora. 22Nɛ e baaŋ ta enɔjiso m pee ketanyembi nɛ b sibɛ ‘Jerusalɛm’ n deŋi kumo so a ŋini fanɛ b kɔ kumo kena, e beeŋ shin nɛ b foŋ kabel n sa benapo ekpa nɛ b ya kulti kadegboŋ na n wɔtɔ, nseŋ koli eshishɛr n deŋi abar so ŋ gbuŋ egbal nɛ k kulti kade na, saŋɛ na so baaŋ bɔla amo so n dii n luri kade na to ŋ kɔ basa na kena. Bumo alɛ beeŋ naaŋ ta ndibi gbɛgbɛso n da kade na be mbunagboŋ na m bugi n n luri to. 23Ekama nɛ e wɔ Jerusalɛm beeŋ baa fɛ fanɛ efɛ be kubɔya e la kumo, ŋkpal manɛ so, bumo nɛ Babilɔn be ewura nase nnɔ nna n sa abar. Ama e beeŋ nyiŋi bumo asheŋ lubi nɛ b wora na nseŋ yili amo so pɛ bumo ŋ ki anya.
24Amoso kusɔ nɛ Enyɛnpetale Ebɔrɛ na kaŋɛ e la fanɛ, ŋkpal menyi, Jerusalɛm be basa, nɛ menyi be ewura be alubi ka dii efuli ashi kusɔ kama nɛ menyee wora to so, meeŋ shin nɛ b pɛ menyi ŋ ki anya.
25Fo, Israɛl be ewura lubi nɛ kumu kpakpaso wura ere, fo kasogberge be kachɛ maaŋ naŋ chɛr nseŋ fo. 26Ma, Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na e naa kaŋɛ fo na fanɛ fo shɛŋi fo kumu so be neemu na nseŋ lara kuwurwuro na. Ŋkpal manɛ so, asheŋ maaŋ naa du kananɛ a daa du na. Esa nɛ e daa maŋ kɔ eyilikpa beeŋ nya eyilikpa nɛ emo nɛ e daa kɔ eyilikpa e paŋ mbe eyilikpa. 27Meeŋ shin nɛ kadegboŋ na e mur! Kumo alɛ maaŋ naŋ ki kade kikɛ n ya fo fanɛ esa nɛ k la mo peya na ka beeŋ ba, nɛ n ta kumo n sa mo.
28Ama fo, dimɛdi pibi, kaŋɛ fanɛ kusɔ nɛ Enyɛnpetale Ebɔrɛ na bee kaŋɛ a laŋɛ Ammɔn be basa nɛ baa tege Israɛl na be kaplɛa so e la fanɛ
b gberge tokobi m pe,
n wora shiriya nɛ b mɔ;
b fifɛa kumo so nna m bela ase nɛ b ta kumo m mɔ.
K bee kpa edɛ fanɛ bɔrɛ ka nyɛkpɛ nna!
29Ebɔrɛdare nɛ menyee ku na la efɛ nna,
nɛ asheŋ nɛ men kpal n wu na kikɛ la kafulesheŋ.
Menyi amu kpakpasowuraana nɛ basa lubi ere,
menyi be kasogberge be kachɛ bee ba;

30Amoso men bɛta menyi be tokobi
n wɔtɔ kumo be efar to.
Ŋkpal manɛ so jemanɛ nɛ menyee gberge basa kusoe fo ekar.
Meeŋ ji menyi demu
kakpa nɛ b kurge menyi,
ashi men nanaana be kasawule so na.
31Meeŋ shin nɛ ma agbo e ba menyi so
fanɛ edɛ na n chɔɔ menyi.
Meeŋ ta menyi m bɔɔ basa nyaŋnyaŋso enɔ,
basa nɛ b nyi kamɔ to.

menyi be ŋklaŋ beeŋ wurge menyi be kasawule so
nɛ esa kikɛ maaŋ naŋ nyiŋi menyi kikɛ;
