Shɛŋ shɛŋ malɛ maaŋ tiŋ ŋ gelge bumo.
4Kashenteŋto b du fanɛ egbaŋɛ nna
nsaa shile manaŋ manaŋ fanɛ esoji ka dii
egbaŋɛ a yɔ kena to na.
5B baa wɔ abee so a tɛ,
bumo be egbri du fanɛ egbaŋɛturko be egbri nna,
a shin nɛ kaplɛkama bee gbri waa fanɛ kananɛ
edɛ bee chɔɔ afitiri wɔlso nɛ a bee gbri na.
Baa pɛ abar a yɔ kena to nna.
6Bumo alɛ baa ba,
kufu bee pɛ ekama nna nyam
nɛ ekama e baa chicha kufuso.
7-8Baa ba nna m ba kɔ kusɔ kama
fanɛ benapo na, nsaa dii egbalana
fanɛ kananɛ benapo bee dii egbal na.
Bumo kikɛ bee kaa pɛ abar to kelargato nna
a ji kenyɛn a yɔ anishito tinini
ŋkaa maa gbɛ a yɔ kakpa ko,
ŋko a kagle abar to.
Baa tiŋ a luri bekumpo lempo to a lar
nɛ shɛŋ shɛŋ maa kuŋ bumo ekpa.
9Baa yarase nna a buu kadegboŋ na
nsaa shile a tɛmbaŋ kumo be egbalana.
Baa tiŋ a bɔla etokuro to a luri ebuana to
fanɛ beyu na.
Basa be kelar bumo be alubi to be saŋɛ ka fo be asheŋ
10B baa ba, kasawule bee gbuŋgbuŋ nna
nɛ awɔlpa bee wora fanɛ a ka bee chicha na,
nɛ epeŋi nɛ kufɔl kikɛ malɛ e biri to tuum
nɛ achɛkpabi e fuli to ŋ gben.
11Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na bee kaa ponte to nna
a juŋkpar mbe benapo,
nɛ b kɔ eleŋ nsaa shi
nɛ esa maaŋ tiŋ ŋ karga bumo na,
nɛ baa nu a sa mo.
Yee, Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ be kachɛ na beeŋ lubi pasaa!
Wanɛ e naaŋ nya ŋkpa
loŋ be kachɛ na bre?
12Ama naniere Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na yɛ:
“Men lar men be alubi to
m bugi men be ŋgbene n sa ma kashenteŋto
nseŋ ta ekishi nɛ anishichubi
nɛ ŋgbenejija be kushu
m bɛta m ba ma kutɔ.
13Men shin nɛ men be kagbenejija na e di efuli
ŋ ŋini fanɛ kashenteŋto
men be ŋgbene maŋ dese menyi.
Men be asɔbuuso be kekpɛa to ere bre maŋ la shɛŋ.
Men bɛta m ba Enyɛnpe,
men be Ebɔrɛ na kutɔ.
E la enyitipo nna,
nsaa bɛ mbe nnɔ naseso so.
Saŋkikɛ e wora shiriya nna nɛ e ta men be alubi m paŋ menyi
nsaa maaŋ gberge menyi kusoe
14Nɛ men lar men be alubi to
ashere Enyɛnpe, men be Ebɔrɛ na beeŋ chɛrga mbe nfɛra
nseŋ nɛfa menyi nɛ men be adɔjibi e wora nɛnɛ ga.
Loŋ nɛ menyeeŋ tiŋ n nya adɔjibi nɛ asɔ nuuso
n lara sarga n sa mo.
15Men yili Zayɔn be kebee so
n foŋ kabel n tre ekama m ba shɛr
nseŋ yili kumo fanɛ ekama e kishi!
16Men gbargbar abar m ba shɛr
kecheembiya be ekpa so.
Men shin nɛ basa nɛ b bel kikɛ e ba
loŋ be nshɛr na to.
Men shin nɛ mbiwurbi nɛ mbi popɔrbi gba e ba.
Bumo nɛ b ta abar kepopɔr to gba
daga fanɛ b lar bumo be ebuana to m ba.
17Men shin nɛ bɔrɛmatapoana
nɛ baa shuŋ Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na
e shɛr bɔrɛlambu na to be bɔrɛsure na be kabuna to
n shu ŋ kule Ebɔrɛ ŋ kaŋɛ le:
‘Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ, wu fo basa kuwɔr.
Sa maŋ shin nɛ efuli pɔtɛana so ebi e wora anyi eyurto,
nseŋ bishi anyi fanɛ, men be Ebɔrɛ na wɔ nnɛ naniere?’ ”
Ebɔrɛ ka beeŋ shin nɛ nɛfa e naŋ ba kasawule na so be asheŋ
18Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ be kasawule be asheŋ tir mo ga nna,
nɛ e wu mbe basa kuwɔr nseŋ nu bumo be kabɔrɛkule
19ŋ kaŋɛ bumo le:
“Naniere bre meeŋ sa menyi adɔjibi nɛ asɔ nuuso
nɛ ɔlif be asɔrso be ŋku nɛ men ji m moɛ.
Loŋ na efuli pɔtɛana so ebi maaŋ naŋ fɛl menyi
nseŋ wora menyi eyurto.
20Meeŋ ju benapo be katuŋgboŋ,
nɛ b shi kelarga to be esoso m ba fanɛ elotɔr na,
ashi menyi to n ya lɛ keshishɛrsawule so kiyi to chil.
Meeŋ ju bumo be bejuŋkparpoana n yɔ Teku Wuso na to
nseŋ shin nɛ bumo be bemantopo na malɛ
e yɔ Mɛditerenia be teku to,
n ya wu mbɛ a dufɛ.”
21Ŋkpal Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ ka wora asɔgboŋ n sa menyi so
menyi be ndɔana gba nya nɛfa
nɛ amo be ŋgbene fuli amo
nɛ a bee ji eyur.
22Kupuŋ to be asɔbɔya,
e sa maŋ naa lɔ kufu naniere
ŋkpal kusɔ nɛ menyeeŋ ji so.
Afitiri nɛ afantaŋ kikɛ purge nna jiliim
n sɔ kaplɛkama.
Naniere ndibi bee sɔr asɔrso nna
nɛ figi nɛ greep be asɔrso kikɛ chase.
23Zayɔnebi,
men shin nɛ men be ŋgbene e fuli menyi
ŋkpal kusɔ nɛ Enyɛnpe, men be Ebɔrɛ na
wora n sa menyi na so.
E sa menyi dɔchubɔrɛso be bɔrɛ
nɛ bɔrɛchu lela
nɛ a shin nɛ men be adɔjibi wora nɛnɛ
fanɛ kananɛ a chɛr a wora na.
24Naniere mboŋ kama
nɛ baa biri ayu na kikɛ beeŋ bɔlɔ
nɛ mboŋ kama nɛ baaŋ nyaŋ asɔrso
a wora greep be nsa
ŋko ɔlif be ŋku na kikɛ
e bɔlɔ a wurge.
25Meeŋ bɛta asɔ kama
nɛ benapo nɛ b du fanɛ
elotɔr damta na daŋ jija na kikɛ
n sa menyi.
Ma Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na e daŋ shuŋi elotɔr na.
26Naniere, menyeeŋ nya ajibi damta n ji m moɛ,
nseŋ fara a di men Nyɛnpetale Ebɔrɛ
nɛ e wora emamachisheŋ n sa menyi na epaŋ.
Kashenteŋto esa kama maaŋ naŋ fɛl ma basa.
27Saŋɛ na so, menyi Israɛlebi beeŋ pin fanɛ ma,
Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na e la men be Ebɔrɛ
nsaa wɔ menyi kutɔ.
Esa kama malɛ maaŋ naŋ tiŋ n fɛl ma basa.
Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ be kachɛ na be asheŋ
28Nɛ Ebɔrɛ naŋ kaŋɛ le:
“Ade kikɛ be kaman,
meeŋ shin nɛ ma kiyoyu e ba ekama so
nɛ men be mbinyɛnsobi nɛ mbichesobi
e fara a bɔ ma kubɔya na
nɛ men be benyɛnnimubiana e ba ku edare
nɛ men be mbrantiɛbi e baa ku bɔrɛdare.
29Loŋ be saŋɛ kaŋ fo,
meeŋ shin nɛ ma kiyoyu e ba ma nyɛrbi
nɛ mbita kikɛ so.
30Kumo be kamɔnchɛ,
meeŋ sa menyi kefiɛso be etɔɔnɛsheŋ
nɛ e shi awɔlpa to nɛ kasawule so.
Kumo be jemanɛ so,
basa ko be ŋklaŋ beeŋ lar
edɛ beeŋ suse n shin nɛ edishi
e sɔ awɔlpa to kikɛ.
31Jemanɛ na ya kaa taga to
epeŋi beeŋ kilgi m biri to le tuum
nɛ kufɔl malɛ e pre to le kpaw
fanɛ ŋklaŋ na.
Asheŋ ere kikɛ beeŋ wora nna pɔɛŋ
nɛ Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ be kachɛ
nɛ e beeŋ ba na e fo.
Kachɛ na kaŋ fo, kufu beeŋ pɛ basa ga.
32Ama Ebɔrɛ beeŋ mɔlga bekama
nɛ b kule mo kechɛto
fanɛ kananɛ e kaŋɛ na!
E yɛ: ‘Basa nɛ b wɔ Zayɔn be kebee so
nɛ Jerusalɛm to na bre
beeŋ gelge loŋ be etɔrɔ na.
Bekama nɛ n lara na bre
beeŋ ji efute.’ ”

english_text:
The Lord Will Judge the Nations
1At that time I, the Lord, will make Judah and Jerusalem prosperous again. 2Then in Judgment Valley I will bring together the nations that scattered my people Israel everywhere in the world, and I will bring charges against those nations. They divided up my land 3and gambled to see who would get my people; they sold boys and girls to pay for prostitutes and wine.
4 You people of Tyre and Sidon and you Philistines, why are you doing this? Are you trying to get even with me? I'll strike back before you know what's happened. 5You've taken my prized possessions, including my silver and gold, and carried them off to your temples. 6You have dragged the people of Judah and Jerusalem from their land and sold them to the Greeks.
7But I'll make the people of Judah determined to come home, and what happened to them will happen to you. 8I'll hand over your sons and daughters to the people of Judah, and they will sell them to the Sabeans, who live far away. I, the Lord, have spoken!
Judgment in Judgment Valley
9Say to the nations:
“Get ready for war!
Be eager to fight.
Line up for battle
and prepare to attack.
10 Make swords out of plows
and spears out of garden tools.
Strengthen every weakling.”
11Hurry, all you nations!
Come quickly.
Ask the Lord to bring
his warriors along.
12You must come now
to Judgment Valley,
where the Lord will judge
the surrounding nations.
13 They are a field of ripe crops.
Bring in the harvest!
They are grapes piled high.
Start trampling them now!
If our enemy's sins were wine,
every jar would overflow.
14Crowds fill Decision Valley.
The judgment day of the Lord
will soon be here—
15no light from the sun or moon,
and stars no longer shine.
16 From the heart of Jerusalem
the Lord roars like a lion,
shaking the earth and sky.
But the Lord is a fortress,
a place of safety
for his people Israel.
God Will Bless His People
17I am the Lord your God.
And you will know I live on Zion,
my sacred hill,
because Jerusalem will be sacred,
untouched by foreign troops.
18On that day, fruitful vineyards
will cover the mountains.
And your cattle and goats
that graze on the hills
will produce a lot of milk.
Streams in Judah
will never run dry;
a stream from my house
will flow in Acacia Valley.
19Egypt and Edom were cruel
and brutal to Judah,
without a reason.
Now their countries will become
a barren desert,
20but Judah and Jerusalem
will always have people.
21I, the Lord, live on Mount Zion.
I will punish the guilty
and defend the innocent.
translation_text:
Ebɔrɛ ka beeŋ ji efuli pɔtɛana so ebi demu be asheŋ
1Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na yɛ:
“Loŋ be jemanɛ na,
meeŋ nɛfa Jerusalɛmebi ashi Juda be efuli so kikɛ,
n shin nɛ asheŋ e naŋ nyalɛ n sa bumo.
2Meeŋ gbargbar efuli pɔtɛana kikɛ so ebi
m ba shɛr ketaŋɛ nɛ baa tre Jehoshafat na to
n ji bumo demu ŋkpal asɔ lubi kama
nɛ b wora ma basa na so.
B pesaŋ Israɛlebi na to n wɔtɔ efuli pɔtɛana to
nseŋ ta ma kasawule m barga to n sa abar.
3B daŋ to beri nna n fin bumo nɛ
baaŋ ta Israɛlebi be basa nɛ b pɛ kena to na ŋ ki anya.
B daŋ fa n fa bumo be mbinyɛnsobi nɛ mbichesobi
fanɛ anya nseŋ ta loŋ be amansherbi na
a sha esakaleche ŋko a nuu nsa.
4Tayaebi nɛ Sidɔnebi, nɛ menyi kama nɛ men wɔ Filisti be nsawule so na kikɛ; manɛ nɛ menyee sha kewora ma ere? Menyee sha kewora ma n tal to nna ŋko? To, nɛ k la loŋ bre, meeŋ juŋkpar n wora menyi pɔɛŋ nɛ men nya ekpa n wora ma n tal to. 5Men yuri ma shuwa nɛ gbiti nɛ ma yawu kpakpaso be asɔ n ya wɔtɔ men be agbirlambu to. 6Men ta Juda be efuli so ebi nɛ Jerusalɛmebi n lar bumo gbagba be efuli so n yɔ kufɔ kufɔ n ya fa n sa Griik be efuli so ebi. 7Ama naniere, meeŋ lara bumo ashi mboŋ kama nɛ men daŋ yɛr bumo na. Kumo be kaman nɛ n wora menyi asheŋ kama nɛ men daŋ ta n wora bumo na gbagba chap. 8Meeŋ shin nɛ b fa menyi alɛ gba be mbinyɛnsobi nɛ mbichesobi n sa Juda be efuli so ebi. Baaŋ fa bumo n sa Sabiaebi nɛ b wɔ kufɔ kufɔ na. Ma, Enyɛnpetale Ebɔrɛ na e kaŋɛ na.”
9Nɛ Anebi Jowɛl kaŋɛ:
“Men ta le be kubɔya ere n sa efuli pɔtɛana so ebi kikɛ
fanɛ b bela ase ŋ kɔ kena.
Ekama e tre mbe benapo ŋ gbargbar
n shin nɛ b lar m wora shiriya.
10Men ta men be asɔbɔya be ntekpa m bel etokobi
nseŋ ta men be nsaŋɛgboŋ m bel akpa.
Men kikɛ nyam e bela ase ŋ kɔ kena.
Menyi to be bepɔshipo gba beeŋ kɔ.
11Menyi efuli pɔtɛana so ebi nɛ men kulti nfe ere kikɛ,
e wora manaŋ ŋ gbargbar abar.”
Kede be kaman nɛ anebi Jowɛl kaŋɛ Ebɔrɛ le:
“O Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ, shuŋi fo benapo nɛ b kɔ basa ere kena.”
12Nɛ Ebɔrɛ kaŋɛ:
“A daga fanɛ efuli pɔtɛana so ebi kikɛ
e bela ase m ba Jehoshafat be ketaŋɛ to naniere.
Ndoŋ nɛ ma Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na beeŋ chena
n ji bumo kikɛ demu.
13B kɔ amu kpakpaso ga
nseŋ wora alubi a maa shu basa so.
Amoso meeŋ ŋele bumo n lɛ
fanɛ aboyu na nseŋ kɔr bumo to
fanɛ kananɛ baa kɔr greep be asɔrso to
a wora nsa a wɔtɔ kusɔ to
nɛ a bee bɔlɔ a wurge na.”
14Nɛ Anebi Jowɛl kaŋɛ:
“Basa ŋgboŋto ŋgboŋto beeŋ ba wɔ ketaŋɛ na to
nɛ Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na e ji bumo demu.
Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na be kachɛ na
be saŋɛ na maaŋ naŋ chɛr nseŋ ba.
15Loŋ be kachɛ na,
epeŋi nɛ kufɔl beeŋ nyɔ m biri to ŋ ki le tuum,
nɛ achɛkpabi e fuli to ŋ gben.
Ebɔrɛ ka beeŋ nɛfa mbe basa be asheŋ
16Ebɔrɛ shi Zayɔn be kebeegboŋ na so m ponte to
fanɛ buluŋ na nɛ mbe ebɔl shi Jerusalɛm to
ŋ gbri m ba fanɛ bɔrɛ ka ponte na
nɛ kasawule nɛ awɔlpa kikɛ gbuŋgbuŋ to.
Ebɔrɛ beeŋ baa du fanɛ kebeegboŋ
a kuŋ mbe basa Israɛlebi na bre.”
17Kede be kaman nɛ Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ yɛ:
“Kumo be jemanɛ na so
nɛ menyi Israɛlebi beeŋ pin fanɛ
ma e la Enyɛnpe men be Ebɔrɛ na.
Ma e wɔ ma kebee cheembi Zayɔn so na.
Jerusalɛm beeŋ naŋ ki kadegboŋ cheembi
nɛ efuli pɔtɛana so ebi
maaŋ naŋ tiŋ ŋ kɔ m pɔɔ kumo so.
18Loŋ be kachɛ na ndibi nɛ b kɔ amo
be asɔrso a wora nsa na
beeŋ wora keshi nɛ asɔbɔya e chase abee so.
Juda be efuli so be mbombi malɛ maaŋ naŋ wɔlto kikɛ.
Nchu beeŋ shi bɔrɛlambu na to
n shile n ya kaa luri ndibi nɛ baa tre akasia
nɛ a yil ketaŋɛ to na to.
19Ijipt be kasawule beeŋ ki kiyi to chil,
kakpa nɛ basa maaŋ baa wɔ,
nɛ Edɔm be kasawule malɛ kikɛ e jija
ŋ ki keshishɛrsawule ŋkpal b ka kɔ Juda be efuli so ebi kena
nseŋ mɔ basa nɛ b maŋ wora alubi na so.
20-21Meeŋ bishi bumo be bekama nɛ b mɔ na kikɛ be kuwule.
M maaŋ kplaŋ bekama malɛ nɛ b wora alubi na so.
Ama basa beeŋ baa wɔ Juda nɛ Jerusalɛm bre to
saŋkikɛ mbaanaayɔ,
nɛ ma, Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na e baa wɔ
Zayɔn be kebeegboŋ na so.”

english_text:
1 I am Amos. And I raised sheep near the town of Tekoa when Uzziah was king of Judah and Jeroboam son of Jehoash was king of Israel.
Two years before the earthquake, the Lord gave me several messages about Israel, 2 and I said:
When the Lord roars
from Jerusalem,
pasturelands and Mount Carmel
dry up and turn brown.
Judgment on Syria
3 The Lord said:
I will punish Syria
for countless crimes,
and I won't change my mind.
They dragged logs with spikes
over the people of Gilead.
4Now I will burn down the palaces
and fortresses of King Hazael
and of King Benhadad.
5I will break through
the gates of Damascus.
I will destroy the people
of Wicked Valley
and the ruler of Beth-Eden.
Then the Syrians will be dragged
as prisoners to Kir.
I, the Lord, have spoken!
Judgment on Philistia
6 The Lord said:
I will punish Philistia
for countless crimes,
and I won't change my mind.
They dragged off my people
from town after town
to sell them as slaves
to the Edomites.
7That's why I will burn down
the walls and fortresses
of the city of Gaza.
8I will destroy the king of Ashdod
and the ruler of Ashkelon.
I will strike down Ekron,
and that will be the end
of the Philistines.
I, the Lord, have spoken!
Judgment on Phoenicia
9 The Lord said:
I will punish Phoenicia
for countless crimes,
and I won't change my mind.
They broke their treaty
and dragged off my people
from town after town
to sell them as slaves
to the Edomites.
10That's why I will send flames
to burn down the city of Tyre
along with its fortresses.
Judgment on Edom
11 The Lord said:
I will punish Edom
for countless crimes,
and I won't change my mind.
They killed their own relatives
and were so terribly furious
that they showed no mercy.
12Now I will send fire to wipe out
the fortresses of Teman
and Bozrah.
Judgment on Ammon
13 The Lord said:
I will punish Ammon
for countless crimes,
and I won't change my mind.
In Gilead they ripped open
pregnant women,
just to take the land.
14Now I will send fire to destroy
the walls and fortresses
of Rabbah.
Enemies will shout and attack
like a whirlwind.
15Ammon's king and leaders
will be dragged away.
I, the Lord, have spoken!
translation_text:
1Mmalaga nɛ Eemɔs nɛ e la mbolpɔkpapo nseŋ shi Tekua be kade to kaŋɛ fanɛ Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ ta n sa mo nfɛ anyɔ pɔɛŋ nɛ kasawule daŋ gbuŋgbuŋ na, nɛ jemanɛ nɛ Uziya daa la Juda be efuli so be ewura nɛ Jehɔash pibinyɛn Jeroboam malɛ daa ji Israɛl be efuli so be kuwura na nde.
2E yɛ:
“Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ baŋ yili Zayɔn be kebeegboŋ
na so ashi Jerusalɛm m ponte,
fanɛ bɔrɛ ka gbri na,
asɔbɔya be ejikpa be mboŋ kikɛ bee wɔl nna,
nɛ afitiri nɛ a wɔ kebeegboŋ
nɛ baa tre Kamɛl na so na kikɛ
e kilgi m pere le kpaw.”
Ebɔrɛ ka ji Siriya demu be asheŋ
3Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na yɛ: “Damaskɔs be basa wora alubi n ya baŋ so. Amoso a ba naa wora shɛŋ, meeŋ gberge bumo kusoe ŋkpal b ka kɔrfɛ Giliad be basa fanɛ kananɛ gbaŋɛ bee gberge ŋgbuliŋ nyɛrɛnyɛrɛ a bri ayu na so. 4Meeŋ shin nɛ edɛ e ya chɔɔ lambu nɛ ewura Haziɛl pɔr na nɛ ewura Bɛnhadad be kumɔlga be mboŋ lempo na kikɛ cheche. 5Meeŋ bure kadegboŋ nɛ baa tre Damaskɔs na be mbunagboŋana na to kpachɛrkpachɛrbi nseŋ mur basa nɛ b wɔ Avɛn be kepla so na nɛ Bɛfadɛn be ejuŋkparpo na. Nseŋ shin nɛ b pɛ Siriya be basa fanɛ basa nɛ b ti ebu na n yɔ Kiir be efuli so kufɔ kufɔ.” Ma Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na e malga na!
Filisti be asheŋ
6Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ yɛ: “Gaaza be basa wora alubi n ya baŋ so. Amoso a ba naa wora shɛŋ, meeŋ gberge bumo kusoe ŋkpal b ka ta efuli lelemu be basa ŋ ki anya n ya fa n sa Edɔmebi so. 7Meeŋ shin nɛ edɛ e ba chɔɔ Gaaza be kade to be kumɔlga be mboŋ lempo nɛ a wɔ egbal nɛ b pɔr ŋ kulti kade na so na kikɛ cheche. 8Meeŋ mur Ashdɔd nɛ Ashkɛlɔn be nde to be bewuraana. Meeŋ jija Ekrɔn be kade cheche. Filisti be esa koŋwule gba maaŋ naaŋ ka a wɔtɔ.” Ma Enyɛnpetale na e malga na.
Tayɛ be asheŋ
9Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ yɛ: “Tayɛ be basa wora alubi n ya baŋ so, amoso a ba naa wora shɛŋ, meeŋ gberge bumo kusoe. M maaŋ yige bumo kikɛ. B kplaŋ bumo be keteri be kɔnɔkoŋwule nɛ b nase n sa abar na be ŋkre so, nseŋ pɛ efuli lelemu be basa n yɔ Edɔm be kasawule so n ya fa. 10Amoso meeŋ shin nɛ edɛ e ba chɔɔ Tayɛ be kumɔlga be mboŋ nɛ a wɔ kumo be egbal nɛ b pɔr ŋ kulti kumo na so kikɛ cheche.”
Edɔm be asheŋ
11Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ yɛ: “Edɔm be basa wora alubi n ya baŋ so. Amoso abaanaaworashɛŋ meeŋ gberge bumo kusoe. B ju m buu bumo kurgepoana Israɛlebi so n ya mɔ bumo. B daŋ maŋ wu bumo kuwɔr ŋkpal bumo be asheŋ ka daa pɛ bumo agbo nɛ b nya agbo n wɔtɔ bumo ga so. 12Amoso meeŋ shin nɛ edɛ e ya chɔɔ Edɔm be efuli so be nde nɛ baa tre Teman na, nɛ Bozra be kumɔlga be mboŋ na kikɛ cheche.”
Ammɔn be asheŋ
13Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ yɛ: “Ammɔn be basa wora alubi n ya baŋ so. Amoso abaanaaworashɛŋ meeŋ gberge bumo kusoe. M maaŋ yige bumo kikɛ. B ka daa kɔ a fin kasawule na, b daŋ baŋɛ bedampoche nɛ b daa wɔ Giliad na be epunana to nna. 14Ŋkpal loŋ so meeŋ shin nɛ edɛ e tɔr egbal nɛ b pɔr ŋ kulti Ammɔn be efuli so be kadegboŋ nɛ baa tre Raaba na so n chɔɔ kumo be kumɔlga be mboŋana. Kumo be kamɔnchɛ benapo beeŋ cha kena to be awɔr nseŋ kɔ kena fanɛ afugboŋ ka bee ber na. 15Baaŋ pɛ bumo be ewura nɛ mbe ekrachiana n yɔ kenyaya to ashi efuli wɔfɔ.” Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na e malga na.

english_text:
Judgment on Moab
1 The Lord said:
I will punish Moab
for countless crimes,
and I won't change my mind.
They made lime from the bones
of the king of Edom.
2Now I will send fire to destroy
the fortresses of Kerioth.
Battle shouts and trumpet blasts
will be heard as I destroy Moab
3with its king and leaders.
I, the Lord, have spoken!
Judgment on Judah
4The Lord said:
I will punish Judah
for countless crimes,
and I won't change my mind.
They have rejected my teachings
and refused to obey me.
They were led astray
by the same false gods
their ancestors worshiped.
5Now I will send fire on Judah
and destroy the fortresses
of Jerusalem.
Judgment on Israel
6The Lord said:
I will punish Israel
for countless crimes,
and I won't change my mind.
They sell honest people for money,
and the needy are sold
for the price of sandals.
7They smear the poor in the dirt
and push aside
those who are helpless.
My holy name is dishonored,
because fathers and sons sleep
with the same young women.
8They lie down beside altars
on clothes taken
as security for loans.
And they drink wine in my temple,
wine bought with the money
they received from fines.
9 Israel, the Amorites were there
when you entered Canaan.
They were tall as cedars
and strong as oaks.
But I wiped them out—
I destroyed their branches
and their roots.
10I had rescued you from Egypt,
and for forty years I had led you
through the desert.
Then I gave you the land
of the Amorites.
11 I chose some of you
to be prophets
and others to be Nazirites.
People of Israel,
you know this is true.
I, the Lord, have spoken!
12But you commanded the prophets
not to speak their message,
and you pressured the Nazirites
into drinking wine.
13And so I will crush you,
just as a wagon full of grain
crushes the ground.
14No matter how fast you run,
you won't escape.
No matter how strong you are,
you will lose your strength
and your life.
15Even if you are an expert
with a bow and arrow,
you will retreat.
And you won't get away alive,
not even if you run fast
or ride a horse.
16You may be brave and strong,
but you will run away,
stripped naked.
I, the Lord, have spoken!
translation_text:
Mowab be asheŋ
1Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ yɛ: “Mowab be basa be alubi damta so, meeŋ gberge bumo kusoe. B daa maŋ keni Edɔm be ewura be awibi m bɔlɔ kenishi nseŋ chɔɔ amo nɛ a ki nsunɔ. 2Amoso meeŋ shin nɛ edɛ e ya chɔɔ kade nɛ baa tre Kiriɔf nɛ k wɔ Mowab be efuli so na be kumɔlga be mboŋ lempo na. Kena to be awɔr beeŋ cha n nɛ b baa foŋ kena to be mbel saŋɛ nɛ mee mur Mowabebi na. 3Meeŋ mɔ Mowab be ewura nɛ mbe benimu kikɛ.” Ma Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na e malga na.
Juda be asheŋ
4Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ yɛ: “Juda be basa wora alubi n ya baŋ so, amoso abaanaaworashɛŋ meeŋ gberge bumo kusoe. B kplaŋ ma keŋini so nseŋ kini kebɛ ma mbra malɛ so. Agbir koŋwule nɛ bumo nananyɛnana daa shuŋ na e fule bumo nɛ b foe ekpa. 5Ŋkpal loŋ so meeŋ shin nɛ edɛ e ba Juda be efuli so m ba chɔɔ Jerusalɛm be kumɔlga be mboŋ lempo kikɛ.”
Ebɔrɛ b kasogberge ka ba Israɛl so be asheŋ
6Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ yɛ: “Israɛl be basa wora alubi n ya baŋ so, amoso abaanaaworashɛŋ meeŋ gberge bumo kusoe. Baa fa beshenteŋjipo a sɔ amansherbi nna, nsaa fa betirpo malɛ asɛbta katuŋ koŋwuleso be yawu. 7B daa ŋin bepɔshipo nɛ basa nɛ b maaŋ tiŋ n chɛ bumo be amu to nna a lɛ kasawule a chichi bumo so nsaa maa ji betirpo be asheŋ nɛ amo be ekpa so. Ma ketre cheembi na jija nna ŋkpal mbia nɛ bumo tutoana ka bee di beche koŋwule so. 8Epiŋi nɛ b ta n nase tarma n sa bumo na nɛ baa ta a nase bumo be agbir be mboŋ a dese so. Bumo be agbirlambu to nɛ baa chena a nuu nsa nɛ b sɔ ashi basa nɛ b ji bumo be akɔ na kutɔ.
9Ama ŋkpal bumo so, nɛ m mur Amɔriebi nɛ b daa wɔ nteŋ fanɛ ndibi tenteŋ nɛ baa tre Sida na, nsaa kɔ eleŋ malɛ fanɛ ndibi gboŋgboŋi lempo na. N daŋ mur bumo be ayabi nɛ achin kikɛ nna cheche. 10Ma e lara menyi ashi Ijipt be kasawule so dra dra na ŋ keta menyi n nite kiyi to nfɛ adena nseŋ sɔ Amɔriebi be kasawule n sa menyi. 11Ma e lara men be mbinyɛnsobi ko ŋ ki anebiana, nseŋ lara menyi b mbrantiafɔlbi ko malɛ nɛ b ki Nazarinebi. Israɛlebi, manɛ kashenteŋ nna a? Ma Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ e malga na. 12Ama men nyaŋ Nazarinebi na nna nɛ baa nuu nsa nseŋ ju anebiana malɛ fanɛ b sa maŋ kaŋ malga abɔrɛsheŋ. 13Meeŋ buri menyi to n nase kasawule fanɛ kananɛ baa ta aboyu a deŋi turko so nɛ k bee buri to na, nɛ men dese a shu to fanɛ kananɛ baa muu aboyu a bɔlɔ turko nɛ amo be egbɛ bee shin nɛ k bee nite a shu to na. 14Basa nɛ baa shile ga gba maaŋ tiŋ n shile n sɔ bumo be amu. Belempo beeŋ paŋ bumo be eleŋ nɛ benapo gba e mɔlga bumo be amu ŋ gben. 15Basa nɛ b maa to ata a da gba beeŋ shile m bɛta kaman, nɛ basa nɛ baa shile ga gba e shile m mɔlga bumo be amu ŋ gben nɛ egbaŋɛdiipoana gba e dii egbaŋɛ m mɔlga bumo be amu ŋ gben. 16Kumo be kachɛ na, benapo lempo gba beeŋ ta bumo be akɔsɔ n lɛ nseŋ shile.” Ma Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ e malga na.

english_text:
1People of Israel,
I rescued you from Egypt.
Now listen to my judgment
against you.
2Of all nations on earth,
you are the only one
I have chosen.
That's why I will punish you
because of your sins.
The Work of a Prophet
3Can two people walk together
without agreeing to meet?
4Does a lion roar in the forest
unless it has caught
a victim?
Does it growl in its den
unless it is eating?
5How can anyone catch a bird
without using a net?
Does a trap spring shut
unless something is caught?
6Isn't the whole city frightened
when the trumpet
signals an attack?
Isn't the Lord the one who brings
disaster on a city?
7Whatever the Lord God
plans to do,
he tells his servants,
the prophets.
8Everyone is terrified
when a lion roars—
and ordinary people
become prophets
when the Lord God speaks.
Samaria Is Doomed
9Here is a message
for the leaders
of Philistia and Egypt—
tell everyone to come together
on the hills of Samaria.
Let them see the injustice
and the lawlessness
in that city.
10The Lord has said
that they don't even know how
to do right.
They have become rich
from violence and robbery.
11And so the Lord God has sworn
that they will be surrounded.
Enemies will break through
their defenses
and steal their treasures.
12The Lord has promised
that only a few from Samaria
will escape with their lives
and with some broken pieces
of their beds and couches.
It will be like when a shepherd
rescues two leg bones
and part of a sheep's ear
from the jaws of a lion.
The Altars at Bethel
13The Lord God All-Powerful
told me to speak this message
against Jacob's descendants:
14 When I, the Lord, punish Israel
for their sins,
I will destroy the altars
at Bethel.
Even the corners of the altar
will be left in the dirt.
15I will tear down winter homes
and summer homes.
Houses decorated with ivory
and all other mansions
will be gone forever.
I, the Lord, have spoken!
translation_text:
1Menyi Israɛlebi nɛ Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ lara ashi Ijipt be kasawule so dra dra na, e loto n nu kusɔ nɛ e malga ŋ gbiti menyi. 2Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ yɛ: “Menyi nawule nɛ n lara ashi efuliana kikɛ so fanɛ men baa la meya, amoso nɛ meeŋ gberge menyi kusoe alegaiso ŋkpal menyi be alubi so na.”
Anebi be kushuŋ be asheŋ
3Fo daŋ wu basa anyɔ ka bee sha k tu abar n yɔ kade nɛ b maŋ kaŋɛ abar n yili a?
4Fo daŋ nu buluŋ ka bee ponte kiyi to nɛ k maŋ wu kusɔbɔya a?
Fo daŋ nu buluŋ fɔlbi ka wɔ kumo be edesekpa a munto nɛ k maŋ pɛ kusɔ ko a?
5Fo daŋ wu kejigbelɛ ka pɛ kabuibi nɛ manɛ kusɔ ko a yɛr kabuibi na kumo ase a?
Fo daŋ wu kejigbelɛ ka to nɛ mannɛ kusɔ ko a tɔr kumo to a?
6Fo daŋ nu b ka foŋ kena to be kabel kade to nɛ kufu maŋ pɛ basa a?
Fo daŋ wu jɛrbi ka ba kade to nɛ Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ maŋ nyi kumo be asheŋ a? 7Kashenteŋto, Enyɛnpetale maa kre kusɔ ko be kewora nɛ e maŋ lara kumo ŋ ŋini mbe nyɛrbi nɛ b la anebiana na.
8Buluŋ baa ponte to, wanɛ nɛ kufu maaŋ pɛ?
Enyɛnpetale na baŋ lara esa fanɛ e yili mbe katelamu to m malga wanɛ e la amodoŋwura nɛ e tiŋ ŋ kini?
Samɛria be kemur be asheŋ
9Kaŋɛ Ijipt nɛ Ashdɔd be bejuŋkparpoana na le: “Men shɛr abee nɛ a kulti Samɛria be kadegboŋ na so ŋ keni kananɛ asheŋ bee baga to nɛ kananɛ basa bee wora kusɔ nɛ baa sha ŋkpal mbra ka maŋ naa wɔtɔ so.”
10Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ yɛ: “Koyu nɛ kebaa tintiŋ basa a sɔ bumo be asɔ nɛ basa ere bɔla so ŋ gbare asɔ m bɔlɔ ebuana. B maaŋ tiŋ n ji kashenteŋ kikɛ.” 11Amoso le nɛ Enyɛnpetale na kaŋɛ: “Bedoŋ beeŋ ba kulti menyi be efuli n wɔtɔ nseŋ jija men be kumɔlga be mboŋ lempo nseŋ m muu asɔ nɛ a wɔ amo to na kikɛ.”
12Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ yɛ: “Kananɛ buluŋ bee ji kubolpɔ nɛ mbolpɔkpapo e ya sɔ kumo be aya anyɔ nɛ kusoe n ya ŋini kubolpɔwura na, aloŋ nɛ baaŋ mɔlga Samɛriaebi nɛ b dese kedamaya be asɔ deseso so ere be basa gbrɛbi nɛ b nya kumɔlga na.” 13Enyɛnpetale na yɛ: “Kaŋ kusoe n nu nfe, nseŋ kpele Israɛlebi nɛ b la Jeekɔb be kaman to ebi na kusoe.” 14“Kachɛ nɛ meeŋ gberge Israɛl be basa kusoe ŋkpal bumo be alubi so na, nɛ meeŋ mur Bɛtɛl be kade to gba be ebɔrɛsureana. Ebɔrɛsureana na be abonfu kikɛ beeŋ bure n tɔr keshishɛrpumpuŋ to. 15Meeŋ bure bumo be elaŋ nɛ baa dese to kebleŋ to nɛ amo nɛ baa dese to awo to na kikɛ. Bumo be elaŋana nɛ b ta asɔlnyii n ji kebita nɛ bumo be elaŋgboŋ kikɛ beeŋ bure. Ma Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na e malga na.”

english_text:
The Women of Samaria
The Lord said:
1You women of Samaria
are fat cows!
You mistreat and abuse
the poor and needy,
then you say to your husbands,
“Bring us more drinks!”
2I, the Lord God, have sworn
by my own name
that your time is coming.
Not one of you will be left—
you will be taken away
by sharp hooks.
3You will be dragged through holes
in your city walls,
and you will be thrown
toward Harmon.
I, the Lord, have spoken!
Israel Refuses To Obey
The Lord said:
4Come to Bethel and Gilgal.
Sin all you want!
Offer sacrifices the next morning
and bring a tenth of your crops
on the third day.
5Bring offerings to show me
how thankful you are.
Gladly bring more offerings
than I have demanded.
You really love to do this.
I, the Lord God, have spoken!
How the Lord Warned Israel
6 I, the Lord, took away the food
from every town and village,
but still you rejected me.
7Three months before harvest,
I kept back the rain.
Sometimes I would let it fall
on one town or field
but not on another,
and pastures dried up.
8People from two or three towns
would go to a town
that still had water,
but it wasn't enough.
Even then you rejected me.
I, the Lord, have spoken!
9I dried up your grain fields;
your gardens and vineyards
turned brown.
Locusts ate your fig trees
and olive orchards,
but even then you rejected me.
I, the Lord, have spoken!
10I did terrible things to you,
just as I did to Egypt—
I killed your young men in war;
I let your horses be stolen,
and I made your camp stink
with dead bodies.
Even then you rejected me.
I, the Lord, have spoken!
11 I destroyed many of you,
just as I did the cities
of Sodom and Gomorrah.
You were a burning stick
I rescued from the fire.
But even then you rejected me.
I, the Lord, have spoken!
12Now, Israel, I myself
will deal with you.
Get ready to face your God!
13I created the mountains
and the wind.
I let humans know
what I am thinking.
I bring darkness at dawn
and step over hills.
I am the Lord God All-Powerful!
translation_text:
1Men nu nfe, menyi Samɛria be beche nɛ men danto durfɛ durfɛ fanɛ Bashan be efuli so be ana nɛ baa ji a moɛ ga na. Menyi e naa mɛaŋ betirpo nɛ betentaŋasepo nsaa nyaŋ menyi kulana fanɛ b baa sa menyi nsa na! 2Le nɛ Enyɛnpetale cheembi na nase kɔnɔ ŋ kaŋɛ: “Kachako bedoŋ beeŋ ta akɔltobi ŋ gberge menyi n yɔ. Baaŋ pɛ menyi be ekama fanɛ kekɔltobi ka pɛ kɔrɔtɔ na. 3Baaŋ gbeye menyi m bɔla men be kade be egbal na be kaba nɛ k bure na n ya lɛ kakpa nɛ baa tre Hɛɛmɔn be kaba so.” Ma Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ e malga na.
Israɛl ka kini kekoya asheŋ be asheŋ
4Enyɛnpetale na yɛ: “Menyi Israɛlebi e yɔ Bɛtɛl n ya kaa wora alubi kanaŋkamaso nɛ menyee sha! Men yɔ Gilgaal gba n ya ka wora alubi ndoŋ a ta asɔbɔya a lara sarga kachipurso kikɛ nsaa lara sarga nɛ menyi be kudukudusopo nchɛ asa sa kikɛ. 5Men ta men be bodobodo nɛ a kɔ yisi na m ba lara kechɔrɔ be sarga nsaa puchi ŋkpal esarga damta nɛ men bar na so ŋkpal manɛ so, loŋ nɛ menyee sha kebaa wora.
6Ma e shin nɛ akoŋ tɔr menyi be ndeana kikɛ to, ama amo nɛ amo kikɛ men kraŋ kini kebɛta m ba ma kutɔ. 7Saŋɛ so nɛ k daga men be asɔduuso ka nya bɔrɛ nɛnɛ na, nɛ mee pɛ bɔrɛ a keta. Ma e naa shin nɛ bɔrɛ bee ba. Ma alɛ e naa shin nɛ bɔrɛ bee ba kade ko to nsaa yige kuko, ŋko a ba ndɔ ko to a yige kuko nɛ k bee wɔl. 8Basa lar bumo be ndeana to n yɔ nde ko n ya kaa fin nchu nɛ b nuu ama b daa maŋ nya amo yɛlyɛla so ndoŋ. Amo nɛ amo kikɛ men kraŋ kini kebɛta m ba ŋ kutɔ.” Ma Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na e malga na!
9Ma e shin nɛ afu tushiso jija menyi be adɔjibi nseŋ shin nɛ elotɔr malɛ jija menyi be ndɔana nɛ men be afeelebi nɛ baa tre greep na be ndɔana nɛ figidibi nɛ ɔlif be ndibi be ndɔana, ama amo nɛ amo kikɛ men kraŋ kini kebɛta m ba ŋ kutɔ. Ma Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na e malga na!
10Kulɔ lubi nɛ k bee mɔ nɛ n daŋ shin nɛ k ba Ijipt be efuli so ebi so dra dra na gbagba nɛ n shin nɛ k ba menyi alɛ gba so. Ma e mɔ men be mbifɔlbi kena to n shin nɛ b pɛ bumo be egbaŋɛ n choŋ, nɛ bubuni be efɛa sɔ menyi be echenakpa a dufɛ pumpuŋ a mɔ menyi. Ama amo nɛ amo kikɛ, men kraŋ kini kebɛ ma so.
11Kananɛ m mur ndegboŋ nɛ baa tre Sodɔm nɛ Gomɔra dra dra na, nɛ m mur menyi alɛ gba be beko. Menyi bumo nɛ men nya men be amu na du fanɛ kedibi nɛ k bee chɔɔ nɛ b lara kumo edɛ to n lɛ nna. Ama amo nɛ amo kikɛ men kraŋ kini kebɛta m ba ma kutɔ. Ma Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na e malga na.
12Amoso meeŋ gberge menyi Israɛlebi kusoe. Men wora shiriya a jo ma demuji. 13Ebɔrɛ e to abeegboŋana nseŋ to afu. Mo e naa lara kusɔ nɛ k wɔ mbe nfɛra to a ŋini edimɛdi nsaa shin nɛ kapa bee ki kanyɛ. Mo e naa nite abeegboŋ be esoso na. Mbe ketre e la Enyɛnpetale na!

english_text:
Turn Back to the Lord
1Listen, nation of Israel,
to my mournful message:
2You, dearest Israel, have fallen,
never to rise again—
you lie deserted in your own land,
with no one to help you up.
3The Lord God has warned,
“From every ten soldiers
only one will be left;
from a thousand troops,
only a hundred will survive.”
4The Lord keeps saying,
“Israel, turn back to me
and you will live!
5Don't go to Gilgal or Bethel
or even to Beersheba.
Gilgal will be dragged away,
and Bethel will end up
as nothing.”
6Turn back to the Lord,
you descendants of Joseph,
and you will live.
If you don't, the Lord
will attack like fire.
Bethel will burn to the ground,
and no one can save it.
7You people are doomed!
You twist the truth
and trample on justice.
8 But the Lord created the stars
and put them in place.
He turns darkness to dawn
and daylight to darkness;
he scoops up the ocean
and empties it on the earth.
9God destroys mighty soldiers
and strong fortresses.
Choose Good Instead of Evil!
The Lord said:
10You people hate judges
and honest witnesses;
11you abuse the poor and demand
heavy taxes from them.
You have built expensive homes,
but you won't enjoy them;
you have planted vineyards,
but you will get no wine.
12I am the Lord, and I know
your terrible sins.
You cheat honest people
and take bribes;
you rob the poor of justice.
13Times are so evil
that anyone with good sense
will keep quiet.
14If you really want to live,
you must stop doing wrong
and start doing right.
I, the Lord God All-Powerful,
will then be on your side,
just as you claim I am.
15Choose good instead of evil!
See that justice is done.
Maybe I, the Lord All-Powerful,
will be kind to what's left
of your people.
Judgment Is Coming
16This is what the Lord has sworn:
Noisy crying will be heard
in every town and street.
Even farmers will be told
to mourn for the dead,
together with those
who are paid to mourn.
17Your vineyards will be filled
with crying and weeping,
because I will punish you.
I, the Lord, have spoken!
When the Lord Judges
18You look forward to the day
when the Lord comes to judge.
But you are in for trouble!
It won't be a time of sunshine;
all will be darkness.
19You will run from a lion,
only to meet a bear.
You will escape to your house,
rest your hand on the wall,
and be bitten by a snake.
20The day when the Lord judges
will be dark, very dark,
without a ray of light.
What the Lord Demands
21 I, the Lord, hate and despise
your religious celebrations
and your times of worship.
22I won't accept your offerings
or animal sacrifices—
not even your very best.
23No more of your noisy songs!
I won't listen
when you play your harps.
24But let justice and fairness
flow like a river
that never runs dry.
25 Israel, for forty years
you wandered in the desert,
without bringing offerings
or sacrifices to me.
26Now you will have to carry
the two idols you made—
Sakkuth, the one you call king,
and Kaiwan, the one you built
in the shape of a star.
27I will force you to march
as captives beyond Damascus.
I, the Lord God All-Powerful,
have spoken!
translation_text:
Kelar alubi to be asheŋ
1Israɛl be basa, men nu keeli nɛ mee shu ŋkpal menyi so ere.
2Ma eshapo lela Israɛl, tɔr a dese kasawule,
a maŋ naŋ tiŋ nɛ e koso!
Nɛ b kplaŋ mo so ashi mo gbagba be efuli so.
Esa kama maŋ chɛ mo to nɛ e niŋito.
3Enyɛnpetale na yɛ: “Israɛl be kade ko ka shuŋi benapo kagboŋ kena to, benapo kalfa nawule e bɛta m ba. Nɛ kuko malɛ shuŋi benapo kalfa kena to nɛ benapo kudu nawule bɛta m ba.”
4Le nɛ Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ kra kaŋɛ Israɛl be basa: “Israɛlebi, men bɛta m ba ŋ kutɔ saŋɛ na so menyeeŋ nya ŋkpa. 5Men sa maŋ kaŋ yɔ Bɛshiba n ya shuŋ kegbir kikɛ. Menyi alɛ e sa maŋ kaa fin ma a yɔ Bɛtɛl ŋkpal manɛ so k maaŋ naa la shɛŋ. Men sa maŋ kaŋ yɔ Gilgaal gba ŋkpal manɛ so bedoŋ beeŋ tintiŋ kumo be basa n yɔ kenyaya to efuli wɔfɔ.”
6Men bɛta n yɔ Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na kutɔ nseŋ nya ŋkpa. Men baa maŋ ba mo kutɔ, e beeŋ ta edɛ m mur menyi. Menyi Bɛtɛl be basa e naaŋ chɔɔ. Esa kama malɛ maaŋ tiŋ m mɔlga menyi kikɛ. 7Menyeeŋ mur cheche, ŋkpal manɛ so menyee kilgi kashenteŋ nna a buu nsaa wɔtɔ a puni basa!
8Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ e to achɛkpabi,
Mo e to achɛkpabi be yiri yiri nɛ baa tre Pleeds nɛ Ɔriɔn na kikɛ.
Mo e naa shin nɛ kanyɛ bee kilgi kapa,
nɛ kapa malɛ bee kilgi kanyɛ.
Mo e shin nɛ teku be nchuana bee ki bɔrɛ a ba
kasawule so.
Mbe ketre e la Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na.
9Mo e naa mur benapo lempo
nɛ nde nɛ b pɔr egbal ŋ kulti na kikɛ.
10Menyi Israɛlebi kishi basa nɛ b maa da a buu alubi so nsaa ji asheŋ nɛ amo be ekpa so nna. 11Ŋkpal men ka mɛaŋ betirpo nseŋ suge bumo be adɔjibi so, menyi alɛ gba maaŋ nya elaŋ lela nɛ men ta ajembu m pɔr na n luri to, ŋko n nya men be asɔrso nɛ baa tre greep na be yabra belbelso n nuu. 12N nyi men be alubi damta nɛ menyee wora, nsaa nyi kananɛ menyee puni nsaa tɔrɔ basa lela. Menyee sɔ brɔbu nna nsaa ji betirpo durmu ashi demujikpa. 13Ŋkpal le be alubi ere so benyiashempo bee lo bumo be nnɔ nna.
14Men baa kɔ a fin kelela be kewora nseŋ yige alubi be kebaa wora, saŋɛ na so menyeeŋ baa kɔ ŋkpa, nɛ Enyɛnpetale Ebɔrɛ na e baa wɔ menyi kutɔ fanɛ kananɛ men kaŋɛ na. 15Men kishi kulubi, nsaa wora kelela. Men baa kɔ a fin asheŋ be keji nɛ amo be ekpa so ashi men be edemujikpa. Ashere Enyɛnpetale na beeŋ wu efuli ere be bekama nɛ b kraa wɔ ŋkpa to ere kuwɔr.
16Enyɛnpetale na yɛ: “Basa beeŋ baa boŋ to a shu kagbenejijaso ashi kade kikɛ be abɔrbi so. Baaŋ tre bedɔpo gba nɛ b ba ti basa nɛ b haya so n shu basa nɛ b wu be nli. 17Basa beeŋ baa boŋ to a shu ashi asɔrso nɛ baa tre greep na be ndɔana kikɛ to. Ade kikɛ malɛ beeŋ wora nna ŋkpal ma kasogberge ka bee ba menyi so so.” Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na e malga na.
18Asheŋ maaŋ nyalɛ n sa menyi nɛ menyee jo Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ be demujiachɛ na. Mannɛ be tɔnɔ nɛ loŋ be kachɛ na beeŋ kurge n sa menyi? Loŋ be kachɛ na beeŋ ba kaa la tentembiri nna n sa menyi, mannɛ kefulto. 19Loŋ be kachɛ na beeŋ baa ka du fanɛ esa ka bee shile a ŋana buluŋ so nna nseŋ ya lar shishiri so! Ŋko esa ka ba laŋ to nɛ e ba wushi nseŋ ta mbe enɔ n deŋi egbal so nɛ kuwɔ e duŋ mo. 20Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ be demujiachɛ na, beeŋ baa la tentembiri nna mina mannɛ kefulto. Kefulto gbrɛ kama maaŋ ba wɔtɔ loŋ be kacha na.
21Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ yɛ: “Ŋ kishi menyi be kabɔrɛshuŋ be kejigboŋana be asheŋ alegaiso. 22Hale nɛ men lara esarga chɔɔso nɛ ayu be esarga gba m ba sa ma, maaŋ sɔ amo. Men be asɔbɔya danso duliduli lela gba be asheŋ maaŋ bɔlɔ ma kenishi. 23Men yige men be awɔr fuloŋ be nshɛ na be keboŋ. Maa sha kenu men be ejaŋjilaŋ gba be kushu. 24Ama men shin nɛ kebaaji asheŋ nɛ amo be ekpa so e baa du fanɛ kabombi nɛ k teŋi a shile nɛ men be kebaawɔtɔ niŋiso malɛ e baa du fanɛ lɔr nɛ k maa wɔlto kikɛ na.
25Nfɛ adena kikɛ nɛ n juŋkpar menyi Israɛlebi ashi keshishɛrsawule na so dra dra na, n daŋ bishi menyi toto ŋko sarga ko a? 26Ama naniere bre menyee sulɔ kegbir nɛ baa tre Sukɔf nɛ k la men be ewura na nɛ kegbir nɛ baa tre Keewan nɛ men pɔr fanɛ kechɛkpabi na a nite. 27Amoso meeŋ shin nɛ men doŋana e pɛ menyi nseŋ tintiŋ menyi n yɔ kadegboŋ nɛ baa tre Damaskɔs na hale m baŋ kumo so n yɔ efuli wɔfɔ kenyaya to.” Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ nɛ mbe ketre la Enyɛnpetale Ebɔrɛ na e malga na.

english_text:
Israel Will Be Punished
1Do you rulers in Jerusalem
and in the city of Samaria
feel safe and at ease?
Everyone bows down to you,
and you think you are better
than any other nation.
But you are in for trouble!
2Look what happened
to the cities of Calneh,
powerful Hamath,
and Gath in Philistia.
Are you greater than any
of those kingdoms?
3You are cruel, and you forget
the coming day of judgment.
4You rich people lounge around
on beds with ivory posts,
while dining on the meat
of your lambs and calves.
5You sing foolish songs
to the music of harps,
and you make up new tunes,
just as David used to do.
6You drink all the wine you want
and wear expensive perfume,
but you don't care about
the ruin of your nation.
7So you will be the first
to be dragged off as captives;
your good times will end.
8The Lord God All-Powerful
has sworn by his own name:
“You descendants of Jacob
make me angry by your pride,
and I hate your fortresses.
And so I will surrender your city
and possessions
to your enemies.”
9If only ten of you survive
by hiding in a house
you will still die.
10As you carry out a corpse
to prepare it for burial,
your relative in the house
will ask, “Are there others?”
You will answer, “No!”
Then your relative will reply,
“Be quiet! Don't dare mention
the name of the Lord.”
11At the Lord's command,
houses great and small
will be smashed to pieces.
12Horses can't gallop on rocks;
oceans can't be plowed.
But you have turned justice
and fairness
into bitter poison.
13You celebrate the defeat
of Lo-Debar and Karnaim,
and you boast by saying,
“We did it on our own.”
14But the Lord God All-Powerful
will send a nation to attack
you people of Israel.
They will capture Lebo-Hamath
in the north,
Arabah Creek in the south,
and everything in between.
translation_text:
Israɛl be kemur be asheŋ
1Asheŋ maaŋ nyalɛ n sa menyi nɛ shɛŋ shɛŋ maŋ tir menyi ashi Jerusalɛm, nɛ menyee fɛ fanɛ men nya kekuŋ ashi Samɛria be kade to ere. Asheŋ maaŋ nyalɛ n sa menyi Israɛl be efuli lempo be bunyaŋwuraana, nɛ basa bee kaa ba menyi kutɔ m ba kaa fin kechɛto na! 2Men yɔ Kalnee be kade to n ya keni. Kumo be kaman nɛ men naŋ yɔ kadegboŋ nɛ baa tre Hamaf na nseŋ yili ndoŋ n yɔ Filisti be efuli so be kade nɛ baa tre Gaaf na. Amo be amo e bɔ Juda nɛ Israɛl be efuliana? Ŋko loŋ be efuliana na e shishibi a chɔ menyeya a? 3Men kini keshuli fanɛ demuji be kachɛ na beeŋ ba, ama menyi be asheŋ woraso e naa ŋini fanɛ kachɛ na gba tiŋ n taga to. 4Asheŋ maaŋ nyalɛ n sa menyi nɛ menyee dese asɔchenaso tenteŋ nɛ b ta asɔlnyii m mata m mata so n ji amo kebita na to a we mbolpɔ nɛ ana fɔlbi be eblaŋ na. 5Kananɛ ewura Deevid ashi Jerusalɛm daa ta jaŋjilaŋ a laŋ a boŋ a wora nshɛ popɔr dra dra na, nɛ menyi alɛ gba bee sha kebaa wora. 6Menyee nuu nsa kananɛ k par menyi nna, nsaa gbiti yawu kpakpaso be etulale, ama men kplaŋ men be efuli Israɛl nɛ k bure n loge na bre so. 7Amoso menyi nɛ men doŋana beeŋ juŋkpar n tintiŋ n yɛr efuli pɔtɛ so kufɔ kufɔ nɛ men be ajigboŋ nɛ menyee wora nɛ kedese a wushi ere kikɛ e ba ekar.
8Le nɛ Enyɛnpetale Ewurgboŋ na kaŋɛ kenishipereso: “Israɛl be basa be kamoowu nɛ b kɔ na be asheŋ bee nu ma agbo alegaiso. Ŋ kishi bumo be nwu gboŋgboŋi nɛ b pɔr na ga. Ma alɛ beeŋ ta bumo be kadegboŋ na nɛ kusɔ kama nɛ k wɔ kumo to n sa bumo doŋana.”
9Hale basa kudu gba ka kanaŋ na to, bumo alɛ gba beeŋ wu. 10Esa nɛ e wu na mo kurgepo nɛ e la keeliwura na e naŋ ya lara kebuni na kowu. Kumo be kaman nɛ e bishi esa kama nɛ e ka laŋ na to le: “Fo nɛ esa ko e wɔtɔ a?
Ndoŋ nna nɛ esa na e kaŋɛ le: ‘M-m!’ ”
Kumo be kaman nɛ ekurgepo na e kaŋɛ le: “Men loto! Men shin nɛ an baa de kananɛ anyee ti an Nyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na be ketre so.”
11Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na baŋ malga, elaŋgboŋana nɛ afimbiana kikɛ bee bure to nna kpachɛrkpachɛrbi. 12Egbaŋɛ beeŋ tiŋ n shile afalta so manaŋ manaŋ a? Ŋko anafɛlso beeŋ tiŋ n dɔ teku to a? Ama menyi ere ta keji asheŋ nɛ amo be ekpa so ŋ kilgi kɔrtɔ nseŋ ta ekpa niŋiso malɛ ŋ ki ekpa kɔnto.
13Menyee ji njɔŋ nna ŋkpal men ka kɔ m pɔɔ Lodiba be kade so so. Nsaa wu menyi be amu ŋkpal men ka kɔ n sɔ Karnayim so.
14Le nɛ Enyɛnpetale na gbagba bee kaŋɛ: “Meeŋ shin nɛ efuli pɔtɛ ko so ebi e ba kɔ menyi Israɛlebi nseŋ sɔ menyi be efuli kikɛ n chena so. Baaŋ yili Hamaf nɛ k wɔ kebeemase ashi kelargato be esoso be kaba so ŋ kɔ sɔ n ya fo kepa nɛ baa tre Araba na be kelargato be kaseto be kaba so kikɛ.”

english_text:
A Vision of Locusts
1The Lord God showed me that he is going to send locusts to attack your crops. It will happen after the king has already been given his share of the grain and before the rest of the grain has been harvested. 2In my vision the locusts ate every crop in the land, and I said to the Lord, “Please forgive your nation. It's so weak. How can it survive?”
3Then the Lord felt sorry and answered, “I won't let it be destroyed.”
A Vision of Fire
4The Lord showed me that he is going to send a ball of fire to burn up everything on earth, including the ocean. 5Then I said, “Won't you please stop? How can our weak nation survive?”
6Again the Lord felt sorry and answered, “I won't let it be destroyed.”
A Vision of a Measuring Line
7The Lord showed me a vision of himself standing beside a wall and holding a string with a weight tied to the end of it. The string and weight had been used to measure the straightness of the wall. 8Then he asked, “Amos, what do you see?”
“A measuring line,” I answered.
The Lord said, “I'm using this measuring line to show that my people Israel don't measure up, and I won't forgive them any more. 9Their sacred places will be destroyed, and I will send war against the nation of King Jeroboam.”
Amos and Amaziah
10Amaziah the priest at Bethel sent this message to King Jeroboam of Israel, “Amos is plotting against you in the very heart of Israel. Our nation cannot put up with his message for very long. 11Here is what he is saying:
‘Jeroboam will be put to death,
and the people will be taken
to a foreign country.’ ”
12Then Amaziah told me, “Amos, take your visions and get out! Go back to Judah and earn your living there as a prophet. 13Don't do any more preaching at Bethel. The king worships here at our national temple.”
14I answered:
I'm not a prophet! And I wasn't trained to be a prophet. I am a shepherd, and I take care of fig trees. 15But the Lord told me to leave my herds and preach to the people of Israel. 16And here you are, telling me not to preach! 17Now, listen to what the Lord says about you:
Your wife will become
a prostitute in the city,
your sons and daughters
will be killed in war,
and your land will be divided
among others.
You will die in a country
of foreigners,
and the people of Israel
will be dragged
from their homeland.
translation_text:
Elotɔr be bɔrɛdare be asheŋ
1Enyɛnpetale e daŋ lara bɔrɛdare ere ŋ ŋini ma nseŋ kaŋɛ fanɛ e beeŋ shin nɛ elotɔr damta e ba ji menyi be adɔjibi. E yɛ saŋɛ nɛ menyee ta menyi be ayu be kachige n sa ewura na nɛ saŋɛ nɛ baa shin nɛ b teŋi ayu nɛ a ka na nɛ loŋ a wora. 2Elotɔr na ka ji kasawule ere so be adɔjibi kikɛ n loge na nɛ ŋ kaŋɛ le: “Enyɛnpetale, ta fo basa Israɛlebi be alubi m paŋ bumo! Nuso nɛ baaŋ wora n ji efute? B maŋ shibi bumo alɛ maŋ naa kɔ eleŋ.”
3Ndoŋ nna nɛ Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ chɛrga mbe nfɛra nseŋ kaŋɛ le: “M maaŋ shin nɛ kusɔ nɛ fo wu ere e wora kikɛ.”
Bɔrɛdare nɛ k la edɛ na be asheŋ
4Bɔrɛdare ere to Enyɛnpetale daŋ kaŋɛ nna fanɛ mbe demuji beeŋ ba mbe basa so, nɛ edɛ e ba chɔɔ kusɔ kama ashi kasawule ere so n ta tekugboŋ na gba n tiso. 5Ndoŋ nna nɛ ŋ kaŋɛ le: “Enyɛnpetale, jande sa maŋ wora loŋ. Nuso nɛ fo basa beeŋ wora n ji efute? B maŋ shibi, bumo alɛ maŋ naa kɔ eleŋ!”
6Nɛ Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ naŋ chɛrga mbe nfɛra ŋ kaŋɛ le: “Loŋ maaŋ wora kikɛ.”
Efɔl nɛ b kɔ a karga egbal be keniŋi be bɔrɛdare be asheŋ
7Ade be kaman nɛ Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ lara mo gbagba be kumu ŋ ŋini ma bɔrɛdare to. E daa yil m mata egbal nna nseŋ keta efɔl nɛ kusɔ gbɛgbɛsobi ko chɛ kumo be kɔnɔ a chul. Loŋ be efɔl na nɛ bepɔrpo bee ta asɔ kargaso a keni egbal be keniŋi. 8Ndoŋ nna nɛ Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ bishi ma le: “Eemɔs manɛ nɛ fo wu?”
Nɛ ŋ kaŋɛ: “Efɔl nɛ baa ta a karga egbal be keniŋi na.”
Nɛ Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ kaŋɛ: “N ta kumo nna a karga ma basa Israɛlebi fanɛ kananɛ baa karga egbal be keniŋi na. Ma alɛ maaŋ naaŋ ta m paŋ bumo kikɛ. 9Abee so be mboŋ nɛ basa daa shuŋ Ebɔrɛ na kikɛ beeŋ mur. Nɛ bumo be ebɔrɛlambuana kikɛ a ki alambure. Nɛ n shin nɛ Ewura Jeroboam be kuwurji malɛ e ba ekar.”
Eemɔs nɛ Amaziya be asheŋ
10Le be kubɔya nɛ Amaziya nɛ e la Bɛtɛl be bɔrɛmatapo na daŋ ta n sa Jeroboam nɛ e la Israɛl be ewura na. E yɛ: “Eemɔs bee kre menyi ŋkre lubi nna ashi Israɛlebi be kasawule so. Mbe mmalga gba nawule beeŋ tiŋ m mur efuli na kikɛ.” 11Le nɛ e bee kaŋɛ:
“Jeroboam beeŋ wu kena to
nɛ b pɛ Israɛlebi na n tintiŋ
bumo n yɔ efuli pɔtɛ ko so kufɔ kufɔ.”
12Kede be kaman nɛ bɔrɛmatapo Amaziya kaŋɛ Eemɔs le: “Ta fo ebɔrɛdareana n shile anyi so! Bɛta n yɔ Juda be kasawule so n ya ka wora fo kenebiya be kushuŋ ndoŋ nsaa nya fo kusɔ jiso kumo to. 13Sa maŋ naa malga kewuŋkaŋɛ be asheŋ kikɛ ashi Bɛtɛl ŋkpal manɛ so ndoŋ nɛ efuli ere so kikɛ be nshɛrbu wɔ, nɛ bewura kikɛ bee shɛr kumo to.”
14Nɛ Eemɔs malɛ kaŋɛ Amaziya le: “Ma ere maŋ la anebi, ŋko anebi pibi. N la mbolpɔkpapo nna nsaa keni efigidibi be ndɔ so.” 15Ama Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na e lara ma ashi mbolpɔ be kebaa kpa be kushuŋ to ŋ kaŋɛ fanɛ m baa malga mbe asheŋ a sa mbe basa Israɛlebi. 16Loto naniere n nu kusɔ nɛ Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ bee kaŋɛ.
17Kusɔ nɛ Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ bee kaŋɛ fo Amaziya nde: “Fo eche beeŋ ki sakaleche ashi kade ere to nɛ b mɔ fo mbia kikɛ kena to. Baaŋ karga fo kasawule m barga kumo to n sa abar, nɛ fo gbagba malɛ e wu efuli pɔtɛ so. Nɛ b tintiŋ Israɛl be basa malɛ n yɔ efuli pɔtɛana so kufɔ kufɔ.” Kumo be kaman nɛ Eemɔs yige mo nseŋ yɔ.

english_text:
A Basket of Fruit
1The Lord God showed me a basket of ripe fruit 2and asked, “Amos, what do you see?”
“A basket of ripe fruit,” I replied.
Then he said,
“This is the end
for my people Israel.
I won't forgive them again.
3Instead of singing
in the temple,
they will cry and weep.
Dead bodies will be everywhere.
So keep silent!
I, the Lord, have spoken!”
Israel Is Doomed
The Lord said:
4You people crush those in need
and wipe out the poor.
5You say to yourselves,
“How much longer before the end
of the New Moon Festival?
When will the Sabbath be over?
Our wheat is ready,
and we want to sell it now.
We can't wait to cheat
and charge high prices
for the grain we sell.
We will use dishonest scales
6and mix dust in the grain.
Those who are needy and poor
don't have any money.
We will make them our slaves
for the price
of a pair of sandals.”
7I, the Lord, won't forget
any of this,
though you take great pride
in your ancestor Jacob.
8Your country will tremble,
and you will mourn.
It will be like the Nile River
that rises and overflows,
then sinks back down.
9On that day, I, the Lord God,
will make the sun
go down at noon,
and I will turn daylight
into darkness.
10Your festivals and joyful singing
will turn into sorrow.
You will wear sackcloth
and shave your heads,
as you would at the death
of your only son.
It will be a horrible day.
11I, the Lord, also promise you
a terrible shortage,
but not of food and water.
You will hunger and thirst
to hear my message.
12You will search everywhere—
from north to south,
from east to west.
You will go all over the earth,
seeking a message
from me, the Lord.
But you won't find one.
13Your beautiful young women
and your young men
will faint from thirst.
14You made promises
to the goddess Ashimah
at Samaria;
you made vows to other gods
at the shrines
of Dan and Beersheba.
So now you will fall
and never get up.
translation_text:
Kelantaŋɛ ka bɔlɔ asɔrso be asheŋ
1Ndoŋ nna nɛ Enyɛnpetale na naŋ shin nɛ ŋ ku bɔrɛdare n wu asɔrso belso kelantaŋɛ be bɔlɔ, 2nɛ e bishi ma le: “Eemɔs manɛ nɛ fo wu?”
Nɛ n yɛ: “Asɔrso belso kelantaŋɛ be bɔlɔ nɛ n wu.”
Nɛ Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ naŋ kaŋɛ ma le: “Kananɛ asɔrso ere bel ere aloŋ nɛ ma basa Israɛlebi be ekar fo. M maaŋ ta bumo be alubi m paŋ bumo kikɛ.” 3Enyɛnpetale yɛ: “Nshɛ nɛ baaŋ ba boŋ bɔrɛlambu to na beeŋ kilgi kushu. Bubuni beeŋ dese kaplɛkama nɛ kakpa kikɛ e wora shruum.”
Israɛl be kemur be asheŋ
4Menyi nɛ menyee ŋin betentaŋasepo nɛ efuli ere so be betirpo a lɛ a chichi so na e nu nfe. 5Menyi e naa kaŋɛ men be amu le na: “Saŋɛ mo nɛ kufɔl popɔr ere beeŋ wu nɛ an ya fa anyi be ayu. Saŋɛ mo nɛ kewushiachɛ na beeŋ choŋ nɛ an naaŋ fara a fa asɔ yawu kpakpaso nsaa puni a ta ekurwawurbi a karga asɔ? 6Saŋɛ mo nɛ anyeeŋ baa ta amimi a wea ayu to a fa yawu kpakpaso nsaa tɔ betentaŋasepo nɛ betirpo kesebeta be yawu ŋ ki anyi be anya.”
7Enyɛnpe nɛ e la Israɛl be Ebɔrɛ na bɔ ntaŋ ŋ kaŋɛ le: “M maaŋ teŋ bumo be asheŋ lubi nɛ b wora na kikɛ so. 8Amoso kasawule beeŋ gbuŋgbuŋ to nɛ kagbenejija e tɔr efuli ere be basa kikɛ so nɛ b baa wora kuwɔr be asheŋ. Efuli na kikɛ beeŋ baga to fanɛ kananɛ lɔrgboŋ nɛ baa tre Nail ashi Ijipt be efuli so na bee kaa ketili a yɔ a ba na. 9Loŋ be kachɛ na, ma Enyɛnpetale beeŋ shin nɛ epeŋi a tɔr kapaso nɛ kanyɛ e biri kapiidi. Ma Enyɛnpetale na e malga na. 10Meeŋ shin nɛ men be kejigboŋana e ki nli be kebaa shu nɛ menyi be kagbenefuli malɛ be nshɛ e ki kagbenejijaso be kushu. Meeŋ shin nɛ men she men be emin nseŋ buu kagbenejijaso be asɔbuuso a du fanɛ esa nɛ mbe kebia koŋwule nɛ e kɔ wu ŋ ka mo na. Loŋ be kachɛ na beeŋ baa la kachɛ lubi ga.
11Kachako bee ba nɛ n shin nɛ akoŋ e tɔr kasawule ere so. Akoŋ nɛ k maŋ la ajibi be akoŋ beeŋ pɛ basa, nɛ achukoŋ nɛ k maŋ la nchu be achukoŋ e mɔ basa. Ekama beeŋ baa fin abɔrɛsheŋ be kenu fanɛ kananɛ baa fin nchu nɛ ajibi na. Ma Enyɛnpetale na e malga na. 12Basa beeŋ shi kelargato be esoso be kaba so ŋ kilgi to n fin Ebɔrɛ be kamalga n ya fo epeŋilarkpa be kaba so. Baaŋ yɛla kenishi to n yɔ kaplɛkama n ya fin Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ be kamalga na, bumo alɛ maaŋ wu kumo. 13Kumo be kamɔnchɛ na achukoŋ beeŋ pɛ menyi be mbrantiɛfɔlbi nɛ menyi be besuŋgurbi nɛ b kɔ eleŋ ga na nɛ b tɔr ŋ kreŋ. 14Bekama nɛ baa bɔ agbir nɛ a wɔ Samɛria na nɛ kegbir nɛ k wɔ Dan na ŋko kegbir nɛ k wɔ Bɛshiba na, beeŋ tɔr a maaŋ naaŋ koso kikɛ.”

english_text:
Judgment on Israel
1I saw a vision of the Lord
standing by the temple altar,
and he said,
“Shake the columns
until the tops fall loose,
and the doorposts crumble.
Then make the pieces fall
on the people below.
I will take a sword and kill
anyone who escapes.
2“If they dig deep into the earth
or climb to the sky,
I'll reach out and get them.
3If they escape to the peaks
of Mount Carmel,
I'll search and find them.
And if they hide from me
at the bottom of the ocean,
I'll command a sea monster
to bite them.
4I'll send a sword to kill them,
wherever their enemies
drag them off as captives.
I'm determined to hurt them,
not to help them.”
His Name Is the Lord
5When the Lord God All-Powerful
touches the earth, it melts,
and its people mourn.
God makes the earth rise
and then fall,
just like the Nile River.
6He built his palace in the heavens
and let its foundations
rest on the earth.
He scoops up the ocean
and empties it on the earth.
His name is the Lord.
The Lord Is God
7Israel, I am the Lord God,
and the Ethiopians
are no less important to me
than you are.
I brought you out of Egypt,
but I also brought
the Philistines from Crete
and the Arameans from Kir.
8My eyes have seen
what a sinful nation you are,
and I'll wipe you out.
But I will leave a few
of Jacob's descendants.
I, the Lord, have spoken!
9At my command, all of you
will be sifted like grain.
Israelites who remain faithful
will be scattered
among the nations.
And the others will be trapped
like trash in a sifter.
10Some of you are evil,
and you deny
that you will ever get caught.
But you will be killed.
The Lord's Promise to Israel
11 In the future, I will rebuild
David's fallen kingdom.
I will build it from its ruins
and set it up again,
just as it used to be.
12Then you will capture Edom
and the other nations
that are mine.
I, the Lord, have spoken,
and my words will come true.
13You will have such a harvest
that you won't be able
to bring in all of your wheat
before plowing time.
You will have grapes left over
from season to season;
your fruitful vineyards
will cover the mountains.
14I'll make Israel prosper again.
You will rebuild your towns
and live in them.
You will drink wine
from your own vineyards
and eat the fruit you grow.
15I'll plant your roots deep
in the land I have given you,
and you won't ever
be uprooted again.
I, the Lord God, have spoken!
translation_text:
Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ be demuji be asheŋ
1N wu Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ ka yil bɔrɛsure na ase ashi bɔrɛlambu na to nseŋ kaŋɛ le: “Gbuŋgbuŋ bɔrɛlambu na be eshabɔrɛ nɛ a sɔ kumo to ŋ keta na eleŋso nɛ kumo be esoso e bure n tɔr basa na be amu so. Meeŋ mɔ bumo be bumo nɛ b ka na malɛ kena to. Bumo be ekama maaŋ tiŋ n shile ŋ ŋana ma so. 2Hale b kur kemaŋ n luri to gba meeŋ gberge bumo n lar. B dii esoso n yɔ awɔlpa so gba, meeŋ gberge bumo m ba kaseto. 3Hale b ŋana kebeegboŋ nɛ baa tre Kamɛl na be esoso gba, meeŋ fin bumo nseŋ pɛ bumo. Nɛ b ŋana tekugboŋ na be kaseto gba, meeŋ shin nɛ ebontojewu e duŋ bumo. 4Nɛ fanɛ bumo doŋana pɛ bumo ŋ ki anya n yɔ efuli pɔtɛ so kufɔ kufɔ gba, meeŋ shin nɛ b mɔ bumo ndoŋ. Mee shin nna nɛ m mur bumo, mannɛ kechɛ bumo to bre.”
5Enyɛnpetale Ewurgboŋ baaŋ beta kasawule ere, k bee ŋalga nna,
nɛ bekama nɛ b wɔ kumo so kikɛ, e baa shu nli.
E bee shin nna nɛ kasawule bee dii a gbelge
fanɛ kananɛ lɔrgboŋ nɛ baa tre Nail na
bee dii a gbelge na ashi Ijipt be efuli so na.
6Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ pɔr mbe kowu nna ashi ebɔrɛso
nɛ kasawule ere malɛ la kumo be gbaltɔlase.
E bee gbargbar etekuana be nchu nna,
a chulgi a wurge kasawule ere so.
Mbe ketre e la Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na!
7Le nɛ Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na bee kaŋɛ: “Kananɛ m baa fɛ menyi Israɛl be basa be asheŋ na, loŋ koŋwule na nɛ mee fɛ Itiopia be basa gba be asheŋ. Mannɛ ma e lara Filistiebi na ashi Kreet be kasawule nɛ nchu kulti n wɔtɔ na, nɛ Siriyaebi ashi Kiir fanɛ kananɛ n lara menyi ashi Ijipt be efuli so dra dra na a? 8Ma Enyɛnpetale na bee wu kulubi nɛ Israɛl be efuli na bee wora, ma alɛ beeŋ mur bumo ashi kasawule ere so. Ama ŋkpal bumo nananyɛn Jeekɔb so meeŋ yige bumo be basa gbrɛbi.
9Meeŋ ponte nɛ b gbaŋgbaŋ Israɛl be basa fanɛ kananɛ baa gbaŋgbaŋ ayunyifu gbaŋgbande to a lara eyurpi amo to na. Meeŋ shin nɛ bumo be bumo nɛ baa ji kashenteŋ a sa ma e pesaŋ to n yɔ efuli pɔtɛana so. 10Baaŋ mɔ bumo be bumo nɛ b la belubiworapo n wea ma basa to na kena to, fɔŋfɔŋ bumo nɛ baa kaŋɛ le na: ‘Ebɔrɛ maaŋ shin nɛ tɔrɔ kikɛ e ba anyi so.’ ”
Ebɔrɛ ka beeŋ naŋ lɔŋɛ Israɛl n yili kumo be eyilikpa be asheŋ
11Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ yɛ: “Kachako bee ba nɛ n naŋ lɔŋɛ Deevid be kuwurji nɛ k ki fanɛ kelambure na m pɔr n yili nɛnɛ. Meeŋ naŋ lɔŋɛ kumo be egbalana m pɔr fanɛ kananɛ k daa du dra na. 12Saŋɛ na so menyi Israɛlebi na beeŋ kɔ n sɔ Edɔm be nsawule nɛ efuliana nɛ a daa la meya na kikɛ.” Ma Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ nɛ meeŋ shin nɛ loŋ e wora na e malga na. 13Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na yɛ: “Saŋko beeŋ ba nɛ menyi be ayu e wora a chɔ kananɛ menyeeŋ tiŋ n teŋi amo,
nɛ menyi be asɔrso nɛ baa tre greep na
e sɔr a chɔ kananɛ menyeeŋ tiŋ n wora amo be nsa.
Nɛ menyi be greep be asɔrso be adɔ e sɔ abeeana so kikɛ.
14Saŋɛ na so meeŋ naŋ bɛta ma basa
m ba bumo be kasawule so.
Nɛ b naŋ lɔŋɛ m pɔr bumo be nde nɛ a bure na,
nseŋ chena amo to.
Baaŋ du asɔrso nɛ baa tre greep na
nsaa wora amo be nsa a nu.
Baaŋ dɔ ndɔana nsaa ji kusɔ kama nɛ b duu amo to.
15Meeŋ naŋ bɛta ma basa m ba kasawule
nɛ n ta n sa bumo na so,
nɛ bumo doŋana maaŋ naŋ tiŋ m pɔɔ bumo so kikɛ.”
Ma Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na e malga na.

english_text:
Edom's Pride and Punishment
1 The Lord God gave Obadiah
a message about Edom,
and this is what we heard:
“I, the Lord, have sent
a messenger
with orders for the nations
to attack Edom.”
2The Lord said to Edom:
I will make you the weakest
and most despised nation.
3You live in a mountain fortress,
because your pride
makes you feel safe from attack,
but you are mistaken.
4I will still bring you down,
even if you fly higher
than an eagle
or nest among the stars.
I, the Lord, have spoken!
5If thieves break in at night,
they steal
only what they want.
And people who harvest grapes
always leave some unpicked.
But, Edom, you are doomed!
6Everything you treasure most
will be taken from you.
7Your allies can't be trusted.
They will force you out
of your own country.
And your best friends
will trick and trap you,
even before you know it.
8Edom, when this happens,
I, the Lord, will destroy
all your marvelous wisdom.
9Warriors from the city of Teman
will be terrified,
and you descendants of Esau
will be wiped out.
The Lord Condemns Edom's Cruelty
10You were cruel to your relatives,
the descendants of Jacob.
Now you will be destroyed,
disgraced forever.
11You stood there and watched
as foreigners entered Jerusalem
and took what they wanted.
In fact, you were no better
than those foreigners.
12Why did you celebrate
when such a dreadful disaster
struck your relatives?
Why were you so pleased
when everyone in Judah
was suffering?
13They are my people,
and you were cruel to them.
You went through their towns,
sneering and stealing
whatever was left.
14In their time of torment,
you ambushed refugees
and handed them over
to their attackers.
The Lord Will Judge the Nations
15The day is coming
when I, the Lord,
will judge the nations.
And, Edom, you will pay in full
for what you have done.
16I forced the people of Judah
to drink the wine of my anger
on my sacred mountain.
Soon the neighboring nations
must drink their fill—
then vanish without a trace.
Victory for Israel
17The Lord's people who escape
will go to Mount Zion,
and it will be holy.
Then Jacob's descendants
will capture the land of those
who took their land.
18Israel will be a fire,
and Edom will be straw
going up in flames.
The Lord has spoken!
19The people of Israel
who live in the Southern Desert
will take the land of Edom.
Those who live in the hills
will capture Philistia,
Ephraim, and Samaria.
And the tribe of Benjamin
will conquer Gilead.
20Those who return from captivity
will control Phoenicia
as far as Zarephath.
Captives from Jerusalem
who were taken to Sepharad
will capture the towns
of the Southern Desert.
21Those the Lord has saved
will live on Mount Zion
and rule over Edom.
Then the kingdom will belong
to the Lord.
translation_text:
Bɔrɛdare nɛ Obadaya ku na be asheŋ
1Kusɔ nɛ Enyɛnpetale Ewurgboŋ na kaŋɛ a laŋɛ Edɔm be kaplɛa so nɛ an nu nde:
“Men koso n shin nɛ an yɔ nɛ anyi nɛ Edɔmebi
e ya kɔ abar kena.”
2Le nɛ Enyɛnpetale na kaŋɛ Edɔm:
“Meeŋ shin nɛ fo ki epɔshipo nɛ ekama nyam
e keni fo jiga.
3Fo, Edɔm be kamoowu e naa fule fo na.
Fo Edɔm nɛ fo tase kebee so nɛ fo kowu
wɔ kaboŋ jeŋgreŋ na,
e naa puchi a kaŋɛ fo kumu fanɛ
wanɛ e naaŋ tiŋ m pɔɔ fo so na, ŋko?
4Kashenteŋ nna fanɛ fo wɔ awɔlto
fanɛ kajɔnɔkoso ka bee firgi nna,
fo alɛ nseŋ ta fo kowu n ya yuu
fanɛ k kaa wɔ achɛkpabi to na,
ama ma, Enyɛnpetale na e kaŋɛ fo na
fanɛ meeŋ shin nɛ fo shi kakpa nɛ fo wɔ ere m ba kaseto.
5Nɛ beyu ŋko besugepo daŋ ba fo to kanyɛso,
ndafanɛ kusɔ nɛ k daa beeŋ nya fo gba maaŋ baa walɛ.
B daa beeŋ yuri fo kananɛ baa sha.
Beyu baŋ ba kanyɛso, asɔ nɛ baa sha nawule nɛ baa ta.
Basa baa chuge greep be asɔrso malɛ,
baa kaa yige amo be gbrɛ ko nna a chɔga so,
ama fo ere, fo doŋana beeŋ mur fo cheche.
6Menyi ere Isɔɔ be kanaŋ to ebi,
baaŋ sensaŋ menyi be asɔ kikɛ n yɔ.
7Men doŋana beeŋ tintiŋ menyi n yɔ
efuli ere so be ekarso cheche,
nɛ men teriana e fule menyi nseŋ pɔɔ menyi so.
Bumo nɛ baa tu menyi a ji menyi be ajibi naniere
beeŋ sho menyi ajigbelɛ,
ama menyi alɛ maaŋ pin.”
8Enyɛnpetale na yɛ: “Kachɛ na kaŋ fo,
meeŋ mur Edɔm be basa nyiashempo kama
nɛ b wɔ lsɔɔ be abee so a pin asheŋ to na.
Meeŋ mur bumo cheche.
9O, Teman be benakɔpo,
kufu beeŋ pɛ menyi tain,
baaŋ ku ekama nɛ e wɔ lsɔɔ be abee so na to.
10Ŋkpal menyi Edɔmebi ka diewu
n ta kumu kpakpaso n shuŋ men kurgepoana
Jeekɔb be kanaŋ to ebi kushuŋ lubi na so,
anishinyɔr beeŋ ba menyi so.
Menyi alɛ beeŋ mur kuraa.
11Kachɛ nɛ bedoŋ nɛ b la befɔ
daŋ ba bɔla Jeekɔb be kanaŋ to ebi be mbuna to
n luri Jerusalɛm to m muu bumo be asɔ kikɛ
nseŋ to beri m barga amo to n sa abar na
men daa yil jiga a keni bumo.
Amoso menyi alɛ gba daa du fanɛ bedoŋ na nna na.
12A daa maŋ daga fanɛ men baa yil
a mushe men niopibiana Jeekɔb be kanaŋ to ebi
saŋɛ nɛ tɔrɔ nɛ kachɛ lubi tu bumo
ashi bumo be kemur be saŋɛ so na.
13A daa maŋ daga fanɛ men luri ma basa be kade to
n ya kaa mushe bumo ashi bumo be etɔrɔ be kaplɛa so
nseŋ suge bumo asɔ kachɛ lubi achɛ na.
14A daa maŋ daga fanɛ men ya yili ŋkpancheriana
a pɛ bumo to be bumo nɛ b nya ekpa
n shile a yɔ nɛ b ya ŋana na.
A daa maŋ daga fanɛ men pɛ bumo
m bɔɔ bumo doŋ ana enɔ
saŋɛ nɛ b wɔ tɔrɔ na.
15Men nu nfe,
kachɛ nɛ ma ere Enyɛnpetale na beeŋ ji efuli kama
demu na taga to nna na.
Asɔ nɛ menyi Edɔmebi wora ere
beeŋ ba menyi alɛ gba so loŋ chap.
Menyeeŋ teŋi kusɔ nɛ men du ere gbagba.
16Ma basa nɛ b tase ma kebee cheembi so
ashi Jerusalɛm na ka nya kasogberge ere bre
meeŋ gberge efuli pɔtɛana kikɛ gba kusoe a chɔ loŋ.
Baaŋ nya kasoegberge a chɔ Jerusalɛm peya na,
hale nɛ k yɛr bumo kemur to cheche.
Israɛl ka beeŋ kɔ m pɔɔ so be asheŋ
17Kumɔlga beeŋ baa wɔ Zayɔn be kebee bre so,
nɛ basa ko e nya ekpa n shile ŋ ŋana.
Ndoŋ beeŋ baa la kakpa cheembi nsaa la
Jeekɔb be kanaŋ to be kasawule.
18Jeekɔb be kanaŋ to ebi beeŋ baa du
fanɛ edɛ suse so nna
nɛ Isɔɔ malɛ be kanaŋ to ebi e baa
du fanɛ afitiri wɔlso nɛ baaŋ chɔɔ.
Isɔɔ be kanaŋ to be ekama maaŋ naŋ ji efute.
Ma, Enyɛnpetale na e kaŋɛ loŋ na.
19Keshishɛrsawule so ebi na beeŋ ba sɔ menyi lsɔɔ
be kanaŋ to ebi be abeesawule a wɔtɔ,
nɛ basa nɛ b wɔ abee be kaseto na malɛ e ba
Filistiebi be nsawule ŋ ki bumo peya.
Israɛlebi beeŋ ba sɔ Efreimebi nɛ Samɛriaebi be nsawule,
nɛ Bɛnjaminebi malɛ e ta Gilead.
20Israɛl be benapo nɛ b pɛ n yɔ Keenan na beeŋ bɛta
m ba kɔ n sɔ nsawule loŋ hale n ya fo Zarefat.
Jerusalɛm be benapo nɛ b wɔ Sefarad naniere malɛ
beeŋ ba kɔ n sɔ keshishɛrsawule be ndeana.
21Zayɔn to be bekɔmpɔɔsopoana beeŋ ya kɔ
Edɔm m pɔɔ kumo so nsaa ji kuwura kumo so.
Enyɛnpetale malɛ gbagba e naaŋ ki bumo be ewura.”

english_text:
Jonah Runs from the Lord
1 One day the Lord told Jonah, the son of Amittai, 2to go to the great city of Nineveh and say to the people, “The Lord has seen your terrible sins. You are doomed!”
3Instead, Jonah ran from the Lord. He went to the seaport of Joppa and found a ship that was going to Spain. So he paid his fare, then got on the ship and sailed away to escape.
4But the Lord made a strong wind blow, and such a bad storm came up that the ship was about to be broken to pieces. 5The sailors were frightened, and they all started praying to their gods. They even threw the ship's cargo overboard to make the ship lighter.
All this time, Jonah was down below deck, sound asleep. 6The ship's captain went to him and said, “How can you sleep at a time like this? Get up and pray to your God! Maybe he will have pity on us and keep us from drowning.”
7Finally, the sailors got together and said, “Let's ask our gods to show us who caused all this trouble.” It turned out to be Jonah.
8They started asking him, “Are you the one who brought all this trouble on us? What business are you in? Where do you come from? What is your country? Who are your people?”
9Jonah answered, “I'm a Hebrew, and I worship the Lord God of heaven, who made the sea and the dry land.”
10When the sailors heard this, they were frightened, because Jonah had already told them he was running from the Lord. Then they said, “Do you know what you have done?”
11The storm kept getting worse, until finally the sailors asked him, “What should we do with you to make the sea calm down?”
12Jonah told them, “Throw me into the sea, and it will calm down. I'm the cause of this terrible storm.”
13The sailors tried their best to row to the shore. But they could not do it, and the storm kept getting worse every minute. 14So they prayed to the Lord, “Please don't let us drown for taking this man's life. Don't hold us guilty for killing an innocent man. All of this happened because you wanted it to.” 15Then they threw Jonah overboard, and the sea calmed down. 16The sailors were so terrified that they offered a sacrifice to the Lord and made all kinds of promises.
17 The Lord sent a big fish to swallow Jonah, and Jonah was inside the fish for three days and three nights.
translation_text:
Jona ka shile Ebɔrɛ be asheŋ
1Kachako nɛ Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ kaŋɛ Amitai pibinyɛn Jona le: 2“Yɔ kadegboŋ nɛ baa tre Ninɛve na to n ya fiɛ ndoŋebi so ŋ kaŋɛ bumo fanɛ n wu bumo be asheŋ lubi nɛ baa wora na kikɛ. Amoso asheŋ maaŋ nyalɛ n sa bumo kikɛ.”
3Nɛ Jona kini nseŋ shile Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na. E daŋ yɔ kade ko nɛ baa tre Jɔpa nna n ya luri nchu so be kuloŋgboŋ ko nɛ k bee yɔ kadegboŋ ko nɛ baa tre Tashish ashi Speen be efuli so na to.
4Ndoŋ nna nɛ Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ shin nɛ afugboŋ ko koso teku na so. Nɛ bɔrɛchu nɛ afu wea abar to m ber kuloŋgboŋ nɛ Jona daa wɔ kumo to na so, nɛ k bee shin nɛ k baŋɛ to m mur nchu na to. 5Nɛ kufu pɛ kuloŋgboŋ na be befarpo na kikɛ ga nɛ b fara a shu a tre bumo be agbirana. Ndoŋ nna nɛ b lara kuloŋgboŋ na to be esulɔ n lɛ teku na to saŋɛ na so kumo be egbɛ beeŋ duga so ŋ ka ŋ kukwe.
Jemanɛ ere so kikɛ nɛ Jona bre wɔ kuloŋgboŋ na be kaseto be ebu ko to a di kenishipereso. 6Ndoŋ nna nɛ kuloŋgboŋ na be befarpo na be enimu yɔ Jona kutɔ n ya kaŋɛ mo le: “Fo ere dese a di nna a? Koso a shu a tre fo Ebɔrɛ. Ashere e beeŋ mɔlga anyi, nɛ an sa maŋ mur.”
7Kumo be kaman nɛ befarpo na kikɛ kaŋɛ a bar le: “Men shin nɛ an to beri n fin esa nɛ tɔrɔ ere shi mbe kumu so m ba anyi so ere.” B ka to beri na nɛ k tɔr Jona so.
8Nɛ b bishi mo le: “Kaŋɛ anyi, fo e shin nɛ le be tɔrɔ ere ba anyi so a? Manɛ be kushuŋ nɛ fee shuŋ? Nnɛ nɛ fo shi? Efuli mo so nɛ fo shi? Kanaŋ mo to be esa e la fo?”
9Ndoŋ nna nɛ Jona kaŋɛ le: “N la Hibruw be esa nna. Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ nɛ e wɔ ebɔrɛso nseŋ to teku nɛ kasawule kikɛ na nɛ mee shuŋ.”
10B ka nu loŋ nɛ kufu pɛ bumo ga, ŋkpal manɛ so, Jona teŋ kaŋɛ bumo fanɛ e bee shile Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na nna.
11Teku na so be afu na daŋ baa wora eleŋ nna a ti so. Ndoŋ nna nɛ b bishi Jona le: “Nuso nɛ anyeeŋ wora fo nɛ teku ere e wora shruum n sa anyi?”
12Nɛ Jona kaŋɛ: “Men ta ma n lɛ teku na to, aloŋ beeŋ shin nɛ k wora shruum. M baa nyi geeŋ fanɛ ŋ ka wora n jija so nɛ le be afugboŋ lubi ere tu anyi na.”
13Ama ŋkpal befarpo na ka daa maa sha kelara mo n lɛ teku na to so, b daŋ pere kenishi nna a far nɛ b ya gbuŋ kedeŋi so. Bumo alɛ daa maŋ tiŋ, ŋkpal manɛ so, afu na be eleŋ daŋ baa wora keshi nna a ti so. 14Ndoŋ nna nɛ b kule Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na ŋ kaŋɛ le: “O, Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ, jande, sa maŋ shin nɛ an wu ŋkpal anyi ka bee shin nɛ an lara kanyɛn ere be ŋkpa so. Sa maŋ kaŋ ji anyi demu ŋkpal an ka mɔ esa nɛ e maŋ kɔ kulubi so. Ŋkpal manɛ so, fo Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na e naa wora kusɔ kikɛ fo keparso.” 15Kumo be kaman nɛ b lara Jona n lɛ teku na to, nɛ k wora shruum epul na to. 16Le be kesheŋ ere daŋ shin nɛ befarpo na ŋana Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na alegaiso nna. Kumo be kaman nɛ b lara sarga nseŋ nase nnɔ n sa Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na.
17Ndoŋ nna nɛ Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ shin nɛ kɔrɔtɔgboŋ ko ba ta Jona m min, nɛ e ji nchɛ asa nɛ nnyɛ asa ashi kɔrɔtɔgboŋ na be epunto.

english_text:
Jonah's Prayer
1From inside the fish, Jonah prayed to the Lord his God:
2When I was in trouble, Lord,
I prayed to you,
and you listened to me.
From deep in the world
of the dead,
I begged for your help,
and you answered my prayer.
3You threw me down
to the bottom of the sea.
The water was churning
all around;
I was completely covered
by your mighty waves.
4I thought I was swept away
from your sight,
never again to see
your holy temple.
5I was almost drowned
by the swirling waters
that surrounded me.
Seaweed had wrapped
around my head.
6I had sunk down deep
below the mountains
beneath the sea.
I knew that forever,
I would be a prisoner there.
But, you, Lord God,
rescued me from that pit.
7When my life was slipping away,
I remembered you—
and in your holy temple
you heard my prayer.
8All who worship worthless idols
turn from the God
who offers them mercy.
9But with shouts of praise,
I will offer a sacrifice
to you, my Lord.
I will keep my promise,
because you are the one
with power to save.
10 The Lord commanded the fish to vomit up Jonah on the shore. And it did.
translation_text:
Jona be kabɔrɛkule be asheŋ
1Jona wɔ kɔrɔtɔ na be epunto nna nseŋ kule mbe Ebɔrɛ nɛ e la Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na le: 2“Ma tɔrɔ to nɛ n shu n tre fo, Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na, nɛ e nu ma kekule. N wɔ nchaŋ chiŋgeliŋ to nna nseŋ kule fo fanɛ fo chɛ ma to, nɛ fo alɛ nu ma kekule.
3Fo kpa ma nna n lɛ Teku be kechimbi be kaseto, nɛ nchu muni ma kikɛ so nsaa kaa atili ma kumu so.
4Nɛ n fɛ fanɛ fo ju ma fo anishito nna, nɛ m maaŋ naŋ wu fo bɔrɛlambu cheembi na kenishiso kikɛ.
5Nchu na daŋ muni ma nna a sha kemur ma nɛ teku to be afitiri kre ma kumu kikɛ.
6Ŋ ka daŋ muni n yɔ kasawule be kechimbi to na, n daŋ fɛ fanɛ ma ŋkpa be ekar fo nna na. Ama fo, Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ, nɛ fo la ma Ebɔrɛ na lara ma kemaŋ chiŋgeliŋ na to m bar ma ŋkpa to.
7Ma ŋkpa kaa bee fo ekar na nɛ n nyiŋi fo, Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na, nseŋ kule fo nɛ fo nu ma kekule ashi fo bɔrɛlambu cheembi na to.
8Basa nɛ baa shuŋ agbir paŋ Ebɔrɛ be kuwɔrwu.
9Ama ma ere beeŋ boŋ nshɛ n di fo, Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na, epaŋ nseŋ lara sarga n sa fo. Meeŋ wora m bɔlɔ ma kɔnɔ naseso so, ŋkpal manɛ so, fo e kɔ eleŋ a tiŋ a mɔlga.”
10Ade be kaman nɛ Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ shin nɛ kɔrɔtɔ na ya gbu Jona n nase kedeŋi so ashi teku na be ekarso.

english_text:
Jonah Goes to Nineveh
1Once again the Lord told Jonah 2to go to that great city of Nineveh and preach his message of doom.
3Jonah obeyed the Lord and went to Nineveh. The city was so big that it took three days just to walk through it. 4 After walking for a day, Jonah warned the people, “Forty days from now, Nineveh will be destroyed!”
5They believed God's message and set a time when they would go without eating to show their sorrow. Then everyone in the city, no matter who they were, dressed in sackcloth.
6When the king of Nineveh heard what was happening, he also dressed in sackcloth; he left the royal palace and sat in dust. 7-9Then he and his officials sent out an order for everyone in the city to obey. It said:
None of you or your animals may eat or drink a thing. Each of you must wear sackcloth, and you must even put sackcloth on your animals.
You must also pray to the Lord God with all your heart and stop being sinful and cruel. Maybe God will change his mind and have mercy on us, so we won't be destroyed.
10When God saw that the people had stopped doing evil things, he had pity and did not destroy them as he had planned.
translation_text:
Jona ka yɔ Ninɛve be asheŋ
1Ndoŋ nna nɛ Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ naŋ kaŋɛ Jona kela nyɔsopo le: 2“Yɔ kadegboŋ nɛ baa tre Ninɛve na to n ya bɔ kubɔya nɛ n sa fo na n sa ndoŋebi.”
3Ndoŋ nna nɛ Jona nu Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ be kamalga na nseŋ yɔ Ninɛve. Ninɛve daa la kadegboŋ nɛ esa beeŋ ta nchɛ asa nna n nite kumo be kaba ko n ya fo kaba ko. 4Jona ka luri kade na to na nɛ e nite kachɛ koŋwule m bɔ le be kubɔya. E yɛ: “Yili kabre n ya fo nchɛ adena be kefɛato, Ninɛve beeŋ mur.” 5Ninɛveebi na ka nu kubɔya na nɛ b yirda Ebɔrɛ nseŋ yili kumo fanɛ ekama e kishi. Ndoŋ nna nɛ benimu nɛ mbia kikɛ ta kagbenejijaso be asɔbuuso m buu a ŋini fanɛ bumo be ŋgbene jija bumo.
6Kubɔya na ka tu Ninɛve be ewura gba, nɛ e koso mbe kuwurputi so m bugi mbe kuwurpiŋi n nase, nseŋ ta kagbenejijaso be asɔbuuso m buu n ya chena nsunɔ to. 7Kumo be kaman nɛ e sa Ninɛveebi kubɔya. Kubɔya na e daa la fanɛ ewura nɛ mbe benimuana yɛ: “Esa kama e sa maŋ ji shɛŋ. Dimɛdi ŋko kusɔbɔya e sa maŋ ta ajibi ŋko nchu n yɔ kɔnɔ. 8Edimɛdi kikɛ e buu kagbenejijaso be asɔbuuso nseŋ shu n tre Ebɔrɛ kenishipreso. Ekama e yige asheŋ lubi be kewora nɛ kebaawɔ kebaawɔtɔ lubi to. 9Ashere Ebɔrɛ be nfɛra beeŋ chɛrga nɛ mbe agbo e wushi nɛ e wu anyi kuwɔr nsaa maŋ shin nɛ an mur.”
10Ebɔrɛ ka wu kusɔ nɛ b wora na nɛ kananɛ b yige bumo be asheŋ lubi nɛ kebaawɔtɔ lubi na, nɛ e wu bumo kuwɔr nsaa maŋ naŋ shin nɛ b mur fanɛ kananɛ e daŋ yili na.

english_text:
Jonah Gets Angry with the Lord
1Jonah was really upset and angry. 2 So he prayed:
Our Lord, I knew from the very beginning that you wouldn't destroy Nineveh. That's why I left my own country and headed for Spain. You are a kind and merciful God, and you are very patient. You always show love, and you don't like to punish anyone.
3 Now let me die! I'd be better off dead.
4The Lord replied, “What right do you have to be angry?”
5Jonah then left through the east gate of the city and made a shelter to protect himself from the sun. He sat under the shelter, waiting to see what would happen to Nineveh.
6The Lord made a vine grow up to shade Jonah's head and protect him from the sun. Jonah was very happy to have the vine, 7but early the next morning the Lord sent a worm to chew on the vine, and the vine dried up. 8During the day the Lord sent a scorching wind, and the sun beat down on Jonah's head, making him feel faint. Jonah was ready to die, and he shouted, “I wish I were dead!”
9But the Lord asked, “Jonah, do you have the right to be angry about the vine?”
“Yes, I do,” he answered, “and I'm angry enough to die.”
10But the Lord said:
You are concerned about a vine that you did not plant or take care of, a vine that grew up in one night and died the next. 11In that city of Nineveh there are more than 120,000 people who cannot tell right from wrong, and many cattle are also there. Don't you think I should be concerned about that big city?
translation_text:
Jona be kanya agbo nɛ Ebɔrɛ be kuwɔrwu be asheŋ
1Ama kumo be loŋ daŋ tɔrɔ Jona ga nɛ e kpal loŋ so n nya agbo. 2Nseŋ kule Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na ŋ kaŋɛ le: “O Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ, mannɛ le nɛ n daŋ kaŋɛ saŋɛ nɛ n kra wɔ epe na a? Loŋ so nɛ n nya manaŋ n shile n yɔ Tarshish na. N nyi fo ka la kasha nɛ kuwɔrwu be Ebɔrɛ, nsaa maa nya agbo manaŋ manaŋ. Fee wora kelela nna saŋkama nseŋ wora shiriya nɛ fo ta alubi m paŋ. Fo alɛ maa kuse a bar kasogberge basa so. 3Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ, shin nɛ n wu. Ŋ ka wu bɔ, ŋ ka kraa wɔ ŋkpa to.”
4Nɛ Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ kaŋɛ: “Nuso be ekpa nɛ fo kɔ nɛ fo nya agbo?”
5Kumo be kaman nɛ Jona lar n ya chena kade na be ekarso ashi epeŋilarkpa be kaba so. E daŋ yuu kubuubi ko nna n chena kumo be kiyoyul to a jo nsaa keni kusɔ nɛ k beeŋ wora kade na to ebi. 6Nɛ Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ shin nɛ kefeelebi ko kɔr ndoŋ m purge a wora kiyoyul m buu Jona so, saŋɛ na so, epeŋi maa naa ŋmɛa mo ga. Kefeelebi na be kiyoyul na daŋ shin nna nɛ Jona be kagbene fuli mo ga. 7Ama kumo be ŋklade kachipurdidi nɛ Ebɔrɛ shin nɛ kushushombi gboŋgboŋi ko ba ji kefeelebi na nɛ k bolo to. 8Epeŋi ka lar nɛ Ebɔrɛ shin nɛ afu tushiso be kebembeŋ shi epeŋilarkpa m ber m ba Jona so nɛ e bɛlɛ. Ndoŋ nna nɛ e kaŋɛ le: “Ŋ ka wu bɔ ŋ ka kraa wɔ ŋkpa to.”
9Nɛ Ebɔrɛ bishi mo le: “Manɛ so nɛ fo kpal kefeelebi na so a nya agbo?” Nɛ Jona kaŋɛ: “Ŋ kpal kumo so n nya agbo, hale a sha fanɛ n wu gba nna na.”
10Nɛ Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ kaŋɛ le: “Kefeelebi nɛ fo maŋ duu ŋko ŋ keni so nɛ k daŋ be asheŋ e tir fo na. Kachɛ koŋwule nɛ kumo gbagba ta ŋ kɔr n daŋ m purge nseŋ naŋ wu kachɛ koŋwule to gba. 11Basa nɛ b chɔ ŋgboŋ kalfa nɛ adunyɔ nɛ b maŋ nyi bumo be bena nɛ jiso, n ta asɔbɔya damta gba n ti so e wɔ Ninɛve be kadegboŋ na to. A maŋ daga bumo be asheŋ ka tir ma a?”

english_text:
1 I am Micah from Moresheth. And this is the message about Samaria and Jerusalem that the Lord gave to me when Jotham, Ahaz, and Hezekiah were the kings of Judah.
Judgment on Samaria
2Listen, all of you!
Earth and everything on it,
pay close attention.
The Lord God accuses you
from his holy temple.
3And he will come down
to crush underfoot
every pagan altar.
4Mountains will melt
beneath his feet
like wax beside a fire.
Valleys will vanish like water
rushing down a ravine.
5This will happen because of
the terrible sins of Israel,
the descendants of Jacob.
Samaria has led Israel to sin,
and pagan altars at Jerusalem
have made Judah sin.
6So the Lord will leave Samaria
in ruins—
merely an empty field
where vineyards are planted.
He will scatter its stones
and destroy its foundations.
7Samaria's idols will be smashed,
and the wages
of temple prostitutes
will be destroyed by fire.
Silver and gold from those idols
will then be used by foreigners
as payment for prostitutes.
Judah Is Doomed
8Because of this tragedy,
I go barefoot and naked.
My crying and weeping
sound like howling wolves
or ostriches.
9The nation is fatally wounded.
Judah is doomed.
Jerusalem will fall.
10Don't tell it in Gath!
Don't even cry.
Instead, roll in the dust
at Beth-Leaphrah.
11Depart naked and ashamed,
you people of Shaphir.
The town of Bethezel mourns
because no one from Zaanan
went out to help.
12Everyone in Maroth
hoped for the best,
but the Lord sent disaster
down on Jerusalem.
13Get the war chariots ready,
you people of Lachish.
You led Jerusalem into sin,
just as Israel did.
14Now you will have to give
a going-away gift
to Moresheth.
Israel's kings will discover
that they cannot trust
the town of Achzib.
15People of Mareshah,
the Lord will send someone
to capture your town.
Then Israel's glorious king
will be forced to hide
in Adullam Cave.
16Judah, shave your head
as bald as a vulture
and start mourning.
Your precious children
will be dragged off
to a foreign country.
translation_text:
1Kamalga ere nɛ Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ daŋ ta n sa Maika nɛ e daŋ shi kade nɛ baa tre Moreshɛf na. E yɛ: “Jemanɛ nɛ Jotam nɛ Ahaz nɛ Hɛzekaya daŋ ji Juda be efuli so be kuwura na, nɛ Enyɛnpetale Ebɔrɛ daŋ lara loŋ be asheŋ ere ŋ ŋini Maika a laŋɛ ndegboŋ nɛ baa tre Samɛria nɛ Jerusalɛm na be kaplɛa so.
Maika ka bee shu a sa Jerusalɛm na be asheŋ
2Menyi basa nɛ men
wɔ durnya ere be efuliana kikɛ so e nu nfe!
Menyi basa kama nɛ men wɔ
kasawule ere kikɛ so gba e nu asheŋ ere!
Enyɛnpetale Ebɔrɛ nɛ e wɔ mbe bɔrɛlambu
cheembi to na, e naa shin nɛ e ji shɛda
ŋ gbiti menyi.
3Men keni nfe!
Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na bee shi mbe kakpa cheembi
a gbelge to a ba nɛ e ba nite kasawule ere so be
abeegboŋ be awɔlto.
4Abeegboŋ na beeŋ ŋalga ashi mbe aya to
fanɛ ŋku bumbuŋ ka luri edɛ to ŋ ŋalga a shile
a yɔ abee na be afito fanɛ nchu
ka shi kebee so a chulgi a wurge kasawule so na.
5Asheŋ ere kikɛ beeŋ wora nna ŋkpal Israɛlebi na ka wora kulubi ŋ gbiti Ebɔrɛ so. To, wanɛ nɛ baaŋ ta Israɛlebi be kekini Ebɔrɛ nseŋ lar mo kaman ere be asheŋ n sulɔ? Samɛria nɛ k la efuli na be kadegboŋ na be basa nɛ baaŋ ta kumo n sulɔ a! Nɛ wanɛ malɛ e tɔr Judaebi be kagbirshuŋ ere be ntaŋ? Mannɛ Jerusalɛm gbagba a? 6Amoso nɛ Enyɛnpetale Ebɔrɛ na yɛ: Meeŋ shin nɛ Samɛria e ki alambure n deŋi abar so kululu. K beeŋ ki ndibi sɔrso be eduukpa.
