Meeŋ pesaŋ Samɛria be egbalana be ebirkesi to n lɛ ketaŋɛ to ŋ ka kumo be egbaltɔlaseana nawule n nase nɛ ekama e baa wu amo. 7Samɛria to be agbirana kikɛ beeŋ bure to ŋ ki le burburbi. Nɛ edɛ e chɔɔ asɔ kama nɛ agbirlambu to be esakale kɔ na kikɛ. Efuli pɔtɛana so ebi beeŋ sulɔ kumo be agbirana be shuwa nɛ gbiti n ya sa esakale pɔtɛana mboŋ ko.”
8“Ŋkpal ade kikɛ so, ma Maika beeŋ boŋto a shu nseŋ buu asɔfarbi a na aya fuloŋ. Meeŋ shu fanɛ kuntuŋ na nseŋ boŋto fanɛ tayetaye. 9Ŋkpal manɛ so, Samɛria jija e shin nɛ k mur cheche nɛ Juda malɛ gba luri loŋ be tɔrɔ na to. Loŋ be tɔrɔ na tiŋ n fo ma basa be mbuna to ashi Jerusalɛm to.”
Edɔm ka firgi n taga Jerusalɛm to be asheŋ
10Men sa maŋ kaŋ malga kusɔ nɛ k bee wora menyi ere be asheŋ n sa Gafebi na kikɛ. Men sa maŋ shin nɛ b wu men ka bee shu. Menyi Bɛf Leafra be basa malɛ e ya dese eshishɛrpumpuŋ to a melti a ŋini kagbenejija nɛ k tɔr menyi so. 11Menyi Shafir nɛ Zaanan be nde to ebi e delgeso nseŋ ta anishinyɔr n shile n yɔ efuli pɔtɛ so. Basa nɛ b wɔ kadegboŋ nɛ baa tre Zaanan na maaŋ shuli n lar bumo be kade na to. Betezel be kade to ebi bee shu nna ŋkpal kusɔ nɛ k bee kuŋ kumo na ka maŋ naa wɔtɔ so. 12Marofebi pesaŋ to a keni e fin esa nɛ e beeŋ mɔlga bumo ŋkpal Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ ka shin nɛ Jerusalɛmebi ji jɛrbi damta so. 13Menyi nɛ men wɔ Lakish na e bela men be egbaŋɛ nɛ kena to be egbaŋɛturko ase. Men kute Israɛlebi to n wora alubi nseŋ ŋin Jerusalɛmebi gba n wɔtɔ alubi to. 14Amoso menyi Judaebi e kela Moreshɛf Gaaf be kade to ebi na fanɛ menyee yɔ. Ŋkpal manɛ so Israɛl be bewura maaŋ naŋ nya kechɛto ashi Akzib be kade to.
15Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na beeŋ ta menyi nɛ men shi kade nɛ baa tre Mareshɛf na m bɔɔ bedoŋ enɔ nɛ b kɔ n sɔ menyi be kade nɛ Israɛl be benimuana kikɛ e shile n ya ŋana kebeelaŋ nɛ k wɔ Adulam na to. 16Judaebi, men she men be amu ŋkpal kagbenejija nɛ k beeŋ tu menyi ŋkpal men be mbia shasoana so. Men she men be amu kɔlikɔli fanɛ ejita be amu na ŋkpal manɛ so, baaŋ pɛ men be mbia shaso ŋ ki anya n yɔ efuli pɔtɛ wɔfɔ so.

english_text:
Punishment for Those Who Abuse Their Power
1Doomed! You're doomed!
At night you lie in bed,
making evil plans.
And when morning comes,
you do what you've planned
because you have the power.
2You grab any field or house
that you want;
you cheat families
out of homes and land.
3But here is what the Lord says:
“I am planning trouble for you.
Your necks will be caught
in a noose,
and you will be disgraced
in this time of disaster.”
4When that happens,
this sorrowful song
will be sung about you:
“Ruined! Completely ruined!
The Lord has taken our land
and given it to traitors.”
5And so you will never again
own property
among the Lord's people.
6“Enough of your preaching!”
That's what you tell me.
“We won't be disgraced,
so stop preaching!”
7Descendants of Jacob,
is it right for you to claim
that the Lord did what he did
because he was angry?
Doesn't he always bless
those who do right?
8My people, you have turned against
one another!
You have even stolen
clothes right off the backs
of innocent neighbors
who pass by in peace.
9You take over lovely homes
that belong to the women
of my nation.
Then you cheat their children
out of the inheritance
that comes from the Lord.
10Get out of here, you crooks!
You'll find no rest here.
You're not fit to belong
to the Lord's people,
and you will be destroyed.
11The only prophet you want
is a liar who will say,
“Drink and get drunk!”
A Promise of Hope
12I, the Lord, promise
to bring together
the people of Israel
who have survived.
I will gather them,
just as a shepherd
brings sheep together,
and there will be many.
13I will break down the gate
and lead them out—
then I will be their king.
translation_text:
Asɔ nɛ a beeŋ nya basa nɛ baa tɔrɔ bebɔlpo na be asheŋ
1Asheŋ maaŋ nyalɛ n sa bekama nɛ baa dese bumo be edesekpa a kre asheŋ lubi be kewora be ŋkre na. Kanyɛso nɛ baa kaa kre loŋ be asheŋ na, nɛ kare e chɛ nɛ b wora amo ŋkpal b ka kɔ eleŋ so. 2B baa sha nsawule ŋko nwu kama, baa suge amo eleŋso nna. Baa puni nna a suge basa be nwu ŋko mpetɛsɔ.
3Amoso kusɔ nɛ Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na kaŋɛ nde: “Mee kre keshin nɛ tɔrɔgboŋgboŋi e ba menyi so nna. Menyi alɛ maaŋ tiŋ ŋ gelge kumo n nya menyi be kumu n ji kikɛ. Menyeeŋ luri etɔrɔ to, saŋɛ na so menyi maaŋ naa nite a wu menyi be amu. 4Kachɛ na kaŋ fo basa beeŋ baa boŋ nshɛ a wora menyi eyurto a kaŋɛ le:
‘Anyi ere mur cheche nna na!
Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na suge anyi be kasawule
n sa bedebɔrpo.’
5Amoso menyi maaŋ naa kɔ kachige ashi Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na be basa to ŋkpal manɛ so, esa kikɛ maaŋ baa wɔtɔ nɛ e yili menyi be katelamu to n sɔ kachige na.”
6Basa wɔtɔ nna a malga a gbiti ma a kaŋɛ le: “Sa maa bɔ le be abɔrɛsheŋ be kubɔya a sa anyi ere. Sa maa malga a laŋɛ amo be kaplɛa so gba kuraa. Anyi maaŋ ŋaba kikɛ. 7Menyi Israɛlebi nɛ men la Jeekɔb be kaman to ebi na kɔ ekpa nɛ men baa kaŋɛ fanɛ Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na nya agbo nna n wora kusɔ nɛ e wora ere? Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ maa kaa nɛfa bekama nɛ baa wora asheŋ niŋiso nna a?”
8Kumo be kaman nɛ Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na kaŋɛ: “Menyi kaa kɔ ma basa kena fanɛ b ka la bedoŋ nna. B baŋ shi kena to a ba epe a fɛ fanɛ epe nɛ kagbenewushi wɔ, menyi kaa ŋana ekpa to nna a jo nɛ b ba nɛ men yuri bumo be asɔbuuso. 9Menyi alɛ bee kaa ju ma basa be beche a lar bumo be elaŋ nɛ baa sha ga na to nna nsaa suge bumo be mbia be enɛfa nɛ n sa bumo fanɛ a baa la bumo peya mbaanaayɔ na. 10Men koso a yɔ! Nfe maŋ la kakpa nɛ menyeeŋ chena n wushi. Ŋkpal manɛ so, menyi be alubi shin nɛ k wora eyurpi nseŋ ki kakpa nɛ k beeŋ mur.
11Basa ere bee sha anebi nɛ e beeŋ ba kaa ku efɛ a kaŋɛ bumo le na nna: ‘Men baa nuu nsa a boo.’
12Ma, Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na e naa nase kɔnɔ, fanɛ meeŋ naŋ bar ma basa Israɛlebi, nɛ baaŋ ji efute na abar so. Meeŋ gama bumo abar so fanɛ mbolpɔ ka wɔ kuluu to, saŋɛ na so basa beeŋ wora keshi n sɔ kasawule na so kikɛ.
13Meeŋ bugi ekpa n sa ma basa nseŋ juŋkpar bumo n lar kenyaya nɛ b wɔtɔ ashi efuli pɔtɛana so m ba ki bumo be ewura.”

english_text:
Evil Rulers and Lying Prophets
1Listen to me,
you rulers of Israel!
You know right from wrong,
2but you prefer to do evil
instead of what is right.
You skin my people alive.
You strip off their flesh,
3break their bones,
cook it all in a pot,
and gulp it down.
4Someday you will beg the Lord
to help you,
but he will turn away
because of your sins.
5You lying prophets promise
security for anyone
who gives you food,
but disaster for anyone
who refuses to feed you.
Here is what the Lord says
to you prophets:
6“You will live in the dark,
far from the sight of the sun,
with no message from me.
7You prophets and fortunetellers
will all be disgraced,
with no message from me.”
8But the Lord has filled me
with power and his Spirit.
I have been given the courage
to speak about justice
and to tell you people of Israel
that you have sinned.
9So listen to my message,
you rulers of Israel!
You hate justice
and twist the truth.
10You make cruelty and murder
a way of life in Jerusalem.
11You leaders accept bribes
for dishonest decisions.
You priests and prophets
teach and preach,
but only for money.
Then you say,
“The Lord is on our side.
No harm will come to us.”
12 And so, because of you,
Jerusalem will be plowed under
and left in ruins.
Thorns will cover the mountain
where the temple now stands.
translation_text:
Maika ka lar Israɛl be bejuŋkparpoana kaman be asheŋ
1Ndoŋ nna nɛ Maika kaŋɛ le: “Israɛlebi be bejuŋkparpo, men nu nfe! Men nyi kelela nɛ kulubi be mbarga, 2ama men kishi alela be kebaa wora nna nsaa sha alubi be kebaa wora. Men wɔtɔ nna a debɔr ma basa nsaa jija bumo be atre fanɛ kananɛ baa luu kusɔbɔya be kawɔl nsaa marga kumo be eblaŋ ashi awibi so na. 3K du fanɛ menyee luu ma basa be nwɔl nna, nsaa kpele bumo be eblaŋ nɛ awibi to a wɔtɔ mpuliya to a daŋɛ a we. 4Kachako menyeeŋ shu ŋ kule Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na, ama e maaŋ nu menyi be kekule. Ŋkpal menyi be alubi so, e beeŋ kpele mbe anishi nsaa maaŋ tuge menyi gba kuraa.
5Kusɔ nɛ Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na bee kaŋɛ nde: ‘Anebiana ko wɔtɔ nna a fule a nase kayurwushi be kɔnɔ a sa basa nɛ baa sa bumo kusɔ jiso nsaa ta kena a funti bekama nɛ b maa wora loŋ na. Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na bee kaŋɛ loŋ be anebiana na nna fanɛ 6k beeŋ wora bumo kachako fanɛ kanyɛ ka biri nɛ b maŋ naa wu na. B maaŋ naaŋ tiŋ ŋ ku bɔrɛdare n fule ma basa kikɛ. 7Bumo be bekama nɛ baa wu echefoso be asheŋ a kaŋɛ na beeŋ ŋaba, ŋkpal manɛ so kusɔ nɛ baaŋ kaŋɛ na maaŋ wora m bɔlɔ so. Baaŋ ji nyɔmɔ, ŋkpal manɛ so Ebɔrɛ maaŋ naaŋ tuge bumo.’ ”
8Ama Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na ta mbe Kiyoyu nɛ mbe eleŋ na nna n wɔtɔ ma ere to, nseŋ shin nɛ n nya kenyɛn a ji asheŋ nɛ amo be ekpa so nsaa tiŋ a kaŋɛ Israɛl be basa bumo be alubi. 9Men nu nfe, menyi Israɛl be bejuŋkparpo, nɛ men kishi kebaaji asheŋ nɛ amo be ekpa so nsaa ta kulubi a tre kelela. 10Kumukpakpaso nɛ kamɔ nɛ men ta ŋ ki menyi be karechɛ kikɛ be kebaawɔtɔ ashi Ebɔrɛ be kadegboŋ nɛ baa tre Jerusalɛm na to. 11Kadegboŋ na be bejuŋkparpoana bee sɔ asɔ basa kutɔ nna pɔɛŋ nsaa ji bumo be asheŋ a sa bumo. Bɔrɛmatapoana nɛ anebiana na malɛ bee sɔ amansherbi nna pɔɛŋ nsaa ŋini mbraana na ŋko a wu abɔrɛsheŋ a kaŋɛ basa. Kumo be kaman nɛ b kilgi ŋ kaŋɛ le: “Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na wɔ anyi kutɔ, amoso shɛŋ maaŋ tiŋ n wora anyi.”
12Ŋkpal bumo so, baaŋ pulgi Jerusalɛm to fanɛ kudɔsawule, nɛ k ki kade bureso m biti abar so a dese; nɛ Zayɔn be kebee nɛ bɔrɛlambu na yil so na malɛ e ki kupo.

english_text:
Peace and Prosperity
1In the future, the mountain
with the Lord's temple
will be the highest of all.
It will reach above the hills,
and every nation
will rush to it.
2People of many nations
will come and say,
“Let's go up to the mountain
of the Lord God of Jacob
and worship in his temple.”
The Lord will teach us his Law
from Jerusalem,
and we will obey him.
3 He will settle arguments
between distant
and powerful nations.
They will pound their swords
and their spears
into rakes and shovels;
they will never again make war
or attack one another.
4 Everyone will find rest
beneath their own fig trees
or grape vines,
and they will live in peace.
This is a solemn promise
of the Lord All-Powerful.
5Others may follow their gods,
but we will always follow
the Lord our God.
The Lord Will Lead His People Home
6The Lord said:
At that time
I will gather my people—
the lame and the outcasts,
and all others into whose lives
I have brought sorrow.
7Then the lame and the outcasts
will belong to my people
and become a strong nation.
I, the Lord, will rule them
from Mount Zion forever.
8Mount Zion in Jerusalem,
guardian of my people,
you will rule again.
9Jerusalem, why are you crying?
Don't you have a king?
Have your advisors gone?
Are you suffering
like a woman in childbirth?
10Keep on groaning with pain,
you people of Jerusalem!
If you escape from your city
to the countryside,
you will still be taken
as prisoners to Babylonia.
But later I will rescue you
from your enemies.
11Zion, because of your sins
you are surrounded
by many nations who say,
“We can hardly wait
to see you disgraced.”
12But they don't know
that I, the Lord,
have gathered them here
to grind them like grain.
13Smash them to pieces, Zion!
I'll let you be like a bull
with iron horns
and bronze hoofs.
Crush those nations
and bring their wealth to me,
the Lord of the earth.
translation_text:
Enyɛnpetale na be kagbenewushi ka beeŋ ba kaplɛkama be asheŋ
1Lalaloge be nchɛ na to kebee nɛ
Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ be bɔrɛlambu na yil so na
e naŋ ba ki abee kikɛ to be kejeŋgreŋ ga.
K beeŋ baa du jeŋgreŋ a chɔ abee kikɛ nyam,
nɛ efuliana na kikɛ be basa e shile m ba kumo ase
2m ba kaŋɛ le:
“Men shin nɛ an dii
n yɔ Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na be kebee na so,
n ya luri Israɛl be Ebɔrɛ na be bɔrɛlambu na to.
E beeŋ ŋini anyi kusɔ nɛ e bee sha fanɛ an wora;
nɛ an baa wora mbe aparsheŋ saŋkama.
Ŋkpal manɛ so, Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na
be keŋini bee shi Jerusalɛm nna;
nɛ mo alɛ bee shi Zayɔn be kebee so
a malga a sa mbe basa.”
3E beeŋ naŋ lɔŋɛ efuliana nɛ a wɔ kufɔ nɛ tatato kikɛ,
nɛ kelaŋtokɔ wɔ bumo be kefɛato na
nɛ b naŋ nyalɛ abar so.
Saŋɛ na so nɛ b ta bumo be etokobi m bel ntekpa
nseŋ ta bumo akpa malɛ m bel eloji.
Efuliana na maaŋ naa ŋini bumo basa
kena be kekɔ kikɛ ŋko n naŋ kɔ abar kena gba kuraa.
4Loŋ be jemanɛ na, ekama na beeŋ chena
mbe ndibi sɔrso be kudɔ to nɛ kayurwushi
nɛ esa kikɛ maaŋ naa funti mo.
Ŋkpal manɛ so, Enyɛnpetale Ebɔrɛ na
be kɔnɔ naseso nna na.
5Efuli kama so ebi bee bunyaŋ nsaa wora bumo be kegbir kasonu nna, ama anyi ere beeŋ baa bunyaŋ nsaa wora Enyɛnpe anyi be Ebɔrɛ na kasonu nna mbaanaayɔ.
Israɛlebi ka beeŋ shi kenyaya to m bɛta m ba be asheŋ
6Kede be kaman nɛ Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na kaŋɛ, “Jemanɛ ko bee ba nɛ ŋ gama basa nɛ ŋ gberge kusoe n shin nɛ b yɔ kenyaya to ashi efuli wɔfɔana so n ya ji awurfoŋ na abar so. 7Meeŋ shin nɛ ma basa nɛ b shir kaman kasawule na so nsaa du fanɛ ebobi na e naŋ ki efuli lempo so ebi. Ma alɛ beeŋ baa wɔ Zayɔn be kebee na so nna a ji kuwura bumo so hale mbaanaayɔ.”
8Kumo be kaman nɛ Jerusalɛm nɛ k la kakpa nɛ Ebɔrɛ wɔ nsaa keni mbe basa so fanɛ mbolpɔkpapo na e naŋ ki efuli na so be kadegboŋ. 9Jerusalɛmebi, manɛ so nɛ menyee shu awɔrso ŋko a ji awurfoŋ fanɛ eche nɛ kakurge ta mo? Menyi ka maŋ kɔ ewura ŋko menyi be asoetojipoana ka wu so nɛ menyee shu a? 10Men baa shu nsaa kii nnɔ to fanɛ eche nɛ kakurge ta na, ŋkpal manɛ so, k maaŋ chɛr nɛ men lar kadegboŋ na to n yaa kaa wɔ kupuŋ to. Baaŋ pɛ menyi n yɔ kufɔ kufɔ Babilɔn be efuli so, ama ma, Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na, beeŋ mɔlga menyi ashi men doŋana be enɔ to ndoŋ. 11Efuli damtaana gama abar so nna nɛ b kɔ menyi kena. B yɛ: “A daga fanɛ Jerusalɛm ka mur! Anyi be kenishi pere nna a fin kewu kumo be ŋaba.” 12Ama efuliana ere maŋ nyi kusɔ nɛ k wɔ Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na be nfɛra to. B maŋ nyi fanɛ b gama abar so nna nɛ kasogberge e ba bumo so fanɛ kananɛ baa bri ayu na.
13Kumo be kaman nɛ Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na naŋ kaŋɛ le: “Jerusalɛm to ebi, men ya gberge men doŋana kusoe. Meeŋ shin nɛ men baa kɔ eleŋ fanɛ egbolu nɛ amo be alambɛ du fanɛ abɛlso nɛ amo be alotobi malɛ du fanɛ danyaŋ na. Menyeeŋ pɔ efuli damtaana so nseŋ sɔ asɔ nɛ b daŋ ta eleŋsheŋ n nya na m ba sa ma, nɛ n la durnya kikɛ be Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na.”

english_text:
A Promised Ruler
1Jerusalem, enemy troops
have surrounded you;
they have struck Israel's ruler
in the face with a stick.
2 Bethlehem Ephrath,
you are one of the smallest towns
in the nation of Judah.
But the Lord will choose
one of your people
to rule the nation—
someone whose family
goes back to ancient times.
3The Lord will abandon Israel
only until this ruler is born,
and the rest of his family
returns to Israel.
4Like a shepherd
taking care of his sheep,
this ruler will lead
and care for his people
by the power and glorious name
of the Lord his God.
His people will live securely,
and the whole earth will know
his true greatness,
5because he will bring peace.
Assyria Will Be Defeated
Let Assyria attack our country
and our palaces.
We will counterattack,
led by a number of rulers
6 whose strong army will defeat
the nation of Assyria.
Yes, our leaders will rescue us,
if those Assyrians
dare to invade our land.
The Survivors Will Be Safe
7A few of Jacob's descendants
survived and are scattered
among the nations.
But the Lord will let them
cover the earth like dew and rain
that refreshes the soil.
8At present they are scattered,
but later they will attack,
as though they were fierce lions
pouncing on sheep.
Their enemies will be torn
to shreds,
with no one to save them;
9they will be helpless,
completely destroyed.
Idols Will Be Destroyed in Israel
10The Lord said:
At that time I will wipe out
your cavalry and chariots,
11as well as your cities
and your fortresses.
12I will stop you
from telling fortunes
and practicing witchcraft.
13You will no longer worship
the idols or stone images
you have made—
I will destroy them,
14together with the sacred poles
and even your towns.
15I will become furious
and take revenge on the nations
that refuse to obey me.
translation_text:
1Jerusalɛmebi, men gama men be benapo abar so n wora shiriya, ŋkpal manɛ so, bedoŋ kulti anyi nna n wɔtɔ! Baa fin kekɔ Israɛlebi be ewura kena ŋ ŋe mbe ketaya kedibi nna.
Ejuŋkparpo ka beeŋ shi Bɛtlɛhɛm n lar be asheŋ
2Ama Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na yɛ: “Bɛtlɛhɛm Efrata, fo la Juda be efuli so be ndewurbiana na be kuko nna, ama fo to nɛ meeŋ lara esa nɛ e beeŋ ba ji Israɛl be efuli so be kuwura. Dra dra na kikɛ nɛ mbe kanaŋ jɔŋɛ.”
3Amoso Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na beeŋ kplaŋ mbe basa so nɛ b baa kraa wɔ bumo doŋana be enɔ to n ya fo jemanɛ nɛ eche nɛ e beeŋ kurge loŋ be ewura na beeŋ kurge ebinyɛn. Saŋɛ na so nɛ Israɛl be basa nɛ b wɔ kenyaya to ashi efuli pɔtɛana so na e bɛta m ba ti bumo peebiana so a wɔtɔ. 4Ewura na kaŋ ba e beeŋ ta Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na be eleŋ nɛ Ebɔrɛ na be ketre be kemaŋkura n ji kuwura mbe basa so. Mbe basa beeŋ nya kekuŋ gboŋgboŋi, ŋkpal manɛ so, mbe ketre beeŋ dii n yɔ durnya be efuli kama so 5nɛ e bar kayurwushi m ba sa bumo. Asiriya be efuli so be basa kaŋ ba kɔ m bure n luri anyi be mboŋ lempoana to, anyeeŋ shuŋi anyi be bejuŋkparpo lempoana nɛ b ya kɔ bumo. 6Anyi be bejuŋkparpo lempoana ere beeŋ keta benapo nɛ b kɔ eleŋ ga n ya kɔ m mɔlga anyi ashi Asiriyaebi nɛ baa shuŋ kegbir nɛ baa tre Nimrɔd na be enɔ to jemanɛ nɛ baaŋ ba bure n luri anyi be kasawule to na.
7Israɛl be basa nɛ baaŋ ji efute na beeŋ baa du fanɛ bunyaŋ ŋko bɔrɛchu nɛ k bee sa kayul nseŋ shi Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na kutɔ a ba efuli damtaana so nna. 8Ama bekama nɛ b shir a wɔ efuli pɔtɛana so na bre beeŋ ki fanɛ buluŋ nɛ e bee kɔ a fin kusɔ jiso ashi kiyi to na nna. E baŋ nya n luri mbolpɔ to e beeŋ baa tɛ nna a yuu bumo so nsaa kpɛa bumo to a we nɛ esa kikɛ malɛ maaŋ tiŋ n sɔ bumo n yige. 9Israɛlebi na beeŋ kɔ m pɔɔ bumo doŋana so nseŋ mur bumo cheche.
10Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na yɛ: “Jemanɛ na kaŋ fo, meeŋ suge menyi be egbaŋɛ nseŋ mur menyi be egbaŋɛturko. 11Ma alɛ beeŋ mur ndegboŋana nɛ a wɔ menyi be kasawule so nseŋ bure menyi be mboŋ lempoana nɛ a bee kuŋ menyi na kikɛ. 12Meeŋ naŋ jija kegba be adur nɛ men kɔ na nɛ men maaŋ naa tiŋ a to abar akprambi ashi menyi be kasawule so. 13Ma alɛ beeŋ naŋ mur asɔ nɛ menyee ta a lɔŋɛ agbir a shuŋ na kikɛ, nɛ menyi maaŋ naŋ nya amo a shuŋ. 14Meeŋ bure kegbirche nɛ baa tre Ashira na be mpɔrduli kikɛ ashi men be kasawule so nseŋ mur menyi be ndegboŋana gba. 15Meeŋ nya agbo ga m bishi efuliana nɛ amo be basa kini kewora ma kasonu na kuwule.”

english_text:
The Lord's Challenge to His People
1The Lord said to his people:
Come and present your case
to the hills and mountains.
2Israel, I am bringing charges
against you—
I call upon the mountains
and the earth's firm foundation
to be my witnesses.
3My people, have I wronged you
in any way at all?
Please tell me.
4 I rescued you from Egypt,
where you were slaves.
I sent Moses, Aaron, and Miriam
to be your leaders.
5 Don't forget the evil plans
of King Balak of Moab
or what Balaam son of Beor
said to him.
Remember how I, the Lord,
saved you many times
on your way from Acacia
to Gilgal.
True Obedience
6What offering should I bring
when I bow down to worship
the Lord God Most High?
Should I try to please him
by sacrificing
calves a year old?
7Will thousands of sheep
or rivers of olive oil
make God satisfied with me?
Should I sacrifice to the Lord
my first-born child as payment
for my terrible sins?
8The Lord God has told us
what is right
and what he demands:
“See that justice is done,
let mercy be your first concern,
and humbly obey your God.”
Cheating and Violence
9I am the Lord,
and you are wise to respect
my power to punish.
So listen to my message
for the city of Jerusalem:
10You store up stolen treasures
and use dishonest scales.
11But I, the Lord, will punish you
for cheating with weights
and with measures.
12You rich people are violent,
and everyone tells lies.
13Because of your sins,
I will wound you and leave you
ruined and defenseless.
14You will eat,
but still be hungry;
you will store up goods,
but lose everything—
I, the Lord, will let it all
be captured in war.
15You won't harvest what you plant
or use the oil
from your olive trees
or drink the wine
from grapes you grow.
16 Jerusalem, this will happen
because you followed
the sinful example
of kings Omri and Ahab.
Now I will destroy you
and your property.
Then the people of every nation
will make fun and insult you.
translation_text:
Asheŋ nɛ Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na kɔ a gbiti Israɛlebi be asheŋ
1Nu kusɔ nɛ Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na yɛ e kɔ a gbiti Israɛlebi na. E yɛ: “Men niŋi to n ta men be asheŋ n nase abeegboŋana be anishito nseŋ shin nɛ abeebi e nu kusɔ nɛ men kɔ nɛ men kaŋɛ. 2O abeegboŋ nɛ durnya be nsawule be egbaltɔlase nɛ a wɔtɔ mbaanaayɔ, men nu asheŋ nɛ Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na kɔ a semaŋ mbe basa Israɛlebi na.”
3E yɛ “Ma basa, manɛ nɛ n wora menyi? Men kaŋɛ ma, n la esulɔ nna n sa menyi a? 4Ma e lara menyi nseŋ mɔlga menyi ashi kenyaya to ashi Ijipt be efuli so. Mosis nɛ Ɛɛrɔn nɛ Miriam nɛ n daŋ shuŋi fanɛ b ya juŋkpar menyi n lar ndoŋ. 5Ma basa, men baa nyiŋi kusɔ nɛ Mowab be ewura Balak daŋ kre kewora menyi nɛ kusɔ nɛ Biyɔɔ pibinyɛn Balaam daŋ kaŋɛ mo a laŋɛ menyi be kaplɛa so na. Men naŋ nyiŋi asheŋ nɛ e wora saŋɛ nɛ men lar Shitim a yɔ Gilgaal na nseŋ nyiŋi kananɛ ma, Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na mɔlga menyi ale damta.”
Kashenteŋto be kasonu be asheŋ
6Manɛ bre nɛ meeŋ ta m ba Enyɛnpetale Ebɔrɛ nɛ e wɔ ebɔrɛso na kutɔ m ba bunyaŋ mo? N ta egbolu lela ga nɛ a ji nfɛ koko m ba lara sarga chɔɔso n sa mo a? 7N ta mbolpɔ ŋgboŋto ŋgboŋto ŋko ɔlif be ŋku nɛ e du fanɛ lɔr be bɔlɔ m ba mo kutɔ, k beeŋ par mo a? N ta ma wurkoŋnyɛn n lara sarga n sa mo ŋkpal ma alubi so a? 8Ayai, Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na teŋ kaŋɛ anyi kusɔ nɛ k walɛ. Kusɔ nɛ e bee fin anyi kutɔ e la, kebaawora asheŋ nɛ amo be ekpa so nɛ kebaa ŋini kasha nsaa kɔ kamubrase a nu a sa mo.
9Nu nfe! Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na bee kela a shoŋi Jerusalɛm be kadegboŋ na to ebi. E yɛ: “Men baa de kuwurkpabi na, nɛ esa nɛ e kɔ kumo to a ba na so. 10Kayu be asɔ nɛ men ta m bɔlɔ ebuana n yili nseŋ ta kapuni be ekurwa nɛ ŋ kishi amo be asheŋ ga na a ber asɔ. 11Nuso nɛ meeŋ tiŋ n ta m paŋ bumo nɛ baa ta kapuni be ekurwa a ber asɔ a sa basa? 12Damawuraana na bee puni betirpo nna nɛ ekama malɛ bee ku efɛ. 13Amoso n teŋ fara nɛ m mur menyi nna ŋkpal menyi be asheŋ lubi so. 14Menyeeŋ ji ajibi, ama menyi alɛ maaŋ moɛ. Menyeeŋ chala asɔ n yili, ama menyi alɛ maaŋ baa kɔ mpetɛ nɛ a yil. Ma, Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na beeŋ shin nɛ bedoŋ e ba kɔ n suge amo kikɛ. 15Menyi beeŋ dɔ n duu, ama menyi maaŋ nya shɛŋ n teŋi. Menyeeŋ ta ɔlif be bibi n wora ŋku, ama menyi alɛ maaŋ nya ŋku na n wora shɛŋ. Menyeeŋ ku eyabra ŋko n daŋɛ nsa, ama menyi maaŋ nya yabra ŋko nsa n nuu. 16Le be asheŋ ere beeŋ ba menyi so nna ŋkpal men ka bɛ ewura Omri nɛ mo pibinyɛn, ewura Ehab be asheŋ lubi so so. Bumo be edaŋkare to nɛ men bee kute to. Amoso meeŋ shin nɛ men mur cheche nɛ ekama e baa tege nsaa mushe menyi fanɛ asɔ jiga na.”

english_text:
Israel Is Corrupt
1I feel so empty inside—
like someone starving
for grapes or figs,
after the vines and trees
have all been picked clean.
2No one is loyal to God;
no one does right.
Everyone is brutal
and eager to deceive
everyone else.
3People cooperate to commit crime.
Judges and leaders demand bribes,
and rulers cheat in court.
4The most honest of them
is worse than a thorn patch.
Your doom has come!
Lookouts sound the warning,
and everyone panics.
5Don't trust anyone,
not even your best friend,
and be careful what you say
to the one you love.
6 Sons refuse to respect
their own fathers,
daughters rebel against
their own mothers,
and daughters-in-law despise
their mothers-in-law.
Your family is now your enemy.
7But I trust the Lord God
to save me,
and I will wait for him
to answer my prayer.
The Nation Turns to God
8My enemies, don't be glad
because of my troubles!
I may have fallen,
but I will get up;
I may be sitting in the dark,
but the Lord is my light.
9I have sinned against the Lord.
And so I must endure his anger,
until he comes to my defense.
But I know that I will see him
making things right for me
and leading me to the light.
10You, my enemies, said,
“The Lord God is helpless.”
Now each of you
will be disgraced
and put to shame.
I will see you trampled
like mud in the street.
A Bright Future
11Towns of Judah, the day is coming
when your walls will be rebuilt,
and your boundaries enlarged.
12People will flock to you
from Assyria and Egypt,
from Babylonia
and everywhere else.
13Those nations will suffer disaster
because of what they did.
Micah's Prayer and the Lord's Answer
14Lead your people, Lord!
Come and be our shepherd.
Grasslands surround us,
but we live in a forest.
So lead us to Bashan and Gilead,
and let us find pasture
as we did long ago.
15I, the Lord, will work miracles
just as I did when I led you
out of Egypt.
16Nations will see this
and be ashamed because
of their helpless armies.
They will be in shock,
unable to speak or hear,
17because of their fear of me,
your Lord and God.
Then they will come trembling,
crawling out of their fortresses
like insects or snakes,
lapping up the dust.
No One Is Like God
The people said:
18Our God, no one is like you.
We are all that is left
of your chosen people,
and you freely forgive
our sin and guilt.
You don't stay angry forever;
you're glad to have pity
19and pleased to be merciful.
You will trample on our sins
and throw them in the sea.
20You will keep your word
and be faithful to Jacob
and to Abraham,
as you promised our ancestors
many years ago.
translation_text:
Israɛlebi be kebaawɔtɔ lubi be asheŋ
1Asheŋ malɛ tu ma bre! N du fanɛ esa nɛ akoŋ kɔ nɛ mo alɛ maŋ nya kusɔrso kama kedibisɔrso ŋko kefeelebi so nɛ e chuge n ji nna. B chuge afeelebi be asɔrso nɛ baa tre greeps na nɛ figidibi be asɔrso na kikɛ nyam. 2Esa kikɛ ma ŋ naa ji kashenteŋ kasawule ere so. Ekama maŋ niŋi Ebɔrɛ be anishito. Ekama bee fin ekpa nɛ e beeŋ bɔla so m mɔ mo barkasa nna. Edimɛdi kikɛ bee tɛ bumo niopibiana nna a fin bumo nɛ b mɔ. 3Alubi be kewora deŋ ekama nna. Ekrachi nɛ demujipoana bee tu basa nna a sɔ asɔ pɔɛŋ nsaa shuŋ bumo be ashuŋ a sa bumo. Ekama nɛ e kɔ eyilikpa basa to bee bɔla mbe eyilikpa so nna a fin asɔ a sa mbe kumu nna. Ekama wora kɔnɔ nna a shin nɛ loŋ be asheŋ bee wora. 4Bumo to be basa nɛ bumo be kebaawɔtɔ niŋi nɛ baa ji kashenteŋ gba maŋ bɔ. B du fanɛ ewidibi nna.
To, kachɛ fo nɛ Ebɔrɛ e gberge edimɛdi kusoe, fanɛ kananɛ e bɔla anebiana na so ŋ kpele bumo kusoe na. Naniere bumo be nfɛra wulto nna. 5Sa maŋ kaŋ yirda fo echenashapo ŋko fo teri kikɛ. Baa de kusɔ nɛ fee kaŋɛ fo eche gba so. 6Jemanɛ mo nɛ an wɔ to ere, bibinyɛn bee keni bumo tutoana nna fanɛ bewulpo. Bibiche malɛ maa sa bumo nioana kashuli nɛ bechekilpo malɛ bee tu bumo shacheana a bile. Naniere esa gbagba be kanaŋ to ebi e la mo doŋana.
7Ama ma ere bee keni Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na be anishito nna nseŋ ta tama a jo mo nɛ e mɔlga ma. Ma Ebɔrɛ na malɛ beeŋ nu ma kekule.
Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na ka beeŋ bar kumɔlga be asheŋ
8N doŋana, men sa maŋ shin nɛ menyi be ŋgbene e fuli nɛ men baa ji njɔŋ ma so. Hale nɛ n tɔr gba, ŋ kraa beeŋ koso. Nɛ n chena tentembiri to gba, Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na e la ma kefulto. 9N wora alubi n da Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na so, amoso meeŋ wora kanyiti n ji mbe agbo be tɔrɔ n ya fo saŋɛ nɛ e beeŋ ba kɔ n sa ma. M baa nyi geeŋ fanɛ e beeŋ naŋ shin nɛ asheŋ a nyalɛ nɛ e juŋkpar ma m ba kefulto to. 10Saŋɛ na so nɛ ma doŋana nɛ b kaŋɛ le: “Nnɛ nɛ Enyɛnpe fo Ebɔrɛ na wɔ?” An wu kusɔ nɛ e wora na nɛ nyɔmɔ e pɛ bumo. Ma anishi ere nɛ meeŋ ta n wu asheŋ ka beeŋ bri bumo. Hale naniere gba n wu fanɛ b ki fanɛ kebɔrbi so be depɔ nna nɛ basa bee chichi so.
11O Jerusalɛmebi, saŋɛ fo nɛ b lɔŋɛ kadegboŋ na be egbalana m pɔr. Jemanɛ na kaŋ fo menyi be kasawule be egbaŋ beeŋ kpalga to n ti so. 12Basa beeŋ shi Asiriya be efuli nɛ k wɔ epeŋilarkpa be kaba so na nɛ Ijipt be efuli so be ndegboŋana to nɛ abonfu nɛ a wɔ Yufreetes be lɔr na nɛ nde wɔfɔ ashi etekuana nɛ abeegboŋana na so m ba menyi kutɔ. 13Ama efuli pɔtɛana bre be nsawule beeŋ ki keshishɛrsawule ŋkpal bumo be basa be amukpakpaso so.
Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ be kashagboŋ nɛ e kɔ n sa Israɛl be asheŋ
14O Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ, baa la fanɛ mbolpɔkpapo n sa fo basa laraso. Kashenteŋ nna fanɛ b pesaŋ to nna a wɔ kiyi to, ama kudɔsawule lela kulti bumo nna n wɔtɔ. Amoso shin nɛ b ya chena Bashan nɛ Giliad be nsawule lela so a nya a ji fanɛ kananɛ b daa nya a ji dra na.
15Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ, yaŋ wora emamachisheŋ n sa anyi fanɛ kananɛ fo daŋ wora saŋɛ nɛ fo daŋ lara anyi ashi Ijipt be efuli so na. 16Efuli pɔtɛana nɛ baa puchi bumo be eleŋ so beeŋ wu asheŋ ere nɛ aba e pɔ bumo nɛ b lo bumo be nnɔ nseŋ ti bumo be asoe kagbenejijaso. 17Kumo be kaman nɛ b dese kasawule a gbeye fanɛ awɔ nsaa chicha kufuso a lar mboŋ lempoana nɛ b daa wɔtɔ to na. Bumo alɛ beeŋ kilgi kufuso m bɛta m ba Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na kutɔ.
18O Enyɛnpetale Ebɔrɛ, Ebɔrɛ kikɛ maŋ naa wɔtɔ a du fanɛ fo. Fo e naa ta fo basa be alubi a paŋ bumo. Fo alɛ be agbo maa wɔtɔ a yɔ. Kuwɔrwu e naa fuli fo kagbene. 19Fo e naa wu anyi kuwɔr fanɛ kananɛ fo daa wora na. Fee chichi anyi be alubi so nna a ta amo a lɛ teku be kechimbi to. 20Feeŋ lara fo kashenteŋji nɛ kasha nɛ k maa loge na ŋ ŋini fo basa nɛ b la an nananyɛnana Eebraham nɛ Jeekɔb be kaman to ebi na, fanɛ kananɛ fo chɛr n nase kumo be kɔnɔ n sa bumo na.

english_text:
1 I am Nahum from Elkosh. And this is the message that I wrote down about Nineveh.
The Fierce Anger of the Lord
2The Lord God demands loyalty.
In his anger, he takes revenge
on his enemies.
3The Lord is powerful,
yet patient;
he makes sure that the guilty
are always punished.
He can be seen in storms
and in whirlwinds;
clouds are the dust from his feet.
4At the Lord's command,
oceans and rivers dry up.
Bashan, Mount Carmel,
and Lebanon wither,
and their flowers fade.
5At the sight of the Lord,
mountains and hills
tremble and melt;
the earth and its people
shudder and shake.
6Who can stand the heat
of his furious anger?
It flashes out like fire
and shatters stones.
The Power of Assyria Will Be Broken
7The Lord is good.
He protects those who trust him
in times of trouble.
8But like a roaring flood,
the Lord chases his enemies
into dark places
and destroys them.
9So don't plot against the Lord!
He wipes out his enemies,
and they never revive.
10They are like drunkards
overcome by wine,
or like twisted thornbushes
burning in a fire.
11Assyria, one of your rulers
has made evil plans
against the Lord.
12But the Lord says, “Assyria,
no matter how strong you are,
you will be cut down!
My people Judah,
I have troubled you before,
but I won't do it again.
13I'll snap your chains
and set you free
from the Assyrians.”
14Assyria, this is what else
the Lord says to you:
“Your name will be forgotten.
I will destroy every idol
in your temple,
and I will send you to the grave,
because you are worthless.”
15 Look toward the mountains,
people of Judah!
Here comes a messenger
with good news of peace.
Celebrate your festivals.
Keep your promises to God.
Your evil enemies are destroyed
and will never again
invade your country.
translation_text:
1Kubɔya ere la bɔrɛdare nɛ Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na shin nɛ Nahum, nɛ e shi kade nɛ baa tre Ɛlkɔsh na, ku a laŋɛ kadegboŋ nɛ baa tre Ninɛve na be kaplɛa so nna.
Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ ka nya agbo n wɔtɔ Ninɛve be asheŋ
2Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na kishi kechamana ga,
nsaa beeŋ gberge mo doŋana kusoe.
E beeŋ bishi bumo kuwule agbo so.
3Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na kɔ eleŋ ga,
mo alɛ maa nya agbo manaŋ manaŋ,
ama mo alɛ maa yige bumo nɛ baa wora
a de so nɛ baa ta bumo be amu a ji.
Bɔrɛfugboŋ nɛ kawuliwuli so
nɛ e bee bɔla a wora asheŋ;
nɛ bɔrɛwɔlpa malɛ du
fanɛ mbe aya to be kalabɛr.
4Mo e naa ponte teku nɛ elɔr so
nɛ amo be nchu bee feeto nɛ a bee wɔlto.
Mo koŋwule na e naa ponte
nɛ Bashan be afitiri bumbuŋ bee bolo,
nɛ Kamɛl be kebeegboŋ so be ndibi bee pere kpaw
nɛ Lebanɔn be ndibi be atoto lela kikɛ bee terge.
5Abeegboŋ bee gbuŋgbuŋ to
Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na be anishito nna,
nɛ abeebi bee ŋalga mbe anishito.
E baŋ lar a ba kasawule kikɛ bee gbuŋgbuŋ nna
nɛ durnya nɛ kumo be basa kikɛ e baa chicha.
6E baŋ nya agbo, esa kikɛ maaŋ pete.
Esa kikɛ maaŋ tiŋ ŋ gelge mbe agbogboŋ na.
Mbe agbo du fanɛ edɛ nna a pante afalta
nɛ a bee bure to a ki eshishɛr.
7Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na walɛ;
mo e naa kuŋ mbe basa tɔrɔ to,
nsaa keni bekama nɛ b yirda mo so.
8Ama e bee mur mo doŋana bre nna
fanɛ nchugboŋ ka jija asɔ na.
Mo alɛ naa yɛr bumo nɛ baa
ji mo emɔrɔ na luwu to nna.
9Amoso sa maa kre Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ ŋkre kulubi!
E bee mur mo doŋana cheche nna
nɛ b maŋ naa nya ekpa a bɛta a ba.
10Baaŋ baa du fanɛ besanuupo
nɛ b nuu nsa ga nɛ a pɔɔ bumo so nna;
ŋko ajinjɛ nɛ atuweklaŋ nɛ a mel abar to
nɛ edɛ chɔɔ amo m mur na nna.
11Esa ko nɛ e kɔ nfɛra lubi shi Ninɛve
be kadegboŋ to m ba kaa kre
Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na ŋkre lubi.
12Ama kusɔ nɛ Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na
bee kaŋɛ mbe basa Israɛlebi nde.
E yɛ: “Asiriyaebi be eleŋ nɛ bumo be keshi ere kikɛ
be kaman baaŋ mur nɛ esa maaŋ naŋ wu bumo.
N shin nɛ menyi, ma basa Israɛlebi, ji awurfoŋ,
ama ma alɛ maaŋ naŋ wora loŋ kikɛ.
13Meeŋ shin nɛ Asiriyaebi be eleŋ
nɛ baa ji menyi so na e ba ekar,
nɛ n tuge ŋgbɛlɛbi nɛ b ta ŋ kre menyi na to.”
14Ketande nɛ Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na nase
a laŋɛ Asiriyaebi be kaplɛa so nde.
E yɛ: “B maaŋ nya kaman to ebi nɛ baaŋ sɔ
bumo so n shin nɛ basa e baa nyiŋi bumo
a ti bumo be atre.
Meeŋ mur bumo be agbirana nɛ a wɔ
bumo be agbirlambuana to na.
Ma alɛ beeŋ kur Asiriyaebi be nchaŋana
n nase, ŋkpal manɛ so, b maŋ walɛ kikɛ.”
15Judaebi, men keni, kabɔ ko kɔ baru lela
n shi kebeegboŋ na so a ba!
Kayurwushi be baru nɛ e kɔ a ba.
Amoso men ji menyi be nchɛgboŋ nseŋ wora
m bɔlɔ nnɔ nɛ men nase n sa Ebɔrɛ na so.
Kumukpakpaso wuraana maaŋ naaŋ kɔ
n sɔ menyi be kasawule kikɛ, ŋkpal manɛ so,
b mur cheche kuraa.

english_text:
Nineveh Will Fall
1Nineveh, someone is coming
to attack and scatter you.
Guard your fortresses!
Watch the road! Be brave!
Prepare for battle!
2Judah and Israel are like trees
with branches broken
by their enemies.
But the Lord is going to restore
their power and glory.
* 3Nineveh, on this day of attack,
your enemies' shields are red;
their uniforms are crimson.
4Their horses prance,
and their armored chariots
dart around like lightning
or flaming torches.
5An officer gives a command.
But his soldiers stumble,
as they hasten to build
a shelter to protect themselves
against rocks thrown down
from the city wall.
6The river gates fly open,
and panic floods the palace.
7Nineveh is disgraced.
The queen is dragged off.
Her servant women mourn;
they moan like doves,
and they beat their breasts
in sorrow.
8Nineveh is like a pond
with leaking water.
Shouts of “Stop! Don't go!”
can be heard everywhere.
But everyone is leaving.
9Enemy soldiers shout,
“The city is full of treasure
and all kinds of wealth.
Steal her silver! Grab her gold!”
10Nineveh is doomed! Destroyed!
Her people tremble with fear;
their faces turn pale.
11What happened to this city?
They were safer there
than powerful lions in a den,
with no one to disturb them.
12These are the same lions
that ferociously attacked
their victims,
then dragged away the flesh
to feed their young.
13The Lord All-Powerful
is against you, Nineveh.
God will burn your chariots
and send an army to kill
those young lions of yours.
You will never again
make victims of others
or send messengers to threaten
everyone on this earth.
translation_text:
Ninɛve ka kɔ n tɔr be asheŋ
1Ninɛveebi, kena bee ba menyi so!
Eleŋ nɛ k beeŋ pesaŋ menyi to na teŋ fo m ba.
Men baa kuŋ menyi be mboŋ lempoana na,
nsaa de menyi be agbembi so nɛnɛ.
Men bela ase nɛnɛ a jo kena be kekɔ!
2Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ naa sha kelaŋɛ Israɛlebi
be kemaŋkura nɛ b daa kɔ pɔɛŋ nɛ bumo
doŋana ba kɔ n suge bumo be asɔ na
n sa bumo.
3Ninɛveebi, bedoŋ be benapo keta
abɛlso be asɔkuŋso peper nna,
nseŋ buu asɔbuuso peper.
Baa bela ase nɛ b ba kɔ kena nna!
Bumo be egbaŋɛturko bee nyɛkpɛ fanɛ edɛ,
ŋko fanɛ bɔrɛ ka nyɛkpɛ na nna,
amo alɛ nsaa shile kenishipereso a yɔ a ba
ashi kadegboŋ na be alɔnɛ so!
4Bumo be egbaŋɛturko bee nyɛkpɛ so nna
fanɛ edɛ be adondulombi na.
Nsaa ji ŋjɔŋ agbembi so,
a shile a yɔ a ba ashi kadegboŋ na be alɔnɛ so.
A bee nyɛkpɛ so nna fanɛ mbulpi ŋko
bɔrɛ ka nyɛkpɛ na.
5Benapo nimuso na ponte n tre benapo na;
nɛ b shil a fiti a ba.
Benapo na daa shil a yɔ egbal na ase nna
nɛ b ya pɔr kusɔ nɛ k beeŋ baa kuŋ ajembu gbɛgbɛso
nɛ bedoŋ beeŋ shi awɔlto ŋ gbelti n lɛ bumo so na.
6Ewurkpa na be mbunagboŋ nɛ e mata lɔr na
bugi nɛ nchu luri m bɔlɔ kumo kikɛ to nɛ k bure n tɔr.
7B pɛ ewurche na kenya n yɔ efuli pɔtɛ so,
nɛ mbe mbita bee shu fanɛ ali
nsaa ber ŋgbene so kagbenejijaso.
8Kadegboŋ nɛ baa tre Ninɛve na bure nna
nɛ kumo to be basa bee shile fanɛ kepa ka bɔlɔ m bu
nɛ kumo to be nchu bee shile na.
Beko bee ponte a kaŋɛ: “Yili! Yili!”
Ama ekama maŋ yili nseŋ bɛta a ba.
9Nɛ bedoŋ be benapo na bee ponte a kaŋɛ:
“Men baa muu eshuwa nɛ egbiti na!
Ŋkpal manɛ so, kadegboŋ na to kɔ asɔ lela ga!”
10Ninɛve bure nɛ kumo to be basa shile n lar kumo to;
nɛ ki kade bureso a dese fuloŋ,
nɛ shɛŋ maŋ naa wɔ kumo to!
Nɛ kufugboŋ tɔr basa so nɛ baa chicha.
Bumo be eleŋ kikɛ loge;
nɛ bumo be anishiakpa ki foleebi.
11Naniere nnɛ nɛ Ninɛve nɛ k daa du
fanɛ ebuluŋ be kelaŋ na naa wɔ?
K daa du fanɛ kakpa nɛ ebuluŋ nyɛnso nɛ becheso kikɛ
beeŋ lar ŋ ka bumo be bibi nɛ shɛŋ maaŋ wora bumo nna.
12Buluŋ na bee pɛ kusɔbɔya nɛ e nya nna,
nseŋ gbeye kumo n ya sa mo barkasa
nɛ bibi nɛ b ji m moɛ.
13Nɛ Enyɛnpetale Ebɔrɛ na kaŋɛ:
“Ninɛveebi, men ki ma doŋana nna na,
meeŋ chɔɔ menyi be egbaŋɛturko
nseŋ shin nɛ b mɔ menyi be benapo kena to.
Ma alɛ beeŋ naŋ shin nɛ b sɔ asɔ nɛ men suge beko kutɔ na,
ekama malɛ maaŋ tuge menyi be mbɔ kikɛ.”

english_text:
Punishment for Nineveh
The Lord said:
1Doom to the crime capital!
Nineveh, city of murder
and treachery,
2here is your fate—
cracking whips,
churning wheels;
galloping horses,
roaring chariots;
3cavalry attacking,
swords and spears flashing;
soldiers stumbling
over piles of dead bodies.
4You were nothing more
than a prostitute
using your magical charms
and witchcraft
to attract and trap nations.
5But I, the Lord All-Powerful,
am now your enemy.
I will pull up your skirt
and let nations and kingdoms
stare at your nakedness.
6I will cover you with garbage,
treat you like trash,
and rub you in the dirt.
7Everyone who sees you
will turn away and shout,
“Nineveh is done for!
Is anyone willing to mourn
or to give her comfort?”
Nineveh's Fate Is Sealed
8Nineveh, do you feel safer
than the city of Thebes?
The Nile River
was its wall of defense.
9Thebes trusted the mighty power
of Ethiopia and Egypt;
the nations of Put and Libya
were her allies.
10But she was captured and taken
to a foreign country.
Her children were murdered
at every street corner.
The members of her royal family
were auctioned off,
and her high officials
were bound in chains.
11Nineveh, now it's your turn!
You will get drunk and try to hide
from your enemy.
12Your fortresses are fig trees
with ripe figs.
Merely shake the trees,
and fruit will fall
into every open mouth.
13Your army is weak.
Fire has destroyed the crossbars
on your city gates;
now they stand wide open
to your enemy.
14Your city is under attack.
Haul in extra water!
Strengthen your defenses!
Start making bricks!
Stir the mortar!
15You will still go up in flames
and be cut down by swords
that will wipe you out like a field
attacked by grasshoppers.
So, go ahead and increase
like a swarm of locusts!
16More merchants are in your city
than there are stars
in the sky—
but they are like locusts
that eat everything,
then fly away.
17Your guards and your officials
are swarms of locusts.
On a chilly day
they settle on a fence,
but when the sun comes out,
they take off
to who-knows-where.
18King of Assyria,
your officials and leaders
are sound asleep,
while your people are scattered
in the mountains.
Yes, your people are sheep
without a shepherd.
19You're fatally wounded.
There's no hope for you.
But everyone claps
when they hear this news,
because your constant cruelty
has caused them pain.
translation_text:
1Asheŋ maaŋ nyalɛ n sa kadegboŋ
nɛ bemɔpo nɛ befɛpo nɛ kapuni
bɔlɔ kumo to na.
2Kusɔ nɛ k beeŋ ba kumo so nde:
Achuchɔ beeŋ gbelge kumo basa so,
nɛ ekama e nu egbaŋɛ nɛ egbaŋɛturko be eshile
be egbri nɛ a beeŋ sɔ kumo kikɛ to na.
3Egbaŋɛdiipo beeŋ nyaŋɛto a fili etokobi
nɛ akpa to nɛ a baa nyɛkpɛ kaplɛkama.
Basa damta beeŋ wu m biti abar so
nɛ esa maaŋ tiŋ ŋ karga basa wuso na.
Basa beeŋ baa fiti bubuni na a tɔr!
4Kasogberge nɛ k beeŋ ba Ninɛve so,
ŋkpal kesakalea damta nɛ k bɔlɔ kumo to,
nɛ kegbaya nɛ b ta m pɛ efuli damtaana so
be basa ŋ ki bumo be anya na so.
5Ade be kaman nɛ Enyɛnpetale Ebɔrɛ na kaŋɛ:
“Ŋ ki fo, Ninɛve, mo doŋ nna na.
Meeŋ delge fo so nɛ efuli pɔtɛana na
e wu fo kesaria nɛ nyɔmɔ e pɛ fo.
6Meeŋ shin nɛ fo ki kusɔ jiga
nɛ kusɔyurpi;
nɛ kumo be loŋ e chinchiŋ basa,
nseŋ pɛ bumo kufu.
7Bekama nɛ baaŋ wu fo
beeŋ shile fo nseŋ kaŋɛ le:
‘Ninɛve e bure a dese na,
wanɛ e naŋ shu n sa mo?
Nnɛ nɛ meeŋ nya esa nɛ e lolo mo?’ ”
8To, Ninɛve, fo maŋ bɔ Ijipt
be efuli so be kadegboŋ
nɛ baa tre Tebes, nɛ Nail be Lɔr na
daa kuŋ kumo fanɛ egbal na.
9Itiopia nɛ Ijipt be efuliana
be eleŋ nɛ kade na
daa fute a yige so.
Libiya nɛ kasawule nɛ baa tre
Put na e daa la kumo teriana
nɛ a chɛ kumo to.
10Ama bedoŋ daŋ ba kɔ Tebes nseŋ pɛ kumo
be basa n yɔ efuli pɔtɛ so.
B daŋ mɔ bumo be mbia nna n nase agbembi so
be kukɔlɔ kama so.
B daŋ to beri nna m barga bumo be benimugboŋ
nɛ b ta ŋgbɛlɛbi ŋ kre na to n sa abar.
11Ninɛve, fo alɛ gba beeŋ nuu nsa m boo m baŋ so nseŋ shile fo doŋana so n ya ŋana m mɔlga fo kumu. 12Fo mboŋ lempo nɛ a bee kuŋ fo kikɛ beeŋ ki fanɛ figi be ndibi nɛ a kɔ asɔrso nɛ a bel m pere. B baŋ gbaŋgbaŋ ndibi na asɔrso na bee tɔr kɔnɔ kama nɛ k bugi a yil to nna. 13Fo benapo du fanɛ beche nna nɛ shɛŋ malɛ maa kuŋ fo kasawule na ashi fo doŋana be enɔ to. Edɛ beeŋ chɔɔ ndibi nɛ baa ta a ber fo mbunagboŋ so na. 14Men saŋ nchu n yili menyi be enɔ so, ŋkpal manɛ so benapo beeŋ ba kulti menyi n wɔtɔ a sha kekɔ menyi kena. Amoso men baga eshii n lɔŋɛ menyi be mboŋ lempoana na m pɔr. 15Kanaŋkama nɛ men wora, edɛ e naŋ chɔɔ menyi m mɔ ŋko kena to nɛ menyeeŋ wu. Baaŋ mur menyi fanɛ kananɛ elotɔr bee ji asɔduu a mur na. Men salga fanɛ alonte ŋko elotɔr nna! 16Menyi be eyawujipo wora keshi a chɔ achɛkpabi nɛ a wɔ awɔlto ere, ama bumo kikɛ beeŋ mur n choŋ fanɛ kananɛ elotɔr bee ji asɔ a mur nsaa firgi a yɔ na nna. 17Menyi be bekumpo nɛ ekrachi kikɛ du fanɛ elotɔr nɛ a mel abar so egbal so awo be kachɛ nna. Ama epeŋi baŋ lar, nɛ b firgi n choŋ. Esa kikɛ malɛ maa pin kakpa nɛ e bee firgi a yɔ.
18Asiriya be Ewurgboŋ, fo gomena be benimuana kikɛ wu, nɛ fo ekrachigboŋ dese a di nsaa maaŋ naaŋ tiŋi kikɛ! Fo basa pesaŋ to a wɔ abeegboŋ so. Esa kikɛ malɛ maŋ wɔtɔ nɛ e naŋ shin nɛ b bɛta m ba epe. 19Kudur kikɛ maŋ wɔtɔ nɛ k tiŋ n chɛ ebesa nɛ doro nɛ a wɔ fo to ere. Ekama nɛ e nu fo kemur be kubɔya ere, bee kpla enɔ kagbenefuliso nna ŋkpal ebesa nɛ b ji ŋkpal fo kumukpakpaso so.

english_text:
1I am Habakkuk the prophet. And this is the message that the Lord gave me.
Habakkuk Complains to the Lord
2Our Lord, how long must I beg
for your help
before you listen?
How long before you save us
from all this violence?
3Why do you make me watch
such terrible injustice?
Why do you allow violence,
lawlessness, crime, and cruelty
to spread everywhere?
4Laws cannot be enforced;
justice is always the loser;
criminals crowd out honest people
and twist the laws around.
The Lord Answers Habakkuk
5 Look and be amazed
at what's happening
among the nations!
Even if you were told,
you would never believe
what's taking place now.
6 I am sending the Babylonians.
They are fierce and cruel—
marching across the land,
conquering cities and towns.
7How fearsome and frightening.
Their only laws and rules
are the ones they make up.
8Their cavalry troops are faster
than leopards,
more ferocious than wolves
hunting at sunset,
and swifter than hungry eagles
suddenly swooping down.
9They are eager to destroy,
and they gather captives
like handfuls of sand.
10They make fun of rulers
and laugh at fortresses,
while building dirt mounds
so they can capture cities.
11Then suddenly they disappear
like a gust of wind—
those sinful people who worship
their own strength.
Habakkuk Complains Again
12Holy Lord God, mighty rock,
you are eternal,
and we are safe from death.
You are using those Babylonians
to judge and punish others.
13But you can't stand sin or wrong.
So don't sit by in silence
while they gobble up people
who are better than they are.
14The people you put on this earth
are like fish or reptiles
without a leader.
15Then an enemy comes along
and takes them captive
with hooks and nets.
It makes him so happy
16that he offers sacrifices
to his fishing nets,
because they make him rich
and provide choice foods.
17Will he keep hauling in his nets
and destroying nations
without showing mercy?
translation_text:
1Kubɔya nɛ Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ lara ŋ ŋini anebi Habakuk nde.
Habakuk ka fubel ŋ ŋini Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ be asheŋ
2O, Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ, ale afanɛ bre nɛ meeŋ kule fo pɔɛŋ nɛ fo nu nseŋ mɔlga ma ashi basa nɛ baa nyaŋɛto a wɔtɔ basa na be enɔ to? 3Manɛ nna nɛ fo shin nɛ n wu le be tɔrɔ ere? Nuso nɛ feeŋ tiŋ n nya kagbene a keni le be alubi ere? Kemur nɛ keŋkenshi be kebaawɔtɔ e kulti ma n wɔtɔ nɛ kebri nɛ katege malɛ sɔ kaplɛkama. 4Mbra na maŋ kɔ eleŋ nɛ tɔnɔ kikɛ. Ekama malɛ maa ji asheŋ nɛ amo be ekpa so. Basa lubi e naa ji a bri basa niŋiso a shin nɛ kashenteŋji maŋ naa wɔtɔ.
Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ ka tuge Habakuk to be asheŋ
5Ndoŋ nna nɛ Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na kaŋɛ mbe basa le: “Men dara efuli pɔtɛana nɛ a kulti menyi na ŋ keni. Kusɔ nɛ menyeeŋ wu na beeŋ mɔ menyi kɔnɔ alegaiso. Meeŋ wora kusɔ ko menyi be jemanɛ to, nɛ men nu kumo gba menyi maaŋ yirda. 6Meeŋ shin nɛ Babilɔnebi nɛ b la ŋgbene kpakpasowuraana a maa ŋana shɛŋ nsaa maŋ kɔ kechena n wushi kikɛ na e ji eleŋ. Baa lar nna a ba nɛ b ba kɔ durnya be kasawule kama so be basa kena. 7Bekama bee ŋana bumo nna nɛ bumo be asheŋ malɛ bee keta kufu ga. Bumo gbagba be mbraana nɛ atande nɛ baa bɛ so.
8Bumo be egbaŋɛ bee shile a chɔ ekarmɛ nsaa keta kufu malɛ a chɔ ekuntuŋ nɛ akoŋ kɔ. Bumo be egbaŋɛdiipoana shi mboŋ wɔfɔ nna nɛ bumo be egbaŋɛ bee shile a pulgi kasawule a ba eleŋso fanɛ kusore ka firgi n yuu kusɔ jisoso na.
9Bumo be benapo nyaŋɛto nna a ba basa be kemur to nɛ kufugboŋ tɔr bekama nɛ baa kɔ na so. Basa nɛ baa kɔ a pɛ a ki anya na shi alegaiso nna fanɛ eshishɛr na. 10Baa keni bewuraana jiga nna nsaa mushe ekrachigboŋ. Egbal ŋko ebu lempo jeŋgreŋ kikɛ maaŋ tiŋ ŋ kuŋ bumo ekpa. Baa koli eshishɛr nna a deŋi abar so amo be mman a bɔla so a dii a luri ndeana to a kɔ amo to be basa kena. 11Kumo be kaman nɛ b choŋ fanɛ afu na. Bumo be eleŋ du fanɛ kegbir be eleŋ nna n sa bumo nɛ baa bunyaŋ kumo.”
Habakuk ka fubel ŋ ŋini Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ be asheŋ
12O Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ, fo la Ebɔrɛ nna sososo na kikɛ. Fo e la ma Ebɔrɛ nɛ fo du cheembi nsaa wɔtɔ mbaanaayɔ. Enyɛnpe, ma Ebɔrɛ nɛ ma ekumpo, fo e lara Babilɔnebi na n shin nɛ b nya eleŋ saŋɛ na so baaŋ gberge anyi kusoe. 13Ama fo maaŋ tiŋ a keni nɛ kulubi e baa wora a yɔ. Fo anishi du cheembi ga nɛ a baa wu asheŋ lubi. Ama fo wora shruum a keni basa lubi nɛ b maŋ kɔ yirda ere nɛ baa mur basa nɛ b niŋi a chɔ bumo.
14Fo shin nɛ edimɛdi ki fanɛ ekɔrɔtɔ ŋko nchu to be asɔ keniso nɛ a maŋ kɔ bejuŋkparpo na. 15Babilɔnebi na bee pɛ edimɛdi nna fanɛ b ka ta edariwa ŋko ashewu m pɛ ekɔrɔtɔ n dii kedeŋi so nsaa cha awɔr kagbenefuliso na. 16Baa bunyaŋ bumo be ashewu nna nsaa lara esarga a sa amo, ŋkpal b ka bee bɔla ashewu na so a dii kedama nsaa nya ajibi lela a ji so.
17Ama b baa kraa mɔ basa fanɛ b ka bee to bumo ashewu na nsaa mur efuliana na a maa wu basa kuwɔr a?

english_text:
The Lord Answers Habakkuk Again
1While standing guard
on the watchtower,
I waited for the Lord's answer,
before explaining the reason
for my complaint.
2Then the Lord told me:
“I will give you my message
in the form of a vision.
Write it clearly enough
to be read at a glance.
3 At the time I have decided,
my words will come true.
You can trust what I say
about the future.
It may take a long time,
but keep on waiting—
it will happen!
4 “I, the Lord, refuse to accept
anyone who is proud.
Only those who live by faith
are acceptable to me.”
Trouble for Evil People
5Wine is treacherous,
and arrogant people
are never satisfied.
They are no less greedy
than death itself—
they open their mouths as wide
as the world of the dead
and swallow everyone.
6But they will be mocked
with these words:
You're doomed!
You stored up stolen goods
and cheated others
of what belonged to them.
7But without warning,
those you owe
will demand payment.
Then you will become
a frightened victim.
8You robbed cities and nations
everywhere on earth
and murdered their people.
Now those who survived
will be as cruel to you.
9You're doomed!
You made your family rich
at the expense of others.
You even said to yourself,
“I'm above the law.”
10But you will bring shame
on your family
and ruin to yourself
for what you did to others.
11The very stones and wood
in your home
will testify against you.
12You're doomed! You built a city
on crime and violence.
13 But the Lord All-Powerful
sends up in flames
what nations and people
work so hard to gain.
14 Just as water fills the sea,
the land will be filled
with people who know
and honor the Lord.
15You're doomed!
You get your friends drunk,
just to see them naked.
16Now you will be disgraced
instead of praised.
The Lord will make you drunk,
and when others see you naked,
you will lose their respect.
17You destroyed trees and animals
on Mount Lebanon;
you were ruthless to towns
and people everywhere.
Now you will be terrorized.
Idolatry Is Foolish
18What is an idol worth?
It's merely a false god.
Why trust a speechless image
made from wood or metal
by human hands?
19What can you learn from idols
covered with silver or gold?
They can't even breathe.
Pity anyone who says to an idol
of wood or stone,
“Get up and do something!”
20Let all the world be silent—
the Lord is present
in his holy temple.
translation_text:
Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ ka tuge Habakuk be kamalga to be asheŋ
1Meeŋ dii n yili egbal lempo jeŋgreŋ nɛ b pɔr ŋ kulti kadegboŋ na so a jo kusɔ nɛ Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na beeŋ tuge pɔɛŋ nɛ m bugi to ŋ kaŋɛ kusɔ nɛ k ba nɛ mee fubel.
2Ndoŋ nna nɛ Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na kaŋɛ ma le: “Sibɛ kusɔ kama nɛ meeŋ lara ŋ ŋini fo n deŋi ajembu peŋgeleŋ peŋgelembi so nɛnɛ, saŋɛ na so basa beeŋ baa wu amo a kraŋ manaŋ manaŋ. 3Ŋkpal manɛ so, kelaraŋŋini ere bee jo kumo be jemanɛ nna. Kusɔ nɛ k beeŋ wora lalaloge be nchɛ to na be asheŋ nɛ k bee ji. Kumo alɛ maaŋ baa la efɛsheŋ kikɛ. Kewora fanɛ k bee chɛr nna, ama baa kraa jo. Kanaŋ kama nɛ asheŋ du k beeŋ wora m bɔlɔ so.
4Kubɔya na nde: ‘Bekama nɛ baa wora asheŋ lubi maaŋ ji efute, ama bekama nɛ bumo be kebaawɔtɔ niŋi na beeŋ baa wɔ ŋkpa to ŋkpal b ka bee ji kashenteŋ a sa Ebɔrɛ so.’ ”
Asheŋ ka maaŋ nyalɛ n sa basa lubi be asheŋ
5Kedamaya bre bee fule esa nna. Kejimuniwuraana bee wu bumo be amu nna ga, bumo alɛ maa wushi kikɛ. B du fanɛ luwu nɛ k maa mɔ a moɛ nna. Amoso b baŋ kɔ m pɔɔ efuli ko so n sɔ kumo, b naa yɔ kenyɔsopo so nna. 6Basa nɛ b kɔ n tɔr na bee melgi belempo nɛ b pɔɔ bumo so na nna a kaŋɛ le: “Asɔ nɛ e maŋ la menyi peya nɛ menyee suge. Asheŋ maaŋ nyalɛ n sa menyi kikɛ! Menyi maaŋ tiŋ n tintiŋ menyi be akɔjipoana n sɔ akɔ nɛ b ji menyi n dii kedama!”
7Ama pɔɛŋ nɛ menyi nɛ menyee kɔ a pɔɔ beko so na e pin nɛ men ji akɔ m muni kubɔ nɛ b tintiŋ menyi nɛ men ka amo nɛ nchu m bɔlɔ so. Saŋɛ na so nɛ menyi alɛ gba e ki beko be akɔjipoana nɛ b baa suge menyi be asɔ. 8Men ta eleŋsheŋ n suge efuli damtaana be basa be asɔ nseŋ m mɔ bumo be basa. Ama naniere bumo be basa nɛ b ji efute gba beeŋ ta eleŋsheŋ n suge menyi be asɔ ŋkpal basa damta nɛ men mɔ nɛ nsawule nɛ ndegboŋana nɛ men mur durnya ere to so.
9Asheŋ maaŋ nyalɛ n sa menyi ŋkpal men ka ta eleŋsheŋ n suge asɔ n shin nɛ menyi be nnaŋ to ebi dii dama nɛ tɔrɔ kikɛ maa ba menyi be elaŋ to ebi so so! 10Ama ŋkpal kusɔ nɛ men wora beko na so, menyeeŋ bar ŋaba menyi be nnaŋ to ebi so nseŋ shin nɛ kemur e ba menyi gbagba so. 11Menyi be nwu be egbalana be ebirkesi nɛ eyɔri gba bee shu a gbiti menyi nna.
12Asheŋ maaŋ nyalɛ n sa menyi, ŋkpal men ka ta kulubi n tɔl menyi be kadegboŋ nseŋ ta basa be kamɔ m pɔr kumo n ya loge so. 13Efuliana nɛ men daŋ kɔ m pɔɔ so na be basa daŋ shuŋ ŋ gben jiga hale a bɛlɛ nna. Asɔ nɛ b gben m pɔr na kikɛ ji edɛ. Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ e shin nɛ loŋ wora na. 14Ama kananɛ teku baŋ bɔlɔ nchu n sɔ kaplɛkama a dese na, aloŋ nɛ basa be kebaanyi Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na be kemaŋkura be asheŋ beeŋ ba sɔ kasawule ere kikɛ so.
15Asheŋ maaŋ nyalɛ n sa menyi nɛ menyee kaa sa menyi braana nsa nɛ baa nuu a boo a baŋ so nsaa ŋaba bumo be amu nɛ menyee keni bumo be kesaria na. 16Aloŋ nɛ menyi alɛ gba be kemaŋkura beeŋ ki ŋaba n sa menyi. Men gbagba beeŋ nuu nsa m boo m baŋ so a nite a jante. Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na e naŋ shin nɛ men ki basa booso a delgeso a nite basa to nɛ menyi be bunyaŋ e ki anishinyɔr. 17Men ku Lebanɔn be kupo to be ndibi n lɛ, naniere baaŋ ku menyi alɛ gba n lɛ. Men mɔ kumo to be asɔbɔya kikɛ nɛ naniere asɔbɔya bee funti menyi. Ŋkpal basa damta nɛ men mɔ nɛ nsawule nɛ ndegboŋana nɛ men mur durnya ere to so nɛ asheŋ ere beeŋ ba menyi so.
18Kegbir maŋ kɔ tɔnɔ kikɛ. Dimɛdi e pɔr ŋko n shɛl kumo. Efɛsheŋ nawule nɛ k bee ŋini. Nɛ manɛ so nɛ menyee yirda kusɔ nɛ b ta kebɛlso ŋko kedibi n lɔŋɛ nɛ k maa malga? 19Asheŋ maaŋ nyalɛ n sa menyi nɛ menyee kaŋɛ kedibi ŋko kejembu fanɛ k koso n sɔ nchu n nuu na. Kegbir beeŋ tiŋ n lara kesheŋ ko ŋ ŋini fo a? Baaŋ tiŋ n ta shuwa ŋko gbiti ŋ gbiti kumo, ama k kraa maŋ kɔ ŋkpa.
20Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na bre wɔ mbe bɔrɛlambu cheembi to nna, amoso ekama e wora shruum mbe anishito ashi kasawule ere so.

english_text:
Habakkuk's Prayer
1This is my prayer:
2I know your reputation, Lord,
and I am amazed
at what you have done.
Please turn from your anger
and be merciful;
do for us what you did
for our ancestors.
3You are the same Holy God
who came from Teman
and Paran to help us.
The brightness of your glory
covered the heavens,
and your praises were heard
everywhere on earth.
4Your glory shone like the sun,
and light flashed from your hands,
hiding your mighty power.
5Dreadful diseases and plagues
marched in front
and followed behind.
6When you stopped,
the earth shook;
when you stared,
nations trembled;
when you walked
along your ancient paths,
eternal mountains and hills
crumbled and collapsed.
7The tents of desert tribes
in Cushan and Midian
were ripped apart.
8Our Lord, were you angry
with the monsters
of the deep?
You attacked in your chariot
and wiped them out.
9Your arrows were ready
and obeyed your commands.
You split the earth apart
with rivers and streams;
10mountains trembled
at the sight of you;
rain poured from the clouds;
ocean waves roared and rose.
11The sun and moon stood still,
while your arrows and spears
flashed like lightning.
12In your furious anger,
you trampled on nations
13to rescue your people
and save your chosen one.
You crushed a nation's ruler
and stripped his evil kingdom
of its power.
14His troops had come like a storm,
hoping to scatter us
and glad to gobble us up.
To them we were refugees
in hiding—
but you smashed their heads
with their own weapons.
15Then your chariots churned
the waters of the sea.
Habakkuk's Response to God's Message
16When I heard this message,
I felt weak from fear,
and my lips quivered.
My bones seemed to melt,
and I stumbled around.
But I will patiently wait.
Someday those vicious enemies
will be struck by disaster.
Trust in a Time of Trouble
17Fig trees may no longer bloom,
or vineyards produce grapes;
olive trees may be fruitless,
and harvest time a failure;
sheep pens may be empty,
and cattle stalls vacant—
18but I will still celebrate
because the Lord God
is my Savior.
19 The Lord gives me strength.
He makes my feet as sure
as those of a deer,
and he helps me stand
on the mountains.
To the music director:
Use stringed instruments.
translation_text:
Habakuk be kabɔrɛkule be asheŋ
1Kabɔrɛkule nɛ anebi Habakuk kule nde.
2O Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ, n nu kusɔ nɛ fo wora,
nɛ k mɔ ma kɔnɔ nsaa keta ma kufu.
Naniere naŋ wora asheŋgboŋ nɛ fo daŋ wora
n sa an nanaana na,
anyi alɛ gba be jemanɛ ere to.
Hale nɛ fo nya agbo gba,
fo baa nyiŋi fo kuwɔrwu na.
3Fo e la Ebɔrɛ cheembi nɛ fo shi kadegboŋ
nɛ baa tre Tɛman ashi Edɔm be keshishɛrsawule so
nɛ kebee nɛ baa tre Paran na so a ba na.
Fo kela nɛ kemaŋkura parga to m buu esoso kikɛ so nna,
nɛ fo kapandi malɛ sɔ kasawule so be kaplɛkama.
4Fo kemaŋkura bee nyɛkpɛ nna fanɛ epeŋi,
nɛ kumo be kefulto bee shi fo enɔana to,
kakpa nɛ fo eleŋgboŋ ŋana a wɔ na.
5Fo e naa shuŋi kulɔ nɛ e bee juŋkpar,
nsaa ponte luwu so nɛ k bee bɛ kumo so na.
6Fo baŋ shir n yili, kasawule bee gbuŋgbuŋ nna,
fo alɛ baŋ gbɛ ŋ keni malɛ efuliana na bee chicha nna.
Dradra be abeegboŋ nɛ abeebi kikɛ bure to n tɔr.
Ama fo ere wɔtɔ nna mbaanaayɔ!
7N wu kufu ka pɛ Kushan be yiri to ebi,
nɛ Midia be yiri to be basa malɛ bee chicha.
8O Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ, elɔrana e daŋ shin nɛ fo nya agbo a?
Teku e daŋ shin nɛ fo kagbene kaa alegaiso a?
Abɔrɛwɔlpa nɛ a bee bar bɔrɛfugboŋ na so nɛ fo chena
fanɛ gbaŋɛturko na m bar kekɔmpɔɔso m ba sa fo basa.
9Fo daŋ bela fo keta ase nna
nseŋ wora shiriya nɛ fo to fo atanyembi.
Fo ta elɔr nɛ mbombi
m baŋɛ kasawule to.
10Abeegboŋana na ka wu fo nɛ a gbuŋgbuŋ to;
nɛ bɔrɛchu shi awɔlpa so n wurge to.
Ndoŋ nna nɛ echɛtabo baga to,
nɛ amo to be nchu bɔlɔ n dii kepla.
11Jemanɛ nɛ fo atanyembi nɛ akpaana
bee kpa edɛ a firgi a choŋ na,
nɛ epeŋi nɛ kufɔl malɛ daa yil diim awɔlto.
12Fo daŋ nya agbo nna a nite a kulti kasawule so,
nseŋ daŋ kaa kagbene alegaiso a chichi efuliana na so.
13Fo lar m ba nna nɛ fo ba mɔlga fo basa,
nɛ fo ewura laraso.
Fo ŋmɛa amukpakpasowuraana be ejuŋkparpo n lɛ,
nseŋ mur basa nɛ b bɛ mo so na cheche.
14Mbe benapo daŋ yarase fanɛ bɔrɛfugboŋ nna m ba,
a tama fanɛ baaŋ pesaŋ anyi to nseŋ mur anyi
nɛ bumo be ŋgbene e fuli bumo.
Bumo ere kutɔ an la basa jiga
nɛ baa shile a ŋana bumo so nna.
Ama bumo gbagba be akɔsɔ nɛ fo ta
m bure bumo be amu to.
15Fo gbagba be egbaŋɛ nɛ fo ta
n fɔnɔ teku be nchuana to nɛ e kaa kupɔpɔ.
16Ŋ ka nu ade kikɛ be asheŋ nɛ kufu pɛ ma;
hale nɛ ma kɔnɔ bee chicha.
Ma eyur daŋ yuri ma nna nɛ awo dii ma
nɛ n fara a fiti a fiti jijiga.
Ama meeŋ ji kanyiti n jo
kachɛ nɛ Ebɔrɛ beeŋ gberge efuli
nɛ k bee kɔ anyi kena na kusoe.
17Hale nɛ figi be ndibi maŋ sɔr gba,
nɛ afeelebi nɛ baa tre greeps na maŋ kɔ asɔrso;
hale nɛ ɔlif be ndibi maŋ sɔr shɛŋ,
nɛ adɔsawule maŋ wora ajibi gba;
hale nɛ kubolpɔ koŋwule gba maŋ naa wɔtɔ,
nɛ kena koŋwule maŋ naa wɔ kenalu to gba,
18ŋ kraa beeŋ shin nɛ ma kagbene e fuli ma,
ŋkpal Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na ka la ma emɔlgapo so.
19Enyɛnpetale Ebɔrɛ na e naa sa ma eleŋ,
nsaa shin nɛ mee mur aya fanɛ shantaŋ,
a tiŋ a nite abee to.

english_text:
1 I am Zephaniah, the son of Cushi, the grandson of Gedaliah, the great-grandson of Amariah, and the great-great-grandson of Hezekiah.
When Josiah son of Amon was king of Judah, the Lord gave me this message.
Judgment on Judah
2I, the Lord, now promise
to destroy everything
on this earth—
3people and animals,
birds and fish.
Everyone who is evil
will crash to the ground,
and I will wipe out
the entire human race.
4I will reach out to punish
Judah and Jerusalem—
nothing will remain
of the god Baal;
nothing will be remembered
of his pagan priests.
5Not a trace will be found
of those who worship stars
from their rooftops,
or bow down to the god Milcom,
while claiming loyalty
to me, the Lord.
6Nothing will remain of anyone
who has turned away
and rejected me.
7Be silent! I am the Lord God,
and the time is near.
I am preparing
to sacrifice my people
and to invite my guests.
8On that day I will punish
national leaders
and sons of the king,
along with all who follow
foreign customs.
9I will punish worshipers
of pagan gods
and cruel palace officials
who abuse their power.
10I, the Lord, promise
that on that day
noisy crying will be heard
from Fish Gate, New Town,
and Upper Hills.
11Everyone in Lower Hollow
will mourn loudly,
because merchants
and money changers
will be wiped out.
12I'll search Jerusalem with lamps
and punish those people
who sit there unworried
while thinking,
“The Lord won't do anything,
good or bad.”
13Their possessions will be taken,
their homes left in ruins.
They won't get to live
in the houses they build,
or drink wine from the grapes
in their own vineyards.
A Terrible Day
14The great day of the Lord
is coming soon, very soon.
On that terrible day,
fearsome shouts of warriors
will be heard everywhere.
15It will be a time of anger—
of trouble and torment,
of disaster and destruction,
of darkness and despair,
of storm clouds and shadows,
16of trumpet calls
and battle cries
against fortified cities
and mighty fortresses.
17The Lord warns everyone
who has sinned against him,
“I'll strike you blind!
Then your blood and your insides
will gush out like vomit.
18Not even your silver or gold
can save you on that day
when I, the Lord, am angry.
My anger will flare up
like a furious fire
scorching the earth
and everyone on it.”
translation_text:
1Jemanɛ nɛ Ammɔn pibinyɛn Josaya daa la Juda be ewura na, nɛ Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na ta kubɔya ere n sa Zefanaiya nɛ e la Kushi pibinyɛn na. Kushi mo tuto e daa la Gedaliya nɛ mo alɛ mo tuto daa la ewura Hɛzekaya pibinyɛn Amariya.
Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ be demujiachɛ na be asheŋ
2Le nɛ Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na daŋ kaŋɛ: “Meeŋ shin nɛ kusɔ kikɛ e mur kasawule so. 3Ma alɛ beeŋ mur edimɛdi nɛ asɔbɔya nɛ mbuibi nɛ ekɔrɔtɔ kikɛ. Meeŋ bar basa lubi kaseto nseŋ mur nyiŋgbasa kikɛ kasawule ere so. Esa kikɛ maaŋ pete. Ma, Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na e kaŋɛ na.
4Meeŋ gberge Jerusalɛm to nɛ Juda be efuli so be basa kikɛ kusoe. Meeŋ mur kegbir nɛ baa tre Baal na be kushuŋ kikɛ ashi ndoŋ nɛ ekama maaŋ naaŋ nyiŋi kegbirwura nɛ e daa keni kumo so na gba kuraa. 5Ma alɛ beeŋ mur bekama nɛ baa dii achoŋi so n ya kaa jɔŋɛ epeŋi nɛ kufɔl nɛ achɛkpabi ase a bunyaŋ amo na. Kumo be kaman nɛ n mur bekama nɛ baa bunyaŋ ma a kaŋɛ fanɛ ma e wɔ bumo, ama nsaa ta kegbir nɛ baa tre Mɔlɛk na be ketre a bɔ ntaŋ na gba. 6Meeŋ mur bekama nɛ b pal kaman n sa ma nseŋ kini ma kutɔ be kebaa ba nɛ m baa ŋini bumo ekpa na gba.”
7Men wora shruum ashi Enyɛnpetale Ebɔrɛ na be anishito, ŋkpal manɛ so, mbe demujiachɛ na taga to. E bela ase nɛ e ta mbe basa n lara sarga nseŋ kela n tre bedoŋ fanɛ b ba kɔ Juda kena n suge bumo be asɔ eleŋ so. 8Kumo be kaman nɛ Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na naŋ kaŋɛ le: “Loŋ be kachɛ na, meeŋ gberge efuli na be benimuana na nɛ ewura be bibinyɛn nɛ bekama nɛ baa bɛ befɔ be edaŋkaresheŋ so na kikɛ kusoe.” 9Meeŋ gberge bekama nɛ baa shuŋ nnyamase be agbir nɛ bekama nɛ baa yuri nsaa mɔ basa a sɔ asɔ a bɔlɔ bumo be agbir be ebuana na kusoe.
10Kede be kaman nɛ Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na naŋ kaŋɛ: “Loŋ be kachɛ na, menyeeŋ nu kushu damta ashi Jerusalɛm be kabunagboŋ nɛ baa tre Kɔrɔtɔ na ase. Menyi kraa beeŋ nu b kaa bee boŋ to awɔrso ashi kadegboŋ na to be echenakpa popɔr na nseŋ nu awɔrgboŋ ko fanɛ asɔ ka tɔr m bure na ashi abee so. 11Menyi nɛ men wɔ kegbɛto be kebonfu so na e baa boŋ to a shu ga, ŋkpal manɛ so, menyi be eyawujipoana maŋ naa wɔtɔ. Bekama nɛ baa ta gbiti a ji yawu na beeŋ mur cheche.
12Kumo be jemanɛ so, meeŋ chɔɔ fitila so n nite ŋ keni Jerusalɛm to n fin bekama nɛ asheŋ maŋ tir bumo nɛ baa kaŋɛ fanɛ Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na maaŋ wora kulubi ŋko kelela na, nseŋ gberge bumo kusoe. 13Basa pɔtɛ beeŋ suge bumo be asɔ lela kikɛ nseŋ bure bumo be nwu. B maaŋ nya n chena nwu nɛ bumo gbagba pɔr to ŋko n nya bumo be ndibisɔrso be asɔrso nɛ baa tre greeps na be nsa n nuu.”
14Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ be kachɛgboŋ na taga to. K fo n loge gba kuraa! K beeŋ baa la kachɛ lubi nɛ benapo lempo nɛ b kɔ kenyɛn ga gba beeŋ baa boŋ to a shu kenishipereso nna. 15Kamɔnchɛ na beeŋ baa la agbo lubi nɛ etɔrɔ nɛ kayurnyaŋ damta nɛ ebesa nɛ kemur nɛ tentembiri mina nɛ awɔlpa be kebuuso be kachɛ nna. 16Kumo alɛ beeŋ naa la kachɛ nɛ kena to be mbel be kushu beeŋ sɔ kaplɛkama nɛ basa e baa boŋ to a cha awɔr ashi ndegboŋ nɛ b pɔr egbalana ŋ kulti nɛ a kɔ mboŋ lempo jeŋgreŋ na kikɛ to.
17Ade kikɛ be kaman, nɛ Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na naŋ kaŋɛ le: “Meeŋ ta kafɔŋ damta n lɛ enyiŋgbasa so nɛ b baa nite a laa a laa fanɛ etanpo na. B wora alubi n da ma so, naniere bumo be ŋklaŋ beeŋ wurge fanɛ nchu na nɛ bumo be kebuni e dese kasawule m bɛ.”
18Kachɛ nɛ Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na be agbogboŋ na beeŋ gbelge bumo so na, eshuwa nɛ egbiti nɛ b kɔ na kikɛ gba maaŋ tiŋ m mɔlga bumo. Mbe agbo na beeŋ koso fanɛ edɛ m mur kasawule kikɛ. Nɛ esa kama nɛ e wɔ durnya to be kebaawɔtɔ e ba ekar epul to.

english_text:
Turn to the Lord
1You disgraceful nation,
gather around,
2before it's too late.
The Lord has set a time
when his fierce anger
will strike like a storm
and sweep you away.
3If you humbly obey the Lord,
then come and worship him.
If you do right and are humble,
perhaps you will be safe
on that day when the Lord
turns loose his anger.
Judgment on Philistia
4 Gaza and Ashkelon
will be deserted
and left in ruins.
Ashdod will be emptied
in broad daylight,
and Ekron uprooted.
5To you people of Philistia
who live along the coast,
the Lord has this to say:
“I am now your enemy,
and I'll wipe you out!”
6Your seacoast will be changed
into pastureland
and sheep pens.
7The Lord God hasn't forgotten
those survivors in Judah,
and he will help them—
his people will take your land
to use for pasture.
And when evening comes,
they will rest
in houses at Ashkelon.
Judgment on Moab and Ammon
* 8 The Lord All-Powerful,
the God of Israel, said:
I've heard Moab and Ammon
insult my people
and threaten their nation.
9 And so, I swear by my very life
that Moab and Ammon will end up
like Sodom and Gomorrah—
covered with thornbushes
and salt pits forever.
Then my people who survive
will take their land.
10This is how Moab and Ammon
will at last be repaid
for their pride—
and for sneering at the nation
that belongs to me,
the Lord All-Powerful.
11I will fiercely attack.
Then every god on this earth
will shrink to nothing,
and everyone of every nation
will bow down to me,
right where they are.
Judgment on Ethiopia
12 People of Ethiopia,
the sword of the Lord
will slaughter you!
Judgment on Assyria
13 The Lord will reach to the north
to crush Assyria
and overthrow Nineveh.
14Herds of wild animals
will live in its rubble;
all kinds of desert owls
will perch on its stones
and hoot in the windows.
Noisy ravens will be heard
inside its buildings,
stripped bare of cedar.
15This is the glorious city
that felt secure and said,
“I am the only one!”
Now it's merely ruins,
a home for wild animals.
Every passerby simply sneers
and makes vulgar signs.
translation_text:
Nfɛra be kechɛrga be asheŋ
1Kanishinyɔrpaŋ be efuli be basa ere, men ba abar so 2pɔɛŋ nɛ afu e foŋ menyi n ya lɛ fanɛ afɔfɔ ŋko pɔɛŋ nɛ Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na be agbogboŋ na e kaa alegaiso m ba menyi so. 3Menyi bekama nɛ men la bebɔlpo ashi kasawule ere so na e baa bar menyi be amu kaseto nsaa nu a sa Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na. Men baa wora kusɔ nɛ k walɛ nsaa bar menyi be amu kaseto a sa mo. Nɛ men wora loŋ, ashere menyeeŋ gelge kasogberge kachɛ nɛ Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na be agbo beeŋ koso na.
Asheŋ ka maaŋ nyalɛ n sa efuliana nɛ a kulti Israɛl na be asheŋ
4Shɛŋ maaŋ naŋ ka a wɔ Filistiebi be ndegboŋana ere to. Shɛŋ maaŋ ka Gaza to. Ekama beeŋ kaa ashi Ashkɛlɔn be kade to. Baaŋ ju Ashdɔd be basa malɛ n lar kapiidi nseŋ ta kena n ya purgi basa nɛ b wɔ Ekrɔn na, nɛ b shile n lar bumo be kade na to. 5Asheŋ maaŋ nyalɛ n sa menyi Filistiebi nɛ men chena teku ase na. Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na tiŋ n ji menyi demu nseŋ ji m bri menyi. E beeŋ mur menyi nɛ menyi to be ekoŋwule gba maaŋ ka. 6Menyi be kasawule nɛ k dese teku ase na beeŋ ki kakpa nɛ mbolpɔkpapo beeŋ baa yuu bumo be ebuana nɛ mbolpɔ be aluu. 7Juda be efuli so be basa nɛ baaŋ ji efute na beeŋ sɔ menyi be kasawule n chena so. Baaŋ baa kpa bumo be mbolpɔ a yɔ keji to ndoŋ nsaa di nwu nɛ a wɔ Ashkɛlɔn na to. Enyɛnpe bumo be Ebɔrɛ na beeŋ baa wɔ bumo kutɔ nseŋ shin nɛ b naŋ dii dama.
8Kumo be kaman nɛ Enyɛnpetale Ebɔrɛ na kaŋɛ le: “N nu Mowab nɛ Ammɔn be basa ka bee tege nsaa wora ma basa eyurto a ji njɔŋ fanɛ baaŋ sɔ bumo be kasawule. 9Ŋ ka baa la Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ nɛ e bee sa ŋkpa nsaa la Israɛl be Ebɔrɛ ere, m bɔ ntaŋ fanɛ Mowab nɛ Ammɔn be basa beeŋ mur fanɛ ndegboŋ nɛ baa tre Sodɔm nɛ Gomɔra na. Mowab nɛ Ammɔn be nsawule beeŋ ki kakpa nɛ basa beeŋ baa kur nfɔl nɛ afitiri e sɔ ndoŋ kikɛ. Ma basa nɛ baaŋ ji efute na beeŋ suge bumo be kasawule nɛ asɔ kikɛ eleŋso.”
10Kusɔ nɛ k beeŋ ba Mowab nɛ Ammɔn be basa so ŋkpal bumo be kamoowu nɛ kebaatege nsaa wora Enyɛnpetale Ebɔrɛ na be basa eyurto so nna na. 11Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na be asheŋ beeŋ pɛ bumo kufu, jemanɛ nɛ e beeŋ mur kasawule na so be agbirana kikɛ na. Efuliana nɛ a wɔ teku ase kikɛ be basa beeŋ bunyaŋ Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na ashi bumo gbagba be nsawule so.
12Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na be tokobi na beeŋ mɔ Itiopia be basa gba.
Demuji nɛ k beeŋ ba Asiriya be efuli so be asheŋ
13Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na beeŋ ta mbe eleŋgboŋ m mur Asiriya be efuli nseŋ shin nɛ kadegboŋ nɛ baa tre Ninɛve na e bure n dese fanɛ keshishɛrsawule nɛ k maŋ kɔ nchu na. 14Ndoŋ beeŋ ki asɔbɔya be yiri kikɛ be edesekpa. Egbuŋgbula be yiri kikɛ beeŋ baa jɔŋɛ egbal bure so na so nsaa shu a wɔtɔ etokuro to. Baaŋ gboŋi sida be ndibi nɛ b ta m buu nwu na so na kikɛ. 15Kusɔ nɛ k beeŋ wora kadegboŋ nɛ baa ji njɔŋ kumo to nsaa puchi kumo be eleŋ so, a fɛ fanɛ shɛŋ shɛŋ maaŋ tiŋ n wora kumo na nna na. Kumo be basa bee fɛ nna fanɛ kadegboŋ kikɛ maŋ naŋ fo kumo so ashi durnya ere to. K beeŋ ki kade bureso, kakpa nɛ kupuŋ to be asɔbɔya kikɛ beeŋ baa dese nɛ ekama e baa choŋ a wu kumo nsaa pɛ kɔnɔ a kooba.

english_text:
Sinful Jerusalem
1Too bad for that disgusting,
corrupt, and lawless city!
2Forever rebellious
and rejecting correction,
Jerusalem refuses to trust
or obey the Lord God.
3Its officials are roaring lions,
its judges are wolves;
in the evening they attack,
by morning nothing is left.
4Jerusalem's prophets are proud
and not to be trusted.
The priests have disgraced
the place of worship
and abused God's Law.
5All who do evil are shameless,
but the Lord does right
and is always fair.
With the dawn of each day,
God brings about justice.
6The Lord wiped out nations
and left fortresses
crumbling in the dirt.
Their streets and towns
were reduced to ruins
and emptied of people.
7God felt certain that Jerusalem
would learn to respect
and obey him.
Then he would hold back
from punishing the city
and not wipe it out.
But everyone there was eager
to start sinning again.
Nations Will Turn to the Lord
8The Lord said:
Just wait for the day
when I accuse you nations.
I have decided on a day,
when I will bring together
every nation and kingdom
and punish them all
in my fiery anger.
I will become furious
and destroy the earth.
9I will purify each language
and make those languages
acceptable for praising me.
Then, with hearts united,
everyone will serve
only me, the Lord.
10From across the rivers
of Ethiopia,
my scattered people,
my true worshipers,
will bring offerings to me.
11When that time comes,
you won't rebel against me
and be put to shame.
I'll do away with those
who are proud and arrogant.
Never will any of them
strut around
on my holy mountain.
12But I, the Lord, won't destroy
any of your people
who are truly humble
and turn to me for safety.
13 The people of Israel who survive
will live right
and refuse to tell lies.
They will eat and rest
with nothing to fear.
A Song of Celebration
14Everyone in Jerusalem and Judah,
celebrate and shout
with all your heart!
15Zion, your punishment is over.
The Lord has forced your enemies
to turn and retreat.
Your Lord is King of Israel
and stands at your side;
you don't have to worry
about any more troubles.
16Jerusalem, the time is coming,
when it will be said to you:
“Don't be discouraged
or grow weak from fear!
17The Lord your God
wins victory after victory
and is always with you.
He celebrates and sings
because of you,
and he will refresh your life
with his love.”
The Lord's Promise to His People
18The Lord has promised:
Your sorrow has ended,
and you can celebrate.
19I will punish those
who mistreat you.
I will bring together the lame
and the outcasts,
then they will be praised,
instead of despised,
in every country on earth.
20I will lead you home,
and with your own eyes
you will see me bless you
with all you once owned.
Then you will be famous
everywhere on this earth.
I, the Lord, have spoken!
translation_text:
Jerusalɛm be kulubi nɛ kumɔlga be asheŋ
1Asheŋ maaŋ nyalɛ n sa Jerusalɛm be kadegboŋ na, ŋkpal k ka la kapuni nɛ kasuge nɛ kɔrfɛ nɛ kakpa nɛ b kini Ebɔrɛ na so. 2Jerusalɛmebi maa nu a sa Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ ŋko a sɔ mbe keŋini. Bumo alɛ maa ta bumo be yirda a deŋi Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ so ŋko a fin kechɛto mo kutɔ. 3Kumo be ekrachi du fanɛ ebuluŋ nɛ a bee munto nna, nɛ kumo be demujipoana malɛ du fanɛ ejiŋkaamu nɛ a bee pɛ kusɔ kanyɛso a ji nɛ, kare be kechɛ kachipurso nɛ shɛŋ maŋ naŋ ka na nna. 4Kumo be anebiana malɛ daa kɔ ŋkpensheŋ be kebaawɔtɔ nna nɛ basa maaŋ tiŋ n yirda bumo. Nɛ bɔrɛmatapoana malɛ bee ta eyurpi a yɔ kakpa cheembi nɛ baa bunyaŋ Ebɔrɛ, nsaa bɔla mbe mbra na so a nya bumo be aparsheŋ. 5Ama Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ kraa wɔ kadegboŋ na to a wora kusɔ nɛ k daga, nsaa ji asheŋ nɛ amo be ekpa so karechɛ kikɛ. Basa nɛ b maŋ niŋi na bre maa ŋana anishinyɔr nsaa wɔtɔ a wora alubi saŋkama.
6Le nɛ Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ kaŋɛ: “M mur efuli damtaana nseŋ bure amo be ndegboŋana be egbalana nɛ ebulempo jeŋgreŋana kikɛ. Esa kama maŋ naa wɔ ndegboŋ na to. Basa malɛ gba maŋ naa nite amo be abɔrbi so nɛ kakpa kikɛ wora shruum. 7N daa nyi fanɛ kumo be loŋ beeŋ shin nɛ ma basa e ta bunyaŋ n sa ma nseŋ sɔ kasogberge nɛ n sa bumo na nna, ama k maŋ chɛr ko nɛ b naŋ bɛta a wora alubi nɛ a chɔ amo nɛ b daa wora dra na gba.
8Menyi ere e jo a keni kachɛ nɛ meeŋ wu efuliana na kulubi nseŋ ji amo demu na. N tiŋ n yili kumo fanɛ meeŋ gama efuliana na nɛ kuwurjiana kikɛ abar so nseŋ shin nɛ ma agbo nɛ k bee suse fanɛ edɛ na e ba bumo so. Meeŋ nya agbo ga m mur durnya ere kikɛ.
9Kumo be kaman nɛ n chɛrga basa nɛ b wɔ efuliana na so be ŋgbene nɛ b naa bunyaŋ ma, Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na nawule. 10Ma basa nɛ b pesaŋ to nɛ bumo nɛ baa bunyaŋ ma kashenteŋto beeŋ shi hale Itiopia be efuli so be elɔrana be mba ndoŋ m bar esarga m ba sa ma. 11Jemanɛ na kaŋ fo, anishinyɔr maaŋ pɛ menyi nɛ men la ma basa ŋkpal men ka daŋ kini ma nseŋ lar ma kaman na so. Ŋkpal manɛ so, meeŋ ju bekama nɛ b kɔ kamoowu nɛ ŋkpensheŋ be kebaawɔtɔ ashi menyi to, saŋɛ na so menyi maaŋ naŋ kini ma nseŋ lar ma kaman ashi ma kebee cheembi na so. 12Bekama nɛ b du boeŋ nsaa bar bumo be amu ase kashenteŋto na bre, m maaŋ ju bumo, ŋkpal b ka ta bumo be yirda n deŋi ma so so. 13Israɛl be basa nɛ b ka na bre maaŋ wora kulubi, bumo alɛ maaŋ ku efɛ ŋko a na a fule basa. Asheŋ beeŋ baa nite nɛnɛ a sa bumo nɛ shɛŋ maaŋ naa fɔŋ bumo. Esa kikɛ maaŋ naŋ tiŋ n ta kufu n da bumo.
Kagbenefuli be kashɛ be asheŋ
14Israɛlebi, men baa boŋ nshɛ awɔrso kagbenefuliso!
Jerusalɛmebi, menyi alɛ gba e baa ji eyur kagbenefuliso!
15Ŋkpal manɛ so, Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na
shin nɛ menyi be kasogberge fo ekar.
E shin nɛ men doŋana bɛta ashi menyi so.
Mo alɛ e la Israɛl be Ebɔrɛ nɛ e wɔ menyi kutɔ na,
men sa maŋ naa ŋana kufu kusɔ ko so.
16Jemanɛ ko bee ba nɛ b kaŋɛ Jerusalɛmebi le:
‘Men sa maa ŋana kufu! Menyi alɛ e sa maŋ pɔ aba
ŋko a yil chaam ŋkpal kufu so!
17Ŋkpal manɛ so, Enyɛnpe menyi be Ebɔrɛ na wɔ men kutɔ,
mbe eleŋgboŋ na e naa kɔ a pɔɔ so a sa menyi.
Menyi be asheŋ bee bɔlɔ mo kenishi ga,
nɛ mbe kasha bee sa menyi ŋkpa popɔr.
Mbe kagbene bee fuli menyi so nna
nɛ e bee boŋ nshɛ kagbenefuliso.’
18Kumo be kaman nɛ Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na naŋ kaŋɛ le:
‘Meeŋ lara kagbenejija nɛ k bee kaa ba
men be kejigboŋana to na
ashi menyi so, ŋkpal manɛ so,
k la egbɛ nɛ ŋaba nna a deŋ menyi so.
19Jemanɛ na kaŋ fo, meeŋ gberge bekama
nɛ b kɔrfɛ menyi na kusoe.
Ma alɛ beeŋ mɔlga ebobi
nseŋ gama basa nɛ b pesaŋ to na abar so.
Meeŋ shin nɛ bumo be nyɔmɔ e ki bunyaŋ n sa bumo,
nɛ durnya kikɛ e baa kpaŋ bumo.
20Loŋ be jemanɛ na, meeŋ gama menyi be basa abar so
m bar bumo epe.
Ma alɛ beeŋ shin nɛ menyi be ketre e dii durnya kikɛ to,
nseŋ shin nɛ men naŋ dii dama.’ ”
Ma, Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ e kaŋɛ na!

english_text:
Rebuild the Temple
1 On the first day of the sixth month of the second year that Darius was king of Persia, the Lord told Haggai the prophet to speak his message to the governor of Judah and to the high priest.
So Haggai told Governor Zerubbabel and High Priest Joshua 2-5that the Lord All-Powerful had said to them and to the people:
You say this isn't the right time to build a temple for me. But is it right for you to live in expensive houses, while my temple is a pile of ruins? Just look at what's happening. 6You harvest less than you plant, you never have enough to eat or drink, your clothes don't keep you warm, and your wages are stored in bags full of holes.
7Think about what I have said! 8But first, go to the hills and get wood for my temple, so I can take pride in it and be worshiped there. 9You expected much, but received only a little. And when you brought it home, I made that little disappear. Why have I done this? It's because you hurry off to build your own houses, while my temple is still in ruins. 10That's also why the dew doesn't fall and your harvest fails. 11And so, at my command everything will become barren—your farmland and pastures, your vineyards and olive trees, your animals and you yourselves. All your hard work will be for nothing.
12Zerubbabel and Joshua, together with the others who had returned from exile in Babylonia, obeyed the Lord's message spoken by his prophet Haggai, and they started showing proper respect for the Lord. 13Haggai then told them that the Lord had promised to be with them. 14So the Lord God All-Powerful made everyone eager to work on his temple, especially Zerubbabel and Joshua. 15And the work began on the twenty-fourth day of that same month.
translation_text:
Bɔrɛlambu na be kelɔŋɛ m pɔr be asheŋ
1Ewurgboŋ Dariɔs ka ji Pɛshiya be efuli so be kuwura be kafɛ nyɔsopo to be kufɔl shesopo be kachɛ juŋkparso to, nɛ Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ bɔla anebi Heegai so m malga. Kubɔya na daa yɔ Juda be efuli so be gomena, Zerubabel nɛ e la Shealtiɛl pibinyɛn na nɛ bɔrɛmatapo nimuso Joshuwa, nɛ e la Jehozadak pibinyɛn na kutɔ nna.
2Kusɔ nɛ Enyɛnpetale Ebɔrɛ na yɛ nde: “Basa ere bee kaŋɛ fanɛ jemanɛ maŋ naŋ fo nɛ b lɔŋɛ bɔrɛlambu na m pɔr ashi Jerusalɛm to.” 3Ndoŋ nna nɛ Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na ta kubɔya ere m bɔla anebi Heegai so n sa basa na. 4E yɛ: “Ma basa, manɛ nna nɛ menyi ere wɔ nwu lela to nɛ ma ere be bɔrɛlambu bure a dese? 5Menyi maŋ wu kusɔ nɛ k bee wora menyi na nna a? 6Men duu asɔ damta, ama asɔ gbrɛbi nɛ men teŋi. Menyee ji ga, ama menyi alɛ maa moɛ. Menyee nuu nchu ga, ama a maa tuge menyi achukoŋ. Menyee buu asɔbuuso, ama men kraa shu awo. Beshumpo bee shuŋ a nya kakɔka, ama k du fanɛ b kaa bee ta amo a wɔtɔ ekɔlgu nɛ a futi to nna.” 7Kusɔ nɛ Enyɛnpetale Ebɔrɛ na yɛ nde: “Menyi maŋ wu kusɔ nɛ k ba nɛ le wora a?” 8Men dii n yɔ abee so n ya ku ndibi m ba lɔŋɛ ma bɔrɛlambu m pɔr, nɛ ma kagbene e fuli ma nɛ basa e naa bunyaŋ ma kananɛ k daga fanɛ b baa bunyaŋ ma.
9Men daa tama keteŋi asɔ damta nna, ama asɔ gbrɛbi nɛ men nya n teŋi. Menyi alɛ ka naŋ bar asɔ nɛ men teŋi na epe, nɛ n shin nɛ afu ba ber amo n yɔ. Manɛ so nɛ n wora loŋ? Ŋkpal ma bɔrɛlambu ka bure a dese nɛ men pere kenishi a pɔr menyi be nwuana so. 10Amoso nɛ bɔrɛ maa ba nɛ shɛŋ maŋ tiŋ ŋ kɔr na. 11Ma e shin nɛ ewule ba adɔsawule nɛ abee nɛ ndibi sɔrso be adɔ so nɛ kusɔ kama nɛ k bee shi kasawule to nɛ edimɛdi nɛ asɔbɔya kikɛ so, nɛ menyi be kegben kikɛ to jiga na.
B ka wora Ebɔrɛ be kamalga kasonu be asheŋ
12Ndoŋ nna nɛ Zerubabel nɛ Joshuwa nɛ basa nɛ b shi kenyaya to ashi Babilɔn be efuli so m bɛta m ba na kikɛ wora kubɔya nɛ Enyɛnpe bumo be Ebɔrɛ na ta m bɔla anebi Heegai so n sa bumo na kasonu ŋkpal b ka bee ŋana Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na so. 13Kumo be kaman nɛ anebi Heegai kaŋɛ basa na le: “Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na nase kɔnɔ ŋ kaŋɛ le: ‘Meeŋ baa wɔ menyi kutɔ.’ ”
14Enyɛnpetale Ebɔrɛ na daŋ ta kenishipere nna n wɔtɔ Zerubabel nɛ e daa la Juda be efuli so be gomena nɛ Joshuwa nɛ e daa la bɔrɛmatapo nimuso na nɛ basa b daŋ pɛ n yɔ efuli pɔtɛana so nɛ b bɛta m ba na to nna nɛ b fara Enyɛnpetale, bumo be Ebɔrɛ na be bɔrɛlambu na kapɔr. 15Ewurgboŋ Dariɔs ka ji Pɛshiya be efuli so be kuwura na be kafɛ nyɔsopo to be kufɔl shesopo to be kachɛ adunyɔ nɛ ana nɛ b fara kushuŋ na.

english_text:
The Glorious New Temple
