Men daa nyi ma nna, men daa beeŋ baa nyi n Tuto gba.”
20Bɔrɛlambu na to be kakpa nɛ k mata kaboŋ nɛ baa yili amansherbi be edekana na nɛ Yesu daŋ yili ŋ ŋini asheŋ ere kikɛ, ama esa kikɛ daa maŋ pɛ mo, ŋkpal manɛ so, mbe saŋɛ daa maŋ naŋ fo.
Basa ka maaŋ tiŋ n yɔ kakpa nɛ Yesu bee yɔ na be asheŋ
21Kede be kaman nɛ Yesu naŋ lɔŋɛ ŋ kaŋɛ bumo: “Meeŋ yɔ nɛ menyi e fin ma ŋ gben nseŋ wu menyi be alubi to. Kakpa nɛ ma ere bee yɔ na, menyi maaŋ tiŋ n yɔ ndoŋ.” 22Ndoŋ nna nɛ Juwebi na bishi abar: “E bee sha kemɔ mbe kumu nna so nɛ e yɛ: ‘Kakpa nɛ mee yɔ na, menyi maaŋ tiŋ n yɔ na’, ŋko nuso?” 23Nɛ Yesu naŋ ta mbe kamalga n chuge so ŋ kaŋɛ: “Kasawule ere nfe nɛ menyi ere shi, ama esoso nɛ ma ere shi, durnya ere to nɛ men shi, ama mannɛ durnya ere to nɛ ma ere shi. 24Amoso nɛ ŋ kaŋɛ menyi fanɛ menyeeŋ wu menyi be alubi to na. Menyi alɛ baa maŋ yirda fanɛ ma e la esa nɛ ŋ kaŋɛ fanɛ n la ere, menyeeŋ wu menyi be alubi to.” 25Ndoŋ nna nɛ b bishi mo: “Nɛ wanɛ e la fo bre?” Nɛ Yesu kaŋɛ bumo: “Kumo nɛ m baa wɔtɔ a kaŋɛ menyi sososo na kikɛ na. 26Asɔ damta wɔtɔ nɛ n yili amo so m malga menyi be asheŋ nseŋ ji menyi demu, ama esa nɛ e shuŋi ma na la Kashenteŋjipo nna. Ma alɛ, kusɔ nɛ mee nu ashi mo kutɔ nɛ mee ta a kaŋɛ durnya.” 27B daa maŋ pin fanɛ mo Tuto be asheŋ nɛ e daa kaŋɛ bumo na. 28Amoso, le nɛ Yesu daŋ kaŋɛ bumo: “Men kaŋ maŋ ma, Nyiŋgbasa Pibinyɛn so m mata kedibi so na, menyeeŋ pin esa nɛ ŋ kaŋɛ fanɛ n la ere, kumo alɛ be saŋɛ na so nɛ menyeeŋ pin fanɛ m maa wora shɛŋ ma kumu so, asɔ nɛ Etuto na bee ŋini ma nawule nɛ mee malga. 29Esa nɛ e shuŋi ma na malɛ maŋ yige ma n to, e wɔ ŋ kutɔ, ŋkpal manɛ so, saŋkikɛ kusɔ nɛ k bee par mo nɛ mee wora.”
Basa nɛ b la Eebraham be mbia gbagba be asheŋ
30Basa damta ka daŋ nu Yesu be mmalga na nɛ b yirda mo. 31Juwebi nɛ b daŋ yirda mo na, le nɛ Yesu daŋ kaŋɛ bumo: “Nɛ men baa bɛ ma keŋini ere so, menyeeŋ baa la ma bebɛsopo kashenteŋto. 32Saŋɛ na so, menyeeŋ pin kashenteŋ na nɛ kashenteŋ na e shin nɛ men lar kenyaya to.” 33Ndoŋ nna nɛ Juwebi na kaŋɛ mo le: “Eebraham mo nanabiana e la anyi, anyi ere maŋ naŋ ki esa kikɛ be anya, nɛ a ji nuso nna nɛ fee kaŋɛ fanɛ anyeeŋ lar kenyaya to?” 34Nɛ Yesu kaŋɛ bumo: “Ma e kaŋɛ menyi kashenteŋto na, esa kama nɛ e bee wora alubi la alubi be kenya nna. 35Kenya maŋ la laŋ to be esa saŋkikɛ mbaanaayɔ, ama ebi bre, laŋ to be esa nna saŋkikɛ mbaanaayɔ. 36Nɛ Ebɔrɛ Pibinyɛn baŋ lara fo kenyaya to, fo nya fo kumu kashenteŋto pasaa.
37N nyi men ka la Eebraham mo nanabiana, ama menyi alɛ bee sha kemɔ ma nna, ŋkpal manɛ so, men maa sha kesɔ ma keŋini. 38Asɔ nɛ n wu n Tuto na kutɔ be asheŋ nɛ mee malga nɛ menyi alɛ bee wora asɔ nɛ men nu ashi men tuto kutɔ.” 39Ndoŋ nna nɛ b kaŋɛ Yesu: “Eebraham e la an tuto.” Nɛ Yesu kaŋɛ bumo: “Nɛ men daa la Eebraham be mbia nna, men daa beeŋ baa wora asɔ nɛ Eebraham daŋ wora. 40Ama kumo nɛ menyee sha kemɔ ma na ŋkpal ŋ ka kaŋɛ menyi kashenteŋ nɛ n nu ashi Ebɔrɛ kutɔ so. Le be asheŋ nɛ Eebraham daŋ wora a? 41Asɔ nɛ men tuto bee wora nɛ menyee wora na.” Nɛ b kaŋɛ Yesu le: “Mannɛ ayurbi e la anyi. Etuto koŋwule nɛ an kɔ, mo alɛ e la Ebɔrɛ na.” 42Nɛ Yesu kaŋɛ bumo: “Nɛ Ebɔrɛ daa la men tuto nna, men daa beeŋ baa sha ma asheŋ, ŋkpal manɛ so, Ebɔrɛ kutɔ nɛ n shi m ba kaa wɔ nfe naniere na, m maŋ ba ŋ gbagba be kumu so. Mo e shuŋi ma. 43Men nyi kusɔ nɛ k ba nɛ men maa pin ma mmalga to ere a? Kusɔ nɛ k ba e la fanɛ men maaŋ tiŋ n nu amo. 44Men tuto e la alubipo na nɛ menyee sha kebaawora mbe aparsheŋ. Emɔpo e la mo sososo kikɛ, mo alɛ be shɛŋ maa ji kashenteŋ to, ŋkpal kashenteŋ ka maŋ wɔ mo to so. E baa ku efɛ, kananɛ mbe kapɔr du nɛ e bee ŋini, ŋkpal manɛ so, e la efɛpo nna nseŋ naa la efɛ kikɛ amo tuto. 45Ŋ ka bee ji kashenteŋ na so so nɛ men maa yirda ma na. 46Men be emo e naaŋ tiŋ ŋ ŋini kulubi kama nɛ n daŋ wora? To, nɛ kashenteŋ nɛ m baa ji, manɛ e ba nɛ men maa yirda ma? 47Esa kama nɛ e la Ebɔrɛ peya bee nu asɔ nɛ Ebɔrɛ bee kaŋɛ nna. Men ka maŋ la Ebɔrɛ peya so e shin nɛ men maa nu asɔ nɛ e bee kaŋɛ na.”
48Nɛ Juwebi na kaŋɛ mo: “Kashenteŋ nɛ an ji ŋ kaŋɛ fanɛ fo la Samɛrianyɛn nsaa kɔ kiyoyu lubi fo to na.” 49Nɛ Yesu kaŋɛ bumo: “Kiyoyu lubi kama maŋ wɔ ma to. N Tuto nɛ mee bunyaŋ nɛ menyi alɛ maa bunyaŋ ma. 50Ma ere gbagba maa fin kemaŋkura nna a sa ma kumu, esa ko e naa fin kumo, mo alɛ e naa ji ma asheŋ amo be ekpa so na. 51Ma e kaŋɛ menyi kashenteŋto na fanɛ nɛ esa baa ta ma kamalga na a wɔtɔ mbe kagbene to, e maaŋ wu kikɛ.” 52Ndoŋ nna nɛ Juwebi na kaŋɛ: “To, naniere nɛ an pin fanɛ kiyoyu lubi e wɔ fo to kashenteŋto, ŋkpal manɛ so, Eebraham nɛ anebiana na kikɛ wu n wu, ama kumo nɛ fee kaŋɛ fanɛ nɛ esa baŋ ta fo kamalga na n wɔtɔ mbe kagbene to, e maaŋ wu na. 53Fo chɔ an tuto Eebraham nna a? Mo nɛ anebiana na kikɛ wu. To, nɛ wanɛ nɛ fee tama fanɛ fo ere la?” 54Nɛ Yesu kaŋɛ bumo le: “Nɛ m baa maŋkura ma kumu, kumo ere ma kemaŋkura na maŋ kɔ kifi, ama n Tuto nɛ menyee tre menyi be Ebɔrɛ na e la esa nɛ e bee maŋkura ma. 55Men maŋ nyi mo, ama ma ere nyi mo. Nɛ ŋ kaŋɛ fanɛ m maŋ nyi mo, meeŋ baa la efɛpo fanɛ menyi, ma ere nyi mo nsaa ta mbe mmalga a wɔtɔ ma kagbene to. 56Men tuto Eebraham be kagbene daŋ fuli mo ga ŋkpal e ka daa shin nɛ e nya ma saŋɛ n wu so. Kashenteŋto malɛ, e wu kumo nɛ mbe kagbene fuli mo.” 57Nɛ Juwebi na kaŋɛ mo: “To, fo maŋ naŋ fo nfɛ adunu gba nɛ fo wu Eebraham a?” 58Nɛ Yesu kaŋɛ bumo: “Ma e kaŋɛ menyi kashenteŋto na fanɛ pɔɛŋ nɛ b kurge Eebraham nɛ n wɔtɔ.” 59E ka malga le ere nɛ b ta ajembu nɛ b kpa mo nɛ e ŋana mbe kumu nseŋ bɔl basa na to n lar bɔrɛlambu na to.

english_text:
Jesus Heals a Man Born Blind
1As Jesus walked along, he saw a man who had been blind since birth. 2Jesus' disciples asked, “Teacher, why was this man born blind? Was it because he or his parents sinned?”
3“No, it wasn't!” Jesus answered. “But because of his blindness, you will see God work a miracle for him. 4As long as it is day, we must do what the one who sent me wants me to do. When night comes, no one can work. 5 While I am in the world, I am the light for the world.”
6After Jesus said this, he spit on the ground. He made some mud and smeared it on the man's eyes. 7Then he said, “Go wash off the mud in Siloam Pool.” The man went and washed in Siloam, which means “One Who Is Sent.” When he had washed off the mud, he could see.
8The man's neighbors and the people who had seen him begging wondered if he really could be the same man. 9Some of them said he was the same beggar, while others said he only looked like him. But he told them, “I am that man.”
10“Then how can you see?” they asked.
11He answered, “Someone named Jesus made some mud and smeared it on my eyes. He told me to go and wash it off in Siloam Pool. When I did, I could see.”
12“Where is he now?” they asked.
“I don't know,” he answered.
The Pharisees Try To Find Out What Happened
13-14The day when Jesus made the mud and healed the man was a Sabbath. So the people took the man to the Pharisees. 15They asked him how he was able to see, and he answered, “Jesus made some mud and smeared it on my eyes. Then after I washed it off, I could see.”
16Some of the Pharisees said, “This man Jesus doesn't come from God. If he did, he would not break the law of the Sabbath.”
Others asked, “How could someone who is a sinner work such a miracle?”
Since the Pharisees could not agree among themselves, 17they asked the man, “What do you say about this one who healed your eyes?”
“He is a prophet!” the man told them.
18But the Jewish leaders would not believe that the man had once been blind. They sent for his parents 19and asked them, “Is this the son that you said was born blind? How can he now see?”
20The man's parents answered, “We are certain that he is our son, and we know that he was born blind. 21But we don't know how he got his sight or who gave it to him. Ask him! He is old enough to speak for himself.”
22-23The man's parents said this because they were afraid of their leaders. The leaders had already agreed that no one was to have anything to do with anyone who said Jesus was the Messiah.
24The leaders called the man back and said, “Swear by God to tell the truth! We know that Jesus is a sinner.”
25The man replied, “I don't know if he is a sinner or not. All I know is that I used to be blind, but now I can see!”
26“What did he do to you?” they asked. “How did he heal your eyes?”
27The man answered, “I have already told you once, and you refused to listen. Why do you want me to tell you again? Do you also want to become his disciples?”
28The leaders insulted the man and said, “You are his follower! We are followers of Moses. 29We are sure God spoke to Moses, but we don't even know where Jesus comes from.”
30“How strange!” the man replied. “He healed my eyes, and yet you don't know where he comes from. 31We know that God listens only to people who love and obey him. God doesn't listen to sinners. 32And this is the first time in history anyone has ever given sight to someone born blind. 33Jesus could not do anything unless he came from God.”
34The leaders told the man, “You have been a sinner since the day you were born! Do you think you can teach us anything?” Then they said, “You can never come back into any of our synagogues!”
35When Jesus heard what had happened, he went and found the man. Then Jesus asked, “Do you have faith in the Son of Man?”
36He replied, “Sir, if you will tell me who he is, I will put my faith in him.”
37“You have already seen him,” Jesus answered, “and right now he is talking with you.”
38The man said, “Lord, I put my faith in you!” Then he worshiped Jesus.
39Jesus told him, “I came to judge the people of this world. I am here to give sight to the blind and to make blind everyone who can see.”
40When the Pharisees heard Jesus say this, they asked, “Are we blind?”
41Jesus answered, “If you were blind, you would not be guilty. But now that you claim to see, you will keep on being guilty.”
translation_text:
Yesu ka chɛ tanpo ko be asheŋ
1Yesu ka na a choŋ nɛ e wu kanyɛn ko b ka kurge mo tanpo. 2Ndoŋ nna nɛ mbe bebɛsopo bishi mo le: “Eŋinipo, kanyɛn ere gbagba be alubi so nɛ e tan ere ŋko mo nio nɛ mo tuto bre e wora alubi?” 3Nɛ Yesu kaŋɛ bumo: “Mannɛ kanyɛn ere gbagba be alubi so ŋko mo nio nɛ mo tuto be alubi so so nɛ e tan. E tan nna nɛ Ebɔrɛ e bɔla mo so ŋ ŋini basa mbe eleŋ be ashuŋ. 4Kefulto ka kraa wɔtɔ ere bre, a daga fanɛ an baa shuŋ esa nɛ e shuŋi ma na be ashuŋ. Kanyɛ bee biri a ba, kumo alɛ baŋ ba, esa maaŋ naŋ tiŋ n shuŋ shɛŋ. 5Ŋ ka kraa wɔ durnya to ere bre, ma e la durnya ere be kefulto.” 6E ka malga le n loge nɛ e tuu echɔl n lɛ kasawule m pɔ shishɛr nseŋ ta amo m mata kanyɛn na be anishi so, nseŋ kaŋɛ kanyɛn na: 7“Yɔ Sailowam be kepa to n ya fɔr amo n lɛ ndoŋ.” Sailowam be kifito e la Shuŋi. Ndoŋ nna nɛ kanyɛn na yɔ ndoŋ n ya fɔr nseŋ fara a wu a ba.
8Mo braana nɛ basa nɛ b daŋ wu mo nɛ e daa tase a kule na ka naŋ wu mo nɛ b bishi abar: “Mannɛ kanyɛn ere e daa tase a kule na a?” 9Nɛ beko kaŋɛ fanɛ mo nna nɛ beko malɛ kaŋɛ le: “Ayai, mannɛ mo nna, b duli abar nna.” Ndoŋ nna nɛ mo gbagba kaŋɛ: “Ma nna.” 10Nɛ b bishi mo: “To, nɛ nuso nɛ fo wora nɛ fo anishi bugi?” 11Nɛ e kaŋɛ bumo: “Kanyɛn nɛ baa tre Yesu na e pɔ shishɛr m mata ma anishi so nseŋ kaŋɛ ma fanɛ n ya fɔr ashi Sailowam. Ma alɛ ka baŋ ya fɔr nɛ n fara a wu epul na to.” 12Nɛ b bishi mo: “Nɛ kanyɛn na wɔ nnɛ?” Nɛ e yɛ: “M maŋ nyi.”
Efarisiana na ka bishi kechɛ na to be asheŋ
13Ndoŋ nna nɛ b keta kanyɛn nɛ e daŋ tan na n yɔ Efarisiana na be anishito. 14Kachɛ nɛ Yesu daŋ pɔ shishɛr na m bugi kanyɛn na be anishi na malɛ daa la kewushiachɛ nna. 15Nɛ Efarisiana na malɛ gba bishi mo kananɛ e wora n nya mbe anishi a wu. Nɛ e yɛ: “Depɔ nɛ e ta m mata ma anishi so nɛ n ya fɔr amo n lɛ nseŋ fara a wu na.” 16Ndoŋ nna nɛ Efarisiana na be beko kaŋɛ: “Kanyɛn na maŋ shi Ebɔrɛ kutɔ kashenteŋto, ŋkpal manɛ so, e maa bɛ kewushiachɛ be mbra na so.” Ndoŋ nna nɛ beko malɛ kaŋɛ: “Nuso nɛ alubipo bee wora a wora le be emamachi be asheŋ ere?” Ŋkpal le so kebarga to daŋ ba bumo to nna. 17Ade kikɛ be kaman nɛ b naŋ bishi kanyɛn na: “Manɛ nɛ fo alɛ kɔ nɛ fo kaŋɛ mbe asheŋ?” Nɛ kanyɛn na kaŋɛ: “Ma ere kutɔ e la anebi nna.” 18Ade kikɛ daŋ wora, ama Juwebi na kraa maa sha keyirda gba kuraa fanɛ kanyɛn na daŋ tan gba, ama b shuŋi nna n tre mo nio nɛ mo tuto pɔɛŋ. 19B ka ba nɛ b bishi bumo: “Men pibi nde a? Men kaŋɛ e daŋ tan nna, nuso nɛ a ji nɛ naniere nɛ e bee wu ere?” 20Ndoŋ nna nɛ kanyɛn na mo nio nɛ mo tuto na kaŋɛ Efarisiana na: “An nyi e ka la an pibi nseŋ naa nyi an ka kurge mo nɛ e tan na, 21ama kananɛ e wora a wu naniere ŋko esa nɛ e chɛ mo bre, an maŋ nyi. Men bishi mo gbagba nɛ e kaŋɛ menyi, ŋkpal manɛ so, mannɛ kebia e la mo.” 22Kanyɛn na mo nio nɛ mo tuto daŋ kaŋɛ loŋ nna ŋkpal b ka daa ŋana Juwebi be benimuana na so so, ŋkpal manɛ so, b daŋ kaŋɛ nna fanɛ ekama nɛ e bugi to ŋ kaŋɛ fanɛ Yesu e la Mesaya na, baaŋ ju mo nshɛrbuana na to be keluri to. 23Amoso nɛ mo nio nɛ mo tuto daŋ kaŋɛ fanɛ: “Mannɛ kebia nna, men bishi mo gbagba na.”
24Ndoŋ nna nɛ b naŋ tre kanyɛn nɛ e daŋ tan na kela nyɔsopo m ba kaŋɛ mo le: “Ji kashenteŋ n sa Ebɔrɛ kemaŋkura, ŋkpal manɛ so an nyi kanyɛn na ka la alubipo.” 25Nɛ kanyɛn na kaŋɛ bumo le: “To, ma ere maŋ nyi ŋko e la alubipo nna ŋko e maŋ la. Ama kusɔ nɛ m baa nyi e la fanɛ n daŋ tan nna, ama naniere mee wu.” 26Nɛ b bishi mo: “Nuso nɛ e wora fo? Nuso nɛ e wora m bugi fo anishi na?” 27Ndoŋ nna nɛ kanyɛn na kaŋɛ bumo: “Kumo nɛ n daŋ kekaŋɛ menyi na, menyi alɛ maa nu. Manɛ e ba nɛ menyi naa sha fanɛ n naŋ kaŋɛ menyi, ŋko menyi alɛ gba naa sha keki mbe bebɛsopo nna?” 28Ndoŋ nna nɛ b tege n tege mo nseŋ kaŋɛ mo: “Fo e baa la mbe ebɛsopo, anyi ere, Mosis be bebɛsopo e la anyi. 29An nyi Ebɔrɛ ka malga n sa Mosis, ama kanyɛn ere bre, anyi maŋ nyi kakpa nɛ e shi gba.” 30Ndoŋ nna nɛ kanyɛn na kaŋɛ: “Asheŋ nde walɛ! Men maŋ nyi kakpa nɛ e shi, ama mo alɛ tiŋ m bugi ma anishi. 31Anyi alɛ nyi fanɛ Ebɔrɛ maa nu a sa alubiworapoana, basa nɛ b kɔ kabɔrɛŋana nsaa wora mbe aparsheŋ na nawule nɛ e bee nu a sa. 32Durnya ka fara kikɛ anyi maŋ naŋ nu esa ka bugi esa nɛ b kurge mo tanpo be anishi kikɛ. 33Nɛ kanyɛn nɛ e bugi ma anishi ere daa maŋ shi Ebɔrɛ kutɔ nna, e daa maaŋ tiŋ n wora shɛŋ.” 34Nɛ basa na kaŋɛ: “Keni, baŋ yili fo kakurgeachɛ kikɛ nɛ fo wɔ alubi to m ba fo mbre nɛ fo ba kaa sha nɛ fo ŋini anyi asheŋ a?” B ka kaŋɛ mo loŋ n loge nɛ b ju mo nshɛrbuana na to be keluri to.
Kiyoyu to be ntaŋ be asheŋ
35Yesu nu b ka ju kanyɛn na nshɛrbuana na to be keluri to nseŋ ya tu mo kakpa ko m bishi mo: “Fo yirda Nyiŋgbasa Pibinyɛn na a?” 36Nɛ kanyɛn na bishi Yesu: “Ebunyampo, wanɛ e la mo? Kaŋɛ ma nɛ n yirda mo.” 37Nɛ Yesu kaŋɛ mo: “Fo teŋ wu mo gba, mo alɛ e naa malga fo kutɔ naniere na.” 38Ndoŋ nna nɛ kanyɛn na kaŋɛ: “Enyɛnpe, n yirda.” Kumo be kaman nɛ e gbir kumuli. 39Nɛ Yesu kaŋɛ: “M ba durnya ere to nna nɛ m ba ji basa demu nɛ betanpo e nya a wu nɛ bumo nɛ baa wu malɛ e tan.” 40Efarisiana ko daa yil ndoŋ nseŋ nu kusɔ nɛ e kaŋɛ na nseŋ bishi mo le: “Fee ŋini fanɛ anyi alɛ gba tan nna ŋko?” 41Nɛ Yesu kaŋɛ bumo: “Men daŋ tan nna, kulubi daa maaŋ baa wɔ menyi so, ama ŋkpal men ka bee kaŋɛ fanɛ menyee wu ere bre, menyi be alubi beeŋ baa kraa wɔ menyi so.”

english_text:
A Story about Sheep
1Jesus said:
I tell you for certain only thieves and robbers climb over the fence instead of going in through the gate to the sheep pen. 2-3But the gatekeeper opens the gate for the shepherd, and he goes in through it. The sheep know their shepherd's voice. He calls each of them by name and leads them out.
4When he has led out all of his sheep, he walks in front of them, and they follow, because they know his voice. 5The sheep will not follow strangers. They don't recognize a stranger's voice, and they run away.
6Jesus told the people this story. But they did not understand what he was talking about.
Jesus Is the Good Shepherd
7Jesus said:
I tell you for certain that I am the gate for the sheep. 8Everyone who came before me was a thief or a robber, and the sheep did not listen to any of them. 9I am the gate. All who come in through me will be saved. Through me they will come and go and find pasture.
10A thief comes only to rob, kill, and destroy. I came so everyone would have life, and have it fully. 11 I am the good shepherd, and the good shepherd gives up his life for his sheep. 12Hired workers are not like the shepherd. They don't own the sheep, and when they see a wolf coming, they run off and leave the sheep. Then the wolf attacks and scatters the flock. 13Hired workers run away because they don't care about the sheep.
14 I am the good shepherd. I know my sheep, and they know me. 15 Just as the Father knows me, I know the Father, and I give up my life for my sheep. 16I have other sheep that are not in this sheep pen. I must also bring them together, when they hear my voice. Then there will be one flock of sheep and one shepherd.
17The Father loves me, because I give up my life, so I may receive it back again. 18No one takes my life from me. I give it up willingly! I have the power to give it up and the power to receive it back again, just as my Father commanded me to do.
19The people took sides because of what Jesus had told them. 20Many of them said, “He has a demon in him! He is crazy! Why listen to him?”
21But others said, “How could anyone with a demon in him say these things? No one like this could give sight to a blind person!”
Jesus Is Rejected
22 That winter, Jesus was in Jerusalem for the Temple Festival. 23One day he was walking in the part of the temple known as Solomon's Porch, 24and the people gathered all around him. They said, “How long are you going to keep us guessing? If you are the Messiah, tell us plainly!”
25Jesus answered:
I have told you, and you refused to believe me. The things I do by my Father's authority show who I am. 26But since you are not my sheep, you don't believe me. 27My sheep know my voice, and I know them. They follow me, 28and I give them eternal life, so that they will never be lost. No one can snatch them out of my hand. 29 My Father gave them to me, and he is greater than all others. No one can snatch them from his hands, 30and I am one with the Father.
31Once again the people picked up stones in order to kill Jesus. 32But he said, “I have shown you many good things my Father sent me to do. Which one are you going to stone me for?”
33They answered, “We are not stoning you because of any good thing you did. We are stoning you because you did a terrible thing. You are just a man, and here you are claiming to be God!”
34 Jesus replied:
In your Scriptures doesn't God say, “You are gods”? 35You can't argue with the Scriptures, and God spoke to those people and called them gods. 36So why do you accuse me of a terrible sin for saying that I am the Son of God? After all, it is the Father who prepared me for this work. He is also the one who sent me into the world. 37If I don't do as my Father does, you should not believe me. 38But if I do what my Father does, you should believe because of that, even if you don't have faith in me. Then you will know for certain that the Father is one with me, and I am one with the Father.
39Again they wanted to arrest Jesus. But he escaped 40 and crossed the Jordan to the place where John had earlier been baptizing. While Jesus was there, 41many people came to him. They were saying, “John didn't work any miracles, but everything he said about Jesus is true.” 42A lot of those people also put their faith in Jesus.
translation_text:
Mbolpɔkpapo nɛ mbe mbolpɔ be keŋasa be asheŋ
1Yesu e daŋ bɔ keŋasa ere ŋ kaŋɛ: “Ma e kaŋɛ menyi kashenteŋto na fanɛ esa kama nɛ e maa bɔla mbolpɔ be kuluu be kabuna to a luri kuluu na to nsaa bɔla kaboŋ pɔtɛ a tɛ a luri kumo to la eyu nɛ esugepo nna. 2Esa nɛ e bee bɔla kuluu na to be kabuna to a luri mbolpɔ na to e la mbolpɔkpapo na. 3E baa ba, kabunakenipo na bee bugi kabuna na nna a sa mo nɛ e bee luri to a tre a tre mo gbagba be mbolpɔ na be atreana nɛ bumo alɛ bee pin mbe ebɔl nsaa bɛ mo so nɛ e bee keta bumo a lar kuluu na to. 4E baŋ lara bumo kikɛ kuluu na to n loge, e bee choŋ nna n juŋkpar mbolpɔ na nɛ b bɛ mo so, ŋkpal manɛ so, b nyi mbe ebɔl. 5Ama efɔ bre, b maaŋ bɛ mo so kikɛ. Baaŋ shile gba nseŋ ka mo, ŋkpal manɛ so, b maŋ nyi mbe ebɔl.”
6Yesu daŋ bɔ le be keŋasa ere nna n sa bumo, ama b daa maŋ pin kusɔ nɛ e daa kaŋɛ bumo na be kifito.
7Ndoŋ nna nɛ Yesu naŋ kaŋɛ bumo: “Kashenteŋ nɛ mee kaŋɛ menyi na fanɛ ma e du fanɛ kabuna a sa mbolpɔ na. 8Bekama nɛ b daŋ juŋkpar ma m ba na kikɛ la beyu nɛ besugepo nna nɛ mbolpɔ na malɛ maŋ nu n sa bumo. 9Ma e la kabuna na, esa kama nɛ e bɔla ma to n luri, beeŋ nya kumɔlga. Mo alɛ beeŋ baa luri a lar a nya ajibi. 10Eyu bre bee kaa ba nna m ba kaa yuri ŋko a mɔ ŋko a jija nawule, ama ma ere ba nna nɛ basa e nya ŋkpa nseŋ nya kumo nɛnɛ ga.
11Ma e la mbolpɔkpapo lela na, mbolpɔkpapo lela na bee shin nɛ baa lara mbe ŋkpa ashi mo to nna a sa mbolpɔ na. 12Esa kama nɛ b ber paa nɛ e bee keni mbolpɔ so, mo alɛ ŋkaa maŋ la mbolpɔkpapo gbagba na, mo alɛ ŋkaa maŋ naa la mbolpɔ na wura na baŋ wu kuntuŋ ka bee ba, e bee shile nna a ka mbolpɔ na. Saŋɛ na so nɛ kuntuŋ na e pɛ mbolpɔ na be ako nɛ amo nɛ a ka e pesaŋ to. 13Amodoŋwura bee shile nna a yɔ a ka mbolpɔ na, ŋkpal manɛ so, b ber mo paa nna nɛ e bee keni amo so nɛ mbe shɛŋ maŋ wɔ amo to. 14Ma e la mbolpɔkpapo lela na, n nyi ma mbolpɔ nɛ ma mbolpɔ malɛ gba nyi ma, 15fanɛ kananɛ Etuto na nyi ma nɛ ma alɛ gba nyi Etuto na. Ma alɛ bee ta ma kumu nna a mɔ a sa bumo. 16Ŋ kraa kɔ mbolpɔ ko nɛ a maŋ wɔ mbolpɔ ere to. A daga fanɛ m bar loŋ be mbolpɔ na gba nɛ amo alɛ gba e ba kaa nu ma ebɔl nɛ amo kikɛ e baa la kukoŋwule nsaa kɔ ekpapo koŋwule. 17Kusɔ nɛ k ba nɛ n Tuto na bee sha ma na e la fanɛ ŋ ka shuli n ta ma ŋkpa a sa basa nɛ n naŋ bɛta n nya kumo so. 18Esa kikɛ maa sɔ kumo ŋ kutɔ. Ŋ gbagba e naa ta kumo a sa basa. Meeŋ tiŋ n ta kumo n sa basa nseŋ naŋ tiŋ n ta kumo a wɔtɔ. Loŋ nɛ n Tuto na yili fanɛ n wora.”
19Ndoŋ nna nɛ Juwebi na yaŋ barga to ŋkpal mmalga na so. 20Le nɛ bumo be bedamta daŋ kaŋɛ: “Kiyoyu lubi e wɔ mo to. E bee lɔ eboŋ nna. Manɛ so nɛ esa bee nu ede be mmalga!” 21Ama le nɛ beko malɛ daŋ kaŋɛ: “Asheŋ nɛ kanyɛn ere bee malga ere maŋ la mbuibilubiwura be mmalga. Nɛ nuso nɛ kiyoyu lubi bee wora a bugi betanpo be anishi?”
Juwebi na ka paŋ yirda be asheŋ
22B wɔtɔ loŋ nɛ bɔrɛlambu na be daŋkare be nshɛr ashi Jerusalɛm ya fo. Kumo be jemanɛ daa la awo to nna. 23Nɛ Yesu wɔ bɔrɛlambu na akpa a na kakpa nɛ baa tre Ewura Sɔlɔmɔn be kedɛdɛ na. 24Ndoŋ nna nɛ Juwebi na chala m ba mo kutɔ m ba bishi mo: “Manɛ e ba nɛ fo ta asheŋ ŋ ŋana anyi so n chɛr loŋ? Kaŋɛ anyi kashenteŋto preen: Fo e la Mesaya na a?” 25Nɛ Yesu kaŋɛ bumo: “N teŋ kaŋɛ menyi, ama menyi alɛ maŋ yirda ma. Emamachi be asheŋ nɛ ŋ kɔ n Tuto be ketre a wora ere e naa ji shɛda a kaŋɛ ma asheŋ. 26Ama menyi alɛ maŋ yirda ma ŋkpal men ka maŋ la ma mbolpɔ so so. 27Ma mbolpɔ bee nu ma ebɔl nɛ n nyi bumo nɛ baa bɛ ma so. 28Mee sa bumo ŋkpa nɛ k maŋ kɔ ekar na nɛ b sa maŋ wu kikɛ. Esa kama malɛ maaŋ tiŋ n suge bumo ashi ma enɔ to. 29N Tuto e ta bumo m bɔɔ ma enɔ, mo alɛ e chɔ kusɔ kikɛ, amoso, esa kama maaŋ tiŋ n suge bumo ashi n Tuto na be enɔ to kikɛ. 30Ma nɛ n Tuto na la kukoŋwule nna.”
31Ndoŋ nna nɛ Juwebi na yaŋ ta ajembu nɛ b kpa mo. 32Nɛ Yesu bishi bumo le: “Asheŋ lela damta nɛ a shi Etuto na kutɔ nɛ n wora ŋ ŋini menyi. To, nɛ amo be kumo so nɛ menyee kpal a sha nɛ men kpa ma ajembu ere?” 33Nɛ Juwebi na kaŋɛ mo: “Mannɛ kusɔ lela ko fo ka wora so nɛ anyee sha kekpa fo ajembu, ama ŋkpal fo ka baa la nyiŋgbasa nsaa tre fo kumu Ebɔrɛ nsaa malga a gbiti Ebɔrɛ na so.” 34Nɛ Yesu bishi bumo le: “Mannɛ menyi be mbra to nɛ Ebɔrɛ bee kaŋɛ fanɛ: ‘Men la ebɔrɛana nna na’ a? 35To, an nyi abɔrɛsibɛ na ka maa chɛrga kikɛ. Amoso, a ka kaŋɛ fanɛ Ebɔrɛ tre basa mo nɛ mbe kamalga ba bumo to ebɔrɛana ere, 36manɛ e ba nɛ menyee kaŋɛ ma, esa nɛ Etuto na gbagba lara n yili a sa mbe kumu nseŋ shuŋi durnya ere to na, fanɛ mee malga nna a gbiti Ebɔrɛ ŋkpal ŋ ka kaŋɛ fanɛ ma e la Ebɔrɛ Pibinyɛn na so? 37Nɛ m maa shuŋ n Tuto na be ashuŋ nna, kumo ere men sa maŋ yirda ma. 38Ama nɛ mee shuŋ mbe ashuŋ na nna nɛ men maŋ yirda ma gba, a daga fanɛ men yirda ashuŋ na bre, saŋɛ na so menyeeŋ pin fanɛ Etuto na wɔ ma to nɛ ma alɛ wɔ Etuto na to.”
39Ndoŋ nna nɛ b naŋ wora ania a sha kepɛ mo nɛ e gelge n lar bumo to n choŋ.
40Yesu ka lar ndoŋ nɛ e naŋ bɛta n yɔ Jɔɔdan be lɔr be kaba ndoŋ, kakpa nɛ Jɔn kabɔrɛbɛrpo daa bɛr basa kabɔrɛbɛr na. Ndoŋ nɛ e daŋ ya kaa wɔ. 41Nɛ basa damta daa ba mo kutɔ m ba kaa kaŋɛ: “Kashenteŋ nna fanɛ Jɔn kabɔrɛbɛrpo daa maŋ wora mamachi be kesheŋ kama, ama asheŋ nɛ e ji shɛda ŋ kaŋɛ kanyɛn ere be asheŋ na kikɛ la kashenteŋ nna chap.” 42Basa damta daŋ yirda mo ndoŋ.

english_text:
The Death of Lazarus
1-2 A man by the name of Lazarus was sick in the village of Bethany. He had two sisters, Mary and Martha. This was the same Mary who later poured perfume on the Lord's head and wiped his feet with her hair. 3The sisters sent a message to the Lord and told him that his good friend Lazarus was sick.
4When Jesus heard this, he said, “His sickness won't end in death. It will bring glory to God and his Son.”
5Jesus loved Martha and her sister and brother. 6But he stayed where he was for two more days. 7Then he said to his disciples, “Now we will go back to Judea.”
8“Teacher,” they said, “the people there want to stone you to death! Why do you want to go back?”
9Jesus answered, “Aren't there twelve hours in each day? If you walk during the day, you will have light from the sun, and you won't stumble. 10But if you walk during the night, you will stumble, because you don't have any light.” 11Then he told them, “Our friend Lazarus is asleep, and I am going there to wake him up.”
12They replied, “Lord, if he is asleep, he will get better.” 13Jesus really meant that Lazarus was dead, but they thought he was talking only about sleep.
14Then Jesus told them plainly, “Lazarus is dead! 15I am glad I wasn't there, because now you will have a chance to put your faith in me. Let's go to him.”
16Thomas, whose nickname was “Twin,” said to the other disciples, “Come on. Let's go, so we can die with him.”
Jesus Brings Lazarus to Life
17When Jesus got to Bethany, he found that Lazarus had already been in the tomb four days. 18Bethany was less than three kilometers from Jerusalem, 19and many people had come from the city to comfort Martha and Mary because their brother had died.
20When Martha heard that Jesus had arrived, she went out to meet him, but Mary stayed in the house. 21Martha said to Jesus, “Lord, if you had been here, my brother would not have died. 22Yet even now I know that God will do anything you ask.”
23Jesus told her, “Your brother will live again!”
24 Martha answered, “I know he will be raised to life on the last day, when all the dead are raised.”
25Jesus then said, “I am the one who raises the dead to life! Everyone who has faith in me will live, even if they die. 26And everyone who lives because of faith in me will never really die. Do you believe this?”
27“Yes, Lord!” she replied. “I believe you are the Christ, the Son of God. You are the one we hoped would come into the world.”
28After Martha said this, she went and privately said to her sister Mary, “The Teacher is here, and he wants to see you.” 29As soon as Mary heard this, she got up and went out to Jesus. 30He was still outside the village where Martha had gone to meet him. 31Many people had come to comfort Mary, and when they saw her quickly leave the house, they thought she was going out to the tomb to cry. So they followed her.
32Mary went to where Jesus was. Then as soon as she saw him, she knelt at his feet and said, “Lord, if you had been here, my brother would not have died.”
33When Jesus saw that Mary and the people with her were crying, he was terribly upset 34and asked, “Where have you put his body?”
They replied, “Lord, come and you will see.”
35Jesus started crying, 36and the people said, “See how much he loved Lazarus.”
37Some of them said, “He gives sight to the blind. Why couldn't he have kept Lazarus from dying?”
38Jesus was still terribly upset. So he went to the tomb, which was a cave with a stone rolled against the entrance. 39Then he told the people to roll the stone away. But Martha said, “Lord, you know that Lazarus has been dead four days, and there will be a bad smell.”
40Jesus replied, “Didn't I tell you that if you had faith, you would see the glory of God?”
41After the stone had been rolled aside, Jesus looked up toward heaven and prayed, “Father, I thank you for answering my prayer. 42I know that you always answer my prayers. But I said this, so the people here would believe you sent me.”
43When Jesus had finished praying, he shouted, “Lazarus, come out!” 44The man who had been dead came out. His hands and feet were wrapped with strips of burial cloth, and a cloth covered his face.
Jesus then told the people, “Untie him and let him go.”
The Plot To Kill Jesus
(Matthew 26.1-5; Mark 14.1,2; Luke 22.1,2)
45Many of the people who had come to visit Mary saw the things Jesus did, and they put their faith in him. 46Others went to the Pharisees and told what Jesus had done. 47Then the chief priests and the Pharisees called the council together and said, “What should we do? This man is working a lot of miracles. 48If we don't stop him now, everyone will put their faith in him. Then the Romans will come and destroy our temple and our nation.”
49One of the council members was Caiaphas, who was also high priest that year. He spoke up and said, “You people don't have any sense at all! 50Don't you know it is better for one person to die for the people than for the whole nation to be destroyed?” 51Caiaphas did not say this on his own. As high priest that year, he was prophesying that Jesus would die for the nation. 52Yet Jesus would not die just for the Jewish nation. He would die to bring together all of God's scattered people. 53From that day on, the council started making plans to put Jesus to death.
54Because of this plot against him, Jesus stopped going around in public. He went to the town of Ephraim, which was near the desert, and he stayed there with his disciples.
55It was almost time for Passover. Many of the Jewish people who lived out in the country had come to Jerusalem to get themselves ready for the festival. 56They looked around for Jesus. Then when they were in the temple, they asked each other, “You don't think he will come here for Passover, do you?”
57The chief priests and the Pharisees told the people to let them know if any of them saw Jesus. This is how they hoped to arrest him.
translation_text:
Lazɔrɔs be luwu be asheŋ
1Kanyɛn ko e daa wɔtɔ nɛ baa tre mo Lazɔrɔs nɛ e daa lɔ. Mo nɛ Mɛɛri nɛ mo da Maata kikɛ daŋ shi Bɛtani nna. 2Mɛɛri ere e la emo nɛ e daŋ chulgi tulale dufɛso ko n wurge Enyɛnpe be aya so nseŋ ta mbe emin m melti amo na, mo alɛ mo siponyɛn e daa la Lazɔrɔs mo nɛ e daa lɔ na. 3Lazɔrɔs ka bee lɔ na nɛ mo sipocheana na shuŋi fanɛ b ya kaŋɛ Yesu. B yɛ: “Enyɛnpe, fo teri kpakpaso na bee lɔ.” 4Yesu ka nu kubɔya na nɛ e kaŋɛ: “Lazɔrɔs be kulɔ ere be lalaloge maŋ la luwu. K la kusɔ nɛ k beeŋ ba bar Ebɔrɛ kemaŋkura nna, saŋɛ na so nɛ ma, Ebɔrɛ Pibinyɛn na e nya kemaŋkura ashi kumo to.” 5Yesu daa sha Maata nɛ mo sipo Mɛɛri nɛ Lazɔrɔs be asheŋ ga. 6Ŋkeshin nɛ e ka nu fanɛ Lazɔrɔs bee lɔ na nɛ e shir a wɔ kakpa nɛ e daa wɔ na nchɛnnyɔ pɔɛŋ nseŋ ba kaŋɛ mbe bebɛsopo na le: 7“Men shin nɛ an naŋ yɔ Judiya.” 8Ndoŋ nna nɛ b kaŋɛ mo: “Eŋinipo, nchɛnnyɔ ere to nɛ Juwebi na daa sha kekpa fo ajembu ndoŋ nɛ fo naa kaŋɛ fanɛ an yɔ ndoŋ a?” 9Nɛ Yesu bishi bumo le: “Mannɛ awa kuduanyɔ e wɔ yili epeŋi be kepete n ya fo kumo be ketɔr to a? Esa kama malɛ nɛ e bee nite kapaso, maa fiti, ŋkpal manɛ so, durnya ere be kefulto nɛ e bee wu a nite. 10E baa nite kanyɛso nɛ e beeŋ baa fiti, ŋkpal manɛ so, e maŋ kɔ kefulto.” 11Yesu ka malga le n loge nɛ e naŋ kaŋɛ bumo: “An teri Lazɔrɔs bee di, ama mee yɔ nɛ n ya tiŋi mo.” 12Ndoŋ nna nɛ mbe bebɛsopo na kaŋɛ mo: “Enyɛnpe, nɛ e bee di bre, kumo ere e beeŋ nya alenfia.” 13Lazɔrɔs be luwu be asheŋ nɛ Yesu daa malga, ama mbe bebɛsopo na bre daŋ fɛ fanɛ edi gbagba nɛ e daa de. 14Ndoŋ nna nɛ Yesu bugi to ŋ kaŋɛ bumo: “Lazɔrɔs wu. 15Ama ŋkpal menyi so, k par ma ga fanɛ ŋ ka maŋ wɔ ndoŋ nɛ e wu, ŋkpal manɛ so, loŋ e naaŋ shin nɛ men yirda ma asheŋ. Ama naniere, men shin nɛ an yɔ mo kutɔ.” 16Ndoŋ nna nɛ Tɔmas nɛ baa tre kaborobi na kaŋɛ mo braana bebɛsopo na le: “Men shin nɛ an kikɛ e yɔ nɛ anyi nɛ mo kikɛ e ya wu ndoŋ.”
Yesu ka wushi Lazɔrɔs mo sipocheana kagbene be asheŋ
17Yesu ka ba fo Bɛtani nɛ e nu fanɛ b teŋ puli Lazɔrɔs kejembulaŋ to kumo be nchɛ nna. 18Bɛtani nɛ Jerusalɛm daa maŋ fo emayɛl anyɔ, 19amoso, Juwebi damta daŋ shi ndoŋ nna m ba nɛ b ba wushi Maata nɛ Mɛɛri kagbene ŋkpal bumo siponyɛn ka wu so. 20Maata ka nu fanɛ Yesu bee ba nɛ e lar n yɔ nɛ e ya shɛr mo to, ama Mɛɛri bre daŋ shir a wɔ laŋ to nna. 21Maata ka ya tu Yesu nɛ e kaŋɛ mo le: “Enyɛnpe, fo daa wɔ nfe nna n siponyɛn ere daa maaŋ wu. 22Ama naniere gba n nyi fanɛ kusɔ kama nɛ fo kule Ebɔrɛ, e beeŋ sa fo kumo.” 23Nɛ Yesu kaŋɛ mo le: “Fo siponyɛn ere beeŋ naŋ tiŋi.” 24Nɛ Maata kaŋɛ mo: “N nyi e ka beeŋ tiŋi ashi luwu to lalaloge be kachɛ na.” 25Nɛ Yesu kaŋɛ mo: “Ma e la esa nɛ e bee tiŋi basa ashi luwu to a sa bumo ŋkpa na, nɛ esa kama nɛ e yirda ma beeŋ nya ŋkpa hale nɛ e wu gba. 26Esa kama malɛ nɛ e wɔ ŋkpa to nseŋ yirda ma, maaŋ naŋ wu kikɛ. Fo yirda kesheŋ ere a?” 27Nɛ Maata shuli ŋ kaŋɛ: “Mm, Enyɛnpe, n yirda kumo. N yirda fanɛ fo e la Mesaya, Ebɔrɛ Pibinyɛn nɛ Ebɔrɛ kaŋɛ fanɛ e beeŋ ba durnya to na.” 28Maata ka malga loŋ n loge nɛ e bɛta n yɔ epe n ya tre mo sipo Mɛɛri n lar ekarso ŋ kaŋɛ mo: “Eŋinipo na ba nsaa fin fo.” 29Mɛɛri ka nu loŋ nɛ e koso manaŋ n yɔ Yesu kutɔ. 30Jemanɛ na so malɛ nɛ Yesu maŋ naŋ luri kade to nɛ e kraa wɔ kakpa nɛ Maata ya tu mo na. 31Juwebi nɛ bumo nɛ Mɛɛri daa tase ebu to nɛ baa wushi mo kagbene na ka wu kananɛ e kpa ŋ koso manaŋ n lar kowu na nɛ b koso m bɛ mo so a fɛ fanɛ e daa yɔ nchaŋ na akpa nna nɛ e ya shu. 32Mɛɛri ka fo kakpa nɛ Yesu daa wɔ na nseŋ wu mo nɛ e gbir Yesu be anishito nseŋ kaŋɛ: “Enyɛnpe, fo daa wɔ nfe nna, n siponyɛn ere daa maaŋ wu.” 33Yesu ka wu kananɛ e daa shu na nɛ kananɛ Juwebi nɛ b daŋ bɛ mo so m ba na kikɛ daa shu na nɛ mbe kagbene kaa nseŋ jija mo. 34Ndoŋ nna nɛ e bishi bumo: “Nnɛ nɛ men ta mo n nase?” Nɛ b kaŋɛ mo: “Ba keni ndoŋ Enyɛnpe.” 35Yesu shu. 36Ndoŋ nna nɛ Juwebi na kaŋɛ le: “Men keni e bee sha mo pasaa.” 37Ndoŋ nna nɛ beko kaŋɛ le: “Esa nɛ e bee tiŋ a bugi tanpo be anishi, ama e daa maaŋ tiŋ n shin nɛ kanyɛn ere e sa maŋ wu a?”
Yesu ka tiŋi Lazɔrɔs luwu to be asheŋ
38Ndoŋ nna nɛ Yesu be kagbene naŋ kaa nɛ e ta m ba nchaŋ na akpa. Kumo alɛ daa la kejembulaŋ nna nɛ b ta kejembu kpaŋgalaŋ ko m buu kumo be kɔnɔ so. 39Yesu ka ba ndoŋ nɛ e kaŋɛ: “Men ta kejembu na ashi nchaŋ na be kɔnɔ so.” Ndoŋ nna nɛ Maata, kanyɛn na mo sipoche na kaŋɛ Yesu le: “Enyɛnpe, mbe nchɛ nna nna na nchaŋ ere to, amoso, naniere e beeŋ baa dufɛ.” 40Nɛ Yesu bishi mo: “M maŋ kaŋɛ fo fanɛ nɛ fo yirda feeŋ wu Ebɔrɛ be kemaŋkura a?” 41Ndoŋ nna nɛ b lara kejembu na nɛ Yesu keni esoso nseŋ kaŋɛ: “Etuto, mee chɔrɔ fo ga fanɛ fo nu ma kekule. 42N nyi fo ka bee nu ma kekule saŋkikɛ, ama ŋ kaŋɛ loŋ nna ŋkpal basa nɛ b yil nfe ere so nɛ b yirda fanɛ fo e shuŋi ma.” 43Yesu ka malga le n loge nɛ e tre awɔrso ŋ kaŋɛ: “Lazɔrɔs, lar m ba!” 44Ndoŋ nna nɛ ebuni na lar nchaŋ na to m ba nɛ mbe kebuni be ameato kraa mea mo to nɛ kechɛbi ko gba mea mbe anishiakpa. Nɛ Yesu kaŋɛ basa na: “Men saŋɛ n saŋɛ bubuni be ameato na nseŋ shin nɛ e yɔ.”
B ka kre Yesu be kemɔ be nia be asheŋ
(Matiu 26:1-5; Maak 14:1-2; Luuk 22:1-2)
45Ŋkpal kesheŋ ere so Juwebi nɛ b daŋ ba nɛ b ba chɔrɔ Mɛɛri nseŋ wu kusɔ nɛ Yesu daŋ wora na be bedamta daŋ yirda Yesu nna. 46Nɛ beko malɛ yɔ Efarisiana na kutɔ n ya kaŋɛ bumo kusɔ nɛ Yesu daŋ wora na. 47Ndoŋ nna nɛ Efarisiana na nɛ bɔrɛmatapowuraana na shɛr kɔɔtiebi nɛ b daa tre Sanhedrinebi na ŋ kaŋɛ: “Men keni emamachisheŋ damta nɛ kanyɛn ere bee wora ere, nuso nɛ anyeeŋ wora? 48An baŋ yige mo nɛ e wɔtɔ a wora le be asheŋ ere, ekama beeŋ yirda mo nɛ Romebi na e ba m ba jija anyi be bɔrɛlambu ere nseŋ ta anyi be efuli ere kikɛ n ti so.” 49Ndoŋ nna nɛ bumo be eko nɛ baa tre Kayafas nɛ e daa la bɔrɛmatapo nimuso amo be kafɛ na kaŋɛ le: “Men maŋ nyi shɛŋ. 50Men maŋ nyi fanɛ nɛ esa koŋwule wu n sa basa, loŋ bɔ n sa menyi a chɔ efuli ere kikɛ ka mur a?” 51Kesheŋ ere e ka malga ere daa maŋ shi mo gbagba to, ama ŋkpal e ka daa la bɔrɛmatapo nimuso amo be kamoafɛ na so so nɛ e daa wu a kaŋɛ fanɛ Yesu e daa shin nɛ e wu n sa efuli na so ebi na. 52Mannɛ bumo nɛ b daa wɔ efuli na so na nawule gba, ama e daa shin nɛ e wu n sa Ebɔrɛ be mbia nɛ b daŋ pesaŋ to a wɔ mboŋ pɔtɛana na kikɛ gba, saŋɛ na so e beeŋ bar bumo abar so n shin nɛ b ba ki kukoŋwule. 53Amoso, baŋ yili kumo be kachɛ na a yɔ nɛ basa na kre Yesu be kemɔ be nia.
54Amoso, Yesu daa maŋ naa bugi to a nite Juwebi na to. E daŋ lar bumo to nna n yɔ kadebi mo nɛ baa tre Efrayim na nna ashi kasawule nɛ k mata keshishɛrsawule so na nɛ mo nɛ mbe bebɛsopo ya kaa wɔ ndoŋ.
55Saŋɛ na so nɛ Juwebi be Kebansonchoŋ be kejigboŋ be saŋɛ bee fo nɛ basa damta shi ndewurbiana na to n juŋkpar n yɔ nɛ b ya fɔr bumo be amu so pɔɛŋ nɛ Kebansonchoŋ be kachɛ na gbagba e fo. 56Basa na daa wɔ ndoŋ nna a fin Yesu nseŋ ya yili bɔrɛlambu na akpa a bishi abar le: “Nuso nɛ fee fɛ, fo tama fanɛ e maaŋ ba Kejigboŋ ere to nna kuraa ŋko nuso?” 57Saŋɛ na malɛ so bɔrɛmatapowuraana na nɛ Efarisiana na sa ebɔl fanɛ esa kama nɛ e nyi kakpa nɛ Yesu daa wɔ, amodoŋwura e ba kaŋɛ bumo nɛ b nya mo m pɛ.

english_text:
At Bethany
(Matthew 26.6-13; Mark 14.3-9)
1Six days before Passover Jesus went back to Bethany, where he had raised Lazarus from death. 2A meal had been prepared for Jesus. Martha was doing the serving, and Lazarus himself was there.
3 Mary took a very expensive bottle of perfume and poured it on Jesus' feet. She wiped them with her hair, and the sweet smell of the perfume filled the house.
4A disciple named Judas Iscariot was there. He was the one who was going to betray Jesus, and he asked, 5“Why wasn't this perfume sold for 300 silver coins and the money given to the poor?” 6Judas did not really care about the poor. He asked this because he carried the moneybag and sometimes would steal from it.
7Jesus replied, “Leave her alone! She has kept this perfume for the day of my burial. 8 You will always have the poor with you, but you won't always have me.”
A Plot To Kill Lazarus
9A lot of people came when they heard that Jesus was there. They also wanted to see Lazarus, because Jesus had raised him from death. 10So the chief priests made plans to kill Lazarus. 11He was the reason that many of the people were turning from them and putting their faith in Jesus.
Jesus Enters Jerusalem
(Matthew 21.1-11; Mark 11.1-11; Luke 19.28-40)
12The next day a large crowd was in Jerusalem for Passover. When they heard that Jesus was coming for the festival, 13 they took palm branches and went out to greet him. They shouted,
“Hooray!
God bless the one who comes
in the name of the Lord!
God bless the King
of Israel!”
14Jesus found a donkey and rode on it, just as the Scriptures say,
15 “People of Jerusalem,
don't be afraid!
Your King is now coming,
and he is riding
on a donkey.”
16At first, Jesus' disciples did not understand. But after he had been given his glory, they remembered all this. Everything had happened exactly as the Scriptures said it would.
17-18A crowd had come to meet Jesus because they had seen him call Lazarus out of the tomb. They kept talking about him and this miracle. 19But the Pharisees said to each other, “There is nothing we can do! Everyone in the world is following Jesus.”
Some Greeks Want To Meet Jesus
20Some Greeks had gone to Jerusalem to worship during Passover. 21Philip from Bethsaida in Galilee was there too. So they went to him and said, “Sir, we would like to meet Jesus.” 22Philip told Andrew. Then the two of them went to Jesus and told him.
The Son of Man Must Be Lifted Up
23Jesus said:
The time has come for the Son of Man to be given his glory. 24I tell you for certain that a grain of wheat that falls on the ground will never be more than one grain unless it dies. But if it dies, it will produce lots of wheat. 25 If you love your life, you will lose it. If you give it up in this world, you will be given eternal life. 26If you serve me, you must go with me. My servants will be with me wherever I am. If you serve me, my Father will honor you.
27Now I am deeply troubled, and I don't know what to say. But I must not ask my Father to keep me from this time of suffering. In fact, I came into the world to suffer. 28So Father, bring glory to yourself.
A voice from heaven then said, “I have already brought glory to myself, and I will do it again!” 29When the crowd heard the voice, some of them thought it was thunder. Others thought an angel had spoken to Jesus.
30Then Jesus told the crowd, “That voice spoke to help you, not me. 31This world's people are now being judged, and the ruler of this world is already being thrown out! 32If I am lifted up above the earth, I will make everyone want to come to me.” 33Jesus was talking about the way he would be put to death.
34 The crowd said to Jesus, “The Scriptures teach that the Messiah will live forever. How can you say that the Son of Man must be lifted up? Who is this Son of Man?”
35Jesus answered, “The light will be with you for only a little longer. Walk in the light while you can. Then you won't be caught walking blindly in the dark. 36Have faith in the light while it is with you, and you will be children of the light.”
The People Refuse To Have Faith in Jesus
After Jesus had said these things, he left and went into hiding. 37He had worked a lot of miracles among the people, but they were still not willing to have faith in him. 38 This happened so that what the prophet Isaiah had said would come true,
“Lord, who has believed
our message?
And who has seen
your mighty strength?”
39The people could not have faith in Jesus, because Isaiah had also said,
40 “The Lord has blinded
the eyes of the people,
and he has made
the people stubborn.
He did this so that they
could not see
or understand,
and so that they
would not turn to the Lord
and be healed.”
41Isaiah said this, because he saw the glory of Jesus and spoke about him. 42Even then, many of the leaders put their faith in Jesus, but they did not tell anyone about it. The Pharisees had already given orders for the people not to have anything to do with anyone who had faith in Jesus. 43And besides, the leaders liked praise from others more than they liked praise from God.
Jesus Came To Save the World
44In a loud voice Jesus said:
Everyone who has faith in me also has faith in the one who sent me. 45And everyone who has seen me has seen the one who sent me. 46I am the light that has come into the world. No one who has faith in me will stay in the dark.
47I am not the one who will judge those who refuse to obey my teachings. I came to save the people of this world, not to be their judge. 48But everyone who rejects me and my teachings will be judged on the last day by what I have said. 49I don't speak on my own. I say only what the Father who sent me has told me to say. 50I know that his commands will bring eternal life. This is why I tell you exactly what the Father has told me.
translation_text:
B ka chulgi tulale n wurge Yesu so be asheŋ
(Matiu 26:6-13; Maak 14:3-9)
1A ka ba ka fanɛ nchɛ nshe nɛ Kebansonchoŋ be kejigboŋ na e fo nɛ Yesu yɔ Bɛtani, kade nɛ Lazɔrɔs nɛ e daŋ tiŋi luwu to na daa wɔ na. 2Ndoŋ nna nɛ Lazɔrɔs nɛ mo sipocheana na wora ajibi nɛ b keta Yesu kufɔ. Maata e daa chige ajibi na nɛ Lazɔrɔs malɛ nɛ basa nɛ b daa wɔ ndoŋ na tu Yesu a tase ejikpa. 3Ndoŋ nna nɛ Mɛɛri ta amansherbi damta be tulale dufɛso be kɔlbagboŋ ko m ba ta amo n wurge Yesu be aya so nseŋ gbir n ta mbe emin m melti tulale na ŋ gbiti amo n wɔtɔ Yesu be aya so. Ndoŋ nna nɛ tulale na be efɛa sɔ ebu na kikɛ to verr. 4Ama mbe bebɛsopo na to be emo nɛ b daa tre Judas Iskareɔt nɛ e daa beeŋ debɔr Yesu na bishi le: 5“To, manɛ e ba nɛ b daa maŋ ta tulale ere n fa n nya pɔŋ alfa asa n ta amansherbi na n sa betirpo?” 6Mannɛ fanɛ betirpo be asheŋ ka tir mo so so nɛ e daŋ kaŋɛ loŋ, ama e daa la eyu nna. Mo e daa la katuŋ na be amansherbikenipo, amoso, e daa wɔtɔ nna a lara amansherbi na be ako a wɔtɔ mbe jifa to. 7Nɛ Yesu kaŋɛ bumo le: “Men yige mo. Kusɔ nɛ e daa beeŋ wora ma ma kepuliachɛ nna na. 8Saŋkama menyi nɛ betirpo e naaŋ baa la, ama ma ere nɛ menyi maaŋ baa la saŋkama.”
9Asheŋ ere ka bee wora ere nɛ Juwebi na be bedamta nu fanɛ Yesu ba Bɛtani nseŋ ba nɛ b ba keni mo. Mannɛ Yesu malɛ gba nawule so nɛ b daŋ ba, b daŋ ba nna nɛ b ba keni Lazɔrɔs nɛ Yesu tiŋi luwu to na. 10Amoso, bɔrɛmatapowuraana na daa kre Lazɔrɔs gba be kemɔ nna. 11Ŋkpal manɛ so, mo so nɛ Juwebi na be bedamta daa yɔ Yesu kutɔ n ya kaa yirda mo.
Yesu ka luri Jerusalɛm bunyanso be asheŋ
(Matiu 21:1-11; Maak 11:1-11; Luuk 19:28-40)
12Kumo be ŋklade nɛ jimaŋ damta nɛ k ba Kejigboŋ na to na nu fanɛ Yesu lar m pɛ Jerusalɛm be ekpa nɛ e yɔ ndoŋ. 13Ndoŋ nna nɛ b fɛta n fɛta abii be ayabi n lar n yɔ nɛ b ya tu mo nsaa ponte a kaŋɛ:
“Hosana,
nɛfa la esa nɛ e shi Enyɛnpe be ketre to a ba na peya nna.
Nɛfa la mo, Israɛl be Ewura na peya nna.”
14Saŋɛ ere so nɛ Yesu fin kurmafɔlbi ko n chena kumo so nɛ abɔrɛsibɛ na e bɔla ekpa. A yɛ:
15“O Zayɔn, sa maa lɔ kufu,
keni fo Ewura e dii kurmafɔlbi a ba na.”
16Saŋɛ nɛ asheŋ ere wora na mbe bebɛsopo na daa maŋ pin amo to she saŋɛ nɛ Yesu ba nya mbe kemaŋkura na pɔɛŋ nɛ k ba bumo be nfɛra to fanɛ asheŋ nɛ a daŋ wora na kikɛ daa dese abɔrɛsibɛ na to a kute mbe asheŋ nseŋ naŋ nyiŋi fanɛ b wora mo asheŋ na kikɛ nyam. 17Saŋɛ ere so malɛ kikɛ nɛ basa nɛ b daa wɔ mo kutɔ kachɛ nɛ e tiŋi Lazɔrɔs ashi luwu to nseŋ tre mo ashi nchaŋ to na, wɔtɔ a kɔ loŋ be kubɔya na a kela kaplɛkama. 18Basa damta na daŋ lar n yɔ mo kutɔ nna ŋkpal mamachi be kesheŋ nɛ b daŋ nu e ka daŋ wora na so. 19Ndoŋ nna nɛ Efarisiana na kaŋɛ abar le: “Men keni, an maaŋ tiŋ n wora shɛŋ nna na, ŋkpal manɛ so, durnya kikɛ e muu a bɛ mo so na.”
Griikebi ko ka ba kaa fin Yesu be asheŋ
20Griikebi ko malɛ gba daŋ ti basa nɛ b daŋ yɔ Jerusalɛm to be Kejigboŋ be nshɛr na to nɛ b ya bunyaŋ Ebɔrɛ na so. 21Ndoŋ nna nɛ b ba Filip nɛ e daŋ shi Bɛtsaida nɛ k wɔ Galili na kutɔ m ba kaŋɛ mo le: “Kowurnyɛn, jande, anyee sha kewu Yesu nna.” 22Ndoŋ nna nɛ Filip ya kaŋɛ Andru nɛ bumo benyɔ ya kaŋɛ Yesu. 23Nɛ Yesu kaŋɛ bumo le: “Naniere bre jemanɛ nɛ ma, Nyiŋgbasa Pibinyɛn beeŋ nya kemaŋkura na fo. 24Ma e kaŋɛ menyi kashenteŋto na fanɛ kuyubi baa maŋ tɔr shishɛr to n wu, k beeŋ baa la keduusobi koŋwule nna saŋkikɛ. Ama nɛ fanɛ k baŋ tɔr shishɛr to ŋ kɔr pɔɛŋ nseŋ wu, k bee bar asɔrso damta nna. 25Esa kama nɛ e bee sha mbe ŋkpa ga beeŋ paŋ kumo, ama ekama nɛ e maa ta mbe ŋkpa ere a tre shɛŋ durnya ere to, beeŋ nya mbe ŋkpa nɛ kebaawɔ ŋkpa ere to mbaanaayɔ. 26Esa kama nɛ e bee shuŋ ma, e baa bɛ ma so nɛ kaplɛkama malɛ nɛ n wɔ, ndoŋ nɛ ma kenya gba beeŋ baa wɔ. N Tuto malɛ beeŋ bunyaŋ esa kama nɛ e bee shuŋ ma.”
Yesu ka malga mbe luwu be asheŋ
27Naniere ma kagbene maŋ dese ma, ama nuso nɛ meeŋ wora? Ŋ kaŋɛ n Tuto fanɛ: ‘Etuto, mɔlga ma ashi le be kenishipere ere to,’ ŋko nuso? Ayai, m maaŋ wora loŋ, ŋkpal manɛ so, loŋ so nɛ m ba nɛ m ba ji saŋɛ ere so be awurfoŋ. 28N Tuto, maŋkura fo ketre. Ndoŋ nna nɛ ebɔl shi ebɔrɛso ŋ kaŋɛ: “N teŋ maŋkura kumo, ama meeŋ naŋ maŋkura kumo.” 29Jimaŋ nɛ k daa wɔ ndoŋ na ka nu ebɔl na be egbri na nɛ beko kaŋɛ fanɛ bɔrɛ e ponte to nɛ beko malɛ kaŋɛ fanɛ malaika e malga mo kutɔ. 30Nɛ Yesu kaŋɛ bumo le: “Menyi so nɛ ebɔl na lar na, mannɛ ma so. 31Naniere bre keji durnya ere demu be saŋɛ fo, naniere nɛ kegboŋi durnya ere to be ejuŋkparpo na ashi mbe kejuŋkpar na to na fo. 32Ama nɛ b kaŋ maŋ ma so ashi kasawule ere so bre, meeŋ bar basa kikɛ ŋ kutɔ.” 33E daŋ malga le nna a ŋini luwu mo nɛ e daa beeŋ wu be asheŋ. 34Ndoŋ nna nɛ jimaŋ na kaŋɛ mo le: “Anyee nu ashi anyi be mbra na to fanɛ Mesaya na beeŋ ba kaa wɔ ŋkpa to mbaanaayɔ nɛ a ji nuso nna nɛ fee kaŋɛ: ‘Baaŋ maŋ Nyiŋgbasa Pibinyɛn na so’? Wanɛ nɛ fee tre Nyiŋgbasa Pibinyɛn na?” 35Nɛ Yesu kaŋɛ bumo: “Kefulto na maaŋ naŋ chɛr menyi kutɔ. Amoso, men ka kraa kɔ kumo menyi to ere bre, men baa na kumo to, saŋɛ na so, tentembiri maaŋ luri menyi to. Esa kama nɛ e na tentembiri to maa pin kakpa nɛ e bee yɔ. 36Men ka kraa kɔ kefulto ere bre, men ta menyi be yirda n wɔtɔ kumo to, saŋɛ na so menyeeŋ baa la kefulto be basa.”
E ka malga n loge nɛ e lar basa na to n ya ŋana.
Juwebi ka maŋ kɔ yirda be asheŋ
37Yesu daŋ wora emamachisheŋ damta ere kikɛ bumo be anishito, ama bumo alɛ daa maŋ yirda mo. 38Loŋ be kesheŋ na malɛ daŋ wora nna nɛ anebi Aizaaya be kamalga nɛ e daŋ malga na e bɔla ekpa. Le nɛ e daŋ bishi Ebɔrɛ: “Enyɛnpe, wanɛ e yirda kubɔya nɛ an bɔ na? Nɛ basa mo nɛ Enyɛnpe ŋini mbe eleŋ na?” 39Ŋkpal loŋ so, b daa maŋ tiŋ n yirda, ŋkpal manɛ so, loŋ malɛ nɛ Aizaaya kaŋɛ kakpa ko na fanɛ Ebɔrɛ kaŋɛ: 40“N tan bumo be anishiana nseŋ ti bumo be ŋgbeneana, nɛ mannɛ aloŋ, bumo be anishiana beeŋ bugi asheŋ be kewuto nɛ bumo be ŋgbene e bugi asheŋ be kepinto nɛ b ba ma kutɔ nɛ n lara bumo ashi bumo be kebaawɔtɔ na to n sa bumo kebaawɔtɔ popɔr.” 41Anebi Aizaaya daŋ kaŋɛ le nna ŋkpal e ka daŋ wu Yesu be kemaŋkura nseŋ malga mbe asheŋ na so. 42Ŋkeshin nɛ benimu na to gba be bedamta daŋ yirda Yesu, ama ŋkpal Efarisiana so, b daa maa sha kebugi to ŋ kaŋɛ fanɛ b yirda mo ŋkpal b ka daa maa sha fanɛ b ju bumo ashi nshɛrbuana na to be keluri to so. 43Bumo alɛ ka daa sha mbo ashi basa kutɔ a chɔ Ebɔrɛ kutɔ na so e shin nɛ b daa wora loŋ.
Kusɔ nɛ k bar Yesu be asheŋ
44Ndoŋ nna nɛ Yesu malga awɔrso ŋ kaŋɛ le: “Esa baŋ yirda ma, mannɛ ma nawule nɛ e yirda, ama emo nɛ e shuŋi ma na gba nɛ e yirda. 45E baŋ keni ma, e bee wu esa nɛ e shuŋi ma na nna. 46M ba durnya to nna fanɛ kefulto na, saŋɛ na so, ekama nɛ e yirda ma, maaŋ shir a wɔ tentembiri to. 47Ama ekama nɛ e nu ma mmalga ŋkaa maa ta amo a wɔtɔ mo to, m maa kaŋɛ fanɛ e daga kasogberge, ŋkpal manɛ so, m maŋ ba na nɛ m ba ji durnya demu. M ba na nɛ m ba mɔlga durnya. 48Esa kama nɛ e bee kini ma a maa sɔ ma mmalga na kɔ esa nɛ e beeŋ ji mo demu. Mmalga nɛ m malga na gbagba e naaŋ ki amodoŋwura be demujipo lalaloge be kachɛ na. 49Ŋkpal manɛ so, mannɛ ŋ gbagba be eleŋ to so nɛ m malga, Etuto nɛ e shuŋi ma na e nase kusɔ nɛ meeŋ kaŋɛ nɛ kananɛ meeŋ kaŋɛ kumo n sa ma. 50N nyi mbe kamalga naseso ka bee bar ŋkpa nɛ k maŋ kɔ ekar na, amoso, kusɔ kama nɛ m malga baa la kusɔ nɛ Etuto na kaŋɛ fanɛ ŋ kaŋɛ nna.”

english_text:
Jesus Washes the Feet of His Disciples
1It was before Passover, and Jesus knew that the time had come for him to leave this world and to return to the Father. He had always loved his followers in this world, and he loved them to the very end.
2Even before the evening meal started, the devil had made Judas, the son of Simon Iscariot, decide to betray Jesus.
3Jesus knew he had come from God and would go back to God. He also knew that the Father had given him complete power. 4So during the meal Jesus got up, removed his outer garment, and wrapped a towel around his waist. 5He put some water into a large bowl. Then he began washing his disciples' feet and drying them with the towel he was wearing.
6But when he came to Simon Peter, this disciple asked, “Lord, are you going to wash my feet?”
7Jesus answered, “You don't really know what I am doing, but later you will understand.”
8“You will never wash my feet!” Peter replied.
“If I don't wash you,” Jesus told him, “you don't really belong to me.”
9Peter said, “Lord, don't wash just my feet. Wash my hands and my head.”
10Jesus answered, “People who have bathed and are clean all over need to wash just their feet. And you, my disciples, are clean, except for one of you.” 11Jesus knew who would betray him. That is why he said, “except for one of you.”
12 After Jesus had washed his disciples' feet and had put his outer garment back on, he sat down again. Then he said:
Do you understand what I have done? 13You call me your teacher and Lord, and you should, because that is who I am. 14And if your Lord and teacher has washed your feet, you should do the same for each other. 15I have set the example, and you should do for each other exactly what I have done for you. 16 I tell you for certain that servants are not greater than their master, and messengers are not greater than the one who sent them. 17You know these things, and God will bless you, if you do them.
18 I am not talking about all of you. I know the ones I have chosen. But what the Scriptures say must come true. And they say, “The man who ate with me has turned against me!” 19I am telling you this before it all happens. Then when it does happen, you will believe who I am. 20 I tell you for certain that anyone who welcomes my messengers also welcomes me, and anyone who welcomes me welcomes the one who sent me.
Jesus Tells What Will Happen to Him
(Matthew 26.20-25; Mark 14.17-21; Luke 22.21-23)
21After Jesus had said these things, he was deeply troubled and told his disciples, “I tell you for certain that one of you will betray me.” 22They were confused about what he meant. And they just stared at each other.
23Jesus' favorite disciple was sitting next to him at the meal, 24and Simon motioned for this disciple to find out which one Jesus meant. 25So the disciple leaned toward Jesus and asked, “Lord, which one of us are you talking about?”
26Jesus answered, “I will dip this piece of bread in the sauce and give it to the one I was talking about.”
Then Jesus dipped the bread and gave it to Judas, the son of Simon Iscariot. 27Right then Satan took control of Judas.
Jesus said, “Judas, go quickly and do what you have to do.” 28No one at the meal understood what Jesus meant. 29But because Judas was in charge of the money, some of them thought that Jesus had told him to buy something they needed for the festival. Others thought that Jesus had told him to give some money to the poor. 30Judas took the piece of bread and went out.
It was already night.
The New Command
31After Judas had gone, Jesus said:
Now the Son of Man will be given glory, and he will bring glory to God. 32Then, after God is given glory because of him, God will bring glory to him, and God will do it very soon.
33 My children, I will be with you for only a little while longer. Then you will look for me, but you won't find me. I tell you just as I told the people, “You cannot go where I am going.” 34 But I am giving you a new command. You must love each other, just as I have loved you. 35If you love each other, everyone will know that you are my disciples.
Peter's Promise
(Matthew 26.31-35; Mark 14.27-31; Luke 22.31-34)
36Simon Peter asked, “Lord, where are you going?”
Jesus answered, “You can't go with me now, but later on you will.”
37Peter asked, “Lord, why can't I go with you now? I would die for you!”
38“Would you really die for me?” Jesus asked. “I tell you for certain before a rooster crows, you will say three times that you don't even know me.”
translation_text:
Yesu ka fɔr mbe bebɛsopo be aya be asheŋ
1K ka ba ka kachɛ koŋwule nɛ Kebansonchoŋ be kejigboŋ na e fo nɛ Yesu pin fanɛ mbe kelar durnya ere to n yɔ Etuto na kutɔ na be jemanɛ fo, e daŋ sha mbe basa ashi durnya to, n sha bumo loŋ n ya fo ekar. 2B ka tase ejikpa a shin nɛ b ji kanyɛso be ajibi nɛ alubipo na malɛ teŋ yili kumo Judas Iskareɔt, Saimɔn pibi be kagbene to fanɛ e debɔr Yesu. 3Yesu daa nyi Etuto na ka daŋ ta eleŋ kikɛ m bɔɔ mo ere Yesu na enɔ nseŋ naa nyi e ka shi Ebɔrɛ kutɔ m ba nseŋ naa bɛta a yɔ mo kutɔ. 4Amoso, Yesu daŋ koso ajibi na akpa nna n yili nseŋ gbaŋ mbe piŋi n nase nseŋ ta bɔrdeba n chɛ kashɛr. 5Kumo be kaman nɛ e chulgi nchu n wɔtɔ katishaŋ to nseŋ fara a fɔr mbe bebɛsopoana na be aya so nsaa ta bɔrdeba nɛ e ta n chɛ kashɛr na a melti bumo be ayaana. 6E wora loŋ m ba fo Saimɔn Pita nɛ e bishi mo: “Enyɛnpe, fo yɛ fo fɔr ma aya so a?” 7Nɛ Yesu kaŋɛ mo le: “Naniere bre fo maŋ nyi kusɔ nɛ mee wora ere, ama k maaŋ chɛr nɛ fo pin to.” 8Ndoŋ nna nɛ Pita kaŋɛ: “Ayai, fo maa ba nɛ fo ba fɔr ma aya so kuraa.” Nɛ Yesu kaŋɛ mo: “Nɛ m baŋ maŋ fɔr fo so, ma nɛ fo maaŋ baa kɔ shɛŋ.” 9Nɛ Saimɔn Pita kaŋɛ mo: “Kumo ere, Enyɛnpe, sa maŋ fɔr ma aya so nawule, fɔr ma enɔana nɛ ma kumu so gba n ti so.” 10Nɛ Yesu kaŋɛ mo: “Esa nɛ e teŋ bɛr nchu maŋ naa bɛr ai, she mbe aya nawule nɛ e beeŋ fɔr so. Menyi alɛ nyalɛ so nna, ama mannɛ menyi kikɛ nyam bre e nyalɛ so.” 11E daa nyi esa nɛ e daa shin nɛ e debɔr mo, amoso nɛ e daŋ kaŋɛ fanɛ mannɛ bumo kikɛ nyam e daŋ nyalɛ so na.
12E ka fɔr n fɔr bumo be ayaana na so n loge nɛ e ta mbe asɔ m buu nseŋ bɛta n yɔ mbe echenakpa n ya chena m bishi bumo le: “Men pin kusɔ nɛ n wora menyi ere to a? 13Menyee kaa tre ma Eŋinipo nɛ Enyɛnpe, kashenteŋ nɛ menyi alɛ bee ji, ŋkpal manɛ so, n la Eŋinipo nɛ Enyɛnpe nna. 14Nɛ kananɛ ma alɛ baa la men Nyɛnpe nɛ menyi be Eŋinipo nseŋ fɔr menyi be aya so ere, a daga fanɛ menyi alɛ gba e baa fɔr abar be aya so. 15N wora loŋ nna ŋ ŋini menyi nna na fanɛ men baa wora kananɛ n wora menyi ere. 16Kashenteŋ nɛ mee ji menyi na fanɛ kenya maŋ chɔ mo nyɛnpe, kabɔ kama malɛ maŋ chɔ esa nɛ e shuŋi mo na. 17Men baŋ pin asheŋ ere nsaa wora amo, nɛfa beeŋ baa la menyeya.”
18E yɛ: “Mannɛ menyi kikɛ nɛ n de. N nyi bumo nɛ n lara. Ama ade kikɛ wora nna nɛ kananɛ abɔrɛsibɛ na kaŋɛ le na e bɔla ekpa, a kaŋɛ: ‘Esa nɛ e ji ma ajibi gbagba kilgi nna n tu ma.’ 19Mee kaŋɛ menyi nna na a yili pɔɛŋ nɛ k ba wora, saŋɛ na so, nɛ k ba wora, menyeeŋ pin fanɛ ma e la Esa nɛ e bee ba na. 20Ma e kaŋɛ menyi kashenteŋto na fanɛ ekama nɛ e sɔ esa kama nɛ n shuŋi, sɔ ma nna na. Ekama malɛ nɛ e sɔ ma sɔ esa nɛ e shuŋi ma na nna na.”
Yesu ka wu b ka beeŋ debɔr mo be asheŋ m malga be asheŋ
(Matiu 26:20-25; Maak 14:17-21; Luuk 22:21-23)
21Yesu ka malga kesheŋ ere n loge nɛ mbe kagbene jija mo ga nɛ e bugi to ŋ kaŋɛ bumo le: “Ma e kaŋɛ menyi kashenteŋto na fanɛ menyi be eko beeŋ debɔr ma.” 22Ndoŋ nna nɛ kesheŋ na wul bebɛsopo na to nɛ b kilgi ŋ keni ŋ keni abar a fɛ bumo to be emo nɛ e daa de. 23Bebɛsopo na be emo nɛ Yesu daa sha na daŋ chena nna m mata mo. 24Nɛ Saimɔn Pita wora ebɛsopo na enɔ fanɛ e bishi Yesu bumo to be emo nɛ e de. 25Ndoŋ nna nɛ ebɛsopo na firgi n taga to Yesu nseŋ bishi mo: “Enyɛnpe, wanɛ nna?” 26Nɛ Yesu kaŋɛ: “Mo e la emo nɛ meeŋ ku bodobodo n wɔtɔ epo to n sa na.” E ka loge nɛ e ku bodobodo na n shoŋi epo to n ta n sa Judas, Saimɔn Iskareɔt pibi. 27Judas ka baŋ sɔ bodobodo na nɛ Setani luri mo to. Nɛ Yesu kaŋɛ mo: “Kusɔ nɛ fee sha kewora ere, fo wora kumo manaŋ manaŋ.” 28Ama bumo nɛ b daa tase ejikpa na be ekama daa maŋ pin kusɔ nɛ k daŋ ba nɛ e kaŋɛ Judas Iskareɔt loŋ. 29Ŋkpal Judas ka daa keni katuŋ na be amansherbi so so, bumo be beko daa fɛ fanɛ Yesu daa kaŋɛ mo nna fanɛ e ya tɔ Kejigboŋ na to be asɔ nɛ baaŋ baa sha m ba ŋko fanɛ e ta kusɔ ko n ya sa betirpo. 30Judas ka baŋ sɔ bodobodo na nɛ e lar epul na to. Kanyɛ daŋ biri nna nɛ e lar.
Kamalga naseso popɔr be asheŋ
31Judas ka lar nɛ Yesu kaŋɛ le: “Naniere bre ma, Nyiŋgbasa Pibinyɛn nya kemaŋkura nɛ Ebɔrɛ malɛ gba nya kemaŋkura ashi ma to. 32Nɛ fanɛ Ebɔrɛ malɛ baŋ bɔla ma so n nya kemaŋkura, kumo ere Ebɔrɛ beeŋ maŋkura ma, Ebinyɛn na ashi mo to. Mo alɛ beeŋ naŋ maŋkura ma epul ere to. 33Ma mbia, m maaŋ baa wɔ menyi kutɔ n chɛr. Menyeeŋ fin ma, ama fanɛ kananɛ ŋ kaŋɛ Juwebi na nɛ mee kaŋɛ menyi alɛ gba na fanɛ kakpa nɛ mee yɔ na, men maaŋ tiŋ m ba ndoŋ.
34Ama kamalga naseso popɔr nɛ mee sa menyi e la fanɛ men baa sha abar. Kananɛ mee sha menyi na e daga fanɛ menyi alɛ gba e baa sha abar loŋ. 35Nɛ menyee sha abar, basa kikɛ beeŋ pin men ka la ma bebɛsopo.”
Yesu ka yɛ Pita beeŋ chɛ fanɛ e maŋ nyi mo be asheŋ
(Matiu 26:31-35; Maak 14:27-31; Luuk 22:31-34)
36Ndoŋ nna nɛ Saimɔn Pita bishi mo: “Enyɛnpe, nnɛ nɛ fee yɔ?” Nɛ Yesu kaŋɛ mo: “Fo maaŋ tiŋ m bɛ ma so naniere n yɔ kakpa nɛ mee yɔ ere, ama kachako feeŋ bɛ ma so n yɔ.” 37Ndoŋ nna nɛ Pita naŋ bishi mo: “Enyɛnpe, manɛ e ba nɛ m maaŋ tiŋ m bɛ fo so naniere n yɔ? Meeŋ tiŋ ŋkpal fo so gba n wu.” 38Nɛ Yesu bishi mo: “Fo yɛ feeŋ tiŋ ŋkpal ma so n wu ŋko? Keni, ma e kaŋɛ fo kashenteŋto na fanɛ pɔɛŋ nɛ koshinyɛn e boŋ kanyɛ ere, feeŋ chɛ ale asa fanɛ fo maŋ nyi ma.”

english_text:
Jesus Is the Way to the Father
1Jesus said to his disciples, “Don't be worried! Have faith in God and have faith in me. 2There are many rooms in my Father's house. I wouldn't tell you this, unless it was true. I am going there to prepare a place for each of you. 3After I have done this, I will come back and take you with me. Then we will be together. 4You know the way to where I am going.”
5Thomas said, “Lord, we don't even know where you are going! How can we know the way?”
6 “I am the way, the truth, and the life!” Jesus answered. “Without me, no one can go to the Father. 7If you had really known me, you would have known the Father. But from now on, you do know him, and you have seen him.”
8Philip said, “Lord, show us the Father. That is all we need.”
9Jesus replied:
Philip, I have been with you for a long time. Don't you know who I am? If you have seen me, you have seen the Father. How can you ask me to show you the Father? 10Don't you believe that I am one with the Father and that the Father is one with me? What I say isn't said on my own. The Father who lives in me does these things.
11Have faith in me when I say that the Father is one with me and that I am one with the Father. Or else have faith in me simply because of the things I do. 12I tell you for certain that if you have faith in me, you will do the same things I am doing. You will do even greater things, now that I am going back to the Father. 13Ask me, and I will do whatever you ask. This way the Son will bring honor to the Father. 14I will do whatever you ask me to do.
The Holy Spirit Is Promised
15 Jesus said to his disciples:
If you love me, you will do as I command. 16Then I will ask the Father to send you the Holy Spirit who will help you and always be with you. 17The Spirit will show you what is true. The people of this world cannot accept the Spirit, because they don't see or know him. But you know the Spirit, who is with you and will keep on living in you.
18I won't leave you like orphans. I will come back to you. 19In a little while the people of this world won't be able to see me, but you will see me. And because I live, you will live. 20Then you will know I am one with the Father. You will know you are one with me, and I am one with you. 21 If you love me, you will do what I have said, and my Father will love you. I will also love you and show you what I am like.
22The other Judas, not Judas Iscariot, then spoke up and asked, “Lord, what do you mean by saying that you will show us what you are like, but you will not show the people of this world?”
23Jesus replied:
If anyone loves me, they will obey me. Then my Father will love them, and we will come to them and live in them. 24But anyone who doesn't love me, won't obey me. What they have heard me say doesn't really come from me, but from the Father who sent me.
25I have told you these things while I am still with you. 26But the Holy Spirit will come and help you, because the Father will send the Spirit to take my place. The Spirit will teach you everything and will remind you of what I said while I was with you.
27I give you peace, the kind of peace only I can give. It isn't like the peace this world can give. So don't be worried or afraid.
28You have already heard me say I am going and I will also come back to you. If you really love me, you should be glad I am going back to the Father, because he is greater than I am.
29I am telling you this before I leave, so when it does happen, you will have faith in me. 30I cannot speak with you much longer, because the ruler of this world is coming. But he has no power over me. 31I obey my Father, so everyone in the world might know that I love him.
It is time for us to go now.
translation_text:
Yesu ka la ekpa nɛ k bee yɔ Etuto na kutɔ be asheŋ
1Yesu yɛ: “Men sa maŋ shin nɛ men be ŋgbene e baa jija menyi. Men yirda n Tuto Ebɔrɛ, men baa yirda ma alɛ gba. 2Ebu damtaana wɔ n Tuto na pe, nɛ mannɛ aloŋ e daa la, n daŋ kaŋɛ menyi. Ma alɛ bee yɔ ndoŋ nna na nɛ n ya kaa lɔŋɛ kaboŋ a yili menyi. 3Ma alɛ kaŋ yɔ n ya lɔŋɛ kaboŋ na n yili menyi n loge, meeŋ naŋ bɛta m ba keta menyi n yɔ ŋ kutɔ, saŋɛ na so kakpa nɛ n wɔ, menyi alɛ gba beeŋ ya kaa wɔ ndoŋ. 4Men nyi kakpa nɛ mee yɔ na be ekpa.” 5Ndoŋ nna nɛ Tɔmas bishi mo: “Enyɛnpe, anyi maŋ nyi kakpa nɛ fee yɔ na nɛ nuso nɛ anyeeŋ wora m pin ekpa na?” 6Nɛ Yesu kaŋɛ mo: “Ma e la ekpa na nɛ kashenteŋ nɛ ŋkpa na, esa kama maaŋ tiŋ n yɔ Etuto na kutɔ ama e bɔla ma so nna.” 7Nɛ e naŋ kaŋɛ bumo le: “Nɛ men daa nyi ma nna, menyi daa beeŋ baa nyi n Tuto na gba. Baŋ yili kabre a yɔ menyi alɛ tea nyi mo hale n teŋ wu mo gba.”
8Ndoŋ nna nɛ Filip kaŋɛ mo le: “Enyɛnpe, ŋini anyi Etuto na nɛ kusɔ kama e kukwe anyi.” 9Nɛ Yesu bishi mo: “Filip, fo maŋ nyi ma a? Ma nɛ menyi kikɛ e baa wɔtɔ n chɛr le nɛ fo maŋ nyi ma a? Esa kama nɛ e wu ma, wu Etuto na nna na nɛ manɛ e ba nɛ fo kaŋɛ fanɛ: ‘Ŋini anyi Etuto na’? 10Fo maŋ nyi fanɛ n wɔ Etuto na to nna nɛ Etuto na malɛ gba wɔ ma to a? Men baa nyi fanɛ mmalga nɛ mee malga ere maŋ la ŋ gbagba peya, Etuto nɛ e wɔ ma to na e naa shuŋ mbe kushuŋ. 11Ŋ ka kaŋɛ fanɛ n wɔ Etuto na to nɛ Etuto na malɛ gba wɔ ma to ere, men yirda ma, nɛ mannɛ aloŋ gba nna, men keni emamachisheŋ nɛ mee wora so n yirda fanɛ kashenteŋ nɛ mee ji na. 12Ma e kaŋɛ menyi kashenteŋto na fanɛ esa kama nɛ e ta mbe yirda n deŋi ma so, beeŋ wora asɔ nɛ mee kaa wora ere. E beeŋ wora asɔ nɛ a chɔ ade gba, ŋkpal ŋ ka bee yɔ Etuto na kutɔ so. 13Kusɔ kama malɛ nɛ men ta ma ketre na ŋ kule, meeŋ wora kumo, saŋɛ na so ma, Ebinyɛn na beeŋ bar Etuto na kemaŋkura. 14Kusɔ kama nɛ men ta ma ketre na ŋ kule, meeŋ wora kumo n sa menyi.”
Yesu ka nase kɔnɔ fanɛ Kiyoyu Cheeŋ na beeŋ ba be asheŋ
15Nɛ men baa sha ma, menyeeŋ baa bɛ ma mmalga naseso so. 16Meeŋ kule Etuto na nɛ e naaŋ sa menyi Echɛtopo ko, 17mo e la kashenteŋ be Kiyoyu na, nɛ e ba kaa wɔ menyi kutɔ mbaanaayɔ. Durnya ere to ebi maaŋ tiŋ n sɔ loŋ be Echɛtopo na, ŋkpal manɛ so, b maaŋ tiŋ n wu mo, bumo alɛ maŋ naa nyi mo. Ama menyi ere nyi mo, ŋkpal manɛ so, e beeŋ ba kaa wɔ menyi kutɔ nseŋ naa wɔ menyi be ŋgbeneana to.
18M maaŋ yige menyi n to fanɛ amunibi. Meeŋ naŋ ba menyi kutɔ. 19A ka gbrɛbi nɛ durnya ere to ebi maaŋ naŋ wu ma, ama menyi ere beeŋ wu ma, ma alɛ ka wɔ ŋkpa to ere, menyi alɛ gba beeŋ baa wɔ ŋkpa to. 20Kachɛ na kaŋ fo, menyeeŋ pin ŋ ka wɔ n Tuto na to nɛ menyi alɛ wɔ ma to nɛ ma alɛ gba wɔ menyi to.
21“Esa kama nɛ e kɔ ma mmalga naseso nsaa wora asɔ nɛ a bee kaŋɛ na e la esa nɛ e bee sha ma. Esa kama malɛ nɛ e bee sha ma, n Tuto gba beeŋ sha mo nɛ ma alɛ gba e sha mo nseŋ lara ma kumu ŋ ŋini mo.” 22Nɛ Judas, mannɛ Judas Iskareɔt, bishi mo: “Enyɛnpe, nuso nɛ feeŋ lara fo kumu ŋ ŋini anyi ŋkaa maaŋ lara fo kumu ŋ ŋini durnya ere to ebi bre?” 23Nɛ Yesu kaŋɛ mo le: “Esa kama nɛ e bee sha ma beeŋ ta ma mmalga n wɔtɔ mbe kagbene to. N Tuto malɛ gba beeŋ baa sha mo nɛ ma nɛ n Tuto na kikɛ e ba mo kutɔ m ba ta mo ŋ ki anyi be kowu. 24Esa kama nɛ e maa sha ma, maa ta ma mmalga a wɔtɔ mbe kagbene to. Mmalga nɛ menyee nu ere malɛ maŋ la meya nna, n Tuto nɛ e shuŋi ma na peya nna.
25Ŋ kraa wɔ menyi kutɔ nna nsaa malga asheŋ ere kikɛ na. 26Ama Echɛtopo na, mo e la Kiyoyu Cheeŋ nɛ n Tuto beeŋ shuŋi ma ketre to na kaŋ ba, e beeŋ ŋini menyi kusɔ kama nseŋ nyiŋi menyi asɔ nɛ ŋ kaŋɛ menyi kikɛ.
27Kagbenewushi nɛ mee yige a sa menyi na, kagbenewushi nɛ k shi ŋ gbagba kutɔ. Kumo alɛ mannɛ fanɛ kananɛ durnya bee sa kumo na nɛ ŋ kɔ kumo a sa menyi. Amoso, men sa maŋ shin nɛ menyi be ŋgbene e baa jija menyi ŋko nɛ kufu e baa kɔ menyi. 28Men teŋ nu ŋ ka kaŋɛ menyi fanɛ: ‘Mee yɔ nna nɛ n naŋ bɛta m ba menyi kutɔ’. Nɛ men daa sha ma nna, k daa beeŋ wora menyi ebel ŋkpal ŋ ka bee yɔ n Tuto na kutɔ so, ŋkpal manɛ so, Etuto na e chɔ ma. 29Ŋ kaŋɛ menyi kesheŋ ere naniere nna na pɔɛŋ nɛ loŋ e ba wora, saŋɛ na so, nɛ k ba wora, menyeeŋ yirda. 30M maaŋ naŋ malga menyi kutɔ n chɛr, ŋkpal manɛ so, durnya ere to be ejuŋkparpo na bee ba. 31E maŋ kɔ eleŋ ma so, ama a daga durnya ere ka pin fanɛ mee sha Etuto na, amoso nɛ mee wora kusɔ nɛ e bee kaŋɛ ma kikɛ na.
Men niŋi to nɛ an koso nfe n choŋ.”

english_text:
Jesus Is the True Vine
1Jesus said to his disciples:
I am the true vine, and my Father is the gardener. 2He cuts away every branch of mine that doesn't produce fruit. But he trims clean every branch that does produce fruit, so that it will produce even more fruit. 3You are already clean because of what I have said to you.
4Stay joined to me, and I will stay joined to you. Just as a branch cannot produce fruit unless it stays joined to the vine, you cannot produce fruit unless you stay joined to me. 5I am the vine, and you are the branches. If you stay joined to me, and I stay joined to you, then you will produce lots of fruit. But you cannot do anything without me. 6If you don't stay joined to me, you will be thrown away. You will be like dry branches that are gathered up and burned in a fire.
7Stay joined to me and let my teachings become part of you. Then you can pray for whatever you want, and your prayer will be answered. 8When you become fruitful disciples of mine, my Father will be honored. 9I have loved you, just as my Father has loved me. So remain faithful to my love for you. 10If you obey me, I will keep loving you, just as my Father keeps loving me, because I have obeyed him.
11I have told you this to make you as completely happy as I am. 12 Now I tell you to love each other, as I have loved you. 13The greatest way to show love for friends is to die for them. 14And you are my friends, if you obey me. 15Servants don't know what their master is doing, and so I don't speak to you as my servants. I speak to you as my friends, and I have told you everything my Father has told me.
16You did not choose me. I chose you and sent you out to produce fruit, the kind of fruit that will last. Then my Father will give you whatever you ask for in my name. 17So I command you to love each other.
The World's Hatred
18If the people of this world hate you, just remember that they hated me first. 19If you belonged to the world, its people would love you. But you don't belong to the world. I have chosen you to leave the world behind, and this is why its people hate you. 20 Remember how I told you that servants are not greater than their master. So if people mistreat me, they will mistreat you. If they do what I say, they will do what you say.
21People will do to you exactly what they did to me. They will do it because you belong to me, and they don't know the one who sent me. 22If I had not come and spoken to them, they would not be guilty of sin. But now they have no excuse for their sin.
23Everyone who hates me also hates my Father. 24I have done things no one else has ever done. If they had not seen me do these things, they would not be guilty. But they did see me do these things, and they still hate me and my Father too. 25 This is why the Scriptures are true when they say, “People hated me for no reason.”
26I will send you the Spirit who comes from the Father and shows what is true. The Spirit will help you and will tell you about me. 27Then you will also tell others about me, because you have been with me from the beginning.
translation_text:
Yesu ka du fanɛ kedibi sɔrso gbagba na be asheŋ
1Yesu yɛ: “N du fanɛ kedibi sɔrso gbagba nna nɛ n Tuto malɛ la ndibi sɔrso na be ekenipo. 2Keyabi kama nɛ k chɔɔ ma so ŋkaa maa sɔr shɛŋ, e bee ku kumo nna a lɛ nɛ keyabi kama malɛ nɛ k bee sɔr e bee lɔŋɛ kumo so nna nɛ k tiŋ n sɔr ga n ti so. 3Men teŋ nyalɛ so ŋkpal kamalga nɛ m malga n sa menyi na so. 4Men baa wɔ ma to nɛ ma alɛ gba e baa wɔ menyi to. Kedibi be keyabi kama nawule maaŋ tiŋ n sɔr asɔrso ama k baa chɔɔ kedibi na gbagba so nna. Menyi alɛ gba maaŋ tiŋ n nya asɔrso kama ama men baa wɔ ma to nna. 5Ma e la kedibi sɔrso na nɛ menyi alɛ la kumo be ayabi. Nɛ esa baa wɔ ma to nɛ ma alɛ gba baa wɔ mo to, amodoŋwura beeŋ nya asɔrso damta, ama nɛ m baa maa wɔ men be asheŋ to, men maaŋ tiŋ n wora shɛŋ. 6Esa kama nɛ e maŋ wɔ ma to du fanɛ kedibi be keyabi nɛ b ku ashi kedibi gbagba so nna n lɛ nɛ k bee wɔl na nna. Ayabi mo nɛ a du loŋ malɛ, baa muu amo nna n wɔtɔ edɛ to nɛ a chɔɔ. 7Nɛ men baa wɔ ma to nɛ ma mmalga gba wɔ menyi to, men kule kusɔ kama nɛ menyee sha nɛ men nya kumo. 8Kusɔ nɛ k bee bar n Tuto na kemaŋkura e la men ka bee nya asɔrso damta, loŋ e naa ŋini men ka la ma bebɛsopo.
9Kananɛ Etuto na sha ma na gbagba nɛ ma alɛ gba sha menyi. Men baa wɔ ma kasha na to. 10Nɛ men baa bɛ ma mmalga naseso so, menyeeŋ baa wɔ ma kasha to fanɛ kananɛ mee bɛ Etuto na be mmalga naseso so nsaa wɔ mbe kasha to na.
11Ŋ kaŋɛ menyi kesheŋ ere nna nɛ kagbenefuli nɛ mee sa na e baa wɔ menyi to, saŋɛ na so, menyi be ŋgbene beeŋ fuli menyi m baŋ so. 12Ma kamalga naseso nde: ‘Men baa sha abar fanɛ kananɛ mee sha menyi na.’ 13Kasha kama maŋ naa chɔ le be kasha ere fanɛ esa ka beeŋ ta mbe ŋkpa n sa mo teriana. 14Nɛ men baa wora asɔ nɛ mee kaŋɛ menyi, kumo ere n teriana e la menyi. 15M maŋ naa tre menyi ma anya, ŋkpal manɛ so, kenya maa pin mo nyɛnpe be asheŋ woraso to. Naniere bre mee tre menyi n teriana nna, ŋkpal manɛ so, kusɔ kama nɛ ŋ koya ashi n Tuto na kutɔ, m maŋ ta amo ŋ ŋana menyi so. 16Mannɛ menyi e lara ma, ma e lara menyi nseŋ kaŋɛ menyi fanɛ men ya nya asɔrso nɛ a beeŋ baa wɔtɔ a yɔ. Saŋɛ na so, Etuto na beeŋ sa menyi kusɔ kama nɛ men ta ma ketre ŋ kule mo. 17Ma kamalga naseso nɛ ŋ kɔ a sa menyi nde fanɛ: ‘Men baa sha abar.’ ”
Kananɛ durnya beeŋ kishi bebɛsopo na be asheŋ
18“Nɛ durnya ere baŋ kishi menyi, men baa nyi fanɛ ma nɛ k fara ŋ kishi pɔɛŋ nseŋ ba kaa kishi menyi na. 19Nɛ men daa la durnya ere peya nna, k daa beeŋ baa sha menyi fanɛ kumo be basa gbagba. Ama n lara menyi ashi durnya ere to nna nɛ men maŋ naa la kumo be basa, amoso nɛ k kishi menyi na. 20Men baa nyiŋi kananɛ n daŋ kaŋɛ menyi na fanɛ: ‘Kenya maŋ chɔ mo nyɛnpe’. Nɛ durnya ere to ebi baŋ tɔrɔ ma, kumo ere baaŋ tɔrɔ menyi alɛ gba. Nɛ b baŋ ta ma mmalga n wɔtɔ bumo be ŋgbene to, baaŋ ta menyi alɛ gba peya n wɔtɔ bumo be ŋgbene to. 21Asheŋ ere kikɛ nɛ baaŋ wora menyi ŋkpal men ka la meya so, ŋkpal manɛ so, b maŋ nyi esa nɛ e shuŋi ma na. 22Kumo alɛ nɛ n daa maŋ ba nna m ba malga n sa bumo, b daa maaŋ tɔr alubi be ntaŋ, ama naniere b maaŋ tiŋ n ji n lar. 23Esa kama nɛ e kishi ma, kishi n Tuto gba nna. 24Nɛ fanɛ n daa maŋ wora emamachisheŋ nɛ esa kikɛ maŋ naŋ wora ere bumo to nna, b daa maaŋ tɔr alubi be ntaŋ, ama naniere b wu emamachisheŋ ere kikɛ, bumo alɛ kraa kishi ma nɛ n Tuto na kikɛ. 25Ama kumo alɛ du loŋ nna nɛ kusɔ nɛ k wɔ bumo be mbra na to na e bɔla. K yɛ: ‘B kishi ma nna kenyanyaŋɛso’.
26Ama Echɛtopo nɛ meeŋ shin nɛ e shi Etuto na kutɔ m ba menyi kutɔ na, mo e la kashenteŋ be Kiyoyu nseŋ shi Etuto na kutɔ na kaŋ ba, e beeŋ ji ma shɛda. 27Ama a daga fanɛ menyi alɛ gba ka ji shɛda na, ŋkpal manɛ so, ma nɛ menyi e baa la sososo na kikɛ.”

english_text:
1I am telling you these things, so that you will not turn away. 2You will be chased out of the synagogues. And the time will come when people will kill you and think they are doing God a favor. 3They will do these things because they don't know either the Father or me. 4I am saying this to you now, so that when the time comes, you will remember what I have said.
The Work of the Holy Spirit
I was with you at the first, and so I didn't tell you these things. 5But now I am going back to the Father who sent me, and none of you asks me where I am going. 6You are very sad from hearing all of this. 7But I tell you I am going to do what is best for you. This is why I am going away. The Holy Spirit cannot come to help you until I leave. But after I am gone, I will send the Spirit to you.
8The Spirit will come and show the people of this world the truth about sin and God's justice and the judgment. 9The Spirit will show them that they are wrong about sin, because they didn't have faith in me. 10They are wrong about God's justice, because I am going to the Father, and you won't see me again. 11And they are wrong about the judgment, because God has already judged the ruler of this world.
12I have much more to say to you, but right now it would be more than you could understand. 13 The Spirit shows what is true and will come and guide you into the full truth. The Spirit doesn't speak on his own. He will tell you only what he has heard from me, and he will let you know what is going to happen. 14The Spirit will bring glory to me by taking my message and telling it to you. 15Everything the Father has is mine. This is why I have said that the Spirit takes my message and tells it to you.
Sorrow Will Turn into Joy
16Jesus told his disciples, “For a little while you won't see me, but after a while you will see me.”
17They said to each other, “What does Jesus mean by saying that for a little while we won't see him, but after a while we will see him? What does he mean by saying he is going to the Father? 18What is this ‘little while’ that he is talking about? We don't know what he means.”
19Jesus knew they had some questions, so he said:
You are wondering what I meant when I said that for a little while you won't see me, but after a while you will see me. 20I tell you for certain that you will cry and be sad, but the world will be happy. You will be sad, but later you will be happy.
21When a woman is about to give birth, she is in great pain. But after it is all over, she forgets the pain and is happy, because she has brought a child into the world. 22You are now very sad. But later I will see you, and you will be so happy that no one will be able to change the way you feel. 23When that time comes, you won't have to ask me about anything. I tell you for certain the Father will give you whatever you ask for in my name. 24You have not asked for anything in this way before, but now you must ask in my name. Then it will be given to you, so you will be completely happy.
25I have used examples to explain to you what I have been talking about. But the time will come when I will speak to you plainly about the Father and will no longer use examples like these. 26You will ask the Father in my name, and I won't have to ask him for you. 27God the Father loves you because you love me, and you believe I have come from him. 28I came from the Father into the world, but I am leaving the world and returning to the Father.
29The disciples said, “Now you are speaking plainly to us! You are not using examples. 30At last we know that you understand everything, and we don't have any more questions. Now we believe you truly have come from God.”
31Jesus replied:
Do you really believe me? 32The time will come and is already here when all of you will be scattered. Each of you will go back home and leave me by myself. But the Father will be with me, and I won't be alone. 33I have told you this, so that you might have peace in your hearts because of me. While you are in the world, you will have to suffer. But cheer up! I have defeated the world.

1Nɛ Yesu kaŋɛ mbe bebɛsopo na le: “Ŋ kaŋɛ menyi asheŋ ere nna nɛ men sa maŋ kaŋ foe ekpa. 2Basa beeŋ ba kaa ju menyi ashi nshɛrbuana na to be keluri to. Saŋko beeŋ ba fo nɛ esa kama nɛ e mɔ menyi beeŋ baa fɛ fanɛ Ebɔrɛ nɛ e bee shuŋ. 3Bumo alɛ beeŋ wora loŋ nna ŋkpal b ka maŋ nyi Etuto ŋko ma so. 4Ŋ kaŋɛ menyi kesheŋ ere nna, saŋɛ na so, jemanɛ nɛ baaŋ wora asheŋ na kaŋ fo, menyeeŋ nyiŋi fanɛ n chɛr ŋ kaŋɛ menyi. Ŋ ka wɔ menyi kutɔ na so so nɛ n daa maŋ kaŋɛ menyi kesheŋ ere sososo na.”
Kiyoyu Cheeŋ na be kushuŋ be asheŋ
5Ama naniere bre mee bɛta a yɔ esa nɛ e shuŋi ma na kutɔ nna ŋkeshin nɛ menyi alɛ be ekama maŋ bishi ma fanɛ: ‘Nnɛ nɛ fee yɔ?’ 6Ama ŋkpal ŋ ka kaŋɛ menyi kesheŋ ere so so, kagbenejija luri nna m bɔlɔ menyi to. 7Kashenteŋ malɛ nɛ mee kaŋɛ menyi na fanɛ menyi be kechɛto so nɛ mee yɔ na, ŋkpal manɛ so, nɛ m baa maŋ yɔ, Echɛtopo na maaŋ ba menyi kutɔ.
