Men baa kɔ kebaawɔtɔ mo nɛ k du fanɛ Ebɔrɛ be anya peya a wɔtɔ. 17Men baa sa basa kikɛ bunyaŋ nsaa sha bekurgepoana na kikɛ. Men baa ŋana Ebɔrɛ nsaa bunyaŋ men be efuli so be ewurgboŋ na.
Kananɛ Kristo be awurfoŋ la keŋini be asheŋ
18Anya, men baa nu a sa men nyɛnpeana nsaa sa bumo bunyaŋ kikɛ nɛ k daga, mannɛ bumo nɛ b la benyɛnpe lela nsaa shu basa so na nawule, bumo nɛ b du nyaŋnyaŋ na gba ti so. 19Ŋkpal manɛ so, nɛ men baa ji kasogberge be ebesa mo nɛ k maŋ daga ŋkpal men ka bee fɛ Ebɔrɛ be asheŋ so, menyeeŋ nya nɛfa damta. 20Ama nɛ fanɛ b kpal men be alubi so nna m bri menyi nɛ men nyiti loŋ be kebri na, manɛ be mbo e wɔ kumo to? Ama nɛ fanɛ b kpal kelela ko so nna n tɔrɔ menyi nɛ men nyiti loŋ be tɔrɔ na, kumo ere, k kɔ mbo ashi Ebɔrɛ be anishito. 21Kashenteŋto malɛ, loŋ so nɛ Ebɔrɛ tre menyi, ŋkpal manɛ so, loŋ nɛ Kristo gba ji tɔrɔ m bugi loŋ be ekpa na n nase fanɛ men bɛ mbe aya so. 22E daa maŋ wora kulubi kikɛ, kafulesheŋ malɛ kikɛ daa maŋ lar mbe kɔnɔ to. 23B daŋ tege mo, ama mo alɛ daa maŋ laŋɛ katege n sa bumo. B daŋ tɔrɔ mo, ama e daa maŋ nyaŋɛ to n tu bumo. Ama e daŋ ta mbe kumu nna m bɔɔ esa nɛ e bee ji asheŋ amo be ekpa so na enɔ. 24Mo ere gbagba e ta mbe eyur n ta an be alubi n yɔ kedibi largato na so nɛ an baa la basa nɛ b wu alubi be kaplɛa so nsaa wɔtɔ ŋkpal alelasheŋ so. Mbe eyur be kemurgi so nɛ men nya kechɛ. 25Ŋkpal manɛ so, men daa du fanɛ mbolpɔ ka yeŋ to nna, ama naniere bre, men bɛta m ba men be ayoyu be Ekpapo nɛ Ekenipo kutɔ.

english_text:
Wives and Husbands
1 If you are a wife, you must put your husband first. Even if he opposes our message, you will win him over by what you do. No one else will have to say anything to him, 2because he will see how you honor God and live a pure life. 3 Don't depend on things like fancy hairdos or gold jewelry or expensive clothes to make you look beautiful. 4Be beautiful in your heart by being gentle and quiet. This kind of beauty will last, and God considers it very special.
5Long ago those women who worshiped God and put their hope in him made themselves beautiful by putting their husbands first. 6For example, Sarah obeyed Abraham and called him her master. You are her true children, if you do right and don't let anything frighten you.
7 If you are a husband, you should be thoughtful of your wife. Treat her with honor, because she isn't as strong as you are, and she shares with you in the gift of life. Then nothing will stand in the way of your prayers.
Suffering for Doing Right
8Finally, all of you should agree and have concern and love for each other. You should also be kind and humble. 9Don't be hateful and insult people just because they are hateful and insult you. Instead, treat everyone with kindness. You are God's chosen ones, and he will bless you. The Scriptures say,
10 “Do you really love life?
Do you want to be happy?
Then stop saying cruel things
and quit telling lies.
11Give up your evil ways
and do right,
as you find and follow
the road to peace.
12The Lord watches over
everyone who obeys him,
and he listens
to their prayers.
But he opposes everyone
who does evil.”
13Can anyone really harm you for being eager to do good deeds? 14 Even if you have to suffer for doing good things, God will bless you. So stop being afraid and don't worry about what people might do. 15Honor Christ and let him be the Lord of your life.
Always be ready to give an answer when someone asks you about your hope. 16Give a kind and respectful answer and keep your conscience clear. This way you will make people ashamed for saying bad things about your good conduct as a follower of Christ. 17You are better off to obey God and suffer for doing right than to suffer for doing wrong.
18Christ died once for our sins.
An innocent person died
for those who are guilty.
Christ did this
to bring you to God,
when his body
was put to death
and his spirit
was made alive.
19Christ then preached to the spirits that were being kept in prison. 20 They had disobeyed God while Noah was building the boat, but God had been patient with them. Eight people went into that boat and were brought safely through the flood.
21Those flood waters were like baptism that now saves you. But baptism is more than just washing your body. It means turning to God with a clear conscience, because Jesus Christ was raised from death. 22Christ is now in heaven, where he sits at the right side of God. All angels, authorities, and powers are under his control.
translation_text:
Beche kilpo nɛ bumo kulana be asheŋ
1Beche, menyi alɛ gba e baa nu a sa men kulana, saŋɛ na so nɛ bumo be ekama maŋ yirda kamalga na, nɛ men maŋ malga n sa bumo gba, baaŋ wu men be kebaawɔtɔ nseŋ ba yirda. 2Ŋkpal manɛ so, baaŋ wu kananɛ men du cheembi nɛ kananɛ men be kabɔrɛŋana be kebaawɔtɔ du. 3Men sa maŋ shin nɛ men be kebita e baa shi eyur so be kelɔŋɛ fanɛ amu be kekre ŋko eshuwa be abitasɔ be kewɔtɔ nɛ asɔbuuso lela be kebaabuu to. 4A daga fanɛ men be kela e baa shi men be ŋgbene to gbagba to, kumo e la fanɛ men baa kɔ ŋgbene nɛ a du boeŋ a maa gbri. Loŋ be kela na e maa terge kikɛ nsaa walɛ ashi Ebɔrɛ be anishito. 5Ŋkpal manɛ so, loŋ nɛ dra na be beche mo nɛ b daa du cheembi nseŋ daŋ ta bumo be tama n wɔtɔ Ebɔrɛ to na daa ji bumo be kebita nseŋ daa nu a sa bumo kulana. 6An ta fanɛ Sɛɛra le, e daŋ nu n sa mo kul Eebraham nseŋ daŋ tre mo mo nyɛnpe. To, nɛ menyi alɛ gba baa wora asheŋ nɛ a daga ŋkaa maa lɔ kufu, menyeeŋ baa la mbe mbichesoana.
7Bekul, loŋ koŋwule na a daga fanɛ menyi alɛ gba e baa kɔ kushuso ashi menyi nɛ men be beche be kebaawɔtɔana to nsaa bunyaŋ bumo a ta bumo fanɛ men braana mo nɛ b maŋ kɔ eleŋ, bumo alɛ ŋkaa beeŋ tu menyi n nya Ebɔrɛ be ŋkpa be kakɛ na. Men baa wora loŋ nɛ shɛŋ shɛŋ e sa maŋ kagle men be kabɔrɛkuleana ekpa nɛ a fo Ebɔrɛ ŋ gben.
Keji awurfoŋ ŋkpal kelela be kewora so be asheŋ
8Kusɔ nɛ k baa wɔtɔ kikɛ e la fanɛ men kikɛ e baa kɔ kɔnɔkoŋwule a wɔ abar so. Men baa shu abar so a kɔ keniopibi be kasha a sha abar nsaa la basa nseŋ naa bar men be amu kaseto. 9Men sa maa laŋɛ kulubi a ka kulubi ŋko a laŋɛ katege a ka katege. Ama kusɔ nɛ k daga e la fanɛ men baa nɛfa basa nɛ baa wora menyi loŋ be alubiana, ŋkpal manɛ so, Ebɔrɛ ka tre menyi na, nɛfa nɛ e nase kɔnɔ fanɛ e beeŋ sa menyi. 10Kumo alɛ nɛ abɔrɛsibɛ na bee kaŋɛ na fanɛ:
“Esa kama nɛ e bee sha ŋkpa
nsaa sha kewu nchɛ lela,
kumo ere, amodoŋwura
e sa maŋ shin nɛ mbe kɔnɔ
e baa malga asheŋ lubi ŋko ku efɛ.
11A daga fanɛ amodoŋwura e baa lar alubi to nsaa wora alela.
A daga fanɛ e baa fin kagbenewushi nsaa bɛ kumo so saŋkikɛ.
12Ŋkpal manɛ so, Enyɛnpe be anishi wɔ belelapo kikɛ so nna,
mo alɛ nsaa kaŋ kusoe a nu bumo be kabɔrɛkule,
ama bekama nɛ baa wora alubi bre, e bee pal kaman nna a sa bumo.”
13Nɛ men baŋ pere kenishi a sha kelela be kebaawora, wanɛ e naaŋ tiŋ n tɔrɔ menyi? 14Hale nɛ men wora kelela nɛ b kpal loŋ so n tɔrɔ menyi gba, nɛfa la menyeya nna. Men sa maa ŋana bumo be kafunti, menyi alɛ e sa maŋ naa shin nɛ men be ŋgbene e baa ku. 15Ama men baa sa Kristo bunyaŋ fanɛ Enyɛnpe ashi men be ŋgbene to. Men baa wora shiriya saŋkikɛ a jo esa kama nɛ e beeŋ ba bishi menyi tama mo nɛ men kɔ ere be kifito, nɛ men kaŋɛ mo. 16Ama men baa kɔ amu be kebar kaseto nɛ bunyaŋ a wora loŋ nsaa maŋ shin nɛ kesheŋ lubi e baa wɔ men be nfɛra fɛsoana to, saŋɛ na so anishinyɔr beeŋ pɛ bekama nɛ baa malga asheŋ lubi a gbiti menyi ŋkpal men ka la Kristo be basa a wora alelasheŋ na so. 17Ŋkpal manɛ so nɛ k la Ebɔrɛ be kepar be kusɔ fanɛ men nya tɔrɔ nɛ men nya loŋ be tɔrɔ na ŋkpal kelela mo nɛ men wora so, k walɛ a chɔ men ka wora alubi ŋkaa nya tɔrɔ. 18Ŋkpal manɛ so, Kristo gba wu kela koŋwule nna pati, ŋkpal basa be alubi so, esa nɛ e maŋ kɔ kulubi e wu n sa basa lubi na, saŋɛ na so e beeŋ yɛra menyi Ebɔrɛ kutɔ. B daŋ mɔ mbe eyur, ama Ebɔrɛ shin nɛ e nya ŋkpa ashi mbe Kiyoyu na to. 19Saŋko Kiyoyu na ka ba bɔla mo to na nɛ e daŋ ya bɔ baru lela na n sa bubuni be ayoyu mo nɛ a wɔ kabuti to na. 20Ayoyu na la basa nɛ b daŋ kini kenu n sa Ebɔrɛ saŋɛ mo nɛ e daŋ ji bumo kanyiti jemanɛ mo nɛ Nowa daa gbir kuloŋgboŋ mo nɛ basa aburwa nawule daŋ luri to n nya kumɔlga ashi nchu na to na. 21Loŋ be nchu na daa la kabɔrɛbɛr nɛ k bee mɔlga menyi naniere be kaduli nna, ama k maŋ la kusɔ nɛ k bee fɔr eyur to be alubi a lɛ. K la nfɛra niŋiso be kɔnɔ naseso mo nɛ esa bee nase nna a sa Ebɔrɛ. Yesu Kristo be ketiŋi luwu to na to nɛ k bee bɔla a mɔlga menyi. 22Mo, Yesu Kristo koŋwule na e yɔ ebɔrɛso n ya kaa tase Ebɔrɛ be jisoso, kakpa nɛ ebunyampo bee chena, a ji emalaika kikɛ nɛ bejuŋkparpoana kikɛ nɛ eleŋana kikɛ so kuwura na.

english_text:
Being Faithful to God
1Christ suffered here on earth. Now you must be ready to suffer as he did, because suffering shows that you have stopped sinning. 2It means you have turned from your own desires and want to obey God for the rest of your life. 3You have already lived long enough like people who don't know God. You were immoral and followed your evil desires. You went around drinking and partying and carrying on. In fact, you even worshiped disgusting idols. 4Now your former friends wonder why you have stopped running around with them, and they curse you for it. 5But they will have to answer to God, who judges the living and the dead. 6The good news has even been preached to the dead, so that after they have been judged for what they have done in this life, their spirits will live with God.
7Everything will soon come to an end. So be serious and be sensible enough to pray.
8 Most important of all, you must sincerely love each other, because love wipes away many sins.
9Welcome people into your home and don't grumble about it.
10Each of you has been blessed with one of God's many wonderful gifts to be used in the service of others. So use your gift well. 11If you have the gift of speaking, preach God's message. If you have the gift of helping others, do it with the strength that God supplies. Everything should be done in a way that will bring honor to God because of Jesus Christ, who is glorious and powerful forever. Amen.
Suffering for Being a Christian
12Dear friends, don't be surprised or shocked that you are going through testing that is like walking through fire. 13Be glad for the chance to suffer as Christ suffered. It will prepare you for even greater happiness when he makes his glorious return.
14Count it a blessing when you suffer for being a Christian. This shows that God's glorious Spirit is with you. 15But you deserve to suffer if you are a murderer, a thief, a crook, or a busybody. 16Don't be ashamed to suffer for being a Christian. Praise God that you belong to him. 17God has already begun judging his own people. And if his judgment begins with us, imagine how terrible it will be for those who refuse to obey his message. The Scriptures say,
18 “If good people barely escape,
what will happen to sinners
and to others
who don't respect God?”
19If you suffer for obeying God, you must have complete faith in your faithful Creator and keep on doing right.
translation_text:
Kebaawɔtɔ popɔr be kebaakɔ be asheŋ
1To, ŋkpal Kristo ka ji tɔrɔ mbe eyur to so, menyi alɛ gba e leŋ menyi be amu to a kɔ loŋ be kagbene, ŋkpal manɛ so, ekama nɛ e ji tɔrɔ mbe eyur to lar alubi to nna na. 2Nɛ loŋ malɛ baŋ wora, loŋ be esa na maŋ naa kɔ mbe durnya ere to be kebaawɔtɔ a wɔ edimɛdi be ayɛlgasɔ lubiana to, ama Ebɔrɛ be aparsheŋ to nɛ e kɔ mbe kebaawɔtɔ a wɔ. 3Naniere bre a daga fanɛ men ka pin fanɛ asɔ nɛ nnyamase bee sha kewora nɛ menyi alɛ gba daa wora amo na be kewora kukwe. Asɔ nɛ men daa wora saŋɛ na e daa la kusɔjigaya be aworbi nɛ kesakalea be kayɛlga be aworbi nɛ kasanuu nɛ keshɛr abar n ji nseŋ boo ana be kebaawɔtɔ nɛ kushuŋ jiga fanɛ kagbirshuŋ be aworbi. 4Naniere k bee chinchiŋ bumo nna, ŋkpal men ka maŋ naa tu bumo a wora loŋ be asheŋ jiga na so. Amoso nɛ baa tege menyi na. 5Ama esa ko wɔtɔ n wora shiriya nɛ e ji basa nɛ b kraa wɔ ŋkpa to nɛ bumo nɛ b wu na kikɛ demu. Baaŋ yili mbe anishito ŋ kaŋɛ ŋ kaŋɛ bumo be asheŋ woraso kikɛ nɛ kusɔ nɛ k ba nɛ b wora amo. 6To, amoso nɛ b daŋ bɔ baru lela na n sa basa nɛ b maŋ naa wɔ ŋkpa to naniere na, saŋɛ na so, dimɛdi be kaplɛa so, baaŋ ji bumo demu, ama Ebɔrɛ bre be kaplɛa so, baaŋ baa wɔ ŋkpa to ashi kiyoyu na to.
Kebaakeni Ebɔrɛ be ŋkɛana so be asheŋ
7Asɔ kikɛ be ekar be jemanɛ na bee taga to nna na, amoso, men baa kɔ nfɛra niŋiso nsaa tiŋ men be amu, saŋɛ na so menyeeŋ tiŋ ŋ kule Ebɔrɛ nɛnɛ. 8Ade kikɛ be kaman, men baa sha abar kashenteŋto, ŋkpal manɛ so, kasha e naa buu alubi damta so. 9Men baa sɔ abar men peana nsaa maa muni to. 10Kiyoyu Cheeŋ be kakɛ kama nɛ ekama kɔ, e baa ta loŋ be kakɛ na a shuŋ mo braana fanɛ kenya lela nɛ b ta Ebɔrɛ be kuwɔr be kakɛ damtaana m bɔɔ mo enɔ. 11Ekama nɛ e bee malga e shin nɛ mbe mmalga na e baa la fanɛ Ebɔrɛ be mmalga gbagba, nɛ ekama malɛ nɛ e bee shuŋ mo braana e baa ta eleŋ mo nɛ Ebɔrɛ bee sa mo na a wora loŋ, saŋɛ na so, kusɔ kama to, Ebɔrɛ beeŋ bɔla Yesu Kristo so n nya epaŋ be kedi. Kemaŋkura nɛ eleŋ e baa la mo peya mbaanaayɔ. Amɛn.
Keji awurfoŋ ŋkpal Yesu so be asheŋ
12Ma basa shaso, men sa maŋ shin nɛ men be ŋgbene e baa wora menyi kanaŋ ko kechɔŋkeni nɛ k bee ba menyi so fanɛ edɛ be kuwuloŋ na so a fɛ fanɛ mamachi be kesheŋ ko e naa nya menyi. 13Ama men shin nɛ men be ŋgbene e baa fuli menyi parr fanɛ men ka bee ji Yesu be tɔrɔ na be ako, saŋɛ na so men be ŋgbene beeŋ fuli menyi saŋɛ nɛ mbe kemaŋkura beeŋ lar efuli na. 14Nɛ b baŋ tege menyi ŋkpal men ka la Kristo be bebɛsopo so, kumo ere nɛfa la menyeya nna, ŋkpal manɛ so, Ebɔrɛ be Kiyoyu nɛ e kɔ kemaŋkura na e wɔ menyi to. 15Men sa maŋ shin nɛ tɔrɔ e baa ba menyi to be ekama so ŋkpal e ka la emɔpo ŋko eyu ŋko alubiworapo ŋko esa nɛ e bee luri basa be asheŋ to so. 16Ama nɛ men luri tɔrɔ to ŋkpal men ka la bebɛsopo so, men sa maŋ shin nɛ k baa wora menyi anishinyɔr. Men baa di Ebɔrɛ epaŋ ŋkpal men ka bee ji mbe ketre so. 17Demu be kejiachɛ na taga to, Ebɔrɛ malɛ be kowu to ebi to nɛ k bee fara. Nɛ k baŋ fara anyi to bre, nuso nɛ asheŋ beeŋ ba kaa du n sa basa nɛ b maa nu a sa Ebɔrɛ be baru lela na? 18Nɛ asheŋ baa du kpakpa n sa elelapo nɛ e nya kumɔlga, nuso nɛ a beeŋ ba kaa du n sa bɔrɛkinipo nɛ alubiworapo! 19Amoso, bumo nɛ b wɔ tɔrɔ mo nɛ a la Ebɔrɛ be keparso peya ere to ere, b baa ta bumo be amu kikɛ a bɔɔ bumo be Epɔrpo mo nɛ e maŋ kɔ kɔnɔkilgi na nsaa wɔtɔ a wora kelela na enɔ.

english_text:
Helping Christian Leaders
1Church leaders, I am writing to encourage you. I too am a leader, as well as a witness to Christ's suffering, and I will share in his glory when it is shown to us.
2 Just as shepherds watch over their sheep, you must watch over everyone God has placed in your care. Do it willingly in order to please God, and not simply because you think you must. Let it be something you want to do, instead of something you do merely to make money. 3Don't be bossy to those people who are in your care, but set an example for them. 4Then when Christ the Chief Shepherd returns, you will be given a crown that will never lose its glory.
5 All of you young people should obey your elders. In fact, everyone should be humble toward everyone else. The Scriptures say,
“God opposes proud people,
but he helps everyone
who is humble.”
6 Be humble in the presence of God's mighty power, and he will honor you when the time comes. 7 God cares for you, so turn all your worries over to him.
8Be on your guard and stay awake. Your enemy, the devil, is like a roaring lion, sneaking around to find someone to attack. 9But you must resist the devil and stay strong in your faith. You know that all over the world the Lord's followers are suffering just as you are. 10But God shows undeserved kindness to everyone. That's why he appointed Christ Jesus to choose you to share in his eternal glory. You will suffer for a while, but God will make you complete, steady, strong, and firm. 11God will be in control forever! Amen.
Final Greetings
12 Silvanus helped me write this short letter, and I consider him a faithful follower of the Lord. I wanted to encourage you and tell you how kind God really is, so you will keep on having faith in him.
13 Greetings from the Lord's followers in Babylon. They are God's chosen ones.
Mark, who is like a son to me, sends his greetings too.
14Give each other a warm greeting. I pray that God will give peace to everyone who belongs to Christ.
translation_text:
Asɔ nɛ a daga bejuŋkparpo nɛ basa fɔlbi ka pin be asheŋ
1To, naniere a ka menyi to be bejuŋkparpo nɛ b du fanɛ kananɛ ma alɛ gba la men barkasa ejuŋkparpo ere nsaa la esa nɛ n la Kristo be tɔrɔ be shɛdajipo nseŋ naa la esa nɛ meeŋ tu bumo nɛ baaŋ nya kemaŋkura na saŋɛ nɛ k lar efuli na. 2Mee kule menyi nna fanɛ men baa keni Ebɔrɛ be basa nɛ b wɔ men be enɔ to a du fanɛ mbolpɔ na so. Men sa maŋ ta bumo be kekeniso na fanɛ katiŋ be kusɔ. Men baa bugi ŋgbene a keni bumo so fanɛ kananɛ Ebɔrɛ bee sha fanɛ men baa du na. Men sa maŋ baa wɔtɔ a kɔ kajɛso a fin kakɔka, men baa bugi kagbene a sha kebaashuŋ basa. 3Men sa maa ŋini bumo nɛ Ebɔrɛ ta m bɔɔ menyi enɔ na kenimu, men baa la basa nɛ mbolpɔbi na beeŋ tiŋ ŋ keni so n wora asheŋ. 4Saŋɛ na so, Ekenipo Nimuso na kaŋ ya lar m ba, menyeeŋ nya kemaŋkurawuro mo nɛ k maa terge kikɛ na.
5Mbrantiɛ, loŋ koŋwule na nɛ a daga fanɛ men baa nu a sa benyɛnnimuana. Men ta kumu be kebar kaseto m mea to fanɛ wajɛ a wɔtɔ a sa abar, ŋkpal manɛ so, Ebɔrɛ maa sa kamoowuwuraana kashuli, ama bumo nɛ baa bar bumo be amu kaseto bre, e bee wu bumo kuwɔr nna.
6Amoso, men baa bar men be amu kaseto a wɔtɔ Ebɔrɛ be enɔgboŋana to nɛ e maŋ menyi so mo gbagba be saŋɛ. 7Men ta men be asheŋ tirso kikɛ a lɛ mo so, ŋkpal manɛ so, men be asheŋ wɔ mbe kagbene to ga.
8Men baa da so n shin nɛ men be nfɛra e baa niŋi, ŋkpal manɛ so, men doŋ alubipo na wɔtɔ nna a kilgi to fanɛ buluŋ a fin esa nɛ e beeŋ mur. 9Men baa kɔ men be yirda to kpakpa a tu mo nsaa maa sa mo kashuli, ŋkpal manɛ so, menyi alɛ gba nyi fanɛ loŋ nɛ men braana bebɛsopo ashi durnya ere to be kaplɛkama gba bee nya tɔrɔ.
10Ama nɛ men baŋ ji tɔrɔ ere gbrɛbi m ba lar, kuwɔr be kakɛ kikɛ be Ebɔrɛ nɛ e bee tre menyi fanɛ men ba tu Kristo nɛ men gama n nya mbe kemaŋkura mo nɛ k maŋ kɔ ekar na gbagba beeŋ naŋ shin nɛ kusɔ kama e nyalɛ n sa menyi nseŋ wɔtɔ menyi eleŋ to n shin nɛ men baa yil to nɛnɛ a maa gbuŋgbuŋ to kikɛ. 11Eleŋ e baa la mo peya hale mbaanaayɔ. Amɛn.
Lalaloge be kechɔrɔ be asheŋ
12Ekurgepo Silvanes mo nɛ n nyi fanɛ meeŋ tiŋ n yirda na so so nɛ mee bɔla a sibɛ menyi kawɔlbi ere na. N sibɛ kumo nna gbrɛbi loŋ nɛ n leŋ menyi to nseŋ naŋ ji shɛda ŋ kaŋɛ fanɛ kuwɔr be kakɛ mo nɛ k shi Ebɔrɛ kutɔ kashenteŋ na nna na. Men baa yil kumo to kpakpa.
13Babilɔn be asɔri nɛ k du fanɛ men sipoche na be basa nɛ Ebɔrɛ lara menyi nɛ bumo kikɛ na bee chɔrɔ menyi. M pibi Maak gba bee chɔrɔ menyi.
14Men baa ta kasha be kegbuŋ be kepipeso be kechɔrɔ a chɔrɔ abar.
Kagbenewushi e baa wɔ menyi nɛ men wɔ Kristo to na kikɛ so.

english_text:
1From Simon Peter, a servant and an apostle of Jesus Christ.
To everyone who shares with us in the privilege of believing that our God and Savior Jesus Christ will do what is just and fair.
2I pray that God will be kind to you and will let you live in perfect peace! May you keep learning more and more about God and our Lord Jesus.
Living as the Lord's Followers
3We have everything we need to live a life that pleases God. It was all given to us by God's own power, when we learned he had invited us to share in his wonderful goodness. 4God made great and marvelous promises, so his nature would become part of us. Then we could escape our evil desires and the corrupt influences of this world.
5Do your best to improve your faith by adding goodness, understanding, 6self-control, patience, devotion to God, 7concern for others, and love. 8If you keep growing in this way, it will show that what you know about our Lord Jesus Christ has made your lives useful and meaningful. 9But if you don't grow, you are like someone who is nearsighted or blind, and you have forgotten that your past sins are forgiven.
10My friends, you must do all you can to show God has really chosen and selected you. If you keep on doing this, you won't stumble and fall. 11Then our Lord and Savior Jesus Christ will give you a glorious welcome into his kingdom that will last forever.
12You are holding firmly to the truth you were given. But I am still going to remind you of these things. 13In fact, I think I should keep on reminding you until I leave this body. 14And our Lord Jesus Christ has already told me that I will soon leave it behind. 15This is why I am doing my best to make sure that each of you remembers all of this after I am gone.
The Message about the Glory of Christ
16When we told you about the power and the return of our Lord Jesus Christ, we were not telling clever stories someone had made up. But with our own eyes we saw his true greatness. 17 God, our great and wonderful Father, truly honored him by saying, “This is my own dear Son, and I am pleased with him.” 18We were there with Jesus on the holy mountain and heard this voice speak from heaven.
19All of this makes us even more certain that what the prophets said is true. So you should pay close attention to their message, as you would to a lamp shining in some dark place. You must keep on paying attention until daylight comes and the morning star rises in your hearts. 20But you need to realize that no one alone can understand any of the prophecies in the Scriptures. 21The prophets did not think these things up on their own, but they were guided by the Spirit of God.
translation_text:
1Kawɔl ere shi ma, Saimɔn Pita nɛ n la Yesu Kristo be kenya nɛ mbe eshuŋipo na kutɔ nna a yɔ menyi nɛ men bɔla Yesu Kristo an be Ebɔrɛ nɛ an be Emɔlgapo be kananɛ e niŋi ekpa so so n nya yirda koŋwule nɛ anyi alɛ gba kɔ na kutɔ. Anyi be yirda na maŋ kɔ ebarkasa kikɛ. 2Ebɔrɛ e bɔla men be kebaanyi mo nɛ Yesu an Nyɛnpe na so n shin nɛ mbe kuwɔr be kakɛ nɛ kagbenewushi e baa la menyeya m bɔlɔ menyi to kiŋkiŋ.
Ebɔrɛ be ketre nɛ mbe kelara esa be asheŋ
3Ebɔrɛ bɔla mbe eleŋ so n sa anyi kusɔ kama nɛ k daga fanɛ an baa kɔ n tiŋ a wɔ kabɔrɛŋana be kebaawɔtɔ nɛ k daga to. Anyi be kebaanyi emo nɛ e bɔla mo gbagba be kemaŋkura nɛ mbe kelela so n tre anyi na so nɛ e wora loŋ. 4Ade malɛ kikɛ so nɛ e bɔla n sa anyi mbe nnɔ naseso gboŋana nɛ a maŋ kɔ abraana kikɛ na, saŋɛ na so menyeeŋ bɔla amo so ŋ gelge kafulesheŋ nɛ k wɔ durnya ere to ŋkpal kumo be ayɛlgasɔ so nseŋ ba tu Ebɔrɛ a kɔ mbe kapɔr na. 5Amoso, ŋkpal le ere so, men wora ania ga n ta kelela n ti men be yirda so. Kelela na malɛ be kaman nɛ men ta kanyiasheŋ m bɛ so. 6Kanyiasheŋ na be kaman nɛ men ta kamootiŋ n ti so. Kamootiŋ na malɛ be kaman men ta kebaayilto kpakpa be kebaawɔtɔ n ti so nseŋ ta kabɔrɛŋana malɛ n ti kebaayilto kpakpa be kebaawɔtɔ so. 7Kabɔrɛŋana malɛ be kaman men ta keniopibi be kasha n ti so nseŋ ta kasha gbagba malɛ n ti keniopibi be kasha so. 8To, nɛ men baa kɔ asɔ ere nsaa kɔ amo to ga menyi to, a beeŋ shin nɛ men baa du wurɛwurɛbi a kɔ tɔnɔ ashi kananɛ men nyi Enyɛnpe Yesu Kristo na to. 9Esa kama nɛ e maŋ kɔ loŋ be asɔ na tan nna na, mo alɛ maa wu a yɔ kufɔ, mo alɛ nseŋ naŋ teŋ so fanɛ Ebɔrɛ kpra mbe alubi nɛ a daa wɔ mo so na kikɛ ashi mo so. 10Amoso, ŋ kurgepoana, men baa wora ania ga kebaawɔtɔ ere to a ti so n shin nɛ men be ketre nɛ kelara nɛ Ebɔrɛ lara menyi na e baa dii efuli men be kebaawɔtɔ to. Nɛ menyi alɛ baa wora loŋ be asheŋ na men maaŋ tɔr kikɛ. 11Saŋɛ na so baaŋ bugi ekpa pawu n sa menyi nɛ men luri an Nyɛnpe nɛ an be Emɔlgapo Yesu Kristo be kuwura nɛ k maŋ kɔ ekar na to.
Abɔrɛsibɛ be kewuŋkaŋɛ be asheŋ
12N nyi men ka nyi asɔ ere kikɛ, ma alɛ nseŋ naa nyi men ka yil kashenteŋ nɛ men kɔ naniere na to kpakpa, ama saŋkikɛ meeŋ baa nyiŋi menyi asheŋ ere kikɛ. 13Ŋkpal manɛ so, mee fɛ fanɛ ŋ ka kraa wɔ eyur ere to ere bre, a daga fanɛ m baa nyiŋi menyi asheŋ na kikɛ a leŋ menyi to. 14N nyi fanɛ k maaŋ naŋ chɛr nɛ ŋ gbaŋ ma eyur ere n lɛ, kumo alɛ be loŋ nɛ an Nyɛnpe Yesu Kristo bugi to ŋ ŋini ma na. 15Ama pɔɛŋ nɛ n wu, meeŋ wora ania ga n fin ekpa mo nɛ menyeeŋ baa bɔla so a nyiŋi asɔ nɛ n nase menyi ere saŋkikɛ. 16Men baa nyi fanɛ mannɛ dimɛdi be kanyiashenso be nfɛra fɛso be ablɔmbi so nɛ an daa bɛ saŋɛ nɛ an daŋ kaŋɛ menyi an Nyɛnpe Yesu Kristo be eleŋ nɛ mbe keba be asheŋ na. An daŋ wu kemaŋkura na kenishiso. 17Ebɔrɛ Etuto na daŋ sa mo bunyaŋ nɛ kemaŋkura na saŋɛ nɛ ebɔl na daŋ shi Kemaŋkuraana kikɛ to be kakpa m ba kaŋɛ le na: “Ŋ gbagba Pibinyɛn shaso nɛ ma kagbene fuli mo so nde.” 18Ebɔl na ka daŋ shi ebɔrɛso m ba saŋɛ nɛ anyi nɛ mo daa la kebee cheembi na so na, anyi alɛ gba daŋ nu kumo. 19Amoso, anyee yirda asheŋ nɛ anebiana wu ŋ kaŋɛ ana an be ŋgbene to a ti so. Nɛ men baa bɛ amo so fanɛ fitila ka bee sa kefulto tentembiri be kakpa to na, menyeeŋ baa wora asɔ. Men baa kɔ to loŋ hale nɛ kachɛ na e ya kaa fo nɛ karechɛso be kechɛkpabi na e ya nyaŋɛ kefulto n wɔtɔ men be ŋgbene to. 20Ade kikɛ nyam be kaman, men baa nyi fanɛ esa kama maaŋ tiŋ n ta mo gbagba be nfɛra ŋ kute abɔrɛsibɛ be kewuŋkaŋɛ kama. 21Ŋkpal manɛ so, abɔrɛsheŋ wuŋkaŋɛ kama maŋ naŋ shi dimɛdi be katiŋ so m ba, ama Kiyoyu Cheeŋ na e daŋ ta basa nɛ b malga baru nɛ k shi Ebɔrɛ kutɔ na.

english_text:
False Prophets and Teachers
1Sometimes false prophets spoke to the people of Israel. False teachers will also sneak in and speak harmful lies to you. But these teachers don't really belong to the Master who paid a great price for them, and they will quickly destroy themselves. 2Many people will follow their evil ways and cause others to tell lies about the true way. 3They will be greedy and cheat you with smooth talk. But long ago God decided to punish them, and God doesn't sleep.
4God did not have pity on the angels that sinned. He had them tied up and thrown into the dark pits of hell until the time of judgment. 5 And during Noah's time, God did not have pity on the ungodly people of the world. He destroyed them with a flood, though he did save eight people, including Noah, who preached the truth.
6 God punished the cities of Sodom and Gomorrah by burning them to ashes, and this is a warning to anyone else who wants to sin.
7-8 Lot lived right and was greatly troubled by the terrible way those wicked people were living. He was a good man, and day after day he suffered because of the evil things he saw and heard. So the Lord rescued him. 9This shows that the Lord knows how to rescue godly people from their sufferings and to punish evil people while they wait for the day of judgment.
10The Lord is especially hard on people who disobey him and don't think of anything except their own filthy desires. They are reckless and proud and are not afraid of cursing the glorious beings in heaven. 11Although angels are more powerful than these evil beings, even the angels don't dare to accuse them to the Lord.
12These people are no better than senseless animals that live by their feelings and are born to be caught and killed. They speak evil of things they don't know anything about. But their own corrupt deeds will destroy them. 13They have done evil, and they will be rewarded with evil.
They think it is fun to have wild parties during the day. They are immoral, and the meals they eat with you are spoiled by the shameful and selfish way they carry on. 14All they think about is having sex with someone else's husband or wife. There is no end to their wicked deeds. They trick people who are easily fooled, and their minds are filled with greedy thoughts. But they are headed for trouble!
15 They have left the true road and have gone down the wrong path by following the example of the prophet Balaam. He was the son of Beor and loved what he got from being a crook. 16But a donkey corrected him for this evil deed. It spoke to him with a human voice and made him stop his foolishness.
17These people are like dried up water holes and clouds blown by a windstorm. The darkest part of hell is waiting for them. 18They brag out loud about their stupid nonsense. And by being vulgar and crude, they trap people who have barely escaped from living the wrong kind of life. 19They promise freedom to everyone. But they are merely slaves of filthy living, because people are slaves of whatever controls them.
20When they learned about our Lord and Savior Jesus Christ, they escaped from the filthy things of this world. But they are again caught up and controlled by these filthy things, and now they are in worse shape than they were at first. 21They would have been better off if they had never known about the right way. Even after they knew what was right, they turned their backs on the holy commandments they were given. 22 What happened to them is just like the true saying,
“A dog will come back
to lick up its own vomit.
A pig that has been washed
will roll in the mud.”
translation_text:
Befɛpo ŋinipoana be asheŋ
1Kananɛ anebi fɛpoana daŋ lar n luri dra na to ebi to na, loŋ koŋwule na nɛ beŋinipo fɛpoana beeŋ lar n luri menyi to. Baaŋ ŋana m bar efɛ be keŋiniana nɛ a bee mur basa nseŋ kini Enyɛnpe nɛ e sɔ bumo n yige na, saŋɛ na so n ta kemur purgiase m bar bumo be amu. 2Basa damta beeŋ bɛ bumo be anishinyɔr be asheŋ so n shin nɛ basa e malga ŋ gbiti kashenteŋ be ekpa na. 3Beŋinipoana ere beeŋ bɔla bumo be kajɛ so n ta bumo gbagba be ablɔmbi n ta menyi n nyalɛ. Bumo alɛ be kasogberge dese n chɛr a jo bumo nɛ bumo be esa nɛ e beeŋ mur bumo na maa di. 4Ŋkpal manɛ so, nɛ Ebɔrɛ maŋ yige emalaika mo nɛ b daŋ wora alubi na gba nseŋ daŋ yɛra bumo kemaŋ nɛ baa tre abis to na nɛ b ya kaa kɔ bumo to tentembiri to mina a jo demujiachɛ na, 5ŋko nɛ e daa maŋ yige saŋɛ na be durnyaebi nseŋ daŋ bar nchu m ba sɔ durnya kikɛ nɛ kumo to be basa lubi mur nseŋ daŋ lara Nowa nɛ e daa la Ebɔrɛ be anishito be alelashemmalgapo na nɛ basa ashunu ko na, e beeŋ yige le be beŋinipo fɛpoana ere a? 6Ŋko nɛ e daŋ wu Sodɔm nɛ Gomɔra be nde na to ebi be alubi nseŋ daŋ chɔɔ amo edɛ nyam n ta kusɔ nɛ k daŋ wora bumo na a ŋini kusɔ nɛ k beeŋ ba wora bɔrɛkinipoana na, e beeŋ yige le be befɛpo ere bre a? 7Ŋko nɛ e daŋ lara Lɔt nɛ e daa la elelapo ashi Ebɔrɛ be anishito na nɛ mbe kagbene daa maŋ dese mo ŋkpal mbrakinipoana na be kebaawɔtɔ jijaso na so, 8ŋkpal manɛ so, e ka daa la esa lela nseŋ daa wɔ bumo to kapa nɛ kanyɛ na so, mbe kagbene daa maŋ dese mo ŋkpal asɔ jiga nɛ e daa wu nɛ amo nɛ e daa nu so. 9Amoso, men baa nyi fanɛ Enyɛnpe na nyi kananɛ e bee lara bɔrɛshapoana ashi bumo be kechɔŋkeniana to nseŋ naa nyi kananɛ e beeŋ baa kɔ bɔrɛkinipoana nɛ e kɔ a wɔ kasogberge to a jo demujiachɛ na, 10fɔnfɔŋ bumo nɛ b wɔtɔ a bɛ bumo be eyurana be nyɛlga lubiana so nsaa kini Ebɔrɛ be eleŋ na so. Loŋ be basa na nya kagbene nna a wɔtɔ a wu bumo be amu nsaa tege bebunyampoana nɛ b wɔ ebɔrɛso na ŋkaa maa ŋana, 11ŋkeshin nɛ emalaika gba e baa chɔ beŋinipo fɛpoana na eleŋ nɛ kemaŋkura ga ere maa wu bebunyampoana na kulubi nsaa tege bumo Enyɛnpe na be anishito. 12Ama loŋ be basa ere bee malga a gbiti asheŋ nɛ b maa pin to nna. B du fanɛ asɔbɔya nna a maŋ kɔ nfɛra a wora asheŋ. B kurge bumo nna nɛ b baa pɛ nsaa jija bumo. To, loŋ nɛ beŋinipoana na gba beeŋ mur fanɛ asɔbɔya na. 13Tɔrɔ mo nɛ baa bar ere, Ebɔrɛ beeŋ ta tɔrɔ ŋ ka bumo. Kusɔ nɛ k la ebel bumo kutɔ e la kewora kusɔ kama nɛ bumo be eyurana bee sha kapaso parr. Bumo be asheŋ la anishinyɔr nɛ ŋaba nna nɛ baa tu menyi a ji a wɔtɔ a nu bumo be kafulesheŋ be ebel na. 14Kesakaleasheŋ e baŋ bɔlɔ bumo be nfɛraana to, bumo alɛ maa wora alubi a gben kikɛ. Bumo e naa fule basa nɛ b maa kra ketɔr a wɔtɔ asheŋ jiga to, bumo alɛ nseŋ naa la kejimuni be bejuŋkparpo. B wɔ Ebɔrɛ be kɔnɔso to nna. 15B yige ekpa niŋiso na nseŋ foe m bɔla Biyɔɔ pibi Balaam nɛ e daŋ sha kebɔlɔ alubi so n dii dama na be ekpa. 16Mo e la esa nɛ kurma nɛ k la kusɔbɔya a maa malga, ama kumo alɛ nseŋ daŋ malga fanɛ dimɛdi n fiɛ mo so na. Mbe alubi so nɛ kurma na daŋ wora loŋ n shin nɛ mo ere anebi na lar mbe ebonsheŋ na to. 17Le be basa ere du fanɛ abombi nɛ a maŋ kɔ nchu nna ŋko kenyɔlɔ nna nɛ afugboŋ bee kpata a yɔ. Ebɔrɛ kɔ tentembiri nna le mina a jo bumo. 18Ŋkpal manɛ so, njɔŋ be mmalga fuloŋ e naa lar bumo be nnɔ to, bumo alɛ nseŋ naa kɔ anishinyɔr be kayɛlgasɔ ashi bumo be eyurana to a pɛ basa nɛ b baŋ fara a sha kelara bumo be amu basa nɛ b wɔ kafule to. 19Baa kaŋɛ basa pɔtɛ fanɛ baaŋ nya kamooji nɛ bumo gbagba wɔ kafule be kenyaya to. Kusɔ kama malɛ nɛ k bee pɔɔ esa so, kumo e la amodoŋwura mo nyɛnpe. 20Bekama nɛ b daŋ pin an Nyɛnpe nɛ an be Emɔlgapo Yesu Kristo na pɔɛŋ ŋkeŋ nya n lar durnya ere to be kebaawɔtɔ bɛso ere be aworbi to, kumo be kaman nɛ loŋ be asheŋ na naŋ pɛ bumo m pɔɔ bumo so, loŋ be basa be kebaawɔtɔ naa lubi nna ga a chɔ bumo be faraŋko be kebaawɔtɔ na. 21Nɛ b daa maŋ pin Ebɔrɛ be anishito be alelasheŋ be ekpa nna, k daa beeŋ baa bɔ bumo so a chɔ b ka ba pin kumo nseŋ naŋ pal kaman n sa Ebɔrɛ be kamalga naseso cheembi nɛ e daŋ ta n sa bumo na. 22Bumo be loŋ be kebaawɔtɔ na e naa ŋini aŋasa mo nɛ a bee kaŋɛ le na ka la kashenteŋ, a yɛ: “Jɔnɔ ka naa bɛta a yɔ kumo be ekwiɛ to,” ŋko: “B ka bɛr preku nɛ k naa bɛta n ya kaa milti depɔ to.”

english_text:
The Lord Will Return
1My dear friends, this is the second letter I have written to encourage you to do some honest thinking. I don't want you to forget 2what God's prophets said would happen. You must never forget what the holy prophets taught in the past. And you must remember what the apostles told you our Lord and Savior has commanded us to do.
3 But first you must realize that in the last days some people won't think about anything except their own selfish desires. They will make fun of you 4and say, “Didn't your Lord promise to come back? Yet the first leaders have already died, and the world hasn't changed a bit.”
5 They will say this because they want to forget that long ago the heavens and the earth were made at God's command. The earth came out of water and was made from water. 6 Later it was destroyed by the waters of a mighty flood. 7But God has commanded the present heavens and earth to remain until the day of judgment. Then they will be set on fire, and ungodly people will be destroyed.
8 Dear friends, don't forget that for the Lord one day is the same as 1,000 years, and 1,000 years is the same as one day. 9The Lord isn't slow about keeping his promises, as some people think he is. In fact, God is patient, because he wants everyone to turn from sin and no one to be lost.
10 The day of the Lord's return will surprise us like a thief. The heavens will disappear with a loud noise, and the heat will melt the whole universe. Then the earth and everything on it will be seen for what they are.
11Everything will be destroyed. So you should serve and honor God by the way you live. 12You should look forward to the day when God judges everyone, and you should try to make it come soon. On that day the heavens will be destroyed by fire, and everything else will melt in the heat. 13 But God has promised us a new heaven and a new earth, where justice will rule. We are really looking forward to this!
14My friends, while you are waiting, you should make certain the Lord finds you pure, spotless, and living at peace. 15Don't forget that the Lord is patient because he wants people to be saved. This is also what our dear friend Paul said when he wrote you with the wisdom God had given him. 16Paul talks about these same things in all his letters, but part of what he says is hard to understand. Some ignorant and unsteady people even destroy themselves by twisting what he said. They do the same thing with other Scriptures too.
17My dear friends, you have been warned ahead of time! So don't let the errors of evil people lead you down the wrong path and make you lose your balance. 18Let the gift of undeserved grace and the understanding that come from our Lord and Savior Jesus Christ help you keep on growing. Praise Jesus now and forever! Amen.
translation_text:
Enyɛnpe be kachɛ be asheŋ
1N teri shasoana, ma kawɔl nyɔsopo nde nɛ mee sibɛ a sa menyi. N sibɛ amo kikɛ nna nɛ n nyiŋi menyi nseŋ naŋ leŋ menyi to n wɔtɔ nfɛra niŋiso to. 2Mee sha fanɛ men nyiŋi mmalga nɛ anebi cheembiana na daŋ malga dra na nɛ kamalga nɛ an Nyɛnpe nɛ an be Emɔlgapo daŋ bɔla men be beshuŋipoana so m malga n nase na. 3Kusɔ nɛ k daga fanɛ men fara m pin e la fanɛ, lalaloge be nchɛ na to befɛpo beeŋ ba kaa wora basa shia nsaa bɛ bumo gbagba be nyɛlga lubiana so. 4Baaŋ kaŋɛ le: “Mannɛ mo e nase kumo fanɛ e beeŋ naŋ ba na a? To, nɛ e wɔ nnɛ? An tutoana ka baŋ wu kikɛ, asheŋ baa du kananɛ a du yili durnya be faraŋko na kikɛ nna.” 5Ama le be basa ere bee kute nna a kini kepin fanɛ dra na Ebɔrɛ daŋ malga nna nɛ esosoana nɛ kasawule daŋ fara kebaawɔtɔ. Nchu nɛ e daŋ ta nseŋ naŋ bɔla amo so ŋ jɔŋɛ kasawule. 6Nchu malɛ so nɛ e daŋ bɔla n jija saŋɛ na be durnya nɛ k mur. 7Kamalga koŋwule na so nɛ naniere be esosoana nɛ kasawule ere wɔtɔ a jo edɛ be keta m mur kumo na. A bee jo demujiachɛ nna, kachɛ nɛ bɔrɛkinipoana beeŋ mur na.
8Ama n teri shasoana, men sa maŋ kaŋ teŋ kesheŋ koŋwule ere so fanɛ Enyɛnpe bre kutɔ kachɛ koŋwule du fanɛ nfɛ kagboŋ nna nɛ nfɛ kagboŋ malɛ du fanɛ kachɛ koŋwule mo kutɔ. 9Amoso, Enyɛnpe na maŋ wushi ashi mbe kɔnɔ nɛ e nase fanɛ e beeŋ wora na to nna fanɛ kananɛ basa ko bee fɛ esa be kewushi na nna. Kanyiti nɛ e bee ji menyi a maa sha fanɛ esa kikɛ e mur, ama e bee sha fanɛ ekama e lar mbe alubi to nna.
10Ama Enyɛnpe be kachɛ na beeŋ purgi basa nna fanɛ eyu na. Kumo be kachɛ na, esosoana beeŋ ta awɔr chilili n foe basa be anishito. Esoso be asɔana beeŋ chɔɔ edɛ m mur. Nɛ kasawule nɛ asɔ nɛ a wɔ kumo so ere kikɛ e dii efuli.
11Nɛ kananɛ asɔ kikɛ ka beeŋ ba mur le ere, nuso be basa a daga fanɛ men baa du? A daga fanɛ men baa kɔ kebaawɔtɔ cheembi a wɔ kabɔrɛŋana be kebaawɔtɔ to 12a keni Ebɔrɛ be kachɛ na ekpa n shin nɛ k ba manaŋ. Kumo be kachɛ na, esosoana beeŋ chɔɔ edɛ m mur nɛ kuwuloŋ na e ŋalga esoso be asɔana na. 13Ama mbe kɔnɔ nɛ e nase na so nɛ anyee keni esoso popɔrana na nɛ kasawule popɔr na ekpa, ndoŋ nɛ Ebɔrɛ be anishito be alelasheŋ wɔ na.
14Amoso, n teri shasoana, ŋkpal men ka bee keni le be kesheŋ ere ekpa so, men baa wora ania ga a la basa nɛ Ebɔrɛ maaŋ wu kulubi bumo so nɛ b maŋ kɔ saŋgre kikɛ nɛ menyi nɛ mo malɛ e naa kɔ kagbenewushi abar so. 15Men baa nyi men be ŋgbene to fanɛ Enyɛnpe be kanyiti e la kumɔlga fanɛ kananɛ Ebɔrɛ daŋ sa an niopibi Pɔɔl kanyiasheŋ nɛ e sibɛ menyi na. 16Mbe nwɔl malɛ kikɛ to loŋ nɛ e bee malga a kaŋɛ loŋ be asheŋ. Ama asɔ ko wɔ mbe nwɔlana na to nna a maa tiŋ a pin to nɛ basa nɛ b maŋ nyi ŋkaa maa tiŋ a yil to kpakpa na bee bɔla ekpa nɛ k maŋ niŋi so a ŋini asheŋ gbɛto fanɛ kananɛ baa ta abɔrɛsibɛ nɛ a ka na a wora na. Loŋ malɛ, bumo gbagba be amu so nɛ baa bar kemur na.
17Ama n teri lelaana, menyi ere tea nyi asheŋ ere kikɛ, amoso, men baa da so nɛ mbrakinipoana be alubi e sa maŋ shin nɛ men foe ekpa n lar kakpa lela nɛ men yil ere so n tɔr. 18Ama men baa wɔtɔ a yɔ anishito ashi an Nyɛnpe nɛ an be Emɔlgapo Yesu Kristo be kuwɔr be kakɛ na nɛ kashennyi na to. Kemaŋkura e baa la mo peya naniere nɛ saŋkikɛ mbaanaayɔ. Amɛn.

english_text:
1 The Word that gives life
was from the beginning,
and this is the one
our message is about.
Our ears have heard,
our eyes have seen,
and our hands have touched
this Word.
2 The one who gives life appeared! We saw it happen, and we are witnesses to what we have seen. Now we are telling you about this eternal life that was with the Father and appeared to us. 3We are telling you what we have seen and heard, so you may share in this life with us. And we share in it with the Father and with his Son Jesus Christ. 4We are writing to tell you these things, because this makes us truly happy.
God Is Light
5Jesus told us God is light and doesn't have any darkness in him. Now we are telling you.
6If we say we share in life with God and keep on living in the dark, we are lying and are not living by the truth. 7 But if we live in the light, as God does, we share in life with each other. And the blood of his Son Jesus washes all our sins away. 8If we say we have not sinned, we are fooling ourselves, and the truth isn't in our hearts. 9But if we confess our sins to God, he can always be trusted to forgive us and take our sins away.
10If we say we have not sinned, we make God a liar, and his message isn't in our hearts.
translation_text:
Kamalga nɛ k bee sa ŋkpa na be asheŋ
1Yesu Kristo nɛ baa tre Kamalga nɛ k bee sa ŋkpa nsaa wɔtɔ durnya be sososo kikɛ na be asheŋ nɛ anyee sibɛ a sa menyi na. E malga nɛ an nu nseŋ wu mo kenishiso ŋ keni mo nseŋ ta an be enɔana m beta mo. 2Le be ŋkpa ere ka ba lar efuli nɛ an wu kumo, amoso nɛ anyee ji kumo be shɛda a sa menyi a kaŋɛ menyi ŋkpa nɛ k maŋ kɔ ekar ere be asheŋ na. K daa wɔ Ebɔrɛ na kutɔ nna pɔɛŋ nɛ b lara kumo efuli n sa anyi. 3Asɔ nɛ an wu nseŋ nu nɛ anyee ta a kaŋɛ menyi alɛ gba na, saŋɛ na so menyeeŋ tu anyi a wɔ kɔnɔkoŋwule be kebaawɔtɔ mo nɛ anyi nɛ Etuto Ebɔrɛ nɛ mo Pibinyɛn Yesu Kristo kɔ na to. 4Anyi alɛ naa sibɛ kawɔl ere nna nɛ anyi be ŋgbene e fuli anyi parr.
Kebaana kefulto to be asheŋ
5Baru mo nɛ an nu ashi Ebɔrɛ Pibinyɛn na kutɔ nsaa bɔ kumo a sa menyi na nde fanɛ Ebɔrɛ la kefulto nna nɛ tentembiri malɛ kikɛ maŋ wɔ mo to kuraa. 6To, nɛ anyee kaŋɛ fanɛ anyi nɛ Ebɔrɛ kɔ kɔnɔkoŋwule be kebaawɔtɔ nsaa na tentembiri to, efɛ nɛ anyee ku na, anyi alɛ nsaa maŋ naa wɔ kashenteŋ be kebaawɔtɔ to. 7Ama nɛ fanɛ an baa na kefulto to fanɛ kananɛ e wɔ kefulto to na bre, kumo ere anyi nɛ an braana beeŋ baa kɔ kɔnɔkoŋwule be kebaawɔtɔ nɛ mo Pibinyɛn Yesu be ŋklaŋ nɛ a lar saŋɛ nɛ e wu na e baa fɔr kulubi kikɛ nyam ashi anyi be ŋgbene to. 8Nɛ an baŋ kaŋɛ fanɛ an maŋ kɔ kulubi bre, anyee fule anyi be amu nna nɛ kashenteŋ malɛ maŋ wɔ anyi to kuraa. 9Ama nɛ fanɛ an bugi to ŋ kaŋɛ Ebɔrɛ anyi be alubi bre, e la esa nɛ e niŋi nna nɛ anyeeŋ tiŋ n yirda mo nɛ e ta anyi be alubi kikɛ nyam m paŋ anyi nseŋ fɔr kulubi kikɛ nyam ashi anyi be ŋgbene to. 10Nɛ an baŋ kaŋɛ fanɛ an maŋ wora alubi bre, kumo ere anyee tre Ebɔrɛ efɛpo nna na nɛ mbe kamalga na malɛ maŋ wɔ anyi to.

english_text:
Christ Helps Us
1My children, I am writing this so you won't sin. But if you do sin, Jesus Christ always does the right thing, and he will speak to the Father for us. 2Christ is the sacrifice that takes away our sins and the sins of all the world's people.
3When we obey God, we are sure we know him. 4But if we claim to know him and don't obey him, we are lying and the truth isn't in our hearts. 5We truly love God only when we obey him as we should, and then we know we belong to him. 6If we say we are his, we must follow the example of Christ.
The New Commandment
7 My dear friends, I am not writing to give you a new commandment. It is the same one you were first given, and it is the message you heard. 8But it really is a new commandment, and you know its true meaning, just as Christ does. You can see the darkness fading away and the true light already shining.
9If we claim to be in the light and hate someone, we are still in the dark. 10But if we love others, we are in the light, and we don't cause problems for them. 11If we hate others, we are living and walking in the dark. We don't know where we are going, because we can't see in the dark.
12Children, I am writing you,
because your sins
have been forgiven
in the name of Christ.
13Parents, I am writing you,
because you have known
the one who was there
from the beginning.
Young people, I am writing you,
because you have defeated
the evil one.
14Children, I am writing you,
because you have known
the Father.
Parents, I am writing you,
because you have known
the one who was there
from the beginning.
Young people, I am writing you,
because you are strong.
God's message is firm
in your hearts,
and you have defeated
the evil one.
15Don't love the world or anything that belongs to the world. If you love the world, you cannot love the Father. 16Our foolish pride comes from this world, and so do our selfish desires and our desire to have everything we see. None of this comes from the Father. 17The world and the desires it causes are disappearing. But if we obey God, we will live forever.
The Enemy of Christ
18Children, this is the last hour. You heard that the enemy of Christ would appear at this time, and many of Christ's enemies have already appeared. So we know the last hour is here. 19These people came from our own group, yet they were not really part of us. If they had been part of us, they would have stayed with us. But they left, which proves they did not belong to our group.
20Christ, the Holy One, has blessed you, and now all of you understand. 21I did not need to write you about the truth, since you already know it. You also know that liars do not belong to the truth. 22And a liar is anyone who says Jesus isn't truly Christ. Anyone who says this is an enemy of Christ and rejects both the Father and the Son. 23If we reject the Son, we reject the Father. But if we say we accept the Son, we have the Father. 24Keep thinking about the message you first heard, and you will always be one in your heart with the Son and with the Father. 25The Son has promised us eternal life.
26I am writing to warn you about those people who are misleading you. 27But Christ has blessed you with the Holy Spirit. Now the Spirit stays in you, and you don't need any teachers. The Spirit is truthful and teaches you everything. So stay one in your heart with Christ, just as the Spirit has taught you to do.
Children of God
28Children, stay one in your hearts with Christ. Then when he returns, we will have confidence and won't have to hide in shame. 29You know Christ always does right and everyone who does right is a child of God.
translation_text:
1Ma mbi shasoana, mee sibɛ kawɔl ere nna a sa menyi nɛ men sa maŋ wora alubi. Ama nɛ k ba fanɛ ekama nɛ e ba wora kulubi bre, an kɔ ematapo ashi anyi nɛ Ebɔrɛ Etuto na be nferinto. Mo e la Yesu Kristo, esa nɛ e la esa lela Ebɔrɛ be anishito na. 2Mo e wu m mata be luwu nɛ k shin nɛ an nya alubi be ketampaŋ. Mannɛ anyi nawule be alubi so nɛ e wu, durnyaebi kikɛ be alubi so nɛ e wu.
Kebaabɛ Ebɔrɛ be mmalga naseso so be asheŋ
3Nɛ an baa bɛ Ebɔrɛ be mmalga naseso so bre, kumo ere an baa nyi geeŋ fanɛ an nyi mo. 4Esa kama nɛ e bee kaŋɛ fanɛ: “Ma ere nyi mo,” mo alɛ nsaa maa bɛ Ebɔrɛ na be mmalga naseso so, amodoŋwura la efɛpo nna nɛ kashenteŋ na malɛ maŋ wɔ mo to. 5Ama esa kama nɛ e bee bɛ Ebɔrɛ na be mmalga naseso so, amodoŋwura e la esa nɛ Ebɔrɛ be kasha bɔlɔ mo to felɛlɛ kashenteŋto Loŋ malɛ nɛ anyee ta a pin fanɛ an ka wɔ Ebɔrɛ to. 6Ekama malɛ nɛ e bee kaŋɛ fanɛ e wɔ Ebɔrɛ na to, a daga fanɛ amodoŋwura e baa wora asheŋ fanɛ kananɛ Yesu daa wora na.
Mbra popɔr na be asheŋ
7N teri shasoana, mannɛ kamalga naseso popɔr nɛ mee sibɛ a sa menyi, kedra nna. Kumo alɛ nɛ men nya sososo kikɛ na. Kamalga naseso dra na e la kubɔya mo nɛ men teŋ nu na. 8Ama kamalga naseso mo nɛ mee sibɛ a sa menyi ere malɛ du fanɛ kepopɔr nna. Menyi nɛ Kristo be kebaawɔtɔ malɛ to nɛ baa wu kumo be loŋ be kashenteŋ na, ŋkpal manɛ so, tentembiri na bee choŋ nna nɛ kashenteŋ be kefulto na tea fuli to. 9Esa kama nɛ e bee kaŋɛ fanɛ e wɔ kefulto na to, mo alɛ nsaa kishi mo niopibi, kraa wɔ tentembiri to nna na. 10Esa kama malɛ nɛ e bee sha mo niopibi wɔ kefulto na to nna na nɛ shɛŋ malɛ maŋ naa wɔ mo to a kagle mo ekpa a shin nɛ e bee fiti a tɔr. 11Ama ekama nɛ e bee kishi mo niopibi wɔ tentembiri to nna na, mo alɛ nsaa na tentembiri to. E maŋ nyi kakpa nɛ e bee yɔ, ŋkpal manɛ so, tentembiri na e naa shin nɛ e maa wu.
12Ma mbi shasoana, mee sibɛ nna a sa menyi ŋkpal Ebɔrɛ ka ta menyi be alubi m paŋ menyi ŋkpal Yesu so na. 13Mee sibɛ nna a sa menyi betutoana ŋkpal men ka nyi mo ere esa nɛ e wɔ ŋkpa to sososo kikɛ na so. Mee sibɛ nna a sa menyi mbrantiɛbia ŋkpal men ka pɔɔ alubipo na so so. 14Mee sibɛ nna a sa menyi mbia ŋkpal men ka nyi etuto na so. Mee sibɛ nna a sa menyi betutoana ŋkpal men ka nyi mo ere esa nɛ e wɔ ŋkpa to sososo kikɛ na so. Mee sibɛ nna a sa menyi mbrantiɛbia ŋkpal men ka kɔ eleŋ nɛ Ebɔrɛ be kamalga na wɔ menyi to nɛ men pɔɔ alubipo na so so.
Durnya be kasha be asheŋ
15Men sa maa sha durnya ere ŋko kusɔ kama nɛ k la durnya ere peya. Esa kama nɛ e bee sha durnya ere maŋ kɔ kasha a sa Etuto Ebɔrɛ na. 16Ŋkpal manɛ so, asɔ nɛ a la durnya ere to be asɔ fanɛ asɔ nɛ dimɛdi be kapɔr lubi ere bee sha nɛ asɔ nɛ basa bee wu nsaa yɛlga nɛ durnya ere to be kamoowusheŋ kikɛ nyam maŋ shi Etuto na kutɔ, a la durnya ere to be asɔ nna. 17Durnya ere malɛ nɛ kumo be ayɛlgasɔ kikɛ nyam bee choŋ nna, ama esa kama nɛ e bee wora Ebɔrɛ na be aparsheŋ bre wɔ ŋkpa to nna mbaanaayɔ.
Kristo mo doŋ be asheŋ
18Ma mbi shasoana, lalaloge be saŋɛ na bee fo nna na. Men daŋ nu fanɛ Kristo mo doŋ beeŋ ba, naniere malɛ Kristo mo doŋana damta ba, amoso nɛ an pin fanɛ lalaloge be jemanɛ na fo. 19Le be basa ere daŋ shi anyi be katuŋ to nna, ama kashenteŋto, b daa maŋ la anyi to be basa, amoso nɛ b lar anyi to n yɔ na. Nɛ b daa la anyi to be basa nna b daa maaŋ lar. Ama bumo be kelar anyi to na e naa ŋini fanɛ mannɛ bumo be ekama e la anyi to be eko.
20Ama menyi ere, Yesu Kristo ta Kiyoyu Cheeŋ na nna n wɔtɔ menyi to nɛ menyi kikɛ e pin kashenteŋ na. 21Mannɛ fanɛ men ka maŋ nyi kashenteŋ na so e shin nɛ mee sibɛ asɔ ere a sa menyi, ama menyi ka nyi kumo so nseŋ naa nyi fanɛ efɛ kikɛ maŋ wɔ kashenteŋ na to so nɛ mee sibɛ amo a sa menyi.
22Esa mo malɛ e baa la efɛpo nɛ mannɛ esa nɛ e bee kaŋɛ fanɛ mannɛ Yesu e la Kristo, Ebɔrɛ be esa laraso na. Loŋ be esa e la Kristo mo doŋ na, emo nɛ e bee kini Ebɔrɛ Etuto na nɛ Ebinyɛn na kikɛ na. 23Ŋkpal manɛ so, ekama nɛ e bee kini Ebinyɛn na maŋ kɔ Etuto na nna na, nɛ ekama malɛ nɛ e bee sɔ Ebinyɛn na kɔ Etuto na gba.
24Ama menyi ere e shin nɛ kusɔ nɛ men nu sososo kikɛ na e shir a wɔ menyi to. Nɛ kusɔ nɛ men nu sososo kikɛ na baa wɔ menyi to bre, kumo ere menyi alɛ gba beeŋ baa wɔ Ebinyɛn na nɛ Etuto na to. 25Kusɔ nɛ mo alɛ nase kɔnɔ fanɛ e beeŋ sa anyi e la ŋkpa nɛ k maŋ kɔ ekar na.
26Mee sibɛ asɔ ere nna a sa menyi nɛ ŋ kaŋɛ menyi basa nɛ baa sha kefule menyi na be asheŋ. 27Ama menyi ere, Yesu Kristo ta Kiyoyu Cheeŋ na nna n wɔtɔ menyi to nɛ e shir a wɔ menyi to. A maŋ daga fanɛ men naŋ nya esa ko nɛ e ŋini menyi, ŋkpal manɛ so, mbe Kiyoyu na e naa ŋini menyi asɔ kikɛ. Kusɔ kama malɛ nɛ e bee ŋini la kashenteŋ nna, mannɛ efɛ. Amoso, men baa bɛ Kiyoyu na be keŋini so nseŋ shir a wɔ Kristo na to.
Ebɔrɛ be mbia be asheŋ
28To, naniere ma mbi shasoana, men baa kraa wɔ mo to, saŋɛ na so, e kaŋ ba, anyi maaŋ baa shika to kikɛ, anyi alɛ maaŋ naŋ ji anishinyɔr mbe anishito ŋkpal menyi so. 29Menyi alɛ gba baa nyi Kristo na ka niŋi kusɔ kikɛ to. Kumo ere a daga fanɛ men baa nyi fanɛ esa kama nɛ e bee wora asɔ nɛ a niŋi la Ebɔrɛ pibi nna na.

english_text:
1 Think how much the Father loves us. He loves us so much that he lets us be called his children, as we truly are. But since the people of this world did not know who Christ is, they don't know who we are. 2My dear friends, we are already God's children, though what we will be hasn't yet been seen. But we do know when Christ returns, we will be like him, because we will see him as he truly is. 3This hope makes us keep ourselves holy, just as Christ is holy.
4Everyone who sins breaks God's law, because sin is the same as breaking God's law. 5 You know Christ came to take away our sins. He isn't sinful, 6and people who stay one in their hearts with him won't keep on sinning. If they do keep on sinning, they don't know Christ, and they have never seen him.
7Children, don't be fooled. Anyone who does right is good, just like Christ himself. 8Anyone who keeps on sinning belongs to the devil. He has sinned from the beginning, but the Son of God came to destroy all that he has done. 9God's children cannot keep on being sinful. His life-giving power lives in them and makes them his children, so they cannot keep on sinning. 10You can tell God's children from the devil's children, because those who belong to the devil refuse to do right or to love each other.
Love Each Other
11 From the beginning you were told we must love each other. 12 Don't be like Cain, who belonged to the devil and murdered his own brother. Why did he murder him? He did it because his brother was good, and he was evil. 13My friends, don't be surprised if the people of this world hate you. 14 Our love for each other proves we have gone from death to life. But if you don't love each other, you are still under the power of death.
15If you hate each other, you are murderers, and we know murderers do not have eternal life. 16We know what love is because Jesus gave his life for us. This is why we must give our lives for each other. 17If we have all we need and see one of our own people in need, we must have pity on that person, or else we cannot say we love God. 18Children, you show love for others by truly helping them, and not merely by talking about it.
19When we love others, we know we belong to the truth, and we feel at ease in the presence of God. 20But even if we don't feel at ease, God is greater than our feelings, and he knows everything. 21Dear friends, if we feel at ease in the presence of God, we will have the courage to come near him. 22He will give us whatever we ask, because we obey him and do what pleases him. 23 God wants us to have faith in his Son Jesus Christ and to love each other. This is also what Jesus taught us to do. 24If we obey God's commandments, we will stay one in our hearts with him, and he will stay one with us. The Spirit he has given us is proof that we are one with him.
translation_text:
1Men keni kananɛ Etuto na sha anyi loŋ n shin nɛ baa tre anyi mbe mbia, kumo alɛ maŋ kɔ emɔrɔ malɛ fanɛ an ka la mbe mbia. Amoso nɛ durnyaebi maa pin anyi to na. Ebɔrɛ nɛ b maŋ pin to pɔɛŋ. 2N teri shasoana, naniere an la Ebɔrɛ be mbia nna na, ama kananɛ anyeeŋ ba kaa du kachako so bre e maŋ naŋ lar efuli. Kusɔ nɛ an baa nyi kikɛ e la fanɛ Kristo kaŋ ba lar efuli, anyeeŋ baa du fanɛ mo gbagba nna, ŋkpal manɛ so, anyeeŋ wu mo kananɛ e baa du. 3Esa kama nɛ e kɔ le be tama ere ashi Kristo to bee keni mbe kumu so nna a du cheembi fanɛ kananɛ Kristo du cheembi na. 4Esa kama nɛ e bee wora alubi bee wora nna a da Ebɔrɛ malɛ gba so na, ŋkpal manɛ so, kewora kulubi la ketɔr Ebɔrɛ be ntaŋ nna. 5Men nyi Kristo ka ba nɛ e ba ta basa be alubi n lɛ n sa bumo. Kulubi kikɛ malɛ maŋ wɔ mo to. 6Amoso, esa kama malɛ nɛ e shir a wɔ mo to maa wora alubi. Esa kama nɛ e baa wɔtɔ a wora alubi bre maŋ naŋ wu mo ŋko m pin mo Yesu na nna na.
7Ma mbi shasoana, men sa maŋ shin nɛ esa kikɛ e shin nɛ men foe ekpa. Ekama nɛ e bee wora asheŋ nɛ a niŋi la esa niŋiso nna ashi Ebɔrɛ be anishito fanɛ kananɛ Kristo niŋi na. 8Esa kama malɛ nɛ e bee wora asheŋ lubi la alubipo na peya nna, ŋkpal manɛ so, durnya be sososo na kikɛ nɛ alubipo na wɔtɔ a wora alubi m ba fo mbre. To, loŋ malɛ so nɛ Ebɔrɛ Pibinyɛn na lar m ba nɛ e ba jija alubipo na be ashuŋ.
9Esa kama nɛ e la Ebɔrɛ pibi maa wora alubi. Ŋkpal Ebɔrɛ be kapɔr gbagba ka wɔ mo to so nɛ ŋkpal Ebɔrɛ ka la mo Tuto na so so, e maaŋ tiŋ n shir a wɔ alubi to a wora amo. 10To, loŋ malɛ nɛ anyee ta a pin Ebɔrɛ be mbia nɛ bumo nɛ bumo alɛ la alubipo na be mbia. Esa kama nɛ e bee wora asɔ nɛ a maa niŋi, maŋ la Ebɔrɛ pibi. Ekama malɛ gba nɛ e maa sha mo niopibi, maŋ la Ebɔrɛ pibi.
Kebaasha abar be asheŋ
11Kubɔya ere nɛ men daŋ nu sososo kikɛ na fanɛ a daga fanɛ an baa sha abar. 12A maŋ daga fanɛ an baa du fanɛ Keen nɛ e daa la alubipo na peya nseŋ bri mo sipo m mɔ na. Nɛ manɛ e daŋ ba nɛ e daŋ bri mo m mɔ? Kusɔ nɛ k daŋ ba e la fanɛ mbe asheŋ woraso daa maa niŋi nna nɛ mo sipo bre peya daa niŋi. 13Amoso, n niopibiana, nɛ durnya ere to ebi kishi menyi, men sa maŋ shin nɛ k baa chinchiŋ menyi. 14Esa kama nɛ e maa sha mo braana kraa wɔ luwu to nna na. Ama anyi ere nyi fanɛ an lar luwu to m ba luri ŋkpa to nna, ŋkpal manɛ so, anyee sha an niopibiana. 15Esa kama nɛ e kishi mo niopibi la emɔpo nna, menyi alɛ nyi fanɛ emɔpo kikɛ maŋ kɔ ŋkpa nɛ k maŋ kɔ ekar na mo to. 16Le nɛ an bɔla m pin kusɔ nɛ k la kasha. Yesu Kristo e shin nɛ b lara mbe ŋkpa ashi mo to n sa anyi. Amoso, a daga fanɛ anyi alɛ gba ka ta anyi be ŋkpaana n sa an niopibiana. 17Ama esa kama nɛ e kɔ durnya ere to be asɔ nseŋ wu fanɛ mo niopibi daga kechɛto, mo alɛ nseŋ ti mbe kagbene a maŋ chɛ mo to, nuso nɛ Ebɔrɛ be kasha bee wora a chena esa na wura to?
Kristo mo doŋana be asheŋ
18Ma mbi shasoana, men sa maŋ shin nɛ an baa kɔ mmalga ŋko nnɔ nawule a sha basa, men shin nɛ an baa kɔ aworbi nɛ kashenteŋ a sha basa.
19Loŋ nɛ anyeeŋ pin an ka wɔ kashenteŋ na to nɛ saŋkama malɛ nɛ an be ŋgbene bee ji a bri anyi, anyeeŋ wushi amo ashi Ebɔrɛ be anishito. 20Anyi alɛ beeŋ tiŋ n wora ade kikɛ nna, ŋkpal manɛ so, Ebɔrɛ e chɔ anyi be ŋgbene, mo alɛ nseŋ naa nyi kusɔ kama. 21Beshapo, nɛ an be ŋgbene baa maa ji a bri anyi, kumo ere anyi maa shika to Ebɔrɛ be anishito. 22Anyi alɛ naa tiŋ a nya kusɔ kama nɛ anyee kule mo ŋkpal an ka bee bɛ mbe mmalga naseso so so nsaa wora asɔ nɛ a bee par mo na so. 23Mbe kamalga naseso na malɛ nde fanɛ, a daga fanɛ an ka yirda mo Pibinyɛn Yesu Kristo be ketre na nsaa sha abar fanɛ kananɛ e yili anyi fanɛ an baa wora na. 24Bekama malɛ nɛ baa bɛ mbe mmalga nasesoana na so shir a wɔ mo to nna nɛ mo alɛ gba wɔ bumo to. To, kananɛ anyee wora a pin fanɛ e wɔ anyi to nde: Mbe Kiyoyu nɛ e ta n sa anyi na so so nɛ an pin loŋ.

english_text:
God Is Love
1Dear friends, don't believe everyone who claims to have the Spirit of God. Test them all to find out if they really do come from God. Many false prophets have already gone out into the world, 2and you can know which ones come from God. His Spirit says that Jesus Christ had a truly human body. 3But when someone doesn't say this about Jesus, you know this person has a spirit that doesn't come from God and is the enemy of Christ. You knew this enemy was coming into the world and now is already here.
4Children, you belong to God, and you have defeated these enemies. God's Spirit is in you and is more powerful than the one who is in the world. 5These enemies belong to this world, and the world listens to them, because they speak its language. 6We belong to God, and everyone who knows God will listen to us. But the people who don't know God won't listen to us. This is how we can tell the Spirit that speaks the truth from the one that tells lies.
7My dear friends, we must love each other. Love comes from God, and when we love each other, it shows we have been given new life. We are now God's children, and we know him. 8God is love, and anyone who doesn't love others has never known him. 9God showed his love for us when he sent his only Son into the world to give us life. 10Real love isn't our love for God, but his love for us. God sent his Son to be the sacrifice by which our sins are forgiven. 11Dear friends, since God loved us this much, we must love each other.
12 No one has ever seen God. But if we love each other, God lives in us, and his love is truly in our hearts.
13God has given us his Spirit. This is how we know we are one with him, just as he is one with us. 14God sent his Son to be the Savior of the world. We saw his Son and are now telling others about him. 15God stays one with everyone who openly says Jesus is the Son of God. This is how we stay one with God 16and are sure God loves us.
God is love. If we keep on loving others, we will stay one in our hearts with God, and he will stay one with us. 17If we truly love others and live as Christ did in this world, we won't be worried about the day of judgment. 18A real love for others will chase those worries away. The thought of being punished is what makes us afraid. It shows we have not really learned to love.
19We love because God loved us first. 20But if we say we love God and don't love each other, we are liars. We cannot see God. So how can we love God, if we don't love the people we can see? 21The commandment that God has given us is: “Love God and love each other!”
translation_text:
Kashenteŋ be Kiyoyu na nɛ efɛ be ayoyu be asheŋ
1N teri shasoana, men sa maa yirda basa kama nɛ baa kaŋɛ fanɛ Ebɔrɛ be Kiyoyu wɔ bumo to. Men baa wora bumo a keni ŋko ayoyu mo nɛ b kɔ na shi Ebɔrɛ kutɔ nna ŋko a maŋ shi mo kutɔ, ŋkpal manɛ so, anebi fɛpo damtaana lar n luri durnya to. 2To, kananɛ menyeeŋ wora m pin Ebɔrɛ be Kiyoyu na esa to nde: Kiyoyu kama nɛ e wɔ esa to a bugi to a kaŋɛ fanɛ Yesu Kristo ta eyur nna m ba durnya ere to na, shi Ebɔrɛ kutɔ nna. 3Ama kiyoyu kama nɛ e maa ji Yesu be asheŋ be shɛda, loŋ be kiyoyu maŋ shi Ebɔrɛ kutɔ. Loŋ be kiyoyu na e la edoŋ na be kiyoyu mo nɛ men nu fanɛ e bee ba na. Mo e teŋ ba durnya ere to na.
4Ama menyi ere, ma mbi shasoana, men la Ebɔrɛ be basa nna m pɔɔ loŋ be anebi fɛpoana so, ŋkpal manɛ so, esa nɛ e wɔ menyi to na e chɔ emo nɛ e wɔ durnya ere to na. 5Durnya ere to be basa e la bumo, amoso, durnya ere to be mmalga nɛ baa malga nɛ durnya ere to ebi malɛ bee nu bumo be mmalga na. 6Anyi ere la Ebɔrɛ be basa nna, ekama malɛ nɛ e nyi Ebɔrɛ bee nu anyi be mmalga nna. Ama ekama malɛ nɛ e maŋ la Ebɔrɛ peya maa nu kusɔ nɛ anyee kaŋɛ. Loŋ malɛ nɛ anyee ta a pin kashenteŋ be Kiyoyu na nɛ efɛ be kiyoyu na to.
Ebɔrɛ be kasha nɛ anyi be kasha be asheŋ
7N teri shasoana, men shin nɛ an baa sha abar, ŋkpal manɛ so, kasha shi Ebɔrɛ kutɔ nna. Esa kama nɛ e kɔ kasha la Ebɔrɛ pibi nna na, mo alɛ nsaa nyi Ebɔrɛ. 8Ama ekama nɛ e maŋ kɔ kasha maŋ nyi Ebɔrɛ, ŋkpal manɛ so, Ebɔrɛ e la kashawura. 9Kananɛ Ebɔrɛ ŋini anyi mbe kasha nde: E shuŋi mo Pibinyɛn koŋwule nna durnya ere to fanɛ an bɔla mo so n nya ŋkpa. 10Kede nɛ baa tre kasha gbagba na, mannɛ anyi gbagba be kasha nɛ an ta n sha Ebɔrɛ, mo e sha anyi nseŋ shuŋi mo Pibinyɛn fanɛ e ba wu m mata be luwu nɛ k shin nɛ an nya alubi be ketampaŋ.
11N teri shasoana, ŋkpal kananɛ Ebɔrɛ sha anyi ere so, a daga fanɛ anyi alɛ gba e baa sha abar. 12Esa kama maŋ naŋ wu Ebɔrɛ kenishiso, ama nɛ an baa sha abar bre, kumo ere Ebɔrɛ wɔ anyi to nɛ mbe kasha malɛ bɔlɔ anyi to felɛlɛ kashenteŋto.
13Kananɛ anyee wora a pin fanɛ an wɔ mo to nɛ mo alɛ gba wɔ anyi to nde: E ta mo gbagba be Kiyoyu nna n sa anyi. 14Anyi alɛ wu nseŋ ji kumo be shɛda fanɛ Etuto na shuŋi mo Pibinyɛn fanɛ e ba kaa la durnya ere to be Emɔlgapo. 15Ekama nɛ e bee bugi to a kaŋɛ basa fanɛ Yesu e la Ebɔrɛ Pibinyɛn na, Ebɔrɛ e wɔ amodoŋwura to nɛ mo alɛ gba wɔ Ebɔrɛ to. 16Anyi alɛ gba ba pin nseŋ yirda kasha mo nɛ Ebɔrɛ kɔ a sa anyi na.
Ebɔrɛ e la kashawura. Ekama malɛ nɛ e wɔ kasha be kebaawɔtɔ to, wɔ Ebɔrɛ to nna na nɛ Ebɔrɛ malɛ gba wɔ amodoŋwura to.
17Kasha malɛ bɔlɔ anyi to nna felɛlɛ, saŋɛ na so demujiachɛ na anyi maaŋ shika to, ŋkpal manɛ so, anyi be kebaawɔtɔ durnya ere to nɛ kananɛ Kristo du na la kukoŋwule nna. 18Kakpa nɛ kasha wɔ, kufu maŋ wɔtɔ. Kashenteŋ be kasha bee ju kufu nna, ŋkpal manɛ so, nɛ an kraŋ baa ŋana fanɛ Ebɔrɛ beeŋ gberge anyi kusoe, kumo ere anyi maa sha mo nɛnɛ nna na. Amoso, esa nɛ e bee lɔ kufu, kasha maŋ naŋ bɔlɔ mo to felɛlɛ nna na. 19Ebɔrɛ e daŋ kesha anyi so shin nɛ anyi alɛ kɔ kasha na. 20Esa kama nɛ e bee kaŋɛ le: “Mee sha Ebɔrɛ,” mo alɛ nsaa kishi mo niopibi la efɛpo nna, ŋkpal manɛ so, esa nɛ e bee wu mo niopibi ŋkaa maaŋ tiŋ n sha mo, maaŋ tiŋ n sha Ebɔrɛ mo nɛ e maŋ naŋ wu kikɛ na. 21To, le be kamalga naseso ere nɛ e ta m bɔɔ anyi enɔ fanɛ, esa kama nɛ e bee sha Ebɔrɛ e baa sha mo niopibi gba.

english_text:
Victory over the World
1If we believe Jesus is truly Christ, we are God's children. Everyone who loves the Father will also love his children. 2If we love and obey God, we know we will love his children. 3 We show our love for God by obeying his commandments, and they are not hard to follow.
4Every child of God can defeat the world, and our faith is what gives us this victory. 5No one can defeat the world without having faith in Jesus as the Son of God.
Who Jesus Is
6Water and blood came out from the side of Jesus Christ. It wasn't just water, but water and blood. The Spirit tells about this, because the Spirit is truthful. 7In fact, there are three who tell about it. 8They are the Spirit, the water, and the blood, and they all agree.
9We believe what people tell us. But we can trust what God says even more, and God is the one who has spoken about his Son. 10If we have faith in God's Son, we have believed what God has said. But if we don't believe what God has said about his Son, it is the same as calling God a liar. 11 God has also said he gave us eternal life and this life comes to us from his Son. 12And so, if we have God's Son, we have this life. But if we don't have the Son, we don't have this life.
Knowing about Eternal Life
13All of you have faith in the Son of God, and I have written to let you know you have eternal life. 14We are certain God will hear our prayers when we ask for what pleases him. 15And if we know God listens when we pray, we are sure our prayers have already been answered.
16Suppose you see one of our people commit a sin that isn't a deadly sin. You can pray, and this person will be given eternal life. But the sin must not be one that is deadly. 17Everything that is wrong is sin, but not all sins are deadly.
18We are sure God's children do not keep on sinning. God's own Son protects them, and the devil cannot harm them.
19We are certain we come from God and the rest of the world is under the power of the devil.
20We know that Jesus Christ the Son of God has come and has shown us the true God. And because of Jesus, we now belong to the true God who gives eternal life.
21Children, you must stay away from idols.
translation_text:
Anyi be eleŋ ka chɔ durnya ere to ebi peya be asheŋ
1Esa kama nɛ e yirda fanɛ Yesu e la Kristo na la Ebɔrɛ pibi nna nɛ ekama malɛ nɛ e bee sha esa nɛ e kurge ebi na beeŋ baa sha ebi na gba. 2Nɛ an baa sha Ebɔrɛ nsaa bɛ mbe mmalga naseso so bre, loŋ nɛ anyeeŋ pin an ka bee sha Ebɔrɛ be mbia gba. 3Kesha Ebɔrɛ malɛ e la kebɛ mbe mmalga nasesoana so, amo alɛ maŋ du kpakpa. 4Ŋkpal manɛ so, esa kama nɛ e la Ebɔrɛ pibi bee pɔɔ durnya ere so nna. Eleŋ mo nɛ k bee pɔɔ durnya so e la anyi be yirda. 5Wanɛ e naaŋ tiŋ m pɔɔ durnya ere so nɛ mannɛ esa nɛ e yirda fanɛ Yesu e la Ebɔrɛ Pibinyɛn na?
Bumo nɛ b ji shɛda ŋ kaŋɛ Yesu be asheŋ
6Yesu ere e la emo nɛ e daŋ yili kabɔrɛbɛr be nchu nɛ mbe luwu be ŋklaŋ so m ba na. Mannɛ nchu na malɛ nawule so nɛ e daŋ yili so m ba, nchu na nɛ ŋklaŋ na kikɛ so nɛ e daŋ yili so m ba. 7Kiyoyu na malɛ e la shɛdajipo na, ŋkpal manɛ so, Kiyoyu na e la kashenteŋ na. 8Eshɛdajipo asa e wɔtɔ. Kiyoyu na wɔtɔ nɛ nchu na wɔtɔ nɛ ŋklaŋ na gba wɔtɔ. Kɔnɔkoŋwule nɛ amo alɛ kikɛ kɔ. 9Anyi maa kplaŋ dimɛdi be shɛda so, ama an nyi fanɛ Ebɔrɛ be shɛda e chɔ dimɛdi peya, ŋkpal manɛ so, Ebɔrɛ be shɛda na nɛ e ta a ji mo Pibinyɛn be asheŋ. 10Esa kama malɛ nɛ e yirda Ebɔrɛ Pibinyɛn na kɔ loŋ be shɛda na mbe kagbene to. Ama ekama nɛ e maŋ yirda Ebɔrɛ ta mo Ebɔrɛ na ŋ ki efɛpo nna na ŋkpal amodoŋwura na ka maŋ yirda shɛda mo nɛ e bee ji mo Pibinyɛn na be asheŋ na so. 11Shɛda na malɛ nde fanɛ, Ebɔrɛ sa anyi ŋkpa nɛ k maŋ kɔ ekar nɛ loŋ be ŋkpa na wɔ mo Pibinyɛn na to. 12Esa kama nɛ e kɔ Ebinyɛn na kɔ ŋkpa na, ama ekama nɛ e maŋ kɔ Ebɔrɛ Pibinyɛn na maŋ kɔ ŋkpa na.
Ŋkpa nɛ k maŋ kɔ ekar na be asheŋ
13Menyi bumo nɛ men yirda Ebɔrɛ Pibinyɛn be ketre na nɛ mee sibɛ asɔ ere a sa na nɛ men baa nyi fanɛ men kɔ ŋkpa nɛ k maŋ kɔ ekar na.
14Kusɔ nɛ k bee shin nɛ anyi maa shika to ashi Ebɔrɛ be anishito nde fanɛ, kusɔ kama nɛ an baŋ bɔla Ebɔrɛ be keparso ŋ kule mo, e beeŋ nu an be kekule. 15To, nɛ an baa nyi fanɛ kusɔ kama nɛ anyee kule mo e bee nu an be kekule, kumo ere an nyi fanɛ kusɔ kama nɛ anyee kule mo anyeeŋ nya kumo.
16Esa kama nɛ e wu mo niopibi ka bee wora kulubi nɛ k maŋ la luwu be kulubi, amodoŋwura e kule Ebɔrɛ nɛ e sa mo ŋkpa. Basa nɛ bumo be alubi maa yɛr bumo luwu to na nɛ n de na. Kulubi ko wɔtɔ a yɛr esa luwu to, mannɛ loŋ be kulubi na be kabɔrɛkule nɛ ŋ kaŋɛ fanɛ amodoŋwura na e kule. 17Kewora n jija kikɛ la kulubi nna, ama kulubi ko wɔtɔ ŋkaa maa yɛr esa luwu to.
18An baa nyi fanɛ Ebɔrɛ pibi kama maa shir a wɔ alubi to a wora amo, ŋkpal manɛ so, Ebɔrɛ Pibinyɛn e naa kuŋ mo nɛ alubipo na e sa maŋ tiŋ n doro mo.
19Anyi alɛ naa nyi fanɛ an ka la Ebɔrɛ peya, ama durnya ere bre kikɛ wɔ alubipo na be enɔ to nna.
20Anyi alɛ nseŋ naa nyi Ebɔrɛ Pibinyɛn na ka ba m ba sa anyi nfɛra nɛ an pin kashenteŋ be Ebɔrɛ na, anyi alɛ wɔ mo kashenteŋ be Ebɔrɛ na to nna, hale mo Pibinyɛn Yesu Kristo na to. Mo e la kashenteŋ be Ebɔrɛ na, nɛ ŋkpa nɛ k maŋ kɔ ekar na.
21Ma mbi shasoana, men baa gelge agbir.

english_text:
1From the church leader.
To a very special woman and her children. I truly love all of you, and so does everyone else who knows the truth. 2We love you because the truth is now in our hearts, and it will be there forever.
3I pray that God the Father and Jesus Christ his Son will be kind and merciful to us! May they give us peace and truth and love.
Truth and Love
4I was very glad to learn that some of your children are obeying the truth, as the Father told us to do. 5 Dear friend, I am not writing to tell you and your children to do something you have not done before. I am writing to tell you to love each other, which is the first thing you were told to do. 6Love means we do what God tells us. And from the beginning, he told you to love him.
7Many liars have gone out into the world. These deceitful liars are saying Jesus Christ did not have a truly human body. But they are liars and the enemies of Christ. 8So be sure not to lose what we have worked for. If you do, you won't be given your full reward. 9Don't keep changing what you were taught about Christ, or else God will no longer be with you. But if you hold firmly to what you were taught, both the Father and the Son will be with you. 10 If people won't agree to this teaching, don't welcome them into your home or even greet them. 11Greeting them is the same as taking part in their evil deeds.
Final Greetings
12I have much more to tell you, but I don't want to write it with pen and ink. I want to come and talk to you in person, because this will make us really happy.
13Greetings from the children of your very special sister.
translation_text:
1Kawɔl ere shi ma nɛ baa tre Enimu na kutɔ nna a yɔ kowurche nɛ Ebɔrɛ lara na nɛ mbe mbia kutɔ. Amo be kache na be asheŋ nɛ mee sha kashenteŋto na. Mannɛ n nawule malɛ gba e naa sha mbe asheŋ, bekama nɛ b nyi kashenteŋ be keŋini na gba bee sha mbe asheŋ, 2ŋkpal kashenteŋ be keŋini na ka wɔ anyi to, kumo alɛ ŋkaa beeŋ shir a wɔ anyi to mbaanaayɔ na so. 3Ebɔrɛ Etuto na nɛ Yesu Kristo nɛ e la Etuto na Pibinyɛn na sa anyi kuwɔr be kakɛ nɛ kuwɔr nɛ kagbenewushi n shin nɛ an nya kashenteŋ be kasha.
Kashenteŋ nɛ kasha be asheŋ
4Kowurche, ŋ ka pin fanɛ fo mbia ko wɔ kashenteŋ be kebaawɔtɔ na to fanɛ kananɛ Ebɔrɛ Etuto na nase na, ma kagbene fuli ma paa. 5Naniere malɛ mee kule fo nna fanɛ fo shin nɛ an kikɛ e baa sha abar be asheŋ, kumo alɛ maŋ la kamalga naseso popɔr ko nna nɛ mee sibɛ a sa fo, kumo nɛ an nya sososo na kikɛ na nna. 6Keŋini kasha e la kebaabɛ Ebɔrɛ be mmalga naseso so. Menyi alɛ kikɛ chɛr n nu dra dra na kikɛ fanɛ kusɔ nɛ Ebɔrɛ na nase e la fanɛ a daga fanɛ men kikɛ e baa wɔ kasha be kebaawɔtɔ to.
7Befɛpo damta mo nɛ b maa yirda fanɛ Yesu Kristo ba durnya ere to nna fanɛ dimɛdi, lar n luri durnya to. Loŋ be basa na be ekama e la efɛpo nɛ Kristo mo doŋ na. 8Amoso, men baa de so n sa maŋ paŋ kusɔ nɛ men kpal kumo so n shuŋ na, ama men wora ania n nya men be tɔnɔ kikɛ nyam.
9Esa kama nɛ e maa shir a wɔ Kristo be keŋini na to nsaa ta asheŋ a ti amo so, maŋ kɔ Ebɔrɛ mo to. Ama ekama nɛ e shir a wɔ Kristo be keŋini na to, kɔ Etuto na nɛ Ebinyɛn na kikɛ mo to. 10Esa kama nɛ e ba men kutɔ nsaa maŋ bar le be keŋini ere, men sa maŋ chɔrɔ mo ŋko n sɔ mo n wɔtɔ men peana, 11ŋkpal manɛ so, ekama nɛ e chɔrɔ mo bee chɛ mo to a wora mbe ashuŋ lubi na nna na.
Lalaloge be kechɔrɔ be mmalga be asheŋ
12Ŋ kraa kɔ asɔ damta nɛ ŋ kaŋɛ menyi, ama m maa sha kesibɛ amo kawɔl to. Kusɔ nɛ mee tama e la fanɛ meeŋ ba bɔɔ menyi so nɛ ma nɛ menyi e chena m malga, saŋɛ na so an kikɛ be ŋgbene beeŋ fuli anyi parr.
13Fo sipo cheso nɛ Ebɔrɛ lara na gba be mbia bee chɔrɔ fo.

english_text:
1 From the church leader.
To my dear friend Gaius.
I love you because we follow the truth, 2dear friend, and I pray all goes well for you. I hope you are as strong in body, as I know you are in spirit. 3It makes me very happy when the Lord's followers come by and speak openly of how you obey the truth. 4Nothing brings me greater happiness than to hear that my children are obeying the truth.
Working Together
5Dear friend, you have always been faithful in helping other followers of the Lord, even the ones you didn't know before. 6They have told the church about your love. They say you were good enough to welcome them and to send them on their mission in a way God's servants deserve. 7When they left to tell others about the Lord, they decided not to accept help from anyone who wasn't a follower. 8We must support people like them, so we can take part in what they are doing to spread the truth.
9I wrote to the church. But Diotrephes likes to be the number-one leader, and he won't pay any attention to us. 10So if I come, I will remind him of how he has been attacking us with gossip. Not only has he been doing this, but he refuses to welcome any of the Lord's followers who come by. And when other church members want to welcome them, he puts them out of the church.
11Dear friend, don't imitate the evil deeds of others, but follow the example of people who do kind deeds. They are God's children, but those who are always doing evil have never seen God.
12Everyone speaks well of Demetrius, and so does the true message that he teaches. I also speak well of him, and you know what I say is true.
Final Greetings
13I have much more to say to you, but I don't want to write it with pen and ink. 14I hope to see you soon, and then we can talk in person.
15I pray that God will bless you with peace!
Your friends send their greetings. Please give a personal greeting to each of our friends.

2N teri shaso, ma kabɔrɛkule nɛ ŋ kɔ a kule a sa fo e la fanɛ Ebɔrɛ e shin nɛ kusɔ kama e baŋ nyalɛ n sa fo nɛ fo baa kɔ eyur be alenfia fanɛ kananɛ fo kɔ eleŋ fo kiyoyu to na. 3Bekurgepo ko ka ba kaŋɛ ma kananɛ fo kɔ kagbene koŋwule a bɛ kashenteŋ be keŋini na so nɛ kananɛ fo baa wɔ kashenteŋ na be kebaawɔtɔ to, ma kagbene fuli ma ga. 4Shɛŋ shɛŋ maa fuli ma kagbene a chɔ kebaanu fanɛ ma mbia wɔ kashenteŋ na be kebaawɔtɔ na to.
Gayes ka nya kechɔrɔ be asheŋ
5N teri shaso, kananɛ fo ta kagbene koŋwule a wora ashuŋ a sa bekurgepoana na ŋkeshin nɛ b la befɔ gba nna na, esa beeŋ tiŋ n fute n yige fo so. 6B ba ji fo kasha be asheŋ asɔri ere to nfe. 9N sibɛ kusɔ ko n shoŋi asɔriebi na, ama Dayɔtrefis nɛ e baa sha kejuŋkpar ga ashi bumo to na maa sha kenu n sa anyi. 10Amoso, ŋ kaŋ ba, meeŋ lara asheŋ nɛ e bee wora na kikɛ efuli. english_text:
1 From Jude, a servant of Jesus Christ and the brother of James.
To all who are chosen and loved by God the Father and are kept safe by Jesus Christ.
2I pray that God will greatly bless you with mercy, peace, and love!
False Teachers
3My dear friends, I really wanted to write you about God's saving power at work in our lives. But instead, I must write and ask you to defend the faith that God has once for all given to his people. 4Some godless people have sneaked in among us and are saying, “God treats us much better than we deserve, and so it is all right to be immoral.” They even deny we must obey Jesus Christ as our only Master and Lord. But long ago the Scriptures warned that these godless people were doomed.
5 Don't forget what happened to those people the Lord rescued from Egypt. Some of them did not have faith, and he later destroyed them. 6You also know about the angels who didn't do their work and left their proper places. God chained them with everlasting chains and is now keeping them in dark pits until the great day of judgment. 7 We should also be warned by what happened to the cities of Sodom and Gomorrah and the nearby towns. Their people became immoral and committed all sorts of sexual sins. Then God made an example of them and punished them with eternal fire.
8The people I am talking about are behaving just like those dreamers who destroyed their own bodies. They reject all authority and insult angels. 9 Even Michael, the chief angel, didn't dare to insult the devil, when the two of them were arguing about the body of Moses. All Michael said was, “The Lord will punish you!”
10But these people insult powers they don't know anything about. They are like senseless animals that end up getting destroyed, because they live only by their feelings. 11 Now they are in for real trouble. They have followed Cain's example and have made the same mistake that Balaam did by caring only for money. They have also rebelled against God, just as Korah did. Because of all this, they will be destroyed.
12These people are filthy minded, and by their shameful and selfish actions they spoil the meals you eat together. They are like clouds blown along by the wind, but never bringing any rain. They are like leafless trees, uprooted and dead, and unable to produce fruit. 13Their shameful deeds show up like foam on wild ocean waves. They are like wandering stars forever doomed to the darkest pits of hell.
14 Enoch was the seventh person after Adam, and he was talking about these people when he said:
Look! The Lord is coming with thousands and thousands of holy angels 15to judge everyone. He will punish all those ungodly people for all the evil things they have done. The Lord will surely punish those ungodly sinners for every evil thing they have ever said about him.
16These people grumble and complain and live by their own selfish desires. They brag about themselves and flatter others to get what they want.
More Warnings
17My dear friends, remember the warning you were given by the apostles of our Lord Jesus Christ. 18 They told you that near the end of time, selfish and godless people would start making fun of God. 19And now these people are already making you turn against each other. They think only about this life, and they don't have God's Spirit.
20Dear friends, keep building on the foundation of your most holy faith, as the Holy Spirit helps you to pray. 21And keep in step with God's love, as you wait for our Lord Jesus Christ to show how kind he is by giving you eternal life. 22Be helpful to all who may have doubts. 23Rescue any who need to be saved, as you would rescue someone from a fire. Then with fear in your own hearts, have mercy on everyone who needs it. But hate even the clothes of those who have been made dirty by their filthy deeds.
Final Prayer
24-25Offer praise to God our Savior because of our Lord Jesus Christ! Only God can keep you from falling and make you pure and joyful in his glorious presence. Before time began and now and forever, God is worthy of glory, honor, power, and authority. Amen.
translation_text:
1Kawɔl ere shi ma Juud, Jeems mo sipo nɛ n la Yesu Kristo be kenya na kutɔ nna a yɔ bumo nɛ Ebɔrɛ Etuto na bee sha nseŋ tre bumo m ba kaa keni bumo so ŋkpal Yesu Kristo so na kutɔ. 2Ebɔrɛ e wu menyi kuwɔr nseŋ sa menyi kagbenewushi nɛ kasha nɛ a baa wɔ menyi to a ti so saŋkikɛ.
Beŋinipo fɛpoana be asheŋ
3Ma beshapo, k daa wɔ ma kagbene to nna ga fanɛ n sibɛ ŋ kaŋɛ menyi kumɔlga mo nɛ an kikɛ kɔ na be asheŋ, ama n naŋ wu fanɛ a daga fanɛ n sibɛ menyi ŋ kule menyi ga fanɛ men baa wora ania a kɔ a sa abɔrɛsheŋ mo nɛ an yirda nɛ Ebɔrɛ ta kela koŋwule pati m bɔɔ mbe basa laraso enɔ na. 4Mee kaŋɛ le nna, ŋkpal manɛ so, basa ko mo nɛ b maa nu a sa Ebɔrɛ ŋana n nyia n luri menyi to a sha kechɛrga Ebɔrɛ be kuwɔr be kakɛ nɛ e kɔ a sa anyi na be kifito, saŋɛ na so baaŋ nya ekpa a wora kulubi kama nɛ baa sha. Baa kini Yesu Kristo gbagba mo nɛ mo nawule la an Nyɛnpe mo nɛ e bee ji anyi so kuwura na. Dra na malɛ kikɛ nɛ b sibɛ abɔrɛsibɛ na to a kaŋɛ fanɛ Ebɔrɛ beeŋ gberge loŋ be basa na kikɛ kusoe.
5N nyi men ka tea nyi asheŋ nɛ mee sha kekaŋɛ menyi ere kikɛ, ama mee sha kenyiŋi menyi kananɛ Enyɛnpe daŋ mɔlga mbe basa Israɛlebi ashi Ijipt be kasawule so nna.
