E daŋ kaŋɛ bumo nɛ b wɔ durnya ere to kikɛ fanɛ b pɔr kaduli nɛ k baa la bunyaŋ a sa kusɔbɔya mo nɛ b daŋ ta tokobi n doro ama nɛ e kraa wɔtɔ na. 15B daŋ sa kusɔbɔya nyɔsopo na eleŋ nna fanɛ e fute ŋkpa n wɔtɔ kusɔbɔya juŋkparso na be kaduli to, saŋɛ na so, e beeŋ malga nseŋ shin nɛ b mɔ bekama nɛ b kini kemaŋ mo so na. 16Kusɔbɔya na daŋ tintiŋ ekama nna, bewurbi nɛ begboŋi kikɛ, damawuraana nɛ betirpo, anya nɛ bumo nɛ b wɔ bumo be amu fanɛ ekama e nya ndulgi mbe enɔjiso so ŋko mbe kɔsɔto so. 17Saŋɛ na so, esa kikɛ maaŋ tiŋ n tɔ shɛŋ ŋko n fa kusɔ ko ama amodoŋwura baa kɔ ndulgi mo nɛ k la kusɔbɔya na be ketre na nna ŋko mbe ketre be lamba nna.
18Kede bre la kanyiasheŋ be asheŋ nna. Ekama malɛ nɛ e kɔ nfɛra e pin kusɔbɔya na be lamba na to, ŋkpal manɛ so, k la dimɛdi be lamba nna. Lamba na e la alfa ashe nɛ adeshe nɛ ashe.

english_text:
The Lamb and His 144,000 Followers
1 I looked and saw the Lamb standing on Mount Zion! With him were 144,000, who had his name and his Father's name written on their foreheads. 2 Then I heard a sound from heaven that was like a roaring flood or loud thunder or even like the music of harps. 3And a new song was being sung in front of God's throne and in front of the four living creatures and the elders. No one could learn that song, except the 144,000 who had been rescued from the earth. 4All of these are pure virgins, and they follow the Lamb wherever he leads. They have been rescued to be presented to God and the Lamb as the most precious people on earth. 5 They never tell lies, and they are innocent.
The Messages of the Three Angels
6I saw another angel. This one was flying across the sky and had the eternal good news to announce to the people of every race, tribe, language, and nation on earth. 7The angel shouted, “Worship and honor God! The time has come for him to judge everyone. Kneel down before the one who created heaven and earth, the oceans, and every stream.”
8 A second angel followed and said, “The great city of Babylon has fallen! This is the city that made all nations drunk and immoral. Now God is angry, and Babylon has fallen.”
9Finally, a third angel came and shouted:
Here is what will happen if you worship the beast and the idol and have the mark of the beast on your hand or forehead. 10 You will have to drink the wine that God gives to everyone who makes him angry. You will feel his mighty anger, and you will be tortured with fire and burning sulfur, while the holy angels and the Lamb look on.
11 If you worship the beast and the idol and accept the mark of its name, you will be tortured day and night. The smoke from your torture will go up forever and ever, and you will never be able to rest.
12God's people must learn to endure. They must also obey his commands and have faith in Jesus.
13Then I heard a voice from heaven say, “Put this in writing. From now on, the Lord will bless everyone who has faith in him when they die.”
The Spirit answered, “Yes, they will rest from their hard work, and they will be rewarded for what they have done.”
The Earth Is Harvested
14 I looked and saw a bright cloud, and someone who seemed to be the Son of Man was sitting on the cloud. He wore a gold crown on his head and held a sharp sickle in his hand. 15 An angel came out of the temple and shouted, “Start cutting with your sickle! Harvest season is here, and all crops on earth are ripe.” 16The one on the cloud swung his sickle and harvested the crops.
17Another angel with a sharp sickle then came out of the temple in heaven. 18After this, an angel with power over fire came from the altar and shouted to the angel who had the sickle. He said, “All grapes on earth are ripe! Harvest them with your sharp sickle.” 19The angel swung his sickle on earth and cut off its grapes. He threw them into a pit where they were trampled on as a sign of God's anger. 20 The pit was outside the city, and when the grapes were mashed, blood flowed out. The blood turned into a river that was about 300 kilometers long and almost deep enough to cover a horse.
translation_text:
Bumo nɛ b sɔ n yige na be kashɛ be asheŋ
1Nɛ n naŋ keni n wu Kpakpafɔlbi na ka yil Zayɔn be kebee so. Mo nɛ basa ŋgboŋ kalfa nɛ ŋgboŋ adena nɛ ŋgboŋ ana nɛ b daŋ sibɛ mbe ketre nɛ mo Tuto na be ketre n deŋi bumo be nsɔto so na e daa yil. 2Ndoŋ nna nɛ n nu ebɔl ko ka shi ebɔrɛso ŋ gbri m ba fanɛ nchu damta ka bee shile nseŋ daŋ naa du fanɛ bɔrɛ ka bee gbri eleŋso na. Ebɔl mo nɛ n daŋ nu na daŋ naa du fanɛ ejaŋjilaŋlampoana ka bee laŋ bumo be ejaŋjilaŋ nna. 3Nɛ b boŋ kashɛ popɔr ashi kuwurputi na be anishito nɛ asɔbɔya keniso ana nɛ bejuŋkparpo na be anishito. Esa kikɛ daa maaŋ tiŋ ŋ koya kashɛ na she basa ŋgboŋ kalfa nɛ ŋgboŋ adena nɛ ŋgboŋ ana mo nɛ b sɔ n yige kasawule so na. 4Bumo e la basa nɛ b maŋ di beche n jija bumo be amu na, b daa maŋ nyi beche. Kaplɛkama nɛ Kpakpafɔlbi na bee yɔ, b bɛ mo so nna. B daŋ sɔ bumo ashi edimɛdi to nna n yige n shin nɛ b du fanɛ asɔrso juŋkparso mo nɛ baaŋ ta n lara sarga n sa Ebɔrɛ nɛ Kpakpafɔlbi na. 5Efɛsheŋ kama daa maŋ shi bumo be nnɔ to n lar kikɛ, kulubisheŋ kama daa maŋ do bumo be ekama so.
Emalaika asa na be asheŋ
6Ndoŋ nna nɛ n naŋ wu malaika ko ka wɔ esoso kumu so a firgi nsaa kɔ baru lela nɛ k wɔtɔ mbaanaayɔ na to nɛ e bɔ kumo n sa basa nɛ b wɔ kasawule ere so n sa efuli kama so ebi nɛ yiri kama to ebi nɛ ŋgbar kama to ebi nɛ basa kama to ebi. 7Kumo be kaman nɛ e kaŋɛ awɔrso fanɛ: “Men baa ŋana Ebɔrɛ nsaa maŋkura mo, ŋkpal manɛ so, mbe demuji be saŋɛ na fo naniere. Men baa maŋ emo nɛ e to ebɔrɛso nɛ kasawule nɛ teku nɛ mbombiana kikɛ na so.”
8Kede be kaman nɛ n naŋ wu malaika nyɔsopo ka ta m bɛ ejuŋkparso na so a kaŋɛ le: “E tɔr, Babilɔn be kade lempo na tɔr. E shin nɛ efuli kikɛ so ebi nuu mbe kesakalealubisheŋ be nsa na.”
9Ndoŋ nna nɛ malaika sasopo ta m bɛ bumo so a kaŋɛ awɔrso le: “Ekama nɛ e bee maŋ kusɔbɔya na nɛ mbe kaduli na so nseŋ nya mbe ndulgi mbe kɔsɔto so ŋko mbe enɔ so, 10amodoŋwura beeŋ nuu Ebɔrɛ be agboso be nsa nɛ b maŋ ta shɛŋ n cha amo to na nseŋ duga amo n wɔtɔ Ebɔrɛ be agbo be kawiebi to na gba. Baaŋ ta edɛ nɛ jɛrbi n wɔtɔ mo ebesa to, emalaika cheembiana na nɛ Kpakpafɔlbi na be anishito. 11Edɛ mo nɛ a bee sa bumo ebesa na be edishi baa wɔtɔ nna mbaanaayɔ. Kapa nɛ kanyɛ bumo nɛ baa maŋ kusɔbɔya na nɛ mbe kaduli na so ŋko ekama nɛ e nya mbe ketre be lamba na daa maa kɔ ewushi kikɛ.”
12Kede e naa ŋini fanɛ a daga fanɛ Ebɔrɛ be basa, bumo e la basa nɛ baa ta Ebɔrɛ be mmalga naseso a wɔtɔ bumo be ŋgbene to nsaa maa lar Yesu kaman na e baa kɔ kanyiti.
13Ndoŋ nna nɛ n nu ebɔl ka shi ebɔrɛso ŋ kaŋɛ ma le: “Sibɛ le n nase: Kagbenefuli la bekama nɛ b wɔ Enyɛnpe to nseŋ wu naniere mbaanaayɔ na peya nna.” Nɛ Kiyoyu Cheeŋ na kaŋɛ: “Kashenteŋto, baaŋ wushi ashi bumo be kegben ere to, ŋkpal manɛ so, bumo be aworbi beeŋ ba bɛ bumo so n yɔ.”
Kasawule be kasɔteŋi na be asheŋ
14Ŋ ka naŋ keni nɛ n wu kuwɔlpa fuful ko nɛ esa ko malɛ du fanɛ nyiŋgbasa pibinyɛn na ka tase ndoŋ a kɔ shuwa be kuwurwuro mbe kumu so nɛ loji jiso ko malɛ wɔ mbe enɔ to. 15Ndoŋ nna nɛ malaika ko malɛ lar ebɔrɛso be bɔrɛlambu na to n tre esa nɛ e daa tase kuwɔlpa na so na awɔrso ŋ kaŋɛ mo le: “Ta fo loji n teŋi asɔ, ŋkpal manɛ so, kasɔteŋi be jemanɛ fo, ŋkpal manɛ so, kasawule be asɔ nɛ baaŋ teŋi na be jemanɛ na fo.” 16Ndoŋ nna nɛ emo nɛ e daa tase kuwɔlpa na so na fili mbe loji na to ŋ gbaari kasawule so nɛ kasawule so be asɔ kikɛ teŋi.
17Nɛ malaika ko malɛ ba shi ebɔrɛso be bɔrɛlambu na to n lar, mo alɛ gba a kɔ loji jiso to. 18Bede malɛ kikɛ be kaman nɛ malaika ko malɛ nɛ e daa kɔ edɛ be eleŋ shi bɔrɛsure na akpa m ba tre emo nɛ e daa kɔ loji jiso na to na awɔrso ŋ kaŋɛ mo le: “Ta fo loji jiso na ŋ ku kasawule so be waindibi be asɔrso na, ŋkpal manɛ so, asɔrso na bel.” 19Ndoŋ nna nɛ malaika na fili mbe loji na to m ba kasawule so n chala kumo be waindibi be asɔrso na nseŋ ta amo ŋ kpa n wɔtɔ Ebɔrɛ be agbo be kusɔ nyaŋasɔrso na to. 20Nɛ b nyaŋ asɔrso na ashi kusɔ nyaŋasɔrso na to ashi kadegboŋ na be ekarso nɛ ŋklaŋ lar asɔ na to ashi amo be kemaŋ na to n teŋi to n dese n fo emayɛl alfa anyɔ nɛ amo be jeŋgreŋ malɛ daŋ fo fanɛ kekargato be ayadra anu.

english_text:
The Last of the Terrible Troubles
1After this, I looked at the sky and saw something else that was strange and important. Seven angels were bringing the seven last terrible troubles. When these are ended, God will no longer be angry.
2Then I saw something that looked like a glass sea mixed with fire, and people were standing on it. They were the ones who had defeated the beast and the idol and the number that tells the name of the beast. God had given them harps, 3 and they were singing the song his servant Moses and the Lamb had sung. They were singing,
“Lord God All-Powerful,
you have done great
and marvelous things.
You are the ruler
of all nations,
and you do what is
right and fair.
4 Lord, who doesn't honor
and praise your name?
You alone are holy,
and all nations will come
and worship you,
because you have shown
that you judge
with fairness.”
5 After this, I noticed something else in heaven. The sacred tent used for a temple was open. 6And the seven angels who were bringing the terrible troubles were coming out of it. They were dressed in robes of pure white linen and wore belts made of pure gold. 7One of the four living creatures gave each of the seven angels a bowl made of gold. These bowls were filled with the anger of God who lives forever and ever. 8 The temple quickly filled with smoke from the glory and power of God. No one could enter it until the seven angels had finished pouring out the seven last troubles.
translation_text:
Emalaika ashunu nɛ etɔrɔ ashunu na be asheŋ
1Ndoŋ nna nɛ n naŋ wu alemaŋkar be kesheŋ ko awɔlpa so. K daa la mamachi be kesheŋ gboŋ ko nna. Emalaika ashunu nɛ etɔrɔ ashunu mo nɛ a daa la lalaloge be etɔrɔ na e daa la, ŋkpal manɛ so, amo be kaman nɛ Ebɔrɛ be agbo bee wushi.
2Ndoŋ nna nɛ n wu kusɔ ko ka du fanɛ digi nɛ edɛ be weato a dese fanɛ teku nɛ basa nɛ b daŋ kɔ kusɔbɔya na nɛ mbe kaduli na nɛ mbe ketre be lamba na m pɔɔ so na yil m mata teku na. B daa yil nna a kɔ ejaŋjilaŋ ko nɛ Ebɔrɛ daŋ ta n sa bumo na to. 3B daa yil nna a kɔ amo a boŋ anebi Mosis, Ebɔrɛ be kenya na be kashɛ nɛ Kpakpafɔlbi na be kashɛ a kaŋɛ:
“Enyɛnpetale Ebɔrɛ,
Enyɛnpe fo asheŋ woraso kɔ mamachi pasaa!
Fo nɛ fo la efuli kama be Ewura na,
fo ekpa niŋi nsaa kɔ kashenteŋ amo to pasaa!
4O, Enyɛnpe, wanɛ e wɔtɔ ŋkaa maaŋ ŋana fo
nsaa maaŋ sa fo ketre na kemaŋkura?
Ŋkpal manɛ so,
fo nawule e du cheembi.
Efuli kama so ebi malɛ kikɛ beeŋ ba kachako
m ba maŋ fo so,
ŋkpal manɛ so, fo demuji niŋisoana na lar efuli.”
5Kede be kaman nɛ ŋ keni n wu shɛda be wajɛbu na be bɔrɛlambu ka bugi a yil ebɔrɛso. 6Ndoŋ nna nɛ emalaika ashunu ko nɛ etɔrɔ ashunu ko shi bɔrɛlambu na to n lar. B daŋ buu m buu asɔbuuso lela nna nɛ a walɛ so n fuli le parrbi nseŋ ta shuwa be kreso peŋgeleŋ peŋgelembi ko ŋ kre bumo be ntetoana so. 7Ndoŋ nna nɛ asɔbɔya keniso ana na be eko ta shuwa be ntishaŋ ashunu mo nɛ Ebɔrɛ mo nɛ e wɔ ŋkpa to mbaanaayɔ na be agbo daŋ bɔlɔ m bɔlɔ amo na n sa emalaika ashunu na. 8Ade be kaman nɛ edishi shi Ebɔrɛ be kemaŋkura to nɛ mbe eleŋ to n sɔ bɔrɛlambu na kikɛ to nɛ esa kikɛ malɛ daa maŋ tiŋ n luri bɔrɛlambu na to hale nɛ emalaika ashunu na be etɔrɔ ashunu na ya loge.

english_text:
The Bowls of God's Anger
1From the temple I heard a voice shout to the seven angels, “Go and empty the seven bowls of God's anger on the earth.”
2 The first angel emptied his bowl on the earth. At once ugly and painful sores broke out on everyone who had the mark of the beast and worshiped the idol.
3The second angel emptied his bowl on the sea. At once the sea turned into blood like that of a dead person, and every living thing in the sea died.
4 The third angel emptied his bowl into the rivers and streams. At once they turned to blood. 5Then I heard the angel, who has power over water, say,
“You have always been,
and you always will be
the holy God.
You had the right
to judge in this way.
6They poured out the blood
of your people
and your prophets.
So you gave them blood
to drink as they deserve!”
7After this, I heard
the altar shout,
“Yes, Lord God All-Powerful,
your judgments are honest
and fair.”
8The fourth angel emptied his bowl on the sun, and it began to scorch people like fire. 9Everyone was scorched by its great heat, and all of them cursed the name of God who had power over these terrible troubles. But no one turned to God and praised him.
10 The fifth angel emptied his bowl on the throne of the beast. At once darkness covered its kingdom, and its people began biting their tongues in pain. 11And because of their painful sores, they cursed the God who rules in heaven. But still they did not stop doing evil things.
12 The sixth angel emptied his bowl on the great Euphrates River, and it completely dried up to make a road for the kings from the east. 13An evil spirit that looked like a frog came out of the mouth of the dragon. One also came out of the mouth of the beast, and another out of the mouth of the false prophet. 14These evil spirits had the power to work miracles. They went to every king on earth, to bring them together for a war against God All-Powerful. But that will be the day of God's great victory.
15 Remember Christ says, “When I come, it will surprise you like a thief! But God will bless you, if you are awake and ready. Then you won't have to walk around naked and be ashamed.”
16 Those armies came together in a place that in Hebrew is called Armagedon.
17As soon as the seventh angel emptied his bowl in the air, a loud voice from the throne in the temple shouted, “It's done!” 18 There were flashes of lightning, roars of thunder, and the worst earthquake in all history. 19 The great city of Babylon split into three parts, and the cities of other nations fell. So God made Babylon drink from the wine cup filled with his anger. 20 Every island ran away, and the mountains disappeared. 21 Hailstones, weighing about 50 kilograms each, fell from the sky on people. Finally, the people cursed God, because the hail was so terrible.
translation_text:
Ebɔrɛ be agbo be ntishaŋ ashunu be asheŋ
1Ndoŋ nna nɛ n nu ebɔl ko ka shi ebɔrɛso be bɔrɛlambu na to m ba malga awɔrso a kaŋɛ a kaŋɛ emalaika ashunu na le: “Men ya chulgi Ebɔrɛ be agbo nɛ k bɔlɔ ntishaŋ ashunu na to n wurge kasawule so.”
2Nɛ malaika juŋkparso na ta mbe katishaŋ nɛ agbo na n chulgi n wurge kasawule so nɛ achuu lubi besaso ko ba basa nɛ b kɔ kusɔbɔya na be ndulgi nɛ bumo nɛ b maŋ kumo be kaduli so na so.
3Ndoŋ nna nɛ malaika nyɔsopo na ta mbe katishaŋ nɛ agbo na n chulgi n wurge teku so nɛ nchu na ki fanɛ dimɛdi mo nɛ e wu be ŋklaŋ nɛ kusɔ keniso kama nɛ k daa wɔ teku na to na wu.
4Malaika nyɔsopo na be kaman nɛ esasopo na malɛ ta mbe katishaŋ nɛ agbo na n chulgi n wurge elɔrana nɛ mbombiana so nɛ a kilgi ŋklaŋ. 5Ndoŋ nna nɛ n nu malaika mo nɛ e daa kɔ nchuana na be eleŋ na ka kaŋɛ le:
“Fo nɛ fo daa wɔtɔ nseŋ kraa wɔtɔ na,
wora asheŋ m bɔla ekpa ashi le be demuji ere to.
6Ŋkpal b ka mɔ fo basa laraso nɛ anebiana n lara bumo be ŋklaŋ so,
fo alɛ gba ta ŋklaŋ n sa bumo nɛ b nuu.
Kusɔ nɛ k baŋ daga bumo nna na.”
7Nɛ n nu ebɔl ka shi bɔrɛsure na akpa ŋ kaŋɛ:
“Enyɛnpetale Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ,
fo demuji kɔ kashenteŋ nseŋ niŋi pasaa.”
8Ndoŋ nna nɛ malaika nasopo na ta mbe katishaŋ nɛ agbo na n chulgi n wurge epeŋi so nɛ k nya eleŋ n chɔɔ basa fanɛ edɛ. 9Edɛ damta na daŋ chɔɔ basa ga nɛ b malga ŋ gbiti Ebɔrɛ mo nɛ e kɔ etɔrɔ na be eleŋ na be ketre nseŋ kini kelar bumo be alubi to m maŋkura mo.
10Malaika nasopo na be kaman nɛ enusopo na malɛ ta mbe katishaŋ nɛ agbo na n chulgi n wurge kusɔbɔya na be kuwurputi so, nɛ mbe kakpa nɛ e bee ji kuwura kikɛ ki tentembiri gbrum nɛ basa duŋ bumo be adonduloŋ ebesa so ga 11nseŋ malga ŋ gbiti Ebɔrɛ nɛ e wɔ ebɔrɛso na. B daŋ wora loŋ nna ŋkpal bumo be ebesa na nɛ bumo be achuuana na so so, ama b daŋ kini kelar bumo be alubi mo nɛ b daŋ wora na bre to.
12Nɛ malaika shesopo na malɛ ta mbe katishaŋ nɛ agbo na n chulgi n wurge lɔrgboŋ nɛ baa tre Yufreetes na so nɛ kumo be nchu kikɛ feeto nɛ k wɔl n lɔŋɛ ekpa a dese a jo bewura mo nɛ b shi bɔrɛfito na.
13Ndoŋ nna nɛ n wu ayoyu lubi asa ko ka du fanɛ etaŋgbaga n shi kusɔ gbeyeso na nɛ kusɔbɔya juŋkparso na nɛ anebi fɛpo na be nnɔ to n lar. 14A la mbuibi lubiana be ayoyu nna a wora emamachisheŋ a yɔ durnya ere kikɛ be bewura kutɔ n ya kaa chala bumo a jo Enyɛnpetale Ebɔrɛ be kachɛgboŋ be kena na.
15“Men nu nfe, meeŋ ba menyi to fanɛ eyu. Kagbenefuli baa la ekama nɛ e maa di, mo alɛ nsaa kɔ mbe asɔbuuso to na peya nna, saŋɛ na so, e maaŋ delge so n nite nɛ anishinyɔr e pɛ mo.” 16Ndoŋ nna nɛ ayoyu na bar bewura abar so ashi kakpa nɛ Hibruwebi bee tre Aamagɛdɔn na.
17Nɛ malaika shunusopo na ta mbe katishaŋ nɛ agbo na n chulgi n wurge esoso nɛ ebɔl ko shi bɔrɛlambu na to awɔrso ŋ kaŋɛ: “Asheŋ na wora.” 18Ndoŋ nna nɛ bɔrɛ nyɛkpɛ pelpel nseŋ gbri m ponte to n wɔtɔ nɛ kebembeŋgboŋ ko beeŋ kasawule so ga. Dimɛdi ka fara a wɔ kasawule so kikɛ kebembeŋ kama maŋ naŋ lubi fanɛ kumo. Kede e daŋ lubi ga a chɔ kebembeŋ kama. 19Nɛ kadegboŋ na barga to ntuŋ nsa so nɛ durnya to be ndegboŋ kama mur. Nɛ Ebɔrɛ nyiŋi Babilɔn lempo nseŋ ta katishaŋ mo nɛ k bɔlɔ mbe agbo damta be nsa na n sa fanɛ e nuu. 20Esa daa maŋ naa wu kebeegboŋ kama, nɛ kepla kama malɛ daŋ foe. 21Nɛ abɔrɛjembubi gboŋgboŋiana ko nɛ amo be egbɛ daa la egbɛ to be pɔŋ kalfa na shi awɔlpa so m ba tɔr basa so. Nɛ basa malga ŋ gbiti Ebɔrɛ ŋkpal abɔrɛjembubi na be tɔrɔ na so, ŋkpal manɛ so, tɔrɔ lubi gbagba e daa la.

english_text:
The Prostitute and the Beast
1 One of the seven angels who had emptied the bowls came over and said to me, “Come on! I will show you how God will punish that shameless prostitute who sits on many oceans. 2 Every king on earth has slept with her, and her shameless ways are like wine that has made everyone on earth drunk.”
3 With the help of the Spirit, the angel took me into a desert, where I saw a woman sitting on a red beast. The beast was covered with names that were an insult to God, and it had seven heads and ten horns. 4 The woman was dressed in purple and scarlet robes, and she wore jewelry made of gold, precious stones, and pearls. In her hand she held a gold cup filled with the filthy and nasty things she had done. 5On her forehead a mysterious name was written:
I AM THE GREAT CITY OF BABYLON, THE MOTHER OF EVERY IMMORAL AND FILTHY THING ON EARTH.
6I could tell that the woman was drunk on the blood of God's people who had given their lives for Jesus. This surprising sight amazed me, 7and the angel said:
Why are you so amazed? I will explain the mystery about this woman and about the beast she is sitting on, with its seven heads and ten horns. 8 The beast you saw is one that used to be and no longer is. It will come back from the deep pit, but only to be destroyed. Everyone on earth whose names were not written in the book of life before the time of creation will be amazed. They will see this beast that used to be and no longer is, but will be once more.
9Anyone with wisdom can figure this out. The seven heads that the woman is sitting on stand for seven hills. These heads are also seven kings. 10Five of the kings are dead. One is ruling now, and the other one has not yet come. But when he does, he will rule for only a little while.
11You also saw a beast that used to be and no longer is. That beast is one of the seven kings who will return as the eighth king, but only to be destroyed.
12 The ten horns you saw are ten more kings, who have not yet come into power, and they will rule with the beast for only a short time. 13They all think alike and will give their power and authority to the beast. 14 These kings will go to war against the Lamb. But he will defeat them, because he is Lord over all lords and King over all kings. His followers are chosen and special and faithful.
15The oceans you saw the prostitute sitting on are crowds of people from all races and languages. 16The ten horns and the beast will start hating the shameless woman. They will strip off her clothes and leave her naked. Then they will eat her flesh and throw the rest of her body into a fire. 17God is the one who made these kings all think alike and decide to give their power to the beast. And they will do this until what God has said comes true.
18The woman you saw is the great city that rules over all kings on earth.
translation_text:
Sakalechegboŋ na be asheŋ
1Ndoŋ nna nɛ emalaika ashunu mo nɛ b daa kɔ ntishaŋ ashunu na be eko ba ŋ kutɔ m ba kaŋɛ ma: “Ba nɛ ŋ ŋini fo kananɛ baaŋ gberge sakalechegboŋ na kusoe. Mo e chena nchu damtaana so na. 2Kasawule ere so be bewurgboŋ nɛ sakalechegboŋ na ji abar kesakalea so nɛ durnya ere to be basa malɛ nuu mbe kesakalea be nsa m boo.” 3Kede be kaman nɛ malaika na keta ma kiyoyu to n yɔ kiyi to, ndoŋ nɛ n ya wu kache ko nɛ e tase kusɔbɔya peper ko so nɛ b sibɛ kabɔrɛtegeso be atre n deŋi kusɔbɔya na kikɛ so. Kusɔbɔya na daa kɔ amu ashunu nɛ alambɛ kudu nna. 4Kache na daŋ buu jilmaso be wajɛ peper kunɔkunɔ nɛ wajɛ peper soo nna nɛ shuwa nɛ ajembubi lela nɛ amo be yawu du kpakpa na nɛ abitasɔ kikɛ wɔ mo so a nyɛkpɛ palpal. E daa kɔ shuwa be kawiebi mo nɛ k bɔlɔ alemaŋkar be alubi be asɔ nɛ kesakalea be eyurpi to nna. 5Le be wulo be ketre ere nɛ b daŋ sibɛ n deŋi mbe kasɔto so: “Babilɔn lempo, kesakaleajipoana bumo nio nɛ emo nɛ kasawule so be alemaŋkar be alubi kikɛ shi mo kutɔ.” 6N daŋ wu fanɛ kache na daŋ nuu Ebɔrɛ be basa laraso be ŋklaŋ nɛ bumo nɛ b daŋ ji Yesu be shɛda na be ŋklaŋ nna m boo.
Ŋ ka wu mo nɛ k wora ma kanaŋ ko ga. 7Ndoŋ nna nɛ malaika na kaŋɛ ma: “Manɛ e ba nɛ kesheŋ ere wora fo kanaŋ ko loŋ? Meeŋ bugi kache na nɛ kusɔbɔya nɛ e bee dii nɛ e kɔ amu ashunu nɛ alambɛ kudu na be wulo be kesheŋ na to ŋ ŋini fo.
8Kusɔbɔya mo nɛ fo wu na daa wɔ ŋkpa to nna, ama naniere e maŋ naa wɔ ŋkpa to. A ka gbrɛbi nɛ e shi kemaŋ nɛ baa tre Abis na to n lar nɛ b mur mo. Basa nɛ b wɔ durnya ere to nɛ b maŋ sibɛ bumo be atre n wɔtɔ ŋkpa be kawɔl na to saŋɛ nɛ durnya ere fara kikɛ na kaŋ wu kusɔbɔya na, bumo be nnɔ beeŋ mɔ bumo, ŋkpal manɛ so, e daa wɔ ŋkpa to nna, ama naniere e maŋ naa wɔtɔ, ama mo alɛ kraa beeŋ naŋ ba. 9Kede bre la kagbene mo nɛ k kɔ kanyiasheŋ be demu nna. Amu ashunu na la abeebi ashunu mo nɛ kache na tase so nna, nɛ amo alɛ la bewurgboŋ ashunu. 10Bumo be benu maŋ naa wɔtɔ nɛ ekoŋwule kraa wɔtɔ nɛ a ka ekoŋwule nɛ e lar. Mo alɛ kaŋ ba, a daga fanɛ e chena gbrɛbi. 11Kusɔbɔya mo nɛ e daa wɔ ŋkpa to ŋkaa maŋ naa wɔtɔ na e la ewura burwasopo. E la beshunu mo nɛ b fara m ba na to be eko nna a yɔ nɛ e ya mur. 12Alambɛ kudu mo nɛ fo wu na la bewurgboŋ kudu ko nna nɛ b maŋ naŋ fara a ji kuwura, ama baaŋ nya ekpa n tu kusɔbɔya na n ji kuwura awa koŋwule. 13Bumo basa kudu na kikɛ kɔ nfɛra koŋwule nna a kɔ bumo be eleŋ nɛ ekpa nɛ b kɔ kikɛ a sa kusɔbɔya na. 14Baaŋ kɔ Kpakpafɔlbi na kena, ama Kpakpafɔlbi na beeŋ pɔɔ bumo so, mo e la benyɛnpe to be Enyɛnpe nɛ bewura to be Ewura na. Saŋɛ na so, mo nɛ mbe basa treso nɛ bumo koŋwule na la basa laraso nseŋ naa la mbe bebɛsopo mo nɛ b maa lar mo kaman na beeŋ baa wɔtɔ.” 15Ndoŋ nna nɛ malaika na naŋ kaŋɛ ma: “Nchuana nɛ fo daŋ wu na, kakpa nɛ sakaleche na tase na be kifi to e la basa be nnaŋ to nɛ ejimaŋ nɛ efuliana so ebi nɛ ŋgbarana to ebi. 16Kusɔbɔya na nɛ alambɛ kudu mo nɛ fo wu na beeŋ kishi sakaleche na. Baaŋ sɔ kusɔ kama nɛ e kɔ ŋ ka mo eyurkpaŋ n yili. Baaŋ we mo nseŋ ta edɛ m mur mo. 17Ŋkpal manɛ so, Ebɔrɛ ta kusɔ nɛ e bee sha nɛ k wora na n wɔtɔ bumo be ŋgbene to nɛ baa sha kewora loŋ. Bumo kikɛ beeŋ nya kɔnɔkoŋwule n ta bumo be eleŋ n sa kusɔbɔya na nɛ e ji kuwura loŋ hale nɛ Ebɔrɛ be kɔnɔ e ya bɔla. 18Kache mo nɛ fo wu na e la kadegboŋ mo nɛ k bee ji kuwura kasawule so be bewura so na.”

english_text:
The Fall of Babylon
1I saw another angel come from heaven. This one had great power, and the earth was bright because of his glory. 2 The angel shouted,
“Fallen! Powerful Babylon
has fallen
and is now the home
of demons.
It is the den
of every filthy spirit
and of all unclean birds,
and every dirty
and hated animal.
3 Babylon's evil and immoral wine
has made all nations drunk.
Every king on earth
has slept with her,
and every merchant on earth
is rich because of
her evil desires.”
4 Then I heard another voice
from heaven shout,
“My people, you must escape
from Babylon.
Don't take part in her sins
and share her punishment.
5 Her sins are piled
as high as heaven.
God has remembered the evil
she has done.
6 Treat her as she
has treated others.
Make her pay double
for what she has done.
Make her drink twice as much
of what she mixed
for others.
7 That woman honored herself
with a life of luxury.
Reward her now
with suffering and pain.
“Deep in her heart
Babylon said,
‘I am the queen!
Never will I be a widow
or know what it means
to be sad.’
8And so, in a single day
she will suffer the pain
of sorrow, hunger, and death.
Fire will destroy
her dead body,
because her judge
is the powerful Lord God.”
9 Every king on earth who slept with her and shared in her luxury will mourn. They will weep, when they see the smoke from that fire. 10Her sufferings will frighten them, and they will stand at a distance and say,
“Pity that great
and powerful city!
Pity Babylon!
In a single hour
her judgment has come.”
11 Every merchant on earth will mourn, because there is no one to buy their goods. 12 There won't be anyone to buy their gold, silver, jewels, pearls, fine linen, purple cloth, silk, scarlet cloth, sweet-smelling wood, fancy carvings of ivory and wood, as well as things made of bronze, iron, or marble. 13No one will buy their cinnamon, spices, incense, myrrh, frankincense, wine, olive oil, fine flour, wheat, cattle, sheep, horses, chariots, slaves, and other humans.
14Babylon, the things
your heart desired
have all escaped
from you.
Every luxury
and all your glory
will be lost forever.
You will never
get them back.
15 The merchants had become rich because of her. But when they saw her sufferings, they were terrified. They stood at a distance, crying and mourning. 16Then they shouted,
“Pity the great city
of Babylon!
She dressed in fine linen
and wore purple
and scarlet cloth.
She had jewelry
made of gold
and precious stones
and pearls.
17 Yet in a single hour
her riches disappeared.”
Every ship captain and passenger and sailor stood at a distance, together with everyone who does business by traveling on the sea. 18 When they saw the smoke from her fire, they shouted, “This was the greatest city ever!”
19 They cried loudly, and in their sorrow they threw dust on their heads, as they said,
“Pity the great city
of Babylon!
Everyone who sailed the seas
became rich
from her treasures.
But in a single hour
the city was destroyed.
20 The heavens should be happy
with God's people
and apostles and prophets.
God has punished her
for them.”
21 A powerful angel then picked up a huge stone and threw it into the sea. The angel said,
“This is how the great city
of Babylon
will be thrown down,
never to rise again.
22 The music of harps and singers
and of flutes and trumpets
will no longer be heard.
No workers will ever
set up shop in that city,
and the sound
of grinding grain
will be silenced forever.
23Lamps will no longer shine
anywhere in Babylon,
and couples will never again
say wedding vows there.
Her merchants ruled
the earth,
and by her witchcraft
she fooled all nations.
24 On the streets of Babylon
is found the blood
of God's people
and of his prophets,
and everyone else.”
translation_text:
Babilɔn be ketɔr be asheŋ
1Kede be kaman nɛ n wu malaika ko ka shi ebɔrɛso a ba. E daa kɔ eleŋ ga nɛ mbe kananɛ e bee kpa edɛ na malɛ daŋ fuli to n sɔ kasawule so be kaplɛkama. 2E ka bee ba na nɛ e ponte eleŋso ŋ kaŋɛ:
“K tɔr, Babilɔn be kade lempo tɔr!
Babilɔn ki alizinaana be kowu nɛ ayoyu lubiana kikɛ be eŋanakpa
nɛ mbuibi jiga mo nɛ basa kishi kikɛ be eŋanakpa.
3Ŋkpal manɛ so,
efuli kama so ebi nuu mbe
kesakalealubisheŋ be nsa na.
Kasawule ere so be bewurgboŋ
tu mo n ji kesakalea
nɛ durnya to be yawujipoana na malɛ bɔla mbe dama
be kebaawɔtɔ to n dii dama.”
4N daŋ naŋ nu ebɔl ko ka shi ebɔrɛso ŋ kaŋɛ:
“Ma basa, men lar mbe asheŋ to,
saŋɛ na so men maaŋ tu mo
n luri mbe alubi na to,
saŋɛ na so men maaŋ nya mbe etɔrɔ na be kekama.
5Ŋkpal manɛ so, mbe alubi dii n deŋi abar so nna n ya fo ebɔrɛso
nɛ Ebɔrɛ malɛ bee nyiŋi mbe alubi na kikɛ.
6Men wora mo kananɛ e wora menyi na gbagba chap.
Men laŋɛ kusɔ kama nɛ e wora menyi na
ŋ ka mo loŋ be ale anyɔ.
Men shin nɛ mbe kawiebi
nɛ e ta n wora nsa n sa menyi na e bɔlɔ a kɔ eleŋ
ale anyɔ a chɔ amo nɛ e sa menyi na.
7Men sa mo tɔrɔ nɛ kagbenejija ga
nɛ a fo fanɛ kananɛ e daŋ sa mbe kumu kemaŋkura nɛ dama na,
ŋkpal manɛ so, le nɛ e wɔtɔ a kaŋɛ mbe kumu:
‘Ewurche e la ma nɛ n tase.
M maŋ la ekulpoche, kagbenejija maaŋ tu ma kikɛ.’
8Ŋkpal loŋ so,
mbe etɔrɔ kikɛ beeŋ tu mo kachɛ koŋwule.
A beeŋ baa la luwu nɛ kushu nɛ akoŋ.
Edɛ beeŋ ji mo, ŋkpal manɛ so, Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ
nɛ e bee ji mo demu na
la elempo nna.”
9Kasawule so be bewura mo nɛ b ji kesakalea nseŋ naŋ tu mo n ji mbe dama na kaŋ wu edɛ mo nɛ a bee chɔɔ mo na be edishi, baaŋ boŋ to n shu anishichubi ŋkpal mo so. 10Ebesa mo nɛ e beeŋ ji na be asheŋ beeŋ pɛ bumo kufu nɛ b yili kufɔ nseŋ kaŋɛ:
“O fo, kadegboŋ ere,
asheŋ nya fo, asheŋ nya fo.
O Babilɔn, eleŋ be kadegboŋ,
awa koŋwule nawule to nɛ fo ta
n nya fo kasogberge na.”
11Kasawule so be yawujipoana malɛ gba beeŋ boŋ to nseŋ shu ŋkpal mo so, ŋkpal esa kikɛ ka maaŋ naŋ tɔ bumo be asɔ so. 12B nyi esa kikɛ ka maaŋ naŋ tɔ bumo be eshuwa nɛ egbiti nɛ ajembubi lela nɛ amo be yawu du kpakpa na nɛ abitasɔ nɛ ewajɛ fuful lela nɛ jilmaso be ewajɛ peper kpaw nɛ ago be ewajɛ nɛ ewajɛ peper kunɔkunɔ nɛ ndibi be nnaŋ to nɛ amo be efɛa wɔ ebel nɛ asɔ nɛ b ta ejebotenyi n lɔŋɛ nɛ asɔwurbi kikɛ nɛ b ta yawu kpakpaso be ndibi ŋko ntishaŋ peper ŋko abɛlsoana ŋko awarabi lelaana n lɔŋɛ. 13Baaŋ shu, ŋkpal manɛ so, b nyi esa kikɛ ka maaŋ naŋ tɔ bumo be ndibi be asɔrso mo nɛ basa kɔ a wora ŋku dufɛsoana na nseŋ naa nyi b ka maaŋ tɔ asɔ nɛ b kɔ a wora ŋku mɛlɛmɛlɛbi nɛ bumo be duwu nɛ mir nɛ fraŋkinsensi nɛ bumo be nsa nɛ ɔlifs be ŋku nɛ nyifu peso nɛ bumo be atuwe nɛ bumo be ana nɛ mbolpɔ nɛ egbaŋɛ nɛ egbaŋɛturkoana nɛ anya, kumo e la fanɛ basa be ayoyu gbagba na. 14Baaŋ kaŋɛ mo le: “Asɔ lela mo nɛ fo daŋ ta fo kagbene n wɔtɔ fanɛ fo nya na kikɛ choŋ nna na. Fo dama nɛ fo kemaŋkura na kikɛ foe, esa kama malɛ maaŋ naŋ wu asɔ na kikɛ.” 15Eyawujipoana nɛ b fa asɔ na m bɔla fo so n ji yawu n dii dama na beeŋ ŋana mbe tɔrɔ na nseŋ yili kufɔ m boŋ to n shu anishichubi. 16Baaŋ boŋ to ŋ kaŋɛ le: “O kadegboŋ, asheŋ nya fo, asheŋ nya fo, fo nɛ fo daa buu asɔ fuful lela nɛ jilmaso be ewajɛ peper kpaw nɛ ewajɛ peper kunɔkunɔ nseŋ daŋ ta eshuwa nɛ ajembubi lela nɛ amo be yawu du kpakpa na nɛ abitasɔ a mea fo eyur kikɛ so na, ama keni, awa koŋwule to nɛ loŋ be dama damta na kikɛ mur na.” 17Ekuloŋgboŋ be katɛrɛ nimuso kikɛ nɛ bekama nɛ b wɔ ekuloŋgboŋ to a nite teku so, befarpoana na kikɛ nɛ bekama nyam nɛ baa bɔla nchu so a ji na kikɛ beeŋ yili kufɔ 18n shu awɔrso ŋkpal b ka wu edɛ mo nɛ a bee chɔɔ mo na be edishi so ŋ kaŋɛ: “Cha, kade mo malɛ e daŋ naŋ fo kadegboŋ ere so?” 19Kumo be kaman nɛ b ta shishɛr n wurge bumo be amuana so ŋkeŋ boŋ to n shu anishichubi ŋ kaŋɛ:
“O kadegboŋ,
asheŋ nya fo, asheŋ nya fo.
Kadegboŋ ere to nɛ bekama nɛ b kɔ ekuloŋgboŋana
a shuŋ tekuana so na bɔla mbe
dama so n dii dama,
ŋkeshin nɛ awa koŋwule to nɛ e mur kuraa!
20Ebɔrɛsoebi,
men shin nɛ men be ŋgbene e fuli menyi,
ŋkpal mbe kemur ere so.
Ebɔrɛ be basa laraso nɛ beshuŋipoana nɛ anebiana,
men shin nɛ men be ŋgbene e fuli menyi, ŋkpal manɛ so,
Ebɔrɛ gberge mo kusoe nna ŋkpal kusɔ nɛ e wora menyi na so.”
21Ndoŋ nna nɛ malaika lempo ko maŋ kejembu ko so,
kumo nɛ kuboogboŋ sasa
n ta kumo ŋ kpa n wɔtɔ teku to nseŋ kaŋɛ:
“Loŋ nɛ baaŋ ta Babilɔn be kadegboŋ n lɛ kasawule so eleŋso
nɛ ekama maaŋ naŋ wu kumo kikɛ.
22Esa maaŋ naŋ nu ejaŋjilaŋlampoana
be asheŋ ŋko nshɛbompoana
be asheŋ ŋko nlopifompoana
be asheŋ ŋko mbelfompoana be asheŋ fo to kikɛ.
Esa maaŋ naŋ wu basa
nɛ baa shuŋ a ji yawu kama fo to.
Esa malɛ maŋ naŋ
nu kubo kikɛ be egbri fo to.
23Esa maaŋ naŋ wu fitila be kefulto fo to kikɛ ŋko n naŋ
nu kejafɔ bumo kulana nɛ kejafɔana be ebɔlana ashi fo to.
Fo yawujipoana e daa la durnya ere to kikɛ be bejuŋkparpo,
fo alɛ be ŋkilgi e daŋ shin nɛ durnya kikɛ foe ekpa.”
24Mo, Babilɔn na to nɛ b daŋ wu anebiana
nɛ Ebɔrɛ be basa laraso nɛ bekama nyam
nɛ b daŋ mɔ kasawule ere so na be ŋklaŋ.

english_text:
1After this, I heard what sounded like a lot of voices in heaven, and they were shouting,
“Praise the Lord!
To our God belongs
the glorious power to save,
2 because his judgments
are honest and fair.
That filthy prostitute
ruined the earth
with shameful deeds.
But God has judged her
and made her pay
the price for murdering
his servants.”
3 Then the crowd shouted,
“Praise the Lord!
Smoke will never stop rising
from her burning body.”
4After this, the 24 elders and the four living creatures all knelt before the throne of God and worshiped him. They said, “Amen! Praise the Lord!”
The Marriage Supper of the Lamb
5 From the throne a voice said,
“If you worship
and fear our God,
give praise to him,
no matter who you are.”
6 Then I heard what seemed to be a large crowd that sounded like a roaring flood and loud thunder all mixed together. They were saying,
“Praise the Lord!
Our Lord God All-Powerful
now rules as king.
7So we will be glad and happy
and give him praise.
The wedding day of the Lamb
is here,
and his bride is ready.
8She will be given
a wedding dress
made of pure
and shining linen.
This linen stands for
the good things
God's people have done.”
9 Then the angel told me, “Put this in writing. God will bless everyone who is invited to the wedding feast of the Lamb.” The angel also said, “These things God has said are true.”
10I knelt at the feet of the angel and began to worship him. But the angel said, “Don't do that! I am a servant, just like you and everyone else who tells about Jesus. Don't worship anyone but God. Everyone who tells about Jesus does it by the power of the Spirit.”
The Rider on the White Horse
11 I looked and saw heaven was open, and a white horse was there. Its rider was called Faithful and True, and he is always fair when he judges or goes to war. 12 He had eyes like flames of fire, and he was wearing a lot of crowns. His name was written on him, but he was the only one who knew what the name meant.
13 The rider wore a robe that was covered with blood, and he was known as “The Word of God.” 14He was followed by armies from heaven that rode on white horses and were dressed in pure white linen. 15 From his mouth a sharp sword went out to attack the nations. He will rule them with an iron rod and will show the fierce anger of God All-Powerful by trampling the grapes in the pit where wine is made. 16On the part of the robe that covered his thigh was written, “KING OF KINGS AND Lord OF LordS.”
17 I then saw an angel standing on the sun, and he shouted to all the birds flying in the sky, “Come and join in God's great feast! 18You can eat the flesh of kings, rulers, leaders, horses, riders, free people, slaves, important people, and everyone else.”
19I also saw the beast and all kings of the earth come together. They fought against the rider on the white horse and against his army. 20 But the beast was captured and so was the false prophet. This is the same prophet who had worked miracles for the beast, so he could fool everyone who had the mark of the beast and worshiped the idol. The beast and the false prophet were thrown alive into a lake of burning sulfur. 21But the rest of their army was killed by the sword that came from the mouth of the rider on the horse. Then birds stuffed themselves on the dead bodies.
translation_text:
1Ade be kaman nɛ n nu kusɔ ko fanɛ jimaŋ damta ko be ebɔlana ka shi ebɔrɛso a boŋ to awɔrso a kaŋɛ le:
“Halleluya.
Kumɔlga nɛ kemaŋkura nɛ eleŋ la an be Ebɔrɛ na peya nna.
2Mo alɛ be demuji kɔ kashenteŋ nna nseŋ niŋi.
E gberge sakalechegboŋ mo nɛ e ta mbe kesakaleasheŋ
n jija kasawule ere na kusoe.
E bishi mo kuwule ŋkpal mbe anya be ŋklaŋ so.”
3Ndoŋ nna nɛ basa na naŋ boŋ to ŋ kaŋɛ:
“Halleluya. Edishi mo nɛ a bee shi mo to
a lar na bee dii nna mbaanaayɔ.”
4Nɛ bejuŋkparpo adunyɔ nɛ ana na nɛ asɔbɔya keniso ana gbir n dese kasawule m maŋ Ebɔrɛ mo nɛ e daa tase kuwurputi so na so nseŋ kaŋɛ awɔrso:
“Amɛn. Halleluya.”
5Ndoŋ nna nɛ ebɔl shi kuwurputi na akpa ŋ kaŋɛ:
“Menyi nɛ men la mbe anya na,
men di an be Ebɔrɛ na epaŋ,
menyi nɛ men ŋana mo na kikɛ,
bewurbi nɛ begboŋi kikɛ,
men di mo epaŋ.”
6Mmalga ere be kaman nɛ n nu kusɔ ko ka gbri fanɛ jimaŋ damta ka wora awɔr na. Awɔr na daŋ naa gbri fanɛ nchu damta ka bee shile nna nseŋ daŋ naa gbri fanɛ bɔrɛ ka bee ponte to a boŋ to a kaŋɛ le:
“Halleluya.
Ŋkpal manɛ so, an Nyɛnpetale Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na e wɔ kuwura a ji.
7Men shin nɛ anyi be ŋgbene
e fuli anyi n dese nɛ an sa mo kemaŋkura.
Ŋkpal manɛ so,
Kpakpafɔlbi be kejafɔachɛ na fo
nɛ mbe kejafɔ malɛ gba bela ase n loge.
8E nya wajɛ fuful lela nyɛkpɛso nɛ k walɛ so nɛ e buu.
Kusɔbuuso lela na
e naa yili fanɛ Ebɔrɛ be basa laraso
be alelasheŋ be aworbi.”
9Ndoŋ nna nɛ malaika na kaŋɛ ma le: “Sibɛ n nase fanɛ: Kagbenefuli la bumo nɛ b tre fanɛ b ba Kpakpafɔlbi na be kejafɔ be kejigboŋ to na.” Kumo be kaman nɛ e kaŋɛ le n ti so: “Ade la Ebɔrɛ be kashenteŋ be mmalga nna.” 10Ndoŋ nna nɛ ŋ gbir n dese kasawule mbe anishito nɛ m maŋ mo so nɛ e kaŋɛ ma: “A maŋ daga fanɛ fo wora loŋ, ŋkpal manɛ so, n la fo barkasa kenya nna fanɛ fo nɛ fo niopibiana nɛ b bɛ Yesu be shɛda be ekpa so na, Ebɔrɛ e daga fanɛ fo baa maŋ mo so.” Ŋkpal manɛ so, kashenteŋ mo nɛ Yesu lara ŋ ŋini na e la Kiyoyu mo nɛ e bee leŋ anebiana na to.
Gbaŋɛ fuful be ediipo na be asheŋ
11Ndoŋ nna nɛ n wu ebɔrɛso ka bugi nɛ gbaŋɛ fuful yil. Kumo be ediipo be ketre e la Kebaayɛawora nɛ Kashenteŋ. Ekpa niŋiso nɛ e bee bɔla a ji demu nsaa kɔ kumo a kɔ kena. 12Mbe anishi daa du fanɛ edɛ nɛ a bee suse nna wuloŋwuloŋ nɛ nwurwuro damta malɛ wɔ mbe kumu so. B daŋ sibɛ ketre ko nna n deŋi mo so nɛ mo nawule kpeŋ nyi kumo. 13Mbe kusɔbuuso naŋ nyɔɔ ŋklaŋ nna nɛ mbe ketre daa la Ebɔrɛ be Kamalga. 14Ebɔrɛso be benapo daŋ buu wajɛ fuful lela nɛ a walɛ so n fuli parr nna n dii egbaŋɛ fuful m bɛ mo so. 15Ndoŋ nna nɛ tokobi jiso ko mo nɛ e beeŋ ta ŋ ŋe efuliana so ebi n nase lar mbe kɔnɔ to. E beeŋ ta kagbene kpakpaso n ji kuwura bumo so. Mo gbagba e naaŋ nyaŋ asɔ nɛ a wɔ Enyɛnpetale Ebɔrɛ be agbo be kusɔ nyaŋasɔrso na to. 16Ketre mo nɛ k daa deŋ mbe piŋi nɛ mbe kebembi so e la:
“BEWURA TO BE EWURA NƐ BENYƐNPE TO BE ENYƐNPE.”
17Nɛ n wu malaika ko ka yil epeŋi so nseŋ malga awɔrso ŋ kaŋɛ mbuibi nɛ a bee firgi kumu so na kikɛ le: “Men ba. Men shɛr Ebɔrɛ be kejigboŋ na ase 18n ji bewurgboŋana be eyurana nɛ benapo be benimuana be eyurana nɛ basa lempoana be eyurana nɛ egbaŋɛ nɛ amo be bediipo nɛ basa kikɛ be eyurana nɛ bumo nɛ b wɔ bumo be amu nɛ bumo nɛ b la anya nɛ bewurbi nɛ begboŋi kikɛ be eyurana.”
19Ndoŋ nna nɛ n wu kusɔbɔya na nɛ kasawule ere so be bewura nɛ bumo be benapo ka shɛr m ba nɛ b ba kɔ gbaŋɛ na be ediipo na nɛ mbe benapo kena. 20Nɛ b pɛ kusɔbɔya na n ta anebi fɛpo mo nɛ e daŋ wora emamachisheŋ damta kusɔbɔya na be anishito na n ti so. Emamachisheŋ na nɛ e daŋ ta n fule bumo nɛ b daŋ nya kusɔbɔya na be ndulgi na nseŋ maŋ mbe kaduli so na. B daŋ ta kusɔbɔya na nɛ anebi fɛpo na nna ŋ kpa n wɔtɔ edɛ mo nɛ jɛrbi wɔ amo to a chɔɔ na to nna nɛ b kraa keni. 21Kumo be kaman nɛ b ta tokobi mo nɛ k daŋ shi gbaŋɛ na be ediipo na be kɔnɔ to n lar m mɔ bumo nɛ b daŋ ka na kikɛ nɛ mbuibi ba ji bumo be eyurana m moɛ ŋ kini.

english_text:
The Thousand Years
1I saw an angel come down from heaven, carrying the key to the deep pit and a big chain. 2 He chained the dragon for 1,000 years. It is that old snake, who is also known as the devil and Satan. 3Then the angel threw the dragon into the pit. He locked and sealed it, so 1,000 years would go by before the dragon could fool the nations again. But after that, it would have to be set free for a little while.
4 I saw thrones, and sitting on those thrones were the ones who had been given the right to judge. I also saw the souls of the people who had their heads cut off because they had told about Jesus and preached God's message. They were the same ones who had not worshiped the beast or the idol, and they had refused to let its mark be put on their foreheads or hands. They will come to life and rule with Christ for 1,000 years.
5-6These people are the first to be raised to life, and they are especially blessed and holy. The second death has no power over them. They will be priests for God and Christ and will rule with them for 1,000 years.
No other dead people were raised to life until 1,000 years later.
Satan Is Defeated
7At the end of the 1,000 years, Satan will be set free. 8 He will fool the countries of Gog and Magog, which are at the far ends of the earth, and their people will follow him into battle. They will have as many followers as there are grains of sand along the beach, 9and they will march all the way across the earth. They will surround the camp of God's people and the city God loves. But fire will come down from heaven and destroy the whole army. 10Then the devil who fooled them will be thrown into the lake of fire and burning sulfur. He will be there with the beast and the false prophet, and they will be in pain day and night forever and ever.
The Judgment at the Great White Throne
11 I saw a great white throne with someone sitting on it. Earth and heaven tried to run away, but there was no place for them to go. 12 I also saw all the dead people standing in front of that throne. Every one of them was there, no matter who they had once been. Several books were opened, and then the book of life was opened. The dead were judged by what those books said they had done.
13The sea gave up the dead people who were in it, and death and its kingdom also gave up their dead. Then everyone was judged by what they had done. 14Afterwards, death and its kingdom were thrown into the lake of fire. This is the second death. 15Anyone whose name wasn't written in the book of life was thrown into the lake of fire.
translation_text:
Nfɛ kagboŋ na be asheŋ
1Nɛ n wu malaika ko ka shi ebɔrɛso a ba nɛ kemaŋ mo nɛ baa tre Abis na be esɔfi wɔ mo kutɔ, mo alɛ nseŋ naa kɔ ŋgbɛlɛbi gboŋgboŋi ko mbe enɔ to. 2Ndoŋ nna nɛ e ya nyaŋ kusɔ gbeyeso, mo e la dra na kikɛ be kusɔkpaŋ nɛ baa tre mo koŋwule alubipo ŋko Setani na ŋ kre mo n nase nfɛ kagboŋ. 3E ka kre mo n loge nɛ e ta mo n lɛ n wɔtɔ kemaŋ nɛ baa tre Abis to na nseŋ ber kumo so n ta tɔɔnɛ be kebersobi n dulgi kumo n ti so, saŋɛ na so e maaŋ naŋ nya n fule efuliana so ebi, ama nfɛ kagboŋ na ya choŋ nna. Nfɛ kagboŋ na be kaman a daga fanɛ b saŋɛ mo n lɛ gbrɛbi.
4Nɛ n naŋ wu kuwurputiana nɛ bumo nɛ b daa tase amo so na kikɛ. B daŋ sa bumo ekpa nna fanɛ b ji basa demu. Ma alɛ daŋ naŋ wu basa nɛ b daŋ mɔ ŋkpal b ka daŋ ji Yesu be shɛda so nɛ ŋkpal b ka daŋ malga Ebɔrɛ be kamalga na so na be ayoyu. Bumo alɛ daa maŋ maŋ kusɔbɔya na ŋko mbe kaduli na so, bumo alɛ daa maŋ naa kɔ mbe ndulgi na bumo be nsɔto so ŋko bumo be enɔana so. B daŋ naŋ nya ŋkpa nna n tu Kristo n ji kuwura nfɛ kagboŋ. 5Bubuni mo nɛ b daŋ ka na bre daa maŋ tiŋi luwu to ama nfɛ kagboŋ na e ba choŋ.
6Ketiŋi luwu to juŋkparso nna na. Kagbenefuli nɛ kebaawɔtɔ cheembi la bekama nɛ b ti bumo nɛ baaŋ tiŋi luwu be ketiŋi juŋkparso na to so. Luwu nyɔsopo na maŋ kɔ eleŋ bumo so. Baaŋ ki Ebɔrɛ nɛ Kristo be bɔrɛmatapoana, bumo alɛ beeŋ tu mo n ji kuwura nfɛ kagboŋ.
Setani be kemur be asheŋ
7Nfɛ kagboŋ na be kaman, baaŋ saŋɛ Setani ashi mbe kabuti to. 8Nɛ e lar n fule efuliana so ebi ashi kasawule so be abonfu ana kikɛ, bumo e la Gɔg nɛ Magɔg ebi na n shɛr bumo nɛ b kɔ kena. Bumo be keshi daa sa fanɛ teku ase be shishɛr. 9Nɛ b yili kasawule be mparto be kaba ko n nite m ba choŋ kaba ko ŋ kulti Ebɔrɛ be basa laraso n wɔtɔ bumo be kakpa, kumo e la kadegboŋ shaso na. Ama edɛ daŋ shi esoso nna m ba mur basa nɛ b daŋ kulti Ebɔrɛ be basa n wɔtɔ na. 10Ndoŋ nna nɛ b ta alubipo mo nɛ e daŋ fule bumo na n lɛ n wɔtɔ edɛ mo nɛ jɛrbi wɔ amo to a chɔɔ na be kepa to, kakpa nɛ b daŋ ta kusɔbɔya na nɛ anebi fɛpo na n lɛ to na. Baaŋ tɔrɔ bumo ga kapa nɛ kanyɛ mbaanaayɔ.
B ka ji bumo nɛ b wu na demu be asheŋ
11Ndoŋ nna nɛ n naŋ wu kuwurputigboŋ fuful ko nɛ esa nɛ e daa tase kumo so. Nɛ kasawule nɛ awɔlpa foe mbe anishito a maŋ naa kɔ kakpa ndoŋ. 12Nɛ n wu bubuni, begboŋi nɛ bewurbi kikɛ nɛ b yil kuwurputi na akpa nɛ b bugi nwɔl. Amo be kaman nɛ b bugi kawɔl ko malɛ, kumo e la ŋkpa be kawɔl na. Nɛ b bɔla nwɔlana na to ŋ keni n wu asɔ nɛ ebuni kama daŋ wora n yili amo so n ji mo demu. 13Nɛ etekuana shin nɛ basa nɛ b daŋ wu amo to na lar nɛ luwu nɛ bubuni be kakpa malɛ gba shin nɛ basa nɛ b daŋ wu a wɔ amo to na malɛ gba lar nɛ b yili asɔ nɛ ekama daŋ wora so n ji mo demu. 14Ndoŋ nna nɛ b ta luwu nɛ bubuni be kakpa malɛ n lɛ n wɔtɔ edɛ be kepa to. Edɛ be kepa na e la luwu nyɔsopo na. 15Esa kama nɛ b daa maŋ sibɛ mbe ketre n wɔtɔ ŋkpa be kawɔl na to, b ta mo nna n lɛ edɛ be kepa na to.

english_text:
The New Heaven and the New Earth
1 I saw a new heaven and a new earth. The first heaven and the first earth had disappeared, and so had the sea. 2 Then I saw New Jerusalem, the holy city, coming down from God in heaven. It was like a bride dressed in her wedding gown and ready to meet her husband.
3 I heard a loud voice shout from the throne:
God's home is now with his people. He will live with them, and they will be his own. Yes, God will make his home among his people. 4 He will wipe all tears from their eyes, and there will be no more death, suffering, crying, or pain. These things of the past are gone forever.
5Then the one sitting on the throne said:
I am making everything new. Write down what I have said. My words are true and can be trusted. 6 Everything is finished! I am Alpha and Omega, the beginning and the end. I will freely give water from the life-giving fountain to everyone who is thirsty. 7 All who win the victory will be given these blessings. I will be their God, and they will be my people.
8But I will tell you what will happen to cowards and to everyone who is unfaithful or dirty-minded or who murders or is sexually immoral or uses witchcraft or worships idols or tells lies. They will be thrown into that lake of fire and burning sulfur. This is the second death.
The New Jerusalem
9I saw one of the seven angels who had the bowls filled with the seven last terrible troubles. The angel came to me and said, “Come on! I will show you the one who will be the bride and wife of the Lamb.” 10 Then with the help of the Spirit, he took me to the top of a very high mountain. There he showed me the holy city of Jerusalem coming down from God in heaven.
11The glory of God made the city bright. It was dazzling and crystal clear like a precious jasper stone. 12 The city had a high and thick wall with twelve gates, and each one of them was guarded by an angel. On each of the gates was written the name of one of the twelve tribes of Israel. 13Three of these gates were on the east, three were on the north, three more were on the south, and the other three were on the west. 14The city was built on twelve foundation stones. On each of the stones was written the name of one of the Lamb's twelve apostles.
15 The angel who spoke to me had a gold measuring stick to measure the city and its gates and its walls. 16The city was shaped like a cube, because it was just as high as it was wide. When the angel measured the city, it was about 2,400 kilometers high and 2,400 kilometers wide. 17Then the angel measured the wall, and by our measurements it was about 60 meters high.
18 The wall was built of jasper, and the city was made of pure gold, clear as crystal. 19Each of the twelve foundations was a precious stone. The first was jasper, the second was sapphire, the third was agate, the fourth was emerald, 20the fifth was onyx, the sixth was carnelian, the seventh was chrysolite, the eighth was beryl, the ninth was topaz, the tenth was chrysoprase, the eleventh was jacinth, and the twelfth was amethyst. 21Each of the twelve gates was a solid pearl. The streets of the city were made of pure gold, clear as crystal.
22I did not see a temple there. The Lord God All-Powerful and the Lamb were its temple. 23 And the city did not need the sun or the moon. The glory of God was shining on it, and the Lamb was its light.
24 Nations will walk by the light of that city, and kings will bring their riches there. 25 Its gates are always open during the day, and night never comes. 26The glorious treasures of nations will be brought into the city. 27 But nothing unworthy will be allowed to enter. No one who is dirty-minded or who tells lies will be there. Only those whose names are written in the Lamb's book of life will be in the city.
translation_text:
Ebɔrɛso popɔr nɛ kasawule popɔr na be asheŋ
1Ndoŋ nna nɛ n wu ebɔrɛso popɔr nɛ kasawule popɔr, ŋkpal manɛ so, ebɔrɛso dra na nɛ kasawule dra na daa maŋ naa wɔtɔ nɛ etekuana malɛ gba daa maŋ naa wɔtɔ. 2Nɛ n wu kadegboŋ cheembi na, kumo e la Jerusalɛm popɔr na ka shi Ebɔrɛ kutɔ ashi ebɔrɛso fanɛ kejafɔ ka mea to nɛ e tu mo kul na. 3Kumo be kaman nɛ n nu ebɔl ko awɔrso ka shi kuwurputi na akpa ŋ kaŋɛ: “Naniere bre, basa to e ki kakpa nɛ Ebɔrɛ ba nɛ e ba kaa wɔ. Mo nɛ basa beeŋ ba kaa wɔtɔ nɛ b baa la mbe basa. Ebɔrɛ gbagba e naaŋ ba kaa wɔ bumo to a la bumo be Ebɔrɛ. 4E beeŋ kpra anishichubi kikɛ ashi bumo be anishito, luwu maaŋ naa wɔtɔ, luwu so be kagbenejija nɛ kushu maaŋ naa wɔtɔ, ebesa malɛ gba maaŋ naa wɔtɔ, ŋkpal manɛ so, amo be saŋɛ nɛ sososo be asheŋ kikɛ beeŋ choŋ.” 5Nɛ emo nɛ e daa tase kuwurputi na so na kaŋɛ le: “Mee ta kusɔ kama nna a ki kepopɔr.” Kumo be kaman nɛ e naŋ kaŋɛ ma le: “Sibɛ asɔ ere n nase, ŋkpal manɛ so, a la mmalga mo nɛ a la kashenteŋ nna nseŋ naa la asɔ nɛ baaŋ tiŋ n yirda.” 6Nɛ e naŋ kaŋɛ: “K teŋ wora. Ma e la Alfa nɛ Omega, Faraŋko nɛ Lalaloge. Ekama nɛ achukoŋ kɔ mo, meeŋ jɔ nchu ashi ŋkpa be kebuye to n sa mo nɛ e nuu ŋkaa maaŋ ka shɛŋ. 7Ekama nɛ e kɔ m pɔɔ so beeŋ nya ade kikɛ, nɛ m baa la amodoŋwura be Ebɔrɛ nɛ mo alɛ e baa la m pibi. 8Ama befupo bre nɛ bumo nɛ b maa yirda na nɛ basa jiga nɛ bemɔpo nɛ kesakaleasheŋ wuraana nɛ bumo nɛ baa wora ŋ kilgi nɛ agbirshumpoana nɛ befɛpo kikɛ bre kikɛ be kaboŋ e la edɛ be kepa nɛ jɛrbi wɔ kumo to a chɔɔ na to. Ndoŋ be luwu e la luwu nyɔsopo na.”
Jerusalɛm popɔr na be asheŋ
9Ndoŋ nna nɛ emalaika ashunu mo nɛ b daa kɔ ntishaŋ ashunu nɛ a daŋ bɔlɔ lalaloge be etɔrɔ ashunu na be eko ba ŋ kutɔ m ba kaŋɛ ma le: “Ba nɛ ŋ ŋini fo kejafɔ na, Kpakpafɔlbi na be eche na.” 10Ndoŋ nna nɛ e ta ma kiyoyu to n yɔ kebee gboŋgboŋi jeŋgreŋ ko so n ya ŋini ma kadegboŋ cheembi na, kumo e la Jerusalɛm na nɛ k shi Ebɔrɛ kutɔ ashi ebɔrɛso a ba. 11Nɛ kadegboŋ na kikɛ sɔ Ebɔrɛ be kemaŋkura a nyɛkpɛ so palpal fanɛ kejembubi mo nɛ baa tre jaspa nɛ k bee wu to fanɛ abɔrɛjembubi na. 12Kade na daa kɔ egbal gboŋgboŋi ko nna nsaa kɔ mbuna kuduanyɔ nɛ emalaika kuduanyɔ yil a keni amo so. B daŋ sibɛ Israɛl be nnaŋ kuduanyɔ na be ekama be ketre nna n deŋi kabuna kama so. 13Mbuna asa e daa wɔ epeŋilarkpa be kaba so nɛ mbuna asa wɔ kelargato be esoso be kaba so nɛ mbuna asa wɔ kelargato be kaseto be kaba so nɛ mbuna asa wɔ epeŋitɔrkpa be kaba so. 14Kadegboŋ na be egbal daa kɔ egbaltɔlase kuduanyɔ nɛ gbaltɔlase kama malɛ daa kɔ Kpakpafɔlbi na be beshuŋipo kuduanyɔ na be ekoŋwule kama be ketre.
15Malaika mo nɛ e daŋ malga ŋ kutɔ na daa kɔ shuwa be kekpabi nɛ b kɔ a karga asɔ enɔ to nna nɛ e ta ŋ karga kadegboŋ na nɛ kumo be mbuna nɛ kumo be egbal. 16Kade na kikɛ daŋ bonte nna a dese nɛ kumo be nteŋ nɛ mparto kikɛ sasa. Malaika na ka ta mbe kekpabi na ŋ karga kade na, kumo be nteŋ daa wɔ emayɛl kagboŋ nɛ alfa anu nɛ kumo be mparto nɛ kumo be jeŋgreŋ malɛ gba kikɛ daa sa loŋ. 17Kumo be kaman nɛ malaika na karga egbal na be jeŋgreŋ n nya ayadra alfa anyɔ nɛ kuduashe. Basa be kekargato nɛ malaika na daŋ ta ŋ karga na. 18Jaspa be ajembu nɛ b daŋ ta m pɔr egbal na nseŋ ta shuwa gbagba malɛ nɛ a bee wu to fanɛ digi n wora kadegboŋ na malɛ kikɛ. 19Ajembu nɛ amo be yawu du kpakpa be yiri kikɛ malɛ nɛ b daŋ ta n ji kadegboŋ na be egbaltɔlaseana kebita. Jaspa be kejembu nɛ b daŋ ta m mea gbaltɔlase juŋkparso na n ta kejembu mo nɛ baa tre safiri na n wora kenyɔsopo na n ta chalkedoni malɛ n wora gbaltɔlase sasopo na nseŋ ta kejembu mo nɛ baa tre ɛmeraldi na n wora kenasopo. 20Sardɔniksi nɛ b daŋ ta n wora gbaltɔlase nusopo nseŋ ta sardie n wora keshesopo na n ta krisolit n wora keshunusopo na. Kuburwasopo na peya e la berɛl, kekpanusopo e la kejembu mo nɛ baa tre topas na, kudusopo peya e la krisoprasi nɛ kudukakosopo peya la jasinɛf. Kejembu kuduanyɔsopo mo nɛ b daŋ ta n wora gbaltɔlase kuduanyɔsopo na nɛ baa tre ametiste. 21Mbuna kuduanyɔ na daa la asɔ nɛ baa tre apɛl na nna. Pɛɛl koŋwule nɛ b daŋ ta n lɔŋɛ kabuna na be kekama. Kadegboŋ na be kubɔrbi daa la shuwa gbagba nna a wu to fanɛ digi.
22N daa maŋ wu bɔrɛlambu kama kadegboŋ na to, ŋkpal manɛ so, Enyɛnpetale Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ nɛ Kpakpafɔlbi na e la ndoŋ be bɔrɛlambu. 23Epeŋi be kenyaŋɛ ŋko kufɔl be kefulto ndoŋ be asheŋ daa maŋ tir kadegboŋ na to ebi kikɛ, ŋkpal manɛ so, Ebɔrɛ be kemaŋkura e daa nyaŋɛ a yuu kade na so nɛ Kpakpafɔlbi na malɛ la kumo be fitila. 24Kumo be kefulto nɛ efuliana so ebi beeŋ wu n nite nɛ kasawule ere so be bewurgboŋana e bar bumo be kemaŋkura kumo to. 25Ndoŋ be mbuna maa ti kikɛ, ŋkpal manɛ so, kanyɛ maa biri ndoŋ kikɛ. 26Baaŋ bar efuliana so be kemaŋkura nɛ amo be bunyaŋ kade na to. 27Eyurpi be kusɔ kikɛ maaŋ luri ndoŋ kikɛ. Esa kama malɛ gba nɛ e bee wora anishinyɔrsheŋ ŋko a fule, e maaŋ luri ndoŋ kikɛ. Bumo nɛ b sibɛ bumo be atre n wɔtɔ Kpakpafɔlbi na be ŋkpa be kawɔl na to na nawule e naaŋ luri ndoŋ.

english_text:
1 The angel showed me a river that was crystal clear, and its waters gave life. The river came from the throne where God and the Lamb were seated. 2 Then it flowed down the middle of the city's main street. On each side of the river are trees that grow a different kind of fruit each month of the year. The fruit gives life, and the leaves are used as medicine to heal the nations.
3 God's curse will no longer be on the people of that city. He and the Lamb will be seated there on their thrones, and its people will worship God 4 and will see him face to face. God's name will be written on the foreheads of the people. 5 Never again will night appear, and no one who lives there will ever need a lamp or the sun. The Lord God will be their light, and they will rule forever.
The Coming of Christ
6Then I was told:
These words are true and can be trusted. The Lord God controls the spirits of his prophets, and he is the one who sent his angel to show his servants what must happen very soon. 7Remember, I am coming soon! God will bless everyone who pays attention to the message of this book.
8My name is John, and I am the one who heard and saw these things. Then after I had heard and seen all this, I knelt down and began to worship at the feet of the angel who had shown it to me.
9But the angel said,
Don't do that! I am a servant, just like you. I am the same as a follower or a prophet or anyone else who obeys what is written in this book. God is the one you should worship.
10Don't keep the prophecies in this book a secret. These things will happen soon.
11 Evil people will keep on being evil, and everyone who is dirty-minded will still be dirty-minded. But good people will keep on doing right, and God's people will always be holy.
12 Then I was told:
I am coming soon! And when I come, I will reward everyone for what they have done. 13 I am Alpha and Omega, the first and the last, the beginning and the end.
14 God will bless all who have washed their robes. They will each have the right to eat fruit from the tree that gives life, and they can enter the gates of the city. 15But outside the city will be dogs, witches, immoral people, murderers, idol worshipers, and everyone who loves to tell lies and do wrong.
16 I am Jesus! And I am the one who sent my angel to tell all of you these things for the churches. I am David's Great Descendant, and I am also the bright morning star.
17 The Spirit and the bride say, “Come!”
Everyone who hears this should say, “Come!”
If you are thirsty, come! If you want life-giving water, come and take it. It's free!
18 Here is my warning for everyone who hears the prophecies in this book:
If you add anything to them, God will make you suffer all the terrible troubles written in this book. 19If you take anything away from these prophecies, God will not let you have part in the life-giving tree and in the holy city described in this book.
20The one who has spoken these things says, “I am coming soon!”
So, Lord Jesus, please come soon!
21I pray that the Lord Jesus will be kind to all of you.
translation_text:
Ŋkpa be lɔr be asheŋ
1Malaika na daŋ ŋini ma ŋkpa be lɔr be nchu gba nɛ a bee wu to fanɛ abɔrɛjembubi ashi Ebɔrɛ nɛ Kpakpafɔlbi be kuwurputiakpa 2a shile a bɔla kadegboŋ na be kubɔrbi be nferinto so. Ŋkpa be kedibi daa yil lɔr na be kaba kama so nna a sɔr kumo be asɔrso ale kuduanyɔ, kumo e la fanɛ kufɔl kikɛ to nɛ kumo be asɔrso. Kedibi na be afantaŋ e la efuliana be kechɛ be asɔ. 3Kusɔ kama nɛ Ebɔrɛ so kɔnɔ maaŋ naa wɔ ndoŋ. Ebɔrɛ nɛ Kpakpafɔlbi na be kuwurputi e naaŋ baa wɔ ndoŋ nɛ mbe anya e baa maŋ mo so. 4Baaŋ wu mbe anishiakpa nɛ mbe ketre malɛ e baa deŋ bumo be nsɔtoana so. 5Kanyɛ maaŋ naa wɔ ndoŋ. Fitila be kefulto ŋko epeŋi be kefulto be asheŋ maaŋ naŋ tir bumo, ŋkpal manɛ so, Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ e naaŋ baa sa bumo kefulto. Bumo alɛ beeŋ ji kuwura mbaanaayɔ.
6Nɛ malaika na kaŋɛ ma le: “Mmalga ere la kashenteŋ nna nɛ baaŋ tiŋ n yirda amo. Amo alɛ so nɛ Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ malɛ ta mbe Kiyoyu na n sa mbe anebi nseŋ shuŋi mbe malaika fanɛ e ba ŋini mbe anya asɔ nɛ a maaŋ naŋ chɛr nseŋ wora na kikɛ. 7Yesu yɛ: ‘Men keni, m maaŋ naŋ chɛr nseŋ ba. Kagbenefuli beeŋ baa la ekama nɛ e bee ta mmalgawuŋkaŋɛ nɛ a wɔ kawɔl ere to ere a wɔtɔ mbe kagbene to peya nna.’ ”
8Ma Jɔn e nu nseŋ wu asɔ ere kikɛ. Ma alɛ ka daŋ nu amo nseŋ wu amo nɛ ŋ gbir n dese kasawule malaika mo nɛ e daa ŋini ma asɔana na be anishito nɛ m maŋ mo so 9nɛ e kaŋɛ ma le: “A maŋ daga fanɛ fo wora loŋ. Ma alɛ gba la fo nɛ fo niopibiana anebiana nɛ bumo nɛ baa ta kawɔl ere to be mmalga a wɔtɔ bumo be ŋgbene to na bumo barkasa kenya nna. Ebɔrɛ e daga fanɛ fo baa maŋ mo so.”
10Kede be kaman nɛ e kaŋɛ ma: “Sa maŋ kaŋ ta le be mmalgawuŋkaŋɛ ere ŋ ŋana wulo to, ŋkpal manɛ so, jemanɛ na bee taga to. 11Esa kama nɛ e bee wora alubi e baa kraa wora amo, ekama malɛ nɛ e kɔ eyurpi mo to e baa kraa du loŋ. Ekama nɛ e bee wora alela e baa kraa wora alela na nɛ ekama malɛ nɛ e du cheembi e baa kraa du cheembi loŋ.”
12E yɛ: “Keni nfe, m maaŋ naŋ chɛr nseŋ ba. Ma alɛ kɔ ma kakɔka nna a ba nɛ m ba yili kanaŋkama nɛ ekama shuŋ so ŋ ka mo. 13Ma e la Alfa nɛ Omega, Faraŋko nɛ Lalaloge nɛ Ejuŋkparpo nɛ Emantopo na. 14Kagbenefuli la bekama nɛ b fɔr bumo be epiŋi nɛ a lar so nseŋ nya ekpa nɛ b ji ŋkpa be kedibi na be asɔrso nseŋ naŋ nya m bɔla mbuna to na n luri kadegboŋ na to na peya nna. 15Bumo nɛ b la njɔnɔ nɛ basa nɛ baa wora ŋ kilgi nɛ kesakaleawuraana nɛ bemɔpo nɛ agbirshumpoana nɛ esa kama nɛ e bee sha nsaa bɛ efɛsheŋ kama so na nawule e maŋ wɔ kadegboŋ na to.
16Ma Yesu e shuŋi ma malaika nɛ e ba ta le be shɛda be kubɔya ere m bɔ n sa asɔriana na. N la Ewura Deevid be kanaŋ to be Ejuŋkparpo nna nseŋ naa la mo Nanabi nɛ kachipurso be Nyanwuleji fuliso parr nna.”
17Ndoŋ nna nɛ Kiyoyu na nɛ kejafɔ na kaŋɛ: “Ba.” Ekama malɛ gba nɛ e nu loŋ e kaŋɛ: “Ba.” Ekama nɛ achukoŋ kɔ mo e ba, ekama malɛ nɛ e bee sha e ba sɔ ŋkpa be nchu na n nuu ŋkaa maaŋ ka shɛŋ.
18Mee fiɛ ekama nɛ e nu kewuŋkaŋɛ ere be mmalga mo nɛ a wɔ kawɔl ere to ere so nna fanɛ ekama nɛ e ta kusɔ kama n ti amo so, Ebɔrɛ beeŋ ta etɔrɔ mo nɛ b malga amo be asheŋ kawɔl ere to ere n ti amodoŋwura so. 19Ekama malɛ nɛ e lara mmalga ashi abɔrɛsheŋ wuŋkaŋɛ be kawɔl ere to, Ebɔrɛ beeŋ lara mbe kachigeso ashi ŋkpa be kedibi be asɔrso na to nseŋ naŋ lara mbe kachigeso ashi kadegboŋ cheembi nɛ b malga kumo nɛ ŋkpa be kedibi sɔrso be kananɛ a du be asheŋ ashi kawɔl ere to na.
20Esa nɛ e bee ji asheŋ ere be shɛda e naa kaŋɛ fanɛ: “Kashenteŋto, m maaŋ naŋ chɛr nseŋ ba.” Amɛn, Enyɛnpe Yesu, ba naniere! 21Enyɛnpe Yesu be kuwɔr be kakɛ e baa wɔ Ebɔrɛ be basa kikɛ so. Amɛn.
